yathā śrutiliṅgādibhirvini- yuktāḥ padārthāḥ prayogavidhinā vidhīyante tathā śrutyarthā- dibhirviniyuktatvāt kramo'pi prayogavidhinā vidhīyate |
na ca tātarthyaiḥ śrutiliṅgādibhireva sarvasya viniyoja- katvena |
tanniyamasya padārthaviniyogamātraviṣayatvena kramasya pāṭhādikaśrutyādibhiḥ viniyoge'pyaviro- ghāta, yathā
vi. 313|2. kaṇikā. pṛ. 177. viniyogavedadharmaḥ kartavyaḥ na utpattivedadharmaḥ |
vā. 3|2|1 pṛ. 814. viniyogaśaktyā anvayamātraparicchedāt anvaya- viṣayakāryatvaṃnupapatteḥ |
su. pṛ. 100. viniyogasādhāraṇyavidhiyathā- 'yadātithyāyāṃ barhistupyadāṃ tadmīpobhīyastva' iti |
yathā vā barhiṣaḥ bahirdharmāṇāṃ ca, vedyāḥ vedidharmāṇāṃ ca vidhiḥ aṅga- pradhānasādhāraṇaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1209. viniyojakāni pramāṇāni ṣaṭ (pramāṇa śabdaḥ vaidika
viprapittau virodhe sati pāśaikatvābhidhāyinā mantreṇa saha pāśabahutvābhidhāyino mantrasya vikalpaḥ syāt |
samatvāt, pāśonmocanakriyāyāṃ karmatvena pāśābhi- dhānasya ubhayorapi mantrayoḥ avaśiṣṭatvāt |
nanu tathāpi bahuvacanasya bahupāśake prayoge arthavattā tasāt bahuvacanaṃ utkarṣaṃ utkṛṣṭhe ca tasmin prātipadikasyāpi syādutkarṣaḥ |
guṇe tu pradhāne bahuvacane anyāyakalpanā kartuṃ śakyate pāśasya ekatvena bahuvacanaṃ anyāyaḥ avikṣaṇīyaṃ tat iti vaktuṃ śakyate vacanasya ekadeśatvāt |
prātipadikaṃ pradhānaṃ tatra na anyāya- kalpanā kartuṃ śakyā iti prātipadikārtho vivakṣaṇīya eveti notkarṣaḥ |
tasmāt prakṛtau ekavacanāntavat bahuvacanānto'pi mantraḥ vikalpena niviśate iti siddhāntaḥ |
agnīṣomīye paśau pāśaikatvābhidhāyī pāśabahutvā- bhidhāyī ca mantrau vikalpena ubhāvapi niviśate sama- tvāt ityuktam, tatra samatvaṃ sādhayati |
'prakaraṇaviśeṣataḥ' iti pāṭho'tra upayuktaḥ, sa tu na kāpi upalabhyate |
agnīṣomīyapaśuprakaraṇe pāśaikatvapāśabahutvābhidhāyinau dvau mantrau śāstrābhedena āmnātau dvāvapi prakaraṇe eva niviśete iti siddhāntinā, pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
nāntakathaṃḥ kiṃtu pāśa- bahutvābhidhāyino mantrasya bahupāśake vicāre utkarṣaḥ syāt |
dviyajñavat 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī' iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kurvata ' ityuktvāt dviyajñe dvayoḥ yajamānayoḥ yajñe kulāyayajñe 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ' ityasyāḥ pratipadaṃ utkarṣaḥ kriyate tadvat |

'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī' ityasyāḥ pratipadaḥ yathā jyotiṣṭomāt ekayajamānāt dvayajamānake kulāyayajñe utkarṣaḥ evaṃ pāśabahutvābhidhāyino mantrasya 'aditiḥ pāśān pramumoktvetān' ityasya bahupāśake utkarṣaḥ syāt iti pūrvapakṣīṇaḥ śaṅkāṃ nirasyati siddhāntī |
arthā- bhāvāt arthasya yajamānadvitvasya abhidhome abhāvāt evaṃ 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ' iti pratipadaḥ niveśaḥ na syāt |
guṇamātraṃ pāśabahutvamātraṃ evaṃ pratipadat prakṛtau niviṣṭaṃ na syāt nāpi utkarṣaṃ syāt |
kiṃtu bahuvacanaṃ avivakṣitaṃ vā syāt pāśā- vathavivakṣayā vā upapannaṃ syāt prakṛtau eva |
itarattu evaṃ syāt itarat prātipadikaṃ tu evaṃ prakṛtau samavetattvāt niviṣṭaṃ syāt |

yathā 'dyāvāpṛthivyorahaṃ devayajanamayorlokayo- rṛdhyāsam' iti dyāvāpṛthivyanuṣṭhānamantro yājamānaḥ prakṛteḥ sakāśāt tadevatāke karmaṇi utkṛṣyate tathā pāśa- bahutvābhidhāyī mantraḥ bahupaśuke karmaṇi utkṛṣyatāṃ iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
yathā dyāvoḥ tathā pāśamantraḥ iti yojanā |

darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe paṭhitaḥ dyāvāpṛthivyānumantra- mantro yājamānaḥ tadevatāke karmaṇi utkṛṣyate tathā pāśabahutvābhidhāyī mantraḥ paśau paṭhitaḥ bahupaśuke utkṛ- ṣyatāṃ iti pūrvapakṣīḥ śaṅkāṃ nirasyati siddhāntī |
dyāvostyeti cet, na, pāśamantrasya utpattiśabdatvāt dyāvāpṛthivyānumantraṇamantrasya tu utpattiśabdābhāvāt |
pāśabahutvābhidhāyī mantraḥ prakṛtāveva paśu vihitaḥ iti vaiṣamyam |
tasmāt dvau api mantrau avikalpena pravartate iti siddhāntaḥ |

moktvete, aditiḥ pāśān pramumoktvetān' iti eka- vacanabahuvacanāntamantrayoḥ dvaidhakaraṇāmnāyayoḥ bahu- vacanāntasya ekapāśake karmaṇi asamavetārthatvāt utkarṣaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā bahuvacanasya asamavetārthatve'pi tadanu- rodhena anupasaṃjātavirodha
tatra aindraḥ puroḍāśaḥ prājāpatyaṃ ca dadhi tayoḥ aindrayāsānāyya- vikāratvāt amāvāsyādharmapekṣā, madhuvratāpāṃ tu upāṃśu- yājavikāratvāt paurṇamāsikadharmapekṣā |
tadeteṣu saptasu yāgeṣu sahaprakrānteṣu paurṇamāsīkāryāṇāṃ vātrdhau ādhya- bhāgamantrau prāptau, darśavikārayostu dvayoḥ vṛdhanvanto grātau, bhuyasāṃ madhvādīnāṃ dharmo vātrdhau anumīyate'tha iti |
vipratiṣiddhadharmasamavāye bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharma- tvam (12|1|22) ityasmāt 'mukhyaṃ vā pūrvvanodanāllokavat' (12|1|23) ityasya bhinnā- dhikaraṇātā |
pṛ. 812, alpasya mukhyatve'pi bhūyo'nusāritvaṃ sūcitaṃ anena nyāyena |
oṃ vipratiṣedhe karaṇaḥ samavāyaviśeṣāditara- mantrasyeti yato viśeṣaḥ syāt |
tasya yūpasya paripyāṇe mantrau- eka ādhvaryavaḥ 'parivīrasi' iti karaḥ, aparo hotuḥ 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti kriyamāṇānuvādaḥ |
kaḥ punarasau? atra ṛtvikamasāsa āmnātaḥ 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' iti |
kiṃ karaṇāt ādhvaryavaṃ hotā kuryāt kiṃvā hotraṃ kriyamāṇānuvādadinamimaṃ |

atrāyaṃ pūrvvapakṣaḥ- 'parivīrasi, yuvā suvāsāḥ' ityetayoḥ karaṇīkriyamāṇānuvādayordhvayunā hotrā ca prakṛtau yugapatprayuktayoḥ kauṇḍapāyināmanaye 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' iti vacanena hotradhvaryukarmaṇorekakartṛtva- mevāgamyate |
tatrāpi prayogopanipatitamanupātajivirodhaṃ hotṛśabdadeva mukhyatve parigṛhya caramopanipatito virodhaścā prāpto'dhvaryuśabdaḥ kāryalakṣaṇārtho varṇanīyaḥ |
tena hotraiva karaṇīkriyamāṇānuvādinau mantrau prayoktavyā- viti prāpnoti |
na cobhayamantraprayogaṃ kartuṃ yugapadekaḥ śaknotītyaniyamana kadācit karaṇamantrasya kadācit kriyamāṇānuvādino mantrasya hotrā prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
athavā 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' ityajahatsva- kāryasyaiva hotṛtvādhvaryavidhitvāt svatantraṃ kriyamāṇānu- vādī hotā prayoktavyaḥ |
atideśāccopadeśo balavāniti karaṇamantra eva hotrā prayoktavyaḥ |
yatrajahatsvakāryaṃ eva hotā ādhvaryaveṇa saṃvadhyate ityuktam, na hi hotrā yogādvātrdham |
yathā rājñaḥ karma rājyam, na tu rājyayogādrājñeti |
upadeśasāmarthyāt hotā karaṇa eva mantraḥ prayoktavyaḥ |
nanu karaṇasya 'mantrāntena karmādisaṃni- pātaḥ' (12|1|125) ityanena nyāyena paricayāṇā- diyasya karaṇamantrasya prayogaḥ prāpnoti, kriyamāṇānuvā- dinastu kriyamāṇe eva paricayāṇe prayogaḥ |
tena bhinnakāla- yormantrayorekenapi hotrā prajyāmanayone kaścidvirodhaḥ |
'yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīrasi' iti mantre'pi asītyanena saṃnihito yūpo nirdiśyate |
ratnācchādanāya paricayāṇāya yūpamupasthitasyāsau yūpaḥ saṃnihito bhavati |
evaṃ ca satyupadeśāt hotṛprati- puruṣeṇa prayoktavyaḥ |
pratipuruṣeṣu madhye yasmin viśeṣo gṛhyate prādhānyena vā kāryatāvyagratayā vā tenaiva prayoktavya iti |
kuṇḍapāyināmanaye ca 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ, sa potā |
yo maitrāvaruṇaḥ sa brahmā, sa pratihartā |
yaḥ prastotāḥ sa brāhmaṇācchaṃsī, sa ātrdhavṛt |
sūtralakṣaṇaḥ sūtrahmaṇaḥ' iti ṛtvikakarmaṇāṃ viparivartanaṃ śrutam |
evaṃ sati hotrā kriyamāṇānuvādī mantro'pi paṭhanīyaḥ; parivartanaśravaṇācca ādhvaryavaḥ karaṇamantro''pi paṭhanīyaḥ iti bhāti |
paraṃtu karaṇa- mantrasya antimāni kānicidakṣarāṇi yadā paṭhanīyāṃ prātāni tadaiva kriyamāṇānuvādimantrasya ādimāni kānicil akṣarāṇi paṭhanīyāni iti prāpnoti iti vipratiṣedhe bhavati |
tathā sati saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ kṣetrā karaṇamantra eva paṭhanīyaḥ athavā kriyamāṇānuvādī mantra eva paṭhanīyaḥ |
iti atra aniyamena icchānusāraṇa kaścidapi paṭhanīyaḥ |
vipratiṣedhe tulyabalavirodhe sati karaṇaḥ karaṇa- mantra eva hotrā paṭhanīyaḥ |
karaṇamantraśca 'yo hotā so- 'dhvaryuḥ' iti pratyakṣaśravaṇāt pratyakṣaḥ |
asmāt pratyakṣaśrutāt upadeśāt samavāyaviśeṣāt hetoḥ 'parivīrasi pari tvā |
' iti ādhvaryavaṃ karaṇamantrameva hotā paṭhet iti siddhāntaḥ |
nanu tarhi 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti hotraṃ mantraṃ kaḥ paṭhatu ? āha- itaramantraḥ |
itara 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' itimantraṃ anyaḥ kaścit ṛtvik brūyāt |
tathāpi teṣāṃ hotṛpuruṣāṇāṃ madhye yataḥ yasmin hotṛpuruṣasamākhyākṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ yasya yūpaparicayāṇakāle anyavyāpārābhāva rūpo viśeṣaḥ syāt sa brūyāt |
vipratiṣedhe karaṇaḥ samavāyaviśeṣāditaramantrasyeṣāṃ yato viśeṣaḥ syāt' (3|8|10|22) iti sūtram |
(sudhāyāṃ tu atra 'vipratiṣedhe samavāyaviśeṣāditarā- mantrasyetāṃ yato viśeṣaḥ syāt' iti mudritam |

ityapekṣāyāṃ sa ca paro hotā niyoktā 'vipratiṣedhe' iti sūtraśeṣoktena nyāyena vijñāyate ityukte'pi apakṛṣṭasya utkṛṣṭākārya- kāritvaprasiddheḥ maitrāvaruṇādutkṛṣṭasya hotuḥ maitrāvaruṇakārya- kāritvāyogāt maitrāvaruṇadapakṛṣṭasthānatarasya hotṛpuruṣa- tvena maitrāvaruṇasadṛśasya acchāvākasya anena nyāyena maitrāvaruṇakāryakariprati |
vipratiṣedhe karaṇasamavāya - (karaṇaḥ samavāya) - viśeṣāditaramantrasyetāṃ yato viśeṣaḥ syāt' (3|8| 10|22) |
kuṇḍapāyināmanaye śrūyate 'yo hotā so'- dhvaryuḥ' iti |

tatra hotṛdhvaryūdhvaryoḥ bhinnapuruṣavācinoḥ mukhyasāmānādhikaraṇyāyogāt anyatarasya lakṣaṇatve kalpanīye prathamaśrutasya hotṛśabdasya mukhyatvyā carama- śrutasya adhvaryuśabdasya adhvaryukarmalakṣakatvaṃ iti talla- kṣitaḥ adhvaryukarmaṇi kartṛtvena hoturidhividhiḥ |
tena prakṛtitaḥ prāptayoḥ adhvaryuhotroḥ adhvaryornivṛttiḥ, hotraiva ādhva- yevamapi kartavyamiti vyavasthā |

tatra yūpaparicayāṇakāle 'parivīrasi', 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' ityanayoḥ paricayāṇe kriyamāṇānuvādikarmaṇayoḥ adhvaryuṇā hotrā ca prayo- jyayoḥ paricayāṇasaṃkalpyabhūtitasmātparyantamanuvarttamānaḥ kriyamāṇānuvādī, tanmadhyapātī paricayāṇārambhasaṃnipātī karaṇamantra iti kālaikyamāpadyayoḥ tathaiva kuṇḍapāyinā- yane'pi prāptau ekena hotrā yugapadubhayoḥ prayoktumaśakya- tayā adhvaryumantratvarādhe vaktavye praśaktaśrutividhīya- mānādhvaryukarmatvādyogāt ānumānikaprakṛtitvacchandaprāpta- hotṛkarmavādhaḥ iti |
tatra hotuḥ prakṛtitvacchandena prāptiḥ pratyakṣavacanasyopajīvyatvā vikṛtau padārthaprāptiḥ upakāra- mukhena iti hotṛkarmaprāptirapi hotṛprāptyathrtvena upa- jīvyā |
sā ca upajīvyahotṛkarmaprāptiḥ atideśāpapravṛttā 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti mantraprayogamapi spṛśati |
tatra purato gacchataḥ kaṇṭhaṃ gṛhītvaiva pāścātyo gacchati |
evaṃ pipīlikāpādvat gacchatāṃ madhye prastautudvātroḥ udgātṛbhirhotrāṃ yadi kadācit apacchedaḥ (anyā- rambhaṇaḥ ) yugapat syāt tadā apacchedoḥ yaugapadye sati prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate na kartavyam |
ekasya vibhāge nāma apacchede prāyaścittaṃ śrūyate na apacchedaye |
tathā ca vibhāgaśruteḥ ekasyaiva vibhāgasya nimittatva- śravaṇāt apacchedaugapye prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate |
agniṣṭome prātaḥsavane grahagrahaṇānantaraṃ vahiṣpavamānārtha adhvaryuḥ vahiṣpavitraṃ gṛhītvā śālāyāṃ vahiḥ prasarpati |
tamudgātā anyārambhate, taṃ prastotā, taṃ pratihartā, taṃ yaja- mānaḥ, taṃ brahmā |
evaṃ anyārambha gacchatāṃ yadi apa- cchedaḥ syāt tadā prāyaścittaṃ bhavati |
apacchedadvaya- yogapadye tu prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate iti pūrvapakṣaḥ prātaḥ sūtreṇa |
prāsanimitta- tvāt, prāptaṃ nimittaṃ apacchedasya yasya prāyaścittasya tat prāsanimittam, prāsanimittatvāt yaugapadye'pi prāvaścittaṃ syāt |
yaugapadye'pi apacchedayoḥ aikyaṃ nāsti, kālamātraṃ tu ekam |
tasmāt apacchedayoryaugapadye'pi prāyaścittaṃ syādeva iti siddhāntaḥ |
yadi samāsalakṣaṇameva āśrīyeta, rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityaprayogaḥ syāt |
bhā. 9|2|7|29. viruddhaṃ api jñānadvayaṃ anyonyānirapekṣaṃ vākya- dvayādutpadyate |
saṃbandhavākṣepaparihāraṃ 34. viruddhārthatvavibhaktyavacchedayoḥ prātipadikārthayoḥ bhedena anvayaḥ vyutpattisiddhaḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 181. dharmatvena niruddhārthatvāt hetvanya ekatra eka- deśini dṛśyamānaṃ viruddhānvayavyabhicāri |
‘vājapeyena svārājya- kāmo yajeta’ atra vājapeyaguṇāvitvatvapakṣe yāge viruddhaṃ trikadvayaṃ prāpnoti |

‘vājapena yāgaṃ bhāvayet’ ityekaṃ vākyam, ‘yāgena svārājyaṃ bhāvayet’ ityaparaṃ vākyaṃ kalpanī- yam, tatra uddeśyatvādyaḥ trayaḥ svārājyarūpaphalaniṣṭhā dharmāḥ, upādeyatvādyaḥ sādhanabhūtayāganiṣṭhā dharmāḥ |
iti yāge upādeyatvā- dikaṃ trikaṃ siddham |
punaśca yāgamuddiśya vāja upādī- yate, yāgamantya vāja vidhīyate |
anu- vādaḥ jñātasya kathanam, vidhiḥ ajñātasyeṣṭatva- kathanam |
maṇi. pṛ. 187. virecanamavanayoḥ ( somasya ) prāyaścittaṃ āghrātama |
na ca anavagato virodhaḥ bādhakāraṇaṃ bhavitumarhati |
darśapūrṇamāsayogārambhanti ‘samo apracchiātrī darmau prādeśamātre pavitre kurute’ tathā ‘aratnimātre vidhṛtī karoti’ iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ vedistaraṇārthasya vahiṣo vidhṛtī pavitre utānyataḥ iti |
idānīṃ prakṛtavāpi vahirdharmāṇāṃ na sarvavahirhyatvamiti prasaṅgāttripte |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ- ‘barhirlanāti’ iti tvanavidhau prayojanaviśeṣāśravaṇāt yāvatprakaraṇaṃ vartitavyaṃḥ kāryatvameva lavanamavagamyate |
tathāhi lūnaṃ barhiḥ stuṇātīti dhātuśabdena saraṇamabhidhīyate |
tena lūnasya barhiṣaḥ sakalasyaiva vedistaraṇārthatvānnānyatra viniyogaḥḥ

sūtraṃ tu- dantasya kṛtsna- syaiva bahiṣḥ śrutiviśeṣādisiddhe viniyogādidhṛti- pavitrātha na tatra grahaṇe virodhadaktaḥ sāmānyabhūto vivṛtipavitrātharyadharmavidhiḥ śeṣe paribhojanīyābhidhāne barhiṣīti |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'samo apracchinnāgrau darbhau prādeśa- mātrau pavitraṃ karoti' iti 'arannimātre vivṛti karoti' iti ca śrutam |
pavitrakhyaṃ darbhadvayaṃ vivṛtyākhyaṃ ca darbhadvayamātraṃ vihitam |
ete darbhāḥ vedistaraṇārthyāt pañcadhātu vā vediṃ stuṇāti' iti śrutiviśeṣāt saṃskṛtaṃ barhiḥ sarve vedistaraṇārthameveti jñāyate |
pavitravivṛtyartha- darbhāṇāṃ tata eva grahaṇe uktaśruteḥ virodhaḥ syāt |
evaṃ śrutiviśeṣāt virodhe sati śeṣe pavitravivṛtyādi- śeṣakāryaṃ upayuktaṃ dharmasamuccayaḥ anyataḥ asaṃsakṛtaḥ syāt, paribhojanīyaṃ nāma yad barhiḥ; tasmāt syāt |
anena prakṛtāvapi bahirādidharmāṇāṃ nātīva sarvā- rthatā iti sādhitam |
yatra śrutivirodhastatra katham ? yathā audumbaryāḥ sarvaveṣṭanaṃ 'audumbarīṃ
pākṣikaṃ ca sarvavedanassaraṇaṃ pakṣe tāvanna śaknoti śrutiṃ ‘vaisarjanahomīyaṃ vāṣoḍaśyurgṛhṇāti’ iti smṛtiḥ parikalpayitum, sparśavijñānena bādhitatvāt |
ke. adyāmohe na tasminnaśakyā śrutiḥ kalpayitum |
18|38. mīko. pṛ. 2185 ‘dravyasaṃskāravirodhādhi- yadeva hi tasyaikasminpakṣe mūlam, tadevaitasminnapi |
virodhe śruti- ekasminpakṣe na vyāmohaḥ śrutiprāmāṇyatulyatvātira- vākyoḥ, śrutirbalīyasī vākyāt |
na cāsāvekasminpakṣe śrutiḥ, nidrākṣa hi sā na pramādapāṭhaḥ |
pratyakṣavadakvāvirodhe naitatpakṣe vijñānaṃ vyāmohāt pakṣāntaraṃ saṃkrāntamityava- smṛtyartho nānuṣṭheyaḥ |
tatra duḥśrutaśramādijñānamūlatvaṃ tu sarvavedana- virodhe tvanapekṣaṃ syādasati hyanumānam |

tasmāt bhāṣyam— atha yatra śrutivirodhastatra katham? yathaikasmin pakṣe na śakyā śrutiḥ kalpayitumevama- yathā audumbaryāḥ sarvavedanaṃ ‘audumbarīṃ spaṣṭāvadagāyeta’ parasmin pakṣe, tulyakāraṇatvāt |
aṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṣāṇi vedabrahma- caryacaraṇaṃ ‘jātaputraḥ kṛṣṇakeśo'gnīnādadhīta’ ityanena api cetaratrāśrayantyataḥ paricchedāt |

‘krītāhako bhojyānnaḥ’ iti ‘tasmādadī- tamāśrayatā ? pramāṇāyāṃ smṛtau spardhanaṃ vyāmohaḥ, spardhane gomīye saṃsthite yajamānasya gṛhe'śitavyam’ ityanena pramāṇe smṛtivyāmohaḥ, tadevaitaditaratrāyaṃ bhavati |
tatpramāṇaṃ kartusāmānyāt, ityevaṃ prāpte, spardhanasya mūlaṃ kalpyate |
śakyatā ? mapyavidhānācca sarvā śakyā vaidharmitumudyatā tadaprāmāṇyāt spardhanaṃ na vyāmohaḥ |
nanu evaṃ saṃpratyayaṃ vyādhemahi ? sarvavedanasmaraṇeneti brūmaḥ |
pratyakṣa nanu nirmūlatvāt vyāmohastatsamastamiha vaidikaṃ śveṣā |
na na yathā anubhavaṃ anupapannamiti na kalpyate, tathā vākyenāvagato'rthaḥ apahanyate |
kathaṃ tarhi sarvavedanasmaraṇam ? yorupapanna vikalpaḥ ; bṛhadarthayośca |
atha kimarthaṃ nemo vikalpyate śrutive- na ādaraṇīyam |
nāsati vyāmohavijñāne vikalpo bhavati, yadi sarvavedanavijñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ vyāmohaḥ |
vā— smṛtiprāmāṇyamutsut prasaktaṃ sarvagau- yadi sparśanaṃ pramāṇaṃ smṛtivyāmohaḥ |
smṛtiḥ pratyakṣadavākyavivādā sati sarvābhyudaya saṃpra- viśvadhyeta |
kiṃ punastādṛśadapi dharmamāvalambana avadhāryate, tathāhi- ‘kadācit śrutimūlatvamuktā vā anyā- kiṃvā paryudasyate iti |
smṛtibhiḥ pratipannā cetkastāmindro'pi virodhaparihārādvā sati vā tulyamūlataḥ |
ekamūlavyavasthayā mūlāntaranirā- avādho vā bhavedyasyā vā tadviparyayāt |
aprāmāṇyanivṛttyarthaṃ śakyā na tadu- ekaviṣaye viruddhopasaṃhāriṇī vijñāne viruddhayete pekṣaṇe |
kiṃca- parasparaviruddhaṃ śrutīnāṃ na valavadavalavattvanirṇayācca bādhyabādhakabhāvaṃ pratipadyate |
smṛteḥ śrutiviruddhāyyāsto mūlāntaraṃ tadyadi śaṅkitavirodho'pi śrutismṛtyoḥ kenacitprakāreṇa bhavet |

vidheyapratiṣedhayorvā rāgagatapo'pigrahaṇena sahasraśaḥ śrutyo'pyasaṃbhavacyu- virodhābhāvāddeśe'smin vipaye samuccayasaṃbhavāt eka- padanuṣṭhānārthatayā parasparaviruddhaṃ dṛśyante tadā yadi nāma prayogagatatvātsaṃbhavadvādhoḥ prāmāṇyāṅgīkaraṇena prayogā- kāsāṃcit smṛtīnāṃ svavedaśākhātavacanaviparītārtha- ntaraṃ cobhayānugrahaḥ syāt ityevaṃ vikalpaprayatne'pi jñālāntaravacanamūlanāṃ adītavākyavirodho dṛśyate ataḥ atyantavirodhabhāvāt pratyakṣānumitaśrutijanitajñānayośca tāvataiva sarvaśyāprātyakarmavyavahāriṇāṃ svayamabhyutthāna- vaidikatvānnaviśeṣe tulyavalavattvāt ubhayaprāmāṇyamupa- śrītvamātreṇa dṛḍhasaraṇopāsthāpitapurāntaraśrutinirā- pattavyate |
tato yathopanyastaviṣaye'pi smṛtiprāmāṇyama- karaṇaṃ na śobhate ‘na caikaṃ prati śidhyete’ iti hi sarva- pekṣetavyam |
atha tu prayatnenānindyamāṇeṣu'pi na viṣayā- śrutīnāṃ sarvapuruṣānu prati prāmāṇyadadhyayanavacca smṛterapi ntarakṛtā vyavasthā nāpi prameyavirodhāt samuccayato nāpi śrutidhāraṇasāmarthyāt |
‘tasmādyathā virodhe'pi vikalpenobhayānyataḥ kiṃ tarhi ubhayapīḍanādatyantavirodha paṭhyamānapramāṇatā |
kiṃca- ‘avirodhe śrutimūlaṃ na mahān balaviśeṣatadā gatvantarābhāvādvābhyupagamātsaṃbhave mūlāntarasaṃbhavaḥ |
virodhe tvanyamūlatvamiti syāda- śrutivalīyastvena smṛtiprāmāṇyamapekṣaṇīya bhaviṣyatīti |
mūlāntaraṃ nirastaṃ ca sāmānyenaiva ‘kiṃ tāvatprāṇuyādatra virodhe'pi pramāṇātā |
anāśaṅkitavipralambhānyādimūlatvā hyyāhateveda mūlatvā- mūlāntarapraveśe vā kiṃ tatprāmāṇyatṛṣṇāyā |
vadhāraṇāḥ smṛtayo nirvyājāprāmāṇyāḥ śakyante dharma- kiṃca śrānyādimūlanāṃ saṃbhavasaṃbhavaścāvaśyaḥ |
yadā tu vedaviruddhatva- smṛtiḥ prati viruddho'yaṃ bādhakaśca na yujyate |
heturdhanaparasparavigānādinā kenacit api chalena tenā''sāṃ yadi vā naiva kacidasti pramāṇatā |
āsāmāprāmāṇyaṃ kalpyate tadā bahuśākhākhilaprakaraṇādi- sarvatrāhyāhatā yā syāt tadarthajaratīyatā |
bhedabhinneṣu (bahuśākhāsvilā khileḥ prakaraṇānyatha teṣāṃ viruddhaṃ ca jānanti smartāraḥ smaranti yat |
medāstomceṣu vedeṣu ) vedeṣu śrutiliṅgādyātmakopa- vedamūlatvaṃ tyaktvā kimapyatra kāraṇam |
utprekṣa- liṅgādyātmakopadeśo yasya nāmādidāro'tideśādasmāka- ṇīyahetutvātsā sarvatra prasajyate |
rāgadveṣamado- ye vicitrapramāṇabhāgāsteṣviti vigrahaḥ : ) to jānāti nmādapramādālludhyatā |
na vā notprekṣituṃ kā smṛtiḥ kīdṛśena vedabhāgena virudhyamānā kadā- śakyāḥ smṛtaprāmāṇyahetavaḥ |
kā vā dharmakriyā yasyāṃ dṛṣṭo heturna yujyate |
na ca kaścana muñceyurdharmamārgaṃ hi te tadā |
prasāraṃ na labhante hi yāvatkacana markaṭāḥ |
yathā''dau śraddhayā siddhaṃ puna- rnyāyena sādhitam |
anyavyavasthā na yuktā hi vyavasthā yatra labhyate |
sarvatraiva hyekasvarūpādharaṇe nira- pitarūpaṃ vyavahartuṃ śakyam |
' tena yasya pramāṇatvaṃ pramāṇaṃ sarvadā'stu tat |
' tadeva tu kadācitpramāṇaṃ kadācidapramāṇamiti na kathaṃcidapi viśvambhaḥ syāt tadetadadvihīyavaśvorityanyataraparihāryatvādāpattitam |
' yo yasya svarūpāśrayo dharmaḥ prātaḥ sa balavatā kāraṇāntareṇa viryati prati- padyate |
na ca śrutijanitapratyayasya smṛtijanito bādha- tvaṃ pratipadyate |
athaira- pahṛtaṃ ko hi gardabhaiḥ prāptumahati |
tasminneva kṣaṇe mūlaṃ kalpayeta smṛtiḥ śrutim |
vikalpaṃ tu vadapakṣe tāvat śrutiprāmāṇyamabhyu- paitīti |
tadā ca smṛtyāprāmāṇyamarthādbhavati tathāthā- prāmāṇyakalpanāyāṃ śruteriva tadadhyāropaḥ |
' śrutimūlatva- vicchedottarakālaṃ ca prāgunirākṛtamūlattarāpavādavigāna- smṛtyupapraṇītatvenārthānna niyatavadanirmūlatvātsaṃbhā- davabhāvi viplavamabhiprāyādi kiṃcidekaṃ mūlamāpa- dyate |
tatyaśraugāntaravelāyāṃ tvatpasādādidhāgnāya- mānatvena saṃnikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭārthatvādi viśeṣābhāvena ca punaḥ yajñena prāmāṇyenābhibhūyate |
' na hi ekasyā eva smṛteḥ pragakṣaśrutyāryāparigrahakāle anumitaśrutimūlatvaṃ tatpari- grahāśravaṇe tu āgnyādimūlatvamiti viruddhāvadhāraṇā'va- kalpate |
satyaṃ yadi prathamameva vikalpakārī śrutyarthe dvitīyādiprayoge sthūlārthaparigrahaṇāgropa- niṣeta |
' yo hi śruti prathamaśrutvā śrutimevakā padyati tasyā- pratihavatvanumāne śrūye |
' na caiva niyamo'sti jijñāsubhiḥ smṛtiviruddhā śrutireva prathamaṃ śrotavyeti |
dvitīye yavaśāstraṃ ca na tattvatyati durbalam |
ityanena nyāyena sarvapuruṣān prati nityāvasthitasaptapyamānārthapramāṇa- vedajñānāyattajñānairjijñāsubhiḥ |
ityarthaṃ ca bhrāntimūlatva- prasaṅge kalpite smṛteḥ |
avirodhe'pi hi śrutyā prāmāṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ bhavet |
yadyapi pūrvo- palavdhayā smṛtyā śrutimitupalabhamānasya prativandharahita- śrutyunmānaṃ kriyate tathāpi kālāntare śruti śrutvā tatvātpakṣabhūtaḥ |
' yo hi kūṭa- kāpāṇapena kaścitkalpamatho lokamadhye vyavaharati na tena vivekajñānajātayuḥpattinā'pi tathaiva vyavahartavyam |
saive- dānīṃ viruddheti gamyate na punaḥ smṛtiḥ |

yadi hyeka- prayogamālocanena prayogāntaraṇopyanumīyate yena vrīhiśāstrapramāṇikṛtya vavāḥ parihāreṇa sa yāva- jīvaṃ tatraiva yajeteti naiva pratipuruṣamabhāvā vikalpya- mānābhyāṃ vyavahāraḥ sidhyet |

tena yāvatprayoga- bhāvipramāṇālocanavaśātsvātmānitā śruti kacidapya- śṛṇvan punarapi smṛtimevopalabhya kartavyamālikhyaiva śrutimanumimānaḥ pratyakṣā śrutyā akṣisintatyā tathā- mānyenāpyanupapadyamānena smṛtyāprāmāṇyaṃ kalpayitvā- vadhāritamūlatvayameva pratipadyate |
' pūrvasmṛtibrāhmaṇe ca svayaṃ bādhama- cetayamānānāpi puruṣā-tasya śrutiśravaṇaprāptyabalena bādhasaṃtāno'nuvartata eva |
na hi dvindrimoho na bādhyate narāntareḥ |
' nanu yavaśrutiparaṃ tarhi pramāṇatvena parigṛhyamāṇāyāḥ puruṣāntaravādhastadānīmastīti mithyātvaprasaṅgaḥ |
sarvān prati tayostulye viśeṣo'nyo na gṛhyate |
smṛtistu yāvatā puṃsāṃ prathamaṃ gocarī- bhavet |

viruddhayorhi śrutismṛtyorvikalpaprasaṅgādayaṃ kalpanīyo'nyataprāmāṇye yāvacchratau paṭācchādananyāyena kalpayitumārabhyate tāvatsmṛtau varuṇāśrayaṃ valamevopalabhya sarvacchede jāte na kadācidyavaśrutāmāprāmāṇya- kalpanopapattiḥ |
yatrayadyumīsavaidhena dharmaśāstrādhyetusmṛtilakṣaṇapratyakṣaśralyopasaṃhārasūtra- kāropanibaddhaṃ tathāpi upariṣṭāt vakṣyamāṇatvātparatvā- bhiprāyeṇa puruṣopadiṣṭatvāviśeṣānna smṛtivadedodāhṛtam |

kītarā jakobhyodāttatvavacanaṃ yadyapyavadhīyatede'sti tathā- 'pi tasyā'''havanīyasaṃbaddhasyopakārābhāvāttadadhikṛta- trayīpratipāditāgrīpomīya-saṃkhyāvadhibhojanapratiṣedhaviro- dhāt 'prakaraṇaviśeṣādadhikṛto virodhi syāt' ityanena nyāyenādhikṛtatvānadhikṛtatvalābalatvaviśeṣābhiprāyeṇa smṛti- paśni.kṣepādrāpyakāreṇa udāhriyate |

kṛṣṇakeśatvaṃ ca yadyapyanyavasthitavayovasthākālaviśeṣaṃ jātaputrātvapakṣe saṃdi- gdhasamāveśaṃ ca tathā'pi yuvaiva dharmamanviccheditetyamādi- smaraṇaprakāśitārtha yauvanāvasthāparigrahāt antyato vā vayordhanatikramātśravaṇādaṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṣaparyantaṃ snānapanya- nasaṃbaddhakālasya ca vayasaḥ sātirekadvidhāyācatuṣpañcā- śanmātrasaṃvatsaraparimitatvenāparihāryathaivotkramikamāvaśyaka- bhāvitatvāt vyakta eva virodho dṛśyate |
nanu ca pūrvai- kṛtasarvaveda‌nottarakālavihitaṃ veṣṭitā yathā sparśanaṃ saṃbhavatītyavirodhaḥ |
kathamavirodho yadā sparśanaṃ nāma tvagindriyadvāraṃ spṛśyasaṃvedanam |
na ca vakvāntaritāyā audumbaryāḥ sparśo gacchate |
na ca vastre spṛśyamāne audumbarī spṛṣṭā bhavāt |
' nanu bhūmāvaudumbarīsadbhāvāccāntari- tāyāṃ ca tadbuddhayatirekādadṛṣṭāntatvaṃ paśyāmya |
tathā ca taddipu- ke'pi vastre tatsparśīdūpite |
' kathaṃ punarayaṃ dharmaśāstreṇa- tūpanibaddho'pi caṇḍālasparśadarśananimitto doṣo- 'dhyavasīyate |
kathaṃ vā neṣyate doṣaḥ kāṣṭhaloṣṭa- tṛṇādiṣu |
na liptagrahaṇaṃ tatra pāṭhe'sti tu ciraṃtane |
nanu ca manuṣyasyaiva caṇḍālasparśanimittaprāya- ścittavidhānādadṛṣṭirūpamamedhyaṃ gamyate na dravyāntarasya gavāśvādeḥ |
tataśca kathaṃ gavāśvādidagdhamuta puruṣapadṛṣṭamiti saṃdehaṃ gavāśvādintyamevāvadhārayituṃ yuktam |
ucyate -- ' puruṣasya sacellasya snānaṃ yasmā- dvidhīyate |
' yadā'pi hi śuddhena hastādinā caṇḍālaḥ spṛśyate gavādinānāṃ tu caṇḍāladispṛṣṭā snānaprakṣālana- vidhyabhāvānna śuddhirvijñāyate iti na tanmadhyapātilam |
yadā tu tarthodatā spṛṣṭa uyyadediti vibhaktitvādvayamevaudumbarīlocyatanuṣṭarī prāptavyam |
upāśrayaṇābhyupagamapakṣo'pi ca spṛṣṭatvāparijñāneva sthita iti na samastācchāditāyāmeva kalpate |
atha kimarthaṃ nemī vidhī vikalpyate iti |
' vyāmohavijñānaṃ ca jñānā- ntaragatavyāmohāvadhāraṇaṃ tadvijñānagatavyāmohatvaṃ vā vinakṣyate |
tādṛśyā ca sakṛdapi śrautaṃ vijñānamanujñātamadhyāropaṇamāhopavipatvānna kadā- citprāmāṇyaṃ tyajatītyāpaktitvābhidhānam |
evaṃ kevalā- pramāṇatvapakṣagrahastasya punarjīvanāśaṃbhavadāpākṣikaṃ ca sarva- vedhanasmaraṇamītyāha- pākṣikaṃ ceti vā |
vikalpyādi- maṃtapākṣikatvavadādeva śrutiprāmāṇyapakṣe smārtaśruti- kalpanāyāmakatāyāṃ mūlāntarasaṃkrānteḥ sarvakālāpramāṇatva- prasaṅgaḥ |
ekadā'pi ca labdhaprāmāṇyāvakāśā śruti- durbalapratipattayā na kadācidapi vyāmohī bhaviṣyatīti samarthyamānaḥ : ' yadeva hi tasyaikasmin pakṣe mūlam ' ityāha |
' ' tena naitasya vijñānam ' iti pramāṇavijñāna- mabhipretyoktam |
yadā smārtajñānameva pūrvāvadhāritavyāmohāt prāmāṇyapakṣāntaraṃ na saṃkrāntamiti |
valīyaḥ prati- pakṣanirākṛtatvatsarvadaiva śrutyanumānaprativandhāt na smṛteḥ prāmāṇyapakṣasaṃkrāntiḥ |
upariṣṭāditaretarāśrayavivaraṇā- dvirodhamevetaretarāśrayamāha - ' parasparaviruddhe hi viruddhā- vyabhicārit |
' pramāṇadvayasya jñānamānādhikaraṇatvena bhāvotpannabuddhatvena vā napuṃsakatvāt vevāḥ pramāṇaṃ smṛtayaḥ pramāṇamiticat pramāṇe smṛtau svārthena vyāmoha iti bhavitavyam |
kathaṃviśeṣāvicchedāyā vā abhidheya- liṅgavacanānuvṛttau vyudantādiṣṭāniti dīpi prāpte prāmāṇyaṃ smṛtāviti prathoktam |
na ca varṇāśratvena yalopo na bhaviṣyati |
' yadvā yoga- vibhāgena vedharvyasya ca lupyate |
yalope ca kṛte'- kāro yaḥ śuddhaḥ pariśiṣyate |
' ' tatra sparśasya kalpaṃ mūlaṃ kalpyaṃ smṛteḥ ' iti |
' smṛteḥ śrutyamāpakaprāmāṇyakalpa- mūlatā tataśca śrutyaśrutiprāmāṇyakalpanāya smṛteḥ prāmāṇyaṃ tadanena ca śrutyāprāmāṇyaṃ kalpyata itaretarā- śrayatvaparihāryam |
yadā tu śrutiprāmāṇyatamitaretarā- śrayatvamālocyate tadā tatrāpi pratipakṣabhūtasmṛtya- prāmāṇyapekṣayā niravadyatvātprāmāṇyadhāraṇasiddheḥ |
' tena yattadādye padake ananumitāvasthāyāṃ śrutāvāpātamātre smṛteḥ aprāmāṇyaṃ dṛśyate tāvataiva labdhaprāmāṇyatvā śrutiḥ sarvadā)
' tadekena māgena darśayati - 'kalpyamūlatvātsmṛtiprāmāṇyamanavacchalattamityādi yāvatsamārtaśrutikalpanmanupapannaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt' iti |
dvitīyamāgeṃḍapi śrutiprāmāṇyadarśanāt ārabhya tāvannetavya yāvatdeva nirapavādaṃ siddhamiti |
brīhiyavabṛhadaṃtara- vidhīnāṃ tvananyagatikatvātkṣāntaritapadakā iva sthāna- bhedābhāvātpunyabalatvā'navasthitakalpanātprāgupadiṣṭa- meva yojyam |
bhāṣyam - lobhādāsa āditsamānaḥ audumbarī kṛtvāṃ veṣṭitavantaḥ kecit |
[ itaḥ paraṃ vidyamānaḥ 'adhikaraṇāntaraṃ vā' ityādibhāṣyagranthaḥ adhikaraṇāntareṇa 'vaisarjana- homīyavāsontyāyaḥ' iti bindau saṃgṛhīta |
' śrutivirodhabhramaprasavā yā smṛti pūrvo- ktena nyāyena śrutyanumānavibhramādāṅkitamūlāntarā- vaśyakalpayitavyatvācca |
na tu śrutetaḥ saiva tadvirodhe hi bādhyate |
virodhe satyapi jñātuṃ śakyaṃ mūlāntaraṃ katham |

' ghrāṇāntaraviprakī- rṇāni hi purupāntarapratyakṣāṇyaiva vedavākyāni puruṣadharmā- nuṣṭhānakrameṇāpaṭhitāni vedasamāmnāyavināśābhayāt sva- rūpeṇānupantyasya arthopanibandhanadvārālabhyāni viśiṣṭadhvani- sthānīyatvena tenaiva parokṣaṇāpi vyajyamānāni piṇḍīkṛtya saryante |

tatra yathaivā''saptaprayādimiha paṭhyate iti kathitamucāritamanucāritaṃ vā śiṣyāḥ pratipadyante tathaiva sūtrakāravacanāni adhyāpakavacanasthānīyāni svānurūpaveda- vākyasamarpaṇābhāṃ kṛtvā nivṛttavyāpārāṇīti na tātyādi- dhvanipreraṇavat pauruṣeyatvena paribhavitavyāni |
'vedo hīhya evārthaṃ puruṣaiḥ prakāśyate sa paṭhadbhiḥ prakāśayeta smaradarthīyatulyabhāk |
bādhitā ca smṛtirbhūtvā kācinnyāya- vidā yadā |
tadā kā te mukhyatvā syānnaiyyāyika- māninaḥ |

etarjanmineva cchā-dogyanādau ca śadvā- yanibrāhmaṇagataśrutimūlatvenaudumbarīpravaṇe ca śāstrāya- nināṃ tāmumbardeśanobhayatra vāmasī dṛśyatīti 'veṣṭutaṃ vai vāmaḥ śrīrvāsaḥ śrīḥ sāme ' jñāta darśite tatpa- sajñaudumbarīveṣṭanavāsaso'pi prakāśaśrutilatvamevāvā-
viruddhatve ca vācaḥ syāna cehāsti viruddhatā |
na hi veṣṭanamātraṃ naḥ sparśaśrutyā viruddhayate |
veṣṭyetedumbarī tatra kiṃ nāma na kṛtaṃ bhavet |
sarvā veṣṭitavyeti na hovaṃ sūtra- kṛddvacaḥ |
na ca tasyāprāmāṇatve kiṃci- dapyasti kāraṇam |
agnī- pomīyasaṃsthāyāṃ krīte vā sati rājani |
asti nāstīti cetyevaṃ sahate nāva- dhāraṇam |
kleśaprāyaṃ ca taṃ pakṣaṃ nā''saśreyaiva kaścana |
tathā gautamenāpyuktam- rājñāṃ ca kāryavidhātārthe brāhmaṇānāṃ ca svādhyāyānivṛttyarthamiti |
antaḥ patitamā- śaucaṃ sa vyāpnoti svasaṃsthayā |
vitala daśa saṃkhyā hi tānyahāni vyavasthitā |
karmaṇā yena keneha mṛdunā dāruṇena vā |
tatrāpi tu 'prabhu: pṛthaga- kalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate |

bhāṣyakārairaiva siddhāntitam- sarvatrānumāne anu- meyajijñāsāyāḥ kāraṇatvāt pratyakṣaśrutyā ca sparśavidhāne- nāvedhitatvarūpeṇa audumbaryāḥ paricchinnatvāt jijñāsā- 'bhāvena naudumbarīvedhaniṣedhaviṣayakaśrutyanumānasaṃbhavaḥ |
tathā pratyakṣaśrutivirodhābhāve'pi yatra lobhādidiśenyam, yathā ‘vaisrjanahomīyaṃ vāso'jyuḥ parigṛhṇāti’ ityādī tatrāpi na śrutikalpyaṃ klṛptahetoraiva mūlatopapatteriti |

vārtikakārastu- na jijñāsāyā anumīyajña- tvam, agnyāyajijñāsāyāmapi tadudayāta satyapi vā tasyāḥ kāraṇatve anamitiviṣayaśruterjijñāsitatvācca pratyakṣaśrutivirodhābhāve'pi lobhādimūlakatvasvīkāre ca ekādiśṭamapi tadāpatteḥ |
ataśca pratyakṣaśrutivirodhe- 'pi smṛteḥ śiṣṭatraivarṇikaparigrahāviśeṣeṇa śrutimūlakatva- kalpanopapatteryuktameva prāmāṇyam |
parantu yāvacchrutidarśanaṃ veṣṭanaṃ nānujñeyam, arthavādādyuvītavidhitvasyāpi smṛtiṣu darśanena prakṛte'pi tanmūlakatvasya saṃbhāvitatvāt |
ataśca yāvacchrutidarśanaṃ ananuṣṭhānalakṣaṇaṃ aprāmāṇya- mityabhiprāyaṃ sūtramiti prāha |

yadvā- śākyādināmapi kṣatriyaprasiddhavedadarśana- saṃbhavena tatpraṇītasmṛtīnāmapi vedamūlakatvam, tanmūla- bhūtavedaśrutīnāṃ pralīnaḥ, iti prāpte- śiṣṭatraivarṇikānāṃ dharmatvena parigrahasya pūrvadhikaraṇamṛṣyahetorabhāvāt pratyu- tāpamāṇatvena teṣāṃ smaraṇāt vedāprāmāṇyādibhireva na tatprāmāṇyāsvīkārāt vedamūlakatvakalpanā'nupapatteḥ- prāmāṇyamiti sūtrārthaḥ |
su. pṛ. 228. virodhādhikaraṇe ca ubhayorpi smṛtyācārayoḥ śrutivirodhe prāmāṇyamoditam |
kau. 1|3|4 pṛ. 54. virodhādhikaraṇe viruddhasmṛtiprāmāṇyāpādana aviruddhasmṛtiprāmāṇyaṃ nirapavādamuktam |
su. pṛ. 204. virodhādhikaraṇe śākyādigranthānāṃ aprāmāṇyaṃ dhyutpā- ditam |
su. pṛ. 227. vārtika- kāramate virodhādhikaraṇe śākyādigranthānāṃ vedamūlatvā- saṃbhavena aprāmāṇyaṃ pratipāditam |
kau. 1|3|6| 11. smṛtadhikaraṇe evācāraprāmāṇyasya vyutpā- ditatvāt virodhādhikaraṇe tasyāpi smṛtitvat vedavirodha- viṣaye prāmāṇyaṃ apoditam |

su. pṛ. 207. yadā nātra (śiṣṭopādhikaraṇe 1|3|4) virodhāvirodhamātraṃ vicāryate, kintu satyapi virodhe kimācamanādīnāṃ dharmatvena baliyastvadāgrahaḥ uta prāmāṇyadvaidhatvād bāghaḥ iti virodhādhikaraṇapāvādārya vicārayate |
su. pṛ. 134. smṛteḥ śrutivirodhe tāvat virodhādhikaraṇa- nyāyena śrutyakalpyam |
kau. 1|3|17. virodhādhikaraṇabhaṭṭaṭīkāyākhyānānte tome- śreṇokam- mantrakalpyo devatāvidhiḥ aśvadānaphala- vidhidhaśca |
bāla. pṛ. 12. bhāṣyakārīyavirodhādhikaraṇabhañjāvasare śruti- viruddhānāmpi smṛtīnāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ parantu tatra vikalpena ubhayānuṣṭhānasaṃbhavāt prāmāṇyam |
ku. 1|3| 5|8 pṛ. 64. virodha eva kāsti na nāsti ’ ityevaṃ virodhādhikaraṇaviṣayavyāpyatvalam |
dvayī hi virodhāgatiḥ, sahā- navasthānaṃ vā chāyā''tapavat, parasparaparihāro vā māvābhāvavat |
virodhinamekaśrutau niyamaḥ syād grahaṇa- syārthavattvāccarayata atito viśiṣṭatvāt |
virodhino padāthānāṃ madhye ekaśrutau ekasya anya- tamasya śravaṇe niyamaḥ syāt niyamavidhiśca svīkāryam |
śrutiḥ śrutyā viśiṣṭatvāt vihitatvāt codakaprāmāṇa- bādheran |
yathā vājapeye ‘syādiro yūpo bhavati’ iti syādirasya niyamaḥ, pālādeśa ndhaḥ |
maidhātavyāyāṃ ‘yavamayo madhyamaḥ puroḍāśaḥ’ iti śruteḥ yavānāṃ niyamaḥ, vrīhīṇāṃ bāghaḥ |
dhāravat yathā ‘śāramayaṃ barhirbhavati’ ityuktaḥ śarāṇāṃ niyamaḥ, kuśānāṃ bāghaḥ tadvat |
ubhayoḥ syādirapālāśayoḥ, bṛha- drathayoḥ, vrīhiyavayorvā pradeśāt codakena upadeśāt na pālāśarayaṃtavrīhīṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ saṃbhavati |
yadi ubhayopradeśāt pālāśadiṣu na nivṛttiḥ tarhi śareṣvapi na nivṛttiḥ syāt tatrāpi vikalpaḥ prasajyeta |
virodhagrahaṇāt virodhino grahaṇābhāvāt kuśavirodheṣu śareṣu aṅgīkriyamāṇe śaravirodhino kuśānāṃ grahaṇa saṃbhavati |
tarhi itarasmin syādirādau pālāśadibirodhini aṅgīkriyamāṇe syādirādibiro- dhinaḥ pālāśādayaḥ aṅkatvena śakyā upādātum |
virodhagrahaṇāt palāśā- dīnāṃ nivṛttau svīkṛtāyāṃ śrutyanarthakyaṃ śruteḥ codakasya syādirapalāśābhayaprāptakasya anarthakatvaṃ prasajyeta |
tasmāt na palāśādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ kintu vikalpaḥ |

‘syādiro yūpo bhavati’ ‘bṛha- pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati’ ‘yavamayo madhyamaḥ puroḍāśaḥ’ iti tadviruhatvānāṃ grahaṇasya vidhānasya arthavattvāt saphala- tvasiddhayarthaṃ ubhayoḥ syādirapalāśayoḥ dvayorapi evaṃ bṛhadrathayoḥ yavavrīhyośca apravṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttirna syāt |
kintu syādirādīnāṃ niyamaḥ palāśādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. virodhinaṃ ca na saha pravṛttiḥ |
ekasmin kārye ye vikalpena sādhakāḥ te parasparaṃ virodhinaḥ |
loka- vat yathā ‘matsyān na payasā samaśrīyāt’ iti matsyaiḥ payo nivartyate tadvat |
atha ādhekacchandaskāḥ ṛca upā- dāsyāmahe tato gīti vileśayāma |
(abhiṣapari- māṇāmu ṛca sāmāgāne ṛcaśepe sāmādarśanaṃ vileśaḥ |
vi. 9|2|124. vileśaḥ ṛgapekṣayā'lpatvam , yadi nyūnacchandaskāgāmuccai utpannaṃ sāma adhikacchandaskāyā- muci gīyate tadā alpaṃ sāma ṛkparipūrṇakṣamaṃ syāt |
pṛ. 47. vivakṣā'vivakṣayoḥ vede saṃmbhāvasaṃbhavavicāraḥ- mīko. pṛ. 1629-1631 ‘grahaṇāyaḥ’ ityadhi- karaṇe draṣṭavyaḥ |
vivakṣābījaṃ vidheyameva, nopādeyatvaṃ tadvi- śeṣaṇatvaṃ vā iti nañjīkāyā (nañjīkā) - ‘sugāṃ na
vivakṣitamekatvaṃ ' paśumālabheta ' ' paśunā yajeta ' ityādi paśoḥ |
4|1|16-18. mīko. pṛ. 3354 ' liṅgādhikaraṇam ' ityatra draṣṭa- vyam |
tatra vivakṣitā- rthāpekṣayā nyūnatvābhyupagame ityatrodāharaṇam- ' vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yaje
vivṛddhastomakeṣu abhivṛddhastomakeṣu ca vikṛtigāyeṣu upadiṣṭaiḥ sāmabhiḥ atidiṣṭānāṃ bādhaḥ, vivṛddhastomakeṣu tu upadiṣṭānāmatidiṣṭānāṃ ca sāmnāṃ samuccayaḥ |
vi. 10|4|12, vivṛddhastomakeṣu kratuṣu ‘ekaviṃśanāti- rātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yājayet, trivṛnneaujaskāmam, trayastriṃśa- śena pratiṣṭhākāmam’ |
tataśca ekaviṃśa- stomapūraṇāya catvārastṛcā āgamamitavyathāḥ, trivṛcca ṣaṭ, trayastriṃśe ca aṣṭau |

eteṣāmāgantūnāṃ tṛcānāṃ niveśaḥ ante kartavyaḥ na tu paryāyāt prāk, klṛptakramatvāt- prasaṅgāt 5|1|14. vivṛddhastomakeṣu kratuṣu gāyatryādinā- bhaṃvapavamānayoḥ āgamyamānānāṃ sāmnāṃ gāyatrībṛhattva- nuṣṭupṣu niveśaḥ na tu ante tuce |
vivṛddhastomakratuṣu upadiṣṭaiḥ sāmabhiḥ prākṛtasāmnāṃ na bādhaḥ, abhivṛddhastomakratuṣu ca upadiṣṭaiḥ sāmabhiḥ prākṛtasāmnāṃ bādhaḥ |
stomavivṛddhau tvadhikaṃ syādvivṛddhau dravya- vikāraḥ syādityasyāśritatvāt 10|4|10-12|
bhāṣyam-- santi vivṛddhastomakāḥ abhivṛddhastoma- kāśca kratavaḥ |
‘ekaviṃśanātirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yāja- yet, trivṛnneaujaskāmam, trayastriṃśena pratiṣṭhākāmam’ iti |
tatra nava rājasāmāni, ekādaśa rājasāmāni, balaudhaśravase vasiṣṭhasya janilanite ca sākaṃ pravedanāt |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ vikṛtau vivṛddhau hānau ca prākṛtānāṃ sāmnāṃ nivṛttiḥ, uta hānau nivṛttiḥ, vivṛddhāvanivṛttiriti |
sāmnāṃ cotpatti- rarthavatī bhaviṣyati, apūrveṣu kriyamāṇeviti |
kutaḥ ? āgamena hi sāmnāṃ saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ vakṣyate |
yāvatā nivṛttena mā saṃkhyā pūryate, tāvatprākṛtaṃ bādhitavyam |
śā-- yatra stomavivṛddhiḥ yathā ‘dvātriṃśaḥ pava- māno'bhipaṃcanīyaḥ’ ityādau, tatra pratyakṣaśruteḥ rāja- sāmabhiḥ prākṛtāni vikrīyante kiṃvā samuccyaḥ iti |
tatra āgamena vivṛddhau pūritāyāṃ pratyakṣaśrutāni rāja- sāmāni vivṛddhau avakāśalabhyamānāni prākṛtabādhena vartante, tena abhivṛddhau vivṛddhau ca sarvatra bādhaḥ |
yatra tatraiva bādhaḥ syādvivṛddhau tvasti saṃbhavaḥ |

sūtrārthastu- stomavivṛddhau prākṛtasamuccayaḥ syāt itarasyāgamāt- tvāt abhivṛddhau yatra prākṛtasaṃkhyā yathāprākṛtyavatiṣṭhate yatra vā ‘punaḥstomasya savanaṃ madhyamaṃ dvādaśaṃ smṛtam’ ityādau hīyate tatra ubhayatrāpi paraṃ prākṛtanivṛttiḥ tāṃ vinā vaikṛtaniveśasaṃbhavāditi |
vṛddhiṃ pratyupa- yogitvād vṛddhau tu na nivartakaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- yatra yathāprākṛtyeva stomaḥ, yatra vā nyūnaḥ, yathā ‘triṣaṭ‌mṛdagniṣṭomaḥ’ ityādau tatra upadiṣṭaiḥ kautsā-

yatra tu prakṛtyapekṣayā vivṛddhastomakratu, yathā ‘ekaviṃśe- nātirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yājayet, trivṛnneaujaskāmam’ ityādau, tatra upadiṣṭānāṃ rājasāmānīnāṃ na prākṛtāma- nivartakatā śrutisaṃkhyāsaṃkhyevopadiṣṭāhitisiddha- mantrairaivopāpatteḥ |
ata eva āgamena saṃkhyāpūraṇamapi upadiṣṭāhitisiddheḥ samucitairapi tadapūraṇe iti vakṣyate |
agnīṣomīye paśau tu ‘ekādaśa prayājān yajati’ iti śrutam |
cātu- rmāsyeṣu ca ‘nava prayājān yajati’ iti |
tatra kiṃ pratiprayājaṃ ekādaśatvasaṃkhyā anvayaḥ ? prayājasamudāye vā anvayaḥ ? iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
vivṛddhiḥ prākṛta- pañcatvasaṃkhyāpekṣayā adhikā ekādaśatvasaṃkhyā tasyatasya ekaikasya prayājasya upadiśyeta |
pṛṣadājyavat ‘pṛṣadājyena anuyājān yajati’ iti pratyanuyājaṃ pṛthagguṇo bhidyate tadvat |
tathā ca paśau pañcaprayājāḥ syuḥ : cātu- rmāsyeṣu ca pañcatvāriṃśat |
na ekādaśatva- saṃkhyā tasyatasya, kintu sarvasaṃkhyā syāt |
sarveṣāṃ pañcānāṃ prayājānāṃ, sarveṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ cānuyājānāṃ iyaṃ vikārabhūtā ekādaśatvasaṃkhyā syāt |
mitrasaṃkhyāyāśca vikāraḥ ekādaśa- tvasaṃkhyā pratīyeta, na tu tasyatasya pratyekaṃ pratīyeta |
paśau ekādaśa- ekādaśaiṣa prayājānuyājāśca, cāturmāsyeṣu navanavaiva |
vivekabhraṣṭānāṃ bhavati vinipātaḥ śata- mukhaḥ’ iti nyāyaḥ |
viśadaṃ vibhaktāyavaṃ iti ‘bhakṣyeṇa miśrī- karaṇaṃ’ ityatra (pā0 2|1|35) haradattaḥ |
garbhirātre, ājyadohāni sāmāni prakṛtya śrūyate ‘agniṣṭupaniyāya stuvate’ iti |
tatra kiṃ alaukikaṃ laukikaṃ vā agniṣṭupaniyāyat iti viṣaye saṃśaye alaukikaṃ vaidikaṃ agni upanidadhyāt |
kutaḥ ? sarvārtha- tvāt sarvavaidikakarmārthatvāt vaidikasya āhavanīyādeḥ |
atra laukikaḥ laukika iti liṅga- bhedena vibhaktibhedena ca dvedhā pāṭho'nyatra |
tatra prathamamantānuṣṭhānānusāreṇa syāt-pada- mapi sūtre paṭhitam |
dvitīyāntapakṣe tu sūtre syāt- padaṃ nāsti kintu upanidadhyāt ityadhyāhāraḥ |
garbhirātre ājyadohāni sāmāni prakṛtya śrūyate ‘agniṣṭupaniyāya stuvate’ iti |
tatra vaidikaṃ agni upanidadhyāt iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa niṣedhya pari- śeṣanyāyena siddhāntamāha |
tatra ca ājyadoha- sāmapaṭhanakāle upanidhānaṃ noktam |
sa ca pariśeṣāt laukika iti siddhā- ntitam |
nanu na pariśeṣādetasya kasyacit dhiṣṇyasyopanidhānasya saṃbhavata iti cenmayā |
itareṣāṃ dhiṣṇyāgnīnāmapi utpattistathā, yathā āhavanī- yādīnām |
te'pi asādhāraṇye vyāpārarūpe kārye vihitāḥ teṣāmapi anyatamasya upanidhānaṃ na saṃbhavati |
vā. 3|4|4|13 pṛ. 915-916. viśiṣṭajñāne viśeṣaṇajñānasya hetutvaṃ nāṅgīkriyate iti śiromaṇiḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 28. viśiṣṭajñāne viśeṣaṇajñānasya na hetutvam, viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇendriyasaṃnikarṣasya viśiṣṭajñānehetutvāt iti kecit |
pṛ. 21. viśiṣṭavidhau vṛttasya viśeṣaṇapravṛttiniyama iti nyāyaḥ |
yathā- dṛśyate hi 'kuṇḍalī yāti' ityādau viśiṣṭasyaiva dharmasya gatyādeḥ kuṇḍalādirūpaviśeṣaṇavṛttatvamiti |
'kuṇḍalī bhuṅkte' ityādau tu kuṇḍalādirūpalakṣaṇatvādistasya bhojanānvaya iti |
bāla. pṛ. 30. viśiṣṭapratau api dehasya puruṣasya ca kevalasya abhidhānaṃ yuktaṃ kā hinyanadaṇḍayoḥ pratyakṣadaṇḍaśabdāvagatayoḥ viśeṣaṇatvopapatteḥ |
vā. 1|3|1|33 pṛ. 318. viśiṣṭapratyayādeva sarvatra arthāpatyā ekasya dvayorvā avayavayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ vyāpāraḥ śabde kalpyate |
śoṇādiśabde viśeṣaṇabuddhiṃ vināpi viśiṣṭabuddhidarśanāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyagrāhakapramāṇadvayasadbhāve eva viśiṣṭabuddhiviśeṣaṇapūrvakatvaniyamaḥ, na sarvatra |
su. pṛ. 1408. viśiṣṭarūpāvayavatvāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ, tajjñānaṃ vinā viśiṣṭajñānānutpattiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1409. daṇḍaśabdaḥ kevale daṇḍe na prayujyate iti viśiṣṭavacano'vagamyate |
vā. 1|3|133 pṛ. 318. viśiṣṭavācakasya padasya ekadeśaparatve lakṣaṇā' iti nyāyāt 'trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya' ityādau navakamātragrahaṇe lākṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgo durvāraḥ eva |
yadā kenacidapi pramāṇena nāsti prāptiratyavagamyate, tadā viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ aṅgīkaroti |
tathā ca prakaraṇaprāptābhāvādeva śruto guṇānāṃ vidhāyya iṣṭā |
nanu atrāpi śvetaṃ vākyaṃ kuryāt, taṃ cālabheta ityarthadvayavidhānāt bhinnetaiva vākyam |
nahi ālabheta ityasya ayamatibhāraḥ, yad dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena puruṣaprayatnaṃ brūyāt |
yathā 'raktamaśvaṃ yojaya' iti yadā guṇavidhiraṃ bhavati vākyam, tadā dvābhyāṃ vākyābhyāṃ prayojanaṃ guṇadvavidhāne |
atha 'śoṇamānaya' ityucyata tatra guṇavidhirapi vākye paryavasita eva guṇadvayavidhānam |
śrutyaiva viśiṣṭaguṇadravyasya pratītatvāt na bhavati ekasya vākyasya atibhāraḥ |
mā. 2|3|124. viśiṣṭavidhāne vākyabhedo medo na bhavati |
dvābhyāṃ tu viśeṣaṇābhyāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ekamādhānaṃ vidhīyate |
yatra hi ekakriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ anekamupādīyate tatra taddvāreṇa tadvidhiḥ sulabhaḥ |

) evaṃ viśiṣṭavidhinyā'nupapattyā viśeṣaṇavidhiṣu kalpyamāne- ṣvapi yāgādervidhyarthasya viśeṣaṇatve'pi na tadviṣayo viśeṣaṇavidhiḥ, śrutenaiva tu pratyayena dhātvarthātiraiva bhāvanā vidhīyate, na śuddhā śabdāntarāyāt (2|2| 1|9) |
tatra hi uktaṃ 'saṃnidhinirūpaṇādhīnanirūpaṇaḥ saṃnidhaiva jñeyanirūpaṇādhīnanirūpaṇaṃ ca jñānamiva ava- cchedakatvātthanirūpaṇādhīnanirūpaṇā bhāvanā' (su. pṛ. 704) iti |

ato yā dhātvarthaṃ vinā nirūpayitu- mevāśakyā, sā sutarāṃ tadvidhiṃ vinā śuddhā pratyayenoktā- 'pi vidhātumaśakyā iti śrutenaiva vidhinā dhātvarthānu- raktāyā eva vidhānāt na dhātvartharūpaviśeṣaṇaviṣayaṃ vidhyantaraṃ kalpyate iti |
grahaikatvādhikaraṇanyāyamudāha- mapi dhātvarthāvacchinnaiva bhāvanā śrutividhyiṣayaḥ ityu- ktam |

yadi (satrāduda- syāt pṛṣṭhamanīyanena yajeran) sāhityaṃ asaṃbhavātmakaṃ syāt tato bhavet viśiṣṭavidhisaṃdantyanyāyena kathaṃcit viśiṣṭavidhigauravāpādakatvamapi kartṛtvavidhiṃ aṅgīkṛtya tatsāhityaviśada |
tat ekapadopādānena nāntrīyakatayā prāptamanuvadiśyate iti na vivakṣitam |
viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyabodhe viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakaprakā- ratvaniścayasya hetutvaṃ nāṅgīkriyate iti śiromaṇiḥ |
(2) viśeṣye viśeṣaṇaṃ tatra ca viśeṣa- ṇāntaraṃ yathā 'nīladaṇḍavān puruṣaḥ' |
(3) eka- viśiṣṭe aparavaiśiṣṭyaṃ (viśiṣṭe vaiśiṣṭyaṃ) yathā 'daṇḍī devadattaḥ kuṇḍalī' |
sāmidhenīpādyadaśayaṃ sāmānyam, sātadaśyaṃ ca vaidaśyasya viśeṣaḥ |
na tu niḥsāmānyaḥ kaścit viśeṣa upa- padyate |
'āhavanīye juhoti' iti sāmānyam, 'pade juhoti' iti viśeṣaḥ |
ki kāraṇam ? svāśrayeṣu anyāvṛttaviṣayasya sāmānyasya tato'nyāpi vṛttisaṃbhavāt, viśeṣasya ca anyapari- cchinnasya ekāvasāyinastadasaṃbhave viṣayābhāvaprasaṅgāt upadeśavaiyarthyaṃ mā bhūditi |
svāśrayeṣu brāhmaṇapiṇḍeṣu, anyāvṛttaviṣayasya sāmānyasya aparicchinnaviṣayasya, viśeṣāpekṣayā tato'nyatrāpi vṛttisaṃbhavāt |
tasmāt viśeṣāt kauṇḍinyāt anya- trāpi brāhmaṇapiṇḍeṣu vṛttiḥ saṃbhavatyeva |
viśeṣasya punaḥ kauṇḍinyādeḥ anyebhyo brāhmaṇapiṇḍebhyo'cchinnasya, tadavasāyinaḥ tadasaṃbhave tasminsaṃbhave viṣayābhāva- prasaṅgādupadeśavaiyarthyaṃ syāt |
'tulyapramāṇako hi viśeṣo bādhako bhavati, na durbalapramāṇakaḥ |
vā. 3|6|2|9 pṛ. 1030, bādhyate ca sāmānyaṃ sāvakāśaṃ vā viśeṣeṇa niravakāśaṃ vā |
viśeṣasya sāmānyatvakatve eva sāmānyavidheḥ viśeṣavidhau paryavasānam |
tathayā- yatra siddhinasti tatra sipādhayiṣāyāṃ satyāmasatyāmapi prakṛtanyāyena pakṣatā bhavati |
śiṣyādaśabdo hi vṛkṣatva-pāthivatva-dravyatva- sattā-prameyatva-jñeyatvānāṃ na tāvadabhidhāyakaḥ |
bhā. 2|5|1|14. viśeṣatodṛṣṭamanumānaṃ svārthaṃ parārthe ceti dvividham |
pūrvaṣāṃ prākṛtānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ vikṛtau kṛṣṇalahomādi- viśeṣadarśanāt na sarveṣāṃ samaprādhānyam |
gīko. pṛ. 196 'atideśaḥ iṣau iyenīyaviśeṣadharmāṇām' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
viśeṣarūpaḥ niṣiddhaviṣayaḥ abhyanujñāvidhi- ryathā- 'krītarājakaḥ abhojyānnaḥ' iti niṣedhe 'jīvitavyamamāpanno yo'nnamatti yatastataḥ |
ākāśa iva paṅkena na sa pāpena lipyate' |
bāla. pṛ. 16, viśeṣarūpaḥ paṣṭadastviṣayaḥ abhyanujñāvidhiḥ yathā aitareyabrāhmaṇe- 'aśitavyaṃ vapāyāṃ hutāyām' iti |
lakṣaṇe sati prakṛtanyāyena siddho satyamapi siṣādhayiṣā- |
mate, na hi apratīte viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭaṃ kecana pratyetu- |
iti dadhisaṃbandhavidhānārtha homaḥ ucyate, tatra dvitīya- |
viśiṣṭasya tādarthye viśeṣaṇasyāpi tādarthya bhavati, yathā |
aindryāḥ na kevalaṃ upasthānāṅgatvam, kintu gārhapatyā- |
viśeṣaṇasya aṅgalaṃ vinā viśiṣṭasya akṣatvaṃ na |
saṃbandho na bhavati, yathā ‘rājapuruṣo gacchati’ iti|
viśeṣaṇaṃ tāvat sarvatra pūrvataramabhidhīyate iti sthitam |
vaiṣamyabījam ? tathā iha kacit viśiṣṭaṃ prati tādarthye |
prati na tādarthyamiṣyate, yathā arthajñānaṃ prati svādhyāyasya |
adhyayanasya vā tādarthye'pi na viśeṣaṇadharmakaṃ prati |
krameṇa aṣṭavarṣaviśiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati, tāpaviśiṣṭaṃ payasa |
saṃkhyāni varṇāni prati upanayanasya, tāpaṃ prati ca |
evaṃ somasya yāgasvarūpe ānarthakyāt apūrva- sādhanāśe vidhānāt apūrvaśeṣatvaṃ vākyāt |
evaṃ ' saurye caruṃ nirvaped brahmavarcasakāmaḥ ' ityādi vākya- saṃyogāt dravyasya phalaśeṣatvam |
ata eva somādīnāṃ phalabhāvanetikartavyatātvam asiddha samāsādyo |
na ca karaṇatvamitikartavyatātvaṃ caikasya viruddham, karaṇasya sato yāgopakārakatvā iti kartavyatātvāt |
taduktaṃ ' nahi tat karaṇaṃ loke vede vā kiñcidīdṛśam |
tasmāt aindrī- daśāpavitra-somādīnāṃ upasthānādhikaraṇakarūpārthādi- karmakabhāvanetikartavyatātvāt dravyabhūtagārhapatyādyapi vākyāt yuktā |
abhikramaṇa- prayājadravya- devatā- mantrāṇāṃ tu prayājakaraṇabhāvamātretikartavyatātvasya avāntaraprakaraṇādibhi
ratnākaraḥ pṛ. 147. viśeṣyaprakārabhedai'pi tadanugatakathaṃmaikye na tadānantyam (viśeṣyaprakārabhāvānantyam |
) nahi śveta- raktādiprakārabhede ghaṭapaṭādirūpaviśeṣyabhede vā 'nāmā- thayorbhedānvayaḥ' iti vyutpattirbhiyate |
bhā. 9|2|7| 29. viśve devāḥ nāma kaścit vattudvādrādivat gaṇo vā sarve devā eva viśve devā iti yā cintāṃ asti some vaiśvadevo grahayajiḥ |
vyapadeśo bhavati 'abhirvasubhiḥ; somo rudraiḥ, indro marudbhiḥ, varuṇa
oṃ viśvajiti aśvādeyaḥ kesariṇo na deyāḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- viśvajityeva saṃdehaḥ, kimaśvādayo deyā neti |
kiṃ prāptam ? sarvasya vihitatvāt deyā aśvā iti |
yasya ca dānamakāryaṃ tacca na deyam, yathā aśvānām |
eṣa hi viśeṣaḥ aśvānāṃ anyebhyo dravyebhyaḥ |
sudhā-- (pṛ. 1492) viśvajitprakaraṇāmnāta- syāpi aśvādānaniṣedhasya asaṃbhavakatvārthatvapratigraha- niṣedhasāhacaryāt dharmatvānnyādinā ca avaidhe api aśvādāne niṣedhopapatteḥ |
vidhyadhīnātmalābhatvābhāvāt sāmānyavidhinā saha vikalpayogaṃ matvā 'aśvānāṃ dāna- makāryam, eṣa hi viśeṣo'śvānāṃ anyebhyo dravya
bhāṭṭa--jyotiṣṭome tadadhikāre tadanyacca yatra sarvasvadānamāmnātaṃ tatra vṛttā kathā |
tatra tu karmārambhe eva tridhā yajamānenātmīyaṃ dhanaṃ vacanādvyāsthāpitaṃ bhakṣārthaṃ ṛtvarthe dakṣiṇārthe ceti |
tatra sarvasya svatvaviśeṣāt pridhasyāpi dānaṃ na tu dakṣiṇārthebhāgasya sarvatā |
tada- bhāve bhāgatrayasyāpyaviśeṣatvāt dakṣiṇārtho'yaṃ bhāga iti vyapadeśānupapattiḥ |

padārthānāṃ pradhāna- tvādgabhūtadakṣiṇānurodhena bādhasya prameyatvāvalayanyāyenānu- pattervā kiñcit ṛtvije śitutvā sarvamanvyadīyatatāmiti prāpte, dakṣiṇārthena nirdiṣṭasya tatsaṃbandhaprāptau sarvatāmātra- vidhāne lāghavamiti tasyaiva sarvadānam |

na caivaṃ prakṛtāvapi tasya dānāpatteśca vidhivaiyarthyam, itarathā tasya dakṣiṇārthatvāttvānupapattiriti vācyam, 'yacetā- vatā ṛtvijo nānameyuḥ, api tu sarvasvena' ityanena vacanena dvādaśatenānatyasaṃbhave tasyāpi dakṣiṇārthatvāt |
atra ca dakṣiṇārthabhāgāsyaiva deyatve'vasthite pūrvatani ṣaḍadhikaraṇāni kṛtvācintayeti kecit |
vastutastu- pitrādīnāmapi dakṣiṇārthābhāgāḥ pāti- tvena vicāropapatterna kṛtvācintām |

bhāṣyam-- viśvajityeva saṃdehaḥ kiṃ prāgdakṣiṇā- kālādvidyamānaṃ niyogato dakṣiṇakāle dātuṃ nighāta- vyam, ūrdhvaṃ ca dakṣiṇakālāt bhaviṣyadāgatamapi dakṣiṇakāle deyamuta dakṣiṇakāle vidyate tadeva deyamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? yasyāpi prāgdhvaṃ ca svatā, tadapi deyam |
dakṣiṇakāle yatsvaṃ vidyate tadeva deyam, na yatprāgdhvaṃ ca |

śā-- kiṃ dakṣiṇakālāt prāgeva prāptopayogamapi dhanamanupayujya prayatnaina dhārayitvā deyaṃ bhāvitena niścitaṃ tadasapi deyaṃ uta yahakṣiṇākāle'vasthitaṃ tadeva deyamiti saṃśaye sarvaśraddhānugrahāya bhūtabhāvinorapi dānam |
ciṃ-- 'bhūtaṃ bhāvi ca deyaṃ syātkāle'vasthita- meva vā |
' bhāṭṭa-- dakṣiṇākāle yatrāsya svatvaṃ tasyaiva dānaṃ na tu tataḥ prāgapi yatprāptopabhogaṃ dhanaṃ tadanupamujya prayatnena dhārayitvā deyam |
tathālatve punardanāsaṃbhavena 'deyaṃ pratiśrutaṃ caiva' iti vidhivaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt |
pratiśravaṇena ca svopabhogānyadānā- yogyatā paraṃ janyate uktadānaniyamāt 'yaccānyasmai pratiśrutam' ityanyasmai dānaniṣedhācca, na tu svatvaṃ nirvāpavat |
' (dānakāle vartamānameva pradīyate na tu tatkāle avidyamānaṃ bhūtaṃ bhāvi vā ityarthaḥ |
6|7|18-20. mīko. pṛ. 314 'adhikāro nāsti viśvajiti dvādaśaśatyūnadhanasya' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
kiṃ pari- cārakaḥ śūdro deyo neti |
evamau tasmai traivarṇikādyopanata imaṃ śuśrūṣamāṇo dharmeṇa saṃbhastavya iti |
śā-- dharmārtha paricārakatvena yajamānamupasthito yaḥ śūdraḥ sa kiṃ deyo na veti sarvaśraddhānugrahāt paricchedī- karaṇasaṃbhavācca deyaḥ |
soma-- 'dharmaśāstranāthe upanatasya śūdrasya tadānīṃ vidheyatayā svatvasadbhāvāt dānaṃ syāditi pratyakṣavacanāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- śūdraśca na deyaḥ dharmaśāstra- tvāt |
vi-- 'dharmārthasevakaḥ śūdro deyo no vā, sa dāsa- vat |
' bhāṭṭa-- dharmārthe bhṛtyaye vā paricārakatvenāvasthitaḥ śūdro'pi na deyaḥ tatrāsya svatvābhāvāt parasvatvānabhyupa- gamasaṃbhavācca |
' viśvajiti 'na kesariṇe dadāti' atra paryu- dāsaḥ |
viśvajiti nāmaveyena āgrayaṇāgratā prāpnoti gavā- mayane |
viśva- jiti (sarvepṛṣṭhe) 'pavamāne rathaṃtaraṃ karoti, ābhave vṛhat, madhye itarāṇi, vairūpaṃ hotuḥ sāma, vairājaṃ maitrā- varuṇasya, raivataṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ, śākaramacchāvākasya' |
viśvajiti ekāhe paridhānārthaṃ vatsavat āmnātā 'avabhṛthādudetya vatsavat paridhatte' iti |
aṣṭarātrasya prathame'hani viśvajiti vatsa- tvak syāt na vikalpaḥ |
itarathā nāmātideśābhāve tantrabhūsatvāt jyotiṣṭomapratikeṣu aṣṭarātramateṣu bhūyaḥ ahaḥsu jyotiṣṭomatatvāt bhūyastvena prāptāt ahaṃta syāt |
tasmāt viśvajitinnā vatsavatveva syāt na ahaṃta iti |
aṣṭarātragate viśvajiti ekāhāt viśvajitaḥ yaja- mānasya paridhānārthe vatsavatvak prāptā amiomācca ahaṃta vāsaḥ prāptam, tayorvirodhāt vatsavatveva grāhyā iti pūrvapakṣe samuccayaḥ |
hi yasmāt vatsavatvak uparivāsaḥ; ahaṃta ca adhovāsaḥ yogyatvāt |

bhāṣyam-- viśvajityeva saṃdehaḥ sarvasvaṃ dadāti, iti kimarjitavopakaraṇānāṃ yāvanti manuṣyasya, yāvanti ca śaknotyupārjitum, sarvāṇi tāni dadyātkṛtāṇḍa- kāni, uta yānyevāsya vidyante tāni sarvāṇi deyāni, nāviyamānāni kartavyānīti |
yadi caivaṃ dhvanyate, yāni sarvāṇi svāni |
kāni tāni ? yāni puruṣasyopa- kārakāṇi śayanādīni, tāni sarvāṇi dadyāditi vidhī- yate |
yadā yāni svāni puruṣasya dāne śakyāni,
yadi dānaṃ vidhīyate, tato'pradānānāṃ kṛtabhāṇḍakānāmima dānam|
nityaṃ hi viśvajiti dānaṃ codakena prāptamanūdyate|
aniyāni ca kṛtabhāṇḍa- kānīti na śakyāni sarvāṇi viśvajiti kriyamāṇe upasaṃhartum|
tatra kṛtabhāṇḍakānāṃ keṣāṃcidutpatti viśvajiti dānaṃ pratīkṣeta|
nityavacca taccodakena vidhīyate, na nimitta- saṃyogena|
tasmāt avaśyametadabhyupagantavyaṃ sākalyaṃ deyānāṃ prāptānāṃ vidhīyate iti|
śrutyasaṃbhave ca vākyārtho grahītavya eva bhavati|
śā-- 'sarvasvaṃ dadāti' iti kiṃ yatpuṣpopa- bhogyaṃ svaṃ kupyākupyayathāsanagavādi tatsarvaṃ dadāti iti śāstrārthaḥ|
tataśca yasyāpi yannāsti so'pi tadarja- yitvā dadyāt yadyasya vidyate tatsarvaṃ dadātīti saṃśaye yat sarvaṃ svaṃ tat dadātīti śrutyarthavidhilipsayā dāna- vidhiṃ manyate|
codakena tu dānasya prāptatvāt yasya yat asti sa tasmin dvādaśatāmātraṃ dātuṃ pravṛttaḥ san sarva- meva dadātīti sarvatā vidhīyate|
kiñca ayaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ prasiddhatvevena sarveṣu upapannatvāt na asiddhastattvānāṃ ākṣipati arjanam|
soma-- pūrvavat iha nāsti paryudāsaḥ iti pratyaya- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ|
sūtrārthastu-- dānasya nityatvāt arjanīyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kadācit alāmena anityatvāt na tadānstya asti saṃbandhaḥ iti|
vi-- 'arjayitvā'pi ki sarvāṃ deyaṃ yadvā yadasti tat|
bhāṭṭa-- yatkiñcitpuruṣasya upabhogyaṃ svaṃ kupyā- kupyayathāsanagavādi tatsarvaṃ dadātīti śāstrārthatvāt- yāt yasyāpi yat nāsti so'pi tadarjayitvā dadyāt dhātvarthavidhilābhāt|

iti prāpte, ṣaṣṭhavidhaprakārāpatte- środakaprāptadānānuvādena dvādaśaśatāmātrena sarvatāmātra- vidhānāt prasiddhatvevena sarvaśabdasyopapattau aprasiddha- svārjanārkṣepakatayānupapatteśca nārjayitvā deyam|
# viśvajiti pāḍahikarathaṃtarādisāmāṃ madhye vairūpyasya hotuḥ pṛṣṭhastotrārthaṃ niveśaḥ|
tatra ayamarthaḥ saṃśayikaḥ kiṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe niveśaḥ uta ekasya pṛṣṭhadeśe anyeṣāmanyatreti|
kiṃ prāptam ? sarvapṛṣṭhe etasmin sarveṣāṃ sāmāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe niveśaḥ|
kaḥ punaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśaḥ ? ūrdhvaṃ mādhyaṃdinapavamānāt prāk maitrāvaruṇāsāmnaḥ, idamantarāle pṛṣṭhadeśaḥ|
katham ? pava- māne rathaṃtaraṃ karoti, ārmabhe bṛhat, madhya itarāṇi- vairūpaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ, vairājaṃ brahmasāma, śākkaraṃ maitrāvaruṇa- sāma, raivatamanyāvāk sāma' iti|
itarathā, ekasya pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ vidhānaṃ nopapadyate, tat mā bhūditi|
ataḥ paśyāma ekasya pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ niveśaḥ, anyeṣāṃ parisamākārya iti|
tatra pāḍahikānāṃ rathaṃtarādipṛṣṭhānāṃ vidhiriti sthitaṃ saptame|

tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi sāmnāṃ pṛṣṭha- stutisādhanatvaṃ tatra pṛṣṭhadeśe mādhyaṃdinapavamānāme- varuṇasāmamadhye niveśaḥ, uta vairūpasyaiva tatsādhana- tvena tatra niveśaḥ anyeṣāṃ stotrāntarasādhanatvena taccadeśe prayoga iti|
tatra ṣaṣṭhe teṣāṃ pṛṣṭhasādhanatvena ihāpi pṛṣṭhaśabdena tatsādhanatvavagamāt pṛṣṭhadeśa eva prayogaḥ sarveṣāmiti prāpte, brūmaḥ|
'rathaṃtaraṃ bahiḥpavamāne kurvā- dārbhave vṛhanmadhyata itarāṇi vairūpaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe' ityādi- vacanāt vairūpasya pṛṣṭhasādhanatvaṃ itarathā stotrāntara- sādhanatvāni|
na ca pṛṣṭhastutau prayuktānāmeva punarvacanāt stotrāntare'pi prayogo'stīti vācyam|
kiṃca sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdena lakṣaṇayā pṛṣṭhasādhanabhūtāni rathaṃtarādīni sāmāni pāḍahikāni vidhīyante|
stuteḥ bahutvābhāvena sarvaśabdavidhayavā- saṃbhavāt teṣāṃ ca sāmnāmihāditānāṃ kāryākāṅkṣiṇāṃ vācanikaireva kāryairupapattau kiṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhasādhanatvaṃ kalpayet ? tasmādibhyaiva niveśaḥ|
soma-- pūrvatra codakaprāptasāmnābhyeṣa iha pṛṣṭhaśabdasvarasavalabdhaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe na cābhanīya ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ|
tatra teṣāṃ sāmnāṃ pṛṣṭhastotrāṇāṃ ya ekadeśat syāt pṛṣṭhaśabdātpṛṣṭhaśabdasya ca niyatadeśatvāditi|
vi-- 'kiṃ sarvapṛṣṭhe sarvāṇi pṛṣṭhadeśe yathokti vā|
' bhāṭṭa-- 'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' ityatra pāḍahikāni rathaṃtarādīni sāmnāṃ viśvajidaṅgatvena vidhiriti sthitam|
tatra ṣaṇṇāmapi ṣaḍahe māhendrādyarathapṛṣṭha- stotrasādhanatve kalpitehāpi tameva saṃsvādavat samu- cayena niveśaḥ|

iti prāpte, 'pavamāne rathaṃtaraṃ ārmabhe vṛhat madhyata itarāṇi vairūpaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe vairājaṃ maitrā- varuṇasya śākkaraṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ raivatamacchāvākyasya' iti vacanena stotrāntareṣu saṃniveśavidhānāt na sarveṣāṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe eva niveśaḥ|
na ca tatra kṛtānāmapyanena vacanena stotrāntareṣu punarvidhānam, viśiṣṭavidhī gaura- vāpatteḥ|
ataśca kratusaṃbandhitvena prāptānāṃ sāmnāṃ lāghavātstotrā- ntararūpadāsaṃrvamātrakaraṇena sarveṣāṃ klṛptasaṃbandhasyāpi vādhanam|
na caivaṃ rathaṃtarādidharmāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhāpūrvasādhanatve klṛpta- tvemeha stotrāntare tadanāpattiḥ|
'pradhānaṃ nīyamānaṃ hi tatrājñānyapakarṣati' iti nyāyena āvaśyakastotravādyanu- rodhena ca sāṅgatyaiva rathaṃtarasya rathaṃtarapadena lakṣaṇayā vidhānādihaiva pavamānātparvasādhanatvopapatteḥ|
pratyahaṃ sarvaiṣaḥ yu na bhavatīti saṃbandhaḥ|
' # viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe grahītavyāḥ; apyagriṣṭheme grahītavyāḥ (lokaṃpuṇāḥ ekaviṃśatiḥ) |
# viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe tatpūrvakatvājyatīti- ṣṭomikāni pṛṣṭhānyasti ca pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ|
tatra sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ anuvāde vidhiriti vicāre anuvāda iti pūrvapakṣamāha|
viśvajiti yāge syameva sarvapṛṣṭhe sati sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdena punastatra sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ vidhinaṃ saṃbhavati|
kathaṃ viśvajiti : sarvapṛṣṭhatā ? tatpūrvakatvāt jyotiṣṭomapūrvatvatvāt jyotiṣṭomaprakṛtatvāt jyoti- ṣṭomikāni pṛṣṭhāni pṛṣṭhāyastotrāṇi viśvajiti codakena prāpnuvanti|
jyoti- ṣṭome ca catvāri pṛṣṭhastotrāṇi māhendrādīni, tāni vidha- jilapi|
asti ca māhendrādiṣu stotreṣu 'saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni' iti pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ|
tasmāt viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ anuvāda iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ|
'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' iti sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ anuvādaḥ, jyotiṣṭomāt viśvajiti pṛṣṭhātideśaḥ iti sūtraprāptaṃ pūrva- |
ṣaḍahāt pṛṣṭhānāṃ atideśo viśvajiti, na jyotiṣṭomāt|
iti yasmāt tatra ṣaḍahe 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityādyāḥ rathaṃtara-bṛhat -vairūpa-vairāja-raivata-śākarāṇāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ codanāḥ santi|
yadyapi jyotiṣṭome pṛṣṭhāni syuḥ tathāpi na sarvāṇi|
tasmāt pāḍahikānyeva pṛṣṭhāni viśvajiti ati- diśyante|
'viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' iti viśvajiti sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ atideśaḥ ṣaḍahādeva na jyotiṣṭomāt iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha|
'pavamāne rathaṃtaraṃ karoti, ārbhavai bṛhat, madhye itarāṇi|
vairūpaṃ hotuḥ sāma, vairājaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya, raivataṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ, śākara- manchāvākasya' iti viniveśapare vākye liṅgaṃ viśva- jiti pāḍahikāni pṛṣṭhāni darśayati|
jyotiṣṭome māhendrādiṣu caturṣu pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ utpannādhi- kāraḥ|
utpannāni stotrāṇi adhikṛtya pravṛttaḥ 'pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' iti ta utpannānāni adhikṛtya|
kiṃca 'bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityevameva pṛṣṭhaṃ vastutaḥ jyotiṣṭome utpannaṃ māhendrādiṣu tu tatra pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ chandomātreṇa|
tasmāt viśvajiti ṣaḍahādeva sarveṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi pṛṣṭhānāmatideśaḥ|
'viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' ityatra pāḍahikānāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ atideśaḥ iti siddhānte uktaṃ pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate|
pāḍa- hikānāṃ vidhau svīkṛte dvayorvidhiḥ prasajyate pṛṣṭhāni ca vidhātavyāni teṣāṃ sarvatvaṃ ceti|
kiṃca jyotiṣṭome bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ vikalpena satvāt dvayoḥ samuccayaḥ viśvajiti sarva- pṛṣṭhaśabdena vidheyaḥ iti dvayorvidhiḥ syāt|
jyotiṣṭome vikalpena prāptayoḥ bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ dvayoḥ pṛṣṭhayoḥ samuccayaḥ viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdena vidhīyate iti yat pūrvapakṣiṇā uktaṃ tat na|
pāḍahikānāṃ tu ṣaṇṇāṃ vidhāne nāyaṃ doṣaḥ|
tatrāpi sarvatvameva vidheyam, pṛṣṭhāni tu arthāt bhaviṣyanti|
nahi pṛṣṭhānya- kurvatā sarvatvaṃ saṃpādayituṃ śakyate|
tasmāt viśvajiti pāḍahikānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ atideśaḥ na jyotiṣṭomikānāṃ iti siddhāntaḥ|
ke. 'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe tatpūrvaktatvāt jyotiṣṭomikāni pṛṣṭhānyasti ca pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ' (7|3|17) iti|

tatra 'viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho bhavati' iti udāhṛtya kimayaṃ pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ atideśārtho na veti vicārayituṃ jyoti- ṣṭomikapṛṣṭhaviṣayo'yaṃ pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ pāḍahikapṛṣṭhaviṣayo vā iti saṃdigdhe viśvajito jyotiṣṭomapūrvatvāt tatra ca 'pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' iti 'sadasahāni pṛṣṭhāni' iti bahu- vacanavalena māhendrādiṣu caturṣu stotreṣu pṛṣṭhaśabdavācya- tvāvagateḥ pṛṣṭhamṛttvasaṃbhavāt atideśaprāptajyotiṣṭomika- pṛṣṭhānuvādatvāt nātideśādyarthaṃ pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ iti pūrva- pakṣayitvā 'bṛhadrathaṃtaraṃ vā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityekasyaiva pṛṣṭhasya jyotiṣṭome vikalpena vidhānāt pṛṣṭhabahutvābhāvena sarvaśabdayogato pāḍahikānāmeva rathaṃtara-bṛhat-vairūpa- vairāja-śākvara-raivatānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ atideśārthaḥ pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ iti 'ṣaḍahāt tatra hi codanā' 7|3| 318 iti sūtreṇa siddhāntiṣyate|

su. pṛ. 426. 'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe tatpūrvaktatvāt' (7|3| 317) iti saptamādhikaraṇe 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati', 'bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityutpattivākyayoḥ māhendrasto- nāmatvena prathamāgatapṛṣṭhaśabdasya 'satadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni' ityanuvādavākye māhendrādiṣu caturṣu stotreṣu prayogo lākṣaṇika iti prakṛtau pṛṣṭhabahutvaṃ nāsti iti prapañcitam|
tādṛśaṃ ca sarvasvaṃ codakaprāptamapi niya- myate|
tathā ca viśvajiti dvādaśaśatāt adhikameva sarvasvam, na dvādaśaśataṃ tato nyūnaṃ vā|
vi. 6|7|9, viśvajiti sarvasvadāne pitrādīnāmeva deyatā: śūdraḥ na deyaḥ: svatvābhāvāt|
viśvajiti sarvasvadāne bhutyarthaṃ yathārthaṃ ca vibhajya jadavaśiṣṭaṃ tasarvaṃ deyam, vibhāgaśca codakaprāpta eva|
bhāṣyam-- atraiva sarvadāne saṃśayaḥ kiṃ bhūmirdeyā neti? kā punarbhūrmiābhipretā? yadetanmṛdārūvaṃ dravyā- ntaraṃ pṛthivīgolakaṃ nāma, na kṣetramātraṃ mṛttikā vā|
śakyate ca mānasena vyāpāreṇa svasvatvaṃ nivartayitumiti|
kutaḥ? kṣetrāṇāmīśitāro manuṣyā dṛśyante, na kṛtsnasya pṛthivīgolakasyeti|
āha, ya idānīṃ sārvabhaumaḥ sa tarhi dāsyati|
sārvabhaumasya tvetadadhikaṃ yadasau pṛthivyāṃ saṃbhūtānāṃ brīhyādīnāṃ rakṣaṇena nirviśatya kasya- cidbhāgasyeve, na bhūmeḥ|
tannirviśaśca ye manuṣyāstairanya- tasarvatrāṇāṃ dhāraṇacaṅkramaṇādi yadbhūbhūmiktama, tatreśitaṃ prati na kaścidviśeṣaḥ|
śā-- yeyaṃ mahāpṛthivī seyaṃ deyā na veti|
sā'pi sārvabhaumasya dhanamiti manyamāno dānamāha, nāsau kasya- citsvam|
rājyaṃ hi svaviṣayaparipālanakaṇṭakoddharaṇa- bhṛtivṛttitvena karṣakādibhyaḥ karādānaṃ daṇḍyebhyaśca daṇḍā- dānamityetāvān saṃbandhaḥ na hi svāmitvam|
ato na sārvabhaumo mahāpṛthivīṃ dadyāt māṇḍalikaśca maṇḍalam|
soma-- dhanamityanena pitrādīnāṃ dhanatvābhāvāt adāne'pi bhūmerdhanatvāt dānaṃ syāditi pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ sūcitā|
vi-- 'deyā na vā mahābhūmiḥ, svasāmrājyā dadāt tām|
, pālanasyaiva rājyatvāt svaṃ bhūdīryate na sā |
' bhāṭṭa-- yeyaṃ mahāpṛthivī tasyāḥ sārvabhaumadhanatvāt tena taddānam|
iti prāpte, sārvabhaumasya api na tasyāṃ svatvam|
jasyyāpi ca śatrusāmikadhanagrahaṇetrādi- viṣaye eva svatvotpādakatvāt|

mahāpṛthivyāṃ tu rājya- mātrādhikārasyaiva yena saṃpādanāt rājyaṃ hi svāviṣaya- paripālanakaṇṭakoddharaṇarūpam, tannimittakaṃ ca tasya karṣakebhyaḥ karādānaṃ daṇḍyebhyaśca daṇḍādānaṃ ityetāva- nmātram|
tathātve vanagata- tṛṇākādāvāpi svācāpattiḥ tatra svatvotpādakakriya- vidhivirodhāpatteḥ|
' viśvajiti somasya vidhyantaḥ: na darśapaurṇa- māsikaḥ|
sa svargaḥ syāt sarvān pratyaviśeṣāt' (4|3|17|16) iti sūtreṇa viśvajiti aśrayamāṇamapi adhikāriṇaṃ saṃpādayituṃ tadviśeṣaṇaṃ svarga- phalaṃ yuktyā sthāpitam (iti pūrvapakṣaḥ) |
viśvajidadhikaraṇe (4|3|15) hi sarveṣā- manāramyavādānāṃ śrutaphalānāṃ kratusaṃbandhapramāṇatvādi- śūnyānāṃ aphalatvanirākaraṇena phalavattvaṃ sādhyate|
viśvajidadhikaraṇasiddhāntasūtratasya (4|3| 511) 'arthānāṃ hyarthavatvena' ityādyavavasya yogya- tānurodhena vyavahitatvānyaparatayā vyākhyānam|
bhāṣyam-- 'indrāya rāje sukaraḥ' iti yathā vākyāntarasthena vidhiṃśabdena guṇavidhānaṃ bhavati, evaṃ phalavidhānamapi bhavitumarhatīti |
yathā 'varuṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti vyavadhāraṇakalpanāyāpi prāmāṇya- mevamidapi draṣṭavyam |
śa-- 'viśvajitā yajeta' ityādiṣu aśrutaphalānu codanāsu phalaṃ asti neti saṃśayaḥ |
śabdagamyamatthaṃ hi phalaṃ tena vinā katham |
tathā ca sati sampūrṇaṃ vākyaṃ nādhyāhṛtikṣamam |
' tasmāt niṣphala- mevedaṃ karmeti prāpte, ucyate- 'vidhiyuktā kriyā naiva dhātvarthaṃ bhāvyamucchati |
bhāvyena ca vinā vākyaṃ naida tatparipūyate |
' soma-- vratadeva phalāśravaṇādviśvajidāderapi na phalārthamiti pratyākhyānāta saṃgatiḥ |

' bhāṭ-- 'viśvajitā yajeta' ityekāhakaṇḍapaṭhita- viśvajidādāvaśrutaphalake bhāvanāyā bhāpyāpekṣā samāna- padaśrutyupanītato'pi yāgo na bhāvyaḥ, tato'pyanyatra- vidhiśrutayagatapravartakatvena puruṣārthasya bhāvatvā- vagateḥ, tṛtīyāntanāmadheyasamānādhikaraṇyena yāgasya karaṇatvāvagateśca |
tacca phalamekameva kalpyate na sarvāṇi, ekakalpanenaiva nirākāṅkṣatvāt |

tadapyekaṃ svarga eva, na tu putrapaśvādiḥ ' yatra duḥkhena saṃbhinnam' ityādi- vākyāt svargaśabdasya sukhāviśeṣamātratvittvena vijñā- tīyasvargatve'tra janyatāvacchedakatve lāghavāt, putrādīnāṃ tu sukhasādhanatayā prārthyamānatayā śāstrasya mahāviṣayatva- lābhācca |

lāghavāviśeṣe'pi ca na sulatavasya aihikā- muṣmikasādhāraṇasya vilmatropasthitatvācca janyatāva- cchedakatvam, svarasato duḥkhasaṃbhinnasukhasyevehaviṣaya- tvāt duḥkhasaṃbhinnatvasya phalatvānupapatteḥ; vyāpyadharmeṇa janyatvasaṃbhave vyāpakadharmeṇa anyāsiddhatvācca vyabhi- cāreṇa sugatatvasya svargatvadeva kāryatāvacchedakatvānupapa- tteśca |
mokṣo'pi ca yadi duḥkhadhvaṃsarūpaḥ, tadā pāpakṣayādivadeva na viśvajijanyaḥ janyatāvacchedakagauravāt |
yadi tvānandā- vāptirūpaḥ tadā śainaikajanyatvācca viśvajijanyatvam |

yadā'pi 'karmaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ' iti vacanātkarmamātramajanyatvam, jñānakarmasamuccayo vā prāmāṇikaḥ tadā'pi 'tatvaktā karmaphalasaṅgamam' ityā- dyupakramopasaṃhārālocanayā karmaśabdasya sarvakarmaparatvā- vasāyādaśrutaphalakaviśvajidādimātraparatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ |

na caivamapi karmāntarasādhāraṇye asyāpi taphalakatvo- papatteḥ viśvajidākyasya cotpattiparatvenāpi caritārtha- tvātkalpakatvanānupacarita iti vācyam, uktavākyena kalpanālāghavānurodhena klaptaprayogadhīnāmeva karmaṇāṃ mokṣaphalakatvāvagāteḥ aklaptaprayogakasya viśvajidāde- rgrahaṇe vairūpyaprasaṅgena viśvajidākye'pi prayogavidhi- siddhayarthaṃ karmaphalakalpanāyā āvaśyakatvāt |
etena 'vidhivipanniti yajeta' ityādivākyāt 'karmaṇā pitṛlokaḥ' ityādivākyādvā vididipāmātrārthatvaṃ pitṛlokamātrārthatvaṃ vā viśvajidāderapāstam |
ata eva prayogāntarakalpanābhāveva na prayājādīnāmapi vididipā-
tasya nityatve nimittayuktanaimittikānuṣṭhānakatvena viśvajiti prayo- jakatvakalpane vairūpyāpatteḥ |
idamidānīṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ yatkiṃcit, uta svarga iti |
sa svargaḥ syāt sarvān pratyavi- śiṣṭatvāt |
kimato yayevam ? aviśepavacanaḥ śabdo na viśeṣe vyavasthāpito bhavi- ṣyati |
bhāṣyam-- bhavati ca anādiṣṭaphale karmaṇi svargaḥ phalamiti pratyayo loke |
kimato yayevam ? ittha- manena nyāyena svargaṃ saṃpratyayo bhavati |
yasmāt svargahetu karmasu kartavyeṣu phalavacanaṃ naivoccārayanti, gamyate eveti |
śa-- ekaṃ phalamityuktam, tadekaṃ kimiti na jñāyate, ataḥ punarapi sarvārthatvaṃ aprāmāṇyaṃ vā ananya- vasābhāt prāpnoti |
' sati saṃbhave śāstrasya bhūyopivacanaṃ nyāyyam, aviśeṣapravṛttasyātisaṃkocaparihārāt |
svargaśca paśvādiṣu ca duḥkhānuṣaktamalpaṃ ca kecideva prārthyante |
' soma-- yat ekaṃ phalaṃ saḥ svargaḥ syāt sarva- puṃsān prati aviśiṣṭatvāditi sūtrārthaḥ |
vi-- 'ekaṃ yatkiṃcidyathā niyataṃ, na niyāma- kam |
yathā- viśvajiddhikaraṇe hi 'viśvajitā yajeta' ityatra phalaśravaṇatvāt phalamantareṇa ca vidhiśrṛteranupapatteraśruya phale kalpayitavye sarvābhi- laṣitatvena svargaḥ phalamityuktam |
evaṃ ca yatrārthavādavākye vidhivākye phalaṃ na śrūyate tatra svargaḥ kalpyate iti prakṛtanyāyaviṣayaḥ |
na ca viśvajinnāyena kalpayituṃ śakyam, parārthakarmaṇi pravṛttasya arthacaiteva asaṃbhavat |
suvarṇaṃ evaṃ bhavati ityatra kṛto niyamanaśakyatvāt puruṣārtha- midaṃ dhāraṇam |
na cātra phalābhāvaḥ; viśvajinnāyena svargasya kalpyatvāt |
darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargākāmo yajeta iti vākyaṃ phalasaṃbandhamapi na karoti utpattivākyena kṛtatvāt viśvajinnāyena |
dvādaśāhadvābhyāṃ bhavinaḥ trayodaśa- rātracaturdaśarātrādayaḥ sarve sarvaviśeṣāḥ |
'trayodaśa- saṃkhyākā rātrayo yasmin satraviśeṣe so'yaṃ trayodaśarātraḥ' iti samudāyaprādhānyena ekavacanantatayā prāyeṇa nirdeśo bhavati |
kacit samudāyādhināṃ rātri viśeṣāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ prādhānyamabhyupetya eka eva satraviśeṣaḥ bahuvacanāntatena rātri śabdenāmāyate |
tādṛśo rātri satre viśvajinnāyena svargaḥ phalatvena kalpanīyaḥ |
dharmajijñāsādhikaraṇe adhyayanavidhiḥ svargāye iti ( viśvajiti yathā kalpyate tathā nātra ) |
bāla. pṛ. 2. ‘ na phalajñe bhakṣayet ’ atra paryudāsaḥ |
tasya ca abhakṣaṇasaṃkalpasya viśvajinyāyena svargeḥ phalatvena kalpanīyaḥ ( iti pūrvapakṣaḥ ) |
ci. 6|2|5. ‘ na phalajñe bhakṣayet ’ ityādau bhakṣaṇābhāvasaṃkalpasya viśvajinyāyena svargārthatvena vidhānaṃ iti ( pūrvapakṣo'yam ) |
bhāṭṭa. 6|2|5. na cātra ( hiraṇyadhāre ) phalabhāvaḥ; viśvajinyāyena svargasya kalpyatvāt |

khālīpākādayastu aupāsane vihitāḥ na sāmānyavihitān gārhapatyādīn |
pūrvaṃ vahiḥ saṃskārāṇāṃ sādhāraṇyāsādhāraṇe vicārite, tatprasaṅgāt agnīnāṃ laukikā-laukikāsādhāraṇaṃ vicāritamiti saṃbandhaḥ |

bhāṭṭa-- āhavanīyādīnāmādhānena utpannānāṃ prayoja nāpekṣāyāṃ sāmarthyādevāgnisādhyatvatarkeṇalaukikāsādhā-raṇyena kāryamātrātyantaṃ 'āhavanīyaṃ juhoti' 'gārha-patye havīṃṣi śrapayati' 'dakṣiṇāgnauhavīṃṣi pacati' ityādivākyāni tu avayutyānuvādaḥ |
athavā''steteṣāṃ viniyojakatvam, tathāpi kāryāntarāṇāmanyamedhāyaṃ lāghavādeteṣāmeva pravṛttāt grahaṇaṃ agmyantarākṣepe gauravāt |
iti prāpte, sāmarthyādeva sarvārthatvaprāptāvevadeśaviśeṣavini-yogavidhivaiyarthyādeva na sarvārthatvam, nāpyanyatra prasaṅga-siddhiḥ |
ata eva nāgmyantarāsādhāraṇe'pi eteṣāṃ grahaṇam, āyatanādgrahibhāvaniṣedhāt, śrautāgni pākādi-niṣedhasya smṛtiṣu śravaṇāt, smārteṣu aupāsanāmevācaṃ-nikatvāt |

ata eva 'māsīyanti ha vā etasyā-juhvato yajamānasyāyo yajamānameva dhyāyanti yajamānaṃ saṃkalpayanti pacanti ha vā'nyeṣvapi vṛthā māṃsaṃ athaiṣāṃ nāto'nyā māṃsāśā vidyate' iti paśubandha-vinā anyamāṃsasyaśrīnivṛttirlaukikamāṃsasya ca anyāmpi pā
ayaṃ vinodyamaṃ svataḥ siddha- vastuprāptijanavivakṣayāyāṃ pravartate |
yathā- vṛkṣo meyo- dakena candrakiraṇaiśca jīvatīti prasiddham |
956. vṛkṣaśabde uccarite vṛkṣārthe eva manasi vipāri- vartate, nānyasahitaḥ |

ihānyākhyāne vartamāne dvayaṃ niṣpadyate- yacca vṛttānta- ntākhyānaṃ yacca kaścit prarocanā dveṣo vā tatra vṛttā- ntākhyānāya na pravartakaṃ na nivartakaṃ ceti prayojanā- bhāvāt anarthakamiti avivakṣitam |
vṛttasyaḥ sarvā ajahatsvārthāḥ iti tadisadvidhuṃ uktam |

su. pṛ. 1080, vṛttīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ ajaha- svārthatvaṃ tadisadvidhume bhāvyuktā (1|6|1213) 'athaina ninyatronāt' (3|2|19) ityatra sūtrakṛtā coktam pṛ. 1447. tṛttyapāyāḥ yājanādyāpanārthagrahāḥ kātyāyana mṛtyukatāḥ |
pṛ. 39-40. ṛju- pareṣāmapi siddhānte naivāsya mithyāśaṅkā upajāyate |
yasmāt nirvikalpakapratyayapramitameva svalakṣaṇaṃ savikalpakānāṃ viṣaya iṣyate |
sadeṣaviṣayaṃ tu jñānaṃ satyam, na mithyā, yathā nirvikalpakajñānam |
iyāstu viśeṣaḥ, nirvikalpakena saha pūrvābhūtaṃ yat svalakṣaṇaṃ tasya yat anusaṃdhānaṃ arthāntara- ghaṭarna yojanam, tena idaṃ upadyate savikalpakajñānam |
anusaṃdhānapratyayasyāpi samānaviṣayatve savikalpakaṃ mithyā, nirvikalpakaṃ satyaṃ iti na yuktam |
tasmāt mithyātvaśaṅkābhāvāt nāsti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ iti nirā- karaṇamanupayogī |
pṛ. 40. bṛhatī--nanu ca tvayaivemuktaṃ iyāstu viśeṣa iti |
anena viśeṣeṇa paraiḥ iduktam, anusaṃdhīyamāno'rthaḥ saṃhitāyāntaraviṣayatvāt naiva asya ekapratyayaviṣayo- 'rthaḥ paricchedyatā asya pratyayasya pratipadyate |
pṛ. 40. ṛju-- nanu ca tvayaiveti pūrvapakṣasamarthanam |

anenaiva viśeṣeṇa jātyānusaṃdhānainaiva jāyate iti parai- ridamuktaṃ- nirvikalpakena yat svalakṣaṇaṃ bādhārtharūpaṃ pratīyate tat vikalpapratyayasya paricchedyaṃ na bhavati, āla- mbanaṃ tu bhavatīti |
eṣo'bhiprāyaḥ - nahi bāhyaṃ vastu jātyādimiyojitaṃ śakyate, tasya vikalpasyaivarūpatvāt |
pṛ. 40. bṛhatī-- tasmāt paricchedakatvaṃ anusaṃdhānapratyayasya icchanti smṛtitvat iti vadantaḥ |
na ca pareṣāmapi anusaṃdhānapratyaye vikalpamātra vādinām |
ayaṃ gauḥ iti laukikāḥ pratipadyante nedaṃ gotvavat dravyamiti |
nanu ca bhedapratyaye- 'pi abhedopacāro dṛṣṭaḥ 'kuntān praveśaya' iti |
na punaḥ 'ayaṃ gauḥ' ityatra upacāra- buddhilaukikānām |
tasmāt upacarito'yaṃ pratyaya iti na śakyate vaktum |
na ca svalakṣaṇaparyavasāyī evāyaṃ pratyayaḥ, arthāntarānusaṃdhānāt |
yadi ayaṃ anyathāgrāhī pratyayaḥ syāt kathaṃ viparyeti ? (viparyayo bādhakajñānam) |
yatra hi dravyaṃ dravyāntarātmanā avasīyate tatra viparyayo bhavati |
na cedaṃ gotvādi dravyāntaraṃ nīlapītādiva- dviśeṣebhyaḥ pṛthaktvena agrahaṇāt |
yata eva hi viśeṣāḥ sāmānyapratyayena avalambyante ata eva ca pramāṇa- viṣayatvābhyāṃ ayaṃ anyaḥ anyaḥ vikalpāyaḥ pratyayaḥ iti vikalpavidaḥ |
guṇakalpanā'pi anenaiva vyākhyātā, pṛthak agraha- ṇāditi |
iyāstu viśeṣaḥ, jātiguṇakalpanāyāṃ yat ekatrābhinnayorbhedakalpanā, itaratra bhinnayorbhedakalpanā (abhinnayorjātimatoriti) bhedakalpanā, bhinnayoḥ nāmanāminoḥ abhedakalpanā ) |
nanu ca karmakalpanāyāṃ dvayamapyetat na saṃbhavati, bhinnayoreva kriyākārakayoḥ saṃśratho'vagamyate vyapadiśyate ca |
nanu ca vaiyadhikaraṇyamapi dṛśyate 'odanaṃ pacati' 'kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati' , pacyate
kimidaṃ pratyayate vaiyadhikaraṇyadarśanā- diti, jātyādāvapi vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate, 'gorbhāvo gotvaṃ' 'paṭasya śuklatvaṃ' 'asyeyaṃ saṃjñā' iti |
tasmādi- mapi ca kalpanā devadatta iti |
pṛ. 40-46. ṛju-- yathā vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate tathā sāmānā- dhikaraṇyamapi |
na ca ekasya vastunaḥ bhinnatvaṃ abhinnatvaṃ ca saṃbhavati |
parasparaṃ virodhena anayoḥ pratītyoḥ parāhata- tvāt |
avidyamānavastvavabhāsī ca pratyayaḥ vikalpamātra- meva iti |
yathā karmaṇi vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate tathā jātiguṇanāmasvapi |
na ca tāni bhinnāni, abhedāva- gamāt |
ataḥ avidyamānameva kadācit bhinnatayā kalpyate kadācit abhinnatayā iti mantavyam |
bhavati kalpanā- jñānaṃ yadi pratyakṣasadhigamyatā jñānasya syāt |
nanu apratyakṣajñānapakṣe jñānasya ākāramātrālambanam , anyathā jñānamyo- tpattirnopapadyate |
ko'yamantyathābhāvaḥ ; ayamanyathābhāvaḥ; śuktikā hi rajatavat prakāśyate |
śuktikā'lambanaṃ hi tat jñānam, na rajatālambanam |
kathamavagamyate ? śuktikā- saṃpukte cakṣuṣi darśanāt anyathānutpādāt |
cakṣuṣmāneva hi śuktikāṃ rajatamiti manyate 'rajataṃnikṛṣṭaṃ me cakṣuḥ' iti |
ataḥ śuktikā'lambanaṃ ca tat jñānam, na rajatālambanam |
nanu ca avidyamānākārālambanapakṣe nirālambana- taiva jñānasya prāpnoti |
nirālambanapakṣe nahi anyasya anyena vyapadeśa upapadyate |
bhavati cāyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ rajataṃ iti śuktikāyāḥ |
nirālambanapakṣe hi kasya kena ca vyapadeśaḥ, bhinnatvāt śuktikā rajata- jñānayoḥ |
asyārthaḥ- yadā- kārāvabhāsi yat jñānaṃ tat tadālambanamucyate |
tasmāt rajatākārasya jñānasya na śuktikā ālambanam |
tasmāt nirālambanamevedaṃ āpa- dyate iti codyam |
asyārthaḥ- nirā- lambanatve hi rajatajñānasya śuktikāyāṃ 'rajataṃ' iti vyapadeśo na syāt, bhinnatvāt śuktikā rajatajñānayoḥ |
ekamatra śuktikā ālambanam, aparaṃ tu nirālambanam |
tasmāt ekamevedaṃ jñānaṃ śuktikāmeva rajatākāreṇa ālambate |
pṛ. 46-47. bṛhatī-- nanu arthālambanapakṣe'pi anyākārasya jñānasya anyākārālambanajñānaṃ iti nopapadyate |
ālambanameva jñāyate na tu anālambanaṃ ityasmin pakṣe anyākāraṃ ālambanaṃ anyākāragrāhi ca jñānaṃ iti nopapadyate |
pṛ. 47. bṛhatī-- idameva hi ālambanasya ālambanatvaṃ yaduta arthākārameva jñānamutpādayati iti |
anyathā hi cakṣurādivat avāptasyāpi jñānotpattau ālambanavyapa- deśo na syāt |
ṛju-- idameva hi ālambanasya ālambanatvaṃ yaduta ātmākārameva jñānaṃ janayati |
yadi punaḥ kāraka- tāmātrameva arthasya syāt tadā cakṣurādīnāṃ jñānotpattau vyāpatānāmapi yathā ālambanabhāvo nāsti, tathā artha- syāpi syāt |
tasmāt yat ālambanamabhimataṃ tadā- kāreṇa jñānenāpi bhavitavyam |
pṛ. 47. bṛhatī-- kena coktaṃ ālambanasya ākāranira- pekṣaiva iyaṃ kalpanā upeyate |
ṛju-- kenedamuktaṃ ālambanabhūtasya arthasya ākāraṃ anapekṣyaiveyaṃ kalpanā upeyate iti |
yadi paraṃ tameva arthāntarameva arthāntarayojanayā gṛhṇāti tena tadākāragrāhitvāt tadālambanaṃ tāvat aviruddha iti |
bṛhattī-- kathaṃ tarhi kalpanā ? arthāntarānusaṃdhāna- tayā (arthāntareṇa anusaṃdhānaṃ yojanaṃ tadbhāvāt) |
kimidaṃ arthāntarānusaṃdhānatayā iti ? idamidam, yasya lakṣaṇāntareṇa ekatāpattiḥ svātmani ca bhedādhyāsaḥ |
kathaṃ tarhi avidyamānajātyādidhiyā eva jātyādi- pratyayāḥ ? 1 svalakṣaṇe hi avidyamānabhedādhyāsāt avidyamānaviṣayā ityucyate |
ṛju-- pūrvapakṣeṇā hi vijñānaṃ sākāraṃ pratyakṣaṃ ityabhyupagatam |
tatra yadyapi jñānasyaivākāraḥ tathāpi svalakṣaṇasaṃsparśāt svalakṣaṇabhedābhedābhāso na ghaṭate |
tena varaṃ jñāne ca avidyamānasya ākārasya adhyāso'dhyāso yukta iti |
bṛhattī-- vivekāgrahaṇāt svarūpamātragrahaṇāt bhedā- nusaṃdhānāt sāmānyādhyāsaḥ |
abhisrasya cārthasya antareṇa sādṛśyaṃ anusaṃdhānaṃbhānāt bhedādhyāsaḥ |
kayā yuktyā saṃvedyālambamanyatiriktaṃ rūpamasya ? āha, arthāntarānusaṃdhānarūpitaṃ tu |
ataḥ arthāntarānu- saṃdhānāt svalakṣaṇāvalambanamapi kalpanā ityucyate |
tasmāt svasaṃvedyajñānapakṣe eva etatkālakathanasye'pi jñānānyatvasaṃvedanaṃ upapadyate |
anyathā hi ālambana- mātratvātirekaṃ ca na sāmānyamastīti iti pradarśitaṃ svalakṣaṇātirekaṃ ca sāmānyamastī iti pradarśitaṃ rūpā ntarāgrahaṇāt tadgrahe taddvyabhāvāt iti |
arthā- ntarasya anusaṃdhānāca (sarvadeva vikalpajñānaṃ arthā- ntarākāreṇa utpadyate |
anusaṃdhānaṃ ca jñānabhede upapadyate iti upapannaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavyavahāro laukikaḥ |
evaṃ ca anitye nityabuddhiḥ, amuṣme sukha- buddhiḥ, anātmani ātmabuddhiḥ iti upapannāḥ saṃsāra- hetavo viparītagrahāḥ |
nahi anya- saṃyukte cakṣuṣi anyāvalambanasya jñānasya utpattiḥ saṃbhava- ti, anyathyānutpādāt ityuktam |
(siddhāntī āha-) ata evaidamucyate, nānyākāraṃ ālambanaṃ anyākārasya jñānasya utpattaheturiti |
nanu kathaṃ avidya- mānamarthāntaraṃ anusaṃdhānaṃ śakyate ? syādetadevaṃ yadi ekāntena idamavidyamānaṃ syāt |
na cedaṃ rajatajñānaṃ saraṇam, puro'vasthitasya tenākāreṇa vyapadeśāt |
yadyapi jñānamutpadyate tenaiva indriyasaṃyoge yat jñānaṃ jāyate tat pratyakṣam |
tacca bahiḥ rajatākārasaṃbhavāt bāhyāvalambanameva iti siddhaṃ jñānasya apratyakṣatvam |
bādhakajñānojaye sati, tatra ca rajatābhāve sthāpite atasaṃyogajāyaṃ jñāyate |
yatra tarhi bādhaka- pratyaya eva na jāyate tatra na śakyate atasaṃyogajatvaṃ vaktu yathā jātyādipratyaye |
anyākārasya svalakṣaṇaṃ anyākārasya jñānasya utpatti- heturna bhavati |
yadi tathā syāt tadā indriyasaṃyogā- bhāvāt tādṛśena indriyasaṃyogenāpekṣave anya- syāpi syāt |
bṛhattī-- kathaṃ tarhi viparītagrahāḥ anātmani ātmādayaḥ ? |
vipathāntaraṃ sahaśamālambya agṛhītavivekaṃ yat jñānamutpadyate tat sadṛśavidyayāntare smṛtihetutāṃ pratipadyate svarāmeti jñānasya |

vipathāntaraṃ rajatāt śuktikāṃ rajatasadṛśīṃ ālambya idaṃ iti agṛhītaviśeṣam, rajatāt medāvagamahetave ye śukti- kāyā viśeṣāḥ, tān indriyadoṣeṇa sato'pi agṛhītvā sādhāraṇaṇeva śuktikāyāṃ dharmān gṛhṇataḥ yat jñānamutpadya tat sahaśāntare smṛtijanahetutāṃ pratipadyate |
doṣavaśāt khaṇḍitaśukti ke manasi anubhavāvamarśābhāvena smarāmi- tijñānaśūnyasya |
vijñānadvayaṃ caitat, idaṃ iti pratyakṣam, rajataṃ iti smaraṇam, anyathā rajatāgyasasaṃbhavāt |
bṛhattī-- upapannāni tāvat śuktikādiṣu rajatādi- jñānāni anātmādiṣu (ca) |
svapnādiṣu katham ? svapnā- diṣu ca tāvat pūrvoktebhyo viśeṣamabhidhāya nirālambana- vādeṣu punaraviśeṣaṃ vakṣyati |
yat rūpāntarāgrahaṇāt tadgrahe taddvyabhāvāt ityuktam, tadasiddham |
tasmāt yuktaṃ anyasaṃyukte cakṣuṣi anyaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ na pratyakṣamiti |
agrahaṇanimittā ca darśitā bhāṣyakāreṇa ' yadi cakṣurādibhiḥ upahataṃ manaḥ ' iti (pṛ. 27 paṃ. 9) |
kathamananena agrahaṇa- nimittatā darśitā bhavati ? yat anyaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ ityasyāḥ pratijñāyā hetutvena upanyāsāt |
yuktaṃ ca duṣṭatātrāḥ kāryākṣamatvam, na punaḥ kāryāntarasāmarthyam |
ataḥ siddham ' yasya ca duṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ yasya ca midhyeti pratyayaḥ sa eva asīcīnaḥ pratyayo nānyaḥ ' iti |
vṛttikārāntareḥ prābhākaraiśca ānmāyasya kriyārthatvāt ' (1|1|1) iti sūtraṃ sakalavedā- prāmāṇyaparatayā vyākhyātam |
tadyathā- vṛddhakumārī tapasvinī indreṇoktā varaṃ gṛṇīṣveti |
sā varamagṛṇīta putrā me bahukṣīraghṛtamodanaṃ kāśyapātsyāṃ bhuñjīranniti |
na ca tāvadasyāḥ patirbhavati, kutaḥ putrāḥ ? kuto gāvaḥ ? kuto dhānyam ? tatrānayā ekena vākyena patiḥ, putrāḥ, gāvaḥ, dhānyaṃ iti sarvaṃ saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati |
evamihāpi ne'siddhapratiparthaṃ bruvatā nāmāvo'pi saṃgṛhīto bhavatīti |

kecittu- yathā'nayā vṛddhakumāryā ekena vākyena patiḥ putrā gāvo dhānyamiti sarvaṃ saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati tathā ' kāśmīramanāttu muktiḥ ' iti śrutvā yattatsādhanamantareṇa muktyanutpattistatsarvaṃ saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavatīti yuktamasya vṛddhakumārīvaranyāyastho- dāharaṇamiti vadanti |
vṛddhakumārī 0, vṛddhakumārīvākya0, vṛddhakumārīvara0 iti paryāyā iti bodhyam |
yathā- āsīt kaścit janmāndho'tyantadaridro'jātavivāho vṛddha brāhmaṇaḥ |

tataḥ sa brāhmaṇo yadi cakṣuṣmattvaṃ yācyate tarhi dāridryapīḍā syādeva, tathā bhāryāyāṃ yācitāyāmapi dāridryātyantasulabhatāḥ puna- rduḥkhaṃ janayeyuḥ, evaṃ cakne yācitā'pyanyadahaṃ, iti kiṃ yācanīvamiti cintāsamākulo bhūyo vicāryedaṃ prārtha- yat- svapne'tra rājasiṃhāsanasthitamīkṣitumicchāmīti |
atha ca tasya buddhikauśalataḥ paramaprītena parameśvareṇa vara- pradānenānugṛhīto dhanaṃ cakṣuṣī manojñāṃ bhāryā saṃtatiṃ ca prāpyātyantamānanandeti |
vṛddhavyāḥ pratyuttheyaḥ saṃmantavyaśca ityasya nimittāvṛttau āvṛttiḥ |
6|2|10|30. mīko. pṛ. 1600 'gurvanugamanādīnāṃ nimittāvṛttau āvṛttiḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vṛddhavyāḥ pratyuttheyaḥ saṃmantavyaśca ityāditātparyakeṣu upanītasyādhikāraḥ, nānupanītasya |
vṛddhavyavahāraśca (ayaṃ, yat) pramāṇāntarāva- gamyaṃ arthaṃ vākyena pratipādayataḥ kasyacit, kaści- danyaḥ pratipadyate |
tatpratipatyā bāle'pi jānāti 'anenaiva tat pratipādyate' iti |
pṛ. 133. vṛddha- vyavahārasya anāditāyāḥ pratipakṣaḥ, puruṣasya (śabdā- rthayoḥ-) saṃbandhaḥ sadbhāvaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 134. vṛddha- vyavahārasya anāditātvāt nātra (śabdārthasaṃbandha-) kartā śakyate kalpayitum |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 143. vṛddhavyavahāre eva śabdānāṃ svārthe vyutpattiḥ |

vaiyanāyaḥ 1|1|15 pṛ. 23 -24. vede pauruṣeyatvamāpadyeta, atyantānnīyatvāt yathāśrutāt īpadapyanyathātve |
vā. 1|2|17 pṛ. 112. vede prādhānyena vidhiniṣedhau bhavataḥ |
