' sudaivo asi varuṇa ' ( ṛsaṃ. 6|5|7 ) ityatra yadyapi tāvattama vibhaktaya eva sama sindhava iti vyākhyāyante tathāpi tāsāṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāmātraṃ vyākaraṇena kriyate prasiddhameva vā gṛhyate |
yāni tu prayogarūpāṇi tāni loke vede ca vibhāgaśaḥ pratyakṣaṇyeveti na vyākaraṇā- pekṣyaivamabhidhīyate |
yadā punaḥ sama sindhavo naya eva yajñaliṅgyamānapraśaṃsāpakṣe vā sama hotṛgatā vācaḥ sama sāmasvaragata|
staddhikṛtā vā parigṛhyante, tadaitihāsika- yājñikagocarāpannatvādipaya eva vyākaraṇasya |
vaktavyaḥ kathaṃ saṃskāraḥ kathaṃ vā kriyate punaḥ |
' vyākaraṇena śabdeṣu saṃskriyamāṇeṇu na jñāyate kiṃ vastu taskriyate vā kā saṃskāraḥ |
' yeṣāṃ tāvadvarṇyatvaḥ pradhvaṃsinya eva teṣāṃ vināśotpannānāṃ saṃskārāyogyameva |
na ca tāṃ saṃskṛtāṃ bhūyaḥ kaścana drakṣyati kacit |

' yaṃthaiva homasaṃskṛtāṃ bhasma- sāndrāvatsaktūnāṃ punardarśanaviniyogāsambhavādvitīyā- pratipāditasaṃskāratvaparigrahe saktavo homastadbhāvanā- vidhiriti sarveṣāṃ anarthakatvaṃ prasajyate iti saṃskārānā- śrayaṇam, tathaiva kṣaṇikatvādyaccitsaṃskārapakṣe sarvārtha- karaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
tataśca yo'dyamayamiyo'bhihito yathaiva nigaḥ śto'dyāpi kārya ubhayathā'pi lakṣaṇaṃ pratyekaṃyamiti sa evameva nyāyanirūpaṇabhayāmātrāviṣkaraṇārthaḥ |
śiṣyā- mohanārtho veti na yuktaḥ parigrahītum |
' vyākaraṇaprakriyānugṛhītena vaivā- karaṇenotpādyamāneṣu sādhuśabdeṣu nityavedatvalavatvādi- nirākaraṇaṃ svayamevā''pāditam |
tādṛśasya ca saṃskāro na śakyyo nopayujyate |
[ pṛ. 272 ] dṛṣṭārtheṣu ca śabdeṣu nādṛṣṭena prayojanam |
pauruṣeyaṃ kathaṃ vastu vidudhyā- cchrādhato vidhiḥ |
na ca sthalavadārambho varṇaiḥ śabdasya kasyacit |
yena tatsaṃskṛtiḥ sidhyetsa hi pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ |
atha tricaturā varṇāḥ saṃskri- yante pade pade |
[ pṛ. 273 ] vakṣyati hi- ' kartṛguṇe tu karmā- samavāyādākyabhedaḥ syāt ' ( 3|1|10|19 ) iti |
śabdātu- śāsanaṃ śāstramiti vyarthaṃ tadā bhavet |
nāmākhyātādi ( ādiśabdena nipātopasaṃgrahoḥ parigrahaḥ ) saṃskāryaṃ teṣāṃ śabda- vipāvanatva |
śṛṅgaṃ śaśādapoddhṛtya kiṃ na saṃkriyate manāka |

iti bahuprapañcamuktvā kevalasya cāprayogārthaprayuktatvaṃ nirākṛtya vākyānvākhyānārthameva vyākaraṇamapi vyākhyāyatāṃ yuktamāsīt tadanāśrayaṇāttu sūtravārtikabhāṣyakāradeva [ pṛ. 274 ] pūrvāparaviruddhamabhidhānaitaukārairapi sutarāṃ vyākaraṇasya aprayatiputrapraṇītatvaṃ darśitam |
pratyakṣaṃ caitad guṇyamānaṃ na śrūyate iti |
tasmāt yamabhiyuktā upadiśantyeṣa eva sādhuriti, sādhurityavagamyate |
vā-- [ pṛ. 278 ] tulyaprayogapratipattīnāmantya- tarāvadhāraṇamaśakyamiti cet, ata āha-'tatra tattvama- miyogaviśeṣatvāt' iti |
kaḥ punarabhiyogaḥ ? ko vā sadiśeṣaḥ ? kathaṃ vā tena vācakatvanirūpaṇamiti |
pratipadapāṭhe hyanyānyadatyantāśakyatvadabhāve ca lakṣaṇa- nusaraṇamevekaṃ aśeṣalakṣaṇarūpaṇakṣamatve avadhāryate |
pauruṣeyavyākaraṇaparamparāyām ca tadanugatasādhu- tvāntaradarśanāt pūrvadṛṣṭavivekajñānamātraparatvādvā nānya- paramparāvacananyāyaprasaṅgaḥ |
tatsiddhayarthāviniha- śabdarūpājñānaṃ vedaśiṣyaprayogasaṃvādivyākaraṇābhyāsāna- pāramparyeṇa sadyaḥ phalatvāt sulabhamiti na puruṣakṛtala- nimittadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ |

yattu dṛṣṭārthatvāt khasāmarthyaprāptatvā- deva ' aprāpte śāstramarthavat ' ( 6|2|14|19 ) iti vācakabhāṣaṇāvidhānamanupapannamiti tatrādhikaraṇenaiva uttaraṃ dāsyate 'niyamāthā vā śrutirucyate' ( 4|1|15|14 ) iti |
' iti hi tulyatvamāmātthyasaramam-- ' api vā kartusāmānyādukto ( 1|1|12 ) nyāyaśca yaḥ smṛteḥ |
ekasya ca yadā yuktyā samūlatvaṃ nirū- pitam |
tatra abhīyate-- ' smṛtīnāmapramāṇatvaṃ- vigānaṃ naiva kāraṇam |
' mūlānurūpeṇa hi smṛtīnāṃ pramāṇatvaṃ tadavigāne-- ' parasparavigītatvamatastatra na dūṣa- ṇam |
' punarukta- tvādinā hi yatsūtravyākhyānaṃ tasya ca punaḥ samādhā- nam |
' satyavacanaṃ ca sarvaśruti- smṛtiṣu svargasādhanatvena yāgasādhanatvena ca niyatam |
satyaṃ ca dvividhaṃ śabdasatyaṃ arthasatyaṃ ca |
yathāvasthitaviplutātharvacanaṃ śreyaḥsādhanameva yathāvasthita- śabdasatyavacanamapi, yathā cārthasatyaviṣayatvaṃḥ pratyayārthāyaivaṃ viniyogātpratyakṣaśabdatatvavacanamapi |
sa eva tvabhiprāyaḥ kiṃ nyāyyo netyāntarametat |
' dharmāya niyamaṃ ( lokato'rthasya śabdaprayoge śāstreṇa dharmaniyamaḥ ) cā''ha vākyakāraḥ prayojanam |
tena vedagatasabhyajñātaśabdaprayoge'hamakathaṃ- svena vyākaraṇaprakriyetarkyatavyatā nityavācakaśabdarūpa- jñānaniyamaḥ kriyate |

yacca kātyāyane jñāne dharma iti cecchā''dhadharma iti tantreṇa prasaṅgena vā'śabdajñānā- dharmamatvātpadopanidhāya śāstraprayogāye abhyudaya iti niḥśreyasasiddhayupāye'vadhārite yadunaḥ : parābhyatra bhāṣya- kāreṇoktam, athavā punarastu jñāne dharma ityabhyupetya- vādyamātraṃ tatpūrvako'pi parihārasāmarthyapradarśanāya kṛtvā- cintānyāyenoktam |
yathā ' yo'śvamedhena yajate ya u cainamevaṃ veda ' iti jñānamātrādeva brahmahatyādi yadi sidhyetko jātuciddugdhadravyayāyāsādhyamaśvamedhaṃ kuryāt |
tasmāttra- vadeva jñāna- [ pṛ. 288 ] pūrvayogasyaiva phala kāraṇe kāryavadupacārāttulyade devavarṣavajjñāne ( ' devo varṣati taṇḍulān ' ityatra yathā taṇḍulaśabdaḥ vṛṣṭau upacaryate iti
' drathasaṃskārakarmasu parārthatvāt ' ( 6|1|12 ) ityanena nyāyena jñānasya puruṣasaṃskāratvena nirā- kāṅkṣasya phalasaṃbandhāsaṃbhavāt |
ārambhajñānaṃ hi saṃgo'pṛthaktvāt katvarthapuruṣārthatvena jñāyate tena vinā paralokaphaleṣu karmasu pravṛttirnivṛttya- saṃbhavāt |

tathā ' ya ātmā'pahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyurviśoko vijighatso'pipāsaḥ satyakāmaḥ satya- saṃkalpaḥ so'nveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ ' tathā ' mantavyo boddhavyaḥ ' tathā ' ātmānamupāsīta ' iti kāma- vādalokavacanaviśeṣe'jijñāsāgamanasahitātmajñānaketra- lāttvodhaparyantaspaṣṭāmatatvajñānavidhānāpekṣitavākyatantro- pāttasiddhivyāmudayataḥ śreyasarūpaphalasaṃbandhaḥ |

' sa sarvāśca lokānapnoti sarvāśca kāmānāpnoti tarati śokamātmavi- tthā sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati saṃkalpadevāsya pitaraḥ samuttiṣṭhanti tena pitṛlokena saṃpadyo mahīyate ' ityādinā tena janyāṇimātrādyaguṇairbrahmaphalāni varṇitāni |
tathā ' sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣaṃ brahmalokamabhisaṃpadyate na sa punarāvartate ' ityapunarāvṛtyākhyaparamātmaprāptyavasthāla- vacanam |
' pratyāśramavarṇaniyatāni nityanaimittikānyapi pūrva- kṛtaduritakṣayārtha akaraṇanimittāgatapratyayāyaparihārārthaṃ ca kartavyāni |
na ca teṣāṃ bhinnaprayojanatvānninnamārga- tvācca brahmavikalpaparasparājñāḥ saṃbhavanti |
śabda- jñānasya tvaikāntena prayogātpūrvabhāvitvācca na pṛthak phalasaṃbandhasaṃbhava iti jñānapūrvayogaphalatvameva niśvīya- yate |
tatra hucyata ityeva vyākṛteti tu niṣphalam |
yadapi ca manunā paṅktipāvanamadhye vedādevopalabho- kama |
) iti tenāpi pūrvapakṣādākāṅkṣātītavedavadyaśamīmāṃsanavyatirikta- viṣayeṇa satā''vadhayametadeva vyākaraṇamāśrityeti tanniyatatvasiddhiḥ |
bhāṣyam-- aya yaduktam-- artho'vagamyate gāvyā- dibhyaḥ |
apareṇa jñātaṃ sāsnādimānasya vivakṣitastadarthaṃ gaurityuccāritukāmo gāvītyuccārayati |
tataḥ śikṣitatvātpare'pi sāsnāditi vivakṣitai gāvī- tyuccārayanti |
bhāṣyam-- ata eva hi vibhaktitvaye'pi pratyayo bhavati |
' asmakerāgacchāmi ' ityasmakaśabda- kadeśo upalabhye, asmakebhya ityeva śabdaḥ smaryate |
śā-- smṛtyācāravirodhe smṛteḥ balīyastvam, ācāreṣvapi abhiyuktācārasya balīyastvaṃ sthitam |
idānīṃ śabdapāṇḍityabhāge'pi vyākaraṇasmṛteḥ tadabhibhutānāmācārasya ca itaralokavyavahārāt balīyastvaṃ saṃbhavati neti cintyate |

tadiha ekasminnarthe prayujyamā- nān go-gāvī-goṇyādi śabdān vyākaraṇānugatanu- gatān ca udāhṛtya cintanīyaṃ kiṃ ete sarve ekasminnarthe prayoktavyāḥ sādhavaḥ kiṃ vā vyākaraṇānugatā eva sādhavaḥ anye tu asādhavāḥ na prayoktavyā iti |
tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ sarve'pi avicchinnapāraṃparyaprayogā uta kecidaśaktitvā apabhraṃśā iti |
tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ vyākaraṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ aprāmāṇaṃ vā iti cintyanīyam |

saṃbhavati neti, mūlastaṃbhe pramāṇabhūtavyākaraṇasmṛtiśāstra- balīyastvena tadamibhuktapuruṣācāratvena ca pṛthagjanācāra- bādhāt gāvyādīnāmasādhutvam, nirmūlatve tu tadaprāmāṇyāt laukikaprayogaviśeṣān sarvaṣāṃ sādhutvena prayojyatā iti|
'tasmātpramāṇaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ sarvabhāpitavya- miti prāpte, abhīdhīyate- 'prayogapratyayau tāvadvā- cakatvāde'pi hi|
vi-- 'gavyādīṣu sādhutve prayoge vā na kaścana |
na ca niyamadvayasya mūlaṃ saṃbhavati, pratijñavādiśabdamanekaśrutivākyapāṭhāsaṃbhavāt, sādhutvasya pūrvapūrvavirodhanāsaṃbhavena anugataikaśrutikalpanā- nupapatteśca |
na hi sādhutvaṃ nāma arthapratyayatvam, anāditve sati vācyatvaṃ vā |
gāvyādiṣvapaśabdatve'pi sattvāt, apaśabdānāṃ kacit vācyatvābhāve gavādivu gauṇatvasyāpyasaṃbhavāt |
ato vācyatvāttveṣāt na vyākaraṇena niyamaḥ saṃbhavati |
iti prāpte, prayogapratyayayoḥ sādhuśabdāpekṣajñānāṃ gāvyādiśabdānāṃ sādhuśabdopa- sthāpanadvārā upapatteḥ na vācakatvam ttā, aneka- śaktiḥ kalpyate |
na cāmūla- tvam, prayoganiyame 'sādhuneva prayujyeta' ityanenavidhāyā ekasyā eva śrutermūlatvāt |
sādhutvaṃ cānādivācaka- tvam, anapabhraṣṭatvaṃ vā, vyākaraṇabhyāsājanitasaṃskāra- vyutpannyā jātirvā, pramitatvañcā arthapratyayatvaṃ veti kaustubhe evātiṣṭhuṇam |
pratyakṣaṃ ca śrutiḥ 'na mlecchitavai nābhāṣitavai mleccho ha vā eṣa yadapaśabdaḥ' ityādirmūlam |
ayaṃ ca niṣedhaḥ prakara- ṇāt jyotiṣṭomāṅgam |
yajñamātre'pi ca niṣedhaḥ; 'yājñe karmaṇi niyamo'nyatrāniyamaḥ' iti mahābhāṣyānusārāt |
sādhuprayoganimittaṃ paraṃ phalaidaya ityapi 'ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyagjñātaḥ suṣṭhu prayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhugbhavati' iti vacanāt |
rāgaprāptasyāpi sādhuyogasya 'tasmādiyaṃ vyākṛtā vāgucyate' iti vacanādāśrayatva- siddhiriti spaṣṭaṃ kaustubhe |
'gavyādaya eva sādhavaḥ na gāvyādayaḥ' iti sādhusvarūpaniyamasya tu anādi- prayogaparaṃparaiva mūlam |
ataḥ pramāṇaṃ vyākaraṇam yattu- nyāyamūlakaṃ sphoṭādi tatrocyate śrutiviruddhaṃ ca, tannyāyaśrutivirodhe kāmaṃ bhagavatpramāṇam |
' vyākaraṇāt vyākaraṇaśāstropaniyamāt, gavyādyāḥ sādhuśabdāḥ, anādayaḥ anādiprayogasiddhaniyatasvarūpā eva iti yojanā |
bāla. pṛ. 110. vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe ca 'sādhuneva prayujyeta nāsādhun' ityasyāḥ smṛteḥ vedamūlatvābhidhānena anādivācakasyasādhuśabda- prayogasya... dharmapramopayotitā prāmāṇyaṃ saṃbhavati |
kau. 1|3|18 pṛ. 54. vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe hi 'anyāya- ścānekaśabdatvam' iti guṇasūtre ekasyārthasya aneka- śabdatvaṃ nirākṛtam |
-saguṇanirguṇātmapratipādikānāṃ tu ubhayavidhopāsanā- vidhyapekṣitvena svārthaparāyaṇameva abhyudayahetutvaṃ iti vārtike vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe upapādayiṣyate |
kau. 1|2|17 pṛ. 29, vyākaraṇe ca śabdadapaśabdavibhāga- kathanaṃ vṛddhavyavahāramūlam |
sādhuśabdaprayogasya ṛtvartha- puruṣārtharūpatvam, asādhuśabdaprayogasya ca ṛtvarthaguṇā- pādakatvaṃ vedamūlakam, vaidikapadakṣobhādikathanena ca vedājñatā iti vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
soma. 2|1|4 pṛ. 109. vyākaraṇādīnāṃ vedārthajñānopayogitvāt vedā- ṅgatvopapattiḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 2. vyākaraṇakartāraḥ pāṇini-kātyāyana-patañjalayaḥ manyādisamānāḥ prāmāṇye |
na ca tasya svārthena saha vācyavācakatvalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ; kiṃtu tādātmyameva, vākyameva vākyārtha- rūpatayā vivartate yuktikena rajatasvarupatayā |
tatra yadyapi vedavākyārtho mānā-tagamyatathā ahītasaṃbandhaḥ; tathāpi vedavākyasya artharūpatayā vivartate ityasthā- ropitaprakṛtitvapadagatau anvayavyatirekau upāyamātraṃ bhavata iti |
vā. 1|3|27 pṛ. 288. vyākaraṇaprāmāṇyaṃ vedoktaṃ 'dve dviye veditavye iti ha sma yad brahmavido vadanti parā caivāparā ca |
tatrāparā ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo'tharvavedaḥ, śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chando jyotiṣam' ityātha- rvaṇikāḥ (muṇḍakopaniṣad 1|1) |
'vāgvai parācya- vyākṛtā'vadat, te devā indramabruvan imāṃ no vācaṃ vyākurviti, tānmindro madhyato'vakramya vyākarot, tasmā- diyaṃ vyākṛtā vāgucyate' iti taittarīyabrāhmaṇam |
nigamaniruktavyākaraṇavaśena dhātuto'rthaḥ kalpa- yitavyaḥ yathā 'suṇyeva jarbharī' ityādī |
su. pṛ. 260. vyākaraṇasmṛteḥ viṣayaḥ 'ekārthayuktānāṃ kaḥ sādhuḥ ko'pabhraṃśaḥ ?' iti |
na ca smṛteḥ kasya ki yoganimittatvaṃ iyeṣa vyāpāraḥ; tathāpi tu sādhvasādhutvaparatayaiva anvākhyā- nāt nimittatvamanagamyate |
' vā. 3|4|12 pṛ. 651. vyākhyāyanto viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehā- dalakṣaṇaṃ iti nyāyaḥ |

asyārthaḥ-viśeṣya anyatarā- rtharūpasya vyākhyānācchidrakṛtāt pratipattirniścayaḥ; hi yataḥ sandehāt śāstra alakṣaṇaṃ anunutrāpakaṃ lakṣaṇama- lakṣaṇaṃ tathā na, śāstrasya nirṇayajanakatvīciyādityarthaḥ |
asādgyānniścayasiddhayarthaṃ tra śāstre sandigdhākṣararūpā- cāryavyavahāre sandehanivṛttyarthānatiriktanimittatāpe- kṣatvaṃ bodhyate iti yāvat |
paribhāṣendūśekhare mukhavandha eva paribhāṣā- rūpeṇokto nāgeśīrilatyamiti |
sāhasī. 583. vyākhyāyanto viśeṣapratipattiḥ ' ityanayaiva paribhāṣayā 'nahi sandehādalakṣaṇaṃ' itivat 'nahi sandehāvedaḥ' ityapi vaktuṃ śakyam |
vā. 1|3|24 pṛ. 267. vyākhyasya niścitaprāmāṇyavyākhyā- nānusāreṇa arthanirṇayo yuktaḥ; 'vyākhyāyanto viśeṣa- pratipattiḥ' iti prasiddheḥ |
parākramaḥ 6. vyādhāraṇaṃ ājyena yonihome tṛtīyasavane eva |
saṃkalpa, 3|1|7. mīko. pṛ. 1801 'jyoti- ṣṭome tṛtīyasavane eva ājyena vyādhāraṇam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vyādhāraṇaṃ ājyena somena vā jyotiṣṭome pūrvayoḥ savanayoḥ |
tena saṃjñena sarvasyaivābhāvasya pūrvakṣaṇavṛttitvaviśiṣṭasyābhāvamaprati- yogyādhikaraṇatvaṃ hetvadhikaraṇasya iti |
tṛtīye tu kapi- saṃyogābhāvavān ātmatvāt ityādau adhyāptiḥ |
ātma- vṛttikapisaṃyogābhāvābhāvaḥ kapisaṃyogaḥ tasya na guṇa- tvāt tatpratiyogitāvacchedakaṃ guṇasāmānyābhāvaṃ tadava- cchinnādhikaraṇatvaṃ ca hetvadhikaraṇamantaḥ iti cet |
nanu kālo ghaṭavān kālaparimāṇāt ityatra prati- yogivyadhikaraṇabhāvāprasiddhiḥ |
hetvadhikaraṇasya mahā- kālasya jagadādhāratayā sarvaiṣāmabhāvānāṃ sādhyatāva- cchedakasambandhena kālikaviśeṣaṇatvena pratiyogivya- dhikaraṇatvasattvāt |
saṃgirante teṣāṃ yadyapi mano dravyaṃ ākāśāvat vyāpakaṃ tathā'pi karṇacchidraparicchinnasya gaganasya dehāva- cchinnasyaivendriyabhāvaṃ ātiṣṭhante manasaḥ, ato'saṃbhavī bāhyena saṃyogaḥ |
yadi caturvidha eva saṃyogaḥ kathaṃ tarhi śabdagrahaṇaṃ ? na hi śrotrasya ākāśādihaṃkārāṇāṃ anyatamātmakasya śabdasya ca niṣkriyatayā tayoḥ saṃbhavati saṃyogaḥ, tasya karmajatvāt |
na cāyaṃ karma- janyaḥ, saṃyogajasaṃyoge vyabhicārāt |
tat ubhayānagataṃ nairantaryemeva dravya- gatam kāraṇam |
bhavatu vā saṃyogajasaṃyogasyāpramāṇakatvātsaṃyogaḥ saṃyogasya karmaja- tvam, avyabhicārāt |
tannugata eva hi turīsaṃyogaḥ tanto abhāvaṃ āpacca ghaṭato'pi bhavati, na tu saṃyogāntarakhaḍgiḥ : tatrāsti, saṃyogo vibhuno-
na hi niyamaṃ grahītuṃ deśāntarādisaṃbhavo grahītaḥ kuḍyādīnāmiṣa sthiraṃ rūpam |
na hi teṣāṃ kālāntarasambandhaḥ apratyakṣa iti tatpūmapratyakṣaṃ bhavati |
tathā seṭaṃ rajatarmiti pūrvajñānabādhakamuttarakāle na syāt viṣayabhedāt |
pūrva- kāle hi rajatajñānena rajataṃ prasañjitam |
uttarakāle ca tadabhāva iti viṣayamedāt kathaṃ bādhakatvam ? ataḥ sthirameva rajataṃ gṛhītamiti vaktavyam |
āha ca- 'rajataṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ hi cirasthāyīti gamyate' |
tada- niyamarūpaṃ gṛhyate iti yuktaṃ pratyakṣatvam |
kīdṛśaṃ punaridaṃ rūpaṃ dhūmādīnām ? niyatojyamaneti niyamaḥ |
kiṃ pratyakṣaṃ sarvaṃ vidyamānopalambhanaṃ ahosvit avidyamānopalambha- mapīti |
yathoktam- 'yo yasya deśakālābhyāṃ samo nyo'pi vā bhavet |
sa vyāpyo vyāpakastasya samo vā'pyadhiko'pi vā ||
yattu dhūmasvarūpaniyama ityuktam, asyaitat svarūpamapi tadisaṃntra-vyāptibhārātmakameva |
tathā ca tasmin pratyakṣīkriyamāṇe deśāntarādisaṃbhavaḥ pratyakṣa āpadyeta |
tatsambandhādiriktaṃ tu pāṇḍuratvādivat dhūmagataṃ niyamābhimānamaparokṣaṃ rūpamīkṣate iti saṃviddhi- rūḍham |
yadi cedaṃ rūpāntaraṃ pāṇḍuratvādivat sarvavyāpti- riktaṃ syāt, tasmin pratyakṣagṛhīte'pi sarvadhūmadeśakāla- vyāpitvamagnerhita na syāt |
na hyanyasmin gṛhīte anyadagṛhītaṃ bhavati, atiprasaṅgāt |
agṛhīte ca deśa- kālāvyabhicāre kathamanumānodayaḥ ? kiṃcidaṃ rūpāntaraṃ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyamāṇaṃ saṃnihitadeśakālavahnayameva gṛhyate iti na kālāntareṇa niyamaḥ sidhyet |
yadapi darśitaṃ kuḍyādīnāmiṣa sthitaṃ rūpamiti, tadapi nirūpaṇīyam |
kiṃvā yadvastṛtaḥ sthāmarūpaṃ tadgṛhyate iti kiṃvā sthitiyogyatā ? na tāvat pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ, sthāyitā anekakālavasthānam, sā kathaṃ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate, tasya vartamānaviṣayatvāt |
yadi cedaṃ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate tataḥ sthāyitāsidvaye pratyabhi- jñādaro nirarthakaḥ syāt |
dvitīye tu kalpe kuḍyārūpameva tat nānyat, evamihāpi yadvastṛto niyataṃ dhūmasvarūpameva tatastatkṣametye sidhyet |
na ca tāvatā kiṃcit prayojanamasti, yogyatā tu sarvabhāvānāṃ arthāpattigamyeti pratyakṣagamyatā'nupapattiḥ |
yastu ghaṭakaḍyādiṣu dṛṣṭa- mātreṣu sthāyitvāvagamo laukikānām, sa tādṛśāṃ sthāyi- tvasya pūrvamevānugamādamānikaḥ |
tathāhi īdṛśīyamavagatiḥ yadi śabdādinā naitadriyate tataḥ kiyatkiṃcit kālaṃ sthāyya- tīti |

anumānena hyetadavagataṃ rajatasya sato nāksādatadbhāvaḥ saṃbhavatīti atadasya vā tadrūpeti ubhayopi kālyo- rekarūpamevedamiti sthite pūrvamevāvagataṃ rajatamuttara- kālaṃ vyāpnoti uttarakālāvagatatvāt : tatpūrvakālam |
tena samānaniyatyā pūrvāvagatasya rajatasya bhavatyu- ttarakālabhuvā nedaṃ rajatamītyanena bādhaḥ |
yatra tvanumānena ekarūpatvaṃ na kāladvaye'pi vastuno'vagataṃ tatra na bhava- tyeva bādhaḥ |
yathā badaraphale śyāmapratyakṣaṃ pākakāla- śruvā raktapratyayena |
pratyakṣaṃ tu sthāyitvamagne tatrāpi bādhaḥ syāt |
nanu svābhāvikalaṃ saṃbandhasya niyamaḥ na tu kālāntarasambandhaḥ, tacca vartamānameveti yuktaṃ yat pratyakṣaṃ gṛhyate |
kiṃ punaridaṃ svābhāvikam ? na tāvat sadātanatvam, kadācitkasya tadayogāt |
atha svarūpa- nimittatvam, amaṃrapi dhūmasambandhe svarūpaṃ nimittamiti
nanu ārdradhanādi- kṛtaḥ asya dhūmasambandhaḥ na svarūpanimittaḥ, satyam, ārdradhanādinimittaṃ svarūpamapi nimittameva |
atha svarūpaikanimittakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ, vahnestu dhūmasambandhe svarūpātikto'pyārdradhanādiḥ asyaiva hetuḥ, dhūmasya vahnirsambandhe svarūpameva nimittam, na nimittā- ntaramastīti matam |
na hi tena nimittāntarābhāvaḥ śakyate pratyetavyam, bhāva- viṣayatvātpratyakṣasya |
api ca dhūmasyāgnisambandhe na svarūpameva nimittam, amārdīnā- mapi nimittatvāt |
abhyabhicāraśca sakaladeśakālavyāti- riti pratyakṣagamyatvānupapattiḥ, tasya vartamānaviṣayatvāt |
api ca svābhāvikatvā'pi vartamānasya saṃnihitasya niścetuṃ śakyate, nātītānāgatavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭānāma saṃbandhānām |
santi hi bahavo vahnidhūmasambandha- vyaktāyaḥ, kathaṃ tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ dhūmasvarūpameva nimitta- miti saṃyuktaviṣayeṇa pratyakṣeṇa gamyate |
atha saṃbandha- sāmānyāsya tannimittatvam, na, tasya nityatvena nimittā- bhāvāt |
idaṃ ca sakṛddarśanamapi niyamapakṣe'pi tulyameva dūṣaṇam |
tatrāpi hi saṃprayuktasya hi saṃyogasya dhūmā- bhāvanimittatvā'gamyate, nātītādīnām |
sa na kāla- ntare naṣṭa iti pratyakṣagatasya saṃyogasya rūpanimittaṃ kālāntare'numānam |
tasmāt na kathaṃcit pratyakṣaviṣayatvaṃ niyamasyeti sthitam |
yadaitacchrayo'mī dhūmadarśanamartho na kacida- pyadarśanam, idamasati dhūmasyāgninā niyamade'nupapannam |
aniyato hi kadācit kvacidagniṃ vināpyagniṃ vyeteti |
na tu tāvatā sarvatra anauau śakyamavasitum, pramāṇābhāvāt |
na tu tāvanmātreṇa sarvajñāvasyeva dhūma iti svadhyava- sānam |
kimatra vaktavyam ? yataḥ- svayaṃ vārtikakāreṇa pramāṇamupadarśitam |
atrajanno hi pūrvabhāgāṃ mahantaṃ kleśamāśrityānumānā- rūḍhā vaiyarthyamātreṇaikāvagatitvāyenanyāśritāḥ |
niyato dhūmojyaṃ nūnamagnerlakṣaṇarūpaṃ jñānasya saṃvidvirūḍhapratyakṣa- tvāśrayaṇādāstaṃ cāyamyugmābhyāṃ bhūyodarśanagamyo niyama iti |
kiṃ punaridaṃ bhūyodarśanaṃ nāma pramāṇam ? naike kiṃcit niyamaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate |
kintu yainaiva pratyakṣā- dīnāmamyatamena liṅgasya bhūyaḥsāhityaṃ liṅginā gamyate tadeva niyamadarśanasahāyaṃ niyamapramāṇaṃ saṃbhavatīti |
nanu bhūyobhirdarśanaistatra sāhityaṃ gamyate na tu sarvatra darśanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ svaviṣayaparyavasānāt ananta- pratyakṣagamyo hi sarvatra sahabhāvaḥ sa jīvandurlabhaḥ |
vipakṣadarśanādapi pratyāsanneva vipakṣe paramābhāvo gamyate, sarvavipakṣavyāvṛttastu durlabhaiva, dṛṣṭādarśa- nābhāvāt |
adarśanamātreṇa cābhāvāsiddheḥ, tatkathaṃ niyamasya sarvadeśakālavyāptirūpasya bhūyodarśanagamya- tvam ? etacca svayamevācāryeṇa śaṅkitam |
yadāha-- 'anvayo hi prativyāptaṃ vyāpakasya na dṛśyate |
etaduktaṃ bhavati- mā nāma sarvavipakṣabhāvo liṅgasya saitsīt, adarśanaṃ tu vipakṣe liṅgasyāsattvam, tāvatā ca sahacārī dṛṣṭo dhūmādiḥ sahacāriṇo'gnyādergamakau bhavati |
yattu saha- cāritvamapi sarvatra durlabhaṃ dṛṣṭamityuktaṃ tatrāpyuttaramuktam- 'durlabhaṃ sahacāritvaṃ sarvatrati yaducyate |
dṛṣṭaṃ na nāma sarvatra dvitriṣvartheṣu dhruvam |
ayamarthaḥ- mā nāma sarvatra saha- cāritvaṃ darśa, dvayostayoḥ pradeśayorbādhakaṃ darśanam |
yadi hi sakaladeśakālavyāptirūpo niyamo'numānāṅgadharmābhi- rūpagamyeta tataḥ syādupālambhaḥ |
na tvevamasmābhirucyate, kintu yatra yatra dhūmādikaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tatra sarvatra niyame- nāmyādisāhityagamyau cādarśanamityetāvadevanānumānādeye kāraṇam, etāvadeva hi laukikānāṃ dhūmo'gniṃ gama- yati |
na tu sakalapakṣaviṣayānvayavyatirekāvagatimepekṣate, yena durlabhaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt |
tena na sakaladeśakālā- pekṣayā niyamābhidhānamapi tarhi itthamāneṣu deśakaleṣu yo liṅgasya liṅgisāhityaniyamaḥ sa eva niyama ityu- cyate |
tacca bhūyobhirava darśaneḥ sugamamiti nāmnāṇaṃ liṅgisāhityaniyamaḥ |
kiñcit punaḥ : sāhityaniyamairanumānam ? ko nāma- tatsaṃbandhe yāvadvirdṛṣṭaṃ tāvadvirdṛṣṭaṃ na tu saṃśayāya vaktuṃ śakyate |

ye'pi bhūyodarśanasahāyapratyakṣagamyaṃ niyamamāhuḥ, ye'pi sakaladarśane'pi gṛhītaṃ niyamaṃ upādhyāyādyuktā- niśakaraṇārthamarthanye bhūyodarśanaṃ te'pi naivaṃ saṃvatsarate tathā vayamapīti na taddoṣaḥ |
kimidānīṃ sakaladhūma- deśakālavyāptitvamemeḥ nāvagantavyamanumitsatā ? satyam, nāvagantavyam |
nanvevaṃ sāmānyato'nvayavyāptisaṃbandhaḥ pakṣa- kadeśīyaṃ kathamiva śatasaṃbandhena abhīyate |

tadayaṃ bhāṣyārthaḥ:- anyasminneva mahānasādyekadeśini dhūmāgne- kadeśābhyāṃ jñātasaṃbandhe sati tadekadeśaṃ dhūmaṃ anyatra parvatādau tatraiva vā mahānase kālāntare dṛṣṭādiritu- mīyate, loke tathā darśanāt |
tathā ca jñātasaṃbandhapadena jñātuṃ nirdeśa ityuktvā athavā na pramātuḥ : kintu prameyasya kasyacit nirdeśo na jñāturityarthaḥ |
evaṃ ca vadan jñātasaṃbandhapadena ekadeśīyapadena dṛṣṭāntaika- deśino'bhidhānamityāha |
yatrayatra yatra dhūmastatra tatrāgniḥ iti bhūyodarśano'vagamaḥ ; sa katham ? na asau nāsti na cāpramāṇam, sarvadā sarveṣāṃ dṛḍhatvena jāyamāna- tvāt |
dhūmasya hi bahuṣu deśa- kāleṣu agninā sāhityamupalabhyato bhavati anumānam |
anyeṣvapītānāgataviprakṛṣṭāḥ sarve eva dhūmanto'mi- manto dhūmatvāt paridṛṣṭamahānasādirditi |
tena pakṣādekaṃ pramāṇasāmānyamanusṛtā dharmāntaragatasāhitya- niyamatvena dharmāntare'numānamityavagamya |
āha ca- 'tena dharmāntareṣveṣā yasya yenaiva yādṛśī |
deśe yāvati kāle vā vyāpatā bhāsūnirūpā |
tasya tāvati tādṛk syād dṛṣṭadharmāṃtare punaḥ |
yādṛśatādṛśaśabdābhyāṃ dṛṣṭāntārtharūpatā nyūnarūpasya na liṅgastvaṃ nāpi liṅgitvamiti darśitam |
na hi vinā dhūmatvaṃ pāṇḍura- vastramātreṇa kapātādibhyaḥ agniṃ anumimate laukikāḥ |
nāpyuṣṇavahnijanitaḥ : tṛṇavikāro hyi dṛṣṭaḥ pratyakṣava- gatadharmāviśeṣatvāt auṣṇyavattve sati anumānameva vanhi- manumāpayati |
yathā loke ca pramāṇagatiḥ parīkṣakaiḥ ranumaraṇīyā, na tādṛśene |
tena niṣiddha- tvamahitasya hiṃsatvasya adharmatvena sāhityamupalabhya brāhmaṇahananādiṣvāta vinā'pi niṣiddhatvena hiṃsatva- mātrātprāṇīhiṃsāyāmadharmatvaṃ anumātuṃ śakyam |
niṣiddhatvasya vinā'pi hiṃsatvena pūrvvajñatvajñāpanādā- vadharmatvasāhityaṃ iti tadanumāpakam |
yathā adhya- yanādikārthavataḥ : śiṣyasyālukupādhyāyāsāhityamavagata- miti na śiṣyamātreṇādhyāpyamānam |
pītādineṣapanimittamiti tadabhāve devadattatanayatvamātreṇa na tattanmātratasya syāmalātumānam |
etena saṃnivedā- viśiṣṭatayā tanutadagnīhādīnāṃ ghaṭādivat upalambha- tarkatvakatvānumānaṃ pratyuktam |

tathāhi yeṣu hastādidhyāpāra- viśeṣeṇa saṃniveśaḥ śakyante racituṃ teṣāmeva ghaṭapaṭa- gṛhādīnāmapalambhitamakartṛkatvam, tadabhāve pāriṇāmi- kānāṃmadehādīnāṃ saṃniveśaviśeṣamabhreṇa kathaṃ tadanumānaṃ pāṇḍuramadrādiṣviva vahyanumānam |
tathā śarīreṃdriyādi- yuktabuddhimatkartṛkatvena sāhityaṃ saṃniveśaviśiṣṭatāmapa- labdhaṃ tacca dṛśyādeśāt dūto'ṅkurakādiṣu niṣiddham |
tasmin niṣiddhe buddhimanmātraṃ dvārādirādirhataṃ ganumānaṃ draṣṭavyam |
na caivaṃ sarvānumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ, saviśeṣaparihāreṇa bhūtatva- sāmānyasya vadisasāmānyena sāhityamavagataṃ parvate na tadavikatvameva dṛṣṭamiti yuktaṃ tatra tadanumānam |
avagatamapi mahānasādī sāmānyaṃ deśāntarakālāntarādau pratyakṣeṇa- vānumānena pratyabhijñāyamānaṃ bhavān prayogamiti na siddhasādhyatā |
sāmānyasyāpi cānyatvaṃ saṃyuktasamanyāya- saṃbandhaḥ parvatena, iti yuktaṃ tatra tasyāmānam |
nanu deśaviśeṣe'pi padārthasvarūpabhavyathā bhavati, kvaciddhi vṛścikadaṃśādi maraṇaṃ bhavati, kvacicca, tathā dhūma- syāpi deśāntare agnirvyabhicāraśaṅkā bhavet |
satyeṣā bhavati, sā tu tattaddeśādāgatyaḥ śrutvā kathyate nirasitu- miti sarvamavadātam |

tena yasya yādṛśasya sāmānyasya viśeṣasya vā yena yādṛśena viśeṣeṇa vā yathā- dṛṣṭeṣu deśakāleṣu sāhityaṃ yena kenāpi saṃbandhena niyata- mupalabhyam, tadeva tādṛśameva deśāntarakālāntarādau dṛṣṭaṃ tasya tādṛśasya sāhityaniyamādeva bodhakaṃ bhavati |
dṛṣṭapradeśeṣu bhūyobhirava darśanairdhanādirādīnāṃ sahāyaiḥ sāhityaniyamaḥ śakyāvagamaḥ : iti siddhaṃ niyamarūpa eva liṅgasya liṅginā saṃbandhaḥ, sa ca bhūyodarśanapramāṇaka iti |
atra ca deśakālabhyāṃ saṃyogena na viśiṣṭamarthirye pratīyate, guṇānāṃ dravya- pagatatvasvabhāvatvāt |
tacca śabdānāmiva padārthānyaviṣayamiti cet, tasyāpi pratyakṣamūlatvāt |

loke tu yena prakāreṇa padārthānāṃ parasparānvayaḥ pratyakṣairbiniścitaḥ, tathaiva śabdo bravīti, itarathā vedavākyeṣu yathātathārthapari- tyāgena lakṣaṇā gauṇā vā vṛttyā'nyārthavarṇanaṃ kriyamāṇa- mayuktaṃ syāt |

ato'nyathāmātraviṣayo nyāyaḥ na śābda- viṣayaḥ : saṃyogasya na deśakālaśca dravyaviśeṣatvena pratīto sthityā saṃyuktāvagamito idānīmagnidhūmavi- tannayo bhavati, na idānīṃ agnidhūmayoḥ : saṃyoga iti, itarathā saṃyogasya deśakālaviśeṣatvaṃ kimiti nāśrī- yate ? tataśca yāvaddravyabhāvitayā saṃyogasya pratīta- tvāt yatra dhūmaḥ : tatrāśiśeṣeṇa ityenīpādhika eva dhūmasya abhisaṃbandhaḥ sakṛdadarśane eva siddhaḥ |
nevam, yadi sāmānyamantareṇāpi vyaktyagrahabhasti, tadā syāt sāmānyasya guṇabhāvaḥ |
na ca sāmānyamantareṇa kadā- cidapi vyaktaḥ pratītiḥ |
na hi rūpaśūnyā kācidapi rūpabuddhirasti ityuktvāt |
ato jātiviśiṣṭasyaiva prādhānyāt, tena saṃyogasyāvantyāt sarvadhūmavattā sakṛ- devāmisattā gṛhītā bhavati |
taduktam, 'tathā ca sati dhūmasattaiva deśāntare kālāntare vā pramāṇamapekṣate, na ca tathyā satyāmamisaṃyogaḥ' iti |
evaṃ gṛhīte'- pyanaupādhikatve yadyupādhiśaṅkā kasyacit syāt, tadā bhūyodarśanādeva śaṅkānirāsamātraṃ kriyate, na vyāpti- grahaṇam |
nanu upādhyarśana'pi śakkodayādeva darśanamapi śaktameva syāt, evaṃ tarhi atiprasaṅgaḥ, ghaṭādigraha- ṇe'pi bādhakaśaṅkayā ghaṭādigrahaṇasyāpi aniścayaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu arthinā saṃyogasya sakṛddarśanenyāt sakṛddarśa- nenāgninā dhūmānumānaṃ prasāvyate |
naivam, sakṛddarśane- naivāgnerdhūmasaṃyogo'pyanaupādhika iti prāptam, uttarakālaṃ tu āgneyatvādyupādhidarśanāt aupādhikatvaniścayaḥ |
na ca upādhidarśanāt aupādhikatvaniścaye upādhyadarśane'pi tatsambaddhaḥ |
na ca sakṛ- darśanasyāśaktau bhūyodarśanasyāpi śaktiḥ, bhūyodarśanā- mapi pratyekaṃ sakṛddarśanatvāt |

ratnatatvagrahaṇe tathā dṛṣṭamiti cet, naivam, na tatrāpi bhūyodarśanasya grāhakatvam, kiṃtu vivecakākāra- grahaṇe pravṛttaṃ tasya ca atisaukhyāt manaḥsamavadhānāya- bhāvācca na tattvaṃ grahītuṃ prabhavati, kevalaṃ ratnamātrameva gṛhṇāti |
evaṃ anekadarśane jāte manaḥsamavadhānādi- sāmagrīsaṃbhavāt arthādavedā tattvaṃ gṛhṇāti |
bhūyodarśanasya kāraṇatvābhyupagame indriyasaṃnyadhādivat sarveṣāṃ bhūyodarśana- niyamo'pi syāt |
na ca tathā dṛśyate, ekaḥ sakṛ- darśanādeva tattvaṃ gṛhṇāti, aparastu śatadarśanāt |

yattuktaṃ sakṛddarśanasyāsāmarthyaṃ'pyekasya darśanajātīya- syaiva sāmarthyaṃ saṃbhavati, tathā ekasya vṛścikadaṃśasya maraṇahetutvaṃ ekasya kharjurasya piṇḍatvamityādi, tadapya- yuktam, tatrāpi bhrāntibhedena deśabhedena vā sāmarthyaṃ kalpanīyam, na tu ekaviṣayasya śaktidvayam |
' vidhivalena kasyacidvyāpyamānasyeṣṭatve kalpyamāne 'vyāpyavyāpyasya sutarāṃ vyāpyatvam' iti nyāyena maitrā- varuṇa eva tadavagatastasyaivetyevam |
'yajeta' iti yā saṃkhyā pratīyate sā guṇabhāvāṃśe na vivakṣitā ityetat nānukte nyāye syāt |
nahi vyāmugdhavān alaṃ kurute puruṣaprayatnaḥ iti teṣāṃ upekṣā kāryā |
ṛju. pṛ. 55. yasya hi darśanasya pramāṇaṃ nāsti vyāmohaḥ (bhramaḥ) saḥ, yathā śuktikāyāṃ rajata- darśanam |
'sāmidhenīnuvacanam etā vyāhṛtīḥ purastāddhāti' ityādibhirvihitāyāṃ daśahotṛ- vyāhṛti- hiṃkāra- sāmidhenīnāṃ kramaniyāmakābhāvādaniyatakrameṇetyarthaḥ |
iti prāpte, 'hiṃkṛtya sāmidhenīranvāha' iti kṛtvā- pratyayenādhyayitapūrvakālakathanāt sāmidhenībhyaḥ pūrvo hiṃkāraḥ |
daśahotṛpi tathaiva śravaṇe'pi mantrātprakaṭāgrāhyatibho'pi pūrvaṃ niveśaḥ |
sarvaitrādhyayanasyāyāt yatrā''dityavadhanenopapattī sthūla- vyavadhānasyāyuktatayā praiṣakramaḥ sidhyati |
arthaviśeṣaviṣayāṃ pratītimanumāya śabdadravyabhāvinīṃ śabdasya svārthaṃ dāktinirūpaṇā vyutpattirucyate |
ṛju. pṛ 16. vyutpattiśca arthena saha śabdasya, na vijñānena kāryeṇa, tasya ānantyāt vyabhicārācca |
buddhavyavahāre hi anena śabdena ayamarthaḥ pratipādyate iti śabdārthayoḥ vācyavācakasambandhāvasānameva vyutpattiḥ ityucyate |
vyutpattiprayojakaḥ kriyākārakānvaya eva, na tu śeṣaśeṣibhāvaḥ |
vyutsekaḥ 'prācyāṃ diśi devā ṛtvijo mārjaya- ntām' ityādimantraiḥ daśapūrṇamāsayoḥ dikṣu sarvāsu apāṃ prakṣepaḥ |
10|2|20| 61. 'saurye carau vyuddaranasya bādhaḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
puroḍāśasya kapālebhyo vyuddaruṇyā antarvedyāṃ barhiṣi āsādanaṃ kriyate |
vyuddaruṇyā āsādanaṃ ca prakṛtau aśrutaṃ na śrutam |

samūḍhastattat aindravāyavāgrau prāyaṇīyodayanīyau, daśamaṃ cāhaḥ, athaiteṣāṃ navānāmahamendravāyavāgraṃ prathama- mahaḥ, atha śukrāmam, atha''grayaṇāmam, athaindravāya- vāyamam, atha śukrāmam, atha''grayaṇāmiti |

atha vyūḍhaḥ, aindravāyavāgrau prāyaṇīyodayanīyau, athai- tareṣāṃ daśanāmamahaṃ aindravāyavaṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāmam, atha dve āgrayaṇāme, athaindravāyavāyamam, atha dve śukrāme, atha''grayaṇāmam, atha dve aindravāyavāgre iti |
siddhānte yatra vacanaṃ liṅgaṃ ca tatra vyūḍhaḥ pravartate, anyatra aviśeṣeṇa samūḍha iti |
10|2|24|7|9-82. mīko. pṛ. 2186 'dvādaśāho vyūḍhaḥ samūḍhasya vikāraḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vyūḍhe dvādaśāhe chandovyatikramaḥ padyate 'chandāṃsi vā anyonyasya lokamabhidhāvanti- gāyatrīṃ triṣṭubhaḥ; triṣṭup jagattyāḥ; jagatī gāyatryāḥ' iti |
tatra mantra- gataśabdānāṃ arthānāṃ ca vyatikramaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
nārthānāṃ vyatikramaḥ; kiṃtu gāyatrīśabdasthāne jagatīśabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ; triṣṭupśabdasthāne gāyatrīśabdaḥ; jagatīśabda-
sthāne ca triṣṭupaśabdaḥ ityeyaṃ śabdavyatikrama eva kartavyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
vi. 10|5|26 vyūḍhe dvādaśāha bhakṣapavamānaparidhikapālamantragatānāṃ gādhyādiśabdānā- meva vyatikramaḥ nārthānām |
ṭupa. 6|2|5|20 vrataṃ iti ca mānasaṃ karmocyate, (prajāpativrataṃ) idamahaṃ na kariṣyāmīti saṃkalpaḥ |
bhā. 6|2|5|20 vrataṃ kuruteti vācaṃ visṛjati iti vratakaraṇavākyagato- kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
3|3|4|10 mīko. pṛ. 1102 utthānavāgnisāgnisādhikaraṇam ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭa- vyam |
6|8|9|29. mīko. pṛ. 1785 jyotiṣṭome apara- rātre vrataṃ na nityam ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vrataṃ niyamo vā yaḥ paḍehe sa makhadāne bhavati dvādaśāhe |
vrataṃ payo brāhmaṇasya yavāg rājajanyasya āmikṣā vaiśyasya jyotiṣṭome |
puruṣāṇāṃ kriyārthānāṃ śarīradhāraṇārthau valakaraṇārthaṃ saṃskāro vrata nāma |
yadā āmayadīpāt māṃsaṃ vratakāryaṃ upādīyate tadā dakṣiṇāgnī śrapayitavyam |
12|2|1|16, eva- meva hi vratasya aṅgabhāvo yat kartāraṃ samarthe karoti |
5|1|2|16-26. mīko. pṛ. amicayane aśicidravratānāṃ kalpate'nuṣṭhānam ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
12|1|11-23. mīko. pṛ. 1818 jyotiṣṭome prāyaṇīyādiṣu ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
4|1|3|3-6 mīko. pṛ. 2700 prajāpati- vratādhikaraṇam ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
dravyāṇāṃ tu kriyārthānāṃ saṃskāraḥ kratudharmaḥ syān |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome samāmananti payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāg rājajanyasya, āmikṣā vaiśyasya iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimayaṃ puruṣadharma uta kratorhita |
puruṣāṇāṃ kriyārthānāṃ śarīradhāraṇārthau valakaraṇā- rthāśrca saṃskāro vrataṃ nāma |
bhāṣyam-- atha puruṣasaṃyogaḥ kimarthaḥ ? vyava- sthāpanārtha iti brūmaḥ |
niyamasya phalaṃ kalpyam, tacca prakaraṇāt kratoḥ ||
soma-- pūrvavat (dakṣiṇādirādivat) iha kratvartha- saṃyogābhāvāt na kratvarthatā iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
) sūtrārthastu-- payovrataṃ kriyārthānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ valādhānārthatvāt saṃskāraḥ iti kratvarthatā syāditi |
vi-- payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasya puṃse tat kratave'thavā |
bhāṭṭa-- some payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāg rāja- nyasya, āmikṣā vaiśyasya iti śrutam |
atra ca na vāla- dvidhādivat brāhmaṇasya nimittatvam, iṣṭavidhayā tasyo- ddeśyatve saṃbhavati nimittatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva rāgaprāptabhakṣaṇadravya payonimittayat yasya rogādinā anaśanaprasaktiḥ tasya na payaḥprayojakateti dhyeyam |
4|3|4|8-9. bratopāyanaṃ satyavacana-brahmacaryādisaṃ kalparūpaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ aupavasathye ahani kartavyam |
jyoti- ṣṭome aindriye tu maumikavratopāyanena prasaṅgasiddhatvāt pṛthaṅ na kāryam |
vratopāyana mantrāḥ-- ame vratapate vrataṃ cari- ṣyāmi tacchakeyaṃ tanme rādhyatām , vāyo vratapate , āditya vratapate , vratānāṃ vratapate iti |
vratagrahaṇaṃ pūrṇamāse barhiḥsaṃpādanakāle, darśaṃ na vatsāpākaraṇakāle kartavyam |
vi. 6|1|12, ayaṃ vrata- kālo na kevalaṃ saṃnayata eva kiṃtu asaṃnayato'pi ! vatsāpākaraṇopalakṣite kāle iti tu darśa viśeṣaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1529. vratapaśoḥ nimittatvenopamānaṃ pituḥ pitā- mahasya vā asomapatvaṃ sāhityāvivakṣā siddham |
śrīhyaḥ kecit kṛṣṇāḥ, kecit āśavo nāma ye alpakālena phalanti, kecit mahātrīhayo nāma, kecit āgvāḥ nāma |
tataḥ piṣṭāni, tebhyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, tena yāgaḥ ; yāgāda- pūrvam |

ḍupa. 6|1|5|16. śrīhyaḥ : pradhānayāga- pārśvatā labdhāḥ, paraṃtu svikṛta-iḍābhakṣaṇa-prāśitra- bhakṣaṇarūpaśeṣakarmaparyāptāḥ na santi, tathāpi śeṣakārya- lopaṃ kṛtvā pradhānaparyāptāḥ śrīhyo grāhyāḥ, na pratinidhiḥ |

vi. 6|1|21. śrīhyo hi anadanīyāḥ : vākyā- ntaraśiṣṭāśca prakaraṇāt utpattivākyaśiṣṭaprakṛtisāpekṣa- puroḍāśāvaruddhatvāgātuvādena vidhīyamānāḥ na śaknu- vanti prakṛtilatapratipattimanantareṇa yāgasādhanatvaṃ prati- pattam |
yā. 3|1|5|41 pṛ. 980. nṛtyā ete śrīhyaḥ ! ya eva bhaktāstata eva karmārthāḥ, na pṛthak kaṃcit karmāthāṃ nāma |
bhā. 6|1|5|16. yatra yāgopayuktā e śrīhyaḥ : nādhikāstatra nirvapāḥ prāptāḥ dhātvartho nirvapa eva vidheyaḥ |
soma. 5|1|2. śrīhīna avahanti ityatrataḥ śrīhīṇāmapūrva- sādhanatvākāramevāpekṣate na svarūpamapi |
evaṃ sati śrīhyābhe nīvārarūpapratinidhivāpi avaghātaviṣayatvena ūhaḥ sidhyati |
vi. 9|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2. śrīhīna- vahanti iti avahananasya niyamavidhiḥ : nānuvādaḥ : darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
bhā. 4|2|1|16. śrīhīna- vahanti ayaṃ niyamavidhiḥ : kriyārthaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 24, śrīhīnavahanti ayaṃ pratipatti-paṣṭārthaguṇakarma- vidhiḥ |
pṛ. 13, śrīhīnavahanti idaṃ sākṣād- viniyuktabhāṣyaprayogadravyasaṃskārārthatayā saṃnipatyo- kārakaṃ nityarthe pravṛttirūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma |
pṛ. 82, śrīhīnavahanti iyaṃ karmaṇi dvitīyā kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī prokṣaṇe śrīhyaḥ prokṣati ityatra prokṣaṇe śrīhyatvaṃ na prayojakaṃ kiṃtu apūrvameva |
vi. 9|1|5. śrīhīna prokṣati ityatra śrīhyaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ bhavati |
bāla. pṛ. 13, 'vrīhīn prokṣati'- idaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ sākṣā- diniyuktabhāṣyupayogadvayasaṃskārārthaṃ aṣṭārthe saṃnipatyo- pakārakaṃ ṛtvarthe pravṛttirūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma |
dī prathamārjitena vā karavartha- marjitena vā, nātra kaścid viśeṣaḥ |
prītyarthamupārjito'pi vrīhiḥ vrīhireva, karmārthamupārjito'pi vrīhiḥ vrīhireva |
bhā. 4|1|2|2 varṇakaṃ 3. 'vrīhibhiḥ' iti kāraka- vibhaktiḥ yavanirapekṣān (vrīhīn) pratipādayati yāga- sādhanatvena, tathā 'yavaiḥ' iti |
ṭup. 10|8|8|16. 'vrīhibhirvrīhyā vrīhibhiraiva yajetā''- yavebhyaḥ' iti prakṛtau dravyavidhi
12|3|15. vrīhiyavau vidhīyamānau śrutivihitena āgneyā-dyupālane na virudhyete, puroḍāśāpekṣitaprakṛtitvatvāt |
na hi vrīhīna yaṣṭan aṣṭakapālaṃ na karoti |
vā. 4|2|17 pṛ. 513-14. vrīhiyavayoḥ niyamavidhigocaratvāt samuccayo na yuktaḥ |
su. pṛ. 140. nahi ramānakāryatvena vrīhiyavayoḥ ekyānarthakyāt arthāntaratvāt vijñāyate |

vā. 2|1|29 pṛ. 869. 'samarthaḥ pada-vidhiḥ' (pā. 2|1|1) iti padamānavidheḥ sāmarthyāpekṣatvāt vrīhyādiprātipadikasya ca yatrādi-sāpekṣatvena vyāghātatvāpatteḥ vibhaktyanvayāyogyāt nirapekṣā-ṇāmeva vrīhiyānāṃ tṛtīyayā karaṇatvapratīteḥ, pradeya-prakṛtitvena dṛṣṭārthatvāt ekavidhānena nairākāṅkṣyāvagataśca samuccaya na yuktaḥ |
su. pṛ. 181. na kadācidapi upālambhāspadaṃ gacchet |

... svayaṃ ca sarvabhyaḥ ṛtvigbhyaḥ anṛtvigbhyo brāhmaṇabhyaḥ paripālanātsarvadānāt ityevaṃ sūtraṃ vyākhyātumāha |

bhāṣyam-- ' suveṇa avayati, svadhitinā ava- yati, hastena avayati' iti śrūyate |
tatra saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ suveṇa avadātavyaṃ sarvasya dravya sahatasya māṃsasya ca |
tathā svadhitinā, hastena ca, uta sarveṣāṃ arthato vyavasthā dravāṇāṃ suveṇa, māṃsānāṃ svadhitinā, sahatānāṃ hastena iti |
tad yathā, kaṭe bhuṅkte kāsyapātryāṃ bhuṅkte ityarthāt kalpyate, kaṭe samāsīnaḥ kāsyapātryāṃ odanaṃ nidhāya bhuṅkte iti |
vā-- ' atha yatreti saṃdigdhaṃ vākyaśeṣo na vidyate |
' devatāprasādābhyaprārthanādau saṃhatahasta- saṃyogamātramañjaliḥ; ' nāñjalinā vāri pibet ' ityādi vyākośaḥ |
sakṛddhomodanāyāṃ śabdāt saṃdehe satyapi ca ākośasya vākyaśeṣe anyathānupapattereva ākośa- śravaṇam |
nanu anenaiva nyāyena yathā śaknuyāditi vākyaśeṣāt- anadhyādīnāṃ ājyāvekṣaṇādirahitaḥ karmā- dhikāraḥ syāt |
na, asaṃdehāt, saṃdigdhanirṇayārthāt tu evaṃ kalpanā bhavati |
na ca adhikāre saṃdehaḥ, samastadharmāpetaṃ yathā śaknuyāt tathā kuryāditi vākya- śeṣāt |
yatra tu yāvajjīvodanā- dāvevaṃ bhaviṣyati tatra śaktikalpātyāge'pi satyaveguṇyaṃ pradhānasya coditamiṣyāśriyāmahe eva |
tassāt yāva- deva labdhātmako vidhisattāvat kalpyate tadaidikam, siddhe tu tatkalpyaṃ pauruṣeyatvāt apramāṇaṃ sāmarthyahīna- tvādākyaśeṣasiddheḥ |
āha ca- ' yathaiva pāṭhaḥ prati- patyupāyastathaiva sāmarthyamapi śrutīnām |
tenaiva caitā na samāmananti sahasrabhāgāstu samāmaneyuḥ |
iti kṛtabahumāgaṃ mantravidhvarthavādaiḥ smṛtiparikha- mudāraṃ vedaśālopagūḍham |
anabhivasamarthaṃ dharma- durge praviśya prabhibhajati samastārthacintā- midānīm |
' śā-- viṣeḥ idānīṃ pratipāditaprāmāṇyasya saṃdigdha- rthinīye'pi sāmarthyanāthasya prāmāṇyaṃ pratipādyate |

' bhāṭṭa-- ' suveṇāvadyati, svadhitinā'vadyati, hastenā- vadyati ' ityādi viṣeḥ atradevadravyaviṣaye saṃdigdhasya sāmarthyataḥ nirṇayaḥ-- suveṇa dravadravyameva ājyādi, svadhitinā māṃsādi, hastena saṃhataṃ puroḍāśādi |
ataśca sāmarthyasakṛtā''vadyatipadenaiva lakṣaṇayā dravadravyāva- dānasyodeyatvāt tadanuvādena suvādividhau na kiñcit bādhakam |
evaṃ ' añjalinā sakṛt juhoti ' ityādivāpi na saṃpuṭāko'ñjaliḥ |

sa ca vāyoḥ karṇavivaraṃ prāpte saṃyuktasamavāyena śrotraṃ saṃspṛśya tena gṛhyamāṇaḥ kadā- cit varṇairahitaḥ kevalo gṛhyate śabdatvopādhinā|

nādasyaipā vṛddhir śabdasya 1|1|16|17. śabdaḥ na vāyavīyasaṃyogavibhāgā- bhidhavyaḥ; kintu tajjanya evāsau prādeśikaśca iti matam, abhivṛddhaya eva nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti mīmāṃ- sakamatam|
kiṃ tarhi? dravyaṃ guṇo vā syāt (etacca anāsthayā abhihitaṃ iti jñeyam)|
bṛhatī. pṛ. 242, śabdo nityaḥ 'iti advayaiva pratipatta- vyam, śabdātmatvayadevedaṃ vedamandā mā bhūditi|
