śabdajñānajanyaṃ asaṃnikṛṣṭā- rthaviṣayakaṃ yathārthajñānaṃ śābdamayā, tatkaraṇabhūtaśabdaḥ pramāṇamityarthaḥ|
evaṃ vākyaśravaṇānantaraṃ padopasthitapadārthānāṃ saṃsarga- vipadhaṇīṃ pramitiḥ pratyakṣādivilakṣaṇā jāyate, tatkaraṇaṃ śabdaḥ tajjñānaṃ vā pramāṇamityam|
ekārthatvaṃ ca aneka- mukhyaviśeṣarahitatvam, na tu ekākhyātatvam|
tena ākhyātabhede'pi yatra ekākhyātārthe anyākhyātārthaḥ prakāraḥ yathā 'paśya mṛgo dhāvati' ityādī, tatra eka- vākyatvam|
nanu idaṃ padopasthitapadārthānāṃ saṃsargābhāhimānasa- pratyakṣamastīti cet, na, tatra manaḥsannikarṣābhāvāt|
mānase tu cākṣuṣādisāmagrī pratibandhikā iti sarvasaṃmatam|
evaṃ ca śābdasya mānasatvavyāptāvapi kāre bhinna- viṣayakacākṣuṣasāmagrīkāle śābdadhīdho na syāt|
tatra cākṣuṣasāmagrīmānasayoḥ pratibandhakatvabhāveṣu ana- nteṣu śābdatvapraveśe gaurava syāt|
'ghaṭaḥ mānaya' ityādidāni tātparyaviṣayabhūtapadārthanirūpita- tātparyaviṣayasaṃsargapramāpūrvakāṇi, parasparānvayatātparyakatve sati yogyatvāt, padārthavat|
yadvā, padaiḥ upasthiteṣu ghaṭādipadāryeṣu karmatvaṃ āveśatāsaṃsargeṇa ghaṭavat, tena saṃsargeṇa ghaṭe bādhābhāvasyayogyatvāttvāt|
na ca etādṛśasaṃsarga- jñānāt kathaṃ pravṛttiḥ, iṣṭāvacchedakaprakārakavṛttiviṣaya- viśeṣakajñānam pravṛttihetutve, uktasya tathāvidhatvā- bhāvāt iti vācyam|

iṣṭāvacchedakaprakārakapravṛtti- viṣayaviśeṣaviṣayajñānasyaiva pravṛttihetutvāt, iṣṭā- vacchedakasaṃsargaprakārakatvāpi vaiśiṣṭāvagāhinijñānatvāt, 'asmin gṛhe suvarṇasaṃparkaṃghaṭo'sti' iti jñānādapi pravṛttinivṛttyanubhavāt, arthakṣakānumāne doṣābhāvācca ityāhuḥ|
padapakṣakānumānasasya saṃsargaprakāraka- tvaniyamat rajanatvaprakārakajñānāye śabdaprāmāṇyasvīkāra āvaśyakaḥ|
'rajatavadabhūla' iti śabdaśravaṇe caraṃ saṃsargadhīdhakārakameva jñānaṃ jāyate iti niyamaḥ|
arthakṣakājñāne ca yogyatā hetulayā liṅgasya niścinasyaiva niścāyaka- tathā yogyatāsaṃśaye anumānānupapattyā pravṛttyādyupapattiḥ|
vastuto vaktuḥ pratārakatvādiśaṅkāyā śābdabodha- vāraṇāyā yogyatāniścayasyaiva śābdabodhe hetutā iti nobhayoḥ pakṣoviśeṣaḥ|
pakṣadharāstu 'ghaṭamānaya' 'ghaṭaḥ karmatvaṃ ānayanaṃ' ityādisvarūpayogyatayobhayoḥ viśeṣo na syāt, anumānasya ubhayatra saṃbhavāt|
'ayaṃ padārthaḥ aparapadārthavān' ityumāne'pi viparītakriyākarmabhāvamādāya arthāntara- svāpatteḥ|
na ca tādṛśajñānasya mānasatvam, śābdātiriktasya manaḥsahakāriṇaḥ abhāvāt|
kiṃca 'odanaṃ pacati' 'odanaḥ pacyate' ityatra pākodanayoḥ viśeṣyatvaniyamaḥ śābdaprāmāṇyaṃ vinā anupapannaḥ|
na ca anumitipamātaḥ śābdapramāyā bhede yatra eka- smin viṣaye anugitāgamatrī śābdasāmagrī ca, tatrā- numitivāraṇāya śābdasāmagryāḥ pratibandhakatvakalpane gauravamiti iti vācyam|
kiṃca śābdapramāyā anumititve siddhisattve śābda- bodho na syāt|
kiṃca anumitiniṣṭhādisāmagrīsattve siddhayabhāvadaśāyāṃ anumitikāraṇībhūtasya siddhayabhāvasya sattvena tatra śābdasyānumityubhayataḥ|
śābdaśabdenātha pañcādipadavat yogarūḍhyā dharmādharmādeśini caturdaśa aṣṭādaśa vā vidyāsthānāni ucyante|
ataśca prakṛta- lakṣaṇasya na vedānupayogitvam, na vā laukikavākya ativyāpakatvaṃ iti viśeṣyam|
kimidaṃ śabdavijñānam iti ? kiṃ śabdāt vijñānaṃ śabdavijñānam, śabde eva vā vijñānaṃ śabdavijñānam ? yadi tāvat śabde vijñānam, śabdālambanamityarthaḥ, tadayuktam |
atha śabdāt yat arthe vijñānamutpadyate tat śabdavijñānam, tatra viśeṣaṇa- gatau kāraṇaṃ vaktavyam |
tatra arthaviṣaye eva vijñāne upapadyate, na śabdaviṣaye |
nanu ca śabdābhāsamapi dṛṣṭaṃ 'eṇa vandhyāsuto yāti' ityevamādi |
tadapi śabdādevāvagamyate ! nahi nāpnādi- tulyaṃ kiṃcit kāraṇāntaramatropalabhāmahe |
parihṛtametat 'taccait pratyāyayitāt' jñāta (bhāṣyeṇa pṛ. 2512) lakṣaṇābhidhānena ca ayameva vyabhicāro nirastaḥ |
śabdaḥ yat vastutaḥ pramāṇāntarapratītaṃ tadāha na tu pramāṇāntaramatīvemevāha |
yassāt svārtha eva svābhāvikī śabdasya śaktiḥ |
tena anapekṣārthamātrapratyāya- katvāt asatyapi pramāṇāntare śabdaḥ eva kārye'rthe pramāṇam |
śabdaḥ yadi pratyāyakaḥ, prathamaśrutaḥ kiṃ na pratyāyayati |
yāvatkṛtvaḥ śrutena iyaṃ saṃjñā, ayaṃ saṃjñī ityavadhāritaṃ bhavati, tāva- tkṛtvaḥ śrutādavagama iti |
(vai. sū. 2|1|1) atra ceyaṃ teṣāṃ prakriyā - āyaḥ śabdaḥ saṃyogāducyate, yathā bherīdaṇḍa- saṃyogātgṛhītāt bherīgamanasaṃghāta ākāro śabdaḥ upajāyate |
sa upajāyate : śabdāntaramārabhate, khoṭyaparaṃ iti vīcīnicayasaṃcaraṇakrameṇa karṇaśakulī madhyākāśadeśe dharmādharmopagṛhīte śrotrābhyāpadyate samavāya- lakṣaṇena saṃnikarṣeṇa gṛhyate |
upajāyate, yathā vaṃśadalavibhāgātgṛhītāt vaṃśadalākāśa- vibhāgāt ākāśe śabda upajāyate, so'pyaparamārabhate, so'pyaparaṃ iti pūrvavadyojyam |
atra cādyaḥ śabdaḥ kāryavirodhī, antyaḥ kāraṇavirodhī, madhye bhavāstu kāryakāraṇobhayavirodhinī iti jñeyam |

sādhu- asādhuśabdaviṣaye 'yadā tu kiṃcidyathopanibaddhaprakṛti-pratyayādibhāgādyarayaki- yātmakavyākaraṇasmṛtivijitakālabhāvāt anvākhyāna- anyāsyeya - anvākhyātāvidhi-prayoga - anvākhyātātprati- pedha-varjanapaṭkasyāpi avagamyamānavedavidhitvatvāt anāditve sati sarveṣāṃ veda-vedi-yūpa-āhavanīya- adhvaryu-godohanādisravarūpatatkāryatvalakṣaṇanimitta sarvedā anavagatapūrvāparavibhāgasaṃbandhe atyantādṛṣṭārtha- tvameva, kevalaṃ śāstrapratyāyadhīnam, tadā sarvakāla- vyākriyamāṇa-vidyamānaśabdadiyamaviṣaye : na kiṃcida- supapannam |
anvā- khyeyāḥ : sādhuśabdāḥ anvākhyātānāṃ vidhiḥ : 'vyākṛtā vāgucyate' ityādi |
'brāhmaṇena na mlecchi- tavai' iti anvākhyātānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ |
vyavahārakāle varjanaṃ ca iti anvākhyātuviṣayaṃ dvayam |

itipaṭkasyāpi anāditve sati sarveṣāṃ anvākhyānādīnāṃ sarvadā anava- gatapūrvāparavibhāgasaṃbandhe sati yadā antādṛṣṭārthamātraṃ eṣāṃ śāstrīyapratyayādhīnam, na svarūpam, tadā sarvakāla- vyākriyamāṇatvena vidyamānasya śabdasya yo niyama- vidhiḥ : tasya (kimu vaktavyam) |
varṇarūpa eva śabdaḥ sa ca nityaḥ iti mīmāṃsakāḥ |
mātā ca paramaṃ daivatam, samā ca putreṣu ityevamūpanibadhyamāno jananīvacco'vagamyate |
mātā samaḥ, kṣipratha ityebhirapi anubadhyamānaḥ dhānyasya mātṛvācakaḥ |
bhā. 1012|116, ayamarthāmataḥ : śabdaḥ na kathaṃcidapi adyatirikte prātipadikādhai bhavitumahati |
1|16|22 pṛ. 687, abhighātena hi preritā vāyavaḥ : stimitāni vāyvantarāṇi pratibādhamānāḥ sarvatodikkān saṃyogavibhāgāt utpādayanti yāvadrega- mabhiprāpyante |
te ca vāyorpratyakṣatvāt saṃyoga- vibhāgā nopalabhyante |
1|16|13 pṛ. 79-80, ahasyo'pi prayujyamānaḥ (śabdaḥ) nāsati sāmarthye pratyāyen |
ataḥ so'pi śabdāt pratīyate iti mukhya eva |
ekaḥ śabdaḥ : upadeśakaḥ prayogasya, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sāma- dādīnāṃ ca 'dadhīpūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yaṃkāmā yajeta' iti |
tena ca phalasaṃbandhaḥ kṛtaḥ (ataḥ : sāṅkhyairva pradhānasya phalasaṃbandhaḥ svīkriyate) |
ye eva laukikāḥ śabdāste eva vaidikāḥ te evāmīṣāmarthā iti sthitatvāt lokaprasiddhīrte vede yatra ekadeśe'pi jātinimittā labhyate na tatra punaḥ nimittāntaraśakti- kalpanā saṃbhavati |
gaurityatra kaḥ śabdaḥ ? 1 gakāraukāravisarjanīyā iti bhagavānupaparvaḥ (pṛ. 46) |
bhā. 1|1|5|12 pṛ. 88, na caikaḥ śabdo'nekārtho yuktaḥ |
1|1|16, na ca sakṛduccaritaḥ śabdaḥ śaknotyarthadvayaṃ vidhātum |
1|1|16, na hi anabhidhāya mukhyam, gauṇamabhidhadati śabdaḥ |
1|1|1 pṛ. 510, nahi śabdaḥ śabdaṃ samanatti, pṛthagevā- vatiṣṭhata |
tat kiṃ teṣāṃ nirākartuṃ śakyate ? (na śakyate) |
yaḥ śabdaḥ śrautenārthena vākyārthe nopayujyate sa lakṣaṇikārthena tātparyavṛttyā yāti |
'yatra deśe hi yaḥ śabdo yasminnarthe prayujyate |
yadā śabdaḥ kevalaguṇavacanatayā prartamānaḥ : nānyena saṃbandhaṃ labhate, tadā anupadeśatvatvādarthavattvaṃ mā bhūt iti dravyaparatāṃ āpadyate |
vispaṣṭe hi paraśabdasāmā- nādhikaraṇye sati anyanyārthasaṃbhave ca jaghanyavṛttiḥ śabdo bhavati |
saṃmūrcchitānekārthasaṃnidhāne hi śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ kimanyapratyāyate prayatnaṃ karoti |
tena ca aviktitābhidheyagamyamānāśānāpa samastadharmīpetena kārya- siddhau kriyamāṇāyaṃ prayuktaḥ |
vā. 1|3|130 pṛ. 290, sarvo hi śabdaḥ arthapratyayāyaiva prayujyate |
śabdāḥ ekadeśe'pi jātinimittā dṛṣṭāḥ : sarvatra jātinimittā bhavituṃ arhanti |
bhā. 1|4|10, śabdāḥ kecit karmaśabdāḥ (santo) na bhāvārthāḥ |
kecit bhāvārthāḥ : (santo) na karmaśabdāḥ, yathā bhavantī bhāvo bhūniriti |
kecit vācyamarthaṃ anyopasarjanaṃ bhūtam bruvate, na svayamānabhūtam |
yathā athaiva vṛkṣau iti dvivacanaṃ prātipadikopasarjana ātmānaṃ bravīti |
ḍupū. 10|1|14|26 śabdāḥ nāma- ākhyāta-upasarga- nipātā iti caturvidhāḥ |
śabdāḥ ye eva laukikāḥ te eva vaidikāḥ utānye |
yadā te eva, tadā'pi kiṃ te eva teṣāmarthā ye loke, utānye iti saṃśaye te eva śabdāḥ arthāśceti siddhāntaḥ |
śabdāḥ ye tu jātivacanaḥ bhūtvā dravyaṃ pratyāyayanti teṣāṃ abhidheyatvalakṣyamāvalastunovidheyatvāmātrāt prati api avibhedaḥ sthita eva |
sa kathaṃcit anyavyatirekābhyāṃ nipuṇaiḥ parīkṣakerapanīyate iti |
na ca parīkṣakāṇāṃ anabhidheyatvaṃ vadatāṃ loka- virodhaḥ |
sāmānyaviśeṣavādādi- siddhayarthaṃ parīkṣakeḥ vivekaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ na nānumandyate |
śabdāḥ ye naimittikāḥ te nimittamupalabhya prayujyante yathā daṇḍī chatrī iti |
gauḥ gāvī goṇī gopatālikā, hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiḥ ityādayaḥ śabdāḥ |
6|3|1|127, 'śabdaṃ kuru, mā kārṣīḥ' : ( ityasya ) śabdaprayogaṃ kuru, śabdaprayogaṃ mā kārṣīḥ ityartho bhaviṣyati ( yataḥ śabdo nityaḥ ) |
1|1|6|14, akṛtakāryasambandhe samācakṣāṇaṃ śabdaṃ upalabdha bhavati sambandhe tasmin saṃpratyayaḥ |
2|3|6|12, mahatā prayatnena śabda- muccaranti- vāyunābhairathitaḥ, urasi vistīrṇaḥ, kaṇṭhe vivartitaḥ, mūrdhanmāhṛtya parāvṛttaḥ, vaktre viciran vividhān śabdān abhivyanakti |
śabdena ekena darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pradhānāni phalaṃ prati upadiśāni 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svarga- kāmo yajeta' iti |
śabdena kāryāpattiḥ yathā --- 'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti |
tasyāḥ svataḥ pramāṇatvaṃ, na cet syād doṣadarśanam |
nahi yena ( śabdena ) vinā arthātmalābho nāsti tattadabhidhātyam |
gotvābhāve aśābdau aprayogāt gotvavyatireke gośabdasya vyatirekāt tadeva tasya vācyamiti ) |
ślovā. sambandhākṣepāde 25-30. śabdasya deśabhedā- bhāvāt, śrotrasya eva sarvaḥ śabdo nābhivyañjaka- deśasyaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 231. śabdasya dravyatvopapatteḥ vaidikaśabde'pi nityecchāṅgī- kāre bādhakābhāvaḥ |
tassāt vākye eva śabdasya yo'rthaḥ sa pratītavyaḥ |
ṭupa. 1012|1310. śabdasya punaḥpunaḥ jñāpyamānatā gamyate, notpadyamānatā |
bhā. 12|1|14. śabdasya pravartakatvaṃ vijñānotpā- dakatvameva na tu audāsīnyaprayojakatvam |
su. pu. 57. śabdasya mīmāṃsakamate dravyatvaṃ vaiyākaraṇamate ākāśāśrayatvena guṇatvam |
pṛ. 1443. śabdasya mukhyasya muktasaṃśayasya varṇakramāt grāhyaṇasaṃskārasmṛti- saṃbandhānumānādi apekṣita arthamayāne |
su. pṛ. 265. śabdasya mukhyatvagauṇatvayoḥ śrotṛtana- prasiddherbhedamūlaṃ vaktṛgataṃ bahalyapratiyogitvaṃ ( iti cenna iti pūrvapakṣī ) |
pṛ. 749. śabdasya mukhyaparatā uta gauṇaparatā'pi iti yukko vicāraḥ |
bhā. 3|2|1 pṛ. 749. śabdasya yatra vācakaśaktiḥ kalpyate sa nāma artho'bhidhīyate |
vā. 3|4|13 pṛ. 913. śabdasya varṇātmakasya ākāśavat vyāpakatvena dravyaṅgīkāraḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 170. śabdasya vibhulaṃ śabdadhikaraṇe, anavayavatvaṃ ca sphoṭe pratipāditam |
ratnākaraḥ vanavāde 31. śabdasya vaidika mantra- vyatiriktasya liṅgaviniyojyatvābhāvaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1209. śabdasya sādhutā śrotropalavdhasyānityatvena, asā- dhutā ca pratyayātparupaiṣṭasādhanatvanivandhanā |
nahi ekasya śabdasya anekārthatā satyāṃ gato nyāyyā |
bhā. 8|3|6|22. nahi śabdasyārthaḥ samīpagatena kṛta- prayojanena ekadeśe avasthāpayitavyo bhavati |

5|3| 14|40. vayaṃ tu sapratyabhijñānāt pratyakṣatā śabdasya ekatāṃ pratipadyamānāḥ utsattaminacchantaḥ śrotrasaṃskāra abhivyañjaka-sāmānyānumānaprasakta-sakalopalambhavādhena niyataśabdaviṣayaṃ kalpayāmaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 212. sarvasyaiva hi śabdasya svārthāliṅghane virodhaḥ kāraṇam |
sa ca pratiyogini dṛṣṭe viśeṣo vijñāyate |
āmiṣāpadena taddinoktadravyaviśeṣasamarpaṇanimitte viśe- ṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ ataḥ arthamedamarpaṇāyāgāt bhinnārtha- tvānupapatteḥ nārthayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ kiṃta śabdayoreva |
vā. 2|1| 15|47 pṛ. 452. śabdānāṃ ekamarthamabhiniviśa- mānānāṃ eko'nādiḥ apare'pabhraṃśāḥ |
hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiḥ ityenāmādiṣu tu abhiyuktopadeśādanāditam |
7|2|12. śabdānāṃ kṛtasyanityatve'pi saṃbandhatānasya śabdapravṛttau nimittatvāt saṃbandhajñānasya na kadācitkatvāt naimittika- kalā'virodhaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1201. śabdānāṃ vācakaśaktiḥ 30 pṛ. 297, śabdānāṃ śaktayaḥ sarvatra kāryadarśanāt kalpyante |

1|2|4|21-1 pṛ. 143. śabdānāṃ satyāpi phalānumeye dṛṣṭasamānārthatayā'satyatve, satyapi ca asmākamapi adṛṣṭaśaktikalpanāgauravatvalye, abhi- dheyamātratvena nivṛttavyāpāre śabde arthapratyaye nākṛtārthe sati kalpyamānatvāt arthaśaktiḥ pramāṇavatī na śabda- śaktiḥ |
3|1|6|12 pṛ. 685. śabdānāṃ sādhutāmeva adṛṣṭasādhanatvam, adṛṣṭasādhanatvameva vā sādhutvaṃ ityu- bhayathā'pi vyavasthā vedāvīnā |
parādyaḥ kṛtāspadaḥ ! śabde sa tadabhiprayajñe prasajan kena vāryate |
' vā. 1|3| 8|25 pṛ. 275. śabdānāṃ sādhutvaṃ arthapratyayānājña- tvam, tacca vācakavṛttyā lakṣaṇāvṛtyā gauṇīvṛttyā ceti trividham |
na tāvat śabdavyatiriktatvā sarvasādhuśabdānu- yāyinī asādhutvo vyāvṛttā vilakṣaṇā ekākārapratyayevecā sādhutvajātiḥ : asādhutvajātirvā'sādhuśabdānugatā sādhubhyo vyāvṛttā upalabhyate |
na vā anyo'pi kaściddharmaḥ sādhva- sādhuśabdābhidheyaḥ saṃbhavati |
tathāhi, na tāvat śabdavyati- rikkasya indriyālaṅghadeḥ śabdasyāpi vā vaktṛjñānaviṣayatvā- vipayaprayatnāt sādhutvaṃ kasyacidasti |
na ca śabdasya arthapratyayatvaṃ sādhutvam, gāvyādiśabdeṣvapi āpatteḥ |
na ca śabdasya śaktyarthapratipādakatvaṃ sādhutvam, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ, agnimāṇavakaḥ ityādī gaṅgāmiśravyoḥ tīra- māṇavakādiṣu śaktyabhāve'pi tatra sādhutvaprasiddheḥ |
arthāntaraviṣayatvakyā arthāntaraviṣaya-sādhutvābhyupagame gauṇīśabdasyāpi āpavanaviṣayatvakatsiddhatvāt sāsnā- dimati sādhutvāpattiḥ, devadattādiśabdānāṃ ca saṃskṛte- nārthapratipādanāt |
na ca śabdasya arthapratyayatvaṃ sādhu- tvam, gāvyādidābdeṣvapi āpatteḥ |
na ca śabdasya śaktyā arthapratipādakānāṃ śakyatvāt asādhutvā- pattiḥ |
stupādiśabdānāṃ putrabhāryādivācitayā putrādya- mabhidhāya tadviśiṣṭamārthānāṃmabhināśakeḥ putrādāvapi śaktiḥ saddhāvāt sādhutvāpattiḥ |
arthaviṣayānādiprayogatve tu sādhutvalakṣaṇe gāvyādiśabdānāmati sāsnādimatva- viṣayatvaprayogavattvaparaṇe anāditvāt sādhutva- maśakyaṃ nirākartum |
svābhāvikāparthatvamapi pratīti- prayogaviśeṣāt gavādiśabdavat gāvyādiśabdeṣvapi tulyam |
tasmāt sādhulaṃ asādhutvaṃ ca na nirūpayituṃ śakyam |
vā. 1|1|2|3-1 pṛ. 356. śabdānāṃ svārthe vyutpattiḥ buddhavyavahāre eva |
dvipakāro hi nāma śabdānāṃ saṃbandhaḥ, sāmānādhi- karaṇyena vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā |
tatra yatheābhyāṃ ubhayārtho- pādānaṃ tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati |
vā. 3|1| 6|12 pṛ. 685. sarvaiṣāmeva śabdānāṃ arthajñāne laukikaḥ prayogo'bhyupāyaḥ |
bhā. 6|1|12 pṛ. 1347. śabde ca kāryasyāsaṃbhavāt arthe kāryaṃ vijñāyate |

vā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 145. śabde kṛtatvādikasya āntarityarthaḥ ' hutādikaṃ api dhaniṣu śrotraṃ prāpyaiva kṣipamantaḥ prajñāteṣu tatsaṃyogasaṃskārasya śrotre alpa- kālamavasthanāt śabdo'pi kṣaṇa eva āvirbhūya tiro- bhavann iti iti gṛhyate |
tathā madhyamo vilambita iti yukto vyañjakadharmāṇāṃ dutādīnāṃ vyuhyaye śabde āntyā samāropaḥ |
bhūtaṃ nimittapālevya śabde prayujyamāne rāja- puruṣa ityatra upakārātkṛte śeṣatvameva vivakṣitaṃ iti gamyate |
vā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 905. śabde mahattva- dike yathā- ' vaiśeṣiko gakārādiṣu vyaktijātime- micchataḥ tathāpi śabdeṣu mahattvatvasyaurguṇatāṃ nābhyupaṃti, nirguṇātvād guṇānāṃ śabdasya ca guṇatvāt |
ato yathā tasya avyabhimānameva śabde mahattvatvaṃ dhvanisaṃskārā- nusāriṇyā buddhayā gṛhyate tathā kṛtatvādikamapi bhānyā śabde samāropitam |
ratnākaraḥ sphoṭavāde ślo. 40. śabde sāpekṣe'pi ' devadatta gāmabhyāja ' ityādī adhikāradarśanāt anapekṣatvaṃ nādhidhāre hetuḥ |
ratna. 6|1|12|1. gośabde uccarite sarvagavādiṣu yugapa- tpratyayo bhavati |
ataḥ ākṛtivacane'śabde dvivacane dravya- medo'vagamyate, ekavacane dravyatvam |
saṃbandhatve'pi saṃbandhatvarāpekṣāṃ vinā śabdapravṛttyarthaṃ śabdapravṛttinimittatvena saṃbandha- ntarāpekṣā saṃbhavati |

'karmake tatra darśanāt' (1|1|6-23) ityadhikaraṇe vedaprāmāṇyasiddhyarthaṃ autpattikasūtra eva autpattikatvarūpanityatvasya śabdarūpobhaya-viśeṣaṇa- viśiṣṭe sambandhe'nvayāt viśeṣaṇībhūtaśabdanityatvamapi arthāt pratiṣṭhātameva ākṣipya samādhīyate |
śabdādhyāhārasamarthanaṃ mīko. pṛ. 662 'arthādhyāhārapakṣalaṇḍanaṃ' iti vindo śā-granthe draṣṭavyam |
śabdāntaraṃ dhātvantararūpaṃ bhāvanānurjhakavyāpārarūpeṇa svārthe vadat svārthānuraktyā bhāvanāyāḥ dhātvantarāna- raktabhāvanātaḥ spaṣṭaṃ bhedaṃ bodhayati |

dhātvarthaviṣayatvena saṃjñāyāḥ tanmātrabhedakatvāt, śabdā- ntarasya tu dhātvarthāvicchede'pi dhātvarthasya spaṣṭabhedatvena amedāśaṅkāyāgāt viśeṣaṇaśabdānāṃ ca viśeṣya- paratvena dhātvarthāpatterapyavagamāt dhātvarthabhedadvārā bhāvanābhedatvāt vailakṣaṇyam |
'somena yajeta', 'dākṣiṇāyena juhoti' 'hiraṇyamātreyāya dadāti' iti yajati-juhoti-dadātiḥ kiṃ sahatya apūrva sādha- yanti viyujya vā iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
śabdā- ntare śabdebhede sati karmabhedaḥ karmabhedaḥ pretavyaḥ |
kṛtānubandhatvāt kṛtaḥ anubandhaḥ dhātvarthena avaccheda- yasya tat karma bhāvanārūpaṃ kṛtānubandham |
bhāṣyam-- asti jyotiṣṭomaḥ, tatra śrūyate 'somena yajeta, dākṣiṇāyena juhoti, hiraṇyamātreyāya dadāti' iti |
yajati-dadāti-juhotvaste kiṃ sahatya kāryaṃ kurvanti, uta viyujyeti saṃśayaḥ |
saṃhalya tāvat, atho śrāvaṇa ekāgulāṃ dhārayanto dṛśyante, nāgadantāstu viyutyāpi |
ato yajati-dadāti-juhotyaḥ saṃhatya sādhayeyurviyutya veti jāyate saṃśayaḥ |
katham ? 'adṛṣṭo yo'śruto vā syāt sa nāstītyavagamyate |
tasminsati dṛṣṭaścet śruto vā na virudhyate |
tato dṛṣṭe kalpyamāne'vayavānāṃ samudāya pratyarthavatvāt ekamapūrvaṃ samudāyāt kalpitaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tathā dadātīti pūrvo bhāgo dadātyartham, uttarasmeva bhāvayediti- vadati |
evaṃ juhotīti pūrvo bhāgo juhotyartham, uttarasmevānuvadati |
tena ekasyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ atho yajatyādaya upāyā vidhīyante śrutyā |
yadvā yajatiśabdena vihitaṃ dānaṃ dānahomaśabdenānūyate guṇasaṃbandhādham |
prayogavākyaśeṣāvena hi samu- dākṣya sattāsaṃbhavo gamyate, śrutyā'vayavasya yajeteti |
śrutyā yāgasyaiva utsaṃsaṃbaṃdho (bhāvanāsaṃbandhaḥ) gamyate na dānahomayoḥ |
tatra yadyapi paro bhāgo bhāvanāvacanaḥ sarveṣu samānasthā''thaikasya pūrvo'va- yavo'nyaḥ |
anyaśca tena samudāyaḥ śabdāntaramanya- syāt samudāyāt |
dadyāditi dānena sādhayediti kevalameva dānaṃ karaṇaṃ bhāvanāyāḥ pratīyate, na yāgahomī sahāyyāpekṣate |
tathā juhotīti homasādhanāṃ bhāvanāmāha, na dānayāgā- vapekṣate |
juhotītyapi homena kevalena sidhyatīti, na tu dānena kevalena sidhyatīti vijñāne nivarttate |
dadātirhi svasya kārakamātreṇa kṛtānubandho na yāgaṃ homaṃ vā'nubandhamapekṣate |
na ca dānasya yajatijuhotīrvā'nu- vādaḥ, yāgahomayorvipakṣaprasaṅgāt |
prayojanam- pūrvapakṣe samudāyapūrvam, siddhānte tu yāgasya phalavatvāditarayoguṇabhāvaḥ |
' tatra śabdāntaraṃ tāvat spaṣṭataraṃ prathamamudā- hriyate |
ekānekākhyātpratyayasaṃbaddhāḥ sarve dhātavo yajati dadāti juhoti nirvapati gṛhṇāti tṛṇāti śaṃsati stauti ityevamādayaḥ |
bhāṣyakāreṇa tu svasvapari- tyāgena yajatyādiyaṃ pratyāsannārthatvāt sutagamabhi- mābhāste ityudāhṛtam |
taccāthā tisro bhāvanāḥ kimekapūrvaṃ kurvanti uta śrīṇīti, tathā trayo dhātvarthāḥ kimekaṃ dhātvarthaṃ vadanti uta śrīnīti |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? 1 'sādhakatvaṃ dvidhā dṛṣṭaṃ pratyekasamudā- yayoḥ |
' athavā pāramārthiko'trāyamekaḥ saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ dhātvartha- tryānuraktakā bhāvanā, athavā pratidhātvarthaṃ bhāvanābheda iti |
tasyā eva śabdāntarādi bhedaṃ bhaviṣyati, apūrvasānabhidheya- tvāt karmabhedānuniṣpāde taditi na pṛthagvinicāra- marhati |
prāsaṅgikastu dhātvarthaikatvopanyāsaḥḥ kathamapya- sārvatrikaḥ san yasyādiṣu bhaviṣyatīti nātīva tantrī- kartavyaḥ |
tataśca etadapi saṃśayakāraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣavādinaḥ pratibhāti kiṃ dhātvarthāntaramyupādīyāmānā bhāvanā pratyekaṃ samāpyate, athavā te tāṃ pratyupādīyāmānāḥ saṃhatya viśiṣyantīti |
' ityādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ samudāyaśabdoccāraṇa- pūrvaikatvābhidhānācca tisṛbhyo bhāvanābhya ekamapūrvamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tatyapyekānekārthakalpanāyorviśeṣaścet guṇalāghavaṃ prati na gamyeta tato'neko'pi kalpyeta, gamyate cāsau |
tatatat syāt, kena bhāvanāsamudāyaścodito yasmāt ekamapūrva syāditi āha- 'na cāśabdaḥ samudāyā''yavasyaiva codita- tvāt |
tato bhāvanā tān pratyupādīyamānā pratipradhānaṃ bhidyeta |
bhāvapradhānatvāccā''khyātasya prakṛtipratyayayośca pratyayā- rtheśatvadaikyaikatvādinā'vidyādibhiḥ saṃhatyaikā bhāvanā viśiṣyate |
yadyapi pradhānānāṃ guṇānurodhenā''vṛttiruktā tathā'pi kevalaprakṛtipratyayayogasaṃbhavādavaśyaṃ tāvadvātu- saṃbandhārtha pratyayaḥ punarāvartanīyaḥ |
yadi tu kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ krīṇātivat śrūyeta, tataḥ sakṛduccarita evārūṇā- dibhiriva dhātubhiḥ saṃvadhyeta, apadatvāt svatantraḥ śrūyate ityāvartate |
dṛṣṭā ca viśeṣaṇasaṃbandhārthyāvṛttiḥ 'āyu- ryajñena kalpatām' 'dadhnā juhoti' 'payasā juhoti' 'aindrādavayaṃ gṛhṇāti' 'maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityeva- mādiṣu |
tassādaikyatvavaśeṇa sarvamidaṃ yajatitadādijuhotividhānātkamekaṃ vākyaṃ ekaṃ karma ekaṃ cāpūrvamiti |
' yadi hi bhāvanābhedaṃ pūrvavācyābhyupagamyeta tataḥ sā bhāvayitavyā pūrvamedāhate naiva bhidyate iti tadbhede'pi siddhe kimanena kṛtaṃ syāt |
api ca samudāyatvāpādana- mekāvayavasaṃyogātsamudāyānuvādarūpeṇa vā bhavati yathā 'ya evaṃ vidvānpaurṇamāsīṃ yajate' iti, phalādisaṃbandhena vā yathā 'rājasūyena svārājyakāmaḥ' iti |
kiṃ tāvatrāstaṃ dhātūtryānura- mināyugabhidhaivaṃ karmeti ( yathendrādyugaṃ lohitaśukṛkṛṣṇe- bhirbhidhātubhiḥ saṃhatyānupyate tatheti dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ :) |
ataḥ 'yajate- tasya pūrvo bhāgo yajatyarthe bravīti, uttaro bhāva- yet' ityādi nigaman |
śakyaṃ tvetat samarthayitum, dve hyete pūrva- pakṣopapattī bhāṣyakāreṇa upanyaste |
tatra anekāṣṭa- kalpanādoṣaṃ pūrvaṃ upanyasya athaivetyupapadyattaramāha |
tasmādevaṃ vācyaṃ pūrvo dadātyarthaḥ : uttaraḥ punaryo yajateḥ pareṇāśinoktastameva bhāvayedityeva dhātvarthāntarasaṃbandhārthe- manuvadatīti |
tathā ca yajenetya- traiva nābhimitam, na hi tatra pūrvataraprākṣā bhāvanā'sti yā'nuyeta |
na tadarjamuttarayoreva brūyādo bhāvamaikatvaprati- jñānābhiprāyametat tasmādekā bhāvanā'pūrva ca |
yadā 'yajatitaśabdena vihitam' iti dhātvarthatvaṃ vadati svatvavyāgāṃśasatvāt |
ayāpi lakṣaṇayā dadāti juhoti yajetetyādyanuvadatā'pi kamāntaranimittāṣṭakalpanātaḥ saitra jyāyasīmāśrīyate |
ekā''stvaiyaḥ saṃpradānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca pradeyaṃ vidhīyate |
tadā ca yajatitadādi- juhotyeva iti dhātvarthabhiprāyakam |
ekaṃ kāryamekaṃ dhātvartha tadetaratadarthamiti vā nyāyekamapi gamayatītyarthaḥ |
na caikasmin pade dhātutrayaṃ parasparapekṣaṃ pratyayaṃ pratyupādīyamānaṃ saṃbhavati 'dhātoḥ' (pā. 3|1|91) iti pratyayotpattau vivakṣitaikatvasaṃkhyātvāt |

yadi ca kevalaiva bhāvanā kenacidupapādyeta tato'ruṇādibhirivaikavākyataḥ : dadhyā- dibhradā bhinnavākyatairaikaikānuṣṭhānaṃ yugapadā viśiṣṭe- vidhānanyāyena gāgadānahomairanujñayeta, na tvasyāḥ pṛthaggupa- tistītyavaśyaṃ dadātyādināmekena samastairvā''pāditavya |
tatra yadi tāvatsamastairākhyāyate, tata utsannatvāḥ punara- tyasyasaṃbhavasiddhaṃ karmāntaratvam |
athaikena tāvaducyeta, tatrāpi vinigamanāyā hetorabhāvādihoṣo na jñāyate |
yena kenacidutpattirityasyāḥ pratīyate tatastadvyatiriktakena dhātunā nā''jñayate |

yenaiva hyekena dhātunā kṛtānubandhā- bhāvanotpannā tathaiva thautatvena balīyastatvāt padāntara- sthairyārthyaḥ saha vikalpaḥ saṃbhavatīti tataḥ prayucyataistaiḥ svapadapratipāditamarthaṃ bhāvanāntaramanurañjanīyam |
eva- mekaikatra svapadopāttatvāttvarjanamaunyatvikaṃ śrautaṃ ca, dhātvarthāntarajanatvañcāvi vākyakaraṇalambhyaṃ ca |
dadātirhi yajatyupanibaddhāṃ bhāvanāṃ niṣedhann svavākyān- caritāṃ padāntarānuvartanīṃ prakaraṇānnākāṅkṣāṃ prāpnuyādevaṃ yajatitarapi tatra tatreti yo'yam |
nanu dadātipade- 'pyasau punaḥ śrayamāṇā seveti pratyabhijñāyate iti na vaktavyaṃ vākyakaraṇāmyāṃ dadātisaṃbandho bhavatīti |
yāgānurakta- bhāvanāsaṃbandhe tu na śrutivyāpāro yujyate |
nanu caika- tvādevāsāṃ bhedavyavahāro na yuktaḥ |
kathaṃ nāsti ? yadā bhinnadhātvarthasaṃnidhānādau nānātvena pratiśabdamupalabhyate |
nanu ca śabdabhedaiva paropādhiko bhedametyanayo na pāramārthiko bhāvanābhedaḥ syāt |
naitadevam, śabdasyāpi gakārādibhedaḥ pāramārthiko naiva kasyacidaniṣṭadvihāpi yāgādibhede siddhe śabdasthānīyamanuṣṭhānasāmānyāt nirūdhyate |
na ca yathā śabdasya arthāntarabhūtā dhvanayaḥ dugādibuddhimāra- mārgīkīṃ kurvantyevamatra yāgādoṣo'durucyateriti |
āha ca - 'yathā raktopādhānena niruddheḥ sphaṭike sati |
' yassātprakṛtipratyayayoḥ : svārthābhidhāne smṛte- rācārācca nityavivakṣitakamatvena pūrvaprayuktaprakṛtyarthyā- teṣu pratipannaṣu pratyayāṃśaḥ saṃnipatan kratutvānubhavameva svārthaṃ vadati |
prayogavākyaśeṣabhāvena hi samudā- yasya sattāsaṃbandha' iti |
ekāpūrvakalpanā hi samudāyā- nuktābhāvanākalpanāmāśritaṃ phalasaṃbandhanimittā vā'pūrva- phalatayā |
prayogavākyaśeṣabhāvena votpattivākyānāṃ phala- saṃbandho bhavati na svarūpaiḥ |
avadhṛtasvarūpāṇi ca karmāṇi prayogavākyena gṛhyante ityavagate bhede na śakyānyekī- kartum |
na ca dadātijuhotyoḥ prayogavākyaśeṣabhāvaṃ paśyāmaḥ ; 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' iti kevalayāgaśravaṇāt |
na ca tyāgamātralakṣaṇa, svārthavṛttitvenāpi vākyasama- vāyogapatteḥ |
na ca dakṣiṇādi nāma guṇaḥ : kaścitsiddha iti sāmānyādhikaraṇyanāmadheyatvameva yuktam |
ataśca vākyānarthakyaṃ mā bhūditi homo vidhīyate |
dadātinā tu yāgamatraguṇe vidhīyamāne hiraṇyādyasaṃbandhe vākya- bhedaprasaṅgādaguṇādi bhedaḥ saṃbhavatītyekaguṇo nirguṇo vā''dadātirādahartavyaḥ |
śā-- ( asmin adhikaraṇe ) śabdāntarāt karma- bhedaḥ abhīdhīyate |
iha ekaprakaraṇagatāni aparyāyadhātu- niṣpannāni ākhyātāni- ' yajati ' ' dadāti ' ' juhoti ' ityādīni udāharaṇam |
tatra hi satyapi pratyayāṃśasya ekatve dhātubhedāt ākhyātādapi mithaḥ śabdāntarāṇi bhavanti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ- kiṃ ekā eva bhāvanā nānā- dhātvarthānuraktā vidhīyate uta pratidhātvarthaṃ bhāvanābheda iti |
anekāpūrvatvakalpanābhiyā eka eva bhāvanā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
yadi vā pratyayaḥ śuddhaḥ sarva- dhātupṛthakkṛtaḥ |
' soma-- sūtrārthastu- śabdāntare paryāyānubhede karmabhedaḥ bhāvanābhedaḥ dhātvarthena bhāvanāyā anubandhasya avacchedasya kṛtatvāditi |

jyotiṣṭomādiprakaraṇānāṃ ' romena yajeta, hiraṇyamātrāya dadāti, dākṣiṇāni juhoti ' ityādīnāṃ vibhinnadhātvarthānāṃ bhāvanābhedo'tha- katvamasti na veti cintāyāṃ ' jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta ' ityanena svargakarmakabhāvanāmātre lāghavādrihite tadanuvādena somādivākyaiḥ somādiviśiṣṭayāgādidhā- nāt |

na ca pratyayārthānvitasvārthā- bhidhāyakatvāt pratyayānāṃ phalavākyasthenākhyātena dhātva- rthānavicchinna-śuddhabhāvanāvidhānānupapattiḥ, ākhyātena dhātvarthāvicchinnabhāvanābhidhāne'pi tadaṃśe vidhivyāpārā- bhāvāt |
ata eva guṇaphalasambandhasyale dhātvarthānuvāde- nāpi bhāvanāmātravidhānāt |
ata eva ca phalavākye yajiḥ prakṛtasarvadhātvarthopalakṣakaḥ |

iti prāpte, kāryamātravṛttitvadharmasya vijātīyatvayāgatvadeḥ kaṃcitpratī kāryatāvacchedakatvāva- katvena tadavacchinnaṃ prati upasthitasya yatnasya vaijātya- parikalpanayā vijātīyayatnenaiva kāraṇatvam |
ata eva ' tinna āhutīrjuhoti ' ityatra saṃkhyayā homabhede siddhe śabdāntarādeva uktavidhābhāvanābhedaḥ na tu mūlektāditi dhyeyam |
dviṣa prāsamāvanānuvādena somayāgādyaneka- vidhāne vākyabhedapāteḥ tacchrutadhātvarthī bhayaviśiṣṭabhāvanā- vidhānameva tattadākye'ṅgīkartavyam |
tatra ca cāturthika- nyāyena jyotiṣṭomadābhidheyasya somayāgasya svarga- vākyena phalasambandhaḥ anyeṣāṃ tu tadaṅgatvam |
na ca svargavākye eva yāgabhāvanāotpattipūrvakaḥ phalasambandhaḥ somavākyena tu somamātravidhānamiti vācyam |
svarga- vākye rājasūyavākyena iṣṭipaśuyāgānāmeva phalasambandha- pattī yāgāntaravidhāne pramāṇābhāvāt |
tataśca paścādya- varuddhe somavidhivyanupapatteḥ somavākye karmāntaravidhivyayaṃ- bhāvaḥ |
tatrāpi śabdāntarasya pramāṇāntarasiddhadhātvarthabhedopajīvitvena bhāvanābhedātre vyāpāgatvaṃ sūcikātanyāyena prathamaṃ tasyaiva bhedakatā nirūpyate |
ata siddhaṃ aparyāyadhātubhedopaśabdānta- rāt kāryatāvacchedakabhedena kāryabhedāvatau kāraṇībhūtāyā bhāvanāyā vaijātyam |
prayojanam siddhānte somayāgasyaiva prādhānyam, anyeṣāṃ tu tadaṅgatvān na vikalpaḥ |
śabdāntarādhikaraṇe yajetetyasya pūrvo bhāgo yajatyarthe bravīti, uttaro bhāgo bhāvayediti bhāṣyam |
atra paro bhāgo bhāvanāvacanaḥ iti spaṣṭam |

su. pṛ. 566. na caivaṃ ' yajati, dadāti ' ityatra yāgānvitāyā api bhāvanāyāḥ niṣkṛṣya svarūpeṇābhidhāne sati tatra dānānvayasaṃbhavāt, ' ekadhātvarthānvitabhāvanāyāṃ na dhātvarthāntarayasaṃbhavaḥ ' iti-śabdāntarādhikaraṇokta- virodhaḥ syāditi vācyam |
ku. 2|2|1|23. ' samidho yajati ' ' tanūnapāta yajati ... ' ityatra yāgamede arthāntarapara-dhātvarthānabhedāt śabdā- ntarādhikaraṇavarṇanāyeva bhāvanābhedasiddhiḥ |
yo yāvaddharmyukamamuṣṭhātuṃ śaknoti tena tāvaddharma- yuktaṃ karma anuṣṭheyaṃ iti śaktyā vyavasthāyāṃ apramāṇā- bhāvāt nyāyaprāptatvena kāmye'pi yathāśaktyupapanno na doṣaḥ |

soma. 7|1|9. tasyā eva ca ( bhāvanāyāḥ ) śabdāntaraṃ bhedakaṃ bhaviṣyati apūrvasthānabhidheyatvāt karmabhedānuniṣpādyameva ca tat ( apūrva ) iti na pṛthak vicāramarhati iti śabdāntarādhikaraṇavārtike apūrvabhedasya lakṣaṇārthatva- niṣedhāt |

su. pṛ. 873-874. śabdāntarābhyāsānamadheyaguṇaprakaraṇāni utpatti- paratāṃ vidhoyanti ( prathamābhyupavacanametat ) utpannasya ca utpannatvānnābhāvāt, vākyāntaravihitatvāt karmaṇaḥ svākyaviṣayasya bhedaṃ bodhayanti |
śā. 2|2|1. śabdāntarādibhiḥ hetubhiḥ pradhānānāṃ bheda uktaḥ ( apūrvāṇām ) |
bhā. 7|1|1|1. ' aindrāvayaṃ ' ityatra taddhitārthadvayabhedastāvat prakṛtyarthadevatābhedāt śabdāntarāyanayena guṇanyāyena vā suprasiddha eva |
kau. 2|2|1|19 nanu śabdāntaratvaṃ saṃjñā bhāvanātvacchedakarūpeṇa dhātvartha- vācitvābhāvāt śabdāntarāyanayena bhāvanābhedakatvā- yogaḥ |
su. pṛ. 880. śabdopacāre na pratinidhiḥ ( śabdo mantraḥ ) |
6|3|1|18-19. mīko. pṛ. 2130 ' devatā'- viśeṣakriyāṇāmapyapyade'pi pratinidhirna grāhyaḥ ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
2|13 pṛ. 586. śabdābhede ( vaidikalaukikaśabdābhede ) ( adhyā- yānadhyāyādi ) dharmavyavasthayaivārthapatteḥ tatsāphalyāya śabdabhedaḥ kalpyate |
tadbhede ca autsargikaḥ arthabhedaḥ ' saṃjñā cotpattisaṃyogāt ' ( 2|2|1|22 ) ityanena setsyati |
su. pṛ. 333. śabdārthaḥ ākṛtiḥ vyaktirvā iti saṃdeha ākṛtiriti siddhāntaḥ |
' kāṣṭhanyāyaḥ ' ityuktaḥ sakṛdāharati, na punaḥ punaḥ |
kāryavaśān sakṛdapi uktaḥ; asakṛdāharati, asakṛ- dapi uktaḥ : sakṛdāharati, nāharati vā |
dup. 10| 1|10|34. śabdārthaḥ yadyākṛtirbhavet na tatra dravyā- śrayavacanaḥ śabdo bhavet |
vā. 1|3|1|9 pṛ. 218. na ācāryavacanāt sūtrakāravacanāt vā śabdārtho bhavati |
... api- ca naiva kartā pratyayārthaḥ, karma vā ityācāryā āhuḥ |
bhā. 3|4|1|13 pṛ. 923, na ca lakṣaṇayā prayoge śabdārthaḥ paricchidyate |
yat kāraṇaṃ svārtha eva vartamānā'rthāntaraṃ lakṣayati, svārthaṃ hyaiva naiva lakṣyate |
yāvāneva hi ananyalabhyaḥ arthaḥ śabdāt gamyate sa sarvaḥ śabdārthaḥ |
vā. 2|1|1|1 pṛ. 375, lakṣaṇaṃ caitāvat yo'rtho'nya gamyate sa śabdārtha iti |
3|4|4|3 pṛ. 913. śabdārthasya anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi vibhāgo'va- gamyate |
vā. 2|1|2|17, śabdā- rthayoḥ anādile'pi nimittanaimittikabhāvaḥ avicchadaḥ |
radaic' ( pā. 1|1|9 ) ityasya sūtrasya kartari, 'vṛddhirasyācāmādeḥ' ( pā. 1|1|73 ) iti kiṃcit pratīyate |
tasmāt kāraṇāt agracchāmo na kṛtvā saṃbandhaṃ vyavahāraiḥ kenacit vedāḥ praṇītā iti |
yadyapi ca vissaraṇamupapadyeta, tathāpi na pramāṇamantareṇa saṃbandhārthaṃ pratipadyamahi |
yathā viva- mānasyāpi anupalabdhaṃ bhavatīti, naitāvatā vinā pramāṇena śaśaviṣāṇaṃ pratipadyamahe |
tasmāt apauruṣeyaḥ śabdasya arthena saṃbandha iti |
nahi akṛtasaṃjñatvāt śabdāt arthe pratipadyamānān upa- lambhāmahe |
tadanupalambhanāt avaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ saṃbandha iti cet |
yadi saṃbandhabhāvāt niyogato nārthā upalabhyeran, tataḥ arthāpatyā saṃbandhārthama- gacchāmaḥ |
vṛddhānāṃ svārthena saṃvyavahāramāṇānāṃ upalambhato bālāḥ prathamamarthaṃ prati- padyamānā dṛśyante |
te'pi vṛddhā yadā bālā āsan, tadā anyebhyo vṛddhebhyaḥ, te'pyanyebhyaḥ iti nāsyādiḥ ityevaṃ vā bhavet |
athavā na kaścideko'pi śabdasyārthena saṃbandha āsīt, atha kenacit saṃbandhāḥ pravartitā iti |
atra vṛddhavyavahāre sati nārthādapayeta saṃbandhasya kartā |
apica vyavahāravidaḥ pratyakṣamupa- diśanti, kalpayanti itare saṃbandhāram, na ca pratyakṣe pratyārthini kalpanā sādhī |
yathā asmin deśe sāsnādimati gośabdaḥ, evaṃ sarveṣu durga- meṣvapi |
bahavaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kathaṃ saṃsravyante ? eko na śaknuyāt |
na hi saṃbandhavyatiriktaḥ kaścit kāle'sti, yasmin na kaścidapi śabdaḥ kenacidarthena saṃbaddha āsīt |
avaśyamanena saṃbandhaṃ kurvatā kena- cit śabdena kartavyaḥ |
yena kriyeta tasya kena kṛtaḥ ? atha anyena kenacit kṛtaḥ, tasya keneti tasya keneti
tasādvayaṃ anena saṃbandhaṃ kurvatā akṛta- saṃjñatvāḥ kecana śabdāḥ vṛddhavyavahārasiddhā abhyupa- gantavyāḥ |
asti cet vyavahārasiddhiḥ, na niyogataḥ saṃbandhā bhavitavyaṃ ityarthāpattirapi nāsti |
syādetat, aprasiddhasaṃbandhā bālāḥ kathaṃ vṛddhebhyaḥ pratipadyante iti |
na ca pratipannāḥ saṃbandhāḥ saṃbandhasya kartuḥ |
anupalabdhe ca devadattādāvarthe anarthakaṃ saṃjñāhakaraṇamaśakyaṃ ca |
viśeṣān pratipatuṃ hi saṃjñāḥ kriyante viśeṣārtho'diśya |
tad viśeṣeṣu ajñāta- gāneṣu ubhayamapi anavaklaptam |
na caivaṃ sati purupāntaraṃ pratyāyantaraṃ cāpekṣyate |
bhā. 1|1|5 pṛ. 52-58. bṛhatī- 'atha saṃbandhaḥ kaḥ ? yat śabde vijñāte'rtho vijñāyate' iti kaḥ punarayaṃ saṃbandhaḥ pṛthaśca upanyastaśca ? pūrvoka eveti vadāmaḥ |
nanu cāsau saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tasādayameva saṃbandha iti manyate |
tathāpi pratyāyasya pratyāyakasya ca saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandha iti evāyaṃ jñāpyapakalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ uktaḥ |
nanu ca pratyāyasya pratyāyakasya ca saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandha iti vadatā pratyāyasya pratyāyakasya iti pañcya- bhidhānena saṃbandhavyantaramuktaṃ bhavati |
tadevedaṃ pratyāyapratyāyakatvaṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇaṃ iti pañcyā prati- pāditam |
kuta etat ? nanu vyatirekaṃ ṣaṣṭhī prati- pādayati |
tamekaṃ na vyapadiśati bhavān yaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti vaktavyam |
'ata eva kṛtaka iti pūrvamupāditaṃ' ityanena granthena pūrvoktasyāpyupanyāsa iti prakaṭayati |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ punaḥ praśnopanyāsaḥ ? idamatra kāraṇam, vivartapakṣe hi (vivartavādine vaiyākaraṇe kṛte ākṣepe ) yutasiddhayoḥ anapekṣatvaṃ na śakyate vaktuṃ iti mantrānasya praśnaḥ |
śakyate hi vṛddhavyavahārasya anādi- tayā anapekṣatā vaktuṃ iti tasyaivopanyāsaḥ |
'tasmānmanyāmahe kenāpi puruṣeṇa śabdānāmaiḥ saha saṃbandhaṃ kṛtvā saṃbandha- hetuṃ vedāḥ praṇītāḥ' iti sāpekṣatvaṃ upasaṃhṛtam ( vivarta- vādinā ) |
tadidānīmucyate, 'apauruṣeyatvāt saṃbandhasya siddhaṃ' iti vṛddhavyavahārasya anāditopanyāsaḥ |
kimidaṃ tarhi praśnottaram ? kathamiti pṛṣṭe, puruṣasya saṃbandhurabhāvāt ityuttaramayuktam |
kathaṃ punaridaṃ pratipakṣatayā āśa- ṅkyate ? bāhyamāśaṅkyate |
anādinā api vṛddhavyava- hāreṇa śabdārthavagamasiddhau yatra kartā upalabhyate tatra ādimataiva balāt prāpnoti 'vṛddhiradaic' itivan |

( ṛju- yadyapi vṛddhavyavahārāditāyāḥ api śabdāt arthāvagama upapadyate, tathāpi sākṣāt saṃketakāraṇādarthena na śakyate anāditā vaktuṃ iti bhanati saṃbandhapuṣpo- palambhane pratipakṣabhūtam ) tasmāt karturupalambho nirā- karaṇīyaḥ |
'kathaṃ punaḥ saṃbandha nāsti' ityasya praśnasya kimi- damuttaramupapadyate 'pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyabhāvāt tatpūrvaka- tvācceteṣāṃ' iti ? kathaṃ nopapadyate ? anumānāderapi prāmāṇatvābhyupagamāt |
( ṛju- tena pratyakṣamātranirā- karaṇaṃ na saṃbandhunāstitāmāvahati ) |
( ṛju- yat loke anyamanasaḥ kathāsu śrūyate- ghoṭārudro bhavato vismṛto ghoṭa iti |
kevalnumānātpramāṇatayā tāvat saṃbhavati anādau vṛddha- vyavahāre pratyārthini ( ṛju- to tāvadanumānāgamī ) kevalapratyakṣavyāpāranirapekṣau |
sā ca naikā- ntena saṃbandhāntarameva anumāpayitumalama, vṛddhavyavahārā- nāditayā'pi upapadyate |
tathā āgamo'pi svatantratā- vat na saṃbandhamucce pramāṇam, kāryakavipayatvāt |
yadi paraṃ pratyakṣānumānapūrvakaṃ vaktavyaḥ, tatrānumānapūrvaka'pi anādiddhavyavahārapratipattasaṃbhavena kevalānumānābhāvāt pratyakṣapekṣo na saṃbhavati iti |
bahuvacanamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ 'tatpūrvakatvāccetta- reṣāṃ' iti ? itareṣoriti vaktavyam |
na hi cira- vṛttaḥ san na smaryata iti na pūrvajñānāmapi pratyakṣamātra saṃbhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ |
na ca himavadādikapuruṣāmādavat asmaraṇaṃ bhavitu- marhati |
'na ca puruṣaviśeṣaḥ śabdānām' iti kimabhipretam ? kṛtakatve hi tadāmāt prāmāṇyaṃ syāt, na niścayo'janatayā vicchedaḥ, smaraṇopapadyate ityabhiprāyaḥ |
( ṛju- yadi saṃbandhā puruṣaḥ pratyakṣamadhiyamyaḥ syāt tadā tatsaṃketasyapratipatteḥ pratipattavyaḥ |
nahi saṃketavipatti vyavahāraḥ syāt ādyedamilayoḥ kaliśabde |
'yadyapi ca ... pratipadyamahe' ( bhāṣyaṃ ) iti kiṃvipayamidaṃ vismaraṇamupanyastam ? yadi tāvat sādhya- viṣayam, tadedameva pramāṇaṃ yadūta vismaraṇopapattiḥ |
tathā na ( ca ) pramāṇamantareṇa saṃbandhārthaṃ pratipadyamahi iti ahetuḥ |
yadyapyucyate- 'yathā vidyamānasyāpi anupalabdharna bhavati iti naitāvatā vinā pramāṇena śaśaviṣāṇaṃ prati- padyāmahe' iti, tadapyayuktam |
yadi vidyamānasyaiva anupalabdhiḥ, kena vā śakyate vaktuṃ śaśaviṣāṇaṃ nāstīti |
'yadyapi anyatra vismaraṇopa- pattirdṛṣṭā, naitāvatā anyatrāpi vidharmopapattiḥ śakyate vaktuṃ' iti, asadabhiprāyo'yam |
iha punarbhayatā anupalabdhyā- veva idamapyupapadyate iti asaṃbaddhamityuktam |
(ṛju- anupalabdhyāveva sarvaiḥ pramāṇairapi anupalabdhyeva saṃvandhaḥ idaṃ vissaraṇaṃ upanyastaṃ iti asaṃbaddhaṃ kāraṇadoṣanirākaraṇe- nāpi na saṃvadhyate ityuktam |
) yathā ghaṭāderupalabdhasya anupalabdhirasti iti naitāvatā śaśaviṣāṇasya astitvaṃ śakyate vaktum |
anupalabdheḥ punaḥ anupalabdherevānupalabdhiḥ ( na tatra kāraṇāntarakalpanā |
'nanu arthāpattyā' iti kimidaṃ pramāṇasaṃjñā upanyastā ? (ekadeśī āha-) omityucyate |
(rāddhāntī- ) kiṃ punaratra nopapadyate iti anathā (buddhayā) parigṛhyate ? (ekadeśī āha-) nanu ca saṃvandhasya kartā |
(rāddhāntī- ) kathaṃ punarasau nopapadyate (ityevaṃ parigṛhyate ? (ekadeśī-) prathamaśravaṇe arthānavagateḥ |
(rāddhāntī-) yadi prathamaśravaṇe arthaṃ na pratipadyate kimāyātaṃ saṃvandhasya kartuḥ ? ( na tatrānupapattiḥ kācit asti |
) (ekadeśī-) evaṃ tarhi (prasiddhātpadārthāde'pi) yadi gṛhe devadatto nopalabhyate, kimāyātaṃ vahnibhāvasya ? (tatrāpi gamyasya vahnibhāvasya anupapadyamānatā nāsti |
kiṃ tarhi ? vidyamānatā nopapadyate ityuktam (arthāpatti- lakṣaṇe |
) saiveyaṃ bahirastīti saṃvit (tasmāt tatra anupapadyamānameva pratīyate |
) iha punaḥ prathamaśravaṇe arthānavagateḥ saṃvandhasya kartā kaḥ saṃvandho dṛṣṭaḥ ? (iti nānūpapattiḥ āyāti |
) athedaṃ manasi vartate, na prathamaśravaṇāt pratipadyate, pratipadyate ca dvitīyādiśravaṇāt |
) nanu ca anumānamapi nopapadyate, prathamaśravaṇāt- pratīteḥ anekatvāt |
(ekadeśī-) nanu padagatayeva cintā (tena padā- bhiprāyeṇa idamyucyate 'prathamaśravaṇe arthānavagamāditi |
na ca kiṃcana padaṃ prathamaśravaṇe arthamavagamayati, iti nāsti bhāgāsiddhātā |
) (siddhāntī-) kimidaṃ padaṃ nāma ? (yadipyayā cintā bhavatā kriyate) (ekadeśī-) prasiddhā gavādayaḥ 'devadatta gāmānaya' ityevamādiṣu vākyeṣu |
(siddhāntī-) kiṃ kāryatayaiva prasiddhāḥ uta vākyārthāvagataye kāryam ? (na padānāṃ vākyārthā- vagateranyat kāryamasti |
yāvat sā vākyārthāvagatiḥ, sā prathamaśravaṇe'pi bhavati |
(ekadeśī-) vāṭhaṃ kāryatayaiva prasiddhāḥ (āvāpo- ddhārābhyāṃ hi padānāṃ padārthamātramavagamaḥ eva kāryatayā anasitaḥ |
) (pṛcchati-) kasmin (prasiddhāḥ ?) (ekadeśī-) vyavahāre, yena vṛddhā vyavaharanti (vyava- hriyate aneneti vyutpattyā vākyameva vyavahāraḥ |
kena vṛddhā vyavaharanti ? (uttaraṃ-) devadatta gāmānaya śuklāṃ ityevamādinā |
na hi vyavahārātprasiddho'rthaḥ kāryantaratayā śakyate vaktum |
(ekadeśī granthavirodhamāha-) kathaṃ tarhi 'ayaṃ gauḥ ityasya śabdasya ko'rthaḥ', 'sāsnā-

nyatve ? (siddhāntī-) kathaṃ vā vṛddhavyavahāreṇa asya (saṃvandhasya) autpattikatvābhidhānam ? (yathā ayaṃ granthaḥ mammaṭe na ghaṭate iti manyase, tathā tvanmate'pi vṛddhavyavahāreṇa asya saṃvandhasya autpattikatvābhidhānaṃ na vaṭate |
vṛddhavyavahāre hi nirupyamāṇe vākyārthāva- gatireva kāryatayā'vabhāti, na padārthīvagateḥ |
) tasmāt pratijñāsadhanayoḥ yathaikavākyatā bhavati tathā ayaṃ grantho varṇanīyaḥ |
sa tu tadbhūtādhikaraṇe svayameva bhāṣyakāreṇa varṇyate ityupapadyate |
abhiprāya ucyate- prathamaśrutaḥ kiṃ na pratyāyaya- tīti |
prathamaśrutaṃ padaṃ nimittabhūtaṃ padārthaṃ na pratipāda- yati |
apratipannanimittaśca prathamaśrutāt padāt vākyā- rthamapi na pratipadyate iti siddhaṃ vede'pi prathamaśrutasya apratipādakatvam |
) kaḥ punaḥ vācakanimittayorbhedaḥ ? idaṃgarthameva hi tadbhūtādhikaraṇe ārabhyate ityalamati- prasaṅgena |
(ṛju- nimittapakṣe padāni svārthebhyo yeṣu vyāpriyamāṇāni vākyārthāvapattiṃ upajanayanti, na punaḥ pratyastamitapadavibhāgaṃ anvayavameva vākyaṃ vadantīti |
evaṃ ca kathyamāne kathita eva vācakanimittayorbhedaḥ |
(ṛju- autpattikasūtrasthaṃ 'upadeśaḥ iti prathamāntaṃ pañcamyantatayā vipariṇamya siddhavat iti cādhyāhṛtya bhāṣyakāreṇa idumuktam |
[pṛ. 153] "kimidaṃ anyathaiva prakānta- manyathaivopasaṃhṛtam ? śabdādavārthānavagatiriti prakāntam, vṛddhavyavahārādityupasaṃhṛtam |
vṛddhavyavahārāt artha avagamyamāne naiva śabdādavagato'rtho bhavati hastasaṃjñādima iva |
hastasaṃjñādau'pi vṛddhavyavahāraprasiddhā eva, nāyena saṃvaddhā iti |
ata eva ca śabdasvabhāvaiḥ (vaiyākaraṇaiḥ :) uktaṃ 'vivarta eva ca bhedavādibhiḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ' iti |
kimanena vivartapakṣapātena, pratyukto'yam, ekatvānupalabdheḥ : (śabdārthayoḥ ekatva- syānupalabdheḥ |
) yadyevam, pratyuktaṃ tarhi vedasya prāgā- ṇyam |
vṛddhavyavahāravyutpatyā avagamyamāne'rthe śabdasyānyat kāraṇaṃ kiṃ vā manyate bhavān ? nanu ca vyutpattimeva kāraṇatayā manyāme |
śabdasya arthasaṃbandhavidhayā hi vyutpattiḥ, na vyutpatteḥ śabdārtha- yoḥ saṃvandhaḥ, tasya viṣayatvāt |
nanu kārye'pi saṃvandhe vṛddhavyavahārotpattiḥ vālānāṃ anuguṇeva |
kathamiyaṃ pratipakṣatayā śaṅkyate ? satyam, pramāṇaparicchedye hi kāryatve vyutpattiḥ : vyākaraṇādi- vyutpattirna virodhaḥ, atha ca kṛtakaḥ kasya puna- rnirupādhi kalpyanām |
(ṛju- yatra pramāṇāntareṇa kārya eva saṃvandho'vagataḥ tatra bhavatu kāryatā |
yatra punaḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ kāryatve nāsti, tatra kāryatvaṃ kalpayitavyam |
tavet kāryaṃ vṛddhavyavahāravyutpattereva pratyakṣa- bhūtāyāḥ upapannam, tarhi na śakyate kāryatānumānam |
nahi pratyakṣadṛṣṭe kāraṇāntare sati sarvatra tadeva kāraṇa- manumātuṃ śakyate |
tena arthapratītiprakāryeṇa tāvanna śakyate saṃvandhasya apauruṣeyatā vaktum |
yatra punaḥ sākṣā- deva dṛśyate, tatra tathaivāṅgīkriyate |
) kiṃca kārye hi saṃvandhe karturdumeṣu saṃvandhakaraṇe na kiṃcit prayojanamasti |
eka eva puruṣaḥ śabdānāmetaiḥ saha saṃbandhaṃ kṛtvā vedān praṇayet tadā tena vedyavyavahāriṣveva saṃketaḥ kāryaḥ, na durgamadeśavyavasthiteṣu mlecchādiṣu, teṣāṃ vedyavyavahāra- bhāvāt |
na cedamupapannaṃ vedakāradasya eva saṃbandha- kāraḥ iti |
[bhāṣye pṛ. 56 paṃ 10 ārabhya] dvitīyāṃ varṇa- yanti-) |
yadi kāryārthaḥ saṃbandho'bhyupagamyate tadā kṛtaṃ kāryeṇa |
(ṛju- 'anena śabdena ayamartho'tra pratipādayitavyaḥ' ityetthaṃ saṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
yadi vṛddhavyavahāre eva vyutpatyāḥ kecana śabdāḥ vyutpādyānāṃ aṅgīkriyante, te hi pūrvaśabdena vyutpādyānāṃ saṃbandhakaraṇa. vākyārthamapi proddhumalama |
yadi vṛddhavyavahārasiddhāḥ ke- cana vyutpādyānāmaṅgīkriyante tadā kimapare saṃbandha- karaṇena ? vṛddhavyavahāra eva vyutpatyupāyo'stu ) |
katham ? ayamatra vācaka ityevaṃ eṣābhidhārthatvasya na śabdādarthāva- gatirupapadyate |
tasmān pratyakṣadṛṣṭe (śabdārthavagatikāraṇe) evaṃ upapadyamāne'rthe na kartuḥ kalpanā upapadyate |
kṛte hi saṃbandhaye adṛṣṭamānasyā- rthasya devatvādeḥ saṃbandhakaraṇam |
naiva śabdasya arthena saṃbandhaḥ, kuto'sya pauru- ṣeyatā apauruṣeyatā veti |
katham ? syādetadeva saṃbandhaḥ, dhuramodakaśabdoccāraṇe mukhasya pāṭanapuraṇe syātām, yadi saṃkṣepalakṣaṇaṃ saṃbandhamabhipretya ucyate |
yo hyatra vyapadeśyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tamekaṃ na vyapadiśati bhavān pratyāyasya pratyayākṣasya ca yaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇa iti |
āha, yadi pratyāyakaḥ śabdaḥ, prathamaśrutaḥ kiṃ na pratyāyayati ? ucyate |
pratyāyaka iti pratyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā avagacchāmaḥ, na prathamaśruta iti |
prathamaśravaṇe pratyaya- madṛṣṭvā yāvatkurutaḥ śrutena iyaṃ saṃjñā ayaṃ saṃjñī ityava- dhāritaṃ bhavati tāvatkṛtaḥ |
yathā cakṣuḥ dṛṣṭaṃ na bāhyena prakāśena vinā prakāśayati iti adṛṣṭaṃ na bhavati |
śabdānāṃ karaṇatvaṃ vā kartṛtvaṃ vā nirūpitam |
pratipādyakriyā- phalabhāgitayā yat arthasya karmatvaṃ tat vācyatvam, śabdasya ca vivakṣāvadhena yat kartṛtvaṃ vā tat vācakatvam |
' uddeśyāḥ anyonyamana- pekṣya kriyāṃ vaśīkurvantiḥ yuktaṃ yat na mithaḥ saṃbadhyante |
upādeyānāṃ tu kriyāṃ vaśīkurvanmānāṃ tada- dvāreṇa asti parasparaniyamaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
uddeśaṃ hi kriyāmāka- rṣati, sa ca svāṃśabhūtamupādeyaṃ gṛhṇītyeva svapradhānaṃ yāti ! tadiha arthaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ |
sa ca svāṃśabhūtaṃ śabdam, ityasti śabdārthayoḥ ekakriyāniyāmyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
sa kriyāsaṃgateḥ paścāt saṃbandhaḥ kīryate tayoḥ |
' nanu astu ekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ niyamaḥ, tathāpi kāraṇānāṃ parasparasaṃbandhānāṃ kriyaiva saṃbandhāt kathaṃ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ, ata āha- tatreti |

arthasya vyavahāropayoginaḥ pratipadyasya saṃskāraṃ kurvan śabdaḥ upakārako bhavati arthaścopakāryaḥ ityasti abhidhānakriyā- dvāraḥ śabdārthayoḥ upakāryoṣakārakalakṣaṇaḥ vācyavācaka- bhāvaḥ niyamādiparyāyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
nanu evaṃ niyamajanya- tvāt anumānameva śabdaṃ syāt ata āha- naceti |
pratītyuttarakālo'yaṃ niyamaḥ na pratītyupayogī ityukta- miti |
gamayantīṃ śruti dṛṣṭvā kalpyate vyava- hārataḥ |
sā'naṅgāṃ tadeva syāt, neyaṃ dhūmā- dibhiḥ samā |
(iyaṃ, eṣā, iyaṃ, iti śabdaḥ saṃjñā nirdiṣṭā) nodyati- saṃjñā iti sapāda- dvayena |
gamakatvameva hi saṃjñālatvam, tacca avagantavya- kālabhāvitvāt nānagayajñam |
nahi asati saṃbandhe saṃjñā saṃjñinaṃ gamayati |
gamakatā tu paścādupajāyamānā dhūmādityeva vācaka- tvasyāpi anaṅgamevetyarthaḥ |
gamakatvena, pūrvaṃ ca tatra notpadyate iti |
' neyaṃ samā ityuktaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ darśayati- nirupite ityādinā |
dhūmādī deśakālādidvārā saṃbandhanīyamaṃ avagate tatsaṃbandhenaiva gamakatā, na tu rauva prathamaṃ gṛhyate |
śabdasya (saṃjñāyāḥ) tu prathamaṃ gamakatvaṃ gṛhyate, na saṃbandhāntaram, tada- grahaṇādeva ca gamakatā bhavati |
na cātmāśravatā, pūrvapūrvavṛddheṣu gamakatvagrahaṇāt uttareṣāṃ gamakato- papatteriti |
' asmāt padāt ayamartho boddhavyaḥ iti eṣā rītiḥ |
ayaṃ śabdo vācakaḥ ayamarthastasya vācyaḥ iti dvitīyā |
uccaritācchabdāt arthaviṣayāṃ jñānakriyā dṛṣṭvā keṣāṃ- vicchuddhānāṃ tatrāthe boddhṛtvaṃ bodhakatvaṃ anumānāt jñāyate |
' itthaṃ vācakatā siddhā saṃkīrṇā'pi tataḥ param |
niṣkṛṣye tu arthe jātimātrarūpe paścāt niyamyate |

' gamakatve gṛhīte paścāt tanmātreṇa asatyapi saṃbandhā- ntare śabdārthe pratipadyamāno liṅgendriyavilakṣaṇaṃ abhi- dhāyakatvarūpaṃ gamakatvaṃ saṃjñā'paraparyāyaṃ adhyavasyati iti saṃjñāsaṃjñiyoga saṃbandhaḥ |
gamakatvasyaiva saṃbandhasya saṃkīrṇarūpeṇa avagatasya vipayaniyamaḥ anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ avagamyate 'asyāyaṃ gamakaḥ asyāyaṃ' iti, ataḥ sa eva saṃbandhaḥ |
' āha yadi pratyāyakaḥ śabdaḥ' ityādibhāṣyārthe- māha-- (bhā. pṛ. 44) 'saṃbandhagrahaṇāt pūrvaṃ yanmātraṃ gamayatyataḥ |
śabdajñānam- laukikaśabdajñānaṃ tu na pramā, anadhigatārthagantṛtvābhāvāt |
laukike śabde tajjanyajñāne ca prāmāṇyavyavahārastu tadati tanmātrakartvāśāmādāya gauṇaḥ |
śabdatattvaṃ evedaṃ artharūpatayā viparivartate ityuktaṃ śabdavidyeḥ |
sa ca nityatva- siddhau syāditi tat pratipādyate |
' yadyacaritamātra- vināśī śabdo bhavet tadā tasya vṛddhavyavahāreṇa svābhā- vikī svārthāmidhānaśaktirivasātamaśakyathā |
bhūyo bhūyaḥ prayogadarśane hi tattadavasthādhairūpeṇa niṣkṛpya svārtho- bhidhānasāmarthyamavadhāryate |
na cocaritamātravargāṇaḥ śabdasya punaḥ punaḥ prayogadarśanaṃmupapadyate |
nanu caikatvāt ākāśasya tasya ca śrotratvāt tatsaṃ- skāre sarvapuṭendriyasaṃskārāt sarve'pi śabdaṃ upalabhe- ran |
śaṣkulīsaṃskāro hi śrotrasaṃskāraḥ bhinnaśca pratipuruṣaṃ śaṣkutya ityasaṃskṛtaśaṣkulīko na śabdamupalabhate |
’ spaṣṭe tadgrahe nānābhāvopalambhaḥ śabde tāvatsiddha eva |
kintu parasparanirapekṣaiḥ abhivyañjakaiḥ koṣṭhyavāyubhirnānātvacakṣu- syairnānābhūtairbhinnaṃ śrotrasaṃskāramābhamāṇānāṃ bhūtaśabda- buddhiṃ janayadbhinneva śabdo vyucyate |
hi śabdaiścāśritāḥ, nāpyanyeṣu śabdāḥ, ataste pṛthagā- śritāḥ |
na ca bhavantu anityāḥ śabdāḥ tathāpi saṃbandhasyāpītyevamupapadyate, śabdasyaiva viśeṣaniṣiddhasya vācakatvaṃ astu, tena nityatāt vācakasya upapannagevāpaudheyatvam |

nanu ca gatvādi anyadanistastamasti ( tena gatvādyanyeva vācakāni bhavantu, upapannāni ca gatvādīni, anityatve gavyaktīnāṃ pratya- ccāraṇaṃ bhinnaṃḥmaivapratyatītergaurtvādivat ) na tat ( yadi- damuktaṃ tat |
( tatra hi sāmānyamaṅgīkriyate yatra hi bhedagrahaṇānubandha abheda- grahaṇaṃ yathā gatvādiṣu |
yatra punaḥ bhedagraho nāsti, tatra bhedagrahaṇanibandhanaḥ abhedāsāvityapadeśaḥ śuktirajatavat iti na sāmānyalakṣaṇopapattiḥ |
) kathaṃ tarhi śuktikādimanuṣyeṣu ( bhedapratītiḥ ? ) yat eva śuktādibhedena bhedapratītiḥ - ) ata eva svato viśeṣo nopalabhyate |
tathā ca laukikāḥ - ' śuko'yaṃ paṭhati ', ' manuṣyo'yaṃ paṭhati ' iti viśeṣānabhidadhati, na punaḥ ' amuṃ gaviśeṣam, amuṃ gaviśeṣam ' iti |
tadidamākṣepapūrvakamucyate ' karmaike tatra darśa- nāt ' iti |
nanu caivaṃ sati kutako'pi saṃbandho nopapadyate |
( samādhistvaḥ pṛcchati - ) tataḥ kim ? ( ākṣeptā - ) laukikavyavahārocchedaḥ |
( samādhātā - ) punastataḥ kim ? ( ākṣeptā - ) anityatvapratijñā nopapadyate |
( samādhātrekadeśī - ) laukikavyavahāravirodhatvāt anityatā mā bhūt, nityatā''padyateḥ kimāyātama ? ( ākṣeptā - ) idamāyātama, laukikavyavahārānupapattireva |
( samādhātā - ) satyamevaṃ yadi pratyastamitaṃ samayena ( bhāve niṣṭhā |
( kiviṣayaḥ punaḥ samayo vyavahārahetuḥ ? na tāvat śabdaviṣayaḥ tasya bhaṭṭagurusya samayavyavahārānuvṛttayogāt |
tatrāha - ) nahi aviṣayaḥ samayasya asti, sarvānupapattirharo'yaṃ samayaḥ |
( adhyārthaḥ - ) yo'yaṃ pratyuccāraṇaṃ bhinneṣvapi varṇeṣu bhedāgrahanivandhanaḥ abhedabhramaḥ, tadviṣayaḥ samayaḥ |
pramāṇāntareṇa hi arthe pratīya tatpratipādanābhiprāyeṇa puruṣāḥ bhrāntyā- rūḍhatvān śabdān samyakkaraṇakalpitābhimānena prayuñjate |
pratipattā'pi tenaivābhimānena tadabhiprāyanta- bhāvamusavena artha pratipadyate, ityabhiprāyavyabhicārārtha- siddhiḥ, tataśca vyavahāra iti |
vaidikastu vyavahāraḥ śābdakanibandhanaḥ iti na samayasya hetuḥ |
tadāha - ) tasmāt śabdapramāṇakānāṃ vyavahāradarśanānmātraṃ prāmāṇyaṃ sidhyati |

( nanu kṣaṇikatve'pi śabdasya puru- pāneṣameva artheṣu prāmāṇyaṃ kimiti na bhavati ? yathā anityānāmapi cakṣurādīnāṃ sataḥ prāmāṇyamitya- trāha - ) vṛddhavyavahārapūrvvakatvāt saṃbandhasya saṃbandha- jñānapūrvvakatvāccārthyavatteḥ |
na ca kṣaṇikatve'pi cakṣurā- dīnāmima prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ, prathamaśravaṇavagamanāt |
karmaike tatra darśanāt ' iti kṛtakatvaṃ śabdasyo- cyate |
kimidaṃ kṛtakatvam ? ( yadi sarvaśabdānādhi- kṛtya kṛtakatvaṃ kṛtrimatvamucyate, tadā prayatnantaradarśanā- diti bhāgāsiddho hetuḥ, samudraghopādiṣvabhāvāt |
atha abhidhānātmakatvena pakṣīkṛtya prayatnajatvaṃ sādhyate, tadā anabhidhāyākānāṃ kṛtakatā na sādhitā syāt iti |
) nanu prayatnapiṇḍikā'pi śabdasyotpattirdṛṣṭā yathā challacchabdeḥ ( jalaśabde ) |
kathaṃ tarhi mṛdabhedādiṣu ? ( atra samādhiḥ - ) anyato'- stitvāvagameḥ |
tasmānna vidyamānasya prayatno'bhivyañjakaḥ iti śakyate vaktum |
( samarthitā āha - ) kathamatra pratyabhi- jñānam ? ( uttaraṃ - ) anyatvānavagamanāt ( anyatvāva- gamapūrvakaṃ hi yatrābhedajñānam, tatra pratyabhijñā bhavati |
ākṣepakaḥ - ) anityatvavādino vā kimapyale- nāvagatirasti ? ( samarthakaḥ - ) kimiti nāsti ( anya- tvenāvagatiḥ :) pravastotpannayoḥ ( pravastasya utpannasya ca vyaktyaṃ anyatvam |
samarthakaḥ - ) kiṃ viśeṣā- grahaṇanibandhanaiva pratyabhijñā ? ( ākṣepakaḥ - ) kiṃ vā manyate bhavān ? ( evamevetyarthaḥ |
( ākṣepakaḥ - ) svarūpa- grahaṇa satīdamucyate, ānumānikaṃ na karma ityuktam |

( samarthakaḥ - ) kā vārtā jvālādiṣu ? ( jvālādīnāṃ tu svarūpaṃ pratyakṣaṇa gṛhyate, bhedaśca nāvagamyate, tena tatrāpi tarhi bhavataḥ pratyabhijñā'bhipretā ? samarthaka eva ākṣepa- kasyāśayamāśaṅkate - ) nityatve jvālādīnāṃ anumāna- virodha iti cet |
( upasaṃharati - ) tasmāt viśeṣāgrahaṇe'pi anyathā, anyatve ca siddhā prayatnanāntareṇopalabdheḥ : prayatnenotpattiḥ |
bhāṣyam - no khalvapi uccaritaṃ muhūrtamapi upa- labhāmahe, ato vinaṣṭaḥ ( śabdaḥ ) ityavagacchāmaḥ |
na ca sannopalabhyate, anupalabbhakāraṇānāṃ vyavadhānādīnā- mabhāve'pi anupalabdhamāt |
na cāsau viṣayamaprāptaḥ, ākāśādivyatvāt, karṇīcchede'pi anupalabdhamāt |

bṛhatī - keyamattapattiḥ ( bhāṣyoktā ) ? ( uttaraṃ - ) asthānatve'pi rūpagrahaṇaśaktiḥ naiva vihanyate, tadvaccchabde'pi iti cet, ( uttaraṃ - ) pratyuktaṃ prathamaśravaṇavagamanāt : ( saṃtraṇagrahaṇasāpekṣasya pratyaka- tvam, na ca tat kṣaṇikatvam bhavati ) tasmāt asthānāt ityeva hetuḥ; autpattikatvavivāti saṃbandhasya |
yadi kālāntarāvasthāpitā syāt, syādapi vyavahārat śabdā- darśayati : |
asthātitve punaḥ samaya eva dharaṇaṃ bhavitu- marhati ityuktaṃ ' asthānāt ' iti |
bhāṣyam - api ca ' śabdaṃ kuru ' ' mā śabdaṃ kārṣīḥ ' iti vyavahārataḥ prayujyate |
na te nūnamagacchanti sa evāyaṃ śabdaḥ ' iti |
kā atra nyāyānuvṛttiḥ ? mukhyayārthā karoteḥ ' śabdaṃ kuru ' ' śabdaṃ mā kārṣīḥ ' ' śabdakārī ayaṃ mānavakaḥ ' iti ( abhūtaprādurbhāvaṃ karotyarthaḥ |
bhāṣyam - nānādeśeṣu ca yugapat śabdamupalabha- mahe |
kāryāṇāṃ tu bahūnāṃ nānādeśeṣu kriyamāṇānāṃ upapadyate anekadeśasaṃbandhaḥ |
bṛhatī - keyamattapattiḥ ( bhāṣyoktā ) ? ( uttaraṃ - ) iyamattapattiḥ, yugapadekasya ( devadattādeḥ ) ? anekotpa- ladhirna dṛṣṭā |
tataḥ kim ? idaṃ tato bhavati, anyatvam ( ekasmāt vyāvṛttā yugapadekopalavdhiḥ anyatvaṃ sādha- yati |
na cet kaścit, hetuprayatnena kim ? satyaṃ yathā bhavān āha |
( anirākṛto'yamarthaḥ siddhāntamākṣipatīti kasya- cit bhrāntiḥ syāt ) tasmāt tadbrahmamapidhāyautha-
aprāpte ca bhrāntitve apunarukto'yaṃ bhavati kasya- cinmandadhiyaḥ |
sarvāthai cedaṃ śāstraṃ ' mandaviśeṣaṇe ' iti darśitaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa |
' asati viśeṣe nityasya nānekatvaṃ ' iti ( bhāṣyam |
ākṣipatti - ) kimidaṃ asati viśeṣe nityasya nānekatvaṃ iti, ' asati viśeṣe nānātvaṃ nāsti ' iti śakyate vaktuṃ nityasyānityasya vā |
yadi anityasya asatyapi viśeṣe nānātvaṃ syāt yuktaṃ vaktuṃ ' nityasya ' iti |
tasmāt ' sattvāttare ca yaugapadyāt ' ityasya anenanyāsiddhi- rāśaṅkitā |
( punarākṣipatti - ) kiṃ gavāderviśeṣo vidyate ? tadapi hi ekamaviśiṣṭam |

( hetusamarthanavādinā hi tvayā evamucyate, yadidaṃ nityatvena ekasyānekatra darśanam, tadiśeṣe sati gavādeḥ, na ca śabdasya viśeṣo'sti, tasmānnitya- tvena idamekatra darśanam, kintu tatratatraprayatnenaiveti |
evaṃ ca vadatsvasya ayamabhiprāyo lakṣyate ' gavāderviśeṣo vidyate ' iti |
sa cāthamabhiprāyaste amupapannaḥ ; gavā- derapi viśeṣābhāvāt |
) athāyamabhiprāyaḥ : ( te ) - ' asati āśrayaviśeṣe ' ( gotvasyāpi viśeṣe nāsti sati tu āśrayaviśeṣe gotvasyāpi viśeṣa iti |
yataḥ - ) tatrāpi āśrayasyaivātyatvam, kiṃ āyātāśrayiṇaḥ ? ( nahi āśrayabhedena āśrayī bhidyate, anyatvāccoḥ ) tasmāt nityasyāpi ekasya anekatra yugapadutpardhatā |
ato ( nityatvenāpi ekasyānekatrayugapadutpattisiddheḥ ) nānyatve yugapadarśanaṃ hetuḥ |
athedaṃ matam, naiva gavāderyugapadarśana- manekatra, medā eva hi tatra anekadeśatayā gṛhyate, na gotvam, iti ( anena samarthanavādinā'bhiprāyāntaramā- śaṅkate pūrvapakṣepavādī |
) dūyati -- ) kathaṃ tarhi sarveṣu ' gauḥ gauḥ ' iti buddhiḥ ? ( samarthanavādī āha - ) ata eva ( sarvatra gaurgoriti buddhereva ) anekadeśatvaṃ gotvasya nāsti |
anyathā hi ( yadi vyaktigotvasya deśatvena pratīyate ) ' iha gotvaṃ, iha gotvaṃ ' iti ( pratītiḥ ) syāt |

( ākṣipatti - ) kathaṃ tarhi iha- pratyayāt samavāyaḥ ? ( ' ihapratyayāt samavāyaḥ ' iti yo'yaṃ padārthaviśāmuddāraḥ sa katham ? uttaraṃ - ) eka- dravyapadārthābhiprāyaṃ tat, na dravyavyabhiprāyam ( ekadravya- śvāsau padārthaśabdena karmapadārtha ucyate |
karmapadārtha eva ekadravyaḥ, ekadravyamāśrayabhūtaṃ tasya eva, na dravyapadārthasya guṇapadārthasya vā ) tasmāt ( anyathāsiddhibhāvāt ) hetustanye yugapadarśanam |
' asati viśeṣe ' iti yuktaṃ ( bhāṣyaṃ anyathā- siddhiparihārārtham ) |
nanu ca anityasyāpi asati viśeṣe naivānyatvam ( ataḥ kimidaṃ ' nityasya ' iti |
uttaraṃ - ) vāḍhaṃ ( asatyapi viśeṣe anekatvamanityasya ) asti jvālādiṣu, kāryatvāccāviśeṣaḥ |
nityasya tu akāryatvāt anekatvavirodhaḥ iti yukto hetuḥ : ( ' sattvā- ntare ca yaugapadyāt ' iti ) |
bhāṣyam -- api ca ' daścatra ' ityatra ' ikāraḥ prakṛtiḥ, yakāro vikṛtiḥ ' ityupadiśanti |
vṛttī -- prakṛtivikārabhāvaṃ ca śabdasya śabdāḥ smaranti |
bhāṣyam -- api ca bahubhiruccāryadvirmahān śabdaḥ śrūyate |
ato manyāmahe, nūnamasya ekaikena kaścidavayavaḥ kriyate, yatracāyaṃ mahānupa- labhyate |
yadi vispaṣṭena hetunā śabdasya nityatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyadhāmaḥ nityapratyayasāmarthyāt prayatnenābhivyajyate iti bhavi- ṣyati |
vṛttī -- kimidaṃ samaṃ darśanam ? idaṃ tu tat samaṃ darśanam, kāryaṃ cākāryaṃ ca tulyo heturiti |
kathaṃ tulyatā ? sāṃvāsikatāyā ( samyak nyastaṃ saṃyastam, tatra bhavaṃ sāṃvāsikam |

kimatra saṃyastam ? idamatra saṃyastam, yadi saprayatnabhinnapratyakṣa- grāhyatāṃ vakṣyāma iti ( yadi saprayatnabhinnapratyakṣagrāhyatā śabdasya syāt, tadā prayatnottaradarśanaṃ prayatnasya abhivyañjakatā bhaviṣyati, atha saprayatnabhinnapratyakṣa- grāhyatā śabdasya na sthāna, tadā prayatnaḥ śabdasya kāraka eveti ) |
parihṛtaṃ ca jvālādiṣviva anumāne prayatneni na śakyate ekatāṃ vaktumiti |
yadi bhedagrahaṇa- nibandhanaiva pratyabhijñā ucyeta, tadgrahaṇanibandhanā sā iti pratipāditaviṣayam : ( pratipādayiṣyate ) |
tasmāt upapannaṃ ' samaṃ tu tatra darśanam ' iti |
atrāpi yadi śakṣyāmo nityatamasya vispaṣṭaṃ vaktuṃ tato nityapratyayasāmarthyādacidupalabhaṃ kadāci- danupalabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃcidupalabhyate miśritaṃ kalpa- viṣayāmaḥ |
tacca saṃyogavibhāgasadbhāve sati bhavatīti saṃyogavibhāgāvevābhivyañjakāviti vakṣyāmaḥ |

yadi śabdaṃ saṃyoga- vibhāgā evābhivyañjanti na kurvanti, ākāśaviṣayatvā- cchabdasya, ākāśasyaivaikatvāt ya evāyaṃ śrotrākāśaḥ sa eva deśāntareṣvapīti nanuśrutyaiḥ saṃyogavibhāgāairabhi- vyaktaḥ pāṭaliputre'pyupalabhyate |
yasya punaḥ kurvanti tasya vīthyāḥ saṃyogavibhāgā vādyāśritatvādvāyutraiva kariṣyanti |
dūre satyāḥ karṇaśaṣkulyā anupakārakāḥ saṃyogavibhāgāstena dūre yaccotre tena nopalabhyata iti |
na cedupakurvanti tasmādanimittaṃ śabdopalambhane saṃyoga- vibhāgāviti |
abhighātena hi preritā vāyavaḥ stimitāni vāyavyantarāṇi pratidhāghamānāḥ sarvato- dikkān saṃyogavibhāgānānupādayanti |
anuparateṣveva teṣu śabda upalabhyate, nopa- rateṣu |
ata eva ca cānutrātaṃ dūrādupa- labhyate śabdaḥ |
vṛttī -- ' sata: paramadarśanaṃ viṣayānāgamāt ' iti tadvat anekāntikadarśanamapi ityukam |
nityadarśane ko hetuḥ ? yadi paraṃ viṣayānāgamaḥ ( so'pi anupapannaḥ : samarthya- yate - ) astu tarhi ! ( ākṣipatti - ) sa evātra durlabhaḥ |
kimiti ( durmedhaḥ ! hetumāha - ) nityapakṣe hi abhivyañjakatvaṃ śabdasya |
ekaśca ayaṃ śabdaḥ eka- viṣayaśca ākāśaviṣayatvāt |
grāhakaṃ cāsya ākāśa- meva ( iti ) keyaṃ viṣayānāgamaḥ ? |
( kena vokte na nyāyyeti, tadgrahaṇe tu sati sarvatraivāsya anyāvyatā syātthā, ata evoktaṃ ' yadi śabdasya ' iti ( bhāṣye ) |
nanu tadgrahaṇe api nātra āvaraṇādiśūnyā ātmānaṃ labhate |
tasmāt saṃyogavibhāgayorabhi- vyañjakatve satyapi sarvaśabdānāṃ sarvaiśca upalabdhiḥ prāpnoti ( sarve hi śabdāḥ samānadeśāḥ, tattaikābhivyaktī sarvābhivyaktiḥ syāt ghaṭādivat |
sarvaśabdānāṃ taṃ na yuktam, kāraṇa- vat abhivyañjakatvāt |
( yathā kāraṇānāṃ bhinna- tvāt kaścit śabdaḥ kenacit kriyate, tathā kaścit śabdaḥ kenacidabhivyajyate ) |
( rāvendriyatvina eva śabdasyotpatteḥ ) yaśca ubhayoḥ ( samo ) doṣaḥ, na tameka śrotro bhavati iti |
parighataṃ idaṃ dūṣaṇam, kārikābhidhāyakoḥ viśeṣābhidhānena vinā naiva codyen nityatvādinā |
abhivyaktiḥ śabdasya, indriyasya vā syāt ? tatra śabdābhivyaktau tāvat ekaviṣayatvāt sarvaśabdānāṃ ghaṭādīnāmiva
vipayasyāvacchitto hetuḥ ? śrotrasya hi abhivyañjaka- saṃskāraṃ nirūpayiṣyan, na punaḥ śabdasyānyatvamavagamayati |
( ākṣeptā - ) nanu coktam, na cet saṃyogavibhāgāḥ śrotrasya śabdagrahaṇasamarthe saṃskāramāpādayanti, śabdasyo- tpādakāḥ prāpnuyuḥ ( bhaveyuḥ :) , uttaraccai cānyatvamiti |
( samādhātā - ) kathamatrapratiṣedhaḥ anyasyollāsitva- gamayati ? ( ākṣeptā - ) anyathā vyāpārānupapatteḥ |

( ekedaśī - ) na cet raṃbhakārakāḥ saṃskuryaḥ, kima- nyat ataḥ śabdotpatteḥ ( kuryuḥ ) ? ( samādhātā - ) kiṃ yasya saṃskārakatā nopapadyate, tenotpādakaḥ bhavi- tavyam ? ( ākṣeptā - ) na cedupapādaḥ, nirvyāpāra eva syāt, anyathā ca saṃyogavibhāgāyopalabdhā |
( sa ca saṃskārakatve pratiṣiddhe dṛṣṭotpattiviya eva |
samā- dhātā - ) satyam, yadarthāḥ tatra bhavantu utpādakāḥ saṃskārakā vā ( na punaḥ śabdaḥ, tadarthatvābhāvāt |
kima- yathā tarhi saṃyogavibhāgāyoḥ, tatrāha - ) paramapratipadya- yathā ca siddhā |
( paraḥ śabdaṃ pratipadyatāṃ iti ) tat tayoḥ ( utpādakatva-saṃskārakatvayoḥ :) yadidaṃ tat parikalpyatām, vipayāntare ( śab
