aṇuppattikāraṇam' ityevamādayaḥ (mama api hi bhikkhavaḥ karma vartate eva sarvam |
tathā uttiṣṭhate loṣṭhaṃ ūrdhvaṃ asti kāraṇam |
ime saṃskṛtā dharmāḥ saṃbhavanti sakāraṇāḥ, akāraṇā vinaśyanti |
' śākyādigrantheṣu yadāpi kiṃcit sādhuśabdābhiprāyeṇa abhinadhruvā prayuktaṃ tatrāpi praśastaviśadaparyatātiprāyaprayogāt kiṃcideva arciṣyantaṃ labhyate |
kimuta yāni prasiddhabhraṣṭadeśa- bhāṣābhyo'pi apabhraṣṭatarāṇi bhikkhave ityevamādīni |
dvitīyābahuvacanasthāne hi e-kārāntaṃ prākṛtaṃ padaṃ dṛṣṭam, na prathamābahuvacane saṃbodhane'pi |
saṃskṛtaśabdasyāne ca kakāradvayayogaḥ anusvāralopaḥ ṛvarṇākārāpastitrātrameva prākṛtapabhraṃśeṣu dṛṣṭam, na ḍa-kārātpattiriti |
saṃskṛtā dharmāḥ ityasya sarvakāla svayaṃmeva pratiṣiddho'pi vināśaḥ kṛtaḥ iti asādhuśabdanibandhanatvāt itya- ntena hetunā vedatvākṛtakaśāstrāntaraśaṅkānivṛttiḥ |
tasya vyākaraṇa- mevaikaṃ upalabdham, tadupalakṣitarūpañca 'vede yathopa- labhyante naivaṃ śākyādibhāṣite |
kṣaṇikatva-nirākṛtanityatva-siddhanityatāvyātyamāna- granthinimāyamupamabhiprāyeṇa vā asannidhamāt ityuktam (kṣaṇikatvena nirākṛtena nityatvena siddhaṃ anityatvaṃ yasya granthasya ) |
asatāṃ vā kṣaṇabhaṅguṣyavādānāma- katvādināṃ asaddetubhirvā pratipādananiyamāt tadeka- kartṛkadharmavacanānāmapi aprāmāṇyam |
śākhāḥ kāṭhakādyāḥ śākhānyapadaveṣāḥ prasidhyanti viśiṣṭarūpasya vedākhya- vṛkṣasya katipayāṅkayapuṣpaphalatvāt |
yathā ekasya vṛkṣasya ekamūlaḥ sarvaśākhādhārabhūtaḥ skandhaḥ tathā eka- syaiva śākhākhyamūlatvetividhyākhyaskandharūpatvāt vṛkṣa- tvopacāraḥ |
yathā vṛkṣasya puṣpaphalāni na ekaikasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ samastāni santi tathā vedaśākhāyāmapi ekaikasyāṃ ṛgvedādipratikāpyahotrādisamastākhyapuṣpa- phalāsattāt śākhatvopacāraḥ |
tathā vṛkṣasya śākhāḥ, evamihāpi vṛkṣasthānīyasya vedasya śākhāḥ |
na caikaikasyāṃ kṛtsnaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ saṃni- hitam |
bhā. 2|4|128, śākhāmadhikṛtya 'prācīmāharati' iti śālāvādo'yaṃ na tu digvādaḥ |
'śākhyā batsānapākaroti, yat palāśaśākhayā vatsānapākaroti' darśasya aupavasathye'hani prātaḥ |
vi. 4|2-1, śākhāyāḥ praharaṇaṃ nāma āhavanīye tyāgaḥ |
nānādeśapaṭhyamānānāṃ śākhānāṃ pramā- dibhiḥ puruṣaiḥ tadeśāgamanāt śrotumaśakteḥ tadgataśratyanu- palambhasaṃbhavaḥ |
ekaśākhāgatāmapi śrutīnāṃ nānā- prakaraṇasthāṃ tatkartṛdharmatvabodhane puruṣadharmatvasya pramā- dibhiḥ nirṇayo'maśakyaḥ |
śākhāyāṃ ekasyāṃ brāhmaṇā- nekatattve'pi tadekaṃ karma |
agrimasūtraikadeśo'yaṃ san pṛthak āvartya adhi- karaṇāntaratvena bhāṣye vyākhyātaḥ |
vastutastu aṣṭama- sūtrasthameva pṛthakkṛtya prathamavarṇatvena vyākhyātaṃ iti niścayo bhavati |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ vatsāpākaraṇārthoṃ palāśaśākhāṃ adhikṛtya śrūyate 'prācīmāharati' , 'udīcīmāharati' , 'prāgudīcī- māharati' iti |
atra prācyādiśabdaḥ diśi vartate iti cenna |
kiṃtu prācyādiśabdaḥ kiṃcidikpṛthakasya prācyādidiśi viruddhāyāṃ śākhāyāṃ prayuktaḥ |
tatpradhā- natvāt śālāvākaraṇatvena śālāpradhānatvāt prācyādi- śabdasya |
śākhāyāṃ tatpradhānatvātpaveṣaṇa vibhāgaḥ syād vaiṣamyaṃ tat |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'mūlataḥ śālāṃ parivāsya upaveṣaṃ karoti' iti śrūyate |
atra chedanasya prayojakaṃ śālā upaveṣaṃ ubhayam, uta śāleva prayojikā upaveṣastu tadanu- niṣpādī iti vicāre siddhāntasūtram |
tatpradhānatvāt, śākhāṃ iti dvitīyā- śrutyā śākhāyāḥ prādhānyabodhanena parivāsanasya śālā- pradhānatvāt |
upaveṣaṇa tu parivāsanasya vibhāgaḥ syāt anvayo na syāt, tasya karotinā anvayāt |
tat etat śālopaveṣayoḥ vaiṣamyaṃ bhavati parivāsane anvayā- nanvayakṛtam |
tasmāt chedanaparaparyāyasya parivāsanasya śālā prayojikā, upaveṣastu anuniṣpannaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'mūlataḥ śālāṃ parivāsya upaveṣaṃ karoti' iti śrutam |
atra parivāsanena śālāyā evā- nvayaḥ na upaveṣasya ityuktaṃ siddhāntinā pūrvasūtre |
tatra śaṅkā, nanu mūlasyāpi śākhāvayavatvāt śākhāyā iva prādhānyamasti iti mūlataḥ parivāsya iti anvayaḥ syāt iti cenna, śrutyapāyāt |
śruteḥ avayavināṃ śākhāyāṃ śaktasya śākhāpasya avayavāt mūlāt apāyo bhavati |
tataśca mūlaṃ śākhāśabdena grahītuṃ na śakyate, nāpi tasya parivāsanenānvayaḥ |
tasmāt śāleva pari- vāsanasya prayojikā nopaveṣaḥ |
na ca tatra paurvā- paryamasti yena jñāyeta anayā śākhayā prathamaṃ vihite śākhāntarīye punaḥ śrutirbhūtvā metsyatīti |
āha ca 'śālānāṃ yugapada vṛttaṃ punaḥ śrutikalpanā |
svaśākhātyāgena paraśākhādhya- yanānupapatteḥ svaśākhādhyayanapūrvakaṃ medhāvitayā śākhānta- radhyayanaṃ yuktam |
yadi pratiśākhaṃ karmabhedaḥ syāt tata ekamūlābhāt ādita evā''rabhya midyamāna- tvāt samastakarmauyapuṣpaphalāntaratvāt vṛkṣāntaravat vedāntarāṇyevocceyan |
kacit kiṃci- dadhikaṃ ityālocya sārūpādyupapannaḥ śākhāntarabheda- vyapadeśaḥ |
śākhānta- rāṇi kāṭhakaṃ kālāpakaṃ paippalādaṃ taittirīyakaṃ tāṇḍakaṃ ityevamādīni |
śākhāntarāṇāṃ puruṣāntara prati prati- pādanena arthavattvam |
śākhāntare'pi hi ekaṃ śāstraṃ icchanti mīmāṃ- sakāḥ |
bhāṣyam-- iha śākhāntarāṇi udāharaṇaṃ kāṭhakaṃ kālāpakaṃ paippalādaṃ ityevamādīni |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimekasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ yat karma agnihotrādi śrūyate, tat śākhāntare punaḥ śrayamāṇaṃ midyeta tasmāduta midyeta ? midyeteti paśyāmaḥ |
evaṃ bhinnarūpaṃ kathamiha na kamaॅntaraṃ bhaviṣyati |
sa evaikaḥ kathaṃ nā''kāṅkṣeta, kathaṃ vā'nyadākāṅkṣatumiti |
yadi sarvaśākhāpratyayaṃ ekaṃ karma, ekasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ vihitasya karmaṇaḥ śākhāntare vacanaṃ punarupamanarthakaṃ syāt |
'prātaḥprātaranṛtaṃ te vadanti puroḍāśyā''hutiṃ ye'gnihotram, divākīrtyamadivā kīrtayantaḥ sūryo jyotirna tadā jyoti- reṣām' iti kecicchākhino'nuditahomaṃ nindanti |
yathā atithaye pradutā- yānnamāhareyustādṛk tad yadyadite juhuyāt' iti sarvaśākhā- pratyaye viruddham, na tu karmabhede |
keci- dāhuḥ, anna asmākamagniḥ parisamāpyate iti |
na hi tadeva tatra parisamāpyeta, anyatra na |
kecidanuditahomamitikrame prāyaścittamāmananti, keci- duditahomamitikrame, vyuḍhe ca prāyaścittam |
na ca karmabhede ubhayā vyuddhiḥ saṃbhavati |
karmabhede tu yadanudite homakarmma, tadudite vyuddhimatadapyanudite |
idaṃ śrūyate - 'yadi purā dīdīkṣāṇāḥ sūryyadi vaiṣāṃ gṛhapatiryeṣate- rvā'nusatriṇa iti, etameva bṛhatsāmānaṃ kratu- supeyurupetaṃ kṣopāṃ rathaṃtaram |
atha yadyadīkṣāṇāḥ ' iti iṣṭavatāmaniṣṭapūrvāṇāṃ ca dvādaśāhe darśanamupapadyate yadi karmabhedaḥ |
tāṇḍayake śrūyate 'eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānāṃ yajjyotiṣṭomo ya etenāniṣṭvā''nyena yajeta garte- patyameva tannāyate pra vā mīyate' iti |
'yatpakṣasaṃmitāṃ minuyātkanīyāṃsaṃ yaścakratumupeyātkanīyasīṃ praśnāṃ kanīyasaḥ paśūn kanīyo''nācca pāpīyān syāt |
atha yadi vediṃsamitāṃ minoti' iti pakṣasaṃmāne pratiṣiddhe vediṃsamānasya darśanaṃ bhavati |
katham ? eke hi samānamanti 'rathyākṣamātrāṇi yupāntarālāni bhavanti' iti |
tatra ca no pakṣasaṃmānaṃ no vediṃsamānaṃ syāt |
api ca sārasvate śrūyate 'ye puroḍāśinaste upavasanti |
api ca śrūyate 'upahavyo- niṣkaṭho'gniṣṭomo yajñaḥ, rathaṃtarasāmā''dhvaḥ |
upahavyo'niṛtha ukthyo yajño bṛhatsāmaḥ śvetaṃ rukmalalāṭo dakṣiṇā' |
nānā- karmatve tu anyo bṛhatsāmānyonyo rathaṃtarasāmeti yuktaṃ bhavati |
kathaṃ punaratra vedāntarāṇi nodāhriyante ? kartavya iti |
kutaḥ ? śākhāntare yathā karma eṣopandyastaḥ śākhāntarīyāṇāṃ guṇānāmekarmaṇyapasaṃhārā- kutrarūpaṃ pratīyate |
yatra hi karma nirākāṅkṣamāmnāyate gatādho'pi san prāyaścittabhedaḥ |
vaikalpi- śākhāsu darśapūrṇamāsajyotiṣṭomādīni samastadravyadevatā- keṣu ubhayathā'pyavaiguṇyaṃ bhavati |
atra ca prāyaścitta- diṣukttatvānyonyanirapekṣāṇi vidhīyante iti medākṣaṃ vidhānādubhayatrāpi vaiguṇyaṃ dṛśyate |
na ca tatkarmatve sahante na tvevaṃ vedāntare'pi |
parihārasūtraṇa pañcānātha- karmamātraṃ prastutya stotraśastrayājyāvākyādimātraṃ vidhī- darśanānuyyante |
yattu tatra atha na dīkṣitavantastato rathaṃtarasāmameveopajuriti |
tathā ca vakṣyati ‘bhūya- vacanena jyotiṣṭomāntarasya prāyamanīyame sati etaccha- svenobhayaśruti’ (a. 3 pā. 3 sū. 10) |
tatra ca prāyamanīyamādīkṣitānāṃ darśanaṃ na syāt |
tadyathā- kāṭhake'gnihotre kādaśinyāṃ pakṣevisamānayoryathāprāyorekaṃ ninditvetara- taittirīye'gnihotre idaṃ paṭhyate ityādi |
vaiśvānaradvādaśāṣṭavādi- kimekasya nindayā, kiṃ vetarasya sphuṭavidhāne sati vadābhikṣāyājinavacca na dvādaśaikadaśatvayoritaretara- stutyā |
tasānnyūnaṃ śākhāntarīya rayākṣamātrantarāla- saṃkrāntirūpapadyate iti guṇa eva mettā |

dve stotrīye śvamedheṣvapi bhūmibhojaneādakumbhāśrāddhāsa guṇā eva santa virāje daśakamatirivyate iti tisro''diricyante iti itikartavyatāsyānītyeva vādyataratvāt pūrvasmāt bhedeno- ca jyotiṣṭomātirātratve sati upapadyate |
‘pare'nyaṃ dharmamācaranti’ iti virodhiguṇā- tu yathāvidhi bhavatītyavirodhaḥ |
‘aśvapādāse’ iti pañcamyantaṃ madhye darśanaṃ dīkṣitādīkṣitasandehaineva gataṃ parihāraprakārānta- paṭhitamubhābhyāṃ saha saṃbadhyate |
sa ca prakṛtitaḥ prāptaḥ karmatve riti |
’ upahavyamede tu niyamārthāya punaḥ mapi uditānuditakālasaṃyogamedāt guṇa eva medakaḥ |
‘sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā’ iti hyanudite sūrye''bhidhīyamānamantraṃ jāyate |
yaḥ pūjāṃ pūjyāya prathamameva gṛhītvottiṣṭhate sa sādhuḥ |
yastvatikrāntaṃ vyāhatya pūja- yati nāsau samyakpūjakaḥ |
bhāṣyam— na naitadasti, yaduktam ‘śākhāntareṣu karmabhedaḥ’ iti |
tena tadeva karma sarvaśākhādhiṣṭhitaṃ vijñāte saṃkhyāvaśena vikalpasiddheḥ |
timedhāvitvādekavedāntāni śākhāntarāṇyapi adhīte sa samuddhaḥ san vrīhiyavairepi miśrayedyata |
parihṛtaṃ tad- sarvaśākhāpratyayamiti — ekasyāpi śākhāyāṃ brāha- granthanāmata iti |
atha yaduktaṃ karme'pi nāmasāmānā- ṇānatve'pi tadekaṃ karmetyabhiprāyaḥ |
saṃyoga kāṭhakādi, na karmasaṃyogāt granthaḥ kāṭhakaḥ |
rūpamiti — pratyā- gamyate ? yatkarma kāṭhakādisaṃyuktaṃ tankāṭhakādiśabdena saccedravyadevatām |
tenaivetarā- vā — yadyapi tāvat kāṭhakādikaṃ nāmadheyaṃ syāttathā- grahaṇāt |
yena hi pradeśāntare gṛhītakarma grahītaṃ vyutpattisaṃyogābhāvācca bhinnāt |
idaṃ tu naiva karma- bhavati sa eva tatsadṛśamanyopalabdhamānaḥ śaknoti nāmadheyam |
ekaśākhāviṣaye ca sarva- granthanāmatve sati karmaṇi lakṣaṇayaiva prayogopapatteḥ |
śākhāntare punaranyāsā- kathaṃ punaragamyate granthanāmatvaṃ karmanāmatve na puna- gatajyotiṣṭomādyanyathādupapūrvavadadhyayamāneṣu na medabuddhi- viparyaye iti |
yattarhi dve śāstre paṭhati tasya prakaraṇāntara- karmāvabodhanam |
yujyate karmanānātvaikaśākho- nyāyena bhavitavyamekaśākhāgatatve tu brāhmaṇāntareṣu |
sa yadi karmanāma syāttvāntare kāraṇam ? svādhyāyagrahaṇenaikā śākhā hi pari- na prayujyeta |
yathaiva ākṛtiḥ prativyakti samavaiti tathaiva cchākhayaiva karmāṇi lakṣyante na karmabhiḥ śākhāḥ |
ataśca ‘svādhyāyo- saṃjñayā kāmaṃ śākhā eva bhidyantāṃ na karmāṇi |
śākhāntareṣu tvanyonya- bhāṣyam— yadi śabdabhede'pi bhavet, śabda- nirapekṣatvānnajyotiṣṭomādirūpapattītestulyārthatvanimitto kyācciddharmaikyaṃ bhavet |
pratyabhijñānamekatve vā — prāyeṇa hetuviṣaye kāryaviparyayo dṛśyate iti kāṭhakādisaṃjñaikatvādekaśākhāyātāgnihotrādeḥ ekatva- prasaṅgaḥ |
sarvatra ca duṣṭe pūrvapakṣe jātīnāmuttaratvaṃ keṣāṃcidiṣṭam|
yataḥ prabhṛti kaṇṭhasthaṃ prakṛtaṃ vacanaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti pravṛttam |
pūrve nā''siddheda idānīṃ bheda iti viruddham |
yadyapi kāṭhāderjatitanityatvāt nityatvā'''khyā tathā'pi pravacananimittaṃ smaryate na ca karmāṇi procyante |
bhāṣyam— ekakarmatve'pi rūpabhedo bhavati vaca- nāt |
na ca vācanike rūpabhede'satyāpi bhedadvau karmeṇo medo'dhyavasīyate |
bhāṣyam— atha yo dharmaviśeṣa ukto vidyā- grahaṇāryaḥ sa na karmaṇa upakārakaḥ |
bhāṣyam— atha yaduktaṃ- yathā''māsyāyā- māgneyasya punaruktadoṣānmadhye pakṣo nirastaḥ, evamaya- mapi tasmādeva doṣātkarmatvapakṣo nirastavyaḥ iti |
sa evā- yamarthaḥ punaḥ āvito'gnihotrādirbahubhistu puruṣaiḥ |
yadi bhavet, ekasminneva vede bahubhirucyamāne bhavet |
kutaḥ ? ' ekaśākhānibaddhānāṃ jñāyate hi punaḥ śrutiḥ |
pūrvoktaṃ hi śākhādhyayanavikalpena yena kāṭhakamagnihotraṃ śrutaṃ nāsau kadācittaittirīyakaṃ śṛṇoti |
śṛṇvannapi vā śākhādyeva pratipadyatvāt taittirī- yakrapaṭhitārthyameveti kalpayitvā na punaḥśruti manyate |
na ca tatra paurvāparyamasti yena jñāyate'nayā śākhāntarīya punaḥśrutirbhavatyetyeveti |
tasmādyathaikaśākhākarma deśāntarapuruṣādiṣu punaḥ śrūyamāṇamapi pratipādyamedāt punaruktaṃ bhavatyevaṃ śākhāntare'pi |
nanu caikasyāpi śākhyā samastapuruṣapratipādane sati, anarthakameva śākhāntaram |
na ca puruṣāntaragataṃ tatprati- pādanenārthavadvān prayatnārthaṃ bhavati |
yastu te'pi kila śāstrinastāgevādhītya pratipadyante ityabhiprāyaḥ sa niyatatvāt vedasya tadadhyayanāpasaṃbaṃdhanatvāt
śākhāṃ śākhāntaraṃ yuktaṃ nādhyetuṃ sadṛśe śrame |
' tasmātparakīyaśākhādhyayane apyasyaiva puruṣāṇāṃ śrama iti yathāsthitaśākhādhyayana- meva |
vā-- atrāntare bhāṣyakārasya sūtraṃ bhraṣṭam 'vākyā- samavāyāt' iti |
na caikaikasyāṃ kṛtsnaṃ guṇakāṇḍaṃ saṃnihitamityarthāsaṃnidheḥ naikekasyāṃ kṛtsnaṃ guṇakāṇḍaṃ saṃnihitamityarthāsaṃnidheḥ śākhādyevopapattiḥ |
' yadi pratiśākhaṃ karmabhedaḥ syāttata ekamulābhātrā- dādita evā''rabhya bhidyamānatvāt samastakarmapuṣpa- phalāntaratvāt vṛkṣāntaravadedāntarāyevetyevam |
ekakarmatvavidhiścakurupatve savitikartavya- tāyāḥ kaściccidādidamityālocya sārūpādyupapannaḥ śākhāntaramedyapadeśaḥ |
tatra nāma punaruktā bhavati yatra pūrvo- kto'rthastasyaiva puṃsaḥ saṃnihito bhavati |
bhāṣyam-- na ca yatkāṭhake'gnihotraṃ tatkāṭhaka- maitrakaṃ puruṣaṃ prati vidhīyate |
satyapi karmamede ye tāvadvākyasaṃyuktāḥ śeṣāste'gnihotrādimātrādeśena vidhī- yamānāḥ : sarvārthatvena jñāyante ityavaṣopādātmānyā iti naiva śākhāmāntraparitoṣavyavā labhyate |
na ca sūtra- kārāṇāmapi kaścitsvaśākhopasaṃhāramātreṇavasthito yena pratiśākhaṃ karmavyavasthā samarthyeta |
pradhānanyāpi prādhā- nyena yajamānaniyamaṃ prati, aprabhavantībhiḥ samākhyā- bhirarthamātramuddiśya vidhīyamānāni sarvaśākhāgatāntyekāṃ puruṣamupatiṣṭhante |
tatraikaphalavadamucyate yena kenaci- tsādhyamāne phale'nyeṣāṃ vaiyarthyaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha teṣāṃ vikalpenārthavattvam, tadare śākhāntarāṇāmeva vyavasthita- pratipadyamānānāmānākulatvaṃ parikalpyamityapunaruktā |
bhāṣyam— atra asmākamapiḥ parisamāpyate ityu- tprekṣitāro bhavanti |
anvāroheṣu maitrāyaṇīyānāmapiḥ parisamāpyate, asmākaṃ teṣu na parisamāpyate iti |
yadyanyadeva maitrāyaṇīyānāmeva teṣāma, kathaṃ te brūya- revasmākaṃ na parisamāpyate iti |
karmedapakṣe hi yathā yāvadeva yeṣāṃ samāpnaṃ tāvadeva teṣāṃ samāpyate iti na brūyarāsmākaṃ na samāpyate iti |
teṣu maitrāyaṇīyānāṃ samāpyate na asmākamitimidhānādyeṣṭāmapi karmatvaṃ prasiddha- mityavasīyate |
bhāṣyam— na hi nindā nindituṃ nindituṃ prayujyate |
tatra na nindi- tasya pratiṣedho gamyate, kiṃ tvitarasya vidhiḥ |
tatra ekasmin agnihotre dvau kālau vihitau vikalpyate |
samarthānāṃ tu sarvaśākhāmyo- 'pyyāmitamavikaṃ vidhimupasaṃhartuṃ śaktirastīti tenaiva- karmetye'pi na viruddhamiti |
tathaikaminapi karmaṇi kiṃcidastu samāptamiti kṛtvā samāptiśabdaḥ prayujyate |
yathā ādhvaryave samāpte jyotiṣṭomasya, samāpto jyoti- ṣṭoma iti bhavati |
vā-- anyonyanindyetarataravidhāne tulyārthayordi- tānuditatvayoḥ karmaṇi vikalpo bhaviṣyati |
ya eva kila vākyasaṃyuktāḥ śākhāntaravidhayasta eva saṃkīryante ye tu prākaraṇikā- steṣāṃ vyavastheti |
' śākhāntareṣu vikalpamāneṣu yathaiva pradhānaṃ vidhīyate'rthinastadīyaṃ : kathaṃbhāvastāmeva prāpnoti na śākhāntarāṇi |
ataścānyagatāḥ guṇāḥ kathaṃ- bhāvena nāpekṣitāḥ prayogavacanenānūpasṛṣṭatā nāṅgaṃ bhava- nīti nānujñeyaḥ |
tasyānyatrāpi tādṛśyaṃ prāptaṃ kena nivā- ryate ||
' prativedampi ca prakaraṇaṃ puruṣasya dharmānupa- diśati |
na ca tadvedāntarasthaṃ prayamapramāṇam, tathā śākhāntare'pi draṣṭavyam |

yadyapi prakaraṇarūpamantrasthatāpi śākhāntaranyāyena eta'pi dharmā gṛhītā ityavadhāraṇāt svaprakaraṇyahītebhyo viśiṣyante sarvāṇu api ca śākhāsu adhikavidhayo na kathaṃ- cicchaktyā parimitā bhavantītya evā''ma iti nāśaktiḥ |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktam- uditahomasyāpi prāya- ścittānāṃ vyudatā gamyate, anuditahomasyāpi |
naiṣa doṣaḥ 'udite hoṣyāmi' iti prakrānte'nyathā kriya- māṇe bhavati doṣaḥ |
tatra prāyaścittasya viṣayo bhaviṣyati iti karmabheda'pi na doṣaḥ |
tena yadā sāṃnāyyena ( yadā sāṃnāyyena iti |
ayamāśayaḥ - mitrāvaruṇayo- rathanāsye sārasvatasatre ' yathā'māvāsyāyāmatirātraḥ syāccātyā dīkṣeran |
te pakṣamāvāsyāmeva vrajitvā paurṇa- māsyāṃ gāmupeyuḥ |
evamāvartanto vrajeyuḥ ' ityanena vākyena pratimāmamekasminpakṣe paurṇamāsāmāvāsyābhya- karmavidhānātpuroḍāśavidheḥ paurṇamāsāyāvaśyakarmopayogi- pakṣopalakṣaṇārthe |
vā - sārasvate hi dvādaśāhanyāyenobhayoḥ pakṣayo- jyotiṣṭomapūrvatvakatvādvakṣyamevaṃ vaktavyam |
yadā puro- ḍāśinaḥ paurṇamāsīpakṣe tadoṣasanta, yadā sāṃnāyyano- 'māvāsyāpakṣe tadā vatsānapākurvantīti |
bhāṣyam - atha yaduktam, upahanye bṛhadrathatara- vidhānaṃ prakṛtiprāptameva |
bhāṣyam - yadā rathaṃtarāmā tadā, advavaḥ iveto dakṣiṇā, yadā bṛhatsāmā tadā rathamlalāṭa iti |
vā - saṃkhyāvyavasthāyāṃ vā bṛhadrathatarayoḥ punaḥśruti- rbhaviṣyati |
bhāṣyam - yadā na sarvaśākhāpratyamekaṃ karmeti, kathamekasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ samāmnāyate anyasyāṃ guṇe vidhī- yate |
yathā maitrāyaṇīyānāṃ samidādayaḥ prajāyā na samā- mnāyante |
atha ca guṇāḥ śrūyante - 'ṛtavo vai prajāḥ samānīya hotavyāḥ' iti |
tathā yeṣāṃ śākhinām, kuṭūrasi, ityaramādānamantro nā''mnātasteṣāmapi hi dṛśyate - 'kukkuṭo'sītyadamānamupādhatte, kuṭūrasīti vā' iti |
vā - śākhāntaravihitaprayājānuvādena saha homaṃ vadan anyaśākhādhītaṃ ca 'kuṭūrasi' iti mantramadmā- dāne vidadhatsarvaśākhāpratyayatvaṃ darśayati |
bhāṣyam - yo hyanyaśākhāvyavasthitān vidhīnupa- saṃharati, sa svaśākhāvihitaṃ kramamupagṛhṇāti |
tathā sati hi karmabhedaṃ na yāsyanti svaśākhāvihitāḥ kriyāḥ |
virodhino tvasaṃyogādekakarmye tatsaṃyogā- dvidhīnāṃ sarvakarmapratyayaḥ syāt |
naiṣa śākhāntaravihitānāmeka- karmye sati virodhinaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
tasmāt sarvaśākhāpratyayaṃ sarvabrāhmaṇapratyayaṃ caikaṃ karma codyate iti siddhaṃ bhavati |
vā - yatra śmātāḥ padārthā na kramakālaparimāṇu- rodhena bādhitāstatra śra
durbalapramāṇaka - anārambhītāśākhāntaravihitayāvadaṅga- kalāpasaṃbandhottaraṃ prayogavidhisaṃpratyakṣīkāreṇaiva tat iti śākhāntarādhikaraṇe vakṣyate |
śākhāntara- nīyayoḥ : uditānuditahomayoḥ : aindrāgmekādaśakapāla- dvādaśakapālayoḥ samavikalpaḥ sarvān prati iti śākhā- ntarādhikaraṇe vārtikam, na khamataṃ kiṃtu paramatam |
bāla. pṛ. 91. spaṣṭasyāpi sāmānyavacanasya yatra nāna- rthakyaṃ tatra viśeṣopasaṃhārābhyupagamāt na doṣaḥ |
śākhāntarādhikaraṇavārtike uditānuditahomayoḥ tathā aindrāgmekādaśakapāla-dvādaśakapālayoḥ śākhāntarīyayoḥ samavikalpaḥ sarvān prati ityuktam ( 2|4|2 ) |
tatparamataṃ na khamatam, śrutiliṅgādhikaraṇe anekavidha- bādhanirūpaṇe svayameva vārtikakṛtā paraśākhāvihitaṃ svaśākhāvihitatvena bādhyate ityuktam |
svaśākhāvihitasya svādhyāyavyayanajanitasya karmaṅga- tvāt tatsaṃbhave itaraśākhāśeṣāt |
svaśākhā'vihitaviruddhaikakalpiksya tu śanaiḥ śākhā- ntarādhyayanajanitamapi karmaṇā sādṛguṇyāya ākṣipyate eva |
śākhāntarādhikaraṇanyāyena gṛhagatapārśvaṇa- sthālīpākādyabheda'pi pūrvapakṣe taddeśeṣu vidhipāṭhavyavasthayā vyavasthitamūlakatvasya puruṣārthavidhitva āvaśyakanityā- nyāyasubodhakammuktam |
(abhi- prāyeṣu meṣapattiyāṃ meṣapatye ' ityatra na tāvadatra śākhābhedena mantrabhedaḥ ekadeśavai lakṣaṇye'pi śākhāntarā- dhikaraṇanyāyena prathamiśratvena tadekatvāvagateḥ |

śākhāntarādhikaraṇasamāptau 'avivā krama- saṃyogāt vidhipṛthaktvamekasyāṃ vyavasthitaṃ ' ( 2|4| 2|32) iti sūtreṇa kramakālaparimāṇavirodhatvāt śākhā- ntarīyapadārthānāmupasaṃhāramādakṣaya ' virodhinārthasaṃyogā- dekadharmyaṃ tatsaṃyogād vidhīnāṃ sarvakarmapratyayaḥ : ( 'virodhino- tvasaṃyogādaikamyaṃ tatsaṃyogāt vidhīnāṃ sarvakarmapratyayaḥ syāt' iti bhā-pāṭhaḥ) iti sūtreṇa padārthānāṃ kramādi- bādhakatvaṃ vakṣyate |
śākhāntarādhikaraṇasiddhasarvajñopasaṃhārānukalpa- vidhiḥ ' bahulpaṃ vā svagṛhyoktaṃ yasya yāvat praco- ditam |
tasya tāvati śākhārthe kṛte sarvaḥ kṛto bhavet ||
atra gṛhyasūtrasya svaśabdena viśeṣaṇāt pāraṃparyā- gata-ekagṛhyasūtrādhyayana-niyamapratīteḥ |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? 'svādhyāyagrahaṇe naikā śākhā hi pari- gṛhyate ' yathaiva ākṛtiḥ prativyakti samavaiti tathaiva svādhyāyatvaṃ ekaikasyāṃ śākhāyām |
atrasya ' svādhyāyo- 'dhyetavyaḥ' iti karmāvabodhanaṃ prati upādīyamānatvāt vivakṣitaikasaṃkhyeyā śākhā'dhyetavyā |
nanu evaṃ vedā- ntarasyāpi adhyayanaṃ na prasajyate |
tathā ‘ vedānadhītya vedī vā ' iti mānavam |
na hi kaścit dve śāstre adhīte |
śākhāntaṃ śākhāntaraṃ yuktaṃ nādhyetuṃ sadṛśe śrame ||
śākhāntara- nyāyena ( 2|4|2|8-33 ) eka eva viśvajit vākyadyena vidhīyate iti na āgūṇaviśvajitaḥ asya ( sābhyutthānaviśvajitaḥ ) bhedaḥ |
adhyayanasya upanayanādīnāṃ ca śākhāntaranyāye- naiva abhedāvagamāt tadjñānāmapi sarvapupasādhā- raṇyopapattiḥ |

1|3|17|16, upanayanādīnāṃ tadjñānāṃ ca śākhālarūpe ānarthakyena adhyayane eva avidhva- nirvṛttatvena upayogasya dvādaśe vakṣyamāṇatvāt tasya (adhyayanavidheḥ) śākhāntarādhyāyena ekatvāvagamena medenā- 'grāhitayogāḥ |
'bahulpaṃ vā svagṛhyoktaṃ' ityasya śākhāntaranyāya- siddhasarvajñopasaṃhāraśakto anukalpatvena svagṛhyoktamātrā- nuṣṭhānabodhakatvam |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayorāmananti 'saha śākhyā prastaraṃ praharati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ śākhāpraharaṇaṃ pratipattirkramaṃ, uta arthakarmeti |
yogo'syāḥ samānaḥ prastareṇa 'saha śākhyā prastaraṃ praharati' iti |
sahayogo yatra tṛtīyā tasya guṇabhāvaḥ, yatra dvitīyā tasya prādhānyam |
śākhā'pi tasminneva yajñau prastarasya viśeṣaṇam, samānayogitvāt |
āha, nanu tatratatra guṇabhūtā śālā, tasyāḥ pratipattinyāyā, itarathā anekaguṇabhāvaḥ prasa- jyeteti |
utpattyā cikīrṣitasya śeṣabhūtānyeva dravyāṇi upadiśyante bhūta bhavyāyopadiśyate iti |
ekastāvat ubhayapi pradhānabhūto ( yathā devadatto yajñadattena saha pūjayitavyaḥ iti ) |
aparaḥ dvāvapi guṇabhūto ( yathā devadattena saha śivikāṃ vahati iti ) |
anyaḥ ( prakāraḥ ) ekaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ itaro guṇabhūta iti ( yathā ṛtvigbhiḥ saha yajamānaḥ kratuṃ karoti iti tathā ihāpi sahabhāve satyapi prastarasya prādhānyaṃ śākhāyāśca guṇatvaṃ nānupapannam ) |
'saktuvākena prastaraṃ praharati' iti saktuvāko na prastaraṃ prakāśayati, nāpi praharaṇakriyām |
tasmāt yadena prakāśayate tat kriyayā saṃbadhyate, tena ca āyurādīni prakā- śyante, ihāśca devatāḥ |
ataḥ āyurādīni phalāni etasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ, agnyādayaśca devatāḥ |
dravyoddeśamantareṇa devatā bhavanti, na ca āyurādīni yāgamantareṇa phalāni bhavanti ( iti na praharaṇamātrasya saṃskārakarmaṇaḥ phalasaṃbandho yuktaḥ |
yasmānna dravyoddeśa- mantareṇa devatā'nvayaḥ ) tasmāt prastaraḥ pratipādya- māno'pi dravyatāṃ pratipadyate |

( yasmāt agnyadayo devatāḥ, prastaraśca dravyam, āyurādīni ca phalāni ) tasmāt dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena yajidhātuḥ anumīyate, phalavān haratistu śruto'pi avivakṣitaḥ nirvapatitat ( sauryai caruṃ nirvapet ityādiāva ) |

( ayaṃ praharatiḥ yajiḥ iti siddhe pūrvapakṣamāha- ) iha ( yāge sahabhāvaḥ śāstrapratyayoḥ śrūyate, tataśca ) sahabhāve śrute yat tṛtīyānirdiṣṭam ( śākhādravyam ), tat sādhakatamatvenaiva saṃcavyate, pramāṇāntareṇa prādhānyā- navagamāt |
yasya hi pramāṇāntareṇa ( yāgaṃ prati ) prādhānyamavagatam, tat ( tṛtīyāpattamāpi ) kriyā nirvarta- yat ātmārthameva nirvartayati ( iti śakyaṃ vaktum |
natu sahabhāvāt dvayostulyatvāvagamāt kathamekasya prādhā- nyam, itarasya tu guṇatvam ? ata āha- ) kriyā- nirvṛttau ca sahabhāva upapadyate |

yadi tṛtīyā na śrūyeta ( kintu vibhaktyantaram 'prastareṇa saha śākhyā praharati' iti ), tataḥ yāgaṃ niṣpādayet api ( śākhyā ) pratipattaryā syāt prastaravat ( prastarasya hi dvitīyā- saṃyogāt yāgāṃśe guṇabhūtasyāpi praharaṇāṃśaṃ prati prādhānyamasti tadvat ) |
ata āha ( bhāṣyakāraḥ ) 'sahayoge yatra tṛtīyā, tasya guṇabhāvaḥ, yatra dvitīyā, tasya prādhānyam' iti |
kṛtārthā satī ( śākhyā ) pratipadyate iti cet, tatra |
( na khalu ekasya anekaguṇabhāvaḥ ucita iti |
kutaḥ ? ) darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ( ubhayoḥ ) prakaraṇe śravaṇāt ( ubhayāṅga- midam 'saha śākhyā prastaraṃ praharati' iti |
tataḥ kim ? ata āha- ) paurṇamāsyāṃ na pratipattiḥ ( śākhyāyāḥ tata akṛtārthatvāt ) prastarastu ubhayatrāpi akṛtārthaḥ ( tena tasya pratipattiḥ |
etacca atiśayārthamuktam, kṛtārthā api tṛtīyātvena guṇabhāva upapādita eva ) |
tasmāt yatra tṛtīyā ( śālāyām ), sā atyanta-
na ca ekatra ( amāvāsyāyām ) pradhāna- bhūtā, aparatra ( paurṇamāsyām ) guṇabhūtā, ( iti ) vivakṣāmedāt ( vairūpyāpatteḥ ) |
nanu anyatraiva sā dvitīyā prastare, na śākhāyām |
evaṃ prastaraḥ grahato bhavati, yadi śākhā'pi prahite |
yadi prastaraḥ praharaṇam, śākhā'pi prastaraviśeṣaṇam, na tarhi tulyayogaḥ |
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? dṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ hitvā adṛṣṭaṃ kalpyeta |
kṛta- prayojanāyāḥ śālāyā apanayanena vedivivecanāt sula- pracāro dṛṣṭaṃ kāryam, na tu praharaṇe kiñcit sūkṣmamapi dṛṣṭamasti |
nanu tṛtīyāśravaṇāt parārthena śāloccāraṇena bhavituṃ nyāyyam |
tataḥ prastarasya kālaparicchedāya kīryamānā parārthā uccāryeta |
tasmāt satyapi tṛtīyāśravaṇe prastara eva śālāyāḥ kālaṃ paricchetsyati |
dup-- praharatī yadi ubhāvapi tulyau tataḥ sahabhāva upapadyate |
prastarasya ca ( tatra ) pratipattiḥ, ( ataḥ ) śākhāyā api ( pratipattiḥ ) |
tatra aniyatakāle praharaṇe prāpte 'saha praharati' iti vidhīyate |
evam ( pratipatteḥ ) apekṣitatvāt nādṛṣṭakalpanā ( kṛtā bhavati ) |
( kutaḥ ityata āha-) prahiyamāṇa- yośca yat niśitakālam, tat itarasya ( aniśita- kālasya ) kālaṃ prayacchat vastuto guṇabhūtam, kriyāyā- stutyatvāt |
( evaṃ prati- pattisādhane paryavasite śākhā prastaravat yāge guṇabhūtā uta neti jijñāsāyāmāha-) anayośca praharaṇe eva sāhityam, nānumite yāge, śākhāyāḥ tatrāśravaṇāt |

pratyakṣeṇa pradīyamāne'pi ( śākhāyāḥ pradāne kriyamāṇe- 'pi ) yathā maitrāvaruṇagrahe ( 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti' iti vihite saṃskāre miśrībhūtam ) payaḥ pratyakṣeṇa hūyamānamapi na yāgasādhanam, evaṃ śākhā praharatinā saṃbadhyamānā'pi na yāgasya sādhikā iti siddham |
iha ca śākhyā anya- syārthasya kṛtatvāt vatsāpakaraṇadādeḥ |
arthāgrahaṇāddhi bhavet tat punaḥ punarabhi- yamānaṃ bahu manyante eva |
kiṃ cintāyāḥ prayojanam ? yadi arthakarma, paurṇamāsyāmapi śākhā utpādyā, atha pratipattirnopādīyateti |
śā-- ' tatra prastaratulyatvāt śākhā yāgasya sādhanam |
' tasmāt śākhāpraharaṇaṃ homaḥ : arthakarma dravya- karmasaṃyoganyāyāt ( 6|1|1 ) |
' yāge yadi sahatvaṃ syāt syādeva haratau tu tat |
tatra ca pratipādyatvāt prastarasya tathaiva sā |
soma- paurṇamāsādiṣu śākhā nāhartavyā ila- yuktam |
sūtrārthastu- praharaṇe'pi homa eva syāt sahaśabdena juhotisādhanaprastareṇa yāgasādhyāvagamāt dravyāṇāmarthakriyā prati dravyakarmasaṃyoganyāyena śeṣatvācceti |
vi- ' prastaraṃ śākhāyā sārdha praharet pravṛtti- stiyam |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tato naiva dhṛtiḥ śākhāṃ yojayet |
' bhāṭṭa- anaiva ' sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati ' iti ' saha śākhyā prastaraṃ praharati ' iti ca śrutam |
tatra ādyavākye tāvat māntravarṇikadevatāsaṃśrayāt homa- vidhirityuktam |
na tu dvitīyavākyavihitapraharaṇāṇu- vādena prastaramuddiśya sūktavākavihiti tantrasāroktaṃ yuktam, yāgasyāpi vidhau vākyabhedāpatteḥ |
ataśca dvitīyavākye praharatinā homamanūdya śākhāsāhityamātravidhiḥ, saha- śabdasya nipātatvena parasparānvayayuktatvena na śākhā sāhityaṃ ceti vidheyānekatā |
ataśca yathaiva home prastaro guṇabhūtaḥ evaṃ śākhā'pi |
tatra tu etāvān viśeṣaḥ, prastarasya dvitīyayā prakṣepārtha prati pratipādyatvāvagamānna tyāgāṃśaḥ tasyākṣepaḥ ityuktam |
śākhāyāstu vatsā- pākaraṇādiva guṇatvasyaivāvagateḥ prastarahomaḥ prayojakaḥ eveti paurṇamāsyāmapi tadarthe śālotpādanīyā |
iti prāpte, ādyavākye sūktavākānuvādena praharatinā homalakṣaṇāyāmapi dvitīyavākye praharatinā tallakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt praharaṇasya śākhāsāhityasaṃbandhamātra kriyate |
ataśca yathaiva praharaṇaṃ prati prastarasya kṛtārthasya saṃskāryatvam, tathā śākhāyāḥ, kṛtārthatvā- viśeṣāt |
na ca tṛtīyayā tasyāḥ karaṇatvāvagatiḥ, sahaśabdayogena tasyāḥ phalaṇatvānabhidhāyakatvāt |

ata eva prastarapraharaṇakālaviśiṣṭapraharaṇattarasya śālo- ddeśonātra vivakṣitatayā vidhānam, na tu prastarapraharaṇa- vyatirekeṇa śāloddeśena viniyogaḥ, tathātve yathāśākhi- prayogadau prastarābhāve'pi śākhāpraharaṇāpatteḥ |
ataśca pratipattitvāt praharaṇamapi na śākhāyāḥ prayojakam |
yathā tu prastara- praharaṇavyākhyāveva śākhāyā na guṇatvaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhe vakṣyate |
śākhābhedena āmnāto ekavacanānta-bahuvaca- nāntapāśamantrau jyotiṣṭome amīṣṭomīya eva vikalpena paṭhanīyau, na tu bahuvacanasya paṣṭhaguṇo utkarṣaḥ |
[ vi. 9|3|6- śākhābhedena samāmnātānāṃ gītyupāyānāṃ viśleṣādīnāṃ vikalpaḥ |
9|2|7|29. mīko. pṛ. 1568 ' gītyupāyānāṃ viśleṣādīnāṃ-' ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
śākhāmānuṣakarūpārthānuṣṭhānaṃ asiṣyaje na kārya- miti siddhāntaḥ |
datraṃ ' prācīmāharet ' iti palāśavṛkṣasya prāgantā śākhā lakṣyate |
' ( śākhāyāṃ tatpradhānatvātpadevibhāgāḥ syād vaipamyaṃ tat ' ityagrimasūtrasya prathamabhāgaṃ pṛthak kṛttvaiva prathamavarṇakamidamitibhāṣyamiti jñeyam |
tathā somanāthī- ' idaṃ na pṛthak sūtram, kiṃtu agrimasūtrā- vayava eva adhikaraṇāntaratvena bhāṣye vyākhyātaḥ ityāhuḥ ' iti ) |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate śākhāmadhikṛtya ' prācīmāharet, udīcīmāharet, prāgudīcīmāharet '
iti ( prācyāḥ udīcyāśca diśoryadantarālaṃ sā prāgu- dīcī |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimayaṃ digvādaḥ, uta śākhāvāda iti |
kutaḥ ? yadi tāvadayamarthaḥ ' prācī dik āhartavyā ' iti, tataḥ aśakyaḥ arthaḥ |
atha prācīṃ diśaṃ prati āharaṇīyati, tataḥ kā āhartavyeti, vākye śākhāśabdasya abhāvāt anupapanno'yaṃ saṃbandhaḥ |
atha prakṛtā śākheti, tataḥ prācīśabdena etāmi- saṃbandho nyāyyaḥ |
kutaḥ ? prakṛtā hi prācīśabdena harateḥ ekavākyatā prakaraṇāt śākhāśabdena bhavet |
ubhayathā atra prācīśabde lakṣaṇayā prakṛtāṃ vā śākhāṃ lakṣyate, diśo vā anopasthitatvāt vihāradeśaṃ īpsitatamaṃ yuktam |
saṃbandhaśabdaśca sarve sāpekṣaḥ, vinā padāntareṇa na paripūrṇamarthamabhi- vadanti |
sāmānyapadārthasaṃbandhe ca saṃvyavahārānupapattiḥ, sarvasyaiva deśasya kutaścit prāgbhāvāt |
tathā śākhā- śabdo'pi saṃbandhaśabdaḥ ' vṛkṣasya ' ityetadapekṣate |
yadā ' vṛkṣasya ' ityetadapekṣate, tadā vṛkṣasya śākhā prācī udīcī prāgudīcī vā iti bhavati saṃbandhaḥ |
aśakya- tvāt prācīṃ diśaṃ prati āhartavyati, tathāpi vākye āhiyamāṇaśāśravaṇāt sākāṅkṣaṃ vākyam |
ayonyeta prādeśe āhartavyati, dvitīyāsthāne saptamī ( kalpyate ), evaṃ aśruto deśaḥ anīpsitaśca ( parigṛhītaḥ syāt ) |
kiṃca prākuśabde''ya saṃbandhaśabdatvāt avadhimapekṣate kasya prācīmiti |
tasmāt prācī ityanena yat īpsitaṃ taducyate ( dvitīyāsaṃyogāt ) |
tacca ( prācīpadaṃ ) āharateḥ karma pūrvaprakṛtāṃ śākhāṃ śaknoti vaditum ( lakṣayitum ) |
kasya vṛkṣasya iti avadhimātramapekṣaṇī- yam, na kiṃcidanyat |
( bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe- ) ' prakṛtāṃ vā śākhāṃ lakṣyate, diśo vā anīpsitatvāt vihāradeśaṃ īpsitatamaṃ yuktam ' ( iti bhāṣye ) diśo vā anīpsitatvāt ityaṃ hetuḥ |
yasmāt dignīpsitā, tasmāt vihāradeśaṃ vā lakṣyate śākhāṃ vā |
śā- ' śrutyā digvacanaḥ śabdaḥ śākhāyāṃ lakṣaṇā bhavet |
' soma- yūpadādavat prācīśabdasyāpi na lakṣaṇā iti pratyavasānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- prācīśabdaḥ śākhāyāṃ syāt tadavadhānatvāt tataḥ prakṛtatvena prācī- śabdasya tatradhānatvāt iti |
vi- ' prācīmāharatītyatra dik śākhā vā'stu, dikśruteḥ |
āhartavyaṃ diśo nāsti śākhā tenopa- lakṣyate |
' bhāṭṭa- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śākhāmadhikṛtya ' prācī- māharati ' iti śrutam |
tatra prācīśabdastāvat digvi- śeṣavācī ' prācīmudeti savitā ' iti prayogāt |
ataścopa- kramyapratipādike lakṣaṇepekṣayā varaṃ dvitīyaiva saptamyathe vyākhyātuṃ yuktā |
karmāpekṣāyāṃ na prakṛtatvadeva śākhā tattvena saṃbadhyate |
prādeśasya ca pūrvottaravadhapekṣāyāṃ pratyakṣopasthitatvāt sāmarthyācca vanavihāradeśastattvena saṃbadhyate |
tena vanāt vihāropa- lakṣitaprācīṃ prati śākhāmāharati vākyārthaḥ |
tathātve chinnaiti syāt, na tu āharati |

iti prāpte, pradhānabhūtavibhaktau lakṣaṇayāḥ pratiśabdādhyāhārasya vā karmādyāhārapūrvottarāvadhyā- hārasaṅgatasya kalpanā'pekṣā ekasmin pratipadike eva prakṛtaśākhālakṣaṇāyā vākyārthopatteḥ, prākṛtasya ca vṛkṣavayavaviśeṣarūpaśākhātvenaiva upasthitavṛkṣāvadhika-
tena vṛkṣasya prāgdeśabhavāṃ prācīṃ śākhāṃ chittvā āharatītyarthaḥ |
śākhāvailakṣaṇyamātreṇa karmavailakṣaṇyāyogāt ameda evāvasīyate na bhedaḥ |
śabdaṃ eva akṣatvena atideśārham, na svārthi- kam |
caturthentu-pañcahetumantrayoḥ haviṣāṃ spardhane (darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ) kālabhedena vyavasthā ārthikī, na śābdī |
śrutavākyapratī yamānānvayānupapatti- saṃdhānena tadupapatteḥ ākāṅkṣitasyānyānvayasya tadbodha- kena vākyenaiva samarpaṇasya yuktatvāt 'śabdaḥ śabdena anveti' iti nyāyāt |
su. pṛ. 1193, śabdave vyavahāre śābdasyaiva prādhānyasya vivakṣitatvāt saṃbandhasyaiva vimaktyā uktatvena pratyayārthatayā śabdataḥ prādhānyāt phalahetutā yuktā ('dandhendrikāmasya ' ityatra) |
pṛ. 851, śābde vyavahāre śraute vākyīye vā pratī- tyākhyasaṃnidhivat yogyatvapekṣayorapi anvayākhyagrahaṇa- kāraṇatvāt na pratītimātreṇa karaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇapattiḥ |
evakāreṇa śābdī parisaṃkhyā iti miśrāḥ yathā 'vrīṇi ha vai yajñasyodarāṇi gāyatrī bṛhatthuṣṭup ca atra hovācapanti ata evodapanti' iti |
pravartanā- preraṇā- vidhi- aparaparyāyabhūtā bhāvanā narahitavākye liḍādyarthaḥ |
saiva ca śabda- niṣṭhatvāt vede śābdī bhāvanā ityucyate |
tasyāśca śabdabhāvanāyāḥ arthabhāvanādeva aṃśatrayaṃ iti vyava- haranti |
tatra pravṛttittiniścayoḥ yathākramaṃ vidhiniṣedha- prayojyatvāt puṣyārthānubandhitvācca bhāvyatvam |
asya ca karaṇatvena vyavahāramātraṃ na tu tasya śābdatve karaṇatvena anvayaḥ aśābdatvāt |
evaṃ prāśastyāprāśa- styajñānaṃ yathākramaṃ vidhiniṣedhayoḥ itikartavyatā |
tadapi vastuta eva, na tu śābdagoṣṭhe anvayaḥ aśā- bdatvādaiva |
te ca prāśastyāprāśastye tattadvidhiniṣedha- saṃnidhipaṭhitārthavādaiḥ lakṣaṇayā pratipādyate |
liḍādivācyā śābdī bhāvanā prāśastyajñānānu- gṛhītā ichāsādhanātākṣepamukhena mukhyaviśeṣabhūtāyāṃ ākhyātārthayuktau anveti |
śābdī dyākāṅkṣā śabdainaiva pūryata iti nyāyaḥ |
śabdatvaṃ na śabdavṛttiviṣayatvaṃ kiṃtu śabdajanya- pratītiviṣayatvam |
tena vṛttyaviṣayasyāpi anvayasya śābdatvopapattiḥ iti naiyāyikāḥ |
pṛ. 30, śabdabodhe dhātvarthavyāpārasa mukhya- viśeṣyatvam, sarvakārakāṇāṃ phalasya vartamānavādikālasya ca vyāpāraviśeṣaṇatvam |
ekatvādisaṃkhyāyāśca kartṛ- karmaṇoḥ, karmaṇaśca phale anvayaḥ |
evaṃ ca 'taṇḍulān pacati' iti kartṛtvāte taṇḍulaniṣṭhaviklittijanakaḥ ekāśrayako vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ |
'taṇḍulaḥ pacyate' iti karmākhyāyate tu ekāśrayaphalajanako vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ |
pṛ. 105, śabdabodhe padārthopa- sthitimātraṃ na hetuḥ |
nāpi padajanya- padārthopasthitiḥ, padopasthitasyākāśāderapi śābda- bodhāpatteḥ |
anye tu na padajanyapadārthopasthitirhetuḥ; kiṃtu padārtho- pasthitimātram |
na ca tathāpi pratyakṣagamyakalāpāderapi pacatītyādau śābdabodhāpattiḥ |
na caivaṃ 'ghaṭaḥ karmatvaṃ' ityādipadajanyapadārtho- sthitau śābdabodhāpattiḥ |
ata eva vācakapadānupasthitasyāpi kramasya vidhānamupapadyate ityāhuḥ |
nanu astu śabdabodhe ākāṅkṣādijñānānāṃ kāra- ṇatā, tathāpi yugapat tāvatpadajñānaṃ tāvatpadārtha- smṛtīnāṃ ca asaṃbhavatvāt kathaṃ vākyārthabodha iti cet |
kramoccāritapadajanyapadārthopasthitisamanantaraṃ sarveṣāṃ padānāṃ samūhālambanamupamānasopasthitiḥ, tataḥ samūhālambanapadārthopasthitau tadanvayabodhopapatteḥ |
na ca padasamūhālambanaṃ vinā arthopasthitiraiva kathyatāṃ iti vācyam |
vastutastu janyatvāpekṣayā ananyathāsiddhatvasya apraveśena prayojyatvasya laghutayā padajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ na hetutvam, kiṃtu padaprayojyapadārthopasthitiraiva |
tathā sati padasamūhālambanaṃ nāvaśyākaṃ iti yuktam |
taduktaṃ 'vṛddhā yuvānaḥ śiśavaḥ kapotāḥ khale yathā'mī yugapat patanti |
tathaiva sarve yugapat padārthāḥ paraspareṇā- nvayino bhavanti |
yatra khaṇḍavākyārthabodhottaraṃ mahāvākyārthabodhaḥ, yatra vā 'daṇḍī kuṇḍalī chatrī caitraḥ' ityādī viśeṣasya vaiśiṣṭyabodhe tātparyaṃ tatra |

khaṇḍavākyārthabodhottaraṃ caramapadasmṛtiḥ, tataḥ tatpadārthasmṛtiḥ, tatra arthasmṛtikāle khaṇḍavākyārtha- bodhanāśāt caramapadasmṛtireva tāvadadviṣayiṇī, tataḥ caramārthasmṛtiḥ tāvadadviṣayiṇī, tataḥ anvayabodhaḥ iti naiyāḥ |
anyathā pacatītyāditaḥ pratyakṣadṛṣṭakalāpāderapi anvaya- bodhāpatteḥ ityuktam |
evaṃ sati 'dvāraṃ' ityādī śābdabodho na syāt |
guravastu tadviṣayakaśabde padajanyatadupasthitiraiva hetu- tvam, kiṃtu tattadanvayabodhe padajanyatadanvayapratiyogyu- pasthititvena hetutvam |
'viśvajitā yajeta' ityādī tu arthādhyāhāreṇaiva anvayabodhaḥ ityāhuḥ |
kāryāvācakapadasamabhivyāhṛtavākyānāṃ mukta- tvāt śābdabodhamātre kāryāvācakapadārthopasthitiśca hetuḥ |
evaṃ ca tattacchabdabodhe tattatpadārthopasthititvena hetutā iti lāghavam |
matāntare tu tattatpadasya tattatpadajanyopasthiteśca hetutvakalpane hetuhetumadbhāva- kalpanā gauravaṃ iti |
maṇi. pṛ. 69-70. śabda- bodhe yogyatājñānakaraṇatvanirāsapūrvakaṃ ayogyatāniścayasya pratibandhakatvavyavasthāpanam |
pravṛttijanakaśabdabodha- kramastu niyojyasvargāmīyaṃ yāgaviṣayakaṃ svarga- sādhanaṃ syāpi kāryaṃ mama ' iti prathamo bodhaḥ |
svarga- kāme niyojyatvaṃ saṃsargatayā prakāratayā vā bhāsate |
anyathā atīndriyasya aphalasya svatantrakṛtyasādhyatayā yāgakṛtisādhyasya yāge kāryatvānvayabodhaṃ vinā anu- papatteḥ |
niyojyasvargāmīyaḥ svaniyojyasvargasādhanatvena jñāya- mānakāryo yāgānukūlakṛtimān iti vyāpāravān iti vā tṛtīyaḥ |
anyathā pūrvapratītakṛteḥ āśrayānvayaṃ vinā anupapatteḥ, ākhyātavācyavyāpārasāmānasya kartṛsākāṅkṣatvāt prathamāntapadopasthāpye anvayabodha- niyamācca tadanvayaṃ vinā anupapattervā |
vivaraṇakārastu atra bodhatrayameva āvaśyakam, tāva- taiva pravṛttisiddherityāha |
nibandhakārastu āśrayobodhottaraṃ ' ahaṃ svarga- kāmaḥ kartā bhoktā ca ' iti bodhāt pravṛttimāha |
kartṛtvāte phale vyāpāre viśeṣaṇam, karmākhyāte'pi vyāpāraḥ phale, janyatvādiva ca saṃsargaḥ |
devadattaniṣṭhakṛtijanyavyāpajanyaphala- śālī taṇḍulaḥ iti karmākhyāte bodhaḥ |
na yogyatājñānaṃ api tu ayogyatāniścayasya pratibandhakatvāmātram |

maṇi. pṛ. 1. śāstraṃ śabda- vijñānāt asannikṛṣṭārthe vijñānam |
atra śāstraśabdena yogarūḍhyā dharmādharmopadeśini caturdaśa aṣṭādaśa
tvāt utsarga rūpe pradhāne ahre vā, prabhau yajamāne eva |
iti nyāyasya vinā vacanaṃ apavāde pramāṇābhāvāt |
kartā tu pradhānasya kartuḥ tasmāt yajamānāt anyaḥ |
ṛtvik kartā syāt, svayaṃ yajamāno vā kartā syāt |
athavā, pradhānasya yaḥ śeṣaḥ, tatkārī tasmādyajamānāt |
iti buddhau satyāṃ kiṃ sahāyāḥ asahāyo vā ityasyāma- |
anyaḥ kartā syāt svayaṃ yajamāno vā syāt ityanvayaḥ |
deva somavāminaḥ upakaroti, yajamānasyaiva ca tathopa- |
yogāt parikraye varaṇe ca svayaṃ kriyamāṇe'pi ata- |
kartuṃ śaknoti natvijam, tataśca yajamānāttvena saume- |
karoti, pradhāne tu svayaṃkṛte ajñāni parikrayavaraṇāmyāṃ |
anyena kāryan yajamānaḥ kartṛtvāt vyāhanyate iti |
uta utsargamātraṃ svayaṃ kuryāt, śeṣamanyaḥ vā uta |
vyate, yāge kartā bhavan phalaṃ sādhayate iti |
vā-- ataḥ paraṃ samākhyāyāḥ sarveḥ sada virodhā- |
yadi hotrādayo nānābhūtā vidhyante tataḥ kva te vini- |
anyatrāpi gacchati samavaiti iti vyutpattyā anyenāpi |

sa yatraiva kartā na syāt tatkṛtamevopakāraṃ na |
utsargaṃ karoti tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati |
prayokkira0' ityatra samadhigataṃ yaḥ kāstyena vidhi- |
parikrayaṃ karoti, tena svayameva sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati |
utsargamātraṃ svayaṃ kuryāt śeṣamanyaḥ svayaṃ vā |
anyasya svargaṃ kāmayamāno'pi anyo yajeta, tatra |
tathā ca yajanti yājakāḥ iti prayojyavyāpāre parasmai- padam|
yajate yajamānaḥ iti prayojakavyāpāre ātmane- padaṃ dṛśyate|
evaṃ hi sati pradhānamapi yathākathañcit anyaireva kārayitavyaṃ bhavet|
yadeva hi svayaṃ kartṛkaṃ jātaṃ tasyaiva phalaṃ na prāpnuyāt|
na ca yat ṛtvijaḥ kurvanti tasya katrtavyatvāt yajamānagāmi phalaṃ yujyate|
kāmaṃ tu pradhānakāriṇo yajamānasya yathākathaṃ- cidanugraheṇa prayojakatvāt ṛtvigvāpāravacanaṃ parasmaipadaṃ ṇijarthe vartate, nātmanepadam|
tasmāt pūrveṇaiva vyākhyānena pradhānādanyasya svayamayo vā kartā syāditi|
tatrāpi tu pratyayapratipāditā bhāvanā pratyāsannatā phalārthikartṛtvena gamyamānā kathaṃ karaṇāṃśamātra eva upasaṃhiyate iti vaktavyam|
tena evaṃ vyākhyāyam, nātmanepadena phalārthi- kartṛtvaṃ codyate|
na tu phalādhīnaḥ anyena vyāpārakaraṇaṃ virudhyate|
tāvatā ca siddhaḥ aṅgeṣu aniyama iti|
anyo vā syāt parikyāmnānāt viprati- ṣedhāt pratyagātmani|
tasmāt parikyene ānataiḥ sarve padārthāḥ kartavyā iti|
yadi svayaṃ kuryāt aparikritena kṛtaṃ syāt|
tasmādanyaiḥ parikrītaiḥ śeṣāḥ padārthāḥ kartavyā iti|
utsargaṃ tu svayaṃ kurvatā sarvaṃ svayaṃ kartṛ bhavati|
vā-- anyārhatvād daśa-idāniṃ karmasaṃyuktebhyo- 'bhidhānāt parikyārthe vā karmasaṃyogāt (10|2| 8|23) iti daśame vakṣyati|
svabhāvataśca parikyaḥ paratra kriyate nāmani, virodhāt|
tatra yadi kadācit svayameva aṅgāni yajamānaḥ kuryāt tataḥ parikyā- sambhavāt parikyo na kriyate|
tasmāt tannityatāṃ kartuṃ avaśyaṃ parikyārhāṇi katrtantarāṇi upādātavyāni|
kacit svayaṃkaraṇāt kacit saṃnidhānāt yajamānasya kartṛtvam|
ātmanepadāpi parikyavartī bhāvanā āśritasya īdṛśenaiva kartṛtvena phalopayogaḥ samānakartṛkaḥ ityartho na virudhyate|
śā-- 'prāsaṅgikī kathā vṛttā, samākhyā- yāstataḥ param|

' soma-- 'tulyaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśuvidhiḥ' (16|7|18) ityāramya adhikaraṇacatuṣṭayena sthānasya pūrvaiḥ saha virodhā- virodhavicāre tatprasaṅgāt 'ārācciddha' (3|6|19| 32) ityāramya yā prāsaṅgikī kathā prasaktā, tatsamāptau kramaprāptaṃ samākhyāyāḥ pūrvaiḥ saha virodhāvirodhavicāraṃ 'te sarvāīḥ prayuktvāt' (3|7|1|19) ityādinā cikīrṣuḥ tadutpodghātaṃ ārabhate|
kartṛnānātve sati samā- khyāyā hotādīnāṃ vyavasthāvicāro ghaṭate nānyathā iti upodghātatvaṃ bodhyam|
vi-- 'yajamānena katrtavyaṃ nikhilaṃ tyāga eva vā|
prayojake- 'pi kartṛtvamasti no cet krayo dhruvā|
' bhāṭṭa-- tadevaṃ pūrvaiḥ saha prakaraṇasthānayoḥ virodhā- virodhavicāre samāpte adhunā samākhyāyāḥ taṃ kartuṃ prathamaṃ tāvat svāmyatiriktakartṛsadbhāvaḥ pratipādyate|

agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsajyotiṣṭomādiṣu dakṣiṇāyukteṣu karmasu yadyapi tāvat 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti samānādhi- karaṇāt sākṣāyā api yāgādikaraṇatayā bhāvanāyāḥ svargakāmakartṛkatvaṃ pratīyate, tathāpi kartṛtvasya 'svatantraḥ kartā' (pā. 1|4|54) ' tatprayojako hetuśca ' (pā. 1|4|55) iti sūtradvayānusāreṇa ' ṣaḍbhi- rhelaiḥ karṣati ' iti prayogaca sākṣātprayojakasādhāraṇe- naiva avagateḥ asati pramāṇāntare prayojakakartṛlāyoge- 'pi prakṛte dakṣiṇāmnānādinā prayojakatvasyāpi avagateḥ sāmyatiriktāpi kartṛtvam|
karmakaraṇānti- sādhanavacanau hi dakṣiṇāśabdaḥ nāsatsu katrtareṣūpa-

yena 'yadi patnīḥ saṃyājayan kapālamabhi juhuyāt vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet tasyaikāhayano gaurdakṣiṇā taṃ sa dveṣyāya dadyāt' ityatra dveṣyasya ṛtviktvapratiṣedhādeva adṛṣṭārthatvaṃ dakṣiṇāyāḥ kalpyeta|
ātmanepadāpi sākṣāt prayojakasādhāraṇenāpi akartari phalapratiṣedhakaratvenaiva upapattau na phalatiriktāsya kartṛtvapratiṣedhakatvam|
tena kasyāpi bādhakasya abhāvāt na dakṣiṇādānasya adṛṣṭārthatvakalpanā|
atastadalāt 'darśapūrṇamāsayo- ścatvāra ṛtvijaḥ' iti vacanāt hotrādisamākhyāvara- ṇāyāmnānabalācca svāmyatiriktā api kartāraḥ|
na ca svāmino'śaktau dakṣiṇādinā anyopādānam, dakṣi- ṇādeḥ nityadāmānānavirodhāt|
ataḥ parakīyasyāsya pareṇa utsṛṣṭamaśakyatvāt utsargāmātraṃ svāminā kāryam|
anyat viśeṣataḥ pramāṇābhāve anyenaiva iti siddham|
' vā. 1|3| 419 pṛ. 223, śākhasthā lakṣaṇā laukikalakṣa- ṇāyāḥ balavatī|
śākhasthā śāstrānusāriṇī eva vipratipattiḥ viśiṣṭā pratipattiḥ (pūrvasūtrādanuvṛtta padaṃ) dīrghasūtrādabhiprāyatvā (nīvārādiṣviva) balīyasī|
'śākhasthā vā tannimittatvāt' (1|3|4|9) ityadhikaraṇe 'yadā vā anyā oṣadhayo mlāyante' iti saṃdigdhyārthaśaktigrāhakorthavādaḥ 'yavamatībhirindraudaudumbarī prokṣati' itividheḥ vākya- śeṣaḥ ityuktam|
bāla. pṛ. 56-58. 'śākhasthā vā tannimittatvāt' (1|3|4|9) ityanena vyākaraṇa- syaśākhagatapratipattilīyastvaṃ tadabhiprukapuruṣīyatvaṃ vā sthāpitam|

'śākhasthā vā tannimittatvāt' iti siddhāntasūtraṃ svayaṃ tāvat avatārapūrvakaṃ vyācaṣṭe- bāśabdena (laukikaśāstra- sthayoḥ pratipatyoḥ - ) sāmyaṃ nirākṛtya pūrvaistvagata- 'syāt' śabdārthanuṣṭheyatā śākhasya syāt ityuktam|
śākhā- nusārāvagataśabdārthagataguṇayoganimittatvenāpi arthāntara- pratītyupapatteḥ nobhayatha śaktiḥ kalpyā ityevamarthatvena 'tannimittatvāt' iti sūtrāvayavo vyākhyātaḥ|
su. pṛ. 209. sārvalaukikāpi prayogāt 'śākhasthā vā tannimittatvāt' ityanenaiva rājaśabdasya kṣatriyavacana- tvam|
vā. 2|1|2|3 pṛ. 586. śākhasthaprayogabalena laukikaprayogādhaḥ yava- varāhādhikaraṇe uktaḥ|
su. pṛ. 259 śākhasthasarvaśabdaprayogaṇāṃ laukikaśabdaiḥ avi- rodhaḥ|
vā. 1|3|24 pṛ. 252. śākhahetukaḥ śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandho nahi bhavati|
nityosau loketoḍavagamyate ityuktaṃ 'autpattikastu śabdasyārthena saṃbandhaḥ' iti (1|1|5|5) |

śākhīyaḥ nityaḥ prātarvādhaḥ pañcadaśadhā - 1 nityaṃ naimittiken, 2 ṛtvarthaṃ puruṣārthena, 3 pūrvaṃ pareṇa, 4 prākṛtaṃ arthalopena, 5 prākṛtaṃ paryudāsena, 6 prākṛtaṃ pratyāmnānena ārabhyādhītena, 7 prākṛtaṃ pratyāmnānena anārabhyādhītena, 8 sāmānyāvihitaṃ viśeṣavihitena vidheyamede vidheyaikye ca vākyabhede, 9 sāmānyāvihitaṃ viśeṣavihitena vākyaikye, 10 niṣprayojanaṃ saprayojanana, 11 alpaṃ bhūyasā, 12 sāvakāśaṃ niravakāśena, 13 aṅgaṃ pradhānana, 14 aṅgadharmaḥ pradhānadharmeṇa, 15 upādeyamanu- pādeyena|
śiṃśāśabdaḥ na tāvat vṛkṣatva-pārthivatva- dravyatva-sattā-prameyatva-jñeyatvānāṃ abhidhāyakaḥ, atha ca tadviśeṣameva śiṃśāṃ abhipatte |
śikye ṣaḍdāme dvādaśyāme vā agnisahitāṃ ukhāmavasthāya, śikyaṃ skandhate saṃvatsaraṃ vibhrayāt tat cayanaṃ kartavyam |
karmāṅgabhūtaṃ tāvattuttaravatta- padmāvattvādibhāgasiddhayarthaṃ avaśyaṃ satataṃ gotram |
vā. śikhākalpaḥ vyavatiṣṭhate, kecit triśikhāḥ, kecit pañcaśikhāḥ iti |
śitipṛṣṭhaḥ bārhaspatyaḥ aikādaśineṣu pañcamaḥ paśuḥ aśvamedhe jyotiṣṭome ca |
śinīnāṃ dārbihomiko brāhmaṇaḥ , annajñānāṃ dārbihomiko brāhmaṇaḥ iti |
yaśca yat karoti sa tena ākhyāyate yathā lāvakaḥ pāvakaḥ iti |
' śinīnāṃ dārbihomiko brāhmaṇaḥ ' iti smārta- home, ' dārbihomaṃ kuryāt ' iti vaidike ca prayogāt , ' dārbihomaḥ ' iti śrautasmārtayobhayoḥ dharmaviśeṣorapi nāmadheyam |
śinīnāṃ ( śinīnāṃ iti bhāṣye pāṭhaḥ ) pākayajñaḥ iti smārta eva dārbihome vyavahāraḥ |
śiraśchede'pi śataṃ na dadāti viṃśati- pañcakaṃ tu prayacchati śākaṭika iti nyāyaḥ |

tathāhi- nanu prapañcasya mithyātvamabhyupeyate, nāsattva- miti cet tadetatsau'pi śiraśchede'pi śataṃ na dadāti viṃśatipañcakaṃ prayacchatīti śākaṭikadṛṣṭāntamanuharet mithyātvāsavayoḥ paryāyatvāt ityalamatiprasaṅgena |
ṛjunā mārgeṇa sidhyato'rthasya vakreṇa sādhanaṃ vyartham |
ke. śilpaḥ : vaiśvadevaḥ aikādaśineṣu ṣaṣṭhaḥ paśuḥ aśvamedhe jyotiṣṭome ca |
śiṣṭāḥ : idānīṃtanāḥ manvādivat deśakālavipra- kṛṣṭaṃ vedaṃ divyajñānena sākṣāt kartuṃ na śaknuvanti |
vi. 1|3|14 varṇakaṃ 2. śiṣṭāḥ na khalu anyārtha kalpitaṃ anyadhame upakalpayanti |
aśikṣā eva te syuḥ, yadi vigāhayeyurvinā śāstreṇa |
tataḥ : śiṣṭācāraḥ smṛtiḥ, smṛteḥ śrutiḥ (anumīyate iti jñeyam ) |
vā. 6|2|3|15 śiṣṭāḥ : yaḥ śāstrajñānāṃ ( prayogaviṣayaḥ ) sa śabdārthaḥ |
śikṣā : vedavihitadharmāṃnuṣṭhānakatvaṃ śiṣṭatvam , ' pratyakṣavedavihitadharmakriyā hi laghvaśiṣṭha- tvavyapadeśaḥ ' iti vārtikāt niṣpannaṃ bhavati |
anantaramevenaṃ śiṣṭāḥ : varṇayeyuḥ patitaḥ karmetyeti vadantaḥ |

na nāma upalakṣaṇāntareṇa śāstraṃ prayucyapalamya śiṣṭāḥ pravṛttāḥ, sarvakālaṃ tu śiṣṭavyavahāraśāstrayoḥ aviyogāt vyavahārādeva apodṛtya kecit svargādisadhanatvena niyamyamānāḥ kādācitkatvaparityāgena nityaprayojyā vijñāyante |
teṣāṃ ca āryāvartaniveśiśiṣṭaprayojyatva- mevopalakṣaṇaṃ vedenāpi sarakhatīvinaśanalakṣaprabhavaṇādivat upapattim śakyamanumātum |
śāstrokte ca sāmikṛte tyakte atyantaṃ śiṣṭā gṛhṇante, devatāśraye ca |
prāyeṇa hi śiṣṭānāṃ dharmācāraṇahitacetasāṃ kaścideva pramādāt alpaḥ anācāro bhavati |

' vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti ' iti śiṣṭānāṃ śruti- vihitānāṃ vededikaraṇadirūpāṇāṃ padārthānāṃ ' śrute ācāmet ' ityādismṛtyā atrādhe sati smṛti- vacanamapi aviruddhaṃ pramāṇameva vedakaraṇādanantaraṃ kadācit śrutādinimittasaṃpāte ācamanādikaṃ smṛti- vihitamapi kartavyameva |
vedavedikaraṇamadhye śrute jāte smṛtivihitācamanaṃ kartavyaṃ smṛteḥ pramāṇatvāt iti siddhāntinā ukte pūrvapakṣī āha |
śāstreṇa ' vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti ' iti śāstreṇa kramabodhakaśrutādinā avagataṃ yat parimāṇaṃ kālādi- paricchedaḥ avyavadhānādipuraḥ tadvatvāt |
tathā ca śrutipramitakramatrādhaprasaṅgena ' śrute ācāmet ' ityādi smṛtivākyaṃ apramāṇam |
smārtāccamanādi- viruddhānāṃ kramakālaparimāṇānāṃ śāstraparimāṇatvāt śrutyavagatatvāt iti vā samāsāryaḥ |
śāstravagataṃ prayogavidhivagataṃ parimāṇaṃ saṃkhyāviśeṣaḥ yasya anuṣṭheya- padārthasaṃghātasya tādṛśatvāt |
prayogavidhinā asmin karmaṇi iyantaḥ padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ iti niyamitatvāt madhye smārtasyādhikasya padārthasyānuṣṭhāne śāstravirodhaḥ syāt iti vā tātparyam |
apivā kāraṇāgrahaṇe prayuktāni pratīyeran ityeva vā sūtram, vārtikoktyā ' apivā kāraṇāgrahaṇe prayuktāni pratīyeran teṣvadarśanādiroṣasya ' iti vā sūtram |
ācā- ntena kartavyam, yajñopavītinā kartavyaṃ ityādayaḥ : śiṣṭā- cārāḥ : dharmatvena na kartavyā iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntasūtra- midam |
na kartavyāni iti na kiṃtu kartavyanveva |
kāraṇāgrahaṇe akartavyatākāraṇasya kasyacit dṛṣṭasya pramāṇasya agrahaṇe grahaṇābhāve jñānābhāve sati yāni śiṣṭaiḥ prayuktāni anuṣṭhīyamānāni bhavanti, tāni dharmatvenaiva pratīyeran jñāyeran |
virodhakāraṇasya anuṣṭhānavādhasya agrahaṇe adarśane sati śiṣṭaiḥ prayuktāni ācamanādīni śrautakramādya- viruddhatvena pratīyeran |
avirodhācca karmamadhye śrutādinimitte āca- manādismaraṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam - 'ācāntena kartavyam' 'yajñopa- vītinā kartavyam' 'dakṣiṇācāreṇa kartavyam' ityevaṃ- lakṣaṇānyudāharaṇāni |
kimetāni śrutiviruddhāni na karvyāni, uta aviśraddhāni kāryāṇi iti cetpaśyasi tairapyanuṣṭhīyamānairvaidikaṃ kiñcit na kupyati |
vā -- śiṣṭākope evaṃ tāvat puruṣārthasmṛtīnāma- virodhe virodhe ca pramāṇatvapramāṇatve nirūpite |
saṃprati tu ṛtvarthānāṃ yajñopavītādācamanadakṣiṇāhastasmṛtīnāṃ bahuśrutyarthamadhyāpattīnāṃ virodhāvirodhamātrameva vicā- ryate |
tannirṇaye tu kṛte pūrvādhikaraṇasyāṃ pramāṇatvā- pramāṇatvasiddhiḥ |
yadi yajñopavītādīni kartumanupraveśyamānāni codakaprayogavacanābhyāṃ na parigṛhyante nirākriyante vā, tato virodhaḥ |
yadi punaranuguṇatvāt prakaraṇādipaṭhitavat smṛtinumitākṣayasaṃyogena kartumanupraveśitāni, na ca pūrva- gṛhītaṃ kiñcidghātate, tato na viruddhānīti |
na ceha smārtaḥ kasya- cidapi śrautasya padārthasya bādha āśaṅkyate, kramakāla- parimāṇāni tu samastapadārthadharmatvena niścitāni |

tatra yadi pramāṇavalavalaṃ valīyaḥ, tato balavacchutiprameyatvāt durbalasvabhāve'pi kramādibhirācamanādīnāṃ bādhaḥ, prameya- valavalavalīyastve tu padārthadharmebhyaḥ kramādibhyaḥ padārtha- tvena ācamanādayo valīyāṃsaḥ, iti satyapi smṛtyākhya- pramāṇe durbalatve balavadāśrayānāpi svarūpeṇa durbalān kramādīneva bādhiṣyante |
na tadarthakriyāyāṃ hi śrutaṃ kiṃcana hīyate |
' yathaiva viśātavalavalairapi śrutyādibhiḥ samāsāpyaparyantairyāvantaḥ śeṣāḥ pramīyante te sarve śeṣikārtha- bhāvena prāthitā itthaṃbhāvena saha anāraśrutvādādītairguhyante |
' kathaṃ- bhāvāpekṣitāpūrvakārasya ajñātaparimāṇājñādhyatvāt yāvatkiṃcit yena kenacidapi pramāṇe prāpnoti, tatsarvamajñaṃ bhavati |
katham ? 'vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ kurvīta' itīmāṃ śrutipuruṣadvyāt antarā vedaṃ vediṃ cānuṣṭhīyamāna- mānatvādi |
dakṣiṇena caikahastenānuṣṭhīyamāneṣu padārtheṣu kadācit pradhānaṃ svakālamatikrāmet |
'na śāstrapari- māṇatvāt (śāstraṃ parimāṇaṃ yeṣāṃ tādṛśatvāt) padārtho'rthadhiko bhavet |
śāstreṇa hi padārthānāṃ parimāṇaṃ tridhā gatam |
' sarve hi padārthāḥ pradhānakālāt na viprakṛṣyāḥ, iti prayogavacanena pratipāditam |
kramaśca yaḥ śrutyarthapāṭha- sthānamukhyapravṛttivatkramairavagataḥ, sa ca vaidikapadārthā- rūḍhatayā vijñātaśravyapramāṇaparimāṇaḥ san anyathatvaṃ śrutādinimittamanvayadhanāt pratipādyeta |
' uktaparimā- ṇasya kramasya nānyadapi kiṃcit pramāṇamavakalpate |

tataśca prathamāparikalpita-paścādgata-smārtapadārthānuṣṭhāne pūrvāvadhāraṇaaṃśataḥ samastakṛtānupūrṇāt anirvṛtta- vaiguṇyāśaṅkasya samyakkṛtatvādyarthanimittasaṃskārapātvā- māvāt apūrvedīrvatyena nyūnaphallāmaprasaṅgaḥ |
( kramavirodhanirāsamādhāya nyāyace-) prāpteṣu hi padārtheṣu kramaḥ pañcādapekṣyate |
' na kenacinmānena pada yainthā pari cchidyate |
tatra yadi vinā anye samastapadārthasmṛti- hetavo na syuḥ; tata etadapyekaṃ kāraṇamiti parimāṇamapi sthāpyeta |
tasyāmapi tvavasthāyāṃ yathā śaucamātraparimāṇaṃ asamāpya samākhyāpyate'prāptipadārthatadgataparimāṇa- dhāraṇamāśrīyete, tathā smṛtyācārayathāvatparimāṇamā- śrayiṣyate iti nirdoṣam |
tatpadasthasya ca nahuṣasya paradārā- bhiyogāt dharmavyatikramaḥ |
kṛṣṇadvaipa- yanasya gṛhītanaiṣṭhikabrahmacaryasya vicitravīryadāreṣu apatyo- tpādanaprasaṅgaḥ |
bhīṣmasya ca sarvāśramadharmavyatireke- ṇavasthānam, apalīkasya ca rāmavat ṛtuprayogaḥ |
tathā andhasya dhṛtarāṣṭrasyetyādi pāṇḍuvarjitārthaiḥ itya- nabhiṣṭakriyā |
tathā yudhiṣṭhirasya kanīyojitabhrātṛ- jāyāpariṇayanam ācāryādināṇadharmārthamatrāpaṇaṃ ca |
vāsudevārjunayoḥ pratiṣiddhamātuladuhitṛkamiṇaśubhadrā- pariṇayanam, 'ubhau madyāśvakṣī' iti surāpānā- caraṇam |
atisūkṣmā pratipuruṣajātikulava- sthitasūkṣmadharmavyatikramaṇāni tu anantamedānīṃ sarvatra vigānahetudarśanāni ca prāyeṇaiva saṃbhavantīti naivajātī- yakamiśnasadācāradharmatvavyavasthāsaṃbhavaḥ |
kiṃca 'ke śiṣṭā ye sadācārāḥ, sadācārāśca tatkṛtāḥ |
' yathābhyāsaṃ hi āśayavaicitryeṇa śubhāśubhamyanakriyā- nuṣṭhānāmāmāratuluṣṭireva bhavati |
tathā hi, kasyaciñjāte tuṣṭirevame'pi hi karmaṇi |
' tathā hi, 'paśuhiṃsādisaṃbandhe yathai tuṣyanti hi dvijāḥ |
tebhya eva hi yajñebhyaḥ śākyāḥ kupyanti pīḍitāḥ |
anye tu sanyalīkena manasā tanna kurvate |
' tataśca anavasthitatvāt yathaiva 'ātmana- stuṣṭireva ca' ityetanmuvacanaṃ kathamanyathā netavyam |
anyathā hi tadanapekṣāḥ svātantryeṇa vyavaharamāṇā duṣṭā bhaveyurna śiṣṭāḥ |
yadi ca syātparokṣā'pi smaryataiva hyasau dhruvam |
arthātha vā, na teṣvasti śiṣṭānāmeva dharmadhīḥ |
dharmatvena prapannāni śiṣṭairyāni tu kāni- cit |
modakādīnāṃ dānaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ ca) anabhipakvamādhasamīpaurṇamāsīphālgunīprati- padmantotsavadīni (anabhipakva bhakṣaṇasa niyamaḥ |
māghasya saptamyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca anuṣṭheyaṃ karma |
phālguna- paurṇamāsyanantarapratipadi vasantotsava lakṣyate) niyama- kriyāpramāṇaṃ na śāstrādate kiṃcidasti |
smṛtikārāśca 'ācāraśca sādhūnāṃ' 'deśātikuladharmāścā'smā- yairviruddhāḥ pramāṇa' iti vedāviruddhamācārāṇāṃ sāmānyataḥ prāmāṇyamanumanyate |
tathā anadhyāyādhikāraḥ, ūrdhvaṃ bhojanadādurakhaḥ, iti deśanagarotsatrapramāṇyā- thaṇam |
vede'pi ca mahāvrate 'preṅkhaṇamagha hotā śaṃsati' ityetadākyaśeṣe śrūyate 'yadā vai prajā maha
āviśanti preṅkhaṃ tarhyārohanti' iti mahaḥśabdavācyo- tsvaprasiddhiranuditā |
yat 'parimitaśāstraprameyatvā- ddharmādharmayoḥ, iha ca tadasaṃbhavāt' ityuktam, tat veda- mūlatvānumānātpūrvadeva (bhrāntenubhavāt |
na ca smṛti- nirmūlā vistaravacanānāmapi prapāṭhakamātreṇa upasaṃhārāt kimuta saṃkṣepavacanasya |
' 'na hi tadevaṃ śāstrapramāṇakam, tasya svarūpamapi tata evāvagantavyam |
tatra pratyakṣavagate'pyācārarūpe dadhi- godohanādivat phalasaṃbandhaḥ śāstreṇāvagamyate |
yāgā- diṣvapi ca naiva svarūpajñānena śāstramapekṣimat, phala- saṃbandhamātrasyaiva atīndriyatvena tadapekṣitatvāt |
ato na nāma upalakṣaṇāntareṇa śāstraṃ pravṛttamapyalam śiṣṭāḥ pravṛttāḥ; sarvakālaṃ tu śiṣṭavyavahāraśāstrayoraviyogataḥ vyavahārādevāpohya kecit svargādisādhanatvena niyamya- yante |
teṣāṃ ca āryāvartanivāsiśiṣṭaprayojyatvemevopa- lakṣaṇaṃ vedenāpi sarasvatīvināśanaprakṣaprasavaṇāditvat upā- ttamiha śakyamanumātum |
' 'pratyakṣa- vedavihitadharmakriyā hi labdhaśiṣṭavyavadeśā tathā paraṃ- parāprāptamanyadapi dharmabuddhyā kurvanti, tadapi svargavat dharmameva |
smṛtipratyācāraṃ vedavacanaṃ vapalabhya abhyanujñānāyaiva pravṛttā ityadoṣaḥ |
' 'vede'pi hi bahunyeva dṛṣṭārtha- gadhaṣṭyāni vidhīyante iti na tāvatā vedamūlatvā- bhāvaḥ |

yāni tu mlecchādisamānāni nityāniyatakriyā- ntarāṇi arthamukhasādhanakṛṣisevāvāṇijyādīni mṛṣṭāpāna- muduśayanasanaramaṇīyagṛhyagāleyagītanutyagandhapuṣpādi- karmāṇi prasidvāni, teṣu naiva kaściddharmatvamāśaṅkā- 'sti |
sa eva kaśceva dharmo netara : prāṇimātrataḥ |
' tathaiva bahukālābhyastavedārthadarśanādita- saṃskārāṇāṃ vedaniyatamāgānusāripratibhānāṃ nommāgena pratibhānaṃ saṃbhavatītyāśrocyate 'yadeva kiṃcanānucā- no'smṛti, ārṣe tadvati |
iti vaidikavāsanā- janitatvādeva eva sa bhavati |
tathāhi, 'yathā ramāyāṃ lavaṇakarepu merau yathā vojjvalakarumabhūmī |
yajāyate tanmayameva tat syāttathā bhavedvedidā- ttuṣṭiḥ |
bahudinābhyastadharmabhyāsādātmano hi na katha- ciddharmakaraṇapāramparyeṇatyatra saṃbhavatīti dharmatvenābhyanu- jñāyate |
yathā vā sarpasiddhānte nakulo yāṃ kilopadhim |
yathā vā yo bhuvaṃ kaścidyavāsati puṇyakṛt |

yattu 'prajāpatirupasamabhaiyat svāṃ duhitaram' 'aha- vyāyāṃ maitreyyāmindro jāra āsīt ' ityevamādidarśanā- ditihāsādarśanācca śiṣṭācāreṣu dharmātikramaṃ paśyantiḥ śiṣṭācārāprāmāṇyaṃ durvyavasanamiti |
sa cāṇḍālyavelāyāmuṣasaṃ uccan abhyat , sā tadāgamanā- devopajāyate iti taduhitṛtvena vyapadiśyate , tasyāṃ cāruṇakiraṇāsyavījinakṣepāt strīpuruṣayogadupacāraḥ |

evaṃ samastatejāḥ parameśvaranimittendrādavācyaḥ savitaiva ahani līyamānatayā rātryahasraśabdavācyāyāḥ kṣayā- tmakajvarapadhetutvāt jīryatyasādanaiveāditana ityādiḥ evāhalyājāra ityucyate , na tu parastrīvyabhicārāt |
nahya- ṣeṇa punaḥ parastrīparanimittanantarakālātsarasvaprāptyaiva ātmano durācāratvaṃ pratyāpitam |
' yo hi sadācāraḥ puṇyabuddhyā kriyate , sa dharmādeśca pratipadyate |
tena viśvāmitrasyāpi yadāgreṣvapūrvakarmāṇi tapobalārudrasya caritaṃ tat 'sarvaṃ balavataḥ pathyaṃ' ityanena nyāyena , mahānti ca tapāṃsi kṛtvā tāni kṣayaṃ nayataḥ |
uttarakāle vā pāpa- viśuddhiṃ prāyaścittaiḥ pratikurvāṇasya jīryatyapi |
manda- tapasāṃ gaireyiva mahāvaṭakādibhakṣaṇaṃ ātmavināśā- yaiva syāt |

dvaipāyanasyāpi , 'guruniyogādatipatya- lippudevarādagurupreritādṛtamatīyāt' ityevamāgatāmātṛ- mātṛsaṃbandhabhrātṛjāyāputrajananaṃ ( mātṛsaṃbandhena mātṛdvārā yo bhrātā vicitravīryaḥ , tajjāyāyāṃ ityarthaḥ ) prākṛta- paścātkāryamāṇatapobalena nātiduṣkaram |
vidhividharmādharmātrādyadāra- yorevaṃ sākṣādvāvihitapratyakṛtapitṛṇayoḥ yāgasiddhiḥ , hiraṇmayīsītākaraṇaṃ ca lokāpavādabhiyā tyaktasītāgatā- nṛśaṃsabhāvāśaṅkānivṛttyartham |
'yo vā piṇḍaṃ pituḥ pāṇau vijñāte'pi na dattavān |
' dhṛtarāṣṭro'pi vyāsānugrahāt āścaryavarṇana putradarśana- vat ṛtukāle'pi dṛṣṭavāneva |
tathaiva tadacanādat agho jāto vijñāyate , tathā yajñānuṣṭhānavacanāttathātvāt kāle dṛṣṭavāni- taryāpattyā sujñanam |
yadā 'yaja devapūjāsaṅgatikaraṇa- dāneṣu' iti dānārthaṃ evāyaṃ yarjirbhaviṣyati ṛtu- phalasamāni ca dānatapaḥśraṇādīni śrūyante , tatkā- raṇāt kratukriyopacāraḥ |
sā ca śrīḥ śrīśca bhūyo- bhirbhujyamānā na duṣyati ||
' ata eva coktam- 'idaṃ ca tatrādbhutarupamuttamaṃ jagada viprarṣi- ratītamānuṣaḥ |
mahānubhāvā kila sā sumadhyamā babhūva kanyaiva gategate'hani ||
itarathā hi kathaṃ pramāṇa- bhūtaḥ san evaṃ vadet |
athavā bahuya eva tāḥ sadṛśarūpā draupadyaḥ ekatvenopacaritā iti vyavahārārthā- patyā gamyate |
' yathā yudhiṣṭhiropadeśāt sabhāmadhyamānīya- mānā sahasaiva rajasvalāveṣaṃ saputrakasya dhṛtarāṣṭrasya ayaśa utpādayitumātmānaṃ pratyapāpayituṃ |

draupadī kṛtavatī , tathaiva kevalārjunamāyāyā eva satyāḥ śrītvaṃ ca janenā- viditaṃ parasparaṃ saṃvātāviṣayaṃ ca medaprayogānavakāśārthe darśayituṃ sādhāraṇapralyapanamityevamādikalpaiḥ : supari- haratvāt rāgolobhakṛtavyavahārasya ca śiṣyaireva dharmatvenā- parigrahasyoktavadanupālambhaḥ |
tathā ca droṇavadhādyabhūtā- nṛtavāde ' prāyaścittaṃ kāmakṛte'pyeke ' ityevamante- 'pyaśvamedhaḥ prāyaścittatvena kṛta eveti na tasya sadā- cāratvābhyupagamaḥ |
yattu vāsudevārjunayormadhyapānamātuladuhitṛpariṇayanaṃ smṛtiviruddhamupanyastam , tatra accavikārasurāmāprasya traivarṇikānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ : ' surā vai malamannānāṃ pāpmā ca malamyucyate |
manuṣyādyostu kṣatriyavaiśyayornaiva pratiṣedhaḥ : kevalabrāhmaṇaviṣayatvāt 'mayaṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇasya' iti vacanāt |
yadapyetat 'gauḍī paiṣṭī ca māghvī ca vijñeyā trividhā surā |
yathaivaikā tathā sarvā na peyā brahmavādibhiḥ ||

' iti , etadapi brahmavādiśabdasya tacchīlataddharmatatsādhukārinimittatvāt pravacanāśrayaṇena brūyadvadatyorekāryetvāt 'pravayādbrāhmaṇastveṣāṃ' iti niya- māt yasyaiva pravacanam , sa eva tacchīlataddharmatatsādhukārī vā bhavati , tasmādbrāhmaṇa eva brahmavādinaḥ |
tasmādetaduktaṃ bhavati 'yathaikā abhyurā trayāṇāmapyapeyā , tathā sarvā brahmavādibhirapeyā' iti |
itarathā yathaiketi ca , brahmavādibhiriti ca ubhayamapyanarthakameva syāt , ślokāntaranirdeśenaiva varṇatrayasaṃbandhalābhāt |

tathā cānyārthadarśanamamya- nujñānavacanam ' yanmālyamāsīttvasyāpyaudhata , surā vai mālyaṃ , tato rājyamamyajata , tasmājjāyāyāṃ śnuṣā ca śvaśrūśca surāṃ pītvā vilapantassā''ste , pāpmā vai mālyaṃ , tasmādbrāhmaṇaḥ surāṃ na pibet pāpmanā na saṃsṛjyā iti , tadetadetat kṣatriyo brāhmaṇaṃ brūyānnaivaṃ surā pītā hinasti ya evaṃ vidvānasurāṃ pibati' iti |
yattu mātṛluduhitṛpariṇayanaṃ tayoḥ tat mātṛpatnītvādidoṣavandhavyavadhāne'pi prāptādityava- hārādaviruddham |

yadyapi vāsudevasatteti subhadrā khyātā , tathā''pyucyate baladevavāsudevorekānaṃśāyathā nijatvā- nyākhyānāt mātṛpatnīyā subhadrā , tasya mātṛpitṛ- cchvasīyā duhitā ceti pariṇayanābhyanujñānādijñāyate |
' yena nyāyyai- yuktam 'mama vartmonuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ |
sa yat pramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanu vartate ||
' iti , sa kathaṃ sarvalokādarśabhūtaḥ san vidvācāraṃ pravartayiṣyati |
yattu ayatanānāmāhi- cchatrakamādharādīnāṃ surāpānādi , dākṣiṇātyānāṃ mātuladuhitṛvivāhādi smṛtiviruddhamupanyastam |
tatra kecittadāhuḥ : smṛtyācārayoḥ itaretaranirapekṣavedamūla- tvena tulyabalatvāt vihitapratiṣedhikavikalpanādāśramaṇā- dadoṣa iti |
' tathā manunā'pyuktam- 'yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ |
tena yāyātasatāṃ mārgaṃ tena gacchanna duṣyati ||
' yeṣāṃ tu yaḥ pitrādibhirevārtho nā''sa- caritaḥ : smṛtyantarapratiṣiddhaḥ , te taṃ pariharentyeva |
( parihārāvādī śaṅkate - ) āha , 'yadi veda- virodhaḥ syādityevaitadaprāmāṇatā |
āpastambavacanaṃ tu baudhāyanena smṛtiviruddhaduṣṭācārādā- haraṇānyeva prayacchatā nirākṛtam |
spaṣṭakāmādihetvantara- darśanācca viruddhācārāṇāmāpastambavacanasya vā śruti- mūlatvopapattiḥ |
kena vā brāhma- ṇīnāṃ surāpānaṃ pratiṣiddham ? ( pariharati - ) ucyate - ‘tasmād brāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśyanna surāṃ pibet |
’ ityanena ( āśaṅkitā svābhiprāyamāha - ) ‘na puṃlliṅganirdeśāt strīṇāṃ na pratiṣidhyate |
’ ( pārśvaha āha - ) ucyate - ‘hananapratiṣedhe'pi bhavet puṃstvaṃ vivakṣitam |

’ ( etadeva viṣṇuṇoti - ) ekaikasyā eva hi brāhmaṇyanyateyāprasakta- vadhapanayoḥ pratiṣedhāt vivakṣyamāṇamapi tāvadanūyamāna- tvāt anyakriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ vā saṃbhavati, kimuta yadā jātigataikatvāduvāda evāyaṃ vijñāyate |
hananapratiṣedhe karmabhūtasya brāhmaṇasyoddeśyamānatvāt, surāpāne ca kartṛtvenopādīya- mānatvāt svargakāmoddumbarīsaṃmānāyaivayajamānavat tulya- vivakṣāvivakṣayopaprasaṅgāddudāharaṇavaiṣamyam |
( vadhaniṣedhe brāhmaṇasya uddeśyatvenāvivakṣitaliṅgatvaṃ prakayati - ) tathāhi - ‘yo brāhmaṇa iti sukte hananaprati- ṣedhataḥ |
brāhmaṇe pratiṣedhe vā liṅgaṃ nānyadvidhī- yate ||

’ ( ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ) pratiṣedhaviparo hi vidhā- yakaḥ śuddhavadhapratiṣedhasaṃbhavāt brāhmaṇajātimātraviśiṣṭa- vadhapratiṣedhaṃ vidhāya nivṛttyapārā yadi liṅgaṃparaṃ brāhmaṇe, vadhe pratiṣedhaṃ vā vidadhyāt tataḥ pratyayā- vṛttilakṣaṇavākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ |

( evaṃ tāvat nañupa- hitasya liṅgo niṣedhakalpe pravartanāpratīyabhāvena tadākṣita- sādhyābhāvāt brāhmaṇasyānupayogitvena asaṃskāryatvāt anupādipadyanyavyatirekeṇa vāstavikoddeśyabhāve'pi śabdaśruteḥ noddeśyatvāvivakṣitaliṅgatā uktā |

yadā tu nañmātreṇa niṣedhasiddheḥ : dveṣārthaprāptavacanānuvādā- rthatvaṃ liṅaḥ aṅgīkriyate, tadā pravartanā'sikṣita- vairanaryātanādādisādhyasiddhayupayogihananasaṃskāryalopapatteḥ : vastuto'pi uddeśyatvāt sutarāṃ liṅgavivakṣā ( iyāha - ) yeṣāṃ tu vidhipratiṣedhau nātmanyabhimanau vedavākyārthau ( dvāveva ), teṣāṃ ( teṣāṃ mate śrayamāṇamapi liṅgaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ prati anupayujyamānatvāt tenāparigṛhītatvāt aviva- kṣitaṃ ityanyat - ) pratyayasaṃvidhānuguṇatayārthāvirabhāvāmā- midhānādadhyadhikalakṣaṇayāparo nañ vidharmyapi dveṣā- caryaprāptaṃ pūrvoktanyāyavivakṣitabrāhmaṇaviśiṣṭahananāviśiṣṭaṃ cānuvartita pratiṣedhārthatvārthaḥ, na liṅgaṃparaṃ brāhmaṇa- vadhavidhiśu śaknotyāvartamānaḥ pratiṣedham, iti śrūya- māṇamapi liṅgaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ prati anupayujyamānatvāvivakṣitaṃ bhavati |
eṣā hyatra vacanavyaktiḥ, ‘yat krodhādivaśena brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt, brāhmaṇe vā hantavyaḥ’ |

tannidhye- katvapakṣe punarīdṛśī vākyayojanā ‘yad brāhmaṇahananaṃ tanna kuryāditi, yo vā brāhmaṇastaṃ na hanyāt’ iti brāhmaṇa- viśiṣṭahananapratiṣedhavidhiḥ : śuddhodvibrāhmaṇaviṣayavadhaprati- ṣedhavidhiveti
' yadi hi tairmūlanyo'śroṣyanta, śabdaḥ tuśabdādyai ) vedavākyāni kalpayatāṃ veda evaikaḥ tato yathaivāni nibadvāni, tathaiva etānyapi nibaddhā- kalpayitavyaḥ |
etasya tu vākyasya naiva kasyacida- nyeva abhaviṣyan |
yatastu svayaṃ upalabdhyānumānanidhca parimitatvādivācyatvamavakalpate, yata ācārāḥ pravarta- parapratyayenaiva sadācārāḥ pramāṇamityāhuḥ; ato na dṛṣṭa- ran |
na ca dharmasūtrakāraistadeva ācārāprāmāṇya- mūlatvena adhyavasātuṃ śakyam |
smṛteḥ, nyāyasādhyasādhutve vicārī iyāha-) iti na cā''darśanenottarakālapravṛttā smṛtiḥ : teṣāṃ mūlaṃ vicāryate |

(tṛtīya- nārtha siddhāntena upakramate-) tatra pūrvādhikaraṇadravyale- prakāreṇa sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe-) 'ataḥ parimitaṃ śāstra- naiva prāmāṇyaṃ pratijñāyate (upakramate ityarthaḥ :) kartu- manumātuṃ yato'rhati |
na ca smṛtisarūpā'pi cit sadācārāḥ śrautasmartavirodhinaḥ |

' śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇamiti hi śrutānu- ntāt karoteḥ kāraśabdaṃ vyāpāravacanaṃ vyutpādya so'- mīyamānāyā ācāraḥ prathamaṃ siddho bhavet tatpūrvikā stāsti iti mattvarthinipratyayāntasya kāraśabdasya kartṛ- śrutiḥ |
'na tyācārasya sā mūlamiti nirmūlatā vacanāt śrautasmārtaḥ : tulyāḥ kartāraḥ eṣāṃ iti puna: |
) 'smṛtikārābhyanujñānāṃ mahadanyacca māṇatvāditi vā parimite śāstre pravartate |
prakāramāha-) parimitārthaviṣayatvādā śāstrasya 'aprāpte (upakrāntasiddhāntanirākaraṇārthatvena pūrvapakṣasūtramava- śāstramarthavat' (6|2|14|169) iti |
'dṛśyamānāntya- tārya vyākhyātuṃ adhyāhāreṇa pūrayati-) tadāpukurvannāha- hetutvātrātra śāstrapramāṇatā |
vaiśyānāṃ seva- śiṣṭācārāḥ pramāṇatvaṃ labhante śabdavarjitāḥ |
caritrāṇāṃ yathā śāstraparimeyatvaṃ tāvat pramāṇaśabdavācyaṃ dharmādharma- cārthasukhāṅgatvaṃ tathā''stviha |
(anyathā vyācaṣṭe-) parimitāni ca 'tasmāt śrutismṛtī eva pramāṇe dharmagocare |
na ca teṣāṃ madhye sadācāra- śīlācārāttutīnāṃ goṣṭīhasyāditulyatā |

na ca sadācāraḥ svayameva śāstraṃ (siddhāntaprakramaṃ sūtrādaṃ kartumupakramete-) yadvā sūtra- nāpi taddarśanamanuṣṭhānaṃ vā, atyantaparāyattvātprameya- śreṇepā (5-6-7) etadevādhikaraṇaṃ vyākhyātavyam |
(adhikaraṇaṃ racayati-) iha āyāvtanivāsiśiṣṭā- (tṛtīyaprakaraṇe vyākhyātuṃ vikalpaṃ dūṣayati-) cārānedāhṛtya pūrvavat prāmāṇyaprāmāṇyasaṃdehe śiṣṭā- 'kiṃ ca mūlaṃ bhavedekamanekamiti cintitaṃ |
na tāvaddeśajātikulabhedāt bhinnanāmasvarūpaṇā- tacchiṣṭācaraṇaṃ dharmaṃ pramāṇatvena gamyate |
siddhāntastu- dharmabuddhyā vaidhikairanuṣṭhānaṃ asati kopāttu nā''cāraprāmāṇyaṃ virudhyate |
vyatikramasāhasadarśanaṃ tu rāga- śā- 'ācāntena kartavyam' ityevamādīni dveṣādinidhanatvāt na dharmabuddhinibandhanam |
kiṃ pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ veti nibandhanasya ca ācaritasya anuṣṭhānākāraṇatvāt śruti- vicāraḥ |
tadarthaṃ ca pratyakṣaśrutyā virudhyante na veti |
manvādi- tadarthamapi ebhiḥ ṛtumadhye anuṣṭhīyamānaiḥ kasyacit bhisu lāghavikeḥ yadi nāma svarūpeṇanibadhyasāmānyā- śrutyarthasya kramāderbhavati vā na veti |
naitāvatā kaści- petyaiva virodhaṃ pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ veti vicāraḥ |
tasmāt smṛtivat ācārāṇāmapi dharme prāmāṇyaṃ pramāṇamevabalābalaviśadaṃ ke kiyāḥ iti cintyate |
soma- virodha eva kāsti ka nāsti iti viro- dhādhikaraṇaviṣayatvānyathāpyetat asya tena saṃgatirvodhā |
hetudarśanādhikaraṇasya tu samanantarasyāpi virodhādhikaraṇa- bhaktatvāt na tena pṛthak saṃgatyapekṣā |
'athavā' iti pakṣe tu virodhādhikaraṇena āpādādikī saṃgatiḥ |
sadācārāprāmāṇyādhikaraṇe tu śākyādisamṛtivat ācāra- vi- syāpi aprāmāṇyaṃ ityucyate : saṃgatiḥ |
vedaṃ kṛtveti yaḥ śrautaḥ kramastena viro- ghataḥ |
(atha vārtikakṛtaṃ śākyādisamṛtiprāmāṇyādhi- karaṇaṃ tu) 'śākyeoktāhiṃsaṃ dharmaṃ na vā, dharmaḥ śrutatvataḥ |
, na dharmo nahi pūtaṃ syād gokṣīraṃ śrutau dhṛtam |
bhāṭṭa- - smārtānāmācamanādīnāṃ śrautaiḥ kramakāla- parimāṇādibhirvirodhe śrautatvāt kramādīnāmeva prābalyāt tadviṣayasmṛtīnāmaprāmāṇyam |
na hi 'śrute ācānte' iti vihitasya smārtākramaṇasya vedavedikaramanuṣṭheya- ṣṭhāne 'vedaṃ kṛtvā vedaṃ karoti' iti śrutivihitaḥ kramaḥ anuṣṭhātuṃ śakyate |
smārtapadārthānāṃ ca bahutvāt pūrvāldākālaḥ prayogasiddhayavataṃ ca parimāṇaṃ na
na ca śrautatve'pi kramādeḥ padārtha- dharmatvāt padārthebhyaḥ ācamanādibhyaḥ daurbalyam |
pramāṇapūrvakatvāt prameyavāgamasya prathamāvagatapramāṇabalā- balāpekṣayā prameyatvabalavattvaṃ daurbalyam |
iti prāpte, padārthaprāpyapekṣatvāt kramādeḥ autpattikatvamādyamā- ṇagamyapadārthāvirodhenaiva kalpanīyatvāt na tāvat padārtha- virodhitvam |
parimāṇaṃ tu na kasyacicchāstrasya iti na tasya śrautatvam |
tadyadaiva prameyavirodha ālo- cyate, tadaiva tadvatena balācalena nirṇīte śāstrārthe, na pramāṇabalābalasya niyāmakamiha pramāṇameva tatsmṛtiḥ |
yadvā yacchāstramanveṣu vedāviruddhaṃ dānādivacanaṃ tasya bhavatu prāmāṇyam |
iti prāpte, ' svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ ', ' vedo'khilo dharmamūlam ', ' tadidaṃ ca smṛtiśīle ' ' purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsādharmaśāstrāṅgamiśritāḥ |
vedāḥ sthānāni vidyānāṃ dharmasya ca caturdaśa |
' ityādi- vacanairniyatapramāṇapratipādyatvameva dharmatvapratīteḥ, anyataḥ pramitasya phalasādhanatvābhāvāt teṣāmaprāmāṇyamiti |

iti prāpte, dharmabuddhyā vaidikairanuṣṭhīyamāna- tvāt smṛtideva vaidikatvam |
viśeṣataḥ anivandhanaṃ tu gauravamītyā na doṣa iti |

bhāṣyam - ' prajākāmo yajeta ' ' grāmakāmo yajeta' ityemādi karma samāmnāyate |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ; kiṃ prakrāntaṃ niyogataḥ samāpanīyaṃ uttecchayā kāryaṃ heyaṃ veti |
kutaḥ ? evaṃ hi śrūyate idaṃ kāmo yajeteti |

yataśrauditaṃ na niyogataḥ ārabhyante ; niyogataḥ punaḥ parisamāpyanti |
sā cecchabdārthaḥ, sā kartavya- satrā codyate |
tenopakrānte karmaṇi yadi vīyāphalecchā, avāpnoti vā phalam, tasyāmapyavasthāyāṃ kartavyamevopakrāntasya parisamā- panam |
nimitte cotpanne yatkartavyamityucyate taddine'pi nimitte kartavya- meva |
tatra yathā kāme'nuṣṭhātavyam, tathā''pagate kāme ārambhasya vidya- mānatvānnimittikī samāptiḥ kartavyā |
yadārambho vidhīyate, tataḥ samāptirivihitatvātnā- vadayaṃ kartavya |
tasmāt samāptiḥ śāstrodi- tattvāt vītāyāmapi phalecchāyāṃ kāryā |
phalārthinaḥ phalaṃ cikīrṣamāṇasyopāyo'yaṃ vidhīyate, na kartavyatā |
sā hi vidhīyamānā phalasya vā yāgasya vā syāt |
nahi yo yat kāmayate tasya tatkarta- vyatopedeṣyā |
idamupadiśyate, yāga upāya iti, yāgena kriyate iti |
yadi yāge- nānyasya kartavyatā, tadā na virodhaḥ |
phalakāmasya yadiṣṭaṃ tatkartavyamanūdya yathāprāptaṃ yāgasya sādhanatā vidhīyate |
yathā anuprāntaṃ nāvaśyopakramitavyam, evamupakrāntaṃ nāvaśyaṃ samāpayitavyam |
yatra śrutyartho na saṃbhavati, tatra vākyārtho gṛhyate ityuktameva |
dup - phalamātmana icchato yāga upāyo vidhīyate |
' kartavyopadeśaśca śakyeṣveva bhavati ' iti yāgaḥ śakyaḥ kartumisyatraiva kartavyatāvanasya kalpanā śakyā kartum |
na tu tadīyo yāgaḥ kartavya iti |
niyamo vā tannimittatvāt kartustat kāraṇaṃ syāt |
yo hyārambhamevajātīyakaṃ na samāpayati, taṃ śiṣṭā vigarhante, 'prākramiko'yam, asaṃtyavahāryaḥ' iti |
āha, śiṣṭāḥ punaḥ kimarthaṃ vigarhante iti |
vigarhante tāvat, kiṃ no viditena kāraṇe- neti |
aśiṣṭā eva te syuḥ, yadi vigarhayeyurvinā śāstreṇa |
taittirīyāṇāṃ cānyaparaṃ vacanamasti ('devatāmyo vā eṣa āṣṭarucyate yo yakṣya ityuktvā na yajate, traidhātavīyena yajeta na devatāmya āṣṭarucyate' 'yadi varṣettāvatyeva
mādhyamyo'heti ahastye, samuḍhe ca tṛtīye ṣaṣṭhe navame ca ityahastye |

ata: pūrvaṃ buddhirupa- dyate, paścāt śāto'rtha: |
(siddhāntī āśayamāha-) satyam, pūrvaṃ buddhirutpadyate, na tu pūrvye jñāyate |
bhavati hi kadācidetat yat śāto'rtha: sanna: ajñāta ityu- cyate |
na ca arthavyapadeśamantareṇa buddhe: rūpopalambha- nam |
tasmānna vyapadeśā buddhi:, anyapadaiyaṃ ca na pratyakṣam |
api ca phāmaṃ ekarūpatve buddherevābhāva:, nārthasya pratyakṣa sata: |
na ca aikarūpyam, anākārameva hi buddhimitumimīmahe, sākāraṃ cārthe pratyakṣamevāvagacchāma: |
api ca niyatanimitta: tantuṣveva upādīyamāneṣu paṭapratyaya: |
itarathā tantvādāne'pi kadācit ghaṭabuddhi: avikalendriyasya syāt |

evaṃ pratyakṣaparīkṣaṇe kriyamāṇe tasya bahi:pravṛttau sāmarthyasya sattvāt tādṛśabahiviṣayaviṣayakapratyakṣaviru- ddhasya bauddhābhimatasya nirālambanatvānumānasya anu- papatte: yatra pratyaye duṣṭaṃ karaṇam, uttarakāle bādhaka- pratyayo vā, tādṛśapratyayasya asamīcīnatve'pi yatra tadubhayaṃ nāsti tādṛśa: samīcīna: pratyakṣatmaka: pratyayo na vyabhicaratyeva iti na parīkṣyatameva pratyakṣam |
vaidyanātha: pṛ. 35. vṛddhatī-- nanu ca 'śūnyastu' iti saiva nirā- lambanatā upanyastā pratyayasya arthaśūnyatāṃ vadatā |
sā ca ātmano vā (dharma:), buddhervā (manasa:), jñāne eva vā (avasthito dharma:) |
evaṃ ca sa eva saṃvedya: iti prāpnoti |
kiṃ 'arthajñānayo- rākāramedaṃ nopalabhāmahe' iti jñānaśabda: pradarśanārtha evābhipreta: ? na |
saṃvidādhāre hi saṃvedye jñānamevāva- śiṣyate, buddhyātmano: śabdāditulyatvāt |
ka punaridaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ viṣaya eva saṃvidā saṃvedyate iti |
saṃvedyataiva hi saṃvedyatāṃ avagacchāma:, na viṣayatayā |
(uttaram-) kena coktaṃ na saṃvedyatayā saṃvedyatā avagamyate iti |
kintu saṃvida: pratyakṣatvāt tasyāśca jñānāramatvāt śabdādirūpatā tasyaiveti manyāmaha |
ko hi nāma dvayo: pratyakṣatāmavakalpayati saṃvida: śabdā- deśca |
na ca sarvalokavyavahāro'pyathaiḥ kalpanā iti yuktam |
na ca arthāntarānusaṃdhānānuvidhaṃ kacit kalpanāśabdāmilapanīyaṃ loke dṛṣṭam |
saṃvideva hi tadā dhīyate, kasyeyaṃ śabdādirūpatā |
(atra samādhiḥ—) yuktaṃ yadi grāhyagrāhakasaṃvedanaṃ ākārāntareṇa syāt |
na ca ākārāntaramupalabhāmahe, nīlādyākārameva hi ubhayaṃ prati- bhāti |
ekākāraṃ ca ubhayapratibhānam, kimanvataḥ pratibhānāt ? tadidamuktam ' arthajñānayorākārameva nopa- lamāmahe ' iti |
' pratyakṣa ca no buddhiḥ ' iti etaduktaṃ bhavati, pratyakṣa ca naḥ saṃvit iti |
tasmāt arthaśūnyā iyaṃ saṃvit iti siddham |
śūnyavādo tu na jñānātirikta bāhyo viṣayo'sti |
jñānasyaivākāro viṣayo jñāna- svarūpāmaka eva, svamaśanavat |
tathāhi, nīlādeḥ kiṃ jñānaviṣayatvam ? na tāvat padārthatvaṃ sattāvattvaṃ vā, nīlādeḥ pītāderapi viṣayatvaprasaṅgāt |
nāpi jñānajanakatvaṃnikāśrayatvam, rūpa- jñāne sparśasya viṣayatvāpatteḥ |
nāpi sādṛśyaviśiṣṭa- hetutvam, viśeṣaṇajñānasya jñānalena sādṛśyāt hetutvācca viśiṣṭajñāne viṣayatvaprasaṅgāt |
na ca atyantāsādṛśyaṃ vivakṣitam, tacca na jñāna- tvena, tasya sādhāraṇatvāt |
tacca tripuṭīpratyakṣajñāne kāraṇaṃ jñānanīyoḥ ekaśana- viṣayatvāt hetutvācca upapannaṃ viṣayatvaṃ iti vācyam |
jñānasya svasmin svasya hetutvā saṃbhavena viṣayatvānupapatteśca |
na ca jñāne nīlādyākāratāsamarpakatve sati hetutvam, tacca japākusumasyeva saṃnidhinā iti vācyam |
jñānavaicitryaṃ mānaṃ iti cet, na, arthaṃ vinā'pi svamajñānavaicitryadarśanāt |
nāpi jñānasyopādānahānādivyavahāratvam ( jñāna- viṣayatvaṃ), ghaṭajñāne ghaṭavyaṇukānāṃ viṣayatvāpatteḥ; sukhā- dīnāṃ svajñānāviṣayatvāpatteśca |
na ca sukhādiṣu 'sukhī' ityādiśabdaprayogo vyavahāra iti vācyam |
jñānaviṣaya- nirūpaṇapūrvakatvena śabdaprayogasya, tena viṣayanirūpaṇe itaretarāśrayatvāpattiḥ |
nāpi jñānasyaśatāvatattvaṃ tat, bhūtabhaviṣyatoḥ tadasaṃbhavāt, tatra mānābhāvāt |
kiṃca viṣayo jñānātmakaḥ, jñānena saha upalabhya- mānatvāt, jñānavattvat |
na ca 'ghaṭo'yaṃ' iti jñānasya jñānāviṣayatvena asiddhaḥ sahopalambhaḥ iti vācyam |
uttarakālaṃ 'śāto ghaṭaḥ' iti jñānasya smaraṇadarśanena pūrvānubhavasya āvaśyakatayā 'ghaṭo'yam' iti jñānasya jñānaviṣaya- kāvakalpanāt |
smādijñānānāṃ sākāratvamiva sarveṣāṃ sākāratvena jñānātiriktaviṣayābhāvaḥ iti khamataṃ pariṣkaroti |

jñānābhāvaviṣayake jñāne jñānābhāvasya jñānātmakatvā saṃbhavāt, 'tadeveṃda' iti sthāyitvaviṣayake jñāne sthāyitvasya kṣaṇikajñānā- tmakatvāsaṃbhavāt, 'idaṃ nānākāraṃ' iti citrabuddhau anekākārasya ekasmin asaṃbhavāt |
kiṃca viṣayasya jñānātmakatve jñānātmakatvajñānasya aparokṣatvaniyamena anumitiṣiyavadyadi parokṣatvā- nupapattiḥ |
na ca tatrātītaṃ jñānameva viṣaya iti vācyam |
tacchidra- viṣayatvaṃ jñānajanyaphalabhāgitvaṃ nityamatiriktaṃ vā ityuktaṃ prāk |
na ca svapradṛṣṭānto yujyate, tasyāpi bāhyaviṣaya- yatvāt |
tena anubhūyamānānāṃ bāhyārthānāṃ apalāpāsaṃbhavāt tadviṣayakṣaṇe na mithyātvam |
oṃ śūrā hi praṇatipriyā iti nyāyaḥ |

vyavasthā vā'rthasaṃyogālliṅgasyārthena saṃbandhā- jayāḥ, rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ, abhyātānāḥ iti homāḥ vaidika- lakṣaṇārthā guṇaśrutiḥ ||
laukikasarvakarmaśeṣabhūtā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ tuśabdena nivārayan siddhāntamāha |
homāḥ 'cittaṃ ca caturthīkaraṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ svāhā' ityādayaḥ trayodaśa jayāḥ nāma, 'ṛtādhāṭ- vāśabde vyāvarttayati |
sauviṣṭakṛtādīni kiṃ haviṣo haviṣyaḥ kartavyāni uta pādanarūpeṇa ciniyojakāni śrutyādīni iti tadvi- |
ekasmād haviṣaḥ eva iti saṃśaye sarvebhya iti yekārtha lakṣaṇamārabdhavyam |
lakṣitam ||' tadadbhāvamityena tāvadyo yena vinā na bhavati sa tasya śeṣaḥ |
svāminā ca vinā dāsā na bhavanti kadācana |
tathā gṛhādyastaiṣāṃ śeṣaḥ svāmī ca neṣyate ||
prayojyo yasya yastasya sa śeṣa iti niścayaḥ ||
'na ca svāmī dāsena rūpasparśā- dibhirvā yatodāhṛtairanyonyaṃ prayujyate |
puroḍāśa- kapālaṃ hi na ca tāvatprayujyate ||
nimittairna ca teṣveṣāṃ homānāṃ śeṣatā matā |

evaṃ ca sati śrutyādīnyeva tādarthyaprati- pādanarūpeṇa śeṣasya viniyojakānīti tadvivekārthaṃ lakṣaṇamārabdhavyam |
'yaḥ parasyopakāre vartate' iti - pārārthyamevopakāreṇa phalenābhidhīyate ityavaganta- vyam, na tvatraiva lakṣaṇoktibhrāntiḥ kartavyā |
tathā ca sphuṭī karoti 'ye parāthāste vaktāro bhavanti' iti |
paraḥ punarupākāralakṣaṇabhrāntyā vadati - 'yathopādhyāyaḥ śiṣyā- ṇām' iti |
'satyaṃ vartate' iti - tādarthyopakārayathārtha- pharadarśanadāhilakṣitaṃ śeṣatvamityupekṣyaitadekā- ntikapārārthyayuktamudāharati - 'tadyathā garmadāsaḥ' iti |
svāmini ca yajamāne śeṣabhakṣāṇāṃ darśanāt tasmā- |

nivartyante, tathā anyārthāvat iti cet pūrvapakṣī tathā cānyārthadarśanam |

rupāṃśu yaṣṭavyo'jāmilāya' ityevamādayo'ntarālasambandha- tadabhāve ca syādbhūyiṣṭhaprakalpanā |

asmin hi sati sūtrokte nānye bhāṣyakṛto- |
