śyene ‘śaramayaṃ barhiḥ bhavati’ iti śarāḥ kuśān nivartayanti |
bhā. 10|4|1|9. śyene śrūyate ‘lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavasanā nivītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti’ iti |
bhāṣyam- asti prakṛtau ‘nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ, prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇāṃ, upavītaṃ devānāṃ, upavyayate devalbhameva tat kurute’ iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kimupa- vītasya nivṛttiḥ uta anivṛttiḥ samuccaya iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? tasya nivṛttiriti pratyakṣaṃ nivītaṃ codakaprāptāsyānumānikasya nivartakam |
api ca prakṛti- liṅgasaṃyogo'pi ‘nivītāḥ pracaranti’ iti |
upavītamadṛṣṭārthaṃ, kathaṃ tasya kāryaṃ nivītaṃ vartata iti gamyate |
ata evā''tīyakaṃ karmasaṃskāraṃ vikṛtau adhikaṃ syāditi |
na pratyakṣaṃ, na codakena jyotiṣṭome upavītam |
pradhānaṃ hi abhaṃbhanva aṅgeṣu arthāt kriyate |
saṃbhavati cātra pradhānaṃ eva nivī- tam |
vi-- na ca nivītopavītayorvirodhaḥ śakyanīyaḥ; vāsobhyāṃ tadubhayopapatteḥ |

bhāṭ-- yattu atra bhāṣyakāreṇa śyene ‘nivītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti’ ityāmnātena prayogāṅgabhūtakartṛsaṃskā- reṇa nivītena atideśaprāptasya sarvakarmārthatvena vihi- tasya copāvītasya bādhamāśaṅkya arthādarthatvāt samuccaya iti siddhāntitam, tat asyādyarthatve śrāddhādāvapi prācīnāvītena saha upavītasya samuccayapatteḥ yāvajjīva- katrisutra - navatanvak - yajñopavītadhāraṇāśritaprakāraviśeṣa- syaiva upavītatvanivītatvādeḥ tattatkarmāṅgatayā vihitasya samuccayāsaṃbhavādvāpekṣitam |
bhāṭ. 5|1|6. śyene saumiko vidhyantaḥ avyakta- codanatvāt |
vi. 3|8|21, śyenāṅgeṣu yat hatinavanītamājyaṃ tacca kevalaṃ sutyākālīnāpaśuparoḍāśādiṣu kiṃtu dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu sarva- traiva jñātavyam |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|40. mīko. pṛ. 48 ‘abhimayane śyenākṛtiḥ kāmyaiva’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhāṭ. 5|1|10. śyenādau upadiṣṭena nivītena atideśasya upavītasya samuccayaḥ |
10|4|1|9-2. mīko. pṛ. 2327 ‘nāriṣṭhahomādīnāṃ ātideśikānāṃ’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
7|1|2|150-51. śyenādauḥ kartavyā iti vidhinā naiva pratipādyante, phalārthitayaiva pravṛtteḥ |
yo hi hitisiñcumicchet tasyāmabhyupāyaḥ iti hi teṣāmupadeśaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 29. śyenādyabhicārakarmaṇaḥ anarthaphalatvena anartha- rūpatvācca dharmatvam |
yathā kapotoṭarkitā- gatena śyena gṛhītastathā phākatālīyavat śyemiti |
7|1|2| 13-16. mīko. pṛ. 196 ‘atideśaḥ iṣau śyenīyadharmāṇām’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
śyenadharmājātaṃ iṣau nāma yāge atidiśyate ‘samānamitaracchyenena’ iti |
jyotiṣṭome tatrāgnihotravidhivadanusāre nānāvedastare prāpte darśapūrṇa- māsaprāptājñaviṣaye śyenānyāyena prākṛtena svareṇa tasya bādhaḥ |
śyenaphalasya abhicārasya rāgaprāptatvāt 'na hiṃsyāt' iti niṣedhaviṣayatvam |

yadi kāmādhikāro'pi niyogo yāgasya kartavyatāṃ vadet, sa ca yāgaḥ phalasādhanabhūtaḥ akartavye phale na kartavyaḥ syāt, iti phalasyāpi arthāt niyoga eva kartavyatāṃ vadet, tataśca phale'pi vidhyākṣitā aupādānikī pravṛttiḥ iti śyenaphalaṃ hiṃsā 'na hiṃsyāt' ityanena pratiṣedhuṃ na śakyate, pratiṣedhasya puruṣārthatvāt |
sa hi niyogaḥ anarthaḥ, yaḥ pratiṣiddhaphalaḥ |
na ca kāmādhikāre niyogo yāgasya kartavyatāṃ vadati, phalata eva kartavyatāsiddheḥ |
yadyapi niyogaḥ kartavyatayā pratīyate tatsādhanatayā ca yāgaḥ, tathāpi kāmādhikāre kāmyaphalasiddhiparyantatvāt śāstrasya na niyoga eva svasiddhayarthaṃ puruṣaṃ prayuṅkte |

tathā ca yāge phale ca pravṛttiḥ naupādānikī iti tatapratiṣedho na kartavyaḥ syāt iti śyena-phalasyāpi pratiṣedho nānupapannaḥ iti niṣiddhaphalatvāt anarthaḥ: śyenādiniyogaḥ codanālakṣaṇaḥ na dharmaḥ iti na kiñcitupapannam |
ṛju. pṛ. 29. iyenayāgasya sāmavedavihitatve'pi na kevalamudgātṛkartṛkatvaṃ kiṃtu jyotiṣṭomavat nānā ṛtvijaḥ kartāraḥ |
ci. 3|1|23. śyenayāge dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ dvādaśamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā, caturviṃśatimānaṃ prāyaṇīyāyām |
śyenavākye śyenaśabdasya yāganāmatvaṃ jyotiṣṭomnāmna iva pravṛttinimittāpekṣatvena vākyaśeṣopadarśitasādṛśyalambanena gauṇavāṅgīkāraḥ |
bhāṣyam-- asti audgātre samākhyātaḥ śyenaḥ, ādhvaryave vājapeyaḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ śyena udgātṛbhireva padārthaḥ kartavyaḥ, vājapeye adhvaryubhiḥ, uta ubhayatra nānatvaṃvibhiriti |
yathā, ādhvaryavamiti samākhyānātpadārthānadhvaryuḥ karoti, evameva vedāntye yathopadeśaṃ syuḥ |
yo yena samākhyāte vede upadiṣṭastasya padārthastenaiva kartavyāḥ |
tasmāt śyene udgātṛbhirvājapeye cādhvaryubhiḥ padārthāḥ kartavyā iti |
vā-- 'guṇamukhyavyatikrame tadarthanvānmukhyena vedasaṃyogaḥ' ( 3|1|19 ) ityatra vyākhyātaṃ yathā'ṅgāni pradhānavedapadeśaṃ labhante iti |
tasmāt śyene sarve padārthāḥ prāptā udgātṛbhiḥ kartavyā iti |
bhāṣyam-- tadgrahaṇāt prākṛtadharmagrahaṇādvā, svadharmaḥ svadharmaiḥ środaprāptaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ syāt |
yaḥ padārtho na codakena prāpnoti, tatra samākhyāyā niyamo bhaviṣyati |
yathā, śyene kaṇṭhakavitodantīti, udgātāre vitotsyanti, vājapeye copaṇaṃ puṭerapyantītyadhvaryurvo'pyiṣyanti |
vā-- uktam ( 3|1|29 ityatra ), vakṣyate ( 5|1|10|18 ityatra ) caitadyathā jaghanyakālatvāt prayogavacanaścodakāt durbala iti |
prayogavacanāśrayā ca pradhānasamākhyā, sā satyapi pratyakṣatve durbalā |
yāvaccātideśena nāṅgāni prāpyante tāvatkasya kartāraṃ niyacchanti |
yadā tu prātāni bhavanti tadaiṣāṃ klaptakartṛsambandhaśca kadācidapekṣeti kiṃ samākhyā kariṣyati |
na cātra prāptāvadho bhavati, śrutikalpanena samākhyāyā viprakṛṣṭatvāt |
uktaṃ hotṛtayā klaptamūlānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ prāptāvadho bhavati na kalpyamūlānīti |
tasmāt prākṛtagrahaṇena tadadhikārasāmarthyāt jyotiṣṭomadeva nānākartṛkaḥ syāt |
yadyapi ca prakṛtāvapi samākhyayaiva nānākartṛstathāpi klaptasambandhatvādvidhe śrutistulyā |
yatprākṛtaṃ kiṃcidāyāte tasya pradhānasamākhyāḥ kartā bhaviṣyatīti darśayāmaha-- 'avyaktaḥ śeṣe' iti |
kaṇṭhakavitodanādīni yadā pradhānasamākhyāte vede paśyante, vedāntare vā |
atha vedāntare paśyante tataḥ pratyakṣatve satyapi tathaiva viśeṣasamākhyāyā baliyasyā bhavitavyam |
sā tvitthaṃcihnaṃ kartṛsambandhena vini-yuktā satī pradhānaṃ gṛhṇate |
yā ca pradhānāṅge na vyāpṛtā sā taddvāreṇāṅgeṣvavatiṣṭhatīti kuta etat |
tena kriyata iti ca tatra vyapadeśaḥ |
tadātmanā ca śakyam 'avyaktaḥ śeṣaḥ' iti vaktum, nāvarśaṃ pradhānādevātarantī samākhyā'
khyānāt pradhānavedasya anyatve sati yathāsamākhyaṃ padārthānāṃ kartāraḥ sphurati |
' bhāṭṭa-- audgātre sāmavede śyenaḥ śrutaḥ jyoti- ṣṭomadharmavān |
tatra prākṛtājñaiṣpattideśena nānā ṛtvijaḥ prāsāḥ aupadeśikyā audgātrasamākhyayā bādhyante iti teṣu udgātā eva kartā |
prayogaśca prayogavidhinā śāstrasya eko vidhīyate iti samākhyayā ajñeṣvapi kartṛvidhi- rupadeśena |
ataśca yathaiva 'apsavabhyuyanti caranti' ityatra apāṃ deśatvāt sāṅgabhāvanāviṣayatvapratīteḥ prākṛteṣu prayājādiṣu abhivāghakatvaṃ tathā prakṛte'pi |

na ca samākhyāyāḥ pradhānamātre śrutāyā api aṅgaviṣayakatvasya kalpanīyatvena prayogavidhyāśritatvāt tasya atideśaprāpitāṅgaviṣayatvena tadapekṣatvāt upajīvyacodakaprāpita-nānākartṛtva-bādhānupapattiriti vācyam, satyapi tṛtīyāśravaṇe apāmapi aṅgaviṣaya- tvasya kalpanīyatvenoktavidhayā abhivāghakatvānāpatteḥ |
na hi tṛtīyāyāḥ sāṅgadhvadhikaraṇatve śaktiḥ; api tu pradhānakaraṇatve eva, tasya aṅgaviśiṣṭatvaṃ vinā anupapanna- miti aṅgaviṣayatvaṃ kalpyameva |
ataśca śarādau klṛptopadeśasthala iva kalpyopadeśasyāpi atideśabādha- katvaṃ vācyam |
ata eva yatra prakṛtāveva stotraśastrādau vedāntarīye viśeṣasamākhyārūpeṇa upadeśenaiva kartrantara- prāptiḥ tatra aṅgaviṣaye kalpyāyāḥ pradhānasamākhyāyāḥ bādha iva |
prakṛte vai atideśikatvāt pradhānasamākhyāyā eva prābalyam |

iti prāpte, ihāpi prayogavidhyāśritāyāstasyā aṅgaviṣaye kalpya- tvena upajīvyatātideśāpekṣatvāt tena ca kartṛviśiṣṭā- meva ca prāptatvena kartṛpekṣābhāvāt samākhyāyā ākā- ṅkṣāvirahe śrutyakalpatvāt, kalpyatve'pi vā prākṛtā- jñaiṣpattivābhāvāt na prākṛtakartṛbādhakatvam |

na ca evamapyapi tathāsvāpattiḥ; avyuvidheḥ pratyakṣatvāt tāsāṃ ca dhātvarthānvayasya avyupapannatvāt tṛtīyayā avayavya- karaṇakabhāvanāyāmanvayāvagateḥ deśatvena ca bhāvanetpa- nyitvābhāvena tatprayogāmyanyitvāt, prayogasya ca aṅga- pradhānasādhāraṇatvāt bhāvanānvayadvārā pāścātyadeśeṣaṇā- navye aviśeṣeṇa ubhayānanvayatātparyatā upadeśenaiva pradhāna iva ajñeṣvapi abhivāghāt |

ata eva yatra tṛtīyāśravaṇābhāvaḥ yathā 'yajñārthavayaṃ vai kāmyā iṣyastā upāṃśu kartavyāḥ' ityādau tatra pradhānakarmakabhāvanāyame- vānvayāt tasyāṃ ca aṅganyāyabhāvena pradhāna eva prākṛta- svarādivādhakatvam |

prakṛte tu samākhyāyāḥ pradhānamātra- viṣayatvāt tasya ca svāmikartṛkatvenānarthakatvānupapatteḥ svanirviṣayatvasyānyathātvānupapattathā kathaṃcit ānarthakyatadaṅga- nyāyena (3|1|9) aṅgamātraviṣayatvakalpane'pi klṛpta- kartṛkāṅkṣaviṣayatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt kalpakatvoda- nācopadeśikāṅgaviṣayatvameva kalpyate |
vastutastu teṣā- mapi viśiṣṭa svasamākhyāyaiva kartṛprāptatvena pradhānasamākhyā- viṣayatvam, api tu yāni vedamayāvihitānaṃ smṛtyu- numitavedavihitānaṃ ajñāni tadaviṣaye sā iti dhyeyam |
kiñca samākhyāyāḥ pāṭhamātranibandhanatvena 'uccairṛcā' ityādipat vidhānanibandhanatvābhāvāt prākṛtānāṃ ca sāmaveda- paṭhitatvādi tadviṣayatvābhāvaḥ |
śyenayāgasya prati- viddhābhicāraphalatvādanarthakaḥ iti siddhaṃ pratyudāharaṇam |
abhigṛpeṣa 'śyenamasya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt, śalā doṣaṇī, kaśyapevāṃso, kavaṣorū, sekaparṇā''ṣṭhīvantā' iti |
ebhiḥ śabdaiḥ sā sā ākṛtiruktā, prasiddhasannidhānāt |
yathā 'amī piṣṭapiṇḍāḥ siṃhāḥ kriyantām' iti siṃhākārāḥ ityarthaḥ |
vakṣaḥ śyenākāraṃ kartavyam, doṣaṇī prakoṣṭhau śalā śalākākārau, aṃsā aṃso karayapā kacchapākārau, ūrū kavaṣā kapāṭākārau, sekaparṇā karavīrapatrākārau aṣṭhīvantā jānusahite jaṅghe ityarthaḥ |
abhigṛpeṣa 'śyenamasya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt, śalā doṣaṇī, kaśyapevāṃsā, kavaṣorū, sekaparṇā''ṣṭhīvantā' iti paṭhitam |
tatra śyenaḥ, śalā śalāke, kaśyapaḥ kacchapaḥ; kavaṣā kavaṣau kapāṭo, sekaparṇā sekaparṇau karavīrapatre ityete śabdāḥ tattadākāraṃ bodhayanti iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
śyenādiśabdāḥ ākāraṃ na bodhayanti kintu kātsyraṃ kṛtsnatāṃ bodhayanti |
śyenaṃ asya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt asya paśoḥ vakṣaḥ kṛtsnaṃ udara ityādyarthaḥ |
evaṃ sati tathā vakṣādayaḥ padārthāḥ svato yadākṛtikā bhavanti tadākṛtikā eva udghṛtā bhaveyuḥ |
ākṛtivacanatāyāṃ tu vakṣādīnāṃ vikṛ- tatā syāt, tathā ca codanoparodhaḥ |
tasmāt kṛtsna- vacanatā śyenādiśabdānāṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
( nanu śyenākāraṃ ye doṣaṇī, śalākāre ye doṣaṇī tat uddhṛta iti rītyā arthakaraṇe ko doṣaḥ ? ke.) abhigo'sya tadarthatvāt |
ata eva ante 'gātraṃ gātramasmān kṛṇutāt' asya paśoḥ uddharaṇī- yāni sarvāṇi aṅgāni nyunāni na kartavyāni ityuktam |
tasmāt śyenādiśabdāḥ vakṣādīnāṃ kātsyraṃ bodhayanti iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. 'śyenaśalādayaḥ' (9|4|25) ityadhi- karaṇe vakṣaḥ kartanādinā śyenasādṛśyaṃ kartavyaṃ iti 'śyenamasya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt' anena mantreṇa anyathā-
🞩 śravaṇāni, dṛṣṭopakārābhāvāt adṛṣṭaḥ soma- miśraṇe somasaṃskāro'bhyupagamyate |
bhā. 9|4|12|47. 🞩 śrayaṇānāṃ tvapūrvatvāt pradānārthaṃ vidhānaṃ syāt |
agniṣṭome 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti, saktubhi- ramainthin, dhānābhirhāriyojanaṃ, hiraṇyena śukraṃ, ājyena pālīvatam' iti śrūyate |
payaḥ-saktu-dhānādīnāṃ yāni some śrayaṇāṇi teṣāṃ apūrvatvāt pramāṇāntareṇa aprāptatvāt pradānarūpe arthe vidhānaṃ syāt |
tasmāt śrayaṇaviṣaye payasi vatsāpākaraṇadayaḥ kartavyāḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
agniṣṭome 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti' ityukte payasi pradeyadharmāḥ kartavyāḥ pradānārthatvāt iti pūrvapakṣaṃ bādhante |
naitat payaḥ pradeyaṃ dravyaṃ kiṃtu śrayaṇārthe miśraṇārtham |
tasmāt asmin payasi pradānadharmā na kartavyāḥ |
agniṣṭome 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti' ityukte payasi pradeyadharmā na kartavyā iti siddhānte hetvantara- māha |
agniṣṭome 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti' atra maitrāvaruṇaṃ iti dvitīyāśrutiḥ tatpradhānā maitrāvaruṇagrahasya- somapradhānā |
tasmāt tasmin payasi pradānadharmā vatsāpākaraṇādayo na kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
agniṣṭome 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti' ityukte payasi pradānadharmā na kartavyāḥ iti siddhānte hetvantara- māha |
'sa mitro'bravīt payasaiva me somaṃ śrīṇan' ityarthavādaḥ śrayaṇasya tadarthatvāt |
'payo me dyuḥ' iti noktaṃ miśreṇa kiṃtu somaṃ payasā saṃskuryuriti |
agniṣṭome 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti' ityukte payasi pradānadharmā na kartavyā iti siddhānte hetvantara- māha |
saṃskāraṃ prati somasaṃskāraprakaraṇe 'payasā maitrā- varuṇaṃ śrīṇāti' ityasya vacanasya bhāvāt vidyamāna- tvāt payasā śrayaṇaṃ somasya saṃskāra iti gamyate |
tasmādapi hetoḥ pūrvaibhyaśca hetubhyaḥ payaḥ somaṃ apradhānaṃ guṇabhūtaṃ syāt |
tasmāt tasmin payasi pradānadharmā na kartavyāḥ; vatsāpākaraṇādayaḥ |
ke. 🞩 śrayaṇānāṃ 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti' ityā- dīnāṃ pradeyadharmā na bhavanti |
bhā. 9|4|145-50. 🞩 śravaṇena ekena sakṛt kṛtāyāṃ buddhau dvitīyaṃ guṇārthaṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavati |
śreyase vihitaṃ dharmyaṃ na sarvatra niṣidhyate ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ sadaikeṣāṃ na tu pithyaṃ kadācana ||
vā. 1|3|4 pṛ. 191. 🞩 śrāddhavratādau maithunaniṣedhaḥ ayaṃ puruṣārthamātra- viṣayakaḥ : ṛtvarthaḥ smārtādipratiṣedhaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 31. 🞩 'śriyaṃ hi satatotsāhī durbalo'pi sama- śrute' iti nyāyaḥ |
🞩 śrutāḥ api anupakāratvātra kartavyāḥ sarve dharmāḥ, ye arthavantaḥ te eva kartavyāḥ |
śrutena saṃbandho nānumitena prakaraṇādiprāptene- tyarthaḥ, prakaraṇāditaḥ śruteḥ balavattvāditi bhāvaḥ |
🞩 śrutadravyāpacāre nityakarmaṇaḥ prārabdhakāmya- karmaṇaśca pratinidhinā samāpanam |
6|3|13-17. mīko. pṛ. 2098 'pratinidhinyāyaḥ' ityatra adhi- karaṇe draṣṭavyam |
vi. 6|3|18. 🞩 śrutadravyasattve'pyatathaiva pratinidhicatvaṃ pratinidhipa- cāre na tu pratinidheḥ pratinidhiḥ |
6|3|14|32. 🞩 śrutapratinidhyapacāre'pi mukhyadravyasyasadṛśasyaiva pratinidhinvam, na tu pratinidhisadṛśasya |
vā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 709. 🞩 śrutyaugikalābhe satyanvitaruḍhārthasyājya iti nyāyaḥ |
ayaṃ hi viśeṣaviṣayatayā pūrvantyasya bādhako dṛśyate |
maṇḍapaṃ bhojayatītyatra maṇḍaṃ pibatīti yaugikārthalābhe ananvitagrahaṇerūparuḍhārthatyāgaḥ |

‘ samidho yajati... (tapa: kurvantya: ) atho vedā ajāyanta, agnerṛgvedo tanūnapātaṃ yajati ’ atra yajatipade vidhitvaṃ śrautaṃ vāyoryajurveda ādityāt sāmaveda:’ ityupakramya ‘ uccai- anuvādatvaṃ tu saṃnidhinā, saṃnidhiśca śruterdurbala: |
vi. ṛcā kriyate, upāṃśu yajuṣā, uccai: sāmnā, uccai- 2|2|2 śrutyā smṛti: bādhyate |
yathā- nigadena ’ ityāmnāte vākye jātādhikāra: jātasya 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 860 śrutyā smṛtirbādhyate |
uddeśyatāyā parigraha: ‘ audumbarī spaṣṭacodagāyate ’ iti śrutyā, ‘ audumbarī syāt |
śrute: ṛgādipadānāṃ ṛktvādajātāveva śakta- sarvā veṣṭayitavyā ’ iti smṛtirbādhyate |
jātānāṃ ṛgādimantragata- asminnadhikaraṇe (9|1|16|19-19) liṅgavākya- jātiviśeṣāṇāṃ ṛktvādīnāṃ adhikāra: śeṣitvaviśeṣā- saṃyuktā naivodāharaṇam, nirākṛtatvāt |
śrutyā tu yeṣāṃ paraparyāyaṃ prādhānyaṃ tātparyaviṣayatvaṃ syāt śrute: ṛgādi- tādarthyaṃ ta ihodāharaṇam |
tān śrutyā tadarthān manya- śabdānāmeva śravaṇāt iti kutūhalam |
ṭupa. 9|1|16|19 na ca dijātī adhikāra: syāt uccaistvavidhāryā: ṛktvādi- śrutyā anyena saṃbadhyamānaṃ vākyena ācchidya anyena jālavacchinnā: ityartha: śrute: ṛgādipadānāṃ ṛktvādi- saṃbandhamarhati |
bhā. 3|1|8|14 pṛ. 724, na hi dijāto śaktatvāt iti subodhino |
ṛgādiśabdasya śrutyā upayuktatāṃ lakṣaṇyā upayogāntaraṃ yujyate |
vā. śrutivattvāt ṛgādijātasyaiva uddeśatvena adhi- 3|1|19, rūpeṇa (‘rūpeṇa juhoti’) iti tāvat kāra: syāt iti kaustubha: |
karaṇavibhaktiśrutyā eva avaddho homo nānumānikai: vedo vā prāyadarśanāt |
‘ uccairṛcā kriyate, upāṃśu yajuṣā, uccai: sāmnā ’ 1|2|3|27, sarvatra hi parisaṃkhyāśabdāt evakārādvā iti ṛgādiśabdā: ṛktvādajātiparā na vedaparā vinā na śrutyā parisaṃkhyā niyamo vā ucyate |
vidhiveva iti pūrvapakṣe sūtreṇa prāpte siddhāntamāha |
vāśabda: tu evaṃjātīyasya phalena eva vyapadeśa: |
vedo vā tataveda: eva ṛgādi- 4|14 śrutibhyāṃ dviśabda-bahuśabdarūpābhyāṃ ‘yuvaṃ śabdādavaca: syāt |
prāyadarśanāt vedaprāye vākye hi stha: svapatī iti dvayorjanamānayo: pratipadaṃ kuryāt, vedopakrame ṛgādiśabdānāṃ pāṭhasya darśanāt iti ete atrumandiva: iti bahumyo yajamānebhya: ’ iti bhāṣyam |
uddeśyatāghaṭakaprāye vākyopakrame vedaśabda- jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā yathoktapratipado: kulāyayajñe darśanāt iti kaustubha: |
veda: vidhyuddeśa: mantrabrāhmaṇa- satre cotkarṣa: kartavya: |
vi. 3|1|14 ‘śrute: karmā- samudāya rūpavedadharma: , prāye vākyopakrame vedaśabda- ntarasānaṃ saṃnidherparikalpyate |
uccaistvavidhiṣu ṛgādiśabda: vedā eva pratyayasya pratyabhijñārūpeṇa saṃnidhinā ‘śrute: kammektā’ lakṣaṇayā vivakṣitā: na tu ṛgādimantrā: |
prapūrvāt śṛṇodhāto: bhāve ghañi prāyaśabda: upasargavaśāt na sarvasminviśeṣāt |
upakrame vedaśabdaśrava- ṛgādimantrāṇāṃ yajñedevavihitakarmāṅgatve upāṃśutvaṃ ṇāt ityartha: |
ṛksāmavedavihitakarmāṅgatve tu uccaistvaṃ iti vairūpyaṃ liṅgācca |
prajñayate, tasmāt ṛgādimantrāṇāṃ na vedaparatvaṃ iti ‘ uccairṛcā kriyate, upāṃśu yajuṣā, uccai: sāmnā ’ pūrvapakṣa: |
na vairūpyaṃ iti ṛgādaya: śabdā: vedamābhivadanti śaknuvanti itya- prajñayate |
sarvasmin tattadvedavihite karmaṇi aṅgabhūtānāṃ sminnarthe liṅgamapi bhavati |
‘ ṛgbhi: prātardivi deva vyatikrāntānāmapi ṛgādimantrāṇāṃ vidhivadeva svarā- īyate yajurvedaṃ tiṣṭhati madhye aha: |
’ ityatra dvau vedo vedasaṃyogācca prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |

ṛkśabdaṃ ca saṃkīrtya triṣu pādeṣu, caturthe pade upa- ṛgādimantrāṇāṃ vedavācipadasamavadhānatvāt vākyāt saṃharati bahuvacanena ‘vedaistyaiścireti sūrya: ’ iti tattadvedavihite sarvasmin ṛtau svaraniveśa: prāpta: prakara- ṛkśabdaṃ vedavacanaṃ darśayati |
tasmāt ‘ uccairṛcā ’ ṇena jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇena na bādhyate vākyasya prakaraṇāt iti ṛgādiśabdā: vedādhikārā iti |
bādheta iti pāṭhe tu svaraniveśaṃ prāptaṃ dharmopadeśācca nahi dravyeṇa saṃbandha: |
prakaraṇena prakaraṇānurodhena na bādheta ‘ uccai: sāmnā ’ iti sāmna: dharmopadeśāt ityartha: |
tasmāt ‘ uccairṛcā kriyate, upāṃśu yajuṣā, ‘ uccairṛcā, upāṃśu yajuṣā ’ iti ṛgādiśabdo'pi uccai: sāmnā ’ iti ṛgādiśabdā: vedopakramāt vedaparā: vedapara eva |
jātādhikāre tu ṛca uccaistvena sāmna iti siddhānta: |
nahi asya uccaistvasya dravyeṇa sāmnā śrutejātādhikāra: syāt |
tasmāt ‘ uccairṛcā, upāṃśu yajuṣā, upakramasyāyā vedaśrute: lakṣaṇayā jātiviṣayatā yuktā na uccai: sāmnā ’ iti ṛgādiśabdā: vedādhikārā: |
tu ṛgādiśabdena vedanāṃ lakṣaṇā''pi adhikāra: viṣayī- trayīvidyā''khyā ca tadvidi |

su. pṛ. tadvidi tān trīn vedān vetti iti tadvit tasmin 1186, uccaistvavādīnāṃ ṛgādimantrarūpaśabdajāti- sakalavedatrayavidi trayīvidya: iti ākhyā trayīvidyāyā dharmatvāt vedaviṣayatvapakṣe anekavedavihitānāṃ ṛgādīnāṃ prasiddhā loke |

tasmāt ‘ uccairṛcā kriyate, upāṃśu uccaistvopāṃśutvarūpaviruddhadharmadvayaprāptau aṣṭadoṣavikalpā- yajuṣā, uccai: sāmnā ’ iti ṛgādiśabdā: vedādhikārā patte: jātaviṣayatvaiva yuktā ityevaṃ āvṛttyā anyathā sūtra- iti |
trayī vedatrayī vidyā yasya sa: trayīvidya: |
pṛ. 1186, uccaistvadicidhānasya jyoti- vyatikrame yathāśruti iti cet |

prādhānyamapi ca nāṅgaravaghaṭakībhūtepsitatvāsthaṃ tadarthaḥ , api tu bhāvanātvat śabdabodhe viśeṣyamātram |
ataśca uktaprādhānyena īpsitatvāttvaṃ tat lakṣayitvā viniyogaḥ taddhitaśrutyā bodhyeta iti kārakaśrutito daurbalyam |
anyāni ca daurbalyakāraṇāni aindrādhikaraṇa eva nirū- pitāni (nirūpitaprāyāṇi spaṣṭamatratulyatvāt ) |

tasya pratipradhānamaṇuṣṭhānaṃ kurvataḥ kramaḥ siddha eva |
ṭup. 5|1|2|12. śrutyarthaviprakarṣāt śrutiliṅgādiṣu paraṃ paraṃ bādhyate |
vā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 830. śrutyavagataṃ hi śravaṇādavagatam, padāntarasaṃbandhaṃ vākyāvagatam |
vā. 1|2| 120. śrutisaṃbhave vākyaṃ kramate na saṃbhavatyāṃ śruto |
bhā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 714. śrutyādīni eva tādarthyapratipādanadvāreṇa śeṣasya viniyojakāni iti tadvivekārtha lakṣaṇamārabdhavyam |
vā. 3|1|2|14 pṛ. 658. śrutyādīni śrīṇyeva tādarthyadhāreṇa viniyoge kāraṇāni (pūrvapakṣe) |
su. pṛ. 1192. śrutyādayaḥ atideśaprāptāḥ pratyakṣeḥ śrutyādibhiḥ vikṛtiṣu bādhyante |
vā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 841. śrutyādayaḥ svasāmarthyāt saṃbandhaṃ pratipāda- yanto vidhiṃ pratipāditaṃ padārthe viśeṣe vyavasthāpayanti |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 384. śrutyādibhiḥ ānumānikaiḥ ānumānikānāṃ śrutyā- dīnāṃ bādhaḥ |
yathā paśyo anumeyaiḥ prayājādiviniyojakaiḥ śrutyādibhiḥ paśupuroḍāśe tadviniyojakānāṃ ānumāni- kānāṃ śrutyādīnām |
bāla, pṛ. 146, śrutyādibhiḥ pratyakṣaiḥ ānumānikānāṃ śrutyādīnāṃ bādhaḥ |
yathā śyenādau ‘śaramayaṃ barhiḥ’ iti pratyakṣaśrutyā ‘barhiṣi havīṃṣyāsādayati’ ityanumānikaśruteḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 146. śrutyādīnāṃ pūrva pūrva uttarottaranirapekṣaṃ pravartamānaṃ balavad bhavati, paraparaṃ tu pūrvapūrvādhīnaprāmāṇyaṃ na śaknoti tasyaiva bādhaṃ kartum |
vā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 830, śrutyādīnāṃ balābalam- ‘niḥśreyasohaṇaprāpyaṃ prātimātropapādi ca |
3|1|7|14 pṛ. 834, śrutyādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi idānīṃ balābalaṃ vicāryate |
3|1|7|14 pṛ. 822, śrutyādīnāṃ sarveṣāmeva ānarthakyapratihatānāṃ durbalairapi bādhyatvamiṣyate |
tadyathā- brīhādīnāṃ prokṣaṇādīn prati śrutyā śeṣitvaṃ prāpnuvadapi atilaṅghya prakaraṇambāpūrvasādhanatvakṛtaḥ saṃbandho bhaviṣyati |
3|1|7|14 pṛ. 861. śrutyādikaṃ ānumānikaṃ pratyakṣaṃ liṅgādinā bādhyate |
vā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 841. śrutyādintrayasya prakaraṇena saha virodhāvirodha- vicāraḥ |
śratirapi caturvidhā- vidhiḥ, pratiṣedhaḥ, abhidhātrī, viniyogī ca |
liṅgaṃ dvividham - śabdasāmarthyaṃ artha- sāmarthyaṃ ca |
śabdasāmarthyamapi dvividham - mantrasya karmasamavetārthaprakāśanasāmarthyaṃ ekavākyopagamanasāmarthyaṃ ca |
tatrottaraṃ liṅgavākyavirodhādhikaraṇe (3|1|7|14 pṛ. 847) bhāṣyakṛtā vyavahṛtam, pūrvaliṅgavākyavyā tattayoktā, “nanu ‘syone te’ ityasya yathaiva upastaraṇa-
tasmāt bhidyamāne vākye liṅgameva bādhitaṃ bhavati iti ! satyamevam |
liṅgamati khalu etadeva lakṣaṇakaṃ viprakṛṣṭā- rthakameva bhavati |
tatrāyaṃ prayoga- vidhiparaṃ nityānyameva kalpitatvādvākyavākyato hi pradhānavidhireva prayogavidhiriti |
dvitīyaṃ ' samidho yajati ' ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta ' ityādi |
vikṛtermahā- prakaraṇaṃ tu saṃdarśanāpi bhavati, asaṃdeśanāpi |
tatrāyaṃ yathā - rājasūye ' rājasūyāya hyanāmuṃnupāti ... rāja- sūyenajānaḥ sarvamāyurjeti ' iti saṃdarśaneodbhūtaṃ kramapra- raṇavalabalādhikaraṇe śāstradīpikāyāmuktam (pṛ. 246) |
asaṃdeśe'pi vikṛtermahāprakaraṇaṃ yathā - yatra vikṛtau prākṛta- kriyānuvādena kiṃcit vihitaṃ tat tatprakaraṇe gṛhyate yathā ' prayāje prāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti ' iti |
ahīnāmaraka- dvādaśāhaṃ ca dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ dvādaśopasadaḥ iti dvādaśatvaṃ ca |
atra ca kriyāmuddiśya ityuktervikṛtau dravyoddeśena jātyādividhau ' audumbaro yūpo bhavati ' ityādau na prakaraṇaṃvādhā ityuktam |
ata evoktaṃ citrādhikaraṇe'pi ' nāvāntara- kriyāyogāhate vākyopakalpitāt |
na ca audumbaravākye upalakṣitaniyojana- saṃkratho vākyīyaḥ iti vācyam, ānarthakyaparihārasya saṃnidhineva siddheḥ |
yatra tu pramāṇāntarāt kriyānvālāvaḥ tatraiva lakṣitakriyānvayaṃ yāvat vidhirākhyāsyate parṇamayīvākye iti |
evaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇeṣu vārtikādigrantheṣu yat prākṛtānuvādena vidhīyate ityādiṣu aṅgaśabdaḥ kriyāpara eva iti dhyeyamiti |
saṃdarśane ca vikṛtermahāprakaraṇaṃ rājasūye iva na kevalaṃ vācanikaṃ vikṛtyarthaṃ saṃdarśaneva bhavati, kiṃtu saṃdaṃśasyā- nekavidhatvāt anekavidham |

tathāhi [1] prākṛtājñā- nuvādena vihitāmapi saṃdaṃśaṃ yadasaṃyuktamapi vikṛtau śrutam, tadapi prakaraṇe gṛhyate, prākṛtānuvādena vihitayoḥ pūrvapraśācanayoḥ prakaraṇagrahaṇataḥ madhye ca tadicchedakatvamāvāt |
[2] tathā vikṛteḥ pūrvai asaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvihitam, tataḥ pūrvaṃ tu prākṛtānuvādena yat vihitaṃ tat asaṃyuktaṃ yat, tat vikṛtiprakaraṇe gṛhyate |
[3] tathā vikṛteranantaraṃ asaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvi- dhāya prākṛtānuvādena kasimidvihite tat pūrvamasaṃyuktaṃ prakaraṇe gṛhyate |

tadidaṃ medatrayaṃ valamalādhikaraṇavārtike uktaṃ ' yasyāṃ tu vikṛtau prākṛtaṃ kiṃcidaṅgaṃ saṃkīrtya tasya purastāt parastād vaikṛtamaṅgaṃ āmnāyate, tatra kathaṃbhāva- gṛhītāṅgamevabhaviṣyati tat prakaraṇapāṭhāt vijñāyate ' iti (2|3|7|14 pṛ. 852) |
tathā vikṛteḥ pūrvamasaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvihitaṃ pūrvaṃ tataḥ vikṛtyanuvādena yadi vihitam, tat asaṃyuktaṃ yat, tat vikṛtiprakaraṇe gṛhyate |
tathā vikṛteranantaraṃ asaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvidhāya vikṛtyanuvādena kasimidvihite tat pūrvamasaṃyuktaṃ prakaraṇe gṛhyate |
tadidaṃ bhedadvayaṃ vikṛtyanuvādena vihitasya prakaraṇaprāptautarkyaiva arthāduktaṃ

asya ca medadvayasya, pūrvoktasya ca medatrayasya udāharaṇāni mṛgyāṇi tathā sāṃgrahaṇī vidhāya tadaṅgaprākṛtaparidhiparidhāne ' dhruvo'si ' ityādīn trīn mantrān vaikṛtān vidhāya ' āmanamasyāmanasya devā iti tisra āhutīrjuhoti, ityāmanahomā asaṃyuktā vihitāḥ |

tataḥ teṣāṃ ' yat prayājānāṃ purastājjuhuyāta bahiḥśāmānaṃ sajātānāṃ dadhyāt, yadanuyājānāṃ parastāt, svargaṃ lokamaprāpmet, madhye juhoti madhyata eva sajātānāmātman dhatte ' iti prayājānuyājaiḥ saha kramo vihitaḥ |
tena prākṛtāṅga- saṃbandhitvena vidhānāt sāṃgrahaṇīprakaraṇāt anuccate : āmana- homāḥ prakaraṇataḥ gṛhyante |
tadetat caturthatantrasāre ' phalava- ddokhetutvāditasya pradhānaṃ syāt ' ityadhikaraṇe uktaṃ (4|4|14|7) |

' māhendrastotraṃ prati abhividyate ityatra tu abhiṣekādeḥ abhiṣecaniyaprākṛtāṅgasaṃbandhitvena vidhāne'pi na tena prakaraṇamanucarya tanmadhyavihitamabhiṣe- kādi gṛhyate iti saṃbhavati, tanmadhye abhiṣekādividha- bhāvāt ' iti tatpūrvādhikaraṇe abhihitamiti |
ata eva miśrā api nyāyaratnamālāyāṃ āmanahomānāṃ prakaraṇa- prājñatāmāhuḥ : ' vikṛtiṣvapi yat prākṛtāṅgamadhye paṭhitaṃ yathā āmanahomādi, tasya prakaraṇe grahaṇam ' iti granthena |
( liṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ vicāraḥ iti bindī mīko. pṛ. 3362 draṣṭavyam |
bhaṭṭasome- śvarastu balādhalādhikaraṇe " kramatve satyapi sāṃgrahaṇyādeḥ ' tisra āhutīrjuhoti ' ityādibhiḥ ekavākyatvopapatteḥ " iti manyena kramādeva āmanahomānāṃ aṅgatāmāha |
yadapi miśraiḥ śāstrīyadīpikāyāṃ caturthe ' phalavaddokhetutvāt ' ityatra saṃnidhigrāhatvamuktaṃ tadapi abhyupeyavādamātram |
ata eva tantraratne prakaraṇagrāhatāmuktvaiva saṃnidhinā'pi tadadhikaraṇasiddhiruktā |
tadevaṃ yatra prākṛtānuvādena dvādaśopasattva vidhiḥ, uktarūpaḥ sasavidhaḥ saṃdaṃśo vā, tatraiva vikṛtau prakaraṇaṃ viniyojakam, anyatra saṃnidhireveti siddham |
evaṃ pradhānasya mahāprakaraṇaṃ prakṛteḥ asaṃdaṃśodbhūti- kam, vikṛtestu saṃdaṃśodbhūtikamapi nirūpitam |
avā- ntaraprakaraṇaṃ tu saṃdaṃśodbhūtikameva, tacca prakṛternāstyeva |
vikṛtestu avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ saṃdaṃśodbhūtikaṃ saptame prathamādhikaraṇe ( 7|3|8| 20-22) varuṇapraghāsānāmuktam |

tatra hi ' upātrā vapanti ' iti varuṇapraghāsāvāntaraprakaraṇadhītami ' na vaiśvadeve uttaravedimupavapanti, na śunāsīrīye ' iti paryudāsavyākyatāvalādeva avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā cāturmāsyānāmeva atraiti vādaḥ, ityuktam |
punarapi samākhyā dvividhā sāmānyasamākhyā viśeṣasamākhyā ca |
vāla. pṛ. 9-12. śrutyādivirodhāvirodhavicāraḥ : prakṛtāviva vikṛtiṣyāpi draṣṭavyaḥ : vā. 8|1|5|120. śrutikalpanāde ahadaṃ kalpayanti iti lakṣaṇā- śabdaḥ parikalpyate |
yathā kāśikepu śālyo ( śāli- taṇḍulāḥ ) bhujyante, gāvaḥ ( gopyaḥ ) pīyante iti |
su. pṛ. 918. śrutikramaḥ : prātisvikavidhivihitaḥ kramaḥ śrutikramaḥ |

soma. 5|1|1 varṇakaṃ 3, yatra kramaḥ tadviśiṣṭapadārthāntaraṃ vā vidhīyate tatra śrutikramaḥ , na tu yatra kramādhikāyaḥ śabdaḥ : tatra śrutikramaḥ : 5|1|1 varṇakaṃ 3. varṇāḥ śrutena gṛhya- māṇāḥ yaṃ kramaṃ pratipādayanti sa eva vidhīyamānatvāt śrutikramo'bhidhīyate |
saha dharmaṃ sā yāti krameṇa paśuśeṣatām |

kecittu - 'tisra eva sāhasyopasado dvādaśā- hīnasya' iti dvādaśasya akriyātvāt aniti- kartavyatātmakatve sati kathaṃbhāva rūpaprakaraṇagrāhyatvānupapatteḥ sannidhimātreṇa prakaraṇakalpanāpūrvakasaṃbandhavaśānāt śrutisthānavirodhādetadudāharaṇatvaṃ yuktamiti |
atha pheyaṃ śrutirnāma ? na tāvat śaktaśabdamātram, aṅgatvapramāṇavibhājakopādhi- bhūtaśrutitvasya uktapramāṇatvavyāpyatvāvaśyakatvāt, niru- ktaśabdarūpaśrutitvasya ca tadavyāpyatvāt |
jyotiṣṭomādvāt tasya cāhā samāpyamānatvāt sāhasa iti padaṃ upapadāṃ jyotiṣṭomasaṃbaṃdhanatvāt; na tu uddeśyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vaiyarthyāt |
ataśca dvādaśasya- mapi taddeva upasadudeśena vidhīyamānaṃ prakṛtāveva niveśite, ahīnapadaṃ 'na hīyate' iti vyutpattyā jyotiṣṭomānuvādakam, vikṛtitvāt hi enaṃ anye ṛtavo na jahati |

'tasya samūhaḥ' ityanuvṛtti- sahitayā 'ahnaḥ kratoḥ' iti smṛtyā ahaḥ- śabdasya ṛtusamūhavācilapratyayāntatvavidhānāt, tasya ca īnādeśavidhānāt ahīnaśabdaniṣpattāvapi ahaḥsādhya- ṛtusamūhatvasya ahīnapadavaccacchedakasya abhyāsa- samūhātmakajyotiṣṭome satvāt tadanuvādopapattiḥ |
iti pūrvapakṣayitvā, upasanmādeśena dvādaśatvavidhau saṃkhyādyasya aṣṭodaśaduvikalpapatteḥ, tadaṅgīkāre ca saṃkhyāntarasādhanatvābhāvādvākyaikavākyānupapatteḥ |
sāhnā- hīnapadavaiyarthyāpatteśca vaidikaprayogāt ahīnapadavvyāhaḥ- sādhyaṛtuviśeṣasamūhātmakahīnasaṃbaṃdhana dvādaśa- śatavidhiḥ iti prāptaḥ : siddhāntāmāha |

nanyāstu, sudharmātamātra bhāvanānyatvaniyamena ṣaṣṭhīkhaṇḍe'pi para- sparānvayā(ya)tyutpatteḥ ahīnasaṃbaṃdhanadhupasadudeśena dvādaśa- tvavidhinupapatteḥ ahīnadeśena dvādaśopasattvameva ati- deśataḥ pūrvapravṛttyā vidhīyate 'tāṃ caturbhiḥ' itivat dvādaśatvavidhaure phalaṃ ityāhaḥ |
'pañcadaśānyājyāni' ityatraiva dvādaśapadārthopasatpadārthayoḥ anvayāsyāklṛptatvāt nanyo- kasya ahīnadeśena dvādaśatvavidhaure asaṃbhavaḥ |
'tāṃ caturbhiḥ' ityatra tu arthaprāpteḥ pūrvapravṛttyā ādānamāva- nāyā eva vidheyatvāt tatra catuḥpadārthavaiśiṣṭyasyetyutpatteḥ samuccayaphalakaviśiṣṭavidhivaibhavaḥ iti vaiṣamyam |

upasattvarūpe ca āna- rthakyaprasaktau dīkṣaṇīyāvādyaniyamanyāya rūpatātparyagrāhakasya nyāyatvena durbalatvāt upasannāpūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā mupetya ahīnapadasamabhivyāhārarūpa-vākyasyaiva tātparyagrāhakatva- mupetya ahīnapūrvasādhanabhūtaupasattvalakṣaṇā aṅgīkriyate |
yatra tu dīkṣaṇīyāvādyaniyamanyāyena samaṃ vākyasā- virotho yathā trivavākye sāhanapadasamabhivyāhārūpa- vākyasya, tatra na tannyāyabādhaḥ |

tātparyagrāhakayorapi ca balābalabalamuktaṃ tatratatra, yathā 'abhighrāṃ juhoti' ityatra homodeśena abhikramaṇavicau homasattvarūpe ānarthakyaprasaktau darśapūrṇamāsīmayamahāprakaraṇarūpatātparyagrāhakatvat pradhāna- homāpūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vidhāya mahāpra- karaṇapekṣayā prabalaprayājīyāvāntaraprakaraṇarūpatātparyagrāhaka- balāt prayājahomāpūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā iti siddhāntitaṃ tṛtīye (bhāṭṭa. 3|1|10) |

yadyapi dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntika- gatajuhotyupasatpadayoḥ apūrvavyabhicāra eva apūrvasāmā- nyasādhanatvalakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakaḥ, tathāpi apūrvaviśeṣa- sādhanatvalakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakatvena vādyaniyamanyāyādīnā- mupanyāsaḥ |
yadvā upasadādiṣṭadvādaśatvasya ahīnadeśena vidhiḥ, pūrvavākye uddeśyatvenopasthitatvāt upasadādeva āśrayatvam |
sarvathā ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śrutitvābhāvāt idaṃ vākyaprakaraṇavirodho- dāharaṇam |
vastutastatra tadvākyasattvāt tena satarātmaka- dvādaśāhe iva ahīnātmakadvādaśāhe'pi tatprāptisaṃbhavāt ' dvādaśāhahīnasya ' iti trividhapairaiva arthavādaḥ |
mahato dvādaśāhasya mahatī saṃkhyā, jyotiṣṭomasya tu svalpatvāt tritvameva praśastaṃ iti stutiḥ |

tathāhi, kiṃ viniyojakaprakaraṇena samaṃ atra vākyasya virodho'bhi- pretaḥ, uta apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakaprakaraṇena ? viniyojakatā''pi hi jyotiṣṭomamahāprakaraṇasya, uta upasadvāntaraprakaraṇasya ? nādyaḥ, jyotiṣṭomamahāprakaraṇasya upasaddvādaśatvagrāhakatāyogāt, jyotiṣṭomasya dvādaśa- vāramahāpratyāpatteḥ |

na dvitīyaḥ, pūrvāparavācanikāṅga- saṃdaṃśarūpopasadvāntaraprakaraṇe mānābhāvāt, pakṣadvaye'pi siddharūpatvāt dvādaśatvasya prakaraṇārthatvādyogāt, upasa- tpadasamabhivyāhārarūpavākyasyaiva tritvāṃśe iva dvādaśa- tvāṃśe'pi vinigamakatvāviraheṇa viniyojakatvopapattau
dīkṣaṇīyāvādyaniyama- nyāyena upasandanāpūrvasādhanatve lakṣaṇaye jyotiṣṭomamahā- prakaraṇasya tātparyagrāhakatvā tu na saṃbhāvataiva |
upasadā- ntaraprakaraṇasyaiva tasya tātparyagrāhakatvā'pi, upasadādampūrvā- vyabhicārasyaiva tātparyagrāhakasya satvāt nirākāryā |
uddeśyasya apūrvavyabhicāre hi prakaraṇasya apūrvasādhanatva- lakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakatvaṃ yathā 'vrīhīnavahanti' ityādi |
ata eva ādhānaprakaraṇe 'vāraṇo yajñavatcaraḥ' iti yajñasādhanatvena śrutānāṃ vāraṇādīnāṃ sākṣādyajñarūpe ādhāne niveśayogāt ānarthakyatadnyāyena ādhānā- ṣṭapavamāneṣṭirūpaye eva niveśaḥ |

ityāśaṅkya pavamāne- ṣṭīnāṃ 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti svaprakaraṇavākyena agnyādyaṅgatvān ādhānāṅgatvasyābhāve ka ānarthakya- tadnyāyāvakāśaḥ iti bhāṣyakāramatena siddhāntamabhi- dhāya vārtikakāramate tādṛśavākyānaṅgīkārāt prakaraṇena pavamāneṣṭīnāṃ ādhānāṅgatve'pi yaśodeśena vāraṇādidhau yajñasya apūrvavyabhicāre iha apūrvasādhanatvavāgamāt tadartha prakaraṇānupraveśasyābhāve vāraṇādīnāṃ ādhānāṣṭave eva pramāṇābhāvāt na tadaṣṭapavamāneṣṭiṣu avatāraḥ |
ato dvādaśatvaviniyogavicau prakaraṇa- vyāpārābhāvāt nedaṃ śrutiprakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇam, na vā vākyaprakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇam, api tu vākyayoḥ paraspara- virodhodāharaṇam |
pūrvapakṣimate vastutaḥ upasadāṃ jyoti- ṣṭomīyatvāt jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe dvādaśatvasya niveśaḥ, siddhānte na, ityataḥ prakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇatvena prācīna- navīnaiśca vyahriyate iti tattvam |
tat siddhaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śrutitvābhāvāt taddārakaviśeṣopādānam (uktānya- tamaniṣṭhasaṃbandhatvānavacchinnaśaktinirūpakatvaṃ iti viśeṣa- ṇam) |
kartṛtvakarmatvādipadānāṃ vākyatve- nāvācyatvāt tatrātivyāpyasaṃbhave'pi kartṛtvādipadadā- dipadādau anivyāptirdurvārā |
na ca kartṛtvādādīnyeva anyatamatvena anugamayya tadanyatamatvānavacchinnaśaktinirūpa- katvaṃ lakṣaṇam, tadādestu buddhiviṣayatvāvacchinnatadanya- tamaniṣṭhaśrutinirūpakatvaṃ iti na doṣaḥ |

tadādito'pi viśeṣarūpakārakabodhyānurodhena viśeṣarūpā- vacchinnaśaktinirūpakatvasya tatrābhyupagamāt, kapratyaye karmatvasya śakyatā'vacchedakatā'vacchedakatvena śakya- tā'vacchedakatvābhāvāt ativyāptivāraṇaprādhānyenetyasya vaiyarthyāt |
saktūn iti dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatvalakṣaṇayāmāpi vastutaḥ tādṛśāntyamatatvāvacchinnaśaktinirūpakatvāna- pāyāt atiprasaṅgāt |
'vrīhīna prokṣati' ityādivākyeṣu dvitīyādīnāṃ svaśakyatāvacchedaka-karmatvatvāvacchinna-tātparyakatvasya saṃsargādhikaraṇado nirṇītatvāt lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ |
saktūn iti dvitīyāyāstu svaśakyatāvacchedakakarmatvatvāvaccha- chinnatātparyakatvasya saktvadhikaraṇe nirastatvāt nāti- vyāptiḥ |
kartṛtvavācyatvamāva- chinnatātparyakavibhaktisya saktūnītyādirakaraṇādipara- dvitīyau ativyāptivāraṇāya svaśakyatāvacchedaketi |
ata eva ' prokṣitāmāmūlalulasulamā ' ityatra kapratyayasya karmatvaviśiṣṭe śakteḥ karmatvatvasya śakyatā- 'vacchedakatā'vacchedakatvena śakyatā'vacchedakatvābhāvāt nātivyāptiḥ |
' āgneyaḥ ' ityādidevatātvasya saṃjñāyatve kartṛtvādyanyatamatvamacce devatātvatvamapi upā- deyam |
na ca devatātvaviśiṣṭadravyavācakasya taddhitasya devatātvasya śakyatā'vacchedakatvāt devatātvatvaṃ na śakyatāvacchedakaṃ iti vācyam |
ākṛtyadhikaraṇa- nyāyena devatātve eva taddhitasya śakteḥ, dravye lakṣa- ṇāṅgīkārāt |

na ca ' rājā rājasūye svārā- jyakāmo yajeta ' ityādi rājādipadottaraprathamāyāḥ sādhutvārthatvena kartṛtvādyanyatamārthatvābhāvāt avyāptiḥ, ' abhihitakārakavācinī prathamā ' iti mate prathamāyāḥ api ākhyātārthakartṛtvādyarthakatvāt ' saṃbhedenānyatara-
vaiyarthyam' iti nyāyāt, prathamāyāḥ sādhutvārthamate śrutitvābhāve'pi kṣativirahāt 'rājā rājasūyena yajeta' ityādau rājādyanvayasya vākyapramāṇakatvopapatteḥ |
na ca rājapadottaraprathamāyāḥ nirarthakatve'pi rājājñatvaṃ kartṛ- tvādyarthakāvyatātparyaśrutipramāṇakaṃ iti śaṅkyam |
ākhyātasya kartṛtvādirśaktatvāḥ karmadhikāraṇe nirasta- tvena śrutitvābhāvāt |
kartṛprathamā''khyātayoḥ asaṃ- grāhyatve śrutilakṣaṇe kartṛtvavattvāddhāraṇatvamatvaniveśavai- phalyaṃ iti tu na vācyam, kartṛtvādiyāḥ saṃgrāhyatvāt |
na ca tathā (kṣati) tasyānvayatvena kartṛtvakarmatvādi- ghaṭakībhūtakṛtiphaladiṣṭadharmāṇāmeva tattaddharmikaśakya- tā'vacchedakatvāt kartṛtvādeḥ śakyatā'vacchedakatvāt asaṃbhavaḥ iti vācyam |
śakyatā'vacchedakabhūtatva- dharmadvayatvamatvaghaṭitalakṣaṇasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt, kartṛ- tvasya akhaṇḍopādhirūpatvena kartṛtvādereva śakyatā'- vacchedakatvāt uttalakṣaṇe'pi adoṣāt |

nanu 'maitrā- varuṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' ityādau maitrāvaruṇasya bhāvoddeśyasya caturthe (bhāṭṭa. 4|2|6) sthāpitatvāt daṇḍasya anīpsitakarmatvena anvayāvagāheḥ anīpsita- karmatvārthakapadapadottaradvitīyāyāḥ daṇḍājñatve apramāṇa- tvena śrutitvābhāvāt tatra utlakṣaṇatvāt iti |
īpsi- tānīpsitāsādhāraṇakarmatvatvācchabde eva dvitīyāyāḥ śakteḥ, daṇḍamiti dvitīyāyāḥ tadavacchinnatātparyakatvāt |

'vyāpyavyāpyasya sutarāṃ vyāpyatvam' iti nyāyena maitrāvaruṇasya bhāvatvāt daṇḍasyāpi karmatve- nānvaye bhāvanāyāḥ ekakarmakatvabhramāpatteḥ daṇḍapadottara- dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatve lakṣaṇā'ṅgīkāre karmatvāvacchinna- tātparyakatvābhāvāt |
ata eva sarvatra anīpsitakarma- padottaradvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatve lakṣaṇā |
ata eva dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatvaparatvaparyavasānāt, anīpsitakarmatvaparatvaparyavasāne iṣṭasyāpi bhāvyatvena vākyabhedāpatteḥ |
kiṃca dvitī- yāyāḥ anīpsitakarmatvaparatve saktūnāṃ homājñatve kiṃ pramāṇam ? na tāvat śrutiḥ, dvitīyāyāḥ homājñatā- prayojakakaraṇatvaśaktatvābhāvāt |
nahi śaktyā karmatvatvena lakṣaṇayā vā anīpsitakarmatvatvena anīpsitakarmatvoktiḥ saktūnāṃ homājñatvaṃ gamayati |

na ca 'somena yajeta' ityatra matvarthalakṣaṇayāpe somenikkaraṇatvasya śaktyā lakṣaṇayā vā vimaktyanuktatvena śrutivākyayoḥ somanidhyājñatāyāṃ pramāṇatvasaṃbhave'pi viśeṣaṇavidhirūpakalpitaśrutereva pramāṇatvamupete, evamihāpi iti vācyam |

yajipadasa- mbhivyāhārarūpatātparyagrāhakabalena somapade somakaraṇake, karaṇatvasaṃbandhena somavati vā lakṣaṇāyāḥ yajipada- samabhivyāhṛtasomapadarūpavākyasya somanidhyājñatve pramāṇatvāt, viśeṣaṇavidhitve'dhe eva vyāpārāt |
ata eva ajñatvaghaṭitakartṛtvādyanyatamā- vagatiḥ śrutavākyāt, vidhyanvayāvagatistu viśeṣaṇa- vidhitaḥ |
viśeṣaṇavidhau hi somakaraṇakabhāvanāyāṃ vidhyanvaye svaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣatā'vacchedaka- tā'vacchedakatvasaṃbandhena vidhiviśiṣṭarūpavidhyanvaya- tvāvagatiḥ |
karaṇatvāt tu somasvarūpāde iva viśeṣaṇa- vidhiranuvāda eva |
prakṛte tu saktūnāṃ anīpsitakarma- tvenānvaye homājñatāprayojakakartṛkaraṇatayāḥ śruta- vākyādanavagateḥ |
ata eva karaṇatvāvacchepakaghaṭita- viśeṣaṇavidhikalpanāyāmapi mānābhāvāt tasyāpi homājñatve pramāṇatvābhāvāt niṣpramāṇakameva saktūnāṃ homājñatvam |

śrutividhau hi kartṛtvādyanyatamasya yasyāva- gatiḥ, tadādyakṣaṃ padadvitaviśeṣaṇavidhiḥ kalpyate, yathā 'somena yajeta' ityatra tṛtīyāntapadaghaṭitaḥ, 'amā- vāsyāyāmaparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti' ityatra 'pade juhoti' ityatra ca saptamyantapadaghaṭitaḥ, na tu somavākye adhikaraṇatāvācakapadaghaṭitaḥ, padavākye karaṇatāvācaka- padaghaṭitaḥ |
tathā saktūvākye saktūnāṃ anīpsitakarma- tvāvagatau tadādyakṣapadaghaṭitaḥ eva viśeṣaṇavidhiḥ kalpyeta, na tu karaṇatāvācakapadaghaṭitaḥ, iti na tatpramāṇakatvamajñatvasya |
ato dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatva- lakṣaṇayā vākyapramāṇakatve eva viniyogabhaṅgāt siddhāntaparyavasānaṃ ityavagacchāmaḥ |
karmavācakapadottaradvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatvaparatvāt karmatvatvā- vacchinnatātparyakatvābhāvena na śrutilakṣaṇātiprasaṅgaḥ |

' ācāntena karma kartavyam ' ' vrīhīn prokṣati ' ' vrīhibhiryajeta ' ' viprāṃ gāṃ dadāti ' uttarārdhāt sviṣkṛte samavadyati ' ' yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityādinā krameṇa kartṛtvādivācakaśrutyudāharaṇāni |
' godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet ' ityādau ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā godohanasya pañcadvatva iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śrutilavyavahārastu gauṇa iti dhyeyam |
kecittu ajñatvapramāṇaṇabhūtā śrutiḥ trividhā- vibhaktī, abhidhātrī, viniyogakrī |
viniyogakrī trividhā- vibhaktīrūpā, samānapadarūpā, samānābhidhāna- rūpā ca |
etatsakalasādhāraṇasya ' nirapekṣo ravaḥ śrutiḥ ' iti pravādāsya yacchabdajñānaṃ anyanvayavidhānamapekṣya yada- rthajñānaṃ janayati, sā tasminnarthe śrutirityarthaḥ |
na ca viniyojakamānaprastāve vidhāvyabhidhātrīsādhāraṇalakṣaṇa- kathanaṃ tannideśaśca arhagato iti śaṅkyam |
vidhi- viniyojakasthāpanena vidhisahakāritvasya tayorapi tulya- tvāt |
śeṣaśeṣitvābhimatayoḥ tattadrūpeṇāvasthitayoḥ saṃbandhabodhau vyavadhānamapekṣya yacchabdajñānena janyate, sā viniyokrī |
saṃbandhaśca ajñatvamānā, sādhanatvavā- tmanā, saṃbandhatvāramanā vā pratīyatām |
tena 'dīkṣaṇīyām' ityādi aṭṭaḥ, tṛtīyāṣaṣṭhīpadaśrutīnāṃ ca saṃgrahaḥ ityāhuḥ |
na ca samānapadaśruteḥ 'yajeta' ityādipāyāḥ yāgabhāvanayoḥ saṃbandharūpāyeṃ śrutitvena tatra śaktatvarūpābhidhātrītvā- bhāvāt na tasya śrutitvavyāpakatvaṃ iti vācyam |

tathāpi śrutivibhājakopādhyantarasamānābhidhānatvena abhidhātrītvasya tadvibhākopādhitvasaṃbhavāt, samāna- padaśrutyā śeṣaśeṣiṇoḥ saṃbandharūpārthajñāne jananīye svaghaṭa- kapadārthajñānasya apekṣaṇīyatvena tvaduktaśrutitvasya samāna- padaśruto abhāvane abhidhātrītvasya uttavyāpakatvasyāpi suvacatvāt |
ata eva śrutilakṣaṇasya samānapadaśrutau avyāpteḥ tasyāḥ lakṣyatvakathanam api asaṃgatam |
na ca padārthopasthitiratiriktavyayadhāyakāpekṣātvaṃ utlakṣaṇaghaṭakaṃ iti nāvyāptiḥḥ iti vācyam |
' uccairṛcā kriyate ' ityādi saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsamānaśeṣo'pi saṃbandhake vākye ativyāpteḥ |

kiṃca ' saktūn ' ityatra prāthamikadvitīyājñānena karaṇatvajñāne jananīye śakyopasthitilakṣaṇājñānādirūpa-vyavadhāyakāpekṣatve api karaṇatvam, śakyasaṃbandhena dvitīyāvat iti jñānena kara- ṇatvajñāne jananīye vyavadhāyakāntarāpekṣatvāt dvitī- yāyāḥ karaṇatve śrutitvāpattiḥ, anapekṣānvayavaiyarthyaṃ |
yat śaktyā padārthajñānaṃ janayati, yat yatra śaktaṃ tat tatra śrutiḥ ityasyaiva suvacatvāt |

api ca śrautājña- vyavahāraviṣayībhūtaśrutitvasya vidhāvyabhidhātrīsādhāraṇe ' saktūn juhoti ' ' dhenurdakṣiṇā ' ityādau vākyī- yājñatvabodhe'pi vidhiviniyojyopasthāpanena vidhāti- padikarūpavidhāvyabhidhātryoḥ sahakāritā ajñatvapramā- ṇatā'vacchedakaṃ śrutitvaṃ vidhiprātipadikādiṣyāptameva vācyam |
evaṃ viniyokrīlakṣaṇe samānābhidhānasamāna- padaśrutisaṃgrahāya svaghaṭakapadārthopasthitivibhinna vyavadhāne viśeṣaṇabodho vācyam |
tathā ca saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsa- mānaśeṣo'pi śeṣaśeṣiṇvake ' dhenurdakṣiṇā ' ityādivākye ativyāptiḥ |
' saktūn juhoti ' ityatra karaṇatvaṃ dvitīyalakṣaṇaṃ iti dvitīyājñānena vyavadhānamapekṣya karaṇatvarūpasaṃbandhabodhāt dvitīyādeḥ viniyokrī- sthāpattiśca iti na kiṃcidetat |
ataḥ samānābhidhāna- samānapadaśrutyādiṣu śrutitvavyavahārasya gauṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya kārakavibhaktyasādhāraṇaṃ asajñatvalakṣaṇameva ucitam |
viniyoktrī tridhā ekābhidhānaṃ ekaṃ padaṃ vibhakti |
yasya hi śabdasya śravaṇādeva saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate sā vini- yogaśrutiḥ |

tadyatrānekārthābhidhānamekena śabdena yugapa- dbhavati vibhaktayeva liṅgasaṃkhyākāraṇāṃ tatra teṣāma- nvitānevābhidhānaṃ ananvitānānekameṣāṃ arthānāmekena śabdena yugapadbhidhānasyaikaśeṣamantareṇāsaṃbhavāt |
anyathā 'gāmānaya' iti yat yāṃ kāṃcitdyakti 'akṣamānaya' iti niyukto videva- nādīnāmantyatamānayetya saṃdihīta saṃdigdhe ca kiṃparo'yaṃ prayukta iti |
tatrāpi pratī- tivalena kārakaṃ pradhānato liṅgasaṃkhye guṇataḥ |
tathā coktaṃ yadā karmādayo vibhaktyarthāstairekatvādayo viśeṣaṇā- nīti |
etena vibhaktiyājyāḥ saṃkhyāyā viśeṣeṇa kārakaviśeṣaṇatvamidaṃ dhānā nirāstāḥ |
ananvitānāma- pyabhidhāne prathamakeśabdopāttena pradhānabhūtena ca kārakeṇaiva saṃkhyā saṃdhyate na prātipadikārthena viprakṛṣṭena guṇabhūtena ca |
prātipadikārthānvitaiḥ sā'bhi- dhīyate na kārakatvamiti tu svasamarthasamaṃtasatkṛtā- rthatattvānāṃ śraddhāmātraṃ na prāmāṇikaṃ pratītyaviśeṣāt |
yathā 'paśunā' ityukte paśuḥ kathaṃ pratīyate tathaikaṃ karaṇamityapi pratīyate eva |
na caikamabhidhānaṃ arthā- ntarānvitamarthāntaramabhidhānaṃ na dṛṣṭam |
prātipadi- kārthaṃ kārakaṃ vā prati viśeṣaṇabhūtasyaikasya tadava- dhīreṇa vidhyarthamadhīyasaṃbhavāt |
saṃbhave vā śeṣīṇādīnā- mapi vidhyarthatvaṃ syāt tadupapatte ca devatabhūtavāyu- viśeṣaṇatā kalpyateti kṣipidraguṇaviśiṣṭa eva vāyurdevatā syān vāyusvarūpamityalamanenālīkavivādena |

prakṛtipratyayārthayorhi śravaṇādeva saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate na padadvayadvaiparāmarśamape- kṣate iti padamapi śrutipakṣe niścityate tadekamekakāra- kāntitānāṃ jātiliṅgasaṃkhyānāṃ aruṇakahāyanonīyena parasparaniyama iti |
vibhaktistu saṃbandhameva sādhyatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ vā pratipādayantī viniyogakāraṇam |
tatra dvitīyā sādhyatvaṃ pratipādayati, tṛtīyādayastu sādhana- tvam |
tatra 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti dvitīyā sādhyatvena vrīhīnabhidhānyā avaghātasya teṣu viniyogakāraṇaṃ bhavati kathaṃ tarhi sukuṣu homasyāviniyogaḥ |
saṃkavo hi dvitīyā sādhyatvena prāptā api samīhitatvevadhuryāt labhyante |
na hi dvitīyā samīhi- tatvaṃ pratipādayati, api tu sādhyatvameva vadati tena saknunāṃ śeṣitvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti paridṛśya homabhāvanā bhāgyāntaramapekṣate, avaghāte tu naivaṃ paricchitkāraṇamiti |
avaghātabhāvanā bhavya samīhitameṣamāṇā dvitīyāprātipāditatvān vrīhīn bhāvyatvena svīkṛtya- mabhisithitā svarūpeṇa teṣāmahīhitatvādihilabhyate |
tatra yadi kathaṃcidapi teṣāṃ samīhitatvaṃ saktuvacca labhyeta tato viparivṛtya bhāgyāntaramapekṣeta saṃbhavati ca teṣāṃ prakṛtā- pūrvasādhanaviśeṣarūpeṇa samīhitatvam |
tathāhi 'vrīhi- bhiryajeta' iti yāgasādhanatvena vrīhayo vihitāḥ |
tena puroḍāśaprakṛtitvena teṣāṃ sādhanatvamiti tena rūpeṇa samīhitāḥ |
evaṃ ca yaveṣvapyaupadeśika evā- vaghātaḥ siddho bhavati tadrūpasya teṣvapyaviśeṣatvāt |

tathā hi darśapūrṇamāsābhyaṃ śruta- sāvaghātasya śrutisaṃyuktrīhimātreṇa prayojanāparyavasānāt 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ prakṛtena darśapūrṇa- māsavākyenaivavākyatvaṃ pratipadyate darśapūrṇamāsasaṃbandhino vrīhīnavahantīti tatsaṃbandhaśca prayojanāvinābhūtāḥ svasādhyaṃ prayojanamupasthāpayanti |
tasminnupasthite tadartha- tvamavaghātasya vrīhyarthatvaparitāyeṇa saṃpādayanti vrīhi- śabdastasya tatsādhanārthatā bhavati |
nanvevaṃ sati 'barhirmāti' ityasyāpi darśapūrṇamāsavākyenaikavākya- tvātsvasādhane barhiṣi lavanasya viniyoge'ṅgapradhānārthatā na sidhyet |

hi darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ vrīhirhiḥprabhṛtayastadarthena viśeṣe- pyante darśapūrṇamāsārthān vrīhīnīti kiṃ tarhi tatsaṃbandha- mātreṇa tatsaṃbandhittvaṃ cājñānāmapi upakārakatvādbhavatyeva tatsaṃbandhamiśra yatprayojanaṃ pradhānapūrvamanadyā apūrvamu- pasthāpyate tatsādhanarūpe vrīhirhiṅgadiśabdairlakṣitaṃ tatra viniyujyamānaṃ labanādi tasya sarvasyāṅgaṃ bhavati |
ata eva sthānādapīmopamīyāgena viśeṣite'pi yūpe vini- yujyamānānāṃ raśanādadharmāṇāmamīmopapradhānatadaṅgāpūrva- vyatirekeṇa tathūpasādhyasaṃvanīyāgāṅgatvamapi |
yathajñāṅgeṣvapi taddharmā bhavanti vaimṛghādreṣvapi tarhi vrīhitaddharmā upadeśenaiva bhaveyuḥ |
na hi vaimṛdhasya vrīhaya upadiṣṭā bhavanti yadā tu tatra codakena prāpnuvanti tadā sahaivāvaghātana prāpnuvantīti dviruktatvānnoṣadeśasaṃbhavaḥ |
ata eva savanīyasya veśa- ṣike dvitīye eva pariṇyāṇe raśanādīnāmupadeśo nānyatra dviruktadoṣāditi |
tatsiddhaṃ prakaraṇaśanā śrutyā ava- ghātādīnāṃ viniyoga iti |
prayājādiṣu tu śabdasvarūpameva viniyojakaṃ kalpyate ityevāvāndheṣaḥ prakaraṇādhīnatvaṃ tanmayāviśiṣṭam |

suvādestatsaṃbandhitvena viniyujyamānasya khādiratvādestaddvāreṇa prayojanākāṅkṣāyāṃ buddhāvavipari- vartamānamapi pūrvamapūrva tenaivāvyabhicāriṇā liṅgena hṛda- yamāgacchatīti vinā''pi prakaraṇaṃ tatsādhanarūpalakṣaṇayā viniyogopapattiḥ |
yatra dvayaṃ nāsti tatra sādhanalakṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate iti prakaraṇasahitā śrutiravaghātaviniyoge kāraṇam |
syādetat dvitīyā vrīhīṇāṃ sādhyatvamātramabhidhāyate avaghātasādhyatvaṃ tu tatpadasamabhivyāhārāmakāṅkṣādeva tatkathaṃ śrutyā'vaghātasya vrīhyatvamiti |
satyaṃ yathā āha bhavān kiṃtu viniyogaḥ śrutyaiva |
sa ca samīhitāsamīhitayoḥ sādhyasādhana- bhāva rūpaḥ |
tatra dvitīyā vrīhīṇāṃ samīhitānāṃ sādhyatvaṃ pratipādayantī pratiyoginaḥ śeṣitvamākṣipya tadiśe- ṣamātārthe vākyamapekṣate tenobhayatrāpi śrutireva viniyoga- kāraṇamucyate |
yatra punaḥ śeṣiśeṣayoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvo na śrutaḥ padadvayasamabhivyāhārādeva śeṣaśeṣitvayoyala- mālocya kalpyaḥ yathā 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti tatra vākyenaiva viniyoga iti |

na hi tatra svargakāmasya yāgasya vā sādhyatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ vā kenacidupāttaṃ padadvaya- samabhivyāhārādeva tu saṃbandhaṃ kalpayantyeva asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyādityanena nyāyena kāminaḥ prādhānyaṃ yāgasya guṇatvaṃ kalpyate |
bhavanasya hyatpannaparanāmadheyasya kartā bhāvyo bhavati svargakāmastvalpo notpannumahati iti na bhāvyaḥ syāditi taducyate |

svargakāmasya tāvadbhāvanā śeṣa iti vākyādavagamyate śeṣatvaṃ ca dvedhā bhavati yadi tāvatsvarūpameva samīhitasya sādhyati tadvataṃ vā ka- ciddharmamevaṃ ubhayathā''pi ca sādhyaṃ śeṣi bhavati yathā prayājādibhāvanāyāḥ |
ṛtuḥ hi prayājādibhiḥ ṛtu- svarūpamupasthāpyate tadupakāra eva tu sādhyate atha ca kṛtvarthatvena prayājādyaḥ saṃbadhyante iti vakṣyāmaḥ |
yathā ca vrīhayo niṣpannā apyavaghātasya bhāvyā bhavanti na hi svarūpeṇotpatyārthaṃ mādhyamiti niyamaḥ samastaḥ |
tatra prathamaṃ bhāvyatāmātrāmake śeṣitve'vadhṛte'pi kamupakāraṃ kṛtvā asyāṃ śeṣaḥ kiṃ svarūpotpatti kiṃ vopakārāntaramiti viśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ sāmarthyena viśeṣaḥ kalpyate |
tatra svarga- kāmasya bhūtasya svarūpeṇa bhāvyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti phala- viśeṣatvenaiva bhāvyatvaṃ bhavati |
yathā 'daṇḍī praiṣānanvāha' iti daṇḍaviśiṣṭasyaivacanājjñatvena codyamāne viśeṣyasya pūrvameva phalatvādviśeṣaṇabhūtasya daṇḍasyānu- vacanājñatvapratipādanaparaṃ vacanaṃ saṃbhavati |
tathā 'svarga- kāmo yajeta' iti vidhineva yāgabhāvanāyāḥ puruṣārthatve

prāpte puruṣasya śeṣitvaṃ na svarūpeṇa saṃbhavatīti kiṃcitkalimicchatastadviśeṣeṇa śeṣitvamiti sāmarthyādavagate svarga- kāmasya śeṣitvamucyamānaṃ svargākhyaviśeṣaṇaparameva bhavati tena svargasādhanadvāreṇa puruṣaśeṣatva- miti |

nanu naivātra svargaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate ityādinā phalasya vācakāmāvaṃ codayitvā anena svargakāmaśabdenetyuktvā nanu puruṣaviśeṣasya vaktetyādinā codyapūrvakaṃ puruṣaparatvaṃ phalaparatvaṃ ca svayaṃ nirasya nimittaparatvaṃ cākhyātopāt- kartṛsaṃkhvāvipakṣapratipādanāvasare spaṣṭaṃ sūtrakāreṇaiva 'phalakāmo nimittamiti cenna nityatvāt' iti paricchata- mityuktvā pariśeṣātphalasaṃyoga evāyaṃ ityupapadya kathama punaranena śakyate phalamabhidhātumiti pṛṣṭvā vacanavyakti- dvayamupanyasya 'malinaḥ khāyāt' itivat śeṣitvenānvayaṃ puruṣasya svargakāmāya yāga upadiśyate iti darśayitvā tatra ca svargākhyopakāraviśeṣapratipattiparatvameva saṃpatsyate ityante abhihitam |
anterāpi tadarthena puruṣamātra- mākhyātādeva gamyate tasmādāgataṃ svargo bhavatītyeva- mayaṃ vacanamiti |
tadevaṃ yatra sādhyasādhanamātrapratipādaka- vibhaktyabhāvastatra vrīhīmiti, śeṣe ca sādhanatva- pratipādikā vibhaktyardhyā 'somena yajeta' iti, tatra śrutiviniyogaḥ |
yatrāpyanyatratatra saṃbandhamātrapratipādikā ṣaṣṭhī yathā dabhendriyakāmasyeti śeṣiṇi yathāyathā yājyeti śeṣe tatrāpi yogyātvalocanayā saiva saṃbandhaviśeṣe vartate iti śrutiviniyogaḥ |
yatrāpi śeṣiṇi caturthī maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍamiti tatrāpi saṃpradānasya karmaṇā abhipramāṇasya sphuṭameva sādhyatvaśrutireva |
tadartha- caturthyā tu sphuṭatara eva śrutiviniyogaḥ |
yathā 'yaḥ somavāmī syāt tasmā etaṃ saumendraṃ śyāmākaṃ caruṃ nirvapet sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' iti |
yatra tu śrutiviṣayayaḥ yathā 'pūrvedyuramāvāsyāyāṃ vedim' iti śeṣiṇi saptamī 'saktūn juhoti' iti śeṣe dvitīyā tatra lakṣaṇayā sādhanavācinyā sādhyatvaṃ tadvā- cinyā ca sādhanatvaṃ pratipādyam |
lakṣaṇā ca sarvatra vākyanimittā iti vākyaviniyoga iti |
āha, kathaṃ punarvinīyogāśrute- rlevidhiyuktaṃ padasya kārakavibhaktīnāṃ ca viniyojakatva- miti hi dvaividhameva darśayati |
yā'pi hi laukikī samākhyā, tasyāṃ śrutinyāyena mūlaśrutikalpatve'pi na sthānādi- kalpakatvam |
yadi 'ahīnaḥ' iti ahargaṇanāmadheyaṃ tataḥ śrutyā saṃbhuktatvāt asaṃyukta- grahaṇamabhāvena prakaraṇena agrahaṇam, asti hi tadānīṃ śrutiprakaraṇayorvirodhaḥ |
vā. 3|3|8|15. śruti- prakaraṇayorvirodhe prakaraṇāt ekaviṃśatyānuvacanānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsāṅgatve prāpte śrayaiva pratiṣṭhākāmādiṣu puruṣārthā- vadhāraṇān prakaraṇabādhaḥ |
anuvacanānāṃ ca kriyāram- katvāt itikartavyatārūpatvāt prakaraṇagrāhyatvena tadvi- rodhādaharaṇatvam |
śeṣīnekalave tu pratiṣṭhākāmadarśapūrṇamāsa- prayoge prakaraṇāt pañcadaśasaṃkhyāsametatvena aṅgatvena prasakte ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā ekaviṃśatyanuvacanavidhānam |
śeṣanekalave tu pratiṣṭhākāma- darśapūrṇamāsaprayoge prakaraṇāt pāñcadaśyānuvacane aṅgatvena prasakte ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā ekaviṃśatyanuvacanavidhānam |
aṣṭau paradaurbalyavantaḥ ādhārāmi- hotrādhikaraṇe vārtikakṛtā nirākṛtāḥ |
su. pṛ. 495. śrutiprakārān aṣṭau paradaurbalyavataḥ kecidarśayanti- 1 dhātvarthavidhānaṃ yathā 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' |
3 kiṃcidvidhisya dhātvarthavidhānaṃ (vā.) dhātvarthasya anyatra vidhiḥ; (sudhā.) yathā 'vrīhīn prokṣati' |
4 viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ (vā.) anyatra viśiṣṭadhātvarthavidhānam, anyoddeśena viśiṣṭadhātvarthavidhānaṃ (sudhā.) yathā 'daśāpavitreṇa grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' |
5 dhātvarthoddeśena anyasya vidhānaṃ (vā.) dhātvarthe anyavidhiḥ (sudhā.) yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' |
6 dhātvarthena anyayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ (vā.) dhātvarthe anyasaṃbandhavidhiḥ (sudhā.) yathā 'prākāśā- vadhvaryave dadāti' dhātvarthe prākāśādhvaryūsaṃbandho vidhī- yate |
7 dhātvarthaviśiṣṭena pratyayena anyayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ yathā 'vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta' |
8 muktvā dhātvartha anyayo- reva saṃbandhaḥ yathā 'dadhnendriyakāmasya juhuyāt' |
bhā. 10|8|8|16 pṛ. 2073. śrutiprabhavayā smṛtyā liṅgādiprabhava arthavāda- prabhavā ca bādhyate |
vā. 3|3|7|14 pṛ. 860. śrutipramāṇakāḥ hi vaidikā arthāḥ |
nityeṣu karmasu śiṣṭābhāve śiṣṭasya vihitasya dravyasya alābhādinā abhāve sati anyasya pratinidhibhūtasya dravyasya anāgamaḥ āgamābhāvaḥ grahaṇaṃ na kartavyam |
śrutipramāṇatvāt mukhyameva dravyaṃ śrutipramāṇakaṃ pratinidhistu na śrutipramāṇakaḥ |
'yadi somaṃ na vindet pūtīkānabhiṣṛṇuyāt' iti kacit pratinidhiḥ vidhānāt jñāyate yatra na vidhīyate na tatra pratinidhiḥ iti |
agnihotrādiṣu karmasu śrudravyopacāre pratinidhigrāhyo na vā iti vicāre na grāhyaḥ, śrutasya dravyasya nāśe sati tadantaḥ prayoga utsraṣṭavyaḥ |
codanāyāḥ arthasya codanāviṣayatvasya mukhye pratinidhi ca aviśeṣāt viśeṣābhāvāt |
nityaṃ karma śrudravyopacāre pratinidhinā kartavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'yadi somaṃ na vindet pūtīkānabhiṣṛṇuyāt' iti yaḥ kvacit vidhiḥ sa niyamārthaḥ |
somābhāve pūtīkā eva grāhyā nānyat iti niyamārthaḥ sa vidhiḥ iti na tat prati- nidhibhāve liṅgam |
somālābhe pūtīkavidhānaṃ pūtīkaniyamārthe ityuktaṃ siddhā- ntanā |
tatra kathaṃ niyamārthatā avagamyate ? ityata āha |
yasmāt taccikīrṣā tasya yāgasya cikīrṣā niyatā tasmāt tat pūtīkadravyaṃ somālābhe nityaṃ

hi yasmāt taccikīrṣā somasādṛśyaṃ pūtīkeṣu dṛṣṭaṃ iti somābhāve tatprāptireva bhavati, tathāpi pūtīkadravyasya punarvidhānāt itarat somasadṛśamapi kiñcit dravyaṃ tyaktvā pūtīkadravyameva grāhyam, iti tat pūtīkadravyaṃ niyamam |
vārtikacchāyayā idaṃ sūtraṃ na lakṣyate iti kutūhalam |
ke. śrutipramāṇatvāccheṣāṇāṃ mukhyabhede yathā- dhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt |
mukhyānāṃ apūrvāṇāṃ pradhānānāṃ mede śabdāntarādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ siddhe sati śeṣāṇāṃ bhāvaḥ vidyamānatā yathā- dhikāraṃ adhikāra prakaraṇaṃ anatikramya syāt |
ye yasya apūrvasya prakaraṇe vidhīyate tasyaiva bhaveyuḥ |
ayamasya apūrvasya śeṣaḥ ; ayamasya ityatra śrutireva pramāṇam |
tasmāt yathāprakaraṇaṃ śeṣāṇāṃ vyavasthā iti siddhāntaḥ |
ajñānāṃ yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavasthā iti siddhānte sūtre- prokte vāśabdena taṃ nirasya pūrvapakṣī āha |
na yathā- prakaraṇaṃ vyavasthā kiṃtu ekadharmaṃ syāt aindrāgnādīnā- mapi pradhānānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsapradhānaiḥ samānadharmatā syāt |
yajño śrūyamānā dharmāḥ yajimatsu sarveṣu apūrveṣu syuḥ |
'gaunaṃ padā spaṣṭavyaḥ' ; iti gotvasaṃbandhena śrūyamāṇo dharmaḥ gotve asaṃbandhan golasaṃbandheṣu piṇḍeṣu vijñāyate tadvat |
codanāśeṣātvād vā tadbhedād vyavatiṣṭhe ra- nutpatterguṇabhūtatvāt |
sarvai dharmaḥ sarvārthāḥ iti pūrvapakṣa sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasya punaḥ siddhāntamāha |
te ca dharmāḥ tadbhedāt bhāvanā- bhedāt yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavatiṣṭheran vyavasthitāḥ syuḥ |
utpatteḥ yāgasya apūrvajanakasya guṇabhūtatvāt dharmāṇāṃ yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavatiṣṭheran |
pūrvapakṣiṇā sattvavat (7|1|12) iti uktaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ vaiṣamyena vighaṭayati siddhāntī |
sattve gotvādyā- kṛtau śrūyamāṇaṃ 'gaunaṃ padā spaṣṭavyaḥ' ityādi dharmajātaṃ sārvatrikaṃ sarvagovyaktigataṃ pratīyate iti yuktam |
lakṣaṇasaṃyogāt sarvārthāṃ vyaktīnāṃ golakṣeṇa lakṣaṇena saṃyogāt saṃbandhāt |
prayāgādyo dharmāṃ yajiprayuktā iti pratipādayati pūrvapakṣī |
evaṃ- na syāt, dharmāṇāṃ apūrvaprayuktā na syāt |
yadi sarve dharmāḥ sarvārthāḥ syuḥ; tata eva saurye karmaṇi prayāgānāṃ darśanamupapadyate |
anyathā prayāgāśca vidhyātavyāḥ prayājeṣu ca kṛṣṇalam |
tathā ca 'prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti vākyaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt |
tasmādyajiprayuktāḥ dharmāḥ sarve sarvārthāḥ iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
utpattī vidhabhāvād vā codanāyāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt tataśca karmabhedaḥ syāt |
utpattī vidhabhāvāt yāge dharmāṇāṃ na vidhiḥ |
yadyapi yāge śrūyante ca tathāpi teṣāṃ codanāyāṃ apūrve apūrvanimittā pravṛttiḥ syāt |
tataśca apūrvārthatvāt karmabhedaḥ karmaṇe cātyarthasya bhedaḥ syāt |
yadi vā'pyabhidhānevat sāmānyāt sarva- dharmaḥ syāt |
dharmāṇāṃ apūrvaprayuktatve'pi sarvārthatā iti pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
yadi vā api yadyapi apūrva dharmāṇāṃ prayojakaṃ tathāpi sarvadharmaḥ syāt sasa padārthaḥ |
kiṃca abhidhāna- vat vāhīka iti abhidhānavat |
yathā 'vāhīko'- tithirāgataḥ yavācamasmai prakriyatām' ityukte yogo vāhīkaḥ tasyatasya yavācaṃ kriyate |
evamihāpi ekasya apūrvasya ye dharmāḥ śrutāḥ te sarvāpūrvāṇāṃ bhavitumarhanti |
tasmādapūrvaprayuktatve'pi sarve dharmāḥ sarvārthā iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
arthasya tvavibhaktatvāt tathā syādabhidhāneṣu, pūrvavattvāt prayogasya, karmaṇaḥ śabdabhāvyatvāt, vibhāgāccheṣāṇāmapravṛttiḥ syāt |
pūrvapakṣiṇā ca sarvārthatve abhidhānavat iti śabdena vāhīkadṛṣṭāntaḥ uktaḥ |
tuśabdena tasya vaiṣamyaṃ sūcayan siddhāntī svapakṣaṃ sādhayati |

arthasya deśaviśeṣasaṃbandhasya sarveṣu vāhīkeṣu avibhaktatvāt anugatatvāt amitratvāt abhidhāneṣu 'vāhīkāya yavācaṃ kriyatām' ityādiśabdeṣu tathā syāt yavācasya sarvavāhīkārthatā syāt, tathā syāt sarvārthā syāt |
arthasya avibhaktatvāt prayogasya ca pūrvavatvāt abhidhāneṣu tathā syāt |

prakṛte tu karmaṇaḥ prayājādyasya śabdabhāvyatvāt śraute- naiva śabdena vidheyatvāt vibhāgāt apūrvāṇāṃ vibhaktatvena jñānāt śeṣāṇāṃ prakṛteraṅgānāṃ anyatra vikṛtiṣu sauryādiṣu apravṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttirna syāt |
kutūhale tu-- abhidhāneṣu vāhīko'yaṃ ityādyupa- deśeṣu arthasya yavācamapyatvasya avibhāgāt sādhāraṇyāt tathā syāt vāhīkāntare'pi yavācapariveṣaṇaṃ syāt |
kutaḥ ? prayogasya vāhīko'yaṃ ityādiprayogasya pūrvava- tvāt yavācapriyatāvādhāraṇapūrvavatvāt |
karmaṇastu śabde- ṇapramāṇakatvāt taddibhāgāt karmabhedāt anyatropa- diṣṭāṇāṃ śeṣāṇāṃ anyatra apravṛttiḥ syāt iti vyākhyātam |
darśapūrṇamāsādī prayājādyo dharmāḥ apūrvaprayuktāḥ na yajiprayuktāḥ iti siddhāntinā ukte pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
aruṇaparāśarāṇāṃ nāma śākhināṃ pariccheda nāma grantheṣu smṛtirūpaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati 'ye darśapūrṇamāsayordharmāḥ te sarveṣāṃ agnīṣomīyasya ca' iti |
tena prayājādyo dharmāḥ sarve sarvārthāḥ iti sidhyati |
'ye darśapūrṇamāsayordharmāḥ te sarveṣāṃ agnīṣomīyasya yasya ca' iti aruṇaparāśarākhināṃ smṛtyā sarve dharmāḥ sarve sarvārthāḥ iti pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktaṃ tat na |
sarveṣāṃ ca agnīṣomīyasya parokṣa darśapūrṇamāsau prakṛtī |
codakanyāyasiddhaṃ ca aruṇaparāśarāṇāṃ smṛtau prakṛtipūrvakatvaṃ anūditam, na tatra apūrve vidhā- nam |
arthasya śabdabhāvyatvāt pratiprakaraṇaṃ ca nibandhanācchabdādevānyatra bhāvaḥ syāt |

prayājādayo dharmāḥ kiṃ apūrvaprayuktāḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoreva vidhīyante athavā sarve dharmāḥ vikṛtiṣvapi vidhīyante iti vicāre sarvaṃ sarvārthāḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ nirasya apūrvaprayuktāḥ yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavasthā iti sādhitaṃ siddhāntaṃ nigamayati |
arthasya dharmajātasya śabdabhāvyatvāt śabdekapramāṇatvāt pratiprakaraṇaṃ ca prakaraṇe prakaraṇe tatprakaraṇe nibandhanāt vyavasthā syāt ye dharmā yasmin prakaraṇe vihitāḥ te tatraiva syuirarthaḥ |
nanu tarhi sauryādau prayājādayo na syuḥ iti cet, satrāda- śabdāt 'prakṛtitvat vikṛtiḥ kartavyā' iti codakaśabdāt anyatra sauryādāvapi vikṛtiyāge bhāvaḥ syāt vidhānāta syāt anujñeyā syāt |
kiṃca śabdāt 'eteṣāṃ rāṣṭrabhṛto juhoti' 'amyatānān juhoti' iti vidhānāt anyatra vivādādapi bhāvaḥ syāt |
śabdadeva anyatra bhāvaḥ syāt vinā tu viśeṣavacanaṃ anyatra bhāvo naiva syāt |
bāla. pṛ. 145. śrutibādhyaiḥ liṅgādibhiḥ yāni bādhyante tāni śrutyā bādhyanterāma |
dhātuḥ, prātipadikam, kṛdādiḥ pratyayaḥ, upasargaḥ, nipātaśceti dhātuṣvapi dvividhaḥ 'bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ' iti vihitadhātusaṃjñaḥ 'sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' iti ca ||
prātipadikamapi dvividhaṃ 'arthavadadhātu- pratyayaḥ prātipadikam' iti kṛtasaṃjñaṃ 'kṛttaddhita- samāsāśca' iti ca ||
nañdīkāyāṃ naño nivartanāvācilokteḥ, paryudāse ca naño lakṣaṇokteḥ mukhyābhāve ca gāvyādi- nāmiva lakṣaṇopapatteḥ |
ākṛtyadhikaraṇe 'yadaryathautako tau tu vācakaḥ sa vicāryate' |
cotakatvapaḍe'pi colasya tadanyātuvidhānāt tayoḥ vācakatvarūpaneva iti na śrutilāvighātaḥ padasyaiva prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ ananvi- tayoramidhānapaḍe'pi viniyojakaśrutitvāt |

viniyojakanī śrutiṣu aṣṭadhā - 1 vidhiśrutiḥ, 2 parasmaipadaśrutiḥ, 3 ātmanepadaśrutiḥ, 4 subantavibha- ntyāyapadarūpā vā upaśleṣalakṣaṇā iti gīyate, 5 ekapratyayatvā, 6 kārakavibhaktiḥ, 7 upapadavibhaktiśca tādarthyacaturthī, 8 śeṣaṣaṣṭhī ceti ||
tatra vidhiśruti- yathā - 'yajeta' ityādī sā svaviṣayabhūtāṃ bhāvanāṃ apuruṣārthaṃ yāgamapekṣya puruṣārtharūpe svargādau bhāvye viniyuṅkte ||
parasmaipadarūpā tu śrutiḥ tṛtīye 'tathā kāmo'rthasaṃyogāt' ityadhikaraṇe (8|1|13-14) siddhāntasādhakatvā uktā miśraiḥ |
'minuyāt' iti parasmaipadaśrutvā adhvaryūṇāpāraḥ parārthaḥ śrūyate, tayā śrutyā virodhāt 'yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāttrīcaiḥ sado minuyāt' iti tatasāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ kāmayetardhatye iti ||

ātmanepadaśrutyā 'āda- bīta' ityātmanepadaśrutyā ādhānasādhyāmisādhyakame- phalānāṃ āghātāyatā bhavati ityuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhe 'prayoge puruṣaśruteḥ' ityadhikaraṇe (6|1|2) tantraratne 'anyārthe nāmisaṃbandhaḥ' (9 sa. ) iti sūtre 'sauryādīnāṃ tu ādhānagatane ātmanepadena ādhānakṛtaiva phalaṃ' ityādinā ||
sucanātmakaikapadarūpā ekapratyayarūpā ca viniyojakanī krameṇa bādhyabādhakabhāvena ukte yathā 'tathā pañcañcamektvaṃ padaśrutyā pratīyate |
tiṅantātmakaikapadarūpā viniyojakanī śrutiryathā 'yajeta' ityādikā śrutirbhāvanāyāṃ dhātvarthasya karaṇatvaṃ pratipādayati ||
ekapratyayarūpā tu śrutiryathā 'paśunā' iti prāguktā suntrā, 'yajeta' iti tiharūpā ca ||
nanu suptiṅapratyayayoḥ kārakavibhakteśca bhedaḥ yena sa pṛthak nirūpyate ? ucyate |
arthānāṃ anyonyaṃ viniyoktrī, kārakavibhaktistu prātipadikārthakriyayorāśrayatvepi viniyoktrī iti bhedaḥ |
tatra 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityanuśiṣṭā 'vrīhīn avahanti' ityādiḥ karmaṇi dvitīyā ||
'tṛtīyā ca hocchandasi' ityanu- śiṣṭā 'yavāgvā juhoti' ityādiḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā ||
' gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanvani' ityanuśiṣṭā 'grāmaya yāti' ityādiḥ karmaṇi caturthī ||
'kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' ityuditā 'somena yajeta' 'brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaśca' ityādiḥ karaṇe kartari ca tṛtīyā ||
'saṃho- 'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi' ityuditā 'pitrā pitaraṃ vā saṃjā- nīte' ityādiḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā ||
'caturthī saṃpradāne' ityuktvā 'maitrāvaṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' ityādiḥ saṃpra- dāne caturthī ||
'kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ' ityuktvā 'phalebhyo yāti' ityādiḥ karmaṇi caturthī ||
'apādāne pañcamī' iti viditā 'agne- stṛṇānyacinoti' ityādiḥ apādāne pañcamī ||
'karaṇe ca sokāryacchukatipayasyāstvacanasya' iti vihitā 'stokrena stokādā muktaḥ' ityādiḥ karaṇe pañcamī ||

'divastadarthasya' iti coditā 'śatasya dīvyati' ityādiḥ, 'vibhāṣā'pasarge' iti ca coditā 'śatasya pratidīvyati' ityādiḥ, 'preṣyabhuvorhavipo devatā- saṃpradāne' iti ca vihitā 'agre chāyāsya havipo vapāyā medasaḥ preṣyānubrūhi' ityādiḥ, 'yajñeśa karaṇe' iti ca vihitā 'ājyasya yajate' ityādiḥ karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī ||
'caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi' iti coditā 'puruṣa- mṛgaścandramase godhākālakadāryāghātāste vanaspatinām' ityādiḥ saṃpradāne ṣaṣṭhī ||
'kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'ḍi- karaṇe' iti coditā 'pañcakṛtvaḥ divo aho bhuṅkte' ityādiḥ adhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhī ||
'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti coditā 'kṛṣṇasya kṛtiḥ, jagataḥ kartā' ityādiḥ kartari karmaṇi ca ṣaṣṭhī ||
'ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti coditā 'citramagopena gavāṃ dohaḥ' ityādiḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī ||
'samamyadhikaraṇe ca' ityupadiṣṭā 'same darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityādiḥ adhikaraṇe saptamī ||
tatrādyā yathā 'ājyasyeva no upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' ityādiḥ ||
prādhānye ṣaṣṭhī yathā 'tisra eva sāhasyopasado dvādaśāhinasa' ityādiḥ ||
bhaṭṭasomeśvaramate tu anyā api viniyoktryaḥ bhūtayaḥ ||
iti itakaraṇaṃ 'iṣe tveti śākhāṃ chinatti' ityādiḥ ||
tatrāpi dvayī gatiḥ, pūrvasyottaratvāt, uttarasya pūrvāṅgatvam |
tatra ādyodāharaṇaṃ yathā 'mūlataḥ śāstrāṃ parivāsya upaveṣaṃ karoti' iti |
dvitīyodāharaṇaṃ yathā 'vālayeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspati- savena yajeta' iti ||
evaṃ 'tumanṇakhau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' 'bhāvavacanāśca' 'aṇ karmaṇi ca' iti vihitārastumanudayaḥ ||
evaṃ 'saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyā- myāvṛttigaṇe kṛtvasuc' iti vihitaḥ kṛtvasuc ||
evaṃ 'dvitricaturbhyaḥ sun' iti sucpratyayo'pi 'vedi- rasi barhiṣe tveti trividhaṃ prokṣati' ityādiḥ ||
kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāmupapade anuśiṣṭena luṭā śrutyaiva ārambhādvātvādivaiḥ ||
pārtha- sārathimatate tu itakaraṇasya tāvat 'tathā''hvānamapīti cet' ityadhikaraṇe (3|1|15-9) siddhānte śrutivat śāstradīpikāyām |
ktvāpratyaye tu vākyīyamaṅgatvamukte tantraratne 'taccāphala saphala- vājapeyasamabhivyāhṛta vākyāt vājapeyāṅgaṃ' iti |
tantraratne'pi 'pareṇāvedanāt' itya- parivāsanam, vākyasaṃyogāt balīyasyā dvitīyā' |

vākyīyameva ādhānāottarakālasya somāṅgatvaṃ laṭaḥ kriyānvayasya vākyārthatvopapattī vākyatvāt |
yadyapya tantraratnaṃ 'yakṣyamāṇaḥ' iti ca 'dīkṣi- kriyāntarasamabhivyāhāre eva pamulādeḥ sādhutā, yathā |
313|7|24 pṛ. 859, śrutiliṅgādiṣu - tasmā- darthaviprakarṣāttu paraṃparaṃ ( pūrveṇapūrveṇa ) bādhyate iti siddham |
āha ca ( ślokapañcakena ) "niḥśreyasopa- prāpyaṃ prātimātropapādi ca |
" tasmāttaidālambyaṃ yuktaṃ yat kacit uttareṣāṃ prāmāṇyamiṣṭam |
yattu pramāṇābhāso bādhyate na pramāṇaṃ iti, tatra brūmaḥ |
' nahi yatra viṣaya bāghaḥ tatraiṣāṃ pramāṇatvam |
kiṃ tarhi ? pradeśāntare kevalānāmupalakṣitaṃ sāmānyato- dṛṣṭarūpeṇa atrāpi pratibhāti |
tastu balīyasā apahṛta- viṣayatvāt dīyatīti paścāt bhrāntitvena adhyavasīyate |
athavā yastatrāsya vyāpāra āsīt tamihāpi prakramate eva |
sa tu javavatā'nyena viṣaye'pachate mūlacchedāt yadā taṃ na gacchati tat kiṃ kriyatām |
anutpannameva ceha śrutya- bhāvāt śeṣajñānaṃ bādhyate āntarālikajñānamithyātva- kalpanayā iti notpattisāmānyena tulyabalatvam |
yo'pi ca utpannabādhaḥ tatrāpi phalaviyogamātmanā upapādaya- ṣyāmaḥ |
313|7|24 pṛ. 834-835, śruti- liṅgādiṣu - sarvatra hi parasya pūrvamanumāya viniyogānupa- pattiḥ |
pūrveṇa tu kṛte viniyoge parasya nāntarīkaṃ sadbhāvamātrakalpane iti pratipattiḥ |
āha, śrute- stāvat pratyakṣatvena liṅgāt balīyastvaṃ yuktam |
atha liṅgavākyādīnāṃ anumīyamānaśrutisāt aviśeṣe sati kiṃkṛtaṃ balāvabalamiti ? taducyate |
śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ yat kāraṇam, tat paraṃ paraṃ prati balīyaso bhavati |
netasyotpattisya vimṛśyamānasya bādhakaṃ vijñānāntaramasti, tasmātteṣāṃ samavāye virodhe paradaurbalyamarthaviprakarṣaditi |
śrutiḥ liṅgaṃ vākyaṃ prakaraṇaṃ sthānaṃ samākhyā ceti ṣaṇṇāṃ viniyogabodhakānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ samavāye ekaviṣaye virodhe sati pāradaurbalyaṃ jñeyam |
durbalasya bhāvo daurbalyaṃ parasya daurbalyaṃ paradaurbalyam, tadeva pāradaurbalyam |
parasya parasya durbalatvaṃ pūrvasya pūrvasya prabalatvaṃ iti jñeyam |
liṅgaṃ śrutikalpanāṃ vinā svārtha vidhātuṃ na śaknoti iti liṅgaviniyogaḥ śrutikalpatayā vyavasthitaḥ |
vākyaṃ ca liṅgaṃ śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā vini- yogamāha |
prakaraṇaṃ ca vākyaṃ liṅgaṃ śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā viniyojakaṃ nānyathā |
sthānaṃ ca prakaraṇaṃ vākyaṃ liṅgaṃ śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā viniyojakam |
evaṃ samākhyā sthānādiṣṭhantāni kalpayitvā viniyojikā nānyathā iti sā pañcamyaivehatā |
anena vyavadhānena hetunā parasya parasya durbalatvaṃ bhavati |
śrutyādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāni tadvirodhodāharaṇāni anyatra vistareṇa uktāni iti neha vistaraḥ |
śrutiliṅgāvirodhādhikāre mantrasvarasāmarthyā- locanena pūrvapakṣaḥ, ainyādhikaraṇe tu taditaśrutyālocana- yaiva pūrvapakṣaḥ ityupaniṣattvam |
śrutivākye anudāhṛtya 'śāstrāntare asti' ityabhidhāne yasmai yadrocate tat sarvaṃ sidhyet |
śrutiviruddhaṃ ( kṣīṇāṃ ) smārta vikrayaṃ nānu- manyante |
'śrutismṛtivihito dharmaḥ tadalāme śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇam' iti vasiṣṭhasmṛtiḥ |
athavā nyūnasya adhikāryaviṣayatva- kalpane lakṣaṇāvākyabhedau gauṇatvādyāhāradoṣau ityarthaḥ |
anyathātvakalpane vipariṇāmamyavahitakalpanā vyavahāra- kalpanā doṣa iti vā yojyam |
anumite tu vivakṣitā- rthābhidhānaśaktasyaiva anumānāt na kaściddoṣaḥ |
iti vārtikoktanyāyena ( 1|4|13 ) adhyayanavidhe svādhyāya iti dvitīyā guṇatvameva lakṣyate anyathā svādhyāye vājapeyavākye iva yāge guṇavidhau vairūpyāpatteḥ iti bhavadevokteḥ parihāraḥ |
yatra śubhe karmaṇi vigrahādyalyaṃ bhavet tatrāpyamavatati |
codanāsūtravat ' evaṃ tarhi śreyaskaro jijñāsitavyaḥ ' ityādi śābarabhāṣyam |
' evaṃ tarhi śreyaskaro jijñāsi- tavyaḥ kiṃ dharmajijñāsā |
ucyate, ya eva śreyaskaraḥ sa eva dharmaśabdenocyate iti |
śreyaḥsādhanākṣepatvakatvaṃ pravṛttiviṣayatvasya katha- miti cet, padasya |

'gāmānaya' ityukte gavānayane prayatnamanasya kutaścit kāraṇāt gavānayanāsiddhāvapi 'madājñāmayaṃ kṛtavān' iti ājñaptyupyavahāradarśanāt 'ito'pasara' iti cokte svayamaprayatnamanasya balāt kenacidasāritasya jāte'pi apasaraṇe 'nāyaṃ madājñāṃ kṛtavān' iti ājñaptyuḥ vyavahāradarśanāt, cetanā- pravartakatvācca pravartanāyāḥ, tasya ca prayatnamantareṇa anyatra apadṛṣṭeḥ prayatnaviṣayatvasiddhiḥ |
sā ca svarasataḥ puruṣārtha evaṃ svargaprupadau bhavati sādhanamantareṇa tadvideḥ tatsiddhayarthe tatsādhane saṃkrāmet |

tena svayaṃ apuruṣārthasya yāgādeḥ puruṣārthasādhanatvaṃ vinā icchā- viṣayatvānupapatteḥ pravṛttiviṣayatvasaṃbhavena tatra liṅādeḥ pravartakatvāyogān tannirvāhārthaṃ puruṣārthasādhanatvakṣepatva- siddhiḥ |
śreyaḥsādhanatvādhigame'pi bahuvyayayāsādarśanāt dveṣotpatteḥ stutimantareṇa anirākaraṇāt durdvārā stutyā- kāṅkṣā |
satyaṃ sarvatra ākāśa- mekam, kiṃtu tasya śrotrabhāvaḥ śrotradeśa eva, kartṛmiḥ sambandhena karaṇātvāt |
kartuḥ bhogāyatanena śarīra- deśa eva kartṛtvāt ( iti ) na śabdābhivyakti- tulyatā |
vadhutaḥ kartavyaḥ padārthaḥ, aparo'nyena, tatra athaśabdaḥ ānantyaṃ bravīti, yathā vedamadhītya itivat |
śā— dvādaśāhe satrabhūte śrūyate 'adhvaryurgṛhapatiṃ dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati' iti |
tadidaṃ kiṃ dīkṣā vidhīyate kramastu pāṭhato labhyate, athavā krama eva vidhīyate śrutikramo'yamiti |

kramastu nānyataḥ prāpta iti so'tra vidhīyate |

vaikṛtānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ āvṛttyā mantrakarma āhutayaḥ syāt |
na prākṛtānāṃ samuccayaḥ kiṃtu bādha eva |
dvādaśatvaṃ tu vaikṛtānāṃ dvirāvṛttyā setsyati iti |
vaikṛtānāmeva mantrāṇāṃ dvirāvṛttyā dvādaśatvaṃ saṃpādaniyaṃ na tu prākṛtānāṃ vaikṛtānāṃ ca samuccayaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ apivāśabdena nirastamuttaramāha |
prati- mantratvāt prākṛtīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ vaikṛtīnāṃ ca ṣaṇṇāṃ iti dvādaśānāṃ dīkṣāhūtīnāṃ pratyekaṃ pṛthak
'ākṛtimimaṃ prayujaṃ svāhā' ityādi: ṣaṭ prākṛtā dīkṣāhutimantrāḥ |
'ākṛtyai prayuje'ye svāhā' ityādaya: ṣaṭ abhivacane yaktvā dīkṣāhutimantrāḥ |
tasmāt prākṛtīnāṃ vaikṛtīnāṃ samuccaya: iti siddhānte yuktyantaramāha |
' ṣaṭ pūrvān juhoti' ' ṣaṭ uttarān juhoti' iti ca tatra paurvāparyaṃ pūrvaparaśabdau bhavataḥ |
na ca vaikṛtānāṃ kevalānāṃ abhyasyamānānāṃ pūrvāparatā upapadyate |
pūrvaparatāyā naimittikatvāt pūrvanimitto hi uttaraśabda: uttaranimittaśca pūrvaśabda: |
tatpṛthaktvaṃ tāsāmāhutīnāṃ pṛthaktvaṃ darśayati 'umayīrjuhoti ābhīkṣṇa ādhvarikīśca' iti |
vaikṛtānāmeva āvṛttau tu sarvā eva āmikyo bhaveyuḥ |
'adhvarasya pūrve athāgneḥ, upāgni hotat karma yadagmikarma' iti vyapadeśo bhavati |
vaikṛtīnāmeva dvarāvṛttyā dvādaśasaṃpadāne tu 'pūrvamadhvarasya, athāgneḥ' iti aviśeṣāt sarvāsābheva ābhiktvena viśeṣābhāvāt artha vyapadeśo na syāt |
kintu prākṛtīnāṃ vaikṛtīnāṃ ca āhutīnāṃ samuccaya iti siddhānta: |
'ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayati' (10|3|4) ityadhikaraṇe 'ākṛtimimaṃ prayujaṃ svāhā' ityādidīkṣādhyāyatopadiṣṭe: ṣaḍbhi: mantrai: atidiṣṭānāṃ 'ākṛtyai prayuje'ye svāhā' ityādīnāṃ samuccaya: ukta: |
bāla. pṛ. 177. 'ṣaḍbhirhalai: karṣati' iti saṃvidhānaṃ kurvan vilekhana akurvan api ucyate, tatsamarthamācara-
' ṣaḍbhirhalai: karṣati' iti vilekhanavacana: san kṛṣi: ṣaḍahalopādānasāmarthyāt vilekhitṛviṣayasaṃbhavāt tatrayojakāvyāpāre vartate |
na hi halaṣaṭkena eka: kartā vilekhituṃ śaknoti |
tena paṇṇāmeva vilekhitānāṃ ya: saṃnidhānena prayojaka: sa tadvyāpāreṇa kṛṣerpi kartā bhavatītyevamabhidhīyate |
vā. pṛ. 168. ṣaṇṇāṃ tu karmaṇāmasa nīṇāṃ karmāṇi jīvikā |
oṃ ṣaṭkarṇo midyate mantra: iti nyāya: |
ṣaṭkarṇakayā: karṇā yasmin tathābhūta:, tṛtīyapuruṣaśruta ityartha: |

su. 3|7 pṛ. 28. (eṣāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ madhye kaścit gṛhastho yo bahupoṣavarga: sa prakṛtai: śrutāyācitabhaikṣakṛṣivāṇijavai: pañcabhi: kusīdena ca ityevaṃ ṣaḍbhi: karmabhi: ṣaṭkarmā bhavati ṣaḍbhiratairjīvati |
ukta- trayāpekṣayā caturtha: puna: brahmasatreṇa adhyāpanena jīvati |
'yo'gniṃ citvā na pratiṣṭhita, pañca pūrvāścitayo bhavanti, atha ṣaṣṭhīṃ citiṃ cinute' iti śrutam |
tatra kiṃ yo'gniṃ niviṣṭo'gni: sa eva ṣaṭcitika: uta eka- citikanimitta iti vicāre agni: (cayanaṃ) ṣaṭcitireva nitya: syāt |
pūrvo yo'gni: pañcacitika: tanmūtaiva pañcāścitividhānāt ṣaṭciti: pūrvavattvaṃ pūrvapañcacitikāgnimata vartata eveti |
tathā ca pañcacitipūrvatvaṃ pañcāścitirādavaśyakaṃ iti ṣaṣṭhyā: pūrvavattvam |
tasmāt ṣaṭcitiko'gni: nitya: iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
agni: (cayanaṃ) ṣaṭcitiko nitya: iti pūrva- pakṣe hetvantaraṃ sūtram |
tābhi: pūrvabhi: pañcabhiści- tibhi: pañcāścita: tulyaṃ saṃkhyāṃ gaṇanā kṛtā dṛśyate |
cayanaṃ ca ittham, 'iyaṃ vāva prathamā citi:, oṣadhaya: purīṣam |
antarikṣaṃ vāva dvitīyā citi:, vayāṃsi purīṣam |
agne vāva tṛtīyā citi:, nakṣatrāṇi purīṣam |
yajño vāva caturthī citi:, dakṣiṇā purīṣam |
yajamāno vāva pañcamī citi:, prajā: purī- ṣam |
saṃvatsaro vāva ṣaṣṭhī citi:, ṛtava: purīṣam' iti |
pūrvapakṣe hetvantaraṃ sūtram ' ṣaṭ citayo bhavanti, ṣaṭ purīṣāṇi, tāni dvādaśa, dvādaśa māsā: saṃvatsara:, saṃvatsara eva pratiṣṭhita' iti arthavādo bhavati |
agni: (cayanaṃ) ṣaṭcitika eva nitya: iti sūtra- trayeṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpte vāśabdena taṃ nirasya siddhāntāmāha |
hi yasmāt apavṛkte samāse yāge tata: pratiṣṭhāyā aprāptau pratiṣṭhā- prāptirūpeṇa nimittena ṣaṣṭhī citiśśrūyate |
tena ṣaṭ- citikatvaṃ saṃpādayitumeva na śakyate |
tasmāt pañcacitiko nitya: eka- citikaśca naimittika: |
'tābhiśca tulyasaṃkhyatvāt, arthavādopapatteśca' (4|4|15-16) iti pūrvapakṣasūtrasya uttaraṃ anena mī. ko. 501

ṣaṣṭhyāśrite: nityatvasya 'yo'gniṃ citvā' ityupakramagatayacchabdena nimittasamarpakena vipratiṣedhāt nityatvanaimittikatvayo: virodhāt tābhi: pūrvacitibhi: samānasaṃkhyatvaṃ tulyatvena ṣaṣṭhyā: parigaṇanaṃ atulyatve'pi syāt |
yathā 'devā manuṣyā: pitaraste'nyata āsan' iti atulyānāmapi tulyatvena parigaṇanaṃ kṛtaṃ tadvat |
tasmāt pañcacitika evāgnirnitya: ṣaṭcitika- śca naimittika iti siddhānta: |
8|3|16-7. mīko. pṛ. 226 'atideśa: ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre ṣaḍaharmā- ṇām' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre śrūyate 'ṣaḍahā bhavanti ... catvāro bhavanti' iti ṣaḍbhirhobhi: niṣpādya: karmaviśeṣa: ṣaḍahaśabdavācya: |
tathā ca ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre ṣaḍahanāmakasya karmaviśeṣasya vidhyanto'tideśatve'tidekṣya: ṣaḍahatvaliṅgāt na tu dvādaśāhasya |
bhā. 9|1|12|9 varṇakaṃ 2, ṣaṭtriṃśat saṃvatsarai māṃsa- mayā eva puroḍāśā: paryagnikartavyā: siddhānte |
' ṣaḍaśītireṣā vakraya: ' iti samāsavacanaṃ aśvamedhe aśvavakrayatprakāśanānāṃ vaiśeṣikamantrākaraṇa- pakṣe aśvataragomṛgāṇāmbhya |
ṣaḍahā bhavanti, catvāro bhavanti' iti karmaviśeṣe (ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre - bhā.) ṣaḍahambhāsa:; na tu dvādaśāhikānāṃ pravṛtti: |
bhā. 8|3|16-7, ṣaḍahasya pṛṣṭhyasya karmāntarvyavadhānācca madhya- jñānāderapyutpattirgāmyane |
ṣaḍahe pṛṣṭhye upadiṣṭena mantraśanena atideśikaprayogādīnāṃ na bādha: |
bhā. 10|6|127-28. ṣaḍahāvṛttau sarvapṛṣṭhānte maghavanśadeḥ sakṛ- devānuṣṭhānam |
bhā. 10|6|1029-30. ṣaḍahā- vṛttau sarvaṣaḍahānte sakṛdeva maghavanśam, na pratiṣaṭha- hānte |
gavāmayane tu abhipravaṣaḍahairadhvaryudhāne sati pratimāsaṃ pṛṣṭhaṣaḍahānte maghavanśaṃ kartavyam |
satriṇāṃ brahma- cāritve'pi brahmacāriṇāṃ ca maghavāṃsaniṣedheṣi
‘ṣaḍ‌viṃśatisya vaṣaṭ‌kayaḥ’ iti padadvayasya abhyāsaḥ, na dhānaṃ syāt |
paśuvaṣaṭ‌kaya tu na tathā iti vaiṣamyam |
vaṣaṭ‌krīṇāmavacane sarvāsāṃ vaṣaṭ‌krīṇāṃ nirdeśaḥ nahi syāt |
ṣaḍ‌viṃśatī anayoḥ iti vacanamātroḥ, nāpi ṣaḍ‌- agnigṛpeṣe 'ṣaḍ‌viṃśatisya vaṣaṭ‌kayaḥ' tā anuṣṭhayā |
iti icchāyayatāt' iti vākye vaṣaṭ‌krīṇāṃ prādhānyamuktam, |
ke. tena tāsāṃ dvidhupadādivikṛtau samasta vacanaṃ
candodaye sati abhyudayeṣṭiḥ prāyaścittam, jyotiṣṭomasya ekādaśo dīkṣāḥ, dvādaśāhasya dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ, ityādi nirūpitam |
ṣaṣṭhe- satrādhikāriṇastulyakalpa eva, satraṃ viprasyaiva, ityevamādikaṃ cintitam |
saptame- pitrādikaṃ na-deyam, mahābhūmirna deyā, ityevamādirvicāraḥ |
aṣṭame- laukikopa nayanahomaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīṣṭistathaiva, ityevamāyavicāraḥ kṛtaḥ |
tatsaṃghātasyāpyekakārya- pratipādakasya pūrvaṣaṭkasyeva uttaraṣaṭkaṃ prati tadupatteḥ |
sati hi tasmin kasyāyamiti vicāraḥ saṃbhavati nānyatheti |

tatra 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti bhāvanā bhāvyākāṅkṣiṇī samānapadāpādanalakṣaṇayā śrutyopasarjanaṃ ca dhātvarthameva padāntaropanītapuruṣaviśeṣatvapragrahaṇena bhāvyatvena svīkaroti śrutervākyādyalī yastvāt svargādi- dravyeṇa yāgaṃ kuryāditi vākyārthaḥ |

tataścādhane tasiddhayarthaṃ kāmanā bhavatyeva itya- nuvāda iti śrutilakṣyāyāṃ vākyārthena yāgasya pradhāna- tyāgaḥ kiñcidena phalaṃ sādhyate iti nāstyevādhikāra ityuktvā vidhibhutibalena siddhāntaḥ kathitaḥ |

vidhirhi samānapadātpasāttvārthādvabhāvanāyāḥ saṃkṣipyaḥ prathamameva tāmavacchidya puruṣārthāya nayati pravartanātmakatvātpuruṣā- rthatvaṃ ca vyāpāre puruṣasya pravartitumaśakyatvāttena pravartanātmakatvenaiva samīhitarūpe bhāvaye apekṣite tadviśeṣamātraṃ vākyādavagamyate, tasmin śrāvagate samāna- padopātta dhātvarthaḥ pratyāsatteḥ karaṇatayā svīkriyate dravyādi sthitikartavyatayā |
yadi tāvadaṃśatrayavattvātprāyoga kevala māvanā vidhīyate tato viśiṣṭabhāvanāvidhvyanavidhimānānāṃ paścāt bhāvanā'- nvaye satyapi kevalāyā eva vidhisaṃsparśācca vidheyatvaṃ syāt |
aya tu nāśaṃmanyatvātprāk bhāvanāyā vidhya- nvayaḥ, tato vidhicchidrā satī dhātvarthameva pratyāsatterbhāvya- mavalambate iti na puruṣārthasya bhāvyatvaṃ sidhyediti |
prathamaṃ tāvadekaśabdavācyoḥ vidhibhāvanayoḥ śrutyā saṃbandho'midhīyate tasyāṃ vyavasthāyāṃ bhāvanāyāḥ kevalāyā ananuṣṭheyatvāt pratītā'pi saṃgatirnaiva niṣpadyate |
aniṣpannāyāmapi ca tasyāṃ tatpratipattyā tadaivaṃ puruṣo nirūpayati asyāstā vadvidhyanvayena bhavitavyam |
tato yāhagirmaraṃśaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vidhyanvayaṃ bhajate tādṛbhiḥ pūra- yitavyā |
na cāpuruṣārthaphalā tadanyamarhati, tasmāt puruṣārthaphalatvavyavasāya tadviśeṣamapekṣamāṇaḥ samānapadasthaṃ dhātvarthamapuruṣārthatvādduṣpya padāntarottamapekṣate |

tatra svargakāmādiśabdena tadviśeṣasya pratipattestena saha bhāvanā saṃgacchate, tadanvitā ca karaṇapekṣā satī pratyāsatti- vaśādvākyārthādhikaraṇanyāyena samānapadopāttaṃ dhātvarthaṃ karaṇa- tayā svīkaroti, tataḥ kathaṃbhāvāpekṣayāṃ śrutyāvagatā- nyajñānītyarthabhāvena gṛhṇāti tataḥ sarvośaviśiṣṭā bhāvanā vidhīyate |
tadevaṃ vidhivalena puruṣārthasya bhāvyatve'vadhārite tadviśeṣatāpekṣayā kāmasaṃbandhavagata- prādhānyasya svargādirbhāvyatvaṃ puruṣopasarjanatayā bhavati na pūrvapakṣa iva sādhanatvam |
na hi pūrvapakṣe'pi svarga- kāmaśabdaḥ puruṣaparaḥ kintu svargo'sya dravyasya kriyā- sādhanatvapratipattiparaḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ puruṣavacanaśabdasya ubhābhyāmpi vādiprativādibhyāṃ tatparatvamavadhāryate ? ucyate |
pūrvapakṣavādī tāvadevaṃ manyate kriyāsāmyadyeva tāvattu guṇabhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ |
prāta tatra svargakāmaśabdena na kaścitpuruṣaviśeṣo rājaśabdeneva vrīhyādiśabdeneva vā dravyaviśeṣaḥ samarpyate ya eva hi svargakāmaḥ sa evā- svargakāmo'pi bhavati |
yadā taskāma iti kālepakṣa- ṇatve vā sa eva doṣaḥ |
tatrāpi svarga- kāmanāyāḥ śeṣatvenopadeśe ahaṣṭārthatā syāt |
na hi svargakāmanāyāḥ karmaṇi dṛṣṭopakāraḥ saṃbhavati |
gauravaṃ ca svargaviśiṣṭasya kāmasya aṅgatvopadeśe vidheḥ syāt |
svargasya tu dravyarūpasya karmatādhanatvena dṛṣṭārthatvāt- nmātrasya cākṣatvavidhāne lāghavāt drayopadeśa evāyam |
siddhāntastu vidhivalenaiva vyāpārasya bhāvanāyāḥ puruṣā- rthatvamavagamyate na hyanyai karmaṇi kaścitśeṣābhāva- pravartate |

tena vicita evāpekṣitāpakārasādhanatvena puruṣārthatve bhāva- nāyāḥ samadhigate satyupakāraviśeṣatāpekṣayā svargakāma- śabdena pūrvoktanyāyācāritānupapannapuruṣaviśeṣaprati- pādakamāvena viśiṣṭatvāpekṣiṇaḥ puruṣasya śeṣatvama- bhidhīyamānaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtasvargādyopakāraviśeṣapratipattiparaṃ bhavati |
tata eva svargakāmaśabdaḥ pakṣyade'pi na puruṣa- paraḥ |
ata evoktaṃ hi svargo guṇataḥ karma pradhānataḥ uta karma guṇataḥ svargaḥ pradhānataḥ iti |
kathaṃ tarhi 'rājā rājasūyena svarājyakāmo yajeta' ityādiṣu rājādiśabdena śeṣa- pratipādakena kāmaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam |
kartṛtvena hi rāja iva phalakāma- syānvayaḥ samastyeva |
sa tvanvayaḥ karmaṇā puruṣasyopa- kāraḥ kathaṃ bhavatītyevamarthaḥ |
yatra hi tṛtīyāśrutyā vispaṣṭe'pi kartṛtve abhihite śeṣitvameva malināde- rbhavati tatra svargakāmādeḥ phalasabhamidhyāhārakalpyakartṛttvasya na bhavatīti kuta etat |
na khalu kartṛtvānvayaḥ śeṣi- māvasya paripanthī |
sarvakārakāṇāṃ śeṣitvasaṃbhavaḥ prayāja- śeṣādīnāṃ prāgeva darśito yataḥ |
dvitīyā hi sādhyabhāvaṃ pratipāda- yati sādhyatvaṃ ca śeṣitvapratyāsannam |
na hyasādhyasya śeṣitvaṃ saṃbhavati tena tadimadhinā dvitīyā tadava- gatirbhavati |
tṛtīyādyastu śeṣabhāvamātrasyānavatvā- bhidhānāttatpramāṇatocyante yatra tu tatpratipāditasādhana- bhāvasyaiva śeṣitvaṃ bhavati tatra sādhyatvamandābhihitamapi kalpayitavyamiti viśeṣasiddhiḥ |
tena kartṛtvānvayoḥ rājasvarājyākāmayorvidhivalena svarājyakāmasya śeṣitvaṃ rāśastu dravyakarmasaṃyoganyāyena sādhanatvānuguṇyātccheṣa- tvameva bhavati |
yo'pi kaiścinniyojyatvenānvayaḥ phala- kāmasyete so'pi vivicyamānaḥ śeṣitvānvaya eva yathokto bhavati |
yatkṛtvā vyāpyate yacca dhruvaṃ tatkartṛkaṃ hi tat |
siddhāntikriyate iti yasya darśanaṃ so'pi śeṣaśeṣābhāvavyatirekeṇānvayasya medaṃ vaktuṃ na kṣamate |
yo mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ |
tathā hi satyasau 'mamedaṃ kāryam' iti budhyate yacca yasya kṛtyā vyāpyate tattatkartṛtvameva yathā māvārthaḥ |
tasmāt rājasrarājakāmayoḥ kartṛtvenā- nyāyāt svārājakāmasya niyojyatvaṃ rājastu kartṛtva- mityayaṃ viśeṣa evaṃ samarthayitavyaḥ |
kartṛtve'pi svārājakāmasya śeṣitvaṃ kārya prati rājastu śeṣatvamiti |
