, nanu - boddhṛtvena niyojyatvaṃ na śeṣitvena kimidānīṃ kāmaśabdaḥ kāminaḥ kārya viṣayāvacchinnaṃ prati boddhṛtva- mabhidhatte kathaṃkāmamīdṛkṃ yāgāvacchinnaṃ kāryamiti |

yadyevaṃ boddhṛtvatareṇa kāminaḥ kāvyābhāvājjñeyate'nena yo'rtho'bhimitastameva kevalaṃ budhyeta kāryamediti na tu mamedaṃ kāryamiti mamaśabdābhidheyasya saṃbandhasya niyogena sahāramanaḥ kasyacidapyabhāvāt |
na hi yaḥ kāryamiti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ kiṃtu yo mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate |
na hi kāryamityeva kaścit pravartate api tarhi mamedaṃ kārya- miti |
anarthakaśca niyojyapratipādakaḥ śabdaḥ syāt antareṇāpi tacchuddhātmāyātāye vyutpannaḥ svargakāmo budhyata eva |
svargakāma eva vyutpanno budhyeta nānya iti sā cāśaṅkā parihartavyā- māne'pi vyutpannānāṃ boddhṛtvalakṣaṇaniyojyasadbhāvācca tadvyāhāraḥ syāt |
tasmāt svargakāmasya mamedaṃ kārya- miti evaṃvidhaboddhṛtvalakṣaṇaniyojyamicchātā''vaśyama- styedaṃ kāryamevemavacanena pratipādayitavyamiti vakta- vyam |
viṣayabhedātkartṛtvaṃ hi bhāvārthe niyoge ca niyojyatva- miti |
kārya prasiddhamapyāpi niyojyatve sthite hi tat ||
ataḥ prāk na tattviddhiriti na viṣayamedāsaṃkaraḥ śakyate'bhi- dhātum |
loke ca tadabhāvāt 'devadatta gāmānaya' ityādiṣu saṃboṣanavibhaktisannadave'pi niyojyatvaṃ na syāt |
tasmāt kārye prati śeṣitvameva niyojyatvaṃ ca kartṛtvamityeva vācyam |
kṛti prati tvasya bhedaḥ kārye tu guṇatā dvayoḥ ||
yadyapi kartṛtvāniyojyatvayoḥ śeṣaśeṣitvamedādeva miśeṣastathā'pi na niyogaṃ prati niyojyasya śeṣitā, tasya sarvapradhānatvāt |
yathā''ha 'niyogasiddhī sarve tadanuguṇamiti kena neṣyate' iti |
kiṃ tarhi kṛti prati śeṣitvaṃ niyojyatvam |

tāṃ ca prati śeṣatvaṃ kartṛtva- miti tenātmārthakṛtityāpyaṃ kāryaṃ budhyamāno''pi niyojya ityucyate na tu kāryamevāryārtha tena 'svargakāmo yajeta' ityasya ko'rthaḥ ? yāgāvacchinnaṃ svargakāmārthakṛtityāpyaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ |
tena kārye pratyubhayoḥ kartṛniyojyayoḥ śeṣatve satyeva kṛti prati śeṣaśeṣibhāvadaśaṃkara iti |
so'pi dvayaiva kriyati, tathāhi - 'kṛtirhi kārya- śeṣatvānyānyaśeṣatvamaśnute |
na khalu niyogaśeṣabhūtā abhidhānata evāvagamyamānā kṛtiḥ puruṣaśeṣabhāvamanubhavitumarhati |
yadi tu tarkārya puruṣaśeṣo bhavet tat- sāṭadvāreṇa kṛterapi saṃskārāṇāmiva kāryadvāreṇa puruṣaśeṣatā puruṣaśeṣatvaṃ bhavedanyathā |
nanvasyapi niyogasya puruṣa- śeṣatve phalasya taccheṣattvātsyāpi tathaiva kṛtyā vyāpya- tvātdvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣaśeṣatā bhaviṣyatīti |
na hi tatra phalāntara- masti yadvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣaśeṣatā bhavet |
asti ca tatrāpi nimittatvānniṣedhanimittakriyāprapañca niyojyaḥ sa kathamātmārthakṛtityāpyaṃ kārye jānīyāt |
yadi naivaṃ phalasyāpi tarhi na puruṣārthatā sidhyet, tasyāpi hi mamedaṃ kāryamityetādṛśeyamevāvati |
tasmātkāmenāpi kāryameva prati puruṣasya śeṣitvaṃ niyojyatvaṃ śeṣatvaṃ ca kartṛtvamityeva viveko bhavitavyaḥ |
'amīdagnīn vihara' ityādiṣu amīdādīnāṃ kṛti kāryaṃ vā prati śeṣibhāvādoṣiṇaścāniyojyatvāt |
pravartanāso'hamidaṃ kuryāmityevaṃvidhānaḥ saṃkalpa- mūlatvāmā vidhiriti bhavārtha siddhāntaḥ |

sa ca pravarta mābhyamivāpekṣate pravartakaśca niyojyaḥ; tatra svargakāmaśabdaḥ kiṃ bhāvanāpekṣitaṃ bhāvyaṃ samarpayet āhosvitdvidhyepekṣitaṃ niyojyaṃ ubhayaparatvānupapatterva- pyāpātādanyatareṇa anyatarasiddheḥ |
na hi svargaphale karma- pyatadarthī niyojyaḥ saṃbhavatīti phalena niyojyasiddhiḥ |
'vidherape- kṣitaḥ satyaṃ niyojyo na tvasau tadā |
avadhāra- yituṃ śakyaḥ phalasya tvarita yogyatā ||
yadyapi phalavanniyojyo'pekṣitaḥ tathā'pi nāsānuṣṭheya- vargārdhārṇāt prāgavadhārayituṃ śakyate |
agrapradhāna- yuktaiva ca kriyā anuṣṭheyā tasyāśca tathā vidhirasaṃbha- saṃbandhottarakālameva bhavati na prathamaṃ ayogyatāt tathā niyojyo'pi |
phalaṃ tu prāgevābhyantarasaṃbandhāt avagantuṃ śakyate iti tatparamevedam |
avagate ca tasmiṃścāṃśāntare cāvadhārite sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ tatphalakāmaṃ tadanuṣṭhānasamarthaṃ puruṣaṃ vidadhadvidhiniyukte |
āha ca 'aṅgapradhānavatyāṃ ca bhāvanāyāṃ yugapatpuruṣaniyogaḥ' iti |
kiṃca niyojyānyeṣe'pi na puruṣaparatvaṃ kāma- śabdasya kiṃtu phalaviśeṣaparatvameva |

tathā hi vidhita evāvagamyate asti hi kaścididaṃ vyāpāre niyojyaḥ sa cāsau yogyasya śeṣī na hyasvārthaṃ vyāpāre kaścicciyoktuṃ śakyate sa eva śeṣī yo'sya bhāvyaṃ phalaviśeṣaṃ bhoktumabhilaṣatītyevamavagate phalaviśeṣamātre cānatatvameva svargakāmaśabdasya bhavati |
kiṃ niyojyatvena svārthamabhidadhattparaḥ uta śeṣitvena iti cintāyāmaśakyāvagamananiyojyaparityāgena śakya- pratipattiśeṣitvapratipādanameva varam |
na hi niyojya- tvavaccheṣitvaṃ śaktiviśiṣṭasya anuṣṭhānopayoginī hi chā na śeṣitvopayoginī, anuṣṭhātureva śeṣivādaśakānā- manadhikāro rājasūya ivārājaḥ |
na hi tatra rājatvama- dhikāraśāpāti tadacchettaretyadhikārarūpasthityanuprave- śācchakyate evājñjanirūpaṇasya purastādeva śeṣitvaṃ nirū- payitumiti śeṣitvenaiva svargakāmasyānvayaḥ |
sa ca phalaviśeṣapratītipara iti iti tasmātsvargadeḥ |
phalatvenānyathā- tatsādhane karmaṇi puruṣasya siddho'dhikāra iti tadviśeṣa- nirūpaṇamārabdhavyam |
tatra pradhānavākye'viśeṣeṇa sarve- ṣāmadhikāravattvāt tadanusāreṇa ajñānāṃ viniyogācco yacchakyato kartuṃ sa tat kuryāditi |

bhāvanāvidhānāttathaiva sarveṣāmekopakārasādhanatvena āmeyā- dīnāmiva phalasādhanatvaṃ samidādīnāmavagamyate yena yatrai- kāryaṃ na tatra nairapekṣyaṃ yatra nairapekṣyaṃ na tatraikāryyamiti na vikalpasaṃbhava iti |
na hi pradhānavākyena sarveṣāmadhikāro niścitaḥ, sāmānyena tvasāvavagamyate tataśca viśeṣapramāṇe sarveṣāṃ syāt |
yatra tu pradhānavākyavirodhe naimittikādhikāre tatra yathā- śaktyalpopasaṃhāro bhavatayeti darśitaṃ yathā śaktinirṇaye |
tasmāt sirdhagādīnāṃ kṣudrāṇāmanāhitāgnīnāmasahāyedhā- vaikalyānāṃ rājasūyādiṣu ca brāhmaṇādīnāmanādhikāraḥ |
avadānaṃ tu dravādīnāṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa tatra vihitamiti na vastuvacana saṃkocanam |

'paśumālabheta' iti sāmānyaparyavasitasyāpi viceḥ 'chāgasya vapāyā medaso- 'nubrūhi' iti mantravarṇānurodhena saṃkoco vidhimantrayo- rekaviṣayatvāt sāmānyasya ca kṛtsnasya chāge'pi vibhāvenāvirodhāt niyamasaṃme cāniyamānupapatteḥ ṣaṣṭhyantye vakṣyate |
tathāhi 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityatra ākhyātā- śena ārthī bhāvanā abhidhīyate 'bhāvayet' iti |
sā ca aṃśatrayam apekṣate- 1 kiṃ bhāvayet, 2 kena bhāva- yet, 3 kathaṃ bhāvayediti |
tatra bhāvanākāṅkṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyanyāyena svargaṃ bhāvayatā anveti 'svargaṃ bhāva- yet' iti |
paśukāmaśabdasya phala- paratvenācāritasya upādānāllavaprāpta (?) paśukāmānu- vādakatvādgotvā phalatvena paśun kāmayamānaḥ paśukāma- śabdena vācyaḥ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasiddhāntanyāyena |
ṣaṣṭhī aprāṇinaḥ pañcamyayeṃ, kvacit tṛtīyārthe, dvitīyārthe vā bhavati |
bhā. 4|2|13. mīko. pṛ. 538 'aprāṇinaḥ ṣaṣṭhī' iti cindo draṣṭavyam |
vā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 687. ṣaṣṭhī citiḥ nāma ekacitika eva prayogaḥ sāsi- cityaprayogottarabhāvī ārthavādikaphalo naimittikaḥ prayogāntarameva na tu paṭcitikaḥ prayogaḥ |
'ṣoḍa- śavidaryasya karaṇe' (pā0 6|3|159) jñānamityārtha- jānātisamabhivyāhāre karaṇatve ṣaṣṭhī |
caurasya ujjāsate, caurasya nihanti prahanti praṇihanti, nāṭayati, krāyayati, pinaṣṭi |

'na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛṇām' (pā0 2|3|69) lādeśayoḥ śatṛśānacoḥ upratyaya-ukrapratyaya- adhyaya-niṣṭhāpratyaya-khalapratyaya-samānārthapratyayānāṃ tṛn- pratyāhāroktaśānajādīnāṃ samabhivyāhāre kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhī na |
'kṛyānāṃ kartari vā' (pā0 2|3|71) kṛsayogāt nityaprāptaṣaṣṭhyāḥ kartari vikalpaḥ |
yathā mukhasya tulyaścandraḥ mukhena vā iti |
atra tṛtīyāyā upamānatvāddhī lakṣaṇā iti kecit |
'caturthī cāśiṣyā- yuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ' (pā0 2|3|73) āyuṣvādi-padakaraṇakāśīrthaka-liṅādisamabhivyāhāre saṃbandhaprāptaṣaṣṭhī caturthī api kalpate |
devadattasya āyuṣyaṃ devadattāya āyuṣyaṃ bhūyāt ityādi |
maṇi. pṛ. 126-128. ṣaṣṭhī 'ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' (pā0 2|3|50) iti sūtreṇa vihitā na kāraka- vibhaktiḥ |
śeṣe uktakarmatvādidvitīyārthebhi saṃbandha- mātre ṣaṣṭhī iti sūtrārthaḥ |
evaṃ 'sarpiṣo jānīte', 'mātuḥ smarati' ityādī saṃbandhaprakāraka eva bodhaḥ |
tātparyagrahācca viśeṣabodho lakṣaṇayā mānaso vā iti jīrṇoḥ |
evaṃ 'caitrasya dhanaṃ' ityatra 'caitranirūpitatvā- bhāvavat dhanaṃ' iti bodhaḥ |
'caitrasya na dhanaṃ' ityādau 'caitraniṣṭhasvāmitvanirūpa- katvābhāvavat dhanaṃ' iti bodhaḥ |
sa ca 'ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' (pā0 2|3|50) iti sūtrānu- śiṣṭaḥ |
evaṃ ca śakyatāvacchedakasya saṃbandhatvasya kartṛkarmatvādiṣu api sattvāt teṣāmapi saṃbandhena rūpeṇa ṣaṣṭhyarthatā astyeva |
ata eva 'satāṃ gataṃ', 'sarpiṣo jānīte', 'mātuḥ smarati' edhaḥ dakasya upaskurute'
sa ca yathaiva 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau svasvāmibhāvaḥ, tathaiva 'satāṃ gatam' ityādau kartṛtvādikamapi |
ata eva kartṛtvādinaT tadviśeṣe lakṣaṇā iti vakṣyate |
na caivaṃ saṃbandhena rūpeṇa saṃbandhānāṃ śakyatve 'akṣataṃ saṃbandhāt' iti mahā-bhāṣyakārīyavacananānupapattiḥ |
pārthaśabdasya arjuna iva pracuraprayogeṇa tatsaṃbandhagrahaṇe saṃbhavati anyasaṃbandhagrahaṇe'nyāyyatvaṃ iti sūcanārthatvāt |
'sarpiṣo jānīte' ityatra vakṣyamāṇarītyā saṃbandhatvena ṣaṣṭhyarthaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
vṛttikāreṇa 'sarvanāmastṛtīyā ca' (pā0 2|3|27) iti sūtre paṭhitasyāpi asya vāti- kasya 'hetau' (pā0 2|3|23) iti sūtre bhāṣya- kāreṇa pāṭhāt |
prāgraharaṇaṃ asarvanāmnaḥ prathamādvitīyaye na staḥ ityetadarthakaṃ tena 'acaṃ kāraṇaṃ vasati' itya- prayogaḥ |
( vasati ityatra acaṃ kāraṇaṃ ityadhyāhāreṇa tu prayogaḥ syādeva |
evaṃ 'ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena' (pā0 2|3|10) iti sūtrāt atasarthapratyayaḥ atasuc - pratyayādiḥ 'dakṣiṇeottarābhyāmatasuc' (pā0 4|3|28) ityādi- sūtravihitaḥ |
tena yoge ṣaṣṭhī ityarthakāt 'grāmasya dakṣiṇataḥ, uttarataḥ, grāmasyopari, grāmasyoparistāt' ityādau ṣaṣṭhī |
atra pratiyogitvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ (grāmaprati- yogikadakṣiṇadiśi iti śabdabodhaḥ |
tattvena bodhārthaṃ pṛthagguṇāśanam, na tu pañcamyapavādārtham, 'cintyāt dakṣiṇataḥ'
evaṃ 'vyākaraṇa prāptaḥ' ityatrāpi taddhitane svārthavihitena kṛdarthe'pi upādānena tatra anvayopapatteḥ |
ata evoktaṃ hariṇā 'tataḥ kriyāvatāṃ yogo bhavati karmaṇām |
dhātvarthānvayaṃ ādāya tacchābdabodhopapādanaṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ asaṃgatameva, kārakāṇāṃ dhātvarthānvayasya kāpi anupapatvāt |
nanu evaṃ 'odanasya pākaḥ', 'kṛṣṇasya kṛtiḥ' ityādau ka kārakatvānvayaḥ |
na tāvat dhātvarthe pāke, tasmin tatrāpi anyupapatvāt |
pakkā ityādivat tatrāpi kārakānvayārthaṃ eva kṛtiviśiṣṭāpākasya svātantryeṇa, śaktilakṣaṇābhyāṃ kṛtipāvayorvā abhidhānena kuto kārakānvayopapatteḥ |
tayoge ṣaṣṭhī ca na kārakaparā apitu śeṣaṣaṣṭhyeva |
tasyā api adhyā- hṛtāstirūpapradhānakriyāyāmanvayaḥ paraṃparāsaṃbandhena iti na kaścit doṣaḥ |
na caivaṃ kuyoganimittakaṣaṣṭhīvidhivaiyarthyam, tasya tjādikṛdviśeṣatvenāpi upapatteḥ ityāhuḥ |
bhataḥ siddhaṃ kṛyoge eva kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhī, na tu sārthakataddhitayoge kārakavācitvadvitīyayoge vā, ityeta- darthakaṃ kṛdgrahaṇamiti |
ata eva kṛtpūrvīṃ ityatra sāpekṣa- tvāt pratyayārthena anvayaṃ aṅgīkṛtya 'kṛtapūrvīṃ kaṭaḥ' ityasyāpi āpattirāstā |
uktataddhitayoge kārakāṇāṃ kṛto ananvayaḥ ityevaṃvijñāpanāprayojanakatvāt kṛd- grahaṇasya |
ataḥ siddhaṃ tādṛśataddhitāsamabhivyāhṛtakṛyoge eva ṣaṣṭhī, na tu tādṛśataddhitayoge'pi iti |
kartṛtvaṃ svatantrakartṛtvaṃ prayojakakartṛtvaṃ ca iti ubhayaṃ vivakṣitam |
tena 'rājñaḥ yājakaḥ', 'caitrasya pacanī sthālī' ityādau ubhayatra ṣaṣṭhī |
dvikarmake tu mukhya- karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī niyatā, dvitīye guṇabhūte tu aniyatā |
ata eva 'netā aśvasya grāmaṃ grāmasya vā' iti ubhaya- yāpi prayogaḥ |

evaṃ 'ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (pā0 2|3|66) iti sūtrāt yasmin kṛti ubhayoḥ prāptiḥ tayoge karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhī syāt kartari tu tṛtīyaiva ityarthakāt 'āśvaryo gavāṃ dohaḥ agopena' ityādau kartari na ṣaṣṭhī |
sa ca sakarmakā- karmakadhātusādhāraṇaḥ; na tu lakāraniṣṭhādivat akarmaka- dhātupara eva iti tatra ubhayaprāptiḥ |
'kṛtapūrvīṃ kaṭaṃ' ityādau tatra tadananvayasya upapādita- tvāt |
subarthadhātvarthayoreka- sādhāraṇyena liṅgāntvayibhāvānāvaśeṣatāsaṃbandhena padaja- nyopasthiteḥ hetutvaṃ iti ekayaiva tatsiddheḥ |
tat padaṃ ca yathā ākhyātakṛtpātāddhitādi, tathā ghañanto dhāturapi iti yuktaḥ |
sa ca ākhyātādau kulyādirūpā bhāvanā, ghañantādau tu dhātvartha eva, ubhayoḥ phalaprayolakatvāt |
'kārakaminna' -ityupādānāt yatra ghañantamina ākhyā- tādau dhātvarthasya kārakatvaṃ vivaraṇāsiddham, tatra dhātvarthe kārakatvānvayavāraṇam |
tatra ananvaye ca 'pacatyodanaṃ' ityasya 'pākena odanaṃ karoti' iti vivaraṇe dvitīyā- ṇodanapadasya karotyarthānvaya eva bījam |
atrāpi dhātvarthānvaye 'odanaṃ pacati' ityasya 'odanasya pākaṃ karoti'
ghañantasthale ca dhātva- rthasya akārakatvāt liṅgāntvayācca |
satyapi ghañā abhihitasya tasya ubhayarūpatve dhātvamihite tasmin kārakānvayo na viruddhaḥ |
ataśca anubhavānusāreṇa ekayaiva vyutpattyā tatra tatra ākhyātārthe dhātvarthe vā vyavasthā kārakānvayopapatteḥ 'āśvaryo gavāṃ dohaḥ agopena' ityatrāpi dhātvarthe kārakānvayaḥ nirābādhaḥ |
vastutastu liṅgāntvayitvaṃ na kāraṇāvacchedaka- koṭipraviṣṭaṃ apitu pratyayajanyopasthititvam |
ataśca ghañarthakṛtāveva anvayaḥ vastupadābhidheyāyāṃ ca anvayeḥ kārakāṇāṃ iti na ko'pi virodhaḥ |
ayaṃ ca ubhayaprāptau kartari ṣaṣṭhyā niṣedhaḥ aka- pratyaya-akārapratyayarūpayoḥ |
ṅilapratyayayoḥ yoge na bhavati 'akārakārayoḥ prayoge pratiṣedho neti vaktavyam' iti vacanāt (pā0 2|3|66 sūtre vārtikam) |
uktavidhapratyayabhinnakṛtī ubhayaprāptau tu vikalpaḥ kartari 'śeṣe vibhāṣā' iti vacanāt (pā0 2|3|66 ityatra bhāṣye) |
śobhanā vyākaraṇasya kṛtiḥ pāṇineḥ pāṇinā vā |
tanmate 'āśvaryo gavāṃ dohaḥ agopena agopasya vā' iyapi bhavatīti dhyeyam |
evaṃ 'kasya ca vartamāne' (pā0 2|3|67) iti sūtrāt vartamānārthakasya yoge ṣṭhī syāt ityarthakāt 'rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā' ityatra ṣaṣṭhī |
tayogān rāśāṃ iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī, karmaṇaḥ kapratyayena abhihitatvāt |
'rāśo mataṃ' ityevaṃ napuṃsake bhāve'pi ca anenaiva sūtreṇa ṣaṣṭhī |
'na lokā- vyayaniṣṭhā0' iti vakṣyamāṇavacanena niṣṭhāviṣaye paryuda- sāyāḥ niṣṭhāviśeṣapratiprasavārthatvāt |
na caivaṃ 'pūjito yaḥ surāsuraiḥ' iti tṛtīyayānāpattiḥ |
na hi matibuddhipūjārthebhyaḥ vartamāne eva ktaḥ |
atītādarthe dhātvarthe uktāt kāntānāṃ loke prayogadarśanena tadacanatva bhūtārthakatva- bādhakatvāyogāt |
na caivaṃ vartamānārthaka-matyādidhātu- kta-ktapratyayabhinna-ktapratyayayoge 'chātrasya hasitaṃ' ityādau ṣaṣṭhyanāpattiḥ |
bhūtārthaka-ktapratyayasyāpi adhikaraṇavācitve pūrvavat ṣaṣṭhīpratiprasavaḥ 'adhikaraṇavācinaśca' (pā0 2|3| 68) iti sūtrāt |
tatrāpi akarmakebhyaḥ kartavya ṣaṣṭhī 'idameṣāṃ śayitaṃ' iti |
sakarmakebhyastu adhikaraṇe ktapratyaye kṛte kartṛkarmaṇoḥ dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhī, anabhihitatvāt viśeṣataḥ |
na tu karmaṇyeva 'ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' ityasya 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityetaduttarapāṭhana tatsūtravihitaṣaṣṭhyā eva tena niyamāt |
tadevaṃ kṛyoge sarvatra 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityanena ṣaṣṭhīprāptau 'na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām' (pā0 2| 3|69) iti sūtreṇa tatparyudāsaḥ |
śatṛśānajādaya eva iha gṛhyante, tiṅaḥ kṛdgrahaṇenaiva nivṛttatvāt |
tena odanaṃ pacan pacamānaḥ ityādau na ṣaṣṭhī apitu dvitīyaiva |
tena ki-kinoḥ lādeśābhāvātnenāpi liṭkāryārthatvāt viśeṣatideśe ca sāmānyātideśasya āvaśyakatvāt tayorapi grahaṇam |
ata eva 'babhrivartman' ityādi- prayogā api saṃgacchante |
('0 mapratiṣedhaḥ' iti vārtika- pāṭhaḥ na loketi sūtre |
) iti vacanāttu 'lakṣmyāḥ kāyuko hariḥ' ityatra ṣaṣṭhī |
kam ) iti vacanācca ' purā vasantāmapākarttaḥ ' ' purā kuruṣva visṛpo virapsin ' ityādi ṣaṣṭhī |
sa ca śatṛ- śānacau iti tṛśabdadārabhya ā tu nakārāt ( pā0 3|2|124-155 ) tena śānacprabhṛtīnāmapi graha- ṇam |
' dviṣaḥ śatrurvā ' ( na loka0 ityatra vārtikam ) iti vacanāt |
sarvatrāyaṃ kārakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ paryudāso na tu śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāḥ |
ata eva ' brāhmaṇasya kurvan, narakasya jiṣṇuḥ, chātrasya hasitam ' ityādiprayogā api saṃga- cchante |

evaṃ ' akenorabhiviṣyādarthayoḥ ' ( pā0 2|3| 70 ) iti sūtrāt bhaviṣya-akasya bhaviṣyadāha- myartha-inśa yoge ṣaṣṭhī na syāt ityarthakāt ' eghānāharako vrajati, vrajaṃ gāmī, śataṃ dāyī ' ityādi dvitīyaiva na ṣaṣṭhī |
atra bhaviṣyatkālavihita-akasyaiva grahaṇāt na kālasāmānyāvihita-ake ' odanasya pācakaḥ ' ityādau dvitīyā |
atra ca vyākhyānavaśāt na yathāsaṃkhyaṃ anvayaḥ |
tena gāmī iti bhaviṣyati iniḥ, dāyī ityayaṃ ādhamarṇye ṇiniḥ |

evaṃ ' kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā ' ( pā0 2|3|71 ) iti sūtre bhāṣyakāreṇa yogavibhāgakaraṇāt kṛtyānāṃ ityasya bhinnasūtratvapratīteḥ tatra ca ubhayaprāptau na iti pūrvasūtra- sthapadadvayānukarṣaṇān ubhayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ anabhidhāna- prayuktaṅasīprasaktau ' kṛtyānāṃ yoge ṣaṣṭhī na ' ityarthakāt ' netavyā vrajaṃ gāvaḥ kṛṣṇena ' ityatra na ṣaṣṭhī, apitu dvitīyā tṛtīyā ca |
atra hi nayetadikkarmakatvāt mukhya- karmaṇaḥ kṛtyenābhidhānāt goṣu prathamā |
amurakhya- karmaṇo vrajasya tu anabhidhānāt tatra dvitīyā |

kartṛkarmaṇormadhye anyatarasya kṛtyayena abhidhānāt na ubhayatra prāptiḥ tādṛśakṛtyasya yoge kṛtyogā nimittaka- ṣaṣṭhyā niyamena prasaktau ' kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā ' iti sūtreṇa kartṛṣaṣṭhāḥ vikalpavidhānaṃ ' karttavyamidaṃ kṛṣṇena kṛṣṇasya vā ' |
na ca bhāvakarmaṇoreva kṛtyavidhā- nāt tatra ca karmaṇaḥ kṛtyena abhidhānādeva tatra ṣaṣṭhyaprāpteḥ pariśeṣāt karttavyaiva vikalpavidhyupapatteḥ |
' bhavyageya ' ( pā0 3|1|68 ) iti sūtreṇa karttavyapi yadyavyākhya- kṛtyavidhānāt tadyoge karmaṇi anabhihitatvena ṣaṣṭhīprāpteḥ tatra vikalpavyāvṛttaye kartṛgrahaṇopapatteḥ |
atra geyaḥ iti karttari kṛtyaḥ, sāmakarmakanakartā mānavakaḥ iti śābdabodhaḥ |

evaṃ ' tulyārthatulyopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyā'nyatarasyām ' ( pā0 2|3|72 ) iti sūtrāt tulyārthakeḥ tulyopamā- śabdabhiḥ śabdayoge tṛtīyā syāt ṣaṣṭhī syāt ityartha- kāt ' tulyaḥ sadṛśaḥ samo vā kṛṣṇena kṛṣṇasya vā ' ityatra pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī |
ayaṃ ca maṇḍūkaplutyā śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā eva pākṣikatva- kalpako vidhiḥ, na tu kārakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ |
ata eva ' tulā upamā vā kṛṣṇasya nāsti ' ityatra śeṣa ṣaṣṭhītṛtīyāyā avidhānāt na tṛtīyā |
kathaṃ tarhi ' tulāṃ yadārohati dantavāsāḥ ' ' sphuṭopamaṃ bhūtisitena śambhunā ' ityādikāvye tulādiśabdayoge tṛtīyā iti cet |
sāhilyaṃ ca nirūpakatvam, tasya ca tattvena tṛtīyāto bodhaḥ |
prakṛte tu śeṣārthakatṛtīyāyāḥ paryudāsa iti na kaścidvirodhaḥ |
atra bahutvacananirdeśenaiva tulyaparyāyāṇāṃ grahaṇopapattau arthagrahaṇaṃ padāntaranirapekṣyeṇa bodhakaparam |
tena ' gauriva gavayaḥ ' ' yathā gauḥ tathā gavayaḥ ' ityādau na ṣaṣṭhyādi |

evaṃ ' caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyabhadrabhadrakuśalasukhārtha- hitaiḥ ' ( pā0 2|3|73 ) iti sūtrāt āyuṣyādyarthaka- śabdayoge āśiṣi śeṣe caturthī syāt ṣaṣṭhī syāt ityarthakāt ' āyuṣyādi ase bhūyāt ' iti caturthī pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī |
madaṃ bhadrameva ubhayoḥ paryāyatve'pi āyuṣyādipadānāṃ arthaparatvasthāpanāya ubhayopādānam |
yattu vyākhyānāt sarvatra arthagrahaṇo- papatteḥ madabhadrayoḥ anyatarat na paṭhanīyaṃ iti kaiyyaṭuktaṃ tat bhāṣyakāreṇa etatsūtrasya anyākhyānādapekṣitam |
kuśalaṃ nirāmayam, sukhaṃ śam, arthaḥ prayojanam, hitaṃ pathyam |
na ca ' hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā ' iti vārtikadeva tatsiddheḥ hitagrahaṇavaiyarthyam |
anāśiṣi tena tanniyamo'pi etasya āśiṣi vikalpavidhāyakatvo- papatteḥ |
ata eva āyuṣyādau anāśiṣi ṣaṣṭhyeva ' caitrasya āyuṣyamasti ' iti |
sarvathā ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ sarvo'pi ākhyātāyeṃ anveti iti siddham |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 72, ṣaṣṭhī saṃbandhamātravācitvena vyava- hitamapi -parirakampi- saṃbandhamabhidhatte, yathā ' deva- dattasya naptā ' iti |
tathā ' vānapeyasya sasadaśāratina- yūpaḥ ' ityatra ūrdhvamānasya yūpadārā paśvaṅgatvena vāja- peyasaṃbandhaḥ |
vi. 3|1|9, ṣaṣṭhyāḥ avyavahita- saṃbandha evābhidheyo'rthaḥ, tadasaṃbhave tu paraṃparāsaṃbandhaḥ kathaṃcid gṛhyate |
3|1|5, ṣaṣṭhyāḥ kārakavibhaktitvā- bhāvāt tadarthasya upapadādyena anvayaḥ iti saṃpradāyaḥ |
anye tu sākṣātparaṃparāsaṃbandhena bhāvākhyānāmeva prādhānyena anvayo yukta ityapyāhuḥ |
vā. 3|1|12 pṛ. 674, ṣaṣṭhyāḥ citaiḥ naimittikatvaṃ pratiṣṭhārthatvam |
ṣaṣṭhīsaptamībhyāṃ hi yāhak saṃbandhaḥ svapradhānaḥ asattvabhūtaśca pratyāyyate na tādṛk matvarthīyata |
na ca vigrahasamāsayoḥ ekārthatvaṃ pāṇinīnā vibhāṣāparambhāt śāpitam, itarathā vinā'pi vibhāṣā- rambhaṃ svārthapratipādanāya vyāsasamāsayoḥ siddheḥ |
ekārthatve tu samāsena vigraha- vākyasya nivṛttirbhū iti ityatathyatvam |
tataśca rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vigrahe saṃbandhapratīteḥ samāse'pi tatpratītyarthaṃ lakṣaṇā iti yuktam |
karmadhāraye abhedasyaiva vācyārthavidha- yaiva saṃbandhasya pratītyupapatteḥ |
atha karmadhāraye vigraha- vākye'pi abhedo vākyarthavidhaiva pratīyate, tatra abheda- vācyaśabdābhāvāt, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu vigrahavākye saṃbandho na vākyārthaḥ kiṃtu ṣaṣṭhīśravaṇāt padārtha eva |
tena tatra saṃbandhasaṃbandha eva vākyārthavidhayā pratīyate na tu saṃbandha eva |
tathā ca vigrahavat samāse'pi saṃbandhasaṃbandhapratītisiddhaye lakṣaṇā |
kiṃca nāmārthayoḥ medena anvayasya vibhaktyarthadvāratvāt vibhaktyarthasaṃbandhaḥ avaśyaṃ lakṣyaṇīya iti cet, evamapi ' dadhi paśya ' ityādī iva chatāyā eva vibhakteḥ tadartha- pratītyupapatteḥ |

ghaṭaḥ karmatvaṃ ānayanaṃ kṛtiḥ iti vākye kriyākarmabhāvena anyābhāvāt vibhaktyā tadupapadyate- reva prayojakatvavat ' dadhi paśya ' ityādī chatāyā eva vibhakteḥ svārthabodhakatvasvīkāre prakṛte'pi rājñaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ( rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ) ityanyabhāvena saṃbandhasyāpi vibhaktyupasthitatve svīkāryatvāt |
na ca samāse vibhaktilopa eva asiddhaḥ |
' ekadeśavikāre hi nityatvaṃ nopapadyate ' iti śābdikamukhyasiddhāntāt |
tathā ca rekhāgavayanyāyena anuśāsanāya kalpite prakriyāvākye eva vibhaktilopaḥ iti samāse ṅasa- vibhakteraiva abhāvāt na tasyāḥ saṃbandhopasthāpakatvaṃ iti vācyam |
yadi ca tatra luptavibhaktyasadbhāve'pi adhyāhṛtavibhakti- saṃbhavāt na lakṣaṇā, tadā samāse'pi adhyāhṛtavibhakti- reva astu |
'nīlaṃ ca tatpalaṃ ca' iti samuccayavāci- caśbdavaśenāpi anyatra samuccaya abhedaparyava- sānena karmadhārayavigrahavākye'pi abhedaḥ padārtha eva |
nipātatvena caśabdasya avācakatve'pi tadupasaṃdānane tatsamabhivyāhṛtapadantarasya tatra śaktervarjanīyatvāt |
parvato vahimān, daṇḍī puruṣaḥ ityādau matvarthopasthita- saṃbhavāttva vigrahavākye ṣaṣṭhyupasthitasaṃbandhasyāpi saṃsarga- maryādayeva bhānaṃ ca upapadyate |
soma. 6|1|13. atra ‘niṣādasthapatanyāyaḥ’ mīko. pṛ. 2312 iti bindī bhāṭṭagranthe draṣṭavyam |
yatra ṣaṣṭhyartha- lakṣaṇayā sāmānyadhikaraṇyaṃ tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ |
yatra tu ṣaṣṭhyarthalakṣaṇaṃ vinaiva sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tatra karmadhārayaḥ |
‘niṣādasthapatiḥ’ niṣādāśceti kṣapathati vigrahaḥ na tu niṣādānāṃ sthapatiriti |
( mīmāṃsā- grantheṣu bahuśaḥ spaṣṭaṃ vivṛtatvāt atra na vyākhyānaṃ kṛtam |
) sāhasī. 846. ṣoḍaśyāni gṛhṇāti’ iti samasta- saṃkhyā ||
‘caturjuhvā gṛhṇāti’ ityādi vidhāya ‘ṣoḍaśā- nyāyāni bhavanti’ iti śrutāni ṣoḍaśagṛhītāni |
iti prāpte, sukṛtgṛhyahītāni samastavādo'yaṃ ‘catu- rdaśapaurṇamāsyāmāhṛtayo hūyante’ itivat |
saṃkarṣa. 2|2|12. ṣoḍaśi sāma aṅgirasāṃ dvirātre uttare'hani bhavati |
bhā. 10|5|1|153. ṣoḍaśī abhi- ṣṭomasya kāmyaḥ saṃsthāviśeṣaḥ |
vi. 5|3|13-14, ṣoḍaśī ‘abhiṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt, apyukthye grāhyaḥ’ iti stutaśastravarjito bhaviṣyati iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
pūrvasaṃsthā- tvahāni anasthasaṃsthātvaṃ cāmnāyasya stutaśastrayuktatvameva draṣṭavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
10|5|12. ṣoḍaśī abhiṣṭomasyokthyo- mīko. pṛ. 75 ‘abhiṣṭomokthyayoḥ ṣoḍaśīḥ’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
ṣoḍaśī aṅgirasāṃ dvirātre eva uttare gṛhyate |
bhā. 10|5|13|53-54. ṣoḍaśī āgrayaṇādeva grāhyaḥ nokthyāt, na ca ubhābhyām |
‘ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī vairājasāmā’ iti prakṛtiliṅgena sāmaśabdena vairūpapṛṣṭhe vairājapṛṣṭha iti gamyate |
aṅgirasāṃ dvirātre nityaḥ; itaratra tu nāstyeva iti vṛttikāramatam |
10|8|2, ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ ‘uttare'han dvirātrasya gṛhyate, madhyame'ṅgirasātrasya’ idaṃ vānayaṃ aharviśeṣasaṃbandhāya rājandyādinimittanairepekṣyāya ca |
rājanyasya tu abhi- ṣṭome'pi gṛhyate ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ |
(tadā ca ‘atyagniṣṭomaḥ’ nāma saṃsthāntarameva niṣpadyate tadeva rājanyasya niyatami- tyanyadetat |
) 10|5|9, ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ jyotiṣṭoma- vikṛtau iti pakṣaḥ |
10|5|9, ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ savanatraye'pi grāhya iti pakṣaḥ |
na sarveṣu savaneṣu gṛhṇāti’ iti tṛtīyasavana eva grāhya iti siddhāntaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome ṣoḍaśiśrahaṃ prakṛtya ‘taṃ parājñamukthyebhyo gṛhṇāti’ iti śrūyate |
‘samayādhyuṣite sūrye ṣoḍaśinaḥ somamupā- karoti’ iti ca ṣoḍaśīstotrasya kāla uktaḥ |

‘yadā tu kenacit pratibandhena ukthyagrahāḥ astamayāduccaṃ utkarṣeyan tadā ṣoḍaśīgrahasyāpi utkarṣo'sti na vā iti vicāre noktamḥ, svakālātikramakāraṇābhāvāt iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntamāha |
ukthyasaṃyogāt ukthyasya hyamukthyebhyo gṛhṇāti’ iti ṣoḍaśinaḥ ukthyaiḥ saṃyogasya vihitatvāt |
ke, ṣoḍaśī ‘caturthe caturthe'hyanyahīnasya gṛhyate’ iti anyatamasyaikasyaiva ahan āditaścaturthe'hani, punaḥ pañcamamārabhya caturthe'hani (arthāt āditaḥ aṣṭame- 'hani) grāhyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
kasminnapi ahani āditaścaturthe'hani eva ekadā grāhyaḥ na punaraṣṭamādau ahani iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhā. 10|6|16|15, ṣoḍaśī jyotiṣṭome tṛtīyasavana eva mahītavyaḥ; na savane savane |
'vicchindanti ha vā eta- dukthyaṃ yadukthyāni ṣoḍaśinaṃ ca tataḥ praṇayanti' iti |
na śakyaḥ āgrayaṇātkṛtsno gṛhyamāṇa ukthyād grahītumiti |
satyāṃ hi gatau na tāvāśrayaṇīyā staḥ |
tathā sati, ukthyātparākamiti saṃbandho bhaviṣyati, na kṛtsnasaṃyogo virotsyate |
vicchindanti ha vā etadukthyaṃ yadukthyāni ṣoḍa- śinaṃ ca tataḥ praṇayanti' iti |
iyamapi kālasaṃbandhe eva pañcamī, nāpā- dāne |
śā— ṣoḍaśinyeva saṃdehaḥ kiṃ asau āgrayaṇāt ukthyāt vā grahītavyaḥ uta āgrayaṇādeveti |
tatra 'āgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti, ukthyānnigṛhṇāti' iti vacana- 'duāgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti, ukthyānnigṛhṇāti' iti vacana- 'kṛtasnasyāgrayaṇādeva grahaṇaṃ nityavacchrutam |

' bhāṭṭa— ṣoḍaśinyeva kimāgrayaṇādeva grahaṇaṃ uta ukthyāditi cintāyāṃ 'āgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti' iti vacanāt āgrayaṇādāpanakatvavat 'ukthyād gṛhṇāti' iti vacanādukthyasyāpādānatvaśrutesādapi vikalpena samuccayena vā grahaṇam |

na ca 'ukthyād gṛhṇāti' ityatrokthyātparatvādgṛhātītyarthākāreṇa ukthyaparabhāva- mātravidhānāt nāpādānavidhānamiti vācyam, digyoga- nimittakatve pañcamyā upapadavibhaktitvena kārakavibhakteḥ balīyastvyāpādānārthakatvevāvāgateḥ |
'anyārāditarartedikchabdāñcottarapadājāhi- yukte' (pā0 2|3|29) iti sūtreṇa śabdayoga eva pañcamīvidhānāt |
iti prāpte, neyamāpādanapañcamī, tathātve aṣṭadoṣadurvikalpā- patteḥ |
api tu 'taṃ parāṅmukhyamyo gṛhṇāti' iti śāstrāntaravacanaikavākya- tayā digyoganimittaiva, vikalpāyapekṣayā upapadavibhakti- stasyāpi svīkāre bādhakāmāvāt |
na ca śabdayoga eva sā 'māsāt pravakṣyāmi' ityādau śabdayogābhāve- 'pi ayathogamātreṇa taddarśanāt |
na ca 'taṃ parāṅkam' ityeva prāsaṣoḍaśyānuvādena parākchabdārthasya ukthyaśabdārthasya vidhau vākyabhedāpatte-

parākmiti tu 'parācīḥ sāmidhenīranuyāt' itivat anabhyāsa- vānitvāccāniyānuvāda iti vācyam, upapadavibhakti- sthale prācāṃ parasparānvayasya vyutpannatvāt parākchabdasya tātparyagrāhakasya satve pañcamyā eva tadarthakatvena vākya- bhedāprasakteśca |
ataḥ ukthyapracārāṇāṃ bahutvātpurakāla eva pañcamya- rtho'nena vidhīyate iti tadekavākyatayā'syāpi tadvidhā- yaktatvāt ukthyāpādānatvaṃ ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇasyeti siddham |
vācopayogitā ca pakṣe āgrayaṇāsya pūrvapakṣe bādhāt draṣṭavya |
10|5|12|144. mīko. pṛ. 1809 'jyotiṣṭome tṛtīyasavane eva ṣoḍaśino grahaṇam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
ṣoḍaśinaḥ nānā''hīneṣu pratyahīne caturthe caturthe divase grahaṇam |
10|5|14|56-57. mīko. pṛ. 2311 'nānā''hīneṣu pratyahīne' ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
jyotiṣṭomaṃ prakṛtya 'ya evaṃ vidvānaitaṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti, bhavatyātmanā parā''tmanyo bhavati' iti ṣoḍaśī nāma graha āmnātaḥ |
sa vikṛtau grāhyaḥ (vaikṛtaḥ) prakṛtau (prākṛtaḥ) vā iti vicāre pūrva- pakṣamāha |
tatra vikṛtau kṛtsnavidhānāt śāntākāṅkṣo yathā syāt tathā vidhānāt 'madhyame'han trirātrasya gṛhṇate' iti |
etadvākyānusāreṇa 'atirātre brāhmaṇasya' iti vacanaṃ vaikṛte'tirātre iti gamyate |
'dve saṃsutānāṃ virāja- matiricyante' iti, abhāve ṣoḍaśinaḥ dve stomīye virājamatiricyante iti varṇitaṃ dvitīya'dhyāye 'vihita- pratiṣedhāt' ityatra (2|4|27) |
'na ṣoḍaśī nāma yajño'stītyāhuḥ' iti prakṛtau jyotiṣṭome vacanam |
ṣoḍaśī graho vaikṛtaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtrayeṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdo vyāvartayati |
na vaikṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśī, prakṛtau jyoti- ṣṭome 'ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti śiṣṭatvāt vihitatvāt asau prākṛtaḥ |
itaśca ṣoḍaśī prākṛtaḥ syāt 'tisraḥ saṃsutānāṃ virājamatiricyante' iti liṅgasya darśanāt ('vihita- pratiṣedhāt' 0 2|4|27 iti sūtre draṣṭavyam) prakṛtau prakṛtigatatve liṅgasya darśanāt |
'madhyame'han trirātrasya gṛhyate' iti pūrvapakṣoktasya vacanasya gatiḥ pradarśayate |

'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt' iti vacane ṣoḍaśino rājanyanimittakatā uktā codakena ca vikṛtau ṣoḍaśini prāpaṇīye rājanyanimittakatvasya sa prāpnuyāt tatparisaṃkhyayaiva 'madhyame'han trirātrasya gṛhyate' ityā- mnānam |
tathā ca brāhmaṇasyāpi prakṛtau ṣoḍaśī syādeva |
vihita- pratiṣedhāt pakṣe stotrātirekaḥ ('vihitapratiṣedhāt' 0 2|4|27 iti sūtre draṣṭavyam) |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā 'ayajñavacanāt' (sū0 36) iti tadapi uktaṃ pratyuktaṃ ityanuvartate |
ṣoḍaśigrahasya vaikaspikatvāt pakṣe ayajñatvaṃ iti guṇāt bhaktyā ayajñatvam |
bhā. 10|5|2149 - 52. ṣoḍaśini atirātre ca pitṛdevatyapradāne śrūyamāṇaṃ 'anuṣṭupacchanda iti bhakṣamantraṃ namanti' iti vākyam |
bhā. ṭippaṇī 3|2|11|29 pṛ. 788. ṣoḍaśini aindraṃ vṛṣṇi tṛtīyam |
(agniṣṭome āgneyaḥ ajaḥ, ukthye aindram dvitīyaḥ ; ṣoḍaśini aindraḥ vṛṣṇiḥ tṛtīyaḥ |
'āgneyaḥ paśupuroḍāśa ālambhyaḥ, aindram ukthye dvitīyaḥ, aindro vṛṣṇiḥ tṛtīyaḥ' iti vidhānāt |
tatra ṣoḍaśini savanīyapaśūnāṃ tritve'pi agniṣṭome 'prāsmā agni' ityatra 'praibhyo agni' iti nāstyūhaḥ |
prakṛtāvapi vacanama- syaiva ityāśaṅkya 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhyayāt, atirātre brāhmaṇasya' iti, vikṛtatvāt vacanasāmarthyāt vikṛtau atirātre syāt ityāśaṅkyate |
prakṛtau āmnānāt prakṛtau cātirātrasya bhāvāt prākṛta ityā- śaṅkā |
katham ? 'ya evaṃ vidvān etaṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityabhidhāya 'madhyame'haṃści- rātrasya gṛhyate' iti vidhīyate |
evaṃ vākyena prakaraṇe bādhite 'ati- rātre brāhmaṇasya' iti vacanaṃ vaikṛte atirātre iti gamyate |
tena yadyapi jyotiṣṭome prakṛtya vidhānāt vikṛtausau na kṛtsna āmnātaḥ, tathāpi kṛtsna eva vikṛtau vihito bhavati |
tasmāt vikṛtiṣu parigaṇitāsu ṣoḍaśī grahītavyo na prakṛtau iti |
ṭup-- 'ya evaṃ vidvān ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti |
prakṛtau prakaraṇa- mānānimittena vākyena saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
abhāve ṣoḍaśino dve stotrīye virājaṃ atiricyate iti varṇitaṃ dvitīyadhyāye (2|4|27) |
evaṃ hi bhavati vacanaṃ 'na ṣoḍaśī nāma'sti ityāhaḥ' iti |
na cedaṃ prakṛtau sambhavat vaikṛte'tirātre śakyate kalpayitum |
evaṃ nātra kimaṃśasya pūraṇaṃ vākyena, yena prakaraṇāt utkarṣaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- prakṛtau bhavati darśanaṃ asya ṣoḍaśinaḥ |
ukta- metat (2|4|127) ṣoḍaśini gṛhyamāṇe tisrāṇāṃ stotrīyāṇāṃ darśanamakalpate iti |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ vaikṛtastatra kṛtsnavidhānāt iti |
atha codakena prāptau kimarthaṃ punarukta iti |
avi- śeṣeṇa hi tadvacanaṃ prakṛtāvabhidhāya agniṣṭome rājanyasya cātirātre iti vākyenoktam |
anati- rātre'pi anagniṣṭome'pi kathaṃ gṛhyeta 'madhyame'han trirātrasya gṛhyate' iti |
bhāṣyam-- aya yaduktaṃ prakṛtau ṣoḍaśī na dṛśyate, 'dve saṃsutānāṃ virājamatiricyate' iti |
taduktam, amāvāsyādarśanāt vaikaspikaḥ ṣoḍaśī vihita- pratiṣedhāt ṣaḍe'tireka iti |
bhāṣyam-- aya yaduktaṃ ayajñavacanāt na prakṛtau ṣoḍaśīti, taduktam |
pakṣe sa yajño nāsti iti bhaktyā ayajña ityucyate |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe prakṛtau na gṛhyate, gṛhyate siddhānte |

sa ca 'ṣoḍa- śinā vīryakāmaḥ' iti puruṣārthatayā vihito'pi punaḥ kratvarthatayā śrūyate 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhyayāt, apyukthye āghāḥ, atirātre brāhmaṇasya, uttare'hani dvirātrasya gṛhyate, caturthe'han- hīnasya gṛhyate' iti |
saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ prakṛtau syāt uta vikṛtiṣveva utkṛṣṭavya iti |

'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate' ityādibacanaiḥ vikṛtisaṃbandhavācamāt 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya' ityādi- vacanasya ca vaikṛtāgniṣṭomābhiprāyatvenāpi aciredhāta prakaraṇe bādhitvā vākyena utkarṣe prāpte, brūmaḥ, prakṛti- karaṇāmmātaiḥ agniṣṭomādiśabdaiḥ tatraiva saṃbhavadbhiḥ kimiti asaṃnihitā'pi vikṛtiramidhīyate |
tatra rājanyadinimittena vihitaḥ sa vikṛtiṣu anaimittiko vidhīyate 'uttare'han dvirāmasya' iti |
soma--triramyasyeva ṣoḍaśino na prakṛtivikṛti- saṃbandhaḥ, kiṃtu vikṛtimātrasaṃbandhaḥ ityutthiteḥ saṃgati- rityāhuḥ |
bādhaprasaṅgāt prakṛtisaṃbandhaḥ ṣoḍaśino bādhyate na iti cintyate ityākhyasaṃgatiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa--jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe samāptaḥ ṣoḍaśī jyotiṣṭomāt uta neti cintāṃyāṃ 'ṣoḍaśinā vīrya- kāmaḥ stuvīta' ityanena tasya puruṣārthatvāvagamena godonādivat prakaraṇatvāt na jyotiṣṭomāṅga- tvam |
na ca 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt' iti vacanena saṃyogapṛthaktvanyāyena prakṛtyarthatā iti vācyam |
tasya 'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate, madhyame'han trirāmasya, caturthe'han ahīnasya' ityādivikṛtiprāṭhena vaikṛtāgniṣṭomābhiprāyatvāt |
vastutastu, agniṣṭomādipadānāṃ saṃkhyāvacchittatvāpa- nāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāṃ prakṛtau vikṛtau vā ṣoḍaśi- saṃsthāyā niveśāyogena vidhātumaśakteḥ : dvirāmrādicce ayamevārthavāda eva |
yatra saṃsthāntareṣvapi ṣaṣṭho ayaṃ pūrvasaṃsthāyādhena grahītumucitaḥ, tatra kimu vaktavyaṃ viruddha- saṃsthāntarehitadvirāmrādau iti stuteḥ |
iti prāpte, ṣoḍaśyādiśabdāstāvat anekeṣu prajyamānā api saṃkhyāmeva śaktāḥ |
tadat jyotiṣṭome niruḍalakṣaṇyā tadati ṛtvantare sāṃpratikalakṣaṇayā aṇe stotre ca tathaivetyādi saṃkhyādhikaraṇe kaustubhe ca dvitīye kṣuṇṇam |
tadiha 'ya evaṃ vidvān ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityatra bhāṣyakārādilikhanāt saṃsthaiva grahaṇaviśiṣṭā vidhīyate |
ṣoḍaśiśabdena nāgṛhītāviśeṣaṇatvena saṃkhyāvacanenāpi tadviśiṣṭakratoḥ upasthāpanena grahaṇena saṃkhyāvantaṃ kratuṃ kuryāt iti vākyārthapratīteḥ |
jāyate hi yāgābhyāsa- sādhanībhūtadravyasaṃskāradvārā grahaṇenāpi saṃkhyā |
ṣoḍaśi- śabdasya grahaṇamātraparatvamaṅgīkṛtya tanmātraviśiṣṭu lakṣaṇā- ''pattereva ayuktaḥ |
ata eva upanayāḥ saṃsthāyā evaṃ vīryārthatvena vidhiḥ na tu stotrasya |
tasya 'eka- viṃśaṃ (stotraṃ) bhavati pratiṣṭhittye' iti vacanaprāptasya sādhutvārthamanuvādāt |
ata eva stotraṃ grahaṇaṃ ca saṃkhyā- saṃpādakatvā vākyācca tadaṅgameva, na tu jyotiṣṭomāṅgaṃ ityapyavivādameva |
ataśca saṃsthāyāḥ phalārthatvāt yadyapi prakaraṇaṃ 'catasraḥ somasaṃsthāḥ' ityādibacanaṃ ca nāṅga- tābodhanakṣamaṃ āśrayalatvenaivopapatteḥ |
tathāpi 'apyagniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt, apyukthye, atirātre brāhmaṇasya gṛhṇīyāt' ityādibacanaiḥ saṃyoga- pṛthaktvanyāyena jyotiṣṭomāṅgastvasyāpyupapatteḥ |
na hi etāni arthavādarūpāṇi, liṅgaśravaṇāt vinigamanā- virahācca |
etadvākyārthastu agre nirūpayiṣyate, nirūpitaḥ kaustubhe api |

astu vā vidvadvākyena saṃkhyāṣṭyā grahaṇāmātrāvidhiḥ; tathāpi uktavākyenaiva saṃkhyāyā vīryāṅgatve siddhe niruktavākyenaiva tasyāḥ prakṛtyaṣṭā, saṃsthārūpaṃ tu grahaṇādividhito yājñika- prasiddhisiddhaṃ iti na kaścit virodhaḥ |
tena ca nityasaṃsthāyāḥ prakṛtau rājanyasya bādhaḥ iti bādhopayogitā'pi |
na caivaṃ kāsucit vikṛtiṣu tataḥ punaḥ śravaṇaṃ anarthakamiti vācyam, anaimittikatvādyarthatvasya prayojanatvena vakṣya- māṇatvāt |
' ṣoḍaśigrahasya aṅgirasāṃ dvirāva upasaṃhāraḥ iti vṛttikāramatam |
10|1|13-54. mīko. pṛ. 181 aṅgirasāṃ dvirāva ṣoḍaśigrahasyopa- saṃhāraḥ ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
ṣoḍaśigrahasya utkarṣaḥ, ukthyānāṃ devādyutkarṣe sati, kartavya eva |
'taṃ parāṅmukhavyebhyo nigṛhṇāti' ityucyottaraṃ ṣoḍa- śino vidhānāt |
vi. 5|1|18, ṣoḍaśigrahasya mukhyasya ukthyottararūpakālaṃ avādhituṃ upasarvanasya stotrasya kālaṃ bādhitvā sastotro graha utkarṣavyaḥ |
5|1| 18 ṣoḍaśigrahe sastutaśale agniṣṭomādau gṛhīte saṃkhyātvaṃ syāt |
vacanāt agniṣṭome ukthye vā gṛhītaḥ san na saṃkhyātvaṃ karoti |
vi. 10|8|3. ṣoḍaśipātraṃ khādiraṃ ūrdhvamānaṃ ca vājapeye |
vā. 5|1|18|35. ṣoḍaśiśastre 'vyastaṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ śaṃsati' ityuktam, tena vyatyāsaḥ śrautaḥ kramaḥ atirātre |
vi. 2|1|10. ṣoḍaśisaṃsthāyāṃ ukthyastotraṃ ṣoḍaśistotraṃ na tu tasyāpyuttaraṃ atirātrādi |
ṣoḍaśiṃsasthe jyotiṣṭome'tipeeṣu homeṣu saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ sāyamihotreṇa pratihotratyamuta prātaramihotreṇeti |
[ soma-vi-bhāṭṭa-vyākhyānāni mīko. pṛ. 2740 ' pratihomapakṣe sāyamihotramārabhyānuṣṭhānam ' iti bindau draṣṭavyāni |
tasmāt tatra ati- pāte prātarhoma eva prathamaḥ |
tasmāt pratihomeṣu api prātarhoma eva ādau kartavyaḥ iti |
' ṣoḍaśiṃsasthāyāṃ 'saubharamukthyānāṃ brahmasāma bhavati' iti nityatayā vihitam |
punaśca tatraiva 'yo vṛddhikāmo ṣoḍaśyākāmaḥ0' ityādinā phalatvāya saubharaṃ vidhīyate iti kathyamapi |
su. pṛ. 873. ṣoḍaśistotrasya ukthyottararūpakāla-samayā- dhyupitakālamadhye pradhānakālaḥ ukthyottararūpa eva grāhyaḥ, anyastu bādhyaḥ |
dupa. 5|1|18|135. ṣoḍaśistotrasyotkarṣaḥ ukthya- stotrāṇāmutkarṣe ṣoḍaśistotrāpi utkarṣaḥ |
samayaḥ astamayaḥ taṃ adhi uṣitaḥ prātaḥ samayādhyuṣitaḥ |
yatra ābharbhavapavamāne gāyatrā- nantaraṃ sāma tatra tasya ‘saṃ’ iti saṃjñā |
‘saṃ te prāṇe vātena’ ityādī ekavākyatve vākyaśeṣāpyāhāra eva kartavyaḥ na tvanuṣaṅgaḥ, vyaveta- tvāt |
‘saṃ te vāyuvātena gacchatāṃ, saṃ yajñairaṅgāni, saṃ yajñapatirāśiṣā’ ityatra gacchatāṃ ityeṣa śabdaḥ ‘saṃ yajñairaṅgāni’ iti bahuvacanāntena vyavahitatvāt ‘saṃ yajñapatirāśiṣā’ ityatra nānuṣajyate |
saṃyavanaṃ caro na kartavyam, puroḍāśe tu piṇḍārthaṃ kartavyam |
saṃyavanaṃ praṇītānāṃ prayojakam, ninayanaṃ tu pratipattiḥ |
saurye carau saṃyavanasya bādhaḥ ’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
saṃyājye triṣubhau kāmye nitye ca saṃyoga- pṛthaktvena darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
mīko. pṛ. 2045 ‘darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ triṣubhau 0’ ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
‘saṃyuktānvekāpavargāṇi’ iti nyāyāt vihavyā- nvādhānaṃ pradhānena ekakena saha kāryam |

kimayaṃ caruḥ yāgārthaḥ yāgaṃ kṛtvā avaśiṣṭa upadhātanyaḥ uta upadhānārtha evāyaṃ iti vicāre vākyaśeṣe ‘bṛhaspatervā etadannaṃ yannīvārāḥ’ iti devatāvacanena ekavākyatayā devatāsaṃyuktaścaruḥ yāgārtha iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntāt |
arthavācakaśabdena upadhātinā saṃyuktaḥ caruḥ tadarthaḥ upadhānārtha eva syāt, na yāgārthaḥ ! śrutisaṃyogāt |
upaddhāti iti śrutvā caroḥ sākṣāt saṃbandhāt |
bṛhaspatinā devatayā tu nīvārāṇāṃ parokṣyā saṃbandhaḥ |
tasmāt kṛtsnaḥ caruḥ upadhānārtha eveti siddhāntaḥ |

‘saṃyuktsvarthaśabdena tadarthaḥ0’ (2|3|7|78) ityadhikaraṇe upakramasya nairākāṅkṣayatva ‘bṛhaspatervā etadannaṃ yannīvārāḥ’ ityasya vākyaśeṣasya devatāsamarpa- katvaṃ nirākṛtya bṛhaspatipadasya brāhmaṇaparatvāṅgīkāreṇa munyannatayā nīvārastutiparatvavarṇanāt agnicaye ‘naivāraṃ carumupaddhāti’ ityasya sthaṇḍilanirvṛttaupayikatayā- ścarutvarūpadhānavidhānena nirākāṅkṣasya ‘bṛhaspatervā eta- dannaṃ yannīvārāḥ’ ityupadhānaparaguṇakarmānvayidevatāsaṃbandha- pratipādakavākyaśeṣānusāraṇa yāgavidhāyakatvaṃ nāṅgī- kriyate |
saṃyukte tu prakramāt tadaṅgaṃ syāditarasya tadarthatvāt |
tathā ca āgneyasya dviravadānaṃ kṛtvā taddomāt prāgeva abhīṣomīyasya dviravadānaṃ kārye iti avadānamātreṇa anusamayaḥ kārya iti utsūtraṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nirasya siddhāntamāha |

sūtrārthastu, saṃyukte caturavattasaṃbaddhe home vidhīyamāne prakramāt caturavattena upakramāt itarasya avadānasya tadarthatvāt homārthatvāt tadantaṃ (tadaṅgaṃ ityatra pāṭhaḥ) homāntaṃ ekaḥ padārthaḥ syāt iti - vṛ |

saṃyukte caturavattasaṃyukte home itarasya itarasya ava- dānasya prakramāt ādyāvayavatvena vidhānāt, tadarthatvāt caturavattasya homārthatvāt tadantaṃ homāntaṃ ekaḥ padārthaḥ iti vā, saṃyukte avadānasaṃyukte home vidhīyamāne itarasya avadānasya tadarthatvāt homārthatvāt avadānenaiva homaprakramāt tadantaṃ avadānādihomāntaṃ ekaḥ padārthaḥ syāt iti vā kutūhalam |
avadānasaṃyukte home vidhīyamāne avadānasya homā- rthatvāt avadānenaiva homaprakramāt homāntamavadānaṃ syāt iti someśvaraḥ |
bhāṣyamūle tu tadaṅgaṃ ityudīritaṃ na ca vyākhyātam |
tatra tu tadaṅgaṃ avadānaṃ homāṅgaṃ homasya ādyo'vayavaḥ |
‘saṃyukte tu prakramāt 0’ (5|2|4|6) ityatra dvyavadānasya caturavattaṃ juhoti ityetadavayave vidhānāt na pṛthakpadārthaḥ ityuktam |
saṃyogadayaḥ sadvitīyaṃ padārthamadhyāvanto naikama nirupyante, na ca samudāyāśrayāḥ |
na ca bhavataḥ ‘samūhaḥ saṃyuktāḥ’ iti pratyayavyapadeśau |
apitu ‘anena eta- tsaṃyuktaṃ’ iti vā, ‘saṃyukte ete’ iti vā |
padārthāḥ yadyapi pratyekaṃ na kramamanulambante, parasparaṃ militāstu saṃyogadivat vitatitarūpaṃ kramaṃ vibhrati |
saṃyogato'viśeṣāt prakaraṇaviśeṣaśca muṣṭī- karaṇavacanamapiḥ hastānvenajasya ca kṛtsne prakaraṇe niveśaḥ siddhāntaḥ |
agnihotre dadhnaḥ nityatvaṃ kāmyatvaṃ ca saṃyogapṛthaktvena |
tathā abhīṣomīye paśau āmnāyate ‘khādire badhnāti iti, punaśca ‘khādire vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt iti |
ekasya ubhayatve - nityatve naimittikatve ca saṃyogapṛthaktvaṃ kāraṇam |
tathaikaḥ : ‘khādire badhnāti ’ iti, aparaḥ : ‘khādire vīryakāmasya ’ iti |
duṣ - saṃyogapṛthaktvaṃ hi ekasyāpi ubhayarūpatve kāraṇam |
bhāṣyam - iti cet paśyasi, kasmāt pūrva- syāmapi śeṣo bhavati |
tasyaiva tu dadhnaḥ phala- mindriyam, tathā khādiresya vīryam|
dup-- yathā praṇayanamanūca camase vidhīyamāne'pi ekavākyatvam, evaṃ yadvā juhoti tadindriyakāma- syeti|
pṛthagetāvarthau-- yaśca dadhi- homasaṃyogaḥ yaśca dadhīndriyasaṃyogaḥ|
tathā khādirasya badhnātinā saṃyogo vīryeṇa ca dvāvetāvarthau|
katham ? juhotisamabhivyāhṛta vidhibhivyaktiḥ asaṃbhave śrautahomavidhānasya guṇaṃ samabhivyāhṛtaṃ vidhātumarhati, tadasaṃbhave guṇaphalasaṃbandham|
tatra hi atyantā śruti- rutthyā vākyānturodhena
vā-- 'nāsyā anamadyāt' iti vākyāntaramapi sadanyārthadarśanopāyikatvāt sahodāhṛtam |

tatra yacchabda-jajñyamānaśabda-tulyopādānaśabdābhāvāt saṃvādasya ca kratau puruṣe cāviśeṣaprasakteḥ abhihite- nānuttvadanapratiṣedhanyāyena 'patna patyeṣa te lokaḥ' ityādeḥ kratvarthasya saṃvādasya pratiṣedha iti prāpte'nyathā pratyavasthīyate |
na hi prāgaparuddhāyāḥ prāptirasti kratuṃ prati |
' 'tāmapacchaya yajeta' iti sāmā- nyataḥ sarvasmādeva kratunuṣṭhānāt ato nivartitā kathaṃ saṃvāde prajñayeta |
puruṣasya tu svātantryāt sarvakālasaṃvāde prāpte, niṣedhasyārthavattā |
yadi ca smṛtirevamaryā vidhate, tato mūlamulibhāvi evamapyupagantavyaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- annapratiṣedha bhavati 'nāsyā anna- madyādabhyañjanaṃ vai striyā annam' ityupagamanapratiṣedha eṣa vidhīyate |
sa ca prakaraṇe na prasakta iti, prakaraṇotkṛṣṭaḥ puruṣadharma eṣa niścityate |
brahmacaryavidhānācca na ṛtukale puruṣārthasyāpi satastatprasaktyena svakāle niṣidhyate |
śā-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'malavadvāsasā na saṃvādot' iti |
kimayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kratvarthaḥ uta puruṣārthaḥ iti |
'tāma- vakṣya yajeta' iti vacanāt sarvasādeva kratuvyāpārātri- vṛttā rajasvalā, tena na anayā saha saṃvādasya prasaktiḥ |
puruṣasya hi svāta- ntryeṇa pravartamānasya rajasvalayā prasaṃvadaḥ |
tena yatra pravaktiḥ tatra pratiṣedhaḥ iti puruṣārthatā |
pūrvavat ihāpi phalabhāvāt kratvarthatvamiti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- malavadvāsasaḥ saṃvādaniṣedhamapi puruṣārthaḥ, tasyāḥ prayogārambhāt pūrvameva avarodhā- diti |
' bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoreva 'malavadvāsasā na saṃva- deta' iti śrutam |

na ca 'yasya tryahe'hanyatanyālabhamuktā syāttāmapacchaya yajeta' (taitrā. 3|7|1) iti vacaneva anālabhukāpadavācya- rajasvalāparodhottaraṃ kratvaprayatnena yāgaprayogakartavyatā- vidhānāt kratvabhrabhūtasya laikiphasya ca yājamānasya ātvijyasya vā rajasvalāsaṃvādasyāprasakteḥ kathaṃ pratiṣedha iti vācyam, anyasyāprasaktāvapi sādhāraṇadravyatayā strīchādaśeṃ'numatirūpasya tasya prasakteḥ |

anumaterapi paraṃ- parayā śātuṃ śakyatvena saṃvādāprasaktau tu patyatiriktaraja- svalāntarasaṃvādasya ṛtumaye rāgatḥ prāptāsyāparodhavākyā- viṣayasya smṛtau niṣiddhasyāpi kratvarthatayā pratiṣedho'- nuttvadanapratiṣedhatvāditi prāpte, manunā 'rajasvalā ca ṣaṇḍaśca' ityādi prakramya 'home pradāne bhojye ca yadebhirimiṣyate |
daive haviṣi pitrye vā tadacchya- yathāthayam |
' ityuktvā 'tānapyanyatataḥ' ityanena rajasvalāmātrasya daivakarmāmātre vākyena śrāddhaprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā''panayavidhānācca saha saṃvādāprasaktena kratvartha- tvam |
na ca rajasvalā- mātrasyāpyetadaparodhavākyavaiyarthya aparodhavākyasya patnyā sahaiva patyuradhikārāt rajasvalāyāśca anadhikāreṇa tāṃ vinā yāgākaraṇasaktau darśapūrṇamāsakaraṇavidhyarthatvāt |
śrītāprāyaścita- prāpyarye iti tu śakyate vaktumiti dhyeyam |

yathā kaścit maṇiprabhāṃ maṇibuddhyā paśyan bhrānta eva, tathāpi tadgrahaṇakāle maṇi labhetastaḥ sa saṃvādābhramaḥ, evaṃ tvaṃpadāye tadyadartha- maṇiprabhābhūtaṃ tatpadāryabuddhyā bhāvayan vyavaharato bhrānta eva, tathāpi tatsākṣātkārakāle tadananyasya tatpadārthasya sākṣātkāro'pi saṃvādābhramanyāyena jāyate iti nīlaka- ṇṭhaḥ |
arthaviṣayā hi pratyakṣā saṃvit, na buddhiviṣayā |
kimarthecaiva saṃvit ? na brūmo na saṃvedyā saṃvi- diti |
saṃvittayaiva hi saṃvit saṃvedyā na saṃvedyatayā |
pṛ. 64, saṃvideva tenatena rūpeṇa anubhūyate na vyatiriktiṃ kiṃcit vijñānavāde |
na ca asaṃvedyaiva saṃvit, tanmūlatvāt sarva- bhāvānāṃ saṃvedyabhāvasya |
svaprakāśarūpāt saṃvitḥ na parādhīnaprakāśaḥ iti na karmatā |
pratyakṣaśabdo'pi saṃvidāṃ aparokṣatayā, na punaḥ indriyajñānavedyatayā |
nanu saṃvido vyava- hāraḥ śabdaprayogarūpaḥ, tasya saṃvicchabdena saha vācya- vācakasaṃbandhanasāpekṣatvātsaṃbhavi lakṣaṇam |
grahaṇapekṣā ca smaraṇāthā, gṛhīte'pi saṃbandhe smṛte śabdaprayogā- bhāvāt |
ataḥ pramātṛprameyoyoḥ svavyavahāre saṃvida- pekṣatvāt svaprakāśatvamiti nātivyāptiḥ |
arthāpattistu- ghaṭa- saṃvidavyavahāro ghaṭajñānahetutāṃ vinā nopapadyate iti ghaṭa- saṃvidisyasaṃvida eva siddheḥ |

nanu sarvatra vyavahāratirikttasaṃviditveva vyavahāro dṛṣṭaḥ, kathamatra saṃvidavyavahāre saṃviditveva vyavahārassa sādhyate ? naivam, vyavahārātiriktahetutvaṃ yadi darśanā- devāṅgīkriyate vahi vyavahārātirekajātīyatvaṃ vyava- hārasya dṛḍhamiti tadapyaṅgīkriyatām, ataśca saṃvida- vyavahārassa saṃviditvevamapi na syāt |
vyavahāryavisa- jātīyahetutvamatra tyajatāṃ kaḥ pakṣapātehetuḥ ? klṛptena kāraṇenopapattau saṃvidityakalpanāmanucitam |

evaṃ vā'numānam, saṃvit svaprativvyavahārarūpa- kārya saṃjātīyaparānapekṣā, tathābhūtaparatakāryakāritvāt, yadyathābhūtaparatakāryakāri tat tata svagatatathābhūte sajātīyaparānapekṣaṃ yathā rūpaṃ rūpāntarānapekṣaṃ parimāṇaṃ vā parimāṇāntarānapekṣam |
nanu liṅgaliṅgena liṅgenaikāntikaḥ, yathā dhūmena agnimanumīyate, agninā cauṣṇyam, tatra agniḥ parānu- mānakārya karoti, sānumāne ca dhūmaṃ apekṣate, naivam, tatrāpi vijātīyaliṅgāpekṣatvāt |

na hi sajātīyaśabdena atyantajātirabhipritā, evaṃ tarhi ghaṭajñānasya ghaṭajñānāntarāpekṣā''sannamaṭe'pi nāsti, jñāna- viṣayajñānamevāpekṣate, ataśca siddhasādhanamiti cet, naivam, jñānaṃ sarvamekajātīyam, ghaṭajñānaṃ paṭajñānamityu- pādhimedāt medaḥ, yatra tatrāpyadhimantareṇa svata eva medo
nirūpayituṃ śakyate tatra medābhyupagamaḥ, ataśca na siddhasādhanatā |
nanu aṅgulīprenaikāntikātvaṃ yathā ca aṅgulīḥ paragatasparśakāryaṃ karoti atha svagate sparśa'ṅgulītvama- pekṣate |
naivam, yasya padārthasya yadasādhāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasya kāryasya svasminnutpattau sajātīyaparāpekṣatvaṃ sādhyam, iha tu sparśakāryaṃ aṅgullyā nasādhāraṇaṃ avayavāntareṇāpi spaṣṭuṃ śakyatvāt |
vyavahārarūpaṃ tu kāryaṃ jñānasya, rūpavyavacchedo'pi rūpasyaiva, mānavyavahāro'pi pari- māṇasyaiva, ato na kaściddoṣaḥ |

paraprakāśatve yadanumānam- parapekṣatvāt guṇatvāt vyavahāryatvādādimaguṇātvādityādi, tat sarvaṃ dharmagrāhaka- pramāṇaviruddhatvāt bādhitaviṣayam, jñānasya svata eva siddhiḥ na jñānāntareṇetyuktatvāt |
tatkatham - 'svata eva yadutpadyate na tatra parāpekṣā' iti, 'dhīkarmaṇaḥ siddha- mabhyupagacchā''daśyaṃ vītvenāpi siddhiśceyā' iti |
paraprakāśatvanirākaraṇe'pi anumānaṃ vyatirekirūpamasti, anubhūtitvāt prakāśatvāt jñānatvāt vyavahārahe
na upavatī na abhyavatī vā kartavyā kintu anyaiva |
bhā. 101516|59-61. saṃvādau ubhayasāmake kratau bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ pṛṣṭhastotra eva samuccitya niveśaḥ ||
'saṃkhye ume kuryāt, apavitrāvapyekāhe ume kuryāt' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ bṛhadrathaṃtare vibhakte bhavataḥ, uta samaste iti |
kutaḥ samastā avagamyate, kuto vā vyakteti |
te yadi samaste, athavā vyaste bhavataḥ, ubhayathā'pi kratu- stābhyāṃ saṃvaddho bhavati |
kutaḥ ? prakṛtau hi bṛhadratha- tarābhyāmanyatareṇa pṛṣṭhaṃ sādhitam, ihāpi prakṛti- vacodakānugrahāya anyatareṇa sādhayitavyamavagamyate |
evaṃ ca pṛṣṭhasaṃbaṃdhā karmaṇāṃ kātsnyena pravṛttau codakī'nu- grahīṣyate, ubhayośca pṛṣṭhasādhanatvonyonyena vihatatvā- dayogāntaramāpadyeta, na rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ na bṛhatpṛṣṭhamiti |
ubhayathā'pi vacanāthaupapattau na codakabādhāyāṃ kāraṇa- masti |
tasmādyathā na viśvajiti bṛhadādīnāṃ sarveṣāmekatra niveśaḥ, evamihāpīti |
kutaḥ ? prakṛtau hi bṛhadratha- tarābhyāṃ vikalpamānābhyāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ sādhitam |
iha idānīṃ vikṛtau tayorigatadeśayoḥ vikalpyatvena prāptayoḥ kevalametadvacanaṃ samastyavidhānārtham, ume bṛhadrathaṃtare kuryāditi |
evaṃ ca sāmastyaṃ bhavati, yadi te sāmanī parasparaṃ na jahītaḥ |
upāyatvena cānayoḥ śrutatvāt dvitvaśrutiḥ samāsaśrutiśca vivakṣitaiva |
tena yatra bṛhat, tatra rathaṃtarasahitam, na kevalamiti |
tatra vyastayorāpi kriyamāṇayoḥ sāhityaṃ na virudhyate |
yathā devadattayajñadattayoḥ pākena samastayorapi saṃyoge undyamāne, ekaḥ kiṃcitkaroti, aparo'pi kiṃcit |
pradhānopakārā- pekṣaṃ sāhityamiti samastasaṃyogo na virudhyate iti |
yena kriyāvayavenā''rambhameṇa madhyena avasānena vā yogaḥ, tena sahitayoḥ na pṛthakkṣaḥ |
na hyatrāyāmadhi- śrīyāmāṇāyāṃ bhūyo'dhiśrayaṇaṃ śakyate kartumityathaviro- dhācca karoti, na tu śabdenāsau tatra na coditaḥ |
te ca śaknutaḥ sahite pṛṣṭhaṃ saṃskartumiti |
yaduktam, ubhayathā saṃbhave codakā- nugraho nyāyya iti |
tatra pratyakṣātsamastavidhānāccodake bādhyamāne na doṣo bhavati |
bhāṣyam— liṅgaṃ ca darśayati, yathā samastayoḥ prayogo na vyastayoriti |
kiṃ liṅgam ? evamāha, mahā- vṛkṣau vai bṛhadrathaṃtare nidhanaṃ samāpyate, yanmahāvṛkṣau samuccayete |
yadi bhinnadeśe syātām, athaidava tatra nidhanabhedaḥ siddhaḥ |
tathā'paraṃ liṅgam, pūrvāṇau vai rathaṃtaram, aparāhṇe bṛhaditi, ekenāhāmisaṃcāradekasthānatāṃ darśayati |

śa— yatra saṃsavādau 'ubhe bṛhadrathaṃtare bhavataḥ' iti śrutaṃ tatra kiṃ ubhayoḥ pṛṣṭhasādhanatvaṃ uta ekena pṛṣṭhaṃ itareṇa stotrāntaraṃ sādhayitvamiyati saṃśaye codakena vikalpapṛṣṭhaprāptestadanugrahāya ekameva pṛṣṭhasādhanaṃ itarattu

sāma viśvajitstotrāntare'pi syāt, naivaṃ viśvajiti vācanikaḥ kāryāntare niveśaḥ na tviha tādṛk vacanamasti yena kāryāntare niveśaḥ syāt, tena vikalpena prāptayoḥ pṛṣṭhayoḥ samuccayamātraṃ vacanena kriyate, codakavādhastu stotrāntarasādhanatve'pi tulyaḥ, tasmāt pṛṣṭha eva niveśaḥ |
soma— codakānugrahatyaiva pūrvoktayāstayoḥ saṃkhyāmātravikāratve itaradravyeṣu saṃkhyāprāpakacodakānugraha evaṃ ihāpi tadanugrahāya nobhayoḥ sādhanaṃ ityuktānāt saṃgatiḥ |

' bhāṭṭa— saṃsavādau yatra bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ samuccayavidhiḥ tatra kimubhayoḥ prākṛtapṛṣṭhastotra eva niveśaḥ ? athavā ekasya pṛṣṭhe'parasya stotrāntare ? iti cintāyāṃ kratu- saṃbandhitvena śrutasya sāmadvayasamuccayasya ekastotranive- śāmāve'pyupapatteḥ prakṛtiprāptanairapekṣyānurodhena stotrabhede- naiva niveśāvagateḥ tatrāpi ekasyāpyavagatapṛṣṭhasaṃbandhenaiva niveśopapattau ubhayostathātve pramāṇābhāvāt ekasya pṛṣṭhastotre niveśo'parasya stotrāntare, tatrāpi pavamāna eva |

yanmate tu prakṛtau sāmadvayasādhyapṛṣṭhastotramevaḥ tanmate'pi sāmnoḥ prakṛtau bhinnakāryetvena nairapekṣyasyāpyakteḥ stotrayoreva nairapekṣa- yauvikalpena sādhanatvāt ubhayoḥ sāmanorekapṛṣṭhapūrvapā- vagatāvāntarakāryavādhe pramāṇābhāvenāvaśyaikapṛṣṭhastotra eva samuccayaviśiṣṭasāmadvayavidhānam, anyathā sāmāntarāśe stotrāntararūpadvadvārā'ntarasyāktasya kalpanāpatteḥ |
ataśca ubhayamata'pyekasmin pṛṣṭhastotre dvayoḥ sāmnostadādhāraśca samuccayaḥ |

tatrāpi 'pūrvāṇau vai rathaṃtaraparāho bṛhat' ityarthavādāt 'ādyā adyo rathaṃtareṇa anyā nava bṛhatā' iti prāpte'pi sāmana- stṛcapāṭhasaṃpattyarthaṃ paryāyabhedena 'keṣucit prathamatau rathaṃtaraṃ paścāt bṛhat' iti dhyeyam |
kalpasūtrakārāstu- saṃsavādau api eka pṛṣṭhastotre aparasya pavamāne viśvajitadeva niveśamāmananti- ṛtva- ntareṣu keṣucit 'bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ paryāyabhedena ekaṃ macce'paramubhayataḥ' ityevaṃrgamam |
keṣucit 'ekasyā- meva bṛhadyonau rathaṃtaryonau vā pūrvādhrye eva aparaṛta- rārdhve' ityevaṃ samuccayam |
' ubhayaśrutau ubhaya- sāmani yāge 'dvaiṣṭham' dve pṛṣṭhe iti dvaiṣṭham, dvayoreva sāmnoḥ samuccayena prayogaḥ |
' saṃsavādivikṛtau upalavyatvaloḥ naimittikoyoḥ prākṛtoḥ pṛṣṭhapratipadoḥ nānuṣṭhānam |
101516|59- 61. mīko. pṛ. 1164 'upatvayavavalonaimitti- kayoḥ : 0' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
mīnyā., ratnākaraḥ ātmavāde 89. oṃ na anāditayā saṃsārasya ādimandatā kasyacit kalpayituṃ śakyate |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 238. 'dharmo'pi ca vṛṇotyeva naraṃ saṃsāravartinam |
anitye nityabuddhiḥ asukhe sukhabuddhiḥ anātmani ātmabuddhiḥ iti upapannāḥ saṃsārahetavo viparītagrahāḥ |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 49. saṃstataḥ nāma daśa havīṃṣi rājasūye |
teṣu aṣṭama-navama-daśamāni trīṇi upasadāmādimadhyāvasāneṣu kartavyatā vihitāni, tathāpi na tāni upasadādam kintu anumatyādivat rājasūye pradhānānyeva |
ata eva dampaloḥ dānādikartṛtvaṃ vyāsajyavṛtti, tayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭadravyatvāt saṃsṛṣṭasya svatvanivṛtteścomayādhīnatvāt |
saṃskāraḥ cayanameḥ, na tu kamantaraṃ cayanaṃ nāma |
bhā. 2|3|1|21-23, saṃskāraḥ aṣṭo'pyasti ityavagamyate loke, yathā-prāmāntarādā- gatānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ paryamikaraṇe aṣṭaka upacāraḥ kriyate ityucyate |
saṃskāraḥ - aṣṭopakārajananako'pi saṃbhavati (yathā prāmāntarādāgatānāṃ agnilavaṇādinā parikaraṇam |
anubhūte eva vastuni smaraṇaṃ bhavati nānubhūte |
tatra yadi anubhavaḥ kaṃcidatiśayaṃ ātmani nādadhyāt tadā anubhavānanubhūtayoḥ aviśeṣāt ubhaya- trāpi smṛtiḥ syāt |
ataevayaṃ vyavasthā smṛtiḥ : upajāyamānā anubhavāhitasaṃskāraṃ prakalpayati |
so'pi yadi anubhavata kṣaṇikaḥ syāt, kālāntare smṛtirnopapadyate |
saṃskāro nāma sa bhavati, yasmin jāte padārtho yogya bhavati kasyacidarthasya |
tenāpi kriyāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ prayojanaṃ iti so'pi parārthaḥ |
saṃskāraḥ : avahanyādiḥ : yāgāsahanapuroḍāśā- dinirvṛttaye coditānāṃ śrīyādīnāṃ svarūpeṇayogatvāt avahatānāṃ yogyatvāt, avahatānāṃ yogyatvamāpādayan utparthyādaṃ bhavati |
tathā anāramya śrūyate ‘vāyavyaṃ śveta- mālameta bhūtikāmaḥ’ iti |

kimatra vāyavyavākye dārśa- paurṇamāsikaṃ īpālmabhaṃ anudya īpāyāṃ śvetatvaṃ guṇe vidhīyate, tathā sauryavākye dārśapaurṇamāsikaṃ nirvāpamanudya caturguṇe vidhīyate athavā bhūtibrahmavarcasaphale vāyusūrya- devaśvetatvacaruguṇake ālabhamanirvāpake karmāntare yāva- duktetikartavyatāke vidhīyate kiṃvā uktaguṇaphalaviśiṣṭe yāgau vidhīyate iti trikoṭiko vicāraḥ |
asmin sūtre, dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ : ‘yāvaduktaṃ’ (13) iti sūtre, tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ : ‘yajatitu’ (14) iti sūtre siddhāntatvena vakṣyate |
aprakaraṇe kasyacit prakaraṇamārabhya śrute vāyavyavākye īpāyāḥ saṃskāraḥ ālabhamḥ brīhisaṃskāra nirvāpaḥ krameṇa śvetatvacarulakṣaṇaguṇavidhānāya anudyate |
atra vārtikam- yathaiva ayaneṣu guṇasaṃbadhapare vākye karmavidhiśabdābhāvāt akarmāntaratvaṃ tathā ihāpi bhaviṣyati iti caśabdena anvādidyate |
ka cāsau guṇavidhiḥ iti viṣayāvadhāraṇārthaṃ aprakaraṇagrahaṇam |

(sudhā- anāramyadhītatvena ayanavailakṣaṇyāt kathaṃ nirvāpālambhaśrutyoḥ guṇārthatā ityāśaṅkānirāsārthaḥ : apra- karaṇaśabdaḥ iti anyathā vyācaṣṭe-) athavā yadyapye- tāvatā pūrvavailakṣaṇyena aprakaraṇe śrūyate tathāpi karmaṇe vidhiśabdanavarodhāt guṇārthaiva punaḥ śrutiḥ |
kalpakatvāt tadnyāvṛttyā tyajyamānahavirddeśyatvātma- kahavirbhokatvalakṣaṇasya devatātvasya yāgakalpakatvasūcanāthaṃ bhoktṛśabdaḥ |

' vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta ' ' sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet ' iti ālambhatinirvapattibhyāṃ lakṣaṇayā yāgo vidhīyate ityatra ' somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet ' iti prakṛtya ' pariśrite yājayet ' iti somāraudre carī pariśrayaṇa- vidhipare vākye yāgānuvādo dṛśyate tat liṅgaṃ bhavati |
dvitīye ' vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta ' ' caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati ' ityālambhanirvapaṇī atra śvetacaturguṇī vicī- yete, vāyavyaṃ iti īśāyāḥ vṛkṣaprabhavatvāt, vṛkṣasya ca vāyusaṃbandhāt |

caruṃmiti caroḥ sthāllyāḥ tenatvi- tvena sūprasādet kathaṃcit anuvādaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe, ālambhanirvapaṇīyoḥ loke'pi sattvena vyabhicārāt na dāśapūrṇamāsikayoreva upasthitiḥ saṃbhavati iti siddhāntinā ukte liṅga vihitau yau ālambhanirvapaṇī iti viśeṣaṇāt nāyaṃ doṣaḥ ityāśaṅkya, evaṃ talliṅgaṃ anuvādakatvātḥ guṇavidhinaṃ labhyate, ubhayāśrayaṇe ca yugapadvidyanudāvirodhaḥ ityuttaritaṃ iti |
anyathā paṭaviṣayakānubhavasya svajanyasaṃskārasaṃbandhena smṛtihetutve ghaṭatvaprakārakānubhavāt tadviśeṣyakasaraṇā- pattiḥ |
saṃskāraḥ sviṣṭakṛdyāgaḥ pradhānahaviṣāṃ na karmī- ntaram |
saṃskāro hi nāma sa bhavati yaḥ svakāryaṃ śaktimupajanayati |
jyotiṣṭome paśuyajñārthasya yūpasya prokṣaṇādayaḥ saṃskārāḥ pratipanna bhedena kartavyāḥ tantreṇa veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
tathā ca trayāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ niyojanakālasya medāt yūpasaṃskārāṇāma āvṛttiḥ kartavyā |
tuśabdaḥ yūpavailakṣaṇyārthaḥ, yūpo nāvartyate, saṃskārāstu āvarteran iti |
tatkālāstu yūpakarmatvāt, tasya dharmavidhānāt, sarvīthānāṃ ca vacanādanyakālatvam |
prokṣaṇādyanādayaḥ saṃskārāḥ tatkālāḥ syuḥ; tasya yūpasya kālaḥ dīkṣākālaḥ sa eva kāle yeṣāṃ te tatkālāḥ |
yūpa- karmatvāt kriyate iti karma kāryam |
yūpaḥ karma yeṣāṃ te yūpakarmaṇaḥ saṃskārāḥ |
athavā tatkālāḥ; tasya agnī- ṣomīyasya kāla eva kālo yeṣāṃ te tatkālāḥ saṃskārāḥ tantreṇa sarveṣāmapyardhveti iti |
tasya yūpasya dharmavidhā- nāt dharmāṇāṃ vidhānāt yūpadharmatvena vidhānāṃ vidhā- nāt na teṣāṃ niyojanadharmatvam |
sarvāthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ arthānāṃ yaḥ kālaḥ tasmāt teṣāṃ anyakālatvamapi vacanāt vacanabalāt syāt |
paripyāṇādanantaraṃ upākaraṇaṃ syāt iti paripyāṇākaraṇayorānantaryārthaṃ paripyāṇānukramam |
ke. saṃskārāstu puruṣasāmarthye yathāvedaṃ karmavad vyavatiṣṭheran |
jyotiṣṭome ' keśaśmaśru vapate, dato dhāvate, nakhāni nikṛntate, snāti ' iti saṃskārāḥ vapanādayaḥ puruṣa- sāmarthye nimitte, kartuḥ puruṣasya karmasāmarthyaprāptyarthaṃ vihitāḥ |
te yathāvedaṃ vidhāyakavacanānusāreṇa samākhyāyā vyavatiṣṭheran vyavasthitāḥ syuḥ |
karmavat yāni karmāṇi yasmin vede vidhīyante tāni tadevasaṃvinā puruṣeṇa kriyante, ādhvaryavāṇi karmāṇi adhvaryuṇā, hautrakarmāṇi hotrā ityādi tadvat |
atra sudhā- puruṣāṇāṃ kartṛṇāṃ sugādivat apūrva- sādhanatvasāmarthyaṃ janayitavye tajjananārthaṃ saṃskārāpekṣā iti |
saṃskāra vapanādayaḥ jyotiṣṭome yājamānāḥ yajamānakartṛkāḥ syuḥ : nādhvaryukartṛkāḥ |
tatpradhānatvāt yajamānapradhānatvāt, kriyāphalasya, yajamānagāmittvena saṃskāreṣu yajamānasyaiva pradhānatvāt |
karmavat pradhānabhūtāni dravyotsargakarmāṇi karmāṇi yathā yajamānakartṛkāṇi tadvat |
phalaṃ yathā yājamānaṃ tathā phalārthaḥ : saṃskārā api yājamānāḥ |

atra sudhā- saṃskārāṇāṃ phalapratigrahaṇaśaktijananārtha- tvāt yajamānasyaiva ca tajjananāpekṣatvāt bhokuṃśapāti- tvalakṣaṇena liṅgena tadarthatvaniścayāt na samākhyāyā adhvaryūṃsaṃskārāthatā śaṅkituṃ śakyā iti|
jyotiṣṭome vapanādayaḥ saṃskārāḥ yājamānāḥ nādhva- ryavāḥ iti siddhānte hetvantarapratipādanāye sūtram |

‘tamyannakti’ ‘śareṣīkayā anakti’ iti yajña- mānasya abhyañje añjane ca adhvaryukartṛke parasmaipadena vyapadeśāt ‘vapate, dato dhāvate’ ityatra ātmanepadena vyapadeśāt jñāyate vapanādayo yājamānāḥ saṃskārā iti|

atra sudhā- dhāvatitapatikuntīnāṃ svaritatvāt dantadhāvanādīnāṃ kartṛbhiprāyakriyāphalatvādātmanepadāt dantadhāvanasya ca lokato'pi tata eva snānasyāpi svayaṃ- kartṛtprasiddheḥ vapana-nakhanikṛntanayośca nāpitakartṛt- niyamaprasiddhe
mādhyaṃdine savane, saugandhikena tṛtīyasavane ' iti, davagamyate |
prākṛtasya samuccayaḥ bādho veti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
saṃskāre abhyañjane ca prākṛtena saha samuccayaḥ vālyām |
syāt anyasaṃyogāt anyasmin kāle kāryārthārtha ' khalevālyāṃ takṣaṇoṣādidharmāṇāṃ bādhaḥ ' ityatra |
snehanārthaṃ navanītam, virūkṣīkaraṇārthaṃ gaugulavādi śabdena ekādaśinigata upaśaye |
ajanāmyajñane satre savanatraye añjanābhyañjanadravyeṇa rāṇāṃ - paryuhaṇa secanaṃ dṛḍhīkaraṇaṃ akṣan- ityādīnāṃ |
gaugulavādinā prākṛtasya codakaprāptasya navanītasya anuṣṭhānaṃ sādyaske khalevālyām |
samuccayaḥ iti siddhānte uktaṃ pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
iti tiṣṭhati paśau prathamānā prākṛtakāryā eva vapanādīnāṃ lopo'syiṣya mutādhikāritvapakṣe |
bhavanti tena prākṛtaprayājānāṃ pāśukeḥ prayājaiḥ bādha eva 2|8|50. mīko. pṛ. 760 (4) 'asthiṣya |
' prayājavaditi cet ' iti sūtreṇa prāptāṃ pūrvapakṣinaḥ nirvṛtterakamiti |
arthā- hi samānadravyāśrayatvena sarvasya prādhānyaṃ bhavati, |
iti pratyakṣaṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ ca yāgaguṇabhūtanairātirekeṇa phalamatigrahaṇa- |
kāryāntaraṃ vartate iti prākṛtasya navanītasya na bādhaḥ |
bāla. bhāgena kṛte'pi saṃskāre dvitīyo'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' vrīhī- lavena prātaḥsavane abhyañjate abhi vā''ḍate, pailudāraveṇa |
saumikeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu ' utkare vājinamāsādayanti ' prāptau niyamāthaṃ avahananaśrutiḥ |
idaṃ āsādanaṃ dalanasyāpi lokataḥ prāptau iti niyamārthā śrutiḥ |
evaṃ sati prakulanuparodhāt prakṛteḥ prākṛtasya codakasya sūtrākṣarārthastu, caśabdaḥ atideśasūcanārthaḥ |
uparodhaḥ prakṛtyuparodhaḥ, na prakṛtyanuparodhaḥ prakṛtyanuparodhaḥ, saṃskāre avahananādirūpe śrutiḥ niyamārthā |
' vaiyā havīṃṣyāsādayati ' ' yūpe paśuṃ niyuñjanti ' tvāt avahananādiniyamasya yāgapradhānatvāt iti |
sa niyamaḥ pradhānaṃ yasyāṃ sā śrutiḥ |
vidhestu tatra bhāvāt saṃdehasya śabdastadarthaḥ lokataḥ pakṣe prāptau avahananādiśruteḥ niyamaparatvaṃ |
saumikeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu ' utkare vājinamāsādayanti ' ' saṃskāre ca tatpradhānatvāt ' (4|2|11|26) |
ida- atra avahananādīnāṃ dṛṣṭārthatvena prāptatvāt avidheyala- |
māsādanaṃ niyojanaṃ ca dharmamātraṃ kāryāntaraṃ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ māśaṅkaya niyamārthatvena deśādivat vidhānaṃ |
vaikṛtasya ca āsādananiyojanavidheḥ tatra cāturmāsya- saṃskāre ca tatpradhānatvāt |
prakaraṇe bhāvāt virodhena saṃdeha iti yasya śabdaḥ ekādaśiniṣu paśuṣu gudānāṃ upayājahomaḥ pratipatti- |
yaduddiśya vidhāyakaḥ śabdaḥ syāt tadarthaḥ syāt sa rūpaḥ saṃskāraḥ |
tathā ca prākṛtaṃ vājināsādana- tvāt upayuktadravyasaṃskārapradhānatvāt upayājahomasya |
evaṃ prākṛtaṃ gudānāṃ samuccayaḥ syāt, na vikalpaḥ |
paśuniyojanamuddiśya paridhirūpasya guṇasya vidhiḥ iti ke. |
tasmādatra prākṛtayoreva āsādananiyojanayoḥ saṃskāre ca tatpradhānatvāt ' (1|2|14|8) |
atra ' gudenopayajati ' iti śrutaṃ paśugaṇe pratipatti- |
saumikeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu ' utkare vājinamāsādayanti ' saṃskāre tu kriyāntaraṃ tasya vidhāyakatvāt |
prākṛtayoreva āsādana-niyojanayoḥ utkaraparidhirūpa- saumikacāturmāsyeṣu ' utkare vājinamāsādayanti ' |
nanu utkaraḥ ' paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjanti ' iti śrūyate |
vīkṣaṇāṃ mṛdāṃ rāśirbhavati tatra vājināsādanaṃ kartuṃ niyojanaṃ ca dharmamātraṃ ahārthe kriyāntaraṃ iti pūrvapakṣa- |
upaśayāne paridhau kartuṃ na śakyeta iti guṇavidhiraśakya niyojanaṃ ca prākṛtāt āsādānādeḥ kriyāntaraṃ syāt |
sati utkare āsādanaṃ paridhau niyojanaṃ kartuṃ śakyate
etādṛśa guṇena saṃyogāt āsādananiyojanarūpasaṃskāra- sāmarthyaṃ utkaraparidhyorbhaviṣyati |
saumikeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu ' utkare vājinamāsāda- yanti ' ' paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjanti ' iti śrūyate |
atra prākṛtayoreva āsādananiyojanayoḥ utkaraparidhirūpa- guṇavidhirarthaḥ iti siddhānta uktaḥ |
nanu yathā sautrā- maṇīprakaraṇe ' brāhmaṇasya mūrdhnyāsādayati ' ( surāgrahān ) iti dharmamātrāsādanaṃ evamihāpi syāt iti cet |
prakaraṇe carakasautrāmaṇīprakaraṇe vipratiṣedhāt surābhāṇḍasya homaparyantacarikāliāsādanasya brāhmaṇa- mūrdhni aśakyatvāt kriyā cāntaraṃ dharmamātraṃ adṛṣṭārthaṃ syāt |
ke. saṃskāre phalaśrutiḥ ' yadāhvakte, caturyeva ātu- nyasya vṛhakte ' iti |
mīnsā. saṃskāre yujyamānānāṃ tādarthyāt tatprayuktaṃ syāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' prokṣitābhyāmulkhalamusalābhyāmana- hanti ' ' prokṣitābhyāṃ dṛṣadupalābhyāṃ pinaṣṭi ' iti śrūyate |
tatra prokṣaṇaṃ kiṃ hantipiśādiprayuktaṃ uta apūrva- prayuktaṃ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
saṃskāre avahanana- peṣaṇādiprayujyamānānāṃ prokṣaṇādidharmāṇāṃ tatprayuktatā saṃskāraprayuktatā syāt |
yadi yadarthaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavati tat tasya prayojakam |
jyotiṣṭome ' yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanubrūyāt, mandraṃ prāṇīyatāṃ, mandraramātithyāyāṃ, upāṃśusaptasu ' iti śrūyate |
tatra kiṃ paramāpūrvaprayuktā uta dīkṣaṇīyāpūrvaprayuktā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
saṃskāre paramāpūrvatve yujyamānānāṃ dīkṣaṇīyādyūpai yujyamānānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ tāda- rthyāt paramāpūrvārthatvāt tatprayuktā paramāpūrvaprayuktā eva syāt |
tena svarthena yajñasya saṃyogād dharmasaṃbandha- stasmād yajñaprayuktaṃ syāt saṃskārasya tadartha- tvāt |
tenāvahananādinā yajñasya apūrvasa saṃyogāt avaghātasya prakaraṇāt apū- vārthatvāt dharmasaṃbandhaḥ avahananasya apūrvasādhanatvena prokṣaṇena dharmeṇa saṃbandhaḥ |
tasmāt nakhanirmiñcarāvi nakheṣu prokṣaṇaṃ yajñaprayuktaṃ apūrvaprayuktaṃ syāt |
tasmāt dravyādi- saṃskāraḥ na avahananādiprayuktaḥ kiṃtu apūrvaprayukta eveti siddhāntaḥ |
' yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanubrūyāt, mandraṃ prāṇīyatāṃ, mandraramāti- thyāyāṃ, upāṃśusaptasu ' iti dīkṣaṇīyādau svaraviśeṣaḥ |
paramāpūrvaprayuktaḥ na tu dīkṣaṇīyādyantarāpūrvaprayukta iti yaduktaṃ tanna iti tuśabdārthaḥ |
tasmāt yajñaprayuktaṃ dīkṣaṇīyādyajñaprayuktaṃ syāt dharma- jātam |
bhāṭṭa. 6|1|15. saṃskārārthānāṃ karmaṇāṃ satre ahīne ca bahukartṛke sarve kartāraḥ na tu gṛhapataureva |
bhā. 1|2|4|35. saṃskārodbodhakaṃ na vastugrahaṇamekameva, nānā- prakāratvāt tadudbodhakatvanām |
bāla. pṛ. 145. saṃskārabhede karmamedo na hi bhavati |
10|2|18|50. mīko. pṛ. 760 (4) ' asthi- yajñasya mṛtādhikāripakṣe ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭa- vyam |
saṃskāraśabdastu ayam ( ṛtvik ), varaṇabharaṇe hi saṃskāro |
te yeṣāṃ na sto na te satyapi kriyāyoge tacchabdavācyā bhaviṣyanti |
te ca varaṇabharaṇe satdaśā- nāmeva yajamānena kriyate |
vā. 3|7|16|33. saṃskārasaṃbandhaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' śeṣaṃ sviṣṭa- kṛte samavadyati ' iti vidhīyate na karmāntaram |
saṃskārahetuḥ kriyā na dravyam, tat vyañjakaṃ syāt |
vi. 5|1|11. saṃskārakaḥ tṛtīyo'nuyānaḥ darśapūrṇamāsagata- sviṣṭakṛdevatānām, ataḥ saṃnipatyopakārakaḥ |
' naidhātavīyā dīkṣaṇīyā ' ityādi, yajamānasaṃskārārthatvena upādā- nāt |
maṇi. pṛ. 129. saṃskāryaṃ deśaḥ kālaḥ phalaṃ nimittaṃ ityupadeyapañcakam |
bāla. pṛ. 88. saṃskāryaḥ pradhānam, saṃskāro guṇaḥ |
vi. 10|1|8. bhūtabhāvyaprayogaṃ hi saṃskāryaṃ dravya- miṣyate ' |
vā. 2|1|4|2 pṛ. 411. saṃskāra- yasya phalasya ca karmabhedakatvam |

bāla. pṛ. 19, saṃskāryataḥ vyavasthārūpaḥ pratiṣedho yathā- āśvalāyana- gṛhe hoṣyadameṣu sarvatra parastaraṇaṃ vidhāya ' kṛtākṛta- mājyahomeṣu parastaraṇāt ' iti akṛtaśabdena anyatra vyavasthayā niṣedha uktaḥ |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ śrūyate ' upaśayo yūpo bhavati ' iti |
sa ca nocchrīyate kiṃtu dakṣiṇataḥ upa samīpe ayaṃ śete iti upaśayanāt upaśayo'yam |
tadidaṃ upaśayadravyaṃ joṣaṇādidharmasaṃskṛtaṃ syāt asaṃ- skṛtameva vā syāt iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
upa- śayadravyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ syāt jovaṇacchedādibhiḥ saṃskāraiḥ |
sa yūpaḥ iti saṃskṛtatvaviśiṣṭa- bodhaka śabdaḥ yasya sa tacchabdaḥ |
saṃskāranimittaka- yūpaśabdoditatvāt asya upaśayasya ' upaśayo yūpo bhavati ' iti |
yūpānāṃ dakṣiṇataḥ bhūmo ayaṃ yo śete iti upaśayo nāma dvādaśaḥ yūpaḥ |
ayaṃ saṃskāraḥ saṃskṛtaḥ syāt iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasyan arthāt asaṃskṛtattvaṃ siddhāntamāha |
yadyapi upaśaye yūpaśabdaḥ saṃskāravācī prayuktaḥ tathāpi ayaṃ yūpaśabdo bhaktyā syāt stutyarthaḥ |
nahi asmin paśurniyujyate, tena ayaṃ yajñaśeṣo na bhavati |
chedanādīnāṃ keṣāṃ- cideva saṃskārāṇāṃ abhidhāyakaḥ yūpaśabdo'yam |
tasmāt itarayūpavat nāyaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ādhānamātrasaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu agnihotrādīni niya- tāni karmāṇi aindrāgnādīni ca aniyatāni karmāṇi pravartan |
uta pavamāneṣṭibhiḥ saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu ( iti ) vicāre ādhānamātrasaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu karmāṇi pravartan |
yathā 'āhitāgniḥ na klinaṃ dāru abhyādadhyāt ' ityādīni āhitāgneḥ vratāni āhitāgnereva bhavanti tadvat |
saṃskṛteṣu pavamāneṣṭibhiḥ saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu karmāṇi agnihotrā- dīni aindrāgnādīni ca pravartan |
kutaḥ ? saṃskārāṇāṃ pavamāneṣṭyādīnāṃ tadarthatvāt anyarthatvāt karmārthatvāt |
āhavanīyādiṣu siddheṣu karmāṇi bhavanti, āhavanīyā- disiddhiśca āghānena pavamāneṣṭibhiśca |
āghāne pavamāneṣṭīḥ kṛtvā agnihotrādīni karmāṇi kuryāt |
'āhitāgnirna klinaṃ dāru abhyādadhyāt ' klinaṃ ārdram, dāru kāṣṭhaṃ agnau āhitāgniḥ na ambā-
dadhyāt ityādidaṃtaṃ tu anantaraṃ eva āghānānantarameva pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ prāgapi svīkuryāt |
āhitaiṣveva agniṣu yajamānasya tadbhūtatvāt āhitāgnitvena niṣpannatvāt |
pavamāneṣṭibhiḥ saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu agnihotrādīni karmāṇi na pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ pūrvaṃ iti siddhānte ukte pūrvapakṣamāha |
yathā pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ parastāt karmāṇi pūrvamapi pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ syuḥ |
'agniṃ vai suṣṭuṃ agnihotreṇānudravanti ' iti āhita- mātreṣu agniṣu agnihotraṃ darśayati |
etasya liṅgasya darśanāt pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ pūrvaṃ karmāṇi syuḥ |
āghānānantaraṃ saṃvatsarottaraṃ vā dvādaśadinottaraṃ vā ādhānāṅgabhūtāḥ pavamāneṣṭayaḥ kartavyāḥ |
antarāle ca tūṣṇīṃhomarūpā agnihotrādyoḥ kartavyā bhavanti |
pūrvapakṣī tu pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ prāgapi mukhyo'gnihotrahomaḥ darśapūrṇamāsādayaśca kartavyā iti manyate |
arthasya tūṣṇīṃhomarūpasya arthasya vidyamānatvāt 'pūrvamiṣṭibhyaḥ' ityayamarthavādaḥ pratyetavyaḥ |

ādhānamātrasaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ prāk yadi agnihotrādīni aindrāgnādīni ca karmāṇi syuḥ tadā 'na vā tāsāṃ tadarthatvāt' ( 3|6|14|12 ) iti yo nyāya uktaḥ, tena vipratiṣedhaḥ virodhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt pavamāneṣṭiṃsaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu karmāṇi kartavyāni iti siddhāntaḥ |
darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ śeṣakāryāṇi ekasmādeva haviṣaḥ kartavyāni iti pūrvapakṣe ityevantamam |
tupoṣavākapālavat śeṣasya anyarthatvena prāptasyāpi śeṣakāryāṇi prati upādeyatvena vivakṣitaikasaṃkhyavāda
eśeṣasādhitaireva śeṣakāryaiḥ pradhānasyopakṛtatvāt na śeṣāntarebhyaḥ kāryāṇi |
paryagnikaraṇadibhireva śeṣasya saṃskṛtatvāt śeṣa- kāryāṇāṃ saṃskāratvātnupapatteḥ na sarvaidāguṇyasiddhaye sarvebhyaḥ kāryāṇi ityevaṃ pūrvasūtraśeṣapadānubandhena sūtra- vyākhyā ( vārtikākārayā ) |

pradhānapūrvasādhanayogyatājñānārthasaṃskārasaṃskṛtasyāpi śeṣasya pratipartho'yaṃ saṃskāro na viruddha ityā- śaṅkānirāsārthatvena kṛtakāryadravyasaṃskārānarthakyāpatteḥ atītasaṃskārāvasaratvāt ityevaṃ āghṛtyā vyākhyā |
saṃskṛtarūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma yathā- 'vrīhīna prokṣati ' iti |
saṃsthā hi kriyā prati audāsīnyam, vyāpārāntara- karaṇaṃ vā pūrvasāt karmaṇaḥ |
saṃsthāḥ agniṣṭomaḥ, ukthyaḥ, ṣoḍaśī, atirātraḥ iti catasraḥ |
yāstu agniṣṭoma- vājapeya-atoryāmādyāḥ anyāstisraḥ smṛtau gaṇyante tāḥ etāsveva antarbhūtāḥ |
saṃsthāśca samānavidhānāḥ prakaraṇāviśeṣāt ( 3|6|16|41 ) ityadhikaraṇe ukthādisaṃsthānāṃ prakaraṇaṃ nirākriyate |
nityatvāt tadīyaprakaraṇe aviśeṣasaṃyuktā nityadā- mnātā evaṃ dharmā gṛhyante |
ukthyādīnāṃ tu kāmyatvena anityatvāt na taddharmā gṛhyante, nityānityasaṃyogāt iti vakṣyate |
te kiṃ sarvasaṃsthasya jyoti- ṣṭomasya uta agniṣṭomasyetyevete saṃdeha pūrvapakṣasūtram |
agniṣṭomādayaḥ jyotiṣṭomasya saṃsthāḥ dīkṣaṇīyādirma- viśiṣṭatvena samānavidhānāḥ syuḥ, na tu phañcamasabat asamānavidhānāḥ |
catasṛṣvapi saṃsthāsu ekehalyā dīkṣaṇīyādayo vidhīyante na tu tatra kaścit prakṛtivikṛtibhāvaḥ |
jyotiṣṭomasya catasraḥ saṃsthāḥ - agniṣṭomaḥ, ukthyaḥ, ṣoḍaśī, atirātraśceti |
tāśca saṃsthāḥ samānavidhānāḥ na tu prakṛtivikṛtibhāvaḥ kaścitna iti pūrvapakṣasya upodvalakaṃ sūtramidam |
vyapadeśaḥ jyoti- ṣṭomaprakaraṇe viśiṣṭa dharmopadeśaḥ sarvasaṃsthānāṃ tulyaḥ |
yathaite prastu madhyaparidhimanakti, yadi ṣoḍaśī droṇakalaśamupaspṛśati, yadyatirātraḥ yajurjanapa havirdhānaṃ prapadyate ' iti |
tathā ' āgrayaṇamajaṃ savanīyamagni- ṣṭome ālabhate, aindrāgnamukthye dvitīyaṃ, aindraṃ vṛṣṇi ṣoḍaśini tṛtīyaṃ, sārasvatīṃ meṣīṃ caturthīmatirātre ' iti vyapadeśo'pi jñeyaḥ |
kāmo bhaviṣyati, tāvatā ca niyatāvighāto nāsti|
tasmāt dīkṣaṇīyādayo dharmāḥ prakṛteḥ prakṛtibhūtasya jyotiṣṭomasya catasraḥ saṃsthā āmnātāḥ |
agniṣṭomasyaiva bhavitumarhanti na vikṛtibhūtānāṃ ukthyā- ṣṭomaḥ, ukthyaḥ, ṣoḍaśī, atirātraśceti |
agniṣṭomaḥ ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśī atirātraśceti jyoti- tuśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ |
ṣṭomasya catasro'pi saṃsthāḥ samānavidhānāḥ iti pūrva- kiṃtu ukthyādayaḥ agniṣṭomasya kāmyā vikārāḥ |
pakṣe āgneyamajmagniṣṭoma ālameta, aindrāmaṃ dvitīya- saṃyoge sati ukthyādīnāṃ śra
uktvādiṣu hi yadyapi jyotiṣṭomasyāpi grāhakatvamasti tathā'pi tacca vyajyate kimuktvādidyaṣṭatā dharmata etasya dvāratvāt bhava- nyeta ātmīyaphalasādhanatvāditi |
atastatsaṃstho gṛhyata eva grāhayituṃ śakyate vaktum |
dharmasādhāraṇyaṃ copadeśātideśābhyāṃ pakṣadvaye'pi abhyupagamyata eveti vidhānagrahaṇam |
kiṃ prāptam ? jyotiṣṭomena saha samānaṃ saṃsthānāṃ dharmavidhānam |
jyotiṣṭomo hi phalavattvādyanatatvena ca tadanvayasannuti- sannidhau samāmnātān dharmān gṛhṇāti na jyotiṣṭomatvena |
bhāṣyam— tulya iha prakaraṇe vyapadeśo bhavati |
'yajñiṣṭomo juhoti, yathukyaḥ, paridhimanakti, yatha- tirātra etadeva havirjanaṃ pratipadyeta' iti sarvāvasthasya viśeṣavacanādagamyate |
yadi hi (na) samānaṃ vidhānamagniṣṭomasaṃsthasya syāt nehāgniṣṭomaṃ saṃkīrtayet |
asaṃkīrtamāne'pi dharmasaṃbandho bhavatīti, sarvāvasthasya kīrtanātsarvasthasya prakaraṇamityavagacchāmaḥ |
api ca śrūyate 'āgneyamagniṣṭoma ālabheta, aindrāgnaṃ dvitīya- mukthye, aindraṃ vṛṣṇi tṛtīyaṃ ṣoḍaśini' iti |
dvitīyasya tṛtīyasya ca darśane samānavicche ghaṭete |
ukthye hi dve nimitte staḥ, agniṣṭomatvamukthyastotraṃ ceti |
tatra dve naimittikī, āgneyaḥ paśuḥ, aindrāgnaśceti |
prakṛtivikārabhāve tu pratyakṣaśrairendrāgnādibhirdeśena prāpta āgneyo bādhyate |
tasmātsarvāvasthasya jyotiṣṭomasya dīkṣā- ṇīyādayo dharmā iti |
vā-- ājyaśeṣasya pratipatti viddhacatulyavatsaṃsthā- prakaraṇasaṃbandhatvena kīrtayati |
yathatirātraḥ, etadeva homamaju; yamame pṛccha maryamiti japanddhavirdhānaṃ pratipadyeta' iti |
yadi hi vākyavaśena kiṃcitkaraṇanāthāṃ saṃsthābhiḥ saṃbadhyate tataḥ kimasaṃyuktsaṃbaṃdhenāpi yuktaṃ bhavitum |
yadi hi sāmānyavihitamagniṣṭomasaṃsthasyaiva syāddinā'pi tadupādānena tadaṅgatvāsiddheḥ |
yatastu saṃkīrtayatastato nūnamavi- śeṣitamagniṣṭomasya na labhyate |
taccaiva na labhyate yadi saṃsthānāmapi sādhāraṇaṃ prakaraṇam |
kevalajyotiṣṭoma- prakaraṇasthe tu punaḥ śrutirnārthikā syāt |
tathokthyā- dīnāmapi yadi prakaraṇamasti tato'nyataranirdhāraṇārya yadidaśopabaṃdha grahaṇaṃ yuktam |
aprakṛtatve tu 'dvāda- śāhinasya' itivadiśenaiva saṃbadhaḥ syāt |
na hi jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe sthitasyaiva vādo yujyate |
idamaparaṃ liṅgam 'āgneyamagniṣṭoma ālabheta' 'aindrāgnamukthye dvitīyam' 'aindraṃ vṛṣṇi boḍaśini tṛtīyam' iti |
cikāpakṣe tu pratyakṣaśrairendrā- gnādimireme bādhyate sarvatraiva syāt |
nanu ca pratyakṣaśrutatve'pi saṃsthāntare saṃsthānāṃ saṃbhavāñji- nimittaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvo na prāpnoti |
yo agniṣṭomastotre samāpyate so'gniṣṭomo na tanmātram (mātraśabdaḥ kātsyarthācca) |
bhāṣyakāra āha— 'dve hi tatra nimitte agniṣṭomastotra- mukthyastotraṃ ca' iti siddhavedatadbravīti |
kathaṃ punaḥ saṃsthāstotrāsādhāraṇāgniṣṭomadisamyiāhāre tulye stotra- nimittamevāṅgīkriyate na saṃsthānimittatvam |
satyapi śabdasādhāramye śāstrasya mahā- viṣayatvānmahārthatvaṃ stotranimittatvāśrayaṇamiti |
athavā stotraviśeṣitāyā eva saṃsthāyā evaṃśabdakatvāt pūrvatara- pratītaviśeṣaṇanimittatvameva jaghanyaviśeṣanimittatva- kalpanā na yuktā |
yadvā ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenaiva (13|9) stotreṣu mukhyaḥ śabdaḥ saṃsthāyāṃ lākṣaṇikaḥ |
śaknoti ca stotramapi saptamīnirdeśāt nimittatvaṃ pratipadyum niṣṭhalānāmpi ca medanādīnāṃ vacanasāmarthyānnimittatva- miṣṭam |
satyapi vā saṃsthānāṃ mukhyatve vyavahārakalpanāyā vākyaśeṣeṇa stotrapari- grahaḥ |
evaṃ hi śrūyate 'āgneyamagniṣṭomama ālabha- meta' 'āgneyo agniṣṭomaḥ' iti |
stotrasya ca stutibhāgamidaṃ vidyate na saṃsthāyāḥ |
yāgā- bhyāse'pi hi yā devatā sā talvevā''gneyaṃ karoti na saṃsthāyāḥ |
na hi saṃsthā, ukthyānītyanena (ukthyasaṃsthayā ekākyāt bahuvacanavirodhālaceriti śeṣaḥ) śabdocyate |
nanu vikārapakṣe'pyatharvatalyānugā- nāmantyokāryārthasaṃbhavā dupapadyata eva samuccayaḥ |
' yadi hi pratyakṣaśrutameva kevalaṃ virodhanirapekṣaṃ bādha- kāraṇa syāttato na kiṃcidvādhyate ṛtvantaragataṃ dṛṣṭārtha- madṛṣṭārthe vā tulyakalpamatulyakalpaṃ vā |
tathā 'prājāpatyeṣu cāmrānāt' (10|4|14|6) ityādāvevaṃjātīyakānāṃ tatra tatrāvirodhālasamuccaya vakṣyati |
tasmātsāmānyāttutyakāryatve sati, asti virodha iti prāpnoti vācyam |
bādhyate ca sāmānyaṃ sāvakāśaṃ vā viśeṣeṇa niravakāśena vā |
yāvattā ca yalenāsau prāpnoti tāvattā ca pūrvo'pi |
na hi tulyārthānāṃ kacit samuccaya dṛṣṭaḥ |
yadi tāvatkiṃcidapi kāryānvayaṃ samuccaya- siddhayarthamapyupapadyate tato vikārapakṣe'pi samuccayaḥ |
atha tatra bādhaṃ samarthayituṃ kāryatvaṃ kalpyate tataḥ sāmānyavicche'pi (sāmānyavidyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe'pi ityarthaḥ) vrīhiyādivādasamuccaya iti |
na caitatpūrvapakṣa- vacanamātraṃ siddhānte'pi darśanamagatyā vacanīkṛtya samuccayaṃ vakṣyati 'vacanāttu samuccayaḥ' (16|1|6 45) iti |
sarve hi paśavaḥ sarvatra prāpnuvantyo yatparyupadeśāt pare na bhavanti tannimittatvāt |
tatra kiṃ samārūyaika- kāryatvaṃ kalpayitvā bādhavikalpayoranyatara āśrīyatāmuta vākyaprāptasamuccayānusāreṇa kāryatvaṃ kalpyatāmiti vākyavalīyastvasasamuccayena bhavitavyam |
tathā prayājā- yādādīnāṃ satyapi samākhyaikatve vākyasāmarthyāt kāryā- nyatvaṃ samuccayaśca |
atideśe punaḥ , samākhyayā kārye- katvam , atideśena kāryatvaṃ ( tenāpi samuccayaḥ ) |
tatsācopadeśāntargatā ( ‘ kalpitātideśāpekṣayā ’ iti tasmāt ityasya arthaḥ ) |
samākhyaiva balīyasīti tatkṛtaṃ kāryaikatvamāśritya virodhādvādhaḥ parihrayeta |
vikāre ca prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogeṇa vidhyate iti kāryāpattirityarthaḥ |
na tu samānavibhipake prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogaḥ kaścit , yena kāryāpattiracaryeta |
kecit āhuḥ : samānavidhitve para- sparānapekṣairdvyadevatāsaṃyogaiḥ karmabhedo'vasīyate |
tata- ścaika eva yāgaḥ syācca dvitīyasya iti |
tenaivaṃ samarthanīyam , karmāntaramevedaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kimapūrvāntara- sādhanatvaṃ pratipadyatāmuta prākṛtasaṃvanīyapūrvameva sādhya- tviti |
pūrvaklaptāpūrvaviniyogāmarthe saṃbhavati nāpūrvāntara- kalpayitvā tatsādhanatvādhyavasānaṃ yuktam |
tathā'tideśa- prāptasaṃvanīyapūrvamapi sādhanāpekṣāvelāyāṃ pratyakṣasatasa- nīyaparityāgena na saṃvanīyāntaraṃ gṛhṇāti |
sarvāpekṣāsu prakṛtāsaṃbhavenāprakṛtagrahaṇāt yāgato'pi vyāpāraḥ prākṛte- naivāpūrveṇa klṛptasaṃbandho na śaknotyapūrvāntarasaṃbandhaṃ prati- patum |
yadā yāgatvavyāpāreṇāpūrvāṇyepekṣante na tadā vaikṛtasaṃva- nīyāpūrvaṃ balavat , yattasminsaṃve nipatayet |
yadā punarapūrveṇa kamāpekṣyate tadā saṃvanīyatvaprakṛtiliṅgasaṃyukte karmāntaraṃ vidyamānamevabudha prākṛtaṃ nigrakaroti |
prakṛtau cāpūrva- kalpanāvasthāt vidhīyamānasaṃvanīyatuṣṭyātānuṣyāpūrva- catuṣṭayaṃ kalpyate |
na hi tatra jñāyate karatarapūrvatat klṛptaṃ yasya sādhanatvarasaṃbandhaḥ syāt |
apūrvakalpanā'pi yugapadbhava- tīti na śyate viśeṣaḥ |
vikārapakṣe tu jñāyate prākṛtasya pūrvataraṃ klṛptiriti yasyāvadheye'nyatarasminkarmaṇi viprakṛṣṭaṃ prākṛtaṃ hātavyaṃ bhavatīti bādhaprasaṅgaḥ |

nanu ca vikāra- pakṣe'gniṣṭomasaṃsthāyā eva vikārabhūtāḥ parāḥ saṃsthā bhavanti na paraspareṇeti kevalasya āgneyasya prāptasya parairdhātvāt sarvatra dvitīya darśanaṃ na syādityetānmātraṃ vaktavyaṃ kimucyate tṛtīyasya darśanaṃ na prāpnotīti |
yadi tvayamaindrādīnāṃ varatra prātānāṃ bādhada- darśanaṃ brūyāttato niṣpramāṇakaṃ vadet |
taccā''gneyasya bādhāt madhyamayoḥ prāpteḥ upa- pannameva |
tainaiva cā''gneyo bādhyatetyāha- na pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ pareṇeti |
kiṃ tarhi ? ukthyādayaḥ saṃsthāḥ vikārabhūtāḥ syuḥ |
‘ ṣoḍaśinā vīryakāmaḥ stuvīta’, ‘ atirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yājayet ’ iti |
katham ? guṇā- devaṃ jātīyake kāmye phalanirvṛttiḥ |
paśukāma ukthyaṃ gṛhṇīyān jyotiṣṭomakāma ukthyagrahaṇakāmo vā |
kathamiti tatrā- vaśyamitikartavyatāpekṣitāyāḥ , saṃnidhānāt nityasyeti- kartavyateti gamyate |
kathaṃ punardravyamitikartavyatā sā nityasyevārthe , na punaḥ asyaiva kāmasya sādhāraṇī veti |
yatra yatra guṇe kāmo bhavati tatra tatra kriyāyāṃ sādhyamānāyām , nānyathā |
sā sādhanasya vā sādhyasya veti saṃdihyamānā sādhyasya bhavitu- marhati |
na cāsti sa prakāraḥ , yenā- sādhyamānāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tena sādhakaḥ kṛto bhavet |
te cokthyādi- saṃsthāsyartheti pūrvamuttareṇa virudhyate , yadi sarvadā , nokthyādināmanayena |
niyacadā- mnānaṃ ca yannityasya syāt , nityadāmanāt tadanidhaṃ kriyate |
tasmāt nitya- saṃsthasya jyotiṣṭomasya , na kāmasyokthyādisaṃstheti |
samāptimantamāśritya pekṣamāṇāḥ prakṛtaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ samāśrayantasya nijāmagniṣṭomasaṃsthāṃ vikṛtya niviśanta iti vikāraśabdenocyante |
nanu cokthyādīnāṃ samāptitve siddhe samāptimadapekṣā bhavati |
na caiṣāṃ prāk jyotiṣṭomasaṃsthātsamāptisiddheḥ , ārambhamadhyāpekṣa- tvātsamāptiśabdapravṛtteḥ |
atha prathamaṃ tatsaṃbhadhastataḥ prathamaṃ ṛtvarthatve avacārite phalasaṃbandhātvāt ‘ sa nityasya samatvāt ’ ityevamadhikāratvaprasaṅgaḥ |
kiṃca ‘ grahaṇau ca vispaṣṭe codyamāne phalaṃ prati |
grahaṇadīnāmapi phalasaṃbandhecchedhikaraṇaṃ gacchatyeva ( adhikaraṇavicāraḥ saṃgacchate eva ityarthaḥ ) kiṃ jyotiṣṭomāmeva dharmavidhitaḥ grahaṇau'pīti |
‘ paśukāma ukthyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ’ ‘ ṣoḍaśinā vīryakāmaḥ stuvīta ’ iti pūrvasamāptyuttarakālaṃ codyamānānāṃ samāptyantararūpa- deśabhāktvaṃ bhavati |
grahaṇādyo'pyatra phalavattvāpyatvena prāptā eva sādhyasādhanasaṃbandha- vidhipare vākye nirvapyatāmitadandanuyanta iti |
’ nanu ca ‘ ukthyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ’ iti sāmānyadhikaraṇya- prayogātprāmā grahaṇādīnāmeva syāt |
ukthyastotrasaṃbhavādi samāptaureva ukthyaśabdena ucyate , tanna ca mukhyasaṃbhave gauṇaḥ parigṛhyate |
nityaṃ tu yajñasāmānādhikaraṇyenaukthyādīnāṃ prayogo dṛśyate , ‘ ukthyena yajetokthyo yajñaḥ ’ iti |
sa ca atyantātyantitarasamāpti- vacanatve'vakalpate na grahastotravacanatve |
stotre kaścit dṛśyate yathā ‘ ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī ’ iti , sa gauṇa iti pratipattavyam |
iha vākyaśeṣe puṃliṅgaḥ ṣoḍaśī pratīyata iti saṃsthāvacanam |
yadipi ca vyathopasarva- tvena śrutaḥ kleśena pradhānīkṛtya |
tasmādātri- matīyā vā samāptiḥ sā phalena saṃbadhyate |
yadi ca grahaṇastotrayoḥ phalasaṃbandhaḥ syāttatastayoḥ kriyātvādā- śrayāpekṣā nāstīti svatantrayoreva prayogaḥ prāpnoti |

kecitvādahuḥ ( prathamaṃ tāvadyājñi- kamatamāha ) ‘ satta somasaṃsthāḥ agniṣṭomādiṣṭomaḥ : ukthyaḥ : ṣoḍaśyatirātro vājapeyo'tirātram ’ iti smarasomamātrasamāptivacanatve siddhe karmāntaratvanāhatya somayāgamātre'pekṣita prakaraṇāt jyotiṣṭomasya'sryathatva- siddhiriti |
jyotiṣṭomasya kvacit abhyāsaviśeṣe samāptyantaraṃ vijñāyate yadupyamānameva ukthyādipyadeśaṃ labhate phalasaṃbandhaṃ ca tatra śrutilī-
tena vā tasmin ṛtuḥ saṃtiṣṭhate iti |
satyapyatideśe sa eva aupadeśika āśrayo'stīti na |
somasya' ityanena nyāyena ye jyotiṣṭomavikārā vijñā- |
yante teṣu sarvāḥ saṃsthā vikalpena, siddhānte tvagniṣṭoma- |
ata eva āśrayo guṇaṇakarūpatāsaṃpādako guṇakaraṇatvāvacchedakatvapraviṣṭo vā iti karaṇākāṅkṣaiva vitatā''śrayākāṅkṣā iti mūla- pravādaḥ |
