guṇabhāvanāyāṃ tu āśrayatau dharmātideśaḥ iti siddham |

prayojanaṃ yadyapi na guṇakāmaprātirūpaṃ saṃbhavati, saṃsthānāṃ vikṛtitve'pi tadāśrayabhūtasya jyotiṣṭomasya prakṛtibhūtasya sattenaiva sadomānādyāśritaguṇakāmanām, ṣoḍaśyādyabhyāsāśrayabhūtagrahaṇāśritānāṃ vā guṇakāmanāṃ prāpyapyate |

nāpi udbhidādīnāṃ vaikalpakasaṃsthāprakṛti- katvarūpam, yāgavatsāhacaryeṇaiva jyotiṣṭomaprakṛti- katvasyāpyate; tathā'pi yatra 'athaiṣa panthāścadevaḥ' ityādau na yāgavatparicāyakapadaśravaṇam, tatra vaikalpaka- saṃsthāprakṛtikatvaṃ pūrvapakṣe |
tathā 'yajñasyāśīvaccamaśīya' ityādipraṇopetamantre adriktvaprapyaḥ pūrvapakṣe, saṃsthāyāmasya lopāt |
' 'aṅgāni' dīkṣaṇīyādīni, 'saṃsthāsu' sarvāsu saṃsatsu, 'na upadeśabhāñji' na vidhiprāptāni, apitu ekasyā- meva saṃsthāyāṃ agniṣṭomanā prasiddhāyāṃ prāptāni ityāśayaḥ |
' saṃsthādhikaraṇena (3|6|16|41-47) saṃsthānāṃ jyotiṣṭomena saha prakaraṇatulyatvaṃ nirā- kriyate |
saṃsthādhikaraṇe (3|6|16) ukthyādau upadiśya aindrāgnādeḥ ati- diṣṭasya nāmeyasya samuccya uktaḥ |

bāla. pṛ. 177, saṃsthādhikaraṇe vārtike- 'āgneyamajamiṣṭome āla- bheta, aindrāgnamukthye dvitīyaṃ, aindraṃ ṣoḍaśini tṛtīyaṃ, sārasvatī meṣīmatirātre caturtham' ityatra tattaddevatāviśiṣṭadravyāṇāṃ samuccayo vidhīyate anyayā savanīyasāmakhyayā ekakāryatvāvagamāt ukthyādyuttara- saṃsthāsu vikṛtiṣu upadiṣṭeḥ aindrāgnādibhiḥ atidiṣṭasya pūrvasya āgneyasya bādhāpatteḥ ityuktam |

ṣoḍaśyādiśabdāstāttva anekeṣu prayujya- mānā api saṃsthāyāmeva śaktāḥ, tadvyajyotiṣṭome niruḍha- lakṣaṇayā, tadvati ṛtvantare sāṃpratikalakṣaṇayā, grahe stotre ca tathaiva ityādi saṃsthādhikaraṇe kaustubhe ca dvitīye kṣuṇṇam |
saṃsthādhikaraṇanyāyena sarveṣāṃ guṇānāṃ kāmyānāṃ āśrayaiḥ saha sāmānavidhinirāsaḥ |

su. pṛ. 1216, 'nāco sādhyasya bhavati iti sādhanena saṃbadhyante' ityādisaṃsthādhikaraṇabhāṣye sādhyabhūtatvātvyanvayadvārā sādhanabhūtasya guṇasya itikartavyatānvayasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt guṇasattvāt itikartavyatānvayāyogyatvāvagateḥ, kartavya- tāviśeṣatvāt itikartavyatāyāḥ kartavyatāparaparyāyānu- ṣṭheyatvarūpeṇa dhātvarthenaiva anvayogyatāpratīteḥ |
agniṣṭomasya pañcakṛtyo'bhyāsena jāyamāno gaṇaḥ pañcāgni- ṣṭomaḥ |
stotrāṇi tu jyotiṣṭomādeva grāhyāṇi na dvādaśāhāt |
pañcokthyaḥ, śatāgniṣṭomaṃ bhavati, śatātirātraṃ bhavati iti saṃsthāgaṇāḥ śrūyante |
teṣu tattatsaṃsthānāṃ gaṇe tadabhyāsaḥ tasyāstasyāḥ saṃsthāyāḥ abhyāsaḥ pratīyate |
evaṃ agniṣṭomasya śatavāramabhyāse śatāgniṣṭomaḥ syāt, atirātrasya tu śatavāramabhyāse śatātirātraḥ saṃsthāgaṇaḥ syāditi |
tathā ca kṛtāni lakṣaṇāni yeṣāṃ te kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ jñātasvarūpāḥ yāgāḥ |
teṣāṃ kṛtalakṣaṇānāṃ svarūpato jñātāmeva pañcokthyādiśabdaiḥ grahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
kṛtalakṣaṇānāṃ grahaṇāt teṣāṃ agniṣṭomādīnāṃ abhyāsaḥ pratīyate, nātra dvādaśā- hikānāmahā atideśaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tadviśiṣṭā iti taccha- bdena adhikāraviṣayagataḥ ukthyādiḥ pratinirdiśyate |
prakṛtiḥ dvādaśāhaḥ, dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni, tadviśiṣṭā ukthyādisaṃsthāviśiṣṭā pañcokthyādiṣu pravartate |
na ca abhiṣṭomādināmnā tattatsaṃsthāka- jyotiṣṭomaḥ pratyabhijñāyate iti vācyam |
tathā ca pañcokthye dvādaśāhasya yaḥ prathamaḥ pañcāhaḥ tasyātideśaḥ |
paraṃtu śatāgniṣṭome dvādaśāhikogniṣṭomayoḥ ukthyastotropacayaṃ kṛtvā āvṛttiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
ke. saṃsthāgaṇeṣu pañcokthyastokyaśatāgniṣṭomaśatā- tirādiṣu dvādaśāhikāmatideśaḥ paraṃtu tatra tatra tattatsaṃsthā |
saṃsthāviśeṣaḥ ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśī ca jyoti- ṣṭomasya |
' ityetacchabdena na parāmarśaḥ, kiṃtu agniṣṭoma- rūpasyaiva |
agniṣṭomavyākhyānānāṃ pārthivadravyaparigrahavaśāt ākārānuvṛttiḥ kalpyeta na svātantryeṇa, dikkālātmamanasāṃ tu guṇakarmaṇāṃ ca na kathaṃcidapi saṃsthānaṃ saṃbhavati |
na ca punaḥ kurvāṇaḥ tadvyāpārāduparata ityucyate |
saṃsthā hi kriyāṃ prati audāsīnyaṃ vyāpārāntarakaraṇaṃ vā pūrvasmāt karmaṇaḥ |
saṃsthitaṃ ca na laṅghayet' (masmṛ. 5|151) ityanena nyāyena (saṃsthitaṃ mṛtaṃ patiṃ strī na laṅghayet nātikrāmet anyatra na kuryāt - ityarthaḥ) : puṃsaḥ anyathā saha punaḥ pravṛttikarma neha |
'saṃsthite pṛṣṭhe ṣaḍahe macchāśayed vrataṃ vā' atra ṣaḍahadharmā vrataniyāmādiḥ macchāśaneḥ kartavyaḥ |
aṅgārāpohādīni saṃsparśā- dīni ca pratipradhānaṃ midyante darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
[ tacchabdasya 'saḥ' 'sā' iti tacchabda- rūpāravattvāni adhikaraṇāni tacchabde saṃsthāgrā- ṇyapi pramādāt na saṃgṛhītāni, yāni atra sakārākṣare saṃgṛhītāni |
saḥ ukhāyāṃ sthāpitaḥ āṣṭrādiramiḥ āhavanīyaḥ syāt |
āhutisaṃyogāt āhutyā saṃyogo hi āhavanīyasya bhavati āṣṭrādau ca ukhāyāṃ sthāpite hūyate |
asau hi āṣṭrāt udbhūya āhriyate, na tu ādhānādinā saṃskriyate |
tasmāsau āhavanīyaḥ, na cātra āhavanīyadharmāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
oṃ sa kapālai prakṛtyā syādanyasya cāśruti-tvāt |
tatra śrutaḥ saḥ caruḥ prakṛtyā darśapūrṇamāsānusāreṇa kapāle paktavyaḥ syāt |
anyasya ca kapālāditarasya kasyacit dravyasya pākādhikaraṇatvena aśrutitvāt |
anyasya ca aśrutitvāt kapālasya ca codakena prāptatvāt kapāle eva caruḥ paktavyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yathā caruśrapaṇārthe codakena kapālaṃ prāptaṃ tadvat kapālasaṃkhyā'pi adṛṣṭaṃ prāptā bhavati |
yadi tu adṛṣṭa kapālaiṣu caruḥ paktuṃ śakyate iti saṃkhyā bādhyate tadā kapālamapi bādhyanīyam |
'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' ityuktaḥ caruḥ kapāle paktavyaḥ ityuktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā |
yadi saṃkhyā bādhyate kapālamapi bādhyatāṃ iti śaṅkā prāptā, tāṃ nirasyati pūrvapakṣī |
nahi aṣṭasu kapālaiṣu caruḥ paktuṃ śakyate |
tathā ca virodhāt saṃkhyā bādhyate, kapālaṃ tu virodhāt na bādhyanīyam |
tasmāt saurya-ścaruḥ ekasmin kapāle paktavyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
na vā'rthāntarasaṃyogādapūpte pākasaṃyuktaṃ dhāraṇāthaṃ caro bhavati tatrārthāt pātralābhaḥ syāda-niyamo'viśeṣāt |
sauryaścaruḥ kapāle paktavyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣanirāsārthaḥ vā-śabdaḥ |
tasya pākena saṃyogatvāt carupākasya kapāle asaṃbhavāt kapāle na caruḥ paktavyaḥ |
carau tu śrapaṇīye udakasya dhāraṇāthaṃ kapālamupā-deyaṃ bhavati |
tatta na saṃbhavati tasmāt arthāt udaka-dhāraṇāthaṃ tatra carau pātralābhaḥ syāt |
tasmiṃśca pātre aviśeṣāt carupāke viśeṣābhāvāt aniyamaḥ syāt |
ada eva pātraṃ grāhyaṃ iti niyamo na syāt |
sauryaścaruḥ pātre kasiṃścit paktavyaḥ na kapāle ityuktam |
tatra kīdṛśe pātre iti cet carau syāt sa caruḥ paktavyaḥ |
'yāsu sthālīṣu somāḥ syuste caravaḥḥ' idaṃ liṅgaṃ somasthālī carupākāryā iti darśayati |
tasmāt caruḥ sthālīyā paktavya iti siddhāntaḥ |
evaṃ carurvidhikāraḥ na kapālavikāraḥ, sauryaścaśca odanaśabdavācyaḥ na sthālī |
carupākaśca sthālyāṃ kartavyo na kapāle iti siddham |
satre apacaritasya anyatamasya yajamānasya sthāne yo'nyaḥ pratinihitaḥ saḥ taddharmā svāmidharmā syāt na ṛtvigadharmā |
yasya yasya kāryamadhiṣṭhitaḥ saḥ taddharmaiḥ saṃbadhyate |
tasya dharmā eva svāmino dharmā eva yasya sa taddharmā |
pratinihitasya svāmidharmatve satyeva itareṣāṃ phalisaṃskārasaṃyogāt saṃyogasaṃbhavāt iti tadarthaḥ |
sa sūktavākaḥ devatākalpanārthaḥ aṅgatvena rūpeṇa praharaṇaṃ prati saṃyogāt (iti akṣarārthaḥ :) |
āgneyādiyāgeṣu agnyādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ devatātve'pi etadyāgāntargatoddeśa-nirūpitadevatātvasya lāghavena vyāsajyavṛtti-ekasyaiva kalpanam |
ataśca paraprayuktāgnyādidhṛttinā ekena devatātvena ekasyaiva etatpradravyasya tyāgaḥ kalpa-nam |
śābdatvārthe cājahatsvārthalakṣaṇayā ādhārayati-vat praharatinā lakṣaṇāt homatvasiddhiḥ |
('sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati' ) lāghavāt prayupayogāt karaṇatve eva śakyasvīkārāt uttarasūtravakṣyamāṇanyāyena praharato jaghanye homalakṣaṇāyāḥ phalamupalatvenādoṣatvāt |
kau. 3|1|5|12-13. oṃ sa nityasa samatvāt' ( 3|1|6|143) prathamaṃ kyavarthatve'vadhārite phala-saṃnbadhābhāvāt 'sa nityasya samatvāt' ityevaṃ avi-kāraprasaṅgaḥ (ukthyādeḥ) |
darśa 'yasyobhayaṃ havirātimācchet aindraṃ pañcaśarāva-modanaṃ nirvapet' ityuktaḥ karmāntararūpaḥ pañcaśarāvaḥ saḥ amāvāsyāṃ pratyāmanet |
yāge vinaṣṭe tasya sthāne pañcaśarāvasya vidhānāt |

darśa 'yasyobhayaṃ havirātimācchet aindraṃ pañcaśarāva-modanaṃ nirvapet' ityuktaḥ karmāntararūpaḥ pañcaśarāvaḥ amāvāsyāyāgasya nātuṃ kiṃtu pratinidhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣa sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena pratyāmnāya siddhāntāt |
havirātirūpeṇa nimittena yāgasya saṃyogāt saṃbandhasya vidhānāt |
avihitetikartavyatākasyapi sauryādiṣu kāciditi-kartavyatā syāditi pūrvādhikaraṇe avagatam |
tataśca pārvaṇasthālīpākādau yasya pravṛttirdṛśyate sa dṛṣṭapravṛttitvāt gṛhyokta itikartavyatā-viśeṣaḥ syāt sauryādau |
sa hi sthālīpākādi phala-sādhakatayā siddhaḥ iti sauryādāvapi grahītuṃ yogyaḥ |
sauryādau apekṣitaḥ itikartavyatāviśeṣaḥ laukiko grāhya ityuktam |
yatra tu vaidikasya itikartavyatāviśeṣasya viśeṣavacanaṃ syāt tatra vacanāt tatḥ laukikāt anyatvaṃ itikartavyatā-viśeṣasya |
yatra itikartavyatā na paṭhitā tatrāpi sā kutaścit grāhyaiva |
sā ca kacit vacanāt iti pūrva-muktam |
liṅgena vā kacit vaidikī itikartavyatā niyamyeta |
yathā saurye carau 'prayāje prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti |
tayā aindrābārhaspatye 'ardhaṃ barhiṣo lunāti ardhaṃ na, svayaṃ-ditamardhaṃ yathā karoti ardhaṃ na' iti |
tathā pitṛyajñe 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte, nārdheyam' iti |
yathā'jādayo hi tasya vaidikasya apūrvasya guṇāḥ |
sauryavadī liṅgena vaidikī itikartavyatā niyamyate iti siddhāntinā uktaṃ tat vyāvartyatarhi apivā'śabdaḥ |
na sauryādau liṅgena vaidikī itikartavyatā sidhyati |
yatra nilānuvāda- vacanāni syuḥ nilasya siddhasya anuvādo yatra vacane dṛśyate tatra uktaiḥ liṅgaiḥ kiñcit bodhyeta |
yatra pādyāḥ siddhāḥ tatra tadanuvādena kṛṣṇalavidhiḥ iti kṛṣṇalavākyasya sauryāt utkarṣaḥ |
' nārṣeyaṃ śṛṇute ' iti vacanaṃ tu nilānuvādaḥ ' nāntarikṣe na divi agnīdhetyataḥ ' itivat |
' ardhe barhiṣo lunāti ' ityādivākyaṃ ca yatra barhiḥ siddhaṃ tatra aindrābārhaspatyāt utkarṣavyam |
tasmāt sauryādiṣu laukikī eva iti- kartavyatā na vaidikī |
sauryādiṣu laukikī itikartavyatā grāhyā iti pūrva- pakṣiṇā uktaṃ kaścit brūyāt nanu laukikī ca vaidikī ca ityubhayaṃ pravartatāṃ iti |
ekatra karmaṇi laukikyā vaidikyā saha pravṛttirna sambhavati, mitho vipratiṣedhāt |
tasmāt guṇānāṃ ajñānāṃ yathārthaṃ arthe anatikramya prakṛtisiddhaṃ prayojanaṃ anatikramya kalpanā syāt |
yathārthakalpanā syāt ekasyā eva itikartavyatāyāḥ phalajanakāyāḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
yadā ca ekasyāḥ tadā laukikyā eva dṛṣṭapravṛttitvāt iti |
bhāgitvāt niyamyate, guṇānāmabhidhānatvāt, sambandhādabhidhānavat, yathā dhenuḥ : kiśoriṇa |
sauryādiṣu laukikī itikartavyatā syāt iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntī āha |
bhāgitvāt apūrvaṃ bhajate iti bhāginī vaidikī api itikartavyatā |
laukikyā vaidikyāśca ubhayoḥ samāne'pi bhāgitve guṇānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ vaidikānāmeva abhidhānatvāt - abhidadhati iti abhi-
kathaṃ guṇā vaidikāmidhā- yakāḥ ? 1 saṃbandhāt prayājādīnāṃ vaidiketikartavyatayaiva saṃbandhāt |
abhidhānavat, yathā kuṇḍapāyānāmayane agnihotraṃ ityabhi- dhānaṃ nityasya agnihotrasya sahacaritānāṃ dharmāṇām ānayati tadvat |
evaṃ bhāgitvāt, saṃbandhāt guṇānāṃ abhidhāna- tvāt abhidhānavat vaidikī itikartavyatā niyamyate |
atra dhenuśabdo yadyapi dhayanyāyāṃ gavi dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ tathāpi abhidhānasāmānyāt dhayanyāmāśrayāmāpi bhāgī iti kiśoraśabde hi aśvasyaiva bālake rūḍhaḥ |
evamihāpi yadyapi laukikī dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ tathāpi itikartavyatā- sāmānyena bhāgitvāt liṅgena vaidikī viśeṣā |
sauryādau prayājakṛṣṇalādi liṅgena vaidikī itikartavyatā iti siddhāntinā uktaṃ punaḥ pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
prayājādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ vā utpattyaivaḥ tāsāṃ samastatvāt |
tena kevalaṃ prayājāḥ sadharmākā anumīyeran na tu anu- yājādīni itarāṇyaṅgāni |
ato na sarvā vaidikī iti- kartavyatā sauryādau grahītuṃ śakyate |
etasmāt hetoḥ yathādhikāraṃ yatrayatra ye dharmāḥ śrutāḥ teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ sattvaṃ syāt na tu anyeṣām |
ataḥ sātānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śruta- mātrasya prayājādeśca sauryādau aṅgatvaṃ syāt |

laukikī itikartavyatā, śrutaṃ ca prayājarūpaṃ vaidika- maṅgaṃ sauryaṃ carī syāt iti pūrvapakṣiṇā ukte iyaṃ śaṅkā- nanu itikartavyatāsyapradhānayā sahasraṃ syāt itikartavya- tākaṃ pradhānaṃ pradhānavidhiraiva vighaṭate |
ataśca sauryasya sāṅgapradhānasya vedena vihitatvāt vaidikī eva tatra itikartavyatā syāt |
utpatti śeṣavacanaṃ ca tayoḥ samāhāraḥ utpattiśeṣavacanam |
ekasmin vākye śabde vā pradhānasya utpattiḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ ajñānāṃ vacanaṃ vidhiśca vipratiṣiddhaṃ viruddham, na saṃbhavati |
yadi ca ' saurye varuṃ nirvapet ' iti ākhyātena pradhānavat aṅgānyapi vidhīyeran tataḥ teṣāṃ api pradhānavat phala- saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
evaṃ ca laukikī eva itikartavyatā sauryādau |
vidhyanto vā prakṛtivaccodanāyāṃ pravartata tathāhi liṅgadarśanam |
sauryādau laukikī itikartavyatā grāhyā iti pūrvapakṣa vāśabdena nirasyan punaḥ siddhāntamāha |
sauryādicoda- nāyāṃ kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ vidhyantaḥ : kathaṃbhāvo vaidika eva prakṛtivat darśapūrṇamāsayoriva pravartata |
tathāhi liṅgadarśanaṃ vaidikakathaṃbhāvasyaiva savyā satyāṃ utpadyate |
prayājādiprāptau ca anuvājādīnāmapi codakataḥ prātisa- varjanīyā iti bhavati prayājādidarśanaṃ vaidikakathaṃbhāvaprāptau liṅgam |
saṃkarṣa, 2|2|21, mīko. pṛ. 1830 “jyotiṣṭome ‘sa vai syāt’ ityadhikaraṇa draṣṭavyam |
✱ ‘sa vai (vaimṛdhaḥ) paurṇamāsena haviṣeṣṭvā anu- nirvāpyaḥ’ anena vākyena pūrṇamāsaprayogotsakālīnatā vaimṛdhasya pratīyate |
‘tasmāt pitṛbhyaḥ ‘pūrvedyuḥ karoti’ ‘vaḥ satrāyāgurate sa viśvajitā yajeta’ ityādikaṃ karma ekameva phalaṃ sādhayati iti pūrvādhikaraṇe avagatam |
iti vicāre yat ekaṃ phalaṃ sa svargaḥ syāt |
svarga eva kutaḥ ? tatrāha, sarvān puruṣān prati nirātiśaya- prītirūpasya svargasya aviśiṣṭatvāt sarvasva prītiṃ kāmayate |
evaṃ svīkāre yajeta ityādiviśeṣa- vacanaḥ śabdaḥ na viśeṣe vyavasthāpito bhavati |
‘viśvajitā yajeta’ ityādau ekameva svargaḥ phalaṃ iti siddhānta uktaḥ, tatra detvantaramāha sūtram |
anādiphale karmaṇi svargaḥ phalaṃ iti pratyayo bhavati loke |
‘ārāmakṛdevadattaḥ’ iti kena- cidukte ‘niyatoḍasya svargaḥ’ ityapara āha |
satre anyatame yajamāne apacarite tasya sthāne prati- nidhiḥ kartavya iti avagatam |
yo hi asau anya ānīyate sa karmaṇi kriyate |
tasmāt pratinidhiḥ svāmī syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
satre anyatame yajamāne apacarite yo'nyaḥ prati- nidhīyate sa svāmī syāt iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasnan siddhāntamāha |
sa pratinidhīya- mānaḥ na svāmī syāt kiṃtu karmakaraḥ; darśadau ṛtvi- gtvat |
pratinidhitena ādita ārabhya karma na kṛtam |
akṛtatvāt karmaṇaḥ nāsau satraphalaṃ prāpnuyāt iti nāsau svāmī |
prāpto vipratiṣedhe sati sakṛt yad bādhitaṃ tat bādhita- meva jñeyamityarthaḥ |
sthānivadbhāviṣye nirdiṣṭamānasya iti pari- bhāṣāyāḥ pravṛttau tisṛṇāṃ iyatra paratvāt tikṣādeśe sthānivadbhāvena trayādeśe āśaṅkya sakṛdgatanyāyena samādhānaparabhāṣyāsaṃgatiḥ |
pṛ. 154, kacit caritārthayoḥ eka- smin yugapadubhayoḥ kāryayoḥ asaṃbhavena bādhakābhāvāt paryāyeṇa tujāditvat śāstradvayasaṅge niyamārthe viprati- ṣedhasūtra iti sakṛdgatanyāyasiddhiḥ |
vyaktau padārthe pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇaplavāt ubhayorapi śāstrayoḥ lakṣya- viṣayayoḥ acaritārthena paryāyeṇa dvayorapi prāptau parameva iti niyamārthamidaṃ iti sakṛdgatanyāyasiddhiḥ |
bhūtiḥ pṛ. 62. 'sakṛ- tpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' iti nyāyaḥ |
atha śabda eva prathamaṃ viṣayatayā ( dhātvartha ) abhidhāya punaḥ karaṇatayā'pi abhidhatte |
kathaṃ sakṛduccarito dvirabhidadhyāt ? abhidhāne vā sādhyatvamapi punarabhi- dadhīta |
( yā strī sakṛt avaguṇṭhanaṃ vinā āpaṇamārgādau pravṛttā tasyāḥ punargamane avaguṇṭhanaṃ nāsti kartavyaṃ prathamapravṛttavat -iti nyāyārthaḥ) |
sā śi. 4|1|4|4 pṛ. 68. 'sakṛtpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' iti nyāyaḥ |
tatra padāntagasaṃbandhe'pi 'sakṛtpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' itivat tasya tādarthyena śraṇīpāḍā |
' buddhau saṃnihitena śakyate sākāṅkṣaḥ śabdaḥ saṃbandhayitumiti |
naitadevam, yo hi asaṃbandha- mānaḥ anarthako bhavati sa saṃbadhyate nānyaḥ ' iti bhāṣyam |
atra vārtikam- yāvadyāvat hi padārtho viśeṣyate tāvattāvat śruteḥ svarasabhaṅgaḥ |
tena 'sakṛt pravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' ityevaṃ ekena kenacit viśeṣitaḥ pareṇāpi viśeṣyatāṃ ityabhyupagantavyaṃ iti |
yā hi kāminī sakṛt para- puruṣe pravṛttā sā punarapi pravartateva, tathā sati lokā mā drākṣuriti ki javanikayā avaguṇṭhanaṃ kāryam ? nāva- guṇṭhanasya prayojanamityarthaḥ |
dravyaikatvāt aindrayāvat 'sakṛd' iti nyāyena sakṛt bhakṣaṇe prāpte 'dvirendrāyā- vasya bhakṣayati' iti vacanāt dvirbhakṣaṇam |
vā. 3|5| 5|18. 'sakṛdvā''rambhasaṃyogāt' ( 9|1| 10|135 ) iti nyāyena 'kṛtasya yāvajjīviksya prayo- gasya arthena ādau kṛtā ārambhaṇīyā' iti (pūrvapakṣe) |
9|4|12|45-50. mīko. pṛ. 1824 'jyotiṣṭome maitrāvaruṇādimeṣu' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhāṣyam- iti cet paśyasi, dvitīyādarśanāt pradhānabhūtamātra dravyamiti |
tathāhi dṛśyate 'saktūn juhoti', 'mārutaṃ juhoti', 'ekakapālaṃ juhoti' iti |
vā- ( dvitīyāvibhaktivicāraḥ ) parastu āha ( pūrvapakṣī ) ' anvayavyatirekābhyāmupakārānu- sāritā |
anaikāntikī ca prādhānye dvitīyā, guṇabhūtadravyopadeśe- 'pi dṛṣṭatvāt 'saktūn juhoti' iti |
tathā 'prayāja- śeṣeṇa havīṃṣidhārayati' iti antareṇāpi dvitīyāṃ ājyaprādhānyaṃ dṛṣṭam |
na ca tat saṃmārgaprokṣaṇādiṣu asti, itīhāpi dvitīyā dravyamevopadiśyatāmiti |
na tadarthatvāt lokavat tasya ca śeṣabhūta- tvāt |
evaṃ hi abhiyuktā upadiśanti 'karmaṇi dvitīyā', 'karturī- psitatamaṃ karma' iti |
na ca loke guṇabhūte kacit dvitīyāṃ paśyāmaḥ |
yadapi ca 'taṇḍulanodanaṃ paca' iti, odanārthaṃ taṇḍulān saṃskuru iti īpsitā eva taṇḍulāḥ |
'balvajān śikhaṇḍakān kuru' iti balvajā eva tena ākāreṇa saṃddhā ipsitā iti tatrā- bhiprāyaḥ |
laukikaśca prayogaḥ śabdārthaparicchede hetuḥ, na vaidikaḥ |
yā laiaukike juhoti iti prayoge dvitīyā, śakyate tatra vaktuṃ īpsitatama eva prayoga iti taṇḍulān juhudhi, taṇḍulān homena saṃbandhaya iti |
loke bhavati hi bahuprakārā vivakṣā, anyāyaścānekārtha- tvam, tena pradhānabhāvena siddhā satī dvitīyā guṇa- bhāvena kalpyate |
vede tu kathaṃ dvitīyānirdiśṭe guṇabhāva iti, dvitīyānirdeśāt prādhānyameva avagacchāmaḥ |
evamagata prādhānye balīyasā hetunā nāsti prādhānyamityavagamyate |
kutaḥ ? na homasya kenacit prakāreṇa saktvarthatā avakalpyate |
na saktunāmantya prayojanaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate vā |
yadi vā homaḥ, tadartho homo'pi niṣprayojanaḥ |
jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe pāṭhāt gamyate prayojana- vattā, nāprayojana iti śakyate vaktum |
ko vā brūte neti, prayojana- vattvaṃ, prayojanavattvaṃ tu homamitinirvartayatām, nānyena prakāreṇa |
bhavedomaḥ saktvarthaḥ, homa- saṃgrahāḥ saktvaḥ syuriti |
na homasya saktvarthatā niṣprayojaneṣu saktuṣu ghaṭate |
saktvarthatācanaṃ tu na puruṣopakārakam, na kratoḥ; tadanarthakameva syāt |
na ca tadacanatāt śakya- manyat kalpayitum |
sa eva dvitīyāntaḥ saktūnāṃ homasya ca saṃbandhaṃ karoti |
saṃbandhe ca sati 'dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃyoge guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhaḥ' ( 6|1|1 ) iti bhūtatvāt, guṇabhāve ca tṛtīyā |
tena tadarthatvāt homārthatvāt saktūnāṃ na prādhānyaṃ dvitīyāsaṃyoge'pi |
tasya ca puroḍāśe : yāgādiṣu śeṣabhāvaḥ; tena prayojanavantaḥ; tatra saṃskāro nānarthakaḥ |
na sa dṛṣṭopakārāyate cet, adṛṣṭo bhaviṣyati |
yathā grāmāntarādāgatānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ paryamikaraṇena adṛṣṭa upakāraḥ kriyate ityucyate |
prayojanaṃ ca varuṇapraghāseṣu śrūyate 'śamīmayyaḥ suco bhavanti hiraṇmayyo vā' iti |
prakṛtau nānā vṛkṣasaktu- saṃmārgasādhyaṃ apūrvaṃ iti nānā vṛkṣasaktucyatetyāḥ saṃmārgārthatvena yathā pūrvapakṣaḥ |
yathā tarhi siddhāntaḥ, śamīmayya eva hiraṇmayyo vā saṃmārgavyāḥ |
tathā, yatra bāṇavantaḥ paridhayaḥ tatrāpi pālāśā utpāditavyāḥ |
tathā, ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṃvatsare ' tarasa- mayāḥ puroḍāśāḥ savanīyāḥ ' iti śrūyate |
tatrāpi piṣṭamayaḥ puroḍāśa utpāditavyaḥ : paryamikaraṇārthatvena pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte māṃsamaya eva paryamikartavya iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? 'ācā- ratvāt prayogo hi smṛtyā sarvatra bādhyate |
' yadi hi ācāryasya aikarūpyaṃ bhavet naiva smṛtayaḥ prayatnena dhārye-
sa eva tu saṃkīrṇavādasphuṭaḥ saraṇena pratipālyate|
samarthyaṃ te dvitīyāyāḥ prādhānyamarthaḥ 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' 'karturīpsitatamaṃ karma' iti|
tathā lokavedayoḥ prayu- jyate 'ghaṭaṃ karoti', 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti|
yāni ca śloke vyabhicārāśaṅkāsthānāni tānyudāharati (bhāṣya- kāraḥ) 'taṇḍulodanaṃ paca, balavān śikhaṇḍakān kuru, taṇḍulānana juhudhi' iti|
taṇḍulaiḥ balavajaiḥ iti ca prayogyatve yā dvitīyā prayujyate tannūnaṃ tṛtīyāsamā- nārthā sā iti gamyate|
' yadā padārthāntara- bhūtaudanaśikhaṇḍakasādhanatvena taṇḍulalavjā viśiṣyante tadā tṛtīyāntapādamāpno bhavanti|

yadā tu bhojanayogyā- danādyavyāpattirūpeṇa taṇḍulāḥ, mārdavotpatyarthaṃ ca śikhaṇḍakākhyeṇa balavajā dṛśyante, tathā vedavākyāva- gataguṇabhāvāśca te dravyasādhanake agnihotre sutrāṇoditā- śchanto ramaṇīyatvāt kasyāścit brāhmaṇaḥ svakarmaśobhā- darśanāye taṇḍulā homasambandhitvena abhipretāḥ|
sā evaṃ preṣyati guṇakāmā vā 'yajamāna taṇḍulānaya juhudhi' iti, tadā dvitīyārthātmakaṃ bhavati|
'bhavati hi loke bahu- prakārā vivakṣā' iti|
guṇabhūte'pyathai kenacit kāra- ṇena kaścit prādhānyāṃśo vivakṣyate, tathā pradhānabhūte guṇāṃśaḥ, kadācidubhau kadācinnobhau|
na ca yādṛkṣyate tat śabdenābhidhātavyaṃ ityasti pramāṇam|
vivakṣā- tattvaṃ tu lakṣaṇādyupāyantarāśrayaṇam, na svārthatyāgaḥ|
) (atha saktunyāyaḥ:-) kathaṃ tu saktvādiṣu guṇa- tvamiti|
' dvitīyā tāvat karmatvaṃ pradhānarūpaṃ ātma- śaktyā vadati|
tacca iha balavatā kāraṇāntareṇa viruddha- mānatvāt nāśrayate|
tena tu kārakaviśeṣātmakatvāt yat kārakasāmyāt avinābhūtaṃ lakṣyate tadaviruddhatvāt vivakṣyate|
na ca sāmānyaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ vyavahāramam, iti viśeṣāpekṣayāṃ karaṇatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, 'dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃyoge' (6|1|1) iti bhūtabhavyasamuccāraṇanyāyāt|
kathaṃ punaḥ saktuprādhānyavivākṣā vidyate? tatrāha 'bhūtabhāvyupayogaṃ hi saṃskāryaṃ dravyamiṣyate|
' yasya hi dravyasya kvacit upayogo nirvṛtto bhaviṣyati iti vā avadhāryate, tat saṃskārārhatvāt karma prati prādhānyaṃ pratipadyate|
yat punarnopayuktam, nopayokṣyate vā, tasya saṃskāro niṣprayojanaḥ, iti tadvidhānavākyārthasya prasaṅgaḥ|
te cāmī saktavaḥ, na homāt prāgupayujyante, nordhvaṃ bhasmāndāvāt, bhasmaviniyogavacanābhāvācca|
tatra samastaṃ vākyaṃ anarthakaṃ bhavat, dvitīyā vā lakṣaṇā- vṛttyā iti (cintāyāṃ) sthitatvāt vedaprāmāṇyasya lakṣaṇā grahītavyā|
mukhyarthaprayogo hi autsargikatvāt apavādadaśanena āntitvaṃ pratipadyate|
sarvetraiva lakṣaṇā- śrayaṇaṃ anarthakyaprasaṅganamittham, anyathā mukhyārthopa- patteḥ|
tena virodhāt saktusādhanakahomavidhānaṃ prakaraṇa- sambandhi gṛhyate|
'nanu saktunāmapi' iti (bhāṣyaṃ) homavantaḥ saktavo'pi jyotiṣṭomesya upayukta arthavanto bhaviṣyanti ityāha (pūrvapakṣatvena)|
siddhāntavādī tu chalena homasādhanībhūtānāmeva arthavattvamabhyucchati 'ko vā brūte neti' (iti bhāṣye)|
' yathā homaḥ kriyātmakatvāt 'kiṃ' ityapekṣamāṇaḥ pradhānakathaṃ- bhāvena itthaṃ anugrāhakatvena gṛhyate, naivaṃ dravyam|
yatrāpi tāvat dravyaṃ sākṣāt phalyena cocyate, yathā 'godohena paśukāmasya' iti, tatrāpi anyaprayo- janakriyādvārameva napūrve bhaviṣyati, kimuta yadā, na kaścidviśeṣyatvena saktavaḥ śrūyante|
dvitīyā hi saktūnāṃ prādhānyaṃ vadantī homaṃ tadarthaṃ kuryāt, na 'saktumporva' iti
'kathaṃ nāma homadhyātāḥ saktavaḥ syuḥ' iti, nānyasmai prayojanāya, aśravaṇāt|
te cāmī 'bhavanti home kṛte saktavo homavaṃdāḥ' (bhāṣyaṃ) iti prāgeva prayojana- lāmāt paryavasitā dvitīyā, niṣprayojane'pi, homaṃ prati prādhānyamātreṇa karmatvasiddheḥ|
tatra siddhe vākyārthe, paścāt na puruṣasya kratorvā upayukta iti jñātvā, tadvacanāddhā adṛṣṭaṃ kalpyeta, prādhānyajñānaṃ vā bhrānti- riti|
tatra āha (bhāṣyakāraḥ) 'na ca tadvacanāt śakyamanyat kalpayitum' iti|
(tataśca tṛtīyāsiddhiḥ iti matvā mahā- bhāṣyakāreṇa (upavarṣeṇa- su. pṛ. 632) uktaṃ 'tṛtīyāyāḥ sthāne dvitīyā' iti|
tena vaiṣamyaṃ homa- saṃmārgayoḥ, saktūnāṃ niṣprayojanatvena tadarthatvāt, puro- ḍāśādeśca anyaśeṣabhāvena paryaśitakaraṇasādihattvāt|
haḍhe ca śāstrārthe avasthite dṛṣṭopakārābhāve'pi adṛṣṭakalpanā bhaviṣyati|
loke'pi adṛṣṭāḥ saṃskārā ācārādabhyante yathā 'āmāntaśrāddhātānāṃ' (iti bhāṣyaṃ) śāntyarthaṃ abhilavaṇadadhyakṣataprabhṛteḥ śirasa upari bhrāmaṇaṃ sucideśapratiṣṭhāpanaṃ ca (dṛṣṭa kāṣṭaṃ iti bhāṣā)|
tena adṛṣṭā- rthānāmipi tulyaśrutitvāt siddho guṇabhāvaḥ (saktū- nām)|

nanu evaṃ sati sarvatra prayojanavaccākṛtameva dravya- prādhānyam, iti na vaktavyaṃ 'tulyaśrutitvāt' (2|1| 4|10 sa.) iti, darśayitavyaṃ vā tatra prayojanavatsā- nirapekṣaṃ dvitīyākṛtameva prādhānyam, kevalatṛtīyākṛto vā guṇabhāva iti|
prādhānyaṃ tāvat 'aindrā gārhapatyetyupatiṣṭhate' ityatra liṅgāt indrārthatvāt gārhapatyavākyatvāt ca tatsādhanakendropasthānaprasaṅge kevaladvitīyākṛtameva gārhapatyaprādhānyam|
tathā 'sakta- vākena prastara' iti ubhayoḥ prayojanavattvāviśeṣe kevala- tṛtīyākṛtameva saktavākyasya prastaragrahaṇārthatvam|
tena vibhaktibhireva aṅgāṅgibhāve abhidhīyamāne niṣprayo- janatvaṃ apavādaḥ, na tu prayojanasadasadbhāvena ajñāṅgitvaṃ iti vivekaḥ|
' priyañco hi utpattivākyāt kevala- pradhānārthatvena jñāyamānāḥ, yuktaṃ yadagreṣu na bhavantī|
śamīmayatvādi tu sugādimātrānuvādena vidhīyamānaṃ 'sarveṣāṃ vā śeṣatvasyātathābhūtatvāt' (3|7|12) ityanena vākyasaṃyogabalīyastvāt prakaraṇagamyapradhānārtha- tvabādhena aṅgapradhānārthaṃ vijñāyate|
na cātra viśeṣaṇaṃ kiṃcidupāttam, yena pradhānagatasugādimātrāpratītiḥ syāt, sadapi vā uddiśyamānaviśeṣaṇatvāt na viva- kṣayeta|
tasmāt pūrvapakṣe api yāni ca pradhānasambandhīni sugādīni, yāni ca ārādupakārakasaṃmārgārdisādhanacini tāni sarvāṇi śamīmayatvādidyukkāni ityukto nānā- vṛkṣasaktusaṃmārgaḥ|
syādetat 'mukhyārtho vā'ṅgāsyācoditatvāt' (3|8| 19|36) iti vaikṛtaviśeṣaṇāṃ kevalapradhānārthatvāt na iha aṅgapradhānārthatā bhaviṣyati iti|
tatraitad vathyate, nātra tādṛśaśca pratī- yate|
', 'yajñārthavarṇa vai kāmyā iṣṭayaḥ tā upāṃśu kartavyāḥ' iti hi pradhānaiva kāmyaśabdopāttaiḥ upāṃśutvaṃ saṃbadhyamānaṃ aṅgasyācoditaṃ iti vakṣyate (3|8|19| 35-36)|
na cātra tādṛśaḥ pradhānayogaḥ iti vaiṣamyam|
nanu ca ātideśikatvāt aprāptāvastheṣu aṅgeṣu śamīmayatvādyupadiśyamānaṃ pradhānamātrārtha bhavet|
evaṃ hi syāt iti 'klṛptopakāra- sākāṅkṣaḥ prathamaṃ prākṛtaiḥ saha|
' adavyaṃ ca anekārthavidhavanupapatteḥ sugādīni anuvada- tathyāni|
tena pratyakṣo'pi sanu upadeśaḥ atideśāṃ tāvat pratīkṣate|
' ya eva hi samāṃgulyā varjanenopāyaḥ tenaiva prayājādi- sumbarjanamapi prāpnoti |
yadyapi ca kiṃcit pradhānamātrasambandhāt bhavet tathāpi saumikavedadakṣiṇānyāyena prasaṅgasiddheḥ na prākṛtatyāpa- saṃgraho yujyate |
tatra saṃmārgasya 'arthābhidhāna- karma ca 0' (4|1|1|126) iti aprayojakatvamapi śakyaṃ vaktum |
tataśca vācanavatparidhiśravaṇe yadi tāvat aparihitānaiva palāśādīn saṃmārṣṭi, aparicaya eva saṃmṛṣṭā bhaveyuḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 22. 'sagotrā na pariṇeyā' ayaṃ smṛtikalpya: |
bāla. pṛ. 29. saṃkarajātānāmapi ca punaḥ utkarṣotkarṣamyāṃ saptame pañcame vā anyataravarṇapatti: smaryate |
tatra tu etāvanmātramāgamikaṃ pratyetyam, nahi ayaṃ puruṣayatnāniyama: laukikapramāṇagamya: |

vā. 1|2|1|2 pṛ. 109. saṃkarṣe 'vrīhibhiriṣṭvā vrīhibhiryajeta ā yathemya:; yavairiṣṭvā yavairaiva yajeta ā vrīhibhya:' itivākyamudāhṛtya kimanena āśrayaṇābhyāso vidhīyate darśapūrṇamāsayorvā dravyaniyama: iti saṃdihya āśrayaṇa-prakaraṇe pāṭhāt yajetadvidhayatpyate: śrīhāgrayaṇe iṣṭvā puna: vrīhāgrayaṇe yajeta iti āśrayaṇābhyāsa-vidhirayaṃ iti 'vrīhibhiriṣṭvā vrīhibhiryajeta ā yathemya ityāśrayaṇābhyāsa: prakaraṇāt' ityanena sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣayitvā abhyāsavidhau prāpte karmaṇi abhyāsa-dravya-rūpānekaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedāpatte: , karmāntaravidhau ca gauravāpatte: , prakṛtāgrayaṇaprakṛtitvena darśapūrṇa-māsākhye karmaṇi vrīhiyavayo: vikalpena prāptayo: yava-vrīhyagrayaṇavavidhyavasthāyidhinārtha etad vākyaṃ iti 'darśapūrṇamāsayorvā'ntarālasaṃyogāllabdhantya pratyakṣaṃ vidhate' iti sūtreṇa siddhāntayiṣyate |
su. pṛ. 145-146. yathā patnī tulyavat śrūyate iti saṃkarṣe vakṣyati |
bhā. 1|2|1|12, striṣuddhikāre vanaspati: iti saṃkarṣe vakṣyate |

10|4|16|32. 'prakṛtita ityāhyamarthya: ' ( saṃkarṣa. 4|2|1 ) iti saṃkarṣacaturthadvitīyapādādhikaraṇanyāyena anuvacanatvasāmānyāt nityasāmyenatyavacanaprakṛtitvasya kāmyā-nuvacanatve satyena codakata: prāptānāṃ ṛcāṃ prāpti: |
su. pṛ. 996. saṃkalpapāraparyāyakramavaśena vaikalpikānāmpya-jñānāṃ yadeva saṃkalpitaṃ tadevādyeyaṃ iti niyamāt tadati-krame karmanye'pi prāyaścittamaviṣadam |
... karmopakrama-kāle eva vaikalpikanāmajñānāṃ 'idameva kariṣyāmi' ityevaṃ aṅgīkaraṇīyatvāt aṅgīkṛtasaṃkalpasya aṅgasya atikrame prāyaścittavidhiyukta: |
su. pṛ. 996. sakṛt saṃkalpitasya puna: saṃkalpayitumaśakyam |
bhā. 6|6|1|14. vā. 1|3|7|17. saṃkoca: nāma ( śrute: ) śrutijanitaviśeṣa-pratyayasya viśeṣe avasthāpanam |
soma. 3|1|10. svata eva ākāṅkṣita: saṃkoca: anyānusāreṇa kriyamāṇo'pi na tatkṛto bādha: |
' vā. 3|2|1 pṛ. 651. saṃkhyā ākhyātābhihitā kartaiva saṃśravyate na kārakāntareṇa |
paśū iti dvau, paśūn iti bahava ānī-yante |
bhā. 4|1|5|13. saṃkhyā uddiśyamānasya vivakṣyate uta neti saṃśaya: |
vā. 1|3|12|13-16. saṃkhyā upādeyapakṣādgatā vivakṣitā 'paśunā yajeta' 'paśumālameta' iti |

dhātva-rthasya pūrvāparībhāvalakṣaṇatvātpade'pi anyopādānukūla-lakṣaṇakriyātvābhāvena kartṛnākṣepatvāt ākṣepatve-'pi vā dhātvarthajñānottarameva pratyayavācyasaṃkhyānāt kartṛjñānasya ca saṃkhyājñānasamakālatvāttvibhāvābha-smṛtivyavahitatvena saṃkhyājñānottarakālatvaṃ kartṛviśeṣaṇa-tvānupapatti: |

jyotiṣṭome saṃkhyānapekṣasya kartu: aci(dhi?)kārā-vagamāt ekasya aśaktau aṅgāntaravat ekatvasyāpi tyāgopapatte: yajamānānekalasaṃbhavena dvitvabahutvayukta-pratipadutkarṣasiddhāntabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt saṃkhyaiva kartṛviśeṣaṇaṃ na tu kartā saṃkhyāviśeṣaṇam |
su. pṛ. 1401. saṃkhyā karmabhedakaṃ pramāṇam, vaidika upadeśa: śabda-pramāṇam |
kacidākhyāte kartā vācya: , kacit karma iti vyavasthāvat kacit kartṛnvitā saṃkhyā vācyā kacit karmānvitā iti vyavasthā'pi śabdaśaktivaśā-yuktā |

su. pṛ. 1400. saṃkhyā tu eṣāmeva ( śabdāntarādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ ) anyatamena utpattirapatte vidheravagate sati anekotpattiratāṃ vidherbodhayantī sva-vākyavidheyatāmeva karmaṇāṃ mithobhedamāvahati iti veditavyam |

śā. 2|1|1. saṃkhyā tu vyāsajya-vṛttitvena ekaniṣṭhatvābhāvāt saṃkhyāntarāvaruddhe'pi karmasu upajanāpāyena upapatte: svaviśiṣṭakarmotpatti-mākṣepaṃ aśaknuvantī pramāṇāntareṇa karmotpatya avadhā-ritāyāṃ anekatvāmātraṃ bodhayati |
su. pṛ. 541. saṃkhyā dravyatā bhinnadravyaireva pūryate na tu ekadravyā-vṛttyā |
tatra dravyāṇāṃ pṛthaktvaniṣṭharūpanāmekakriyā saṃśrayamānānāṃ yujyate saṃkhyā, 'daśa ghaṭā ānīyantām' iti |
vā. 5|3|12. saṃkhyā yathā 'grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' ityatrāviśaktā, tathā 'svargakāma:' ityatra liṅgaṃ aviśaktaṃ siddhānte iti |
śā. 6|1|3. saṃkhyā vidhīyamānā yogyatvāt paricchedakatā vidhī-yate |
su. pṛ. 96. saṃkhyā śabdārthatvāt vivakṣitā 'paśunā yajeta' ityatra |
yasya daśa gāva: tasya dvau pañcako gavām |
ḍupū. 12|1|11, saṃkhyā hi kenacidekena avāntaradharmasaṃyogena pravartate |
10|7|12|11. avivakṣite'pi vacane yā saṃkhyā anuyate, tena vacanena bhavitavyam |
yathā lakṣaṇatvenāpi ucyamāne brāhmaṇajātīyo na hantavya iti |
na dvivacanāntena nirdeśo bhavati, brāhmaṇau na hantavyau iti |
bhā. 10|3|1|140, utpatticchā hi saṃkhyā meḍikā bhavati, 'tisra āhutī:' ityādiṣu |
vā. 2|1|5|16 pṛ. 507. kartṛgataiva saṃkhyā ākhyāte gamyate nānyagatā |
su. pṛ. 1399. kriyāvicca ca tadākṣiptakartṛ: paricchedāpekṣayā tatparicchedakatvena saṃkhyā vivakṣitā |
soma. 6|1|2. na ca saṃkhyā kriyākārakaviśeṣākṣepasamarthā ityuktam |
vā. 3|4|1|3 pṛ. 929, na ca pṛthastvena trinā saṃkhyāyā: ātmalābha: saṃbhavati |
na ca abhyāsa-pūritā saṃkhyā samajhā bhavati |
2|1|7|21 pṛ. 522. na ca saṃkhyā saṃkhyāntare vartate |
10|1|6|17, yadi ekā ca ṣaṭ ca samuccayena saṃkhyāntaraṃ satasaṃkhyā utpadyeta |
12|4|59. yā hi juhotipade saṃkhyā, kartu: khalu sā bhaviṣyati na bhāvanāyārthayo: |
vā. 2|1|7|21 pṛ. 522. yeṣāmekena kenacit saṃbandha: teṣāṃ tamekaṃ saṃbandhanamedhya saṃkhyā niviśate |
sa tatra eka: saṃbandhī vaktavya:, prakṛto vā grahītavya: |
bhā. 10|3|1|144, sādhanaṃ pari-cchindatī saṃkhyā karmaṇi aṅgībhavati |
8|16|15. saṃkhyā karmabheda: ( 2|1|7|21 ) ityanena nyāyena dvādaśa yāgā ete ( dvādaśahāgā: ) |
21) ityanena nyāyena saṃkhyāśabda: dvādaśāhe dvādaśa- yāgān pratipādayati |
vā. 2|2| 5|16 pṛ. 507. saṃkhyā vihitān mantrāṇāṃ samuccaya: abhiyanayato |
1|3|14|30 mī.ko. pṛ. 51 ' abhicyane saṃkhyā ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
yathā ' śatamāmyāṃ dīyatām ' iti ekajātīyānāṃ śatam, na bhinna- jātīyānām |
yathā dravyaṃ guṇa: karma avayava ityeva- mādīnām |
10|3|1|144 pramāṇāntareṇa utpattividhayatvena avagatasya vidhe: anekaviṣayatvamātraṃ saṃkhyāyā avagatyate |
su. pṛ. 561. saṃkhyāyā: idameva svābhāvyaṃ yaduta mineṣu itaretarayukteṣu vartate |
yo'nyo guṇa: sa itaretaranirapekṣeṇa vaśī kriyate |
paśuṣu hi sā saṃkhyā śrūyate, nāvadānagaṇe |
sā avadānaprakṛtidravyaṃ viśiṣṭī prakṛtau pradhānasyopakṛtavaditi vikutāvyavadānaprakṛtidravyaṃ viśiṣṭī pradhānasyopakariṣyati |
tatra ca paśoḥ saptadaśa- saṃkhyā vikārikā, nāvadānagaṇasya |
evamevākalpiṣyate, yadi śṛṅgā- miprāyā varṇābhiprāya rūpābhiprāya vā'bhaviṣyan saptadaśa paśavaḥ śvetaḥ kṛṣṇo rohita ityevamādyasteṣāmanyatamo gṛhyate iti |
athavā tuparaḥ śṛṅgiṇa ekaśṛṅgā ityeva- mādyasteṣāmanyatamo gṛhyate iti |
prayojanam- ekasmingrahe duṣṭe kṛtsnaḥ paśugaṇa āvarteta |
tatra 'tisra āhutīrjuhoti' 'dvādaśa dvādaśānī juhoti' ityevamādyaḥ utpadyamāna- karmasāmānādhikaraṇyacoditāḥ khaṃsaṃkhyāyā udāharaṇataḥ |
sakṛjjuhotiśravaṇāt karmakatve sati saṃkhyānugrahe'bhyā- sena bhaviṣyatīti prāpte, abhighātavyam |
utpadyamānasya- vātra homasya saṃkhyāsaṃbandhaḥ śrūyate notpannasya paścāta 'ekādaśa prayājān' itivat |
na ca pṛthaktvena vinā saṃkhyāyā ātmalābhaḥ saṃbhavati |
agalā hi sā niyatapari- māṇaprayājopasadādiviṣayatvena āśriṣyate |
saṃbhavati cātra prāganavadhāritasaṃkhyāntaratvāt svarūpata eva bhedaḥ |
nanu ca juhotiśabdāt prathamameko homo'vacārita ityabhyāsena pūraṇameva prāpnoti |
yā hi tatra juhotipade saṃkhyā, kartuḥ khalu sā bhaviṣyati na bhāvanādhārayathayoḥ |
tatra sakṛdādānaśrutvāt arthādekasaṃkhyaṃ homamutpekṣitumāra- bhamāṇa eva svabhāvaśrutayā saṃkhyāyā vāryamāṇastatpari- cchinnāmevāṅgīkurvan svarūpabhedaṃ sarvatra pratipadyate |
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa 'saptadaśa prājāpatyān' ityudāhṛtaṃ tatra dravyagatā'pi saṃkhyā karmabhedaṃ karotītyetadadṛṣṭapratipādaṃ pratipādayāmītyanene- vābhiprāyeṇa |
' yadi prajāpatireteṣāṃ devateti prājāpatyastataikaśeṣeṇa sarvanāmnā nirdiṣṭasya taddhitaḥ kriyate tata eka eva saṃbandhaḥ saptadaśānāṃ dravyāṇāmekasyaiva devatāyā ityekakarmatvam |

atha tu prajāpatirdevatā'syeti prājāpatyaśca prājāpatyaśca sapta- daśakṛtva ucārya prājāpatyā iti sarūpaikaśeṣaḥ kriyate tataḥ saptadaśa dravyadevatāsaṃyogāḥ pṛthakpadārthā iti pratisaṃyogaṃ yāgānāmānakarmabhedaḥ |
' yo hi prājāpatyaḥ prājāpatya ityevamekaśeṣaṃ karoti tenobhayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayorasāvupagato bhavati |
na ca tataikaśeṣamantareṇa pratyayārthasya darśayituṃ na śakyate |
tassāt sakṛt śruta eva prajāpatirbahubhirdevaiḥ saṃbadhyate |
na kalpyāni bhaviṣyanti siddhe'rthe stoka- kalpanāt |
' kṛtvā''pi hi taddhitāntenaiva ekaśeṣaṃ na tāvanmātraṃ sucyate |
yanmātreṇa vinā coditadravyadevatāsaṃbandhapattistanmātra- mevādyaśrutārthaparayā kalpayituṃ śakyate nānyat |
avadayaṃ chedādikrameṇa saptadaśa karmaṇapūrvāṇi ca kalpayitavyāni |
tatra prathamamekatvane- naivānuṣṭhānatvalavadyadyamānaviśeṣatvātsarvadravyāṇi yāga- vanti jātānīti nopariṣṭhāt gantuṃ śakyate |
' yadi hi dravyamedāt kriyāṇāṃ medaḥ syāt tato hṛdayādimedena dravyadānabhedenāpi mā medaḥ syāt |
prakṛtau ca kṛtsne paśau yāgasādhanatve tathetyetatpraśne prāpte hṛdayādyā- daśāvadānaprakṛtitvena paśunā yāgaḥ sādhayitavya iti vākyāntaravādagamyate |
ihāpi saptadaśānāṃ yāgasādhanatve'vagate pratyekaṃ sarvadharmāḥ prāpyanta ityeko'pi : saptadaśavadānagaṇā- natideśena gṛhya vihanyate |
' na hyetadevatātve vākyaṃ paryavasyati prājāpatyān paśū- niti, kiṃ tarhi ? prakṛtitvadilparo vākyaśeṣaḥ |
tatra ca eko'vadānagaṇo yāgasya sādhanamāsīdityāpya eva prāpnoti |
so'pi vivakṣitaikasaṃkhyaguṇaniṣṭhaśca āsī- diti tādṛgeva kartavyaḥ |
tataścaikena paśunā siddhatvāt paśvantarāṇi prājāpatinā saṃbadhyante iti svapadopāttaṃ bahutvaṃ vākyaprāptaṃ ca saptadaśatvamubhayamapi nānuṣṭhīyate |
yadā tu saptadaśa yāgā iti buddhiḥ kriyate tadā prati- karmacāvimiśradaivatāstvavadānagaṇāḥ prāpyante |
tsiddhayarthe cāśrutānāmapi saptadaśānāṃ paśūnāmāgamaḥ kriyate, kiṃ punaḥ śrutānāmupādānam |
nanu ca pratyakṣaṃ yāgaikatvamujjhya na yuktaṃ ānumānikacodakānurodhena nānātvaṃ kalpayitum |
parimāṇaṃ prayatnamiśritasāmarthyaviśeṣaḥ prāgupadiṣṭasaṃdehaśeṣa- tadadhiṣṭhitārthaparaṃ san atideśātmakena vākyaśeṣeṇa tadgrahaṇānurūpasāmarthyena ca nirṇayate |
yadyapi ca paścāttato'tideśastathāpi so'tra bhaviṣyatītyādidatta eva jñātvā tadavirudvārthatvamupadeśasyādhyavasīyate |
tataśca yadyapi prājāpatyatvetāpi viguhya vākyārtho- nyanaṃ prakramyate, tathā''pyante visaṃvādadarśanād āntyā- mayā''dau cigrahaḥ kṛta iti buddhipūrvakaṃ nādhya- vasyati |
na cātra prakāro'sti (yathodeśyasyātideśā- nurodhavṛttitve saṃdigdhatvarūpo virodharūpakaḥ so'tra nāstītye) yena atideśa eva pūrvajñānānurodhena pravartate |
na hyasau prakṛtaupaṭhyamānān saptadaśāvadāna- gaṇekasmin karmaṇi śapayituṃ samarthaḥ |
nānyasyaiva gaṇe saptadaśa prakṛtidravyāṇi prāpayituṃ samarthaḥ |
na ca saṃdehāva- vā'sau saṃdeho yenopadeśāccirṇiyate |
na ca saṃdehāva- tvātpadatraikāntiko''tideśasya virodho yenaikagaṇaprāpti- rbīdhyeta |
' prājāpatyapaśu- yāgena bhāvayetkathamiti hyapekṣyate, na paśunā katha- miti, svayamānatvena dravyasya jñātaprakāratvāt |
prakṛtāvāpi ca ekapaśuniṣṭhaikādaśāvadānagaṇasādhyatvaṃ yāgadharmo na paśoḥ |
na ca tena prayojanam, vinā- śitatvāt |
yāgena tu siddhe'rthātsattvavinā''pūrveṇa veti sarvamidaṃ tannirvṛttiprakāratvena''śrīyate |
yadyapi cāvadānaprakṛtitve'kathaṃ sadṛśasaṃsthayā bādhyata iti nānāpaśuniṣpanna eka evaṃ gaṇo gṛhyatāmiti buddhirbhavet |
ataśca bahuvrīhyanavacchinnasyaiva pratisaṃbandhitvāt pratisaṃbandhitvā'vacchedakasya pratyekavṛttitvena pratisaṃbandhi- bhedatīte : tadbhedena saṃbandhabhedasiddhiḥ |
saṃbandhānāmekatvānekatvābhyā- mathavā'pyupapattau lāghavapakṣayā pakṣetāprāptiyodakasya śākhatayā balavattvena niyāmakatvāt |
prayojanaṃ ca yāgaikatve ekapaśuvisaraṇe'pi tasya jātatvāt na punaryānakaraṇam |
agnī- ṣomīyaṃ paśuṃ ityatra ekatvasaṃkhyā vivakṣitā |
bhāṣyam-- asti vājapeyaḥ 'śaradi vājapeyena svārājyākāmo yajeta' iti |
tatra śrūyate 'naivāraḥ sapta- daśaśarāvaḥ kṣīraṃ carmavatī' iti |
asti tu prakṛtau saṃkhyā muṣṭayaśca 'caturo muṣṭīrnirvapati' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ saṃkhyānugraho muṣṭilepaḥ, uta muṣṭyanugrahaḥ saṃkhyālopaḥ, athavā kiṃ saṃkhyāyā muṣṭīnāṃ ca lopaḥ, athavā anyataralopa iti |
yadi vā muṣṭiṣu, yadi vā saṃkhyāyām |
ataśca saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇaṃ pratyakṣatvāt parimāṇābhyāmātideśikatadubhayavyāptaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā tada- tasyā eva bādhaḥ |

(10|2|8|65-68) padaṃ parimāṇaviśiṣṭaśrīhirāśameva viśeṣyatayā saṃgṛhā- 'bārhaspatyo navāraḥ saptadaśaśarāvaścarurbhavati' iti tīti yadyapi na parimāṇasya saṃkhyāṃ prati prādhānyam, vihitāyāṃ vikṛtīhau prākṛte caturmurbhirnivāpe codakataḥ tathā'pi saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇaparicchedadvāreṇa tatparimita- prāpte caturbhirmuṣṭibhiḥ saptadaśaśarāvapūrakasya caroḥ saṃpā- dravyaparicchedakatvāt parimāṇasya antarajñatayā bādhā- dayitumaśakyatvena tatra saṃkhyāmuddiṣyatvatvā
na hi saṃkhyā- mātramanujña śakyate guṇe vidhātum |
na hi kasyacit kācit saṃkhyā na bhavati |
tathāhi- 'saṃtasyāsi saṃsthitasya payo nāmāpi na jñāyate, muktākārastayā tadeva nalmīpanasthitaṃ rājate |
khātyāṃ sāgaraśuktiṣkukṣipatitaṃ tajjāyate mauktikam, prāyeṇa'dhamamadhyamottamaguṇaḥ saṃvāsato jāyate |
' śāstrādipratipādyarthasaṃbandhatayā adhi- karaṇe yojite sati tasyādhikaraṇasya śāstrasaṃgati
etasya stomāḥ ' ityevaṃ śrutinirdiṣṭatriṣṭudādicaṣṭoma- jyotiḥ iti saṃjñābhedāt karmabhedaḥ ||
śabdasāmānādhikaraṇyarūpapramāṇāntareṇa jyotiḥśabdaḥ bhāṣyam— ' athaiṣa jyotiraiṣa viśvajyotirathaiṣa |
1) na śabdena sarvajyotiḥ etena sahasradakṣiṇena yajeta ' iti śrūyate |
yatra tu tatpramāṇāntaraṃ nāsti, na tatra vardhitumarhati |
atra saṃdehaḥ, kimemirnāmaidheyaiḥ prakṛtaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ saṃkīrtya |
yathā siṃho devadatta iti siṃhaśabdo devadattavacanaḥ tatra sahasradakṣiṇādiguṇe vidhīyate, athavā vakṣyamāṇa- |
pramāṇāntareṇa, na tu siṃhamālameteti yatra, tatra tu tat viśeṣāni karmāntarāṇyapadiśyante iti |
tasmānna viśvajyotiḥ sarvajyotiḥ prakaraṇagrahāt prakṛtasya guṇavidhānamiti |
vā — bahuvicāratvādaguṇaprakaraṇabhedāpekṣya saṃjñā jyotiṣṭomasya pratīkaṃ upādīyate, viśvajyotiriti |

gavāmayanadīni satrāṇi sarvavarṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ trayāṇā- mapi varṇānāṃ syuḥ |

dvādaśāhe ' bārhadridraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārthudaṃ rājanyasya, rāyovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya ' iti vacane rājanyavaiśyayorapi nirdeśaḥ satre trayāṇāmapi varṇānāṃ saṃbandhe liṅgaṃ dṛśyate |
satre trayāṇāmapi varṇānāmadhikāra iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtrābhyāṃ prāptaṃ bādhavena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
rājanyavaiśyanāṃ nāsti satradhikāra iti siddhāntinā ukte pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
ātvijyaṃ tu ' ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ ' iti vacanāt syāt |
' ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ ' iti vacanāt rājanya- vaiśyānāṃ yajamānānāṃ satāṃ ātvijyaṃ vidhīyate iti teṣāmapi satrādhikāraḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vākyārthavicāreṇa nirācaṣṭe |
tadedāha- na vacanāt rājanyavaiśyayoḥ satre'dhikāraḥ prāpnoti |
hi yasmāt ' ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ ' iti vākye svāmitvaṃ
ye ṛtvijaḥ te yajamānāḥ iti vacanamyaktiratra|
ārtvijyamuddiśya svāmitvavidhānāt rājanyavaiśyayośca ārtvijyabhāvāt na tayoḥ satre'dhikāraḥ iti siddhā- ntinā ukte pūrvapakṣī punaḥ śaknute|
tasmāt gṛhapati- karmaṇi ārtvijyasahite rājanyavaiśyayoḥ avipratiṣedhāt pratiṣedhābhāvāt tāvapi satre adhikāriṇau syātām|
rājanyavaiśyayorapi satre satrādhikāraḥ, gṛhapatikarmaṇi tayoradhikārasaṃbhavāt iti pūrvapakṣiṇā ukte siddhāntī āha|
gṛhapati- karmaṇyapi rājanyavaiśyayoḥ nādhikāraḥ saṃbhavati, kalpa- virodhāt|
evaṃ brahmasāma bārhadgiraṃ brāhmaṇānām, rāthovājīyaṃ rājanyamānā- jīyaṃ vaiśyānām|
tasmāt rājanyavaiśyayoḥ gṛhapati- karmaṇyapi na niveśaḥ|

sasadasasūtre rājanyavaiśyayoḥ satrādhikārapradarśanārthaṃ yat liṅgayuktaṃ 'bārhadgiraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārthudramaṃ rājanyasya, rāthovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti, tat liṅgadarśanaṃ adhīnate syāt|
satre tu itareṣāṃ ṛtvijāṃ svāmitvāt rājanyavaiśyayośca ṛtviktvāsaṃbhavāt|
tasmāt brāhmaṇānāmeva satre satrādhikāro na rājanyavaiśyayoḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
10|6|15|1-59. 'satrāyā- gurye viśvajitā yajeta' ayaṃ bhāve puruṣārtho vidhiḥ|
bhāṣyam- idamamananti 'yadi satrāya dīkṣitānāṃ sāmyutthitena, somamabhajya viśvajitā'tirātreṇa sarva- stomena sarvavedadakṣiṇena yajeran' iti|
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ kītarājakasyotthāne viśvajit utta mātrasyeti|
kiṃ prāptam ? sāmyutthāne viśvajit krīte syāt|
ye krīte rājanyavṛtti- chanti, teṣāṃ somavibhāgābhāvādguṇyaṃ syāt|
vā-- viśvajidyaṃ satraphalārthaḥ, satraparisamāpti- doṣopaghātāya vā, na tu sarvaphalāya, aśvavat|
na ca tacchakyaṃ viśeṣayitum, krīte yadi sāmyutthānamiti|
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam 'akrīte rājanya- tiṣṭhanto vibhāgābhāvādiguṇaṃ kuryuḥ' iti|
sāmyutthāne viśvajitā yajeran, somasya tu vibhāgaṃ kṛttveti|
kathaṃ prāptiriti cet ? arthādutthitāṃ vibhāgo bhavati dhanasya|
somaṃ vibhajya anyāni ca dravyāṇīti, ādeśārthetarā śrutirbhavati|
tasmāt krīte cākrīte ca rājanyatiṣṭhatāṃ viśvajititi|
śā-- 'yadi satrāya dīkṣitānāṃ sāmyutthiāse- tsomamabhajya viśvajitā yajeta' kimayaṃ viśvajit kītarājakasya utthāne uta akrītarājakasya iti vicāraḥ|
tata evaṃ bhavedeva tvartha- prāpto na codyate ||
' tasmāt rāgaprāptadravyavibhāga- vādamātraṃ idam, somagrahaṇaṃ tu pradarśanārtham, viśvajinmātraṃ tu vidhīyate iti akrītarājakasyāpi syāt|
soma-- yathā asanayato'pi abhyudayeṣṭiḥ evaṃ akrītarājakasyāpi viśvajit iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ|
' bhāṭṭa-- 'yadi satrāya dīkṣitānāṃ sāmyutthitena somamabhajya viśvajitā'tirātreṇa sarvastomena sarvapṛṣṭhena sarvavedadakṣiṇena yajeran' iti śrutam|
tatra viśva- jityaṃ somakrayottaraṃ uta pūrvamapyutthāne bhavediti cintāyām, yadyapi tyāgāparaparyāyaṃ vyutthānamātraṃ nimittaṃ na tu sāmipadavācyārthatvamapi viśeṣaṇam, nāpi soma- krayaḥ|
tathā'pi somavibhāgāsyāpi viśvajitgrahaṇena vidheyatvānanurādhādava naimittikasvarūpālocanayā somakrayottarameva vidhīyate|
na hi pūrve somo'sti yena somavibhāgarūpamabhaṅgamanuṣṭhīyeta|
na ca bodhanādikalya- paryālocanayā pūrvamapi somatvāddibhāgāpapattiḥ|
vikretṛ- somasya krayātpūrvamapyutthāne tasmin yajamānastva- bhāvāt|
iti prāpte-- nātra vibhāgavidhiḥ saṃsṛṣṭadravyāṇāṃ vyutthāne dravya- vibhāgasyārthaprāptatvāt|
ata eva somapadaṃ saṃsṛṣṭavat- mātraparam, athaca somamabhajya ityasyānuvādatvā- dviśrjanamātraṃ naimittikaṃ somakrayāt pūrvamapi vyutthā- nasya nimittasya sattvāttvameva|
kiñca yadyapi vibhāgo vidhīyate tathā'pi tasyādyevi viśvajityārādupakāra- kāṅgatvenaiva krītatvasya svasyaiva vā somasya vibhāgaḥ, kintu laukikasyaiva satrasambandhino yasya kasyacit somasya
pratyekaḥ vibhāgaḥ, ataśca tādṛśanaimittikasya pūrvamapi saṃbhavāviśeṣaḥ|
ayaṃ viśvajit guṇātmakarmāntaraṃ svārthe- viśvajitpekṣayā, āgūraṇaviśvajitpekṣayā'pi|
vastutastu nimittabhedasya nirvaktumaśakyatvāt śāstrā- ntaranyāyena eka eva viśvajidākhyadvayena vidhīyate iti nāguraṇaviśvajito'sya bhedaḥ|
pravṛttasya viśvajit utāpravṛttasyeti vicārastvetadabhāve kṛtvācintāyā iti dhyeyam|
' satrāya pravṛttamātrasya (kītarājakasya akrīta- rājakasya ca) sāmyutthāne viśvajidvidhānam|

'sāmyu- tthāne viśvajiti krīte vibhāgasaṃyogāt' ityadhi- karaṇe (6|5|17-27) 'yadi satrāya dīkṣitānāṃ sāmi utthite sati somamabhajya viśvajitā yajeta' ityudāhṛtya kimayaṃ viśvajit krītarājakasyaiva utthāne uta akrītarājakasyeti saṃśayya tadarthaṃ ca somama- pabhajya iti vidhiḥ anuvādo vā iti saṃśayya, vidhiḥ tataśca tadviśiṣṭaṃ naimittikaṃ kītarājaka eva śaknoti kartuṃ nākītarājakaḥ iti tasya na viśvajit|
satrātheṃ hi ekīkṛtadhanānāṃ satrāyāge dākṣiṇādravyasyaiva somasyeva vibhajya grahaṇaṃ prāptameva|
tacca śakyameva akrītarāja- kena kartuṃ iti tasyāpyadhikāra iti siddhāntitam|
bāla. pṛ. 115-116. satre ajñanāmyajñanākhye gaugulavādimistailaiḥ abhyañjanaṃ kriyate|
satre ajñanāmyajñanākhye samāmnātena gaugulavā- bhyañjanādinā prākṛtananītābhyañjanasya samuccayaḥ|
6|6|4|24-26. mīko. pṛ. 304 ' adhikāra: satre vaiśāmitratasamānakalpanāmāmeva ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
satre adhikāra: samānakalpanāmāmeva ( kalpa: prayoga: , na tu sūtram ) |
6|6|11-12. mīko. pṛ. 305 ' adhikāra: satre samānakalpanāmāmeva ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
śā. 5|1|1 varṇakaṃ 3. satre iṣṭopāhānamantre ' ye ca yaspatiṃ varchān ' ityatra yaśa-pratiśabde bahuvacanatvenaho na kartavya: , praśaṃsāparatvāt |
vi. 9|2|14. satre ṛtuyājyāvaraṇamātreyā dānaṃ ca kartavyam |
10|2|26 61. mīko. pṛ. 1246 ' ṛtuyājyāvaraṇahiraṇya-dānayo: ahardhāyyonaṃ: satre na vāca: ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
satre ṛtvijāmeva yajamānatvāt na kāpi dakṣiṇā deyā |
' adakṣiṇāni satrāṇītyāhurna hyatra gaurdiyate na vāso na hiraṇyam ' iti |
bhāṣyam-- parikrayaśca prakṛto jyotiṣṭome āmnāta: ' gauśvāśvāśvataraśca gardabhaścājāvaśva yavaśca tilāśca māṣāśca dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā ' iti |
tadākṣiṇyaṃ satre codakena prāptaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ niṣṭhavati veti saṃśaya: |
api ca tatra gavādaya: pratiṣidhyante ' na hyatra gaurdiyate , na vāso na hiraṇyam ' iti |
bhāṣyam-- prāptau satyāṃ pratiṣedho'vakalpate iti yaduktam , tatparihartavyam |
na hyatra gaurdiyate , na vāso na hiraṇyam ' iti |
tatra hi śrūyate ' gauścāśvāścāśvataraśca gardabhaścājāvaśva yavaśca tilāśca māṣāśca tasya dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā ' iti |
idānīṃ parikraya eva satre kiṃ kartavyo neti saṃśaya: |
soma-- sūtrārthastu- parikrayaśca satre na kartavya: , satrasya āsmārthatvāditi |
ci-- ' kraya: kāryo na vā satre niṣedhātkṛti-kalpanam |
bhāṭṭa-- parikrayavat varaṇamapi ṛtvigāgatyarhatvāt satre na kāryameva |
na hi tat ahardhāyyapraklṛptatve'nya-thaim , ṛtvikatvasya dṛṣṭarūpatve pramāṇābhāvasya tṛtīye sādhitatvāt |
siddhamapi ca evamādi bādha-lakṣaṇe śiṣyahitāye kathyate iti viveka: |
satre audumbarīsamānaṃ ekenaiva yajamānena , na sarvai:, na hyayaṃ yajamānasaṃskāra: |
satre kartṛbhedāt vyāsajyavṛtti kartṛtvaṃ na svīkriyate , ato bahuvacanopapattaye tathā ' yajeta ' ityatra na ' yajeta ' ityatra tu daṃpatyorvyāsajyavṛtti ekaṃ kartṛtvam |
satre kasyacit ekadeśa-manuṣyāya somakrayottaramutthāne prāyaścittau viśvajit vibhajyagṛhītena somena syāt |
teṣu kasiṃścit svāmini, apacarati saṃdeha: kiṃ tatra anya: pratinidhirbhavatyuta neti |
bahūnāṃ yajamānānāṃ pravṛtte karmaṇi, apacarite kasiṃścitsvāmini, anyamāgamayat |
nanu svāmigatā saṃkhyā, na tyāgammāna: svāmiti vakṣyāma: |
ye svāmināṃ padārthāste iha saptadaśāvare: kartavya ityetat upapāditaṃ maviṣyati |
vā-- āsīranniti kartṛgatā aniyamena saṃkhyā prāptā ' saptadaśāvarā: ' ityanena niyamyate |
api ca-- devatoddeśena dravyatyāgaṃ kurvata iyaṃ saṃkhyā |
tatra ānīyamāna: svāmigatāṃ saṃkhyāṃ na pūrayati |
yastu mriyate , tasya padyate kartṛtvaṃ na śaknoti pratipattumiti |
śā-- ' saptadaśāvarā: satramāsīran ' iti saptadaśasu pravṛtteṣu yadā kaścinmriyate tadā tatsthāne'nya: prati-nidheya: uta neti ( saṃśaye ) na svāmina: pratinidhi-rityuktam |
kāmyamapi karma yadā pravṛttaṃ bhavati tadā avaśyaṃ samāpta-nīyamityuktam |

ato yadyapi ' ye yajamānāste ṛtvica: ' iti yajamānaśabdasya svāmibhūtakartṛvacanatvāt ekapado-pāttayorathva svāmikartṛtvayo: ārtitvayodeśena vidhi-saṃbhavāt svāmimireva ārtvijyaṃ kartavyam , ānīya-mānaśca uparitānādhikaraṇanyāyena svāmī na bhavati tathāpi tanmātraṃ hitvā karmaṇi saptadaśatvaṃ samāptayituṃ āgamayitavyaṃ puruṣāntaram |
soma-- sūtrārthastu- bahūnāṃ saṃbandhini karmaṇi pravṛtte kasiṃścidyajamāne'pacarite'nyamāgamayat tathā sati avaiguṇyāditi |
vi-- ' mṛte satriṇi nānya: syāt syādvā nātrāpi pūrvavat |
bhāṭṭa-- evaṃ tāvattyācāraprāmāṇyāt kacitka-trantarasacce'pi nyāyena tatpratinidhiriti sthite'pavāda: kriyate - satramadhye kasyacityajamānasya maraṇe tatpratinidhi-rnya: kārya eva |
yadyapi ca mukhyakartu: prayogavidhiviṣayatvācca pratinidhi: na vā mṛtena tadāpādanasaṃbhava: |
tathā'pi sāṅkatye ' saptadaśāvarā: satramāsīran ' iti vākyena saptadaśatvavidhānāt saptadaśasya saṃpattyarthamanyopādānaṃ avaśiṣṭe: kāryam |
na ca tasya ākhyātopāttādhikārasaṃkhyāviśeṣatvādānīyamānasya ca vakṣyamāṇarītyā bhāvādbhavatādhikāritvāttu-

ata eva ārtvijye'pi 'ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ' itya- nena jaghanyaṛtvikapade ārtvijyalakṣaṇamāṅgīkṛtya tadu- deśena yajamānānāṃ kartṛtvavidhānāt yajamānapadasya ca jñānajanitayā ātmanepadarūpatvena phalabhoktṛtvaviśiṣṭa- kartṛtvābhāve'pi yathāśakti prayogeṇa bhoktṛtvābhāve- 'pītyādimānasya kartṛtvasattvāt saṃkhyāsaṃparyaviyātaḥ |
evaṃ ca nyāyaprāptaḥ pūrvameva pravṛttena 'yadi satrāya dīkṣi- tāstatastena saha yajeran' ityanena vacanena nedi- ṣṭhatvavidhāne punarvividhaḥ |
ata etadadhikaraṇaṃ śiṣya- vyutpattimātrārtham, tadabhāve'pi vacanenaivāgamopapatteḥ |
atra ca patnīmaraṇe'pi 'tena saha yajeran' iti pulliṅganirdeśāt yajamānasātada
6|6|3|16-23. mīmāṃsā, pṛ. 302 ' adhikāraḥ satre brāhmaṇāneva' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
satre yaḥ ko'pi sraikadeśamanuṣṭhāya satraṃ parityajya gantumicchet tena somādidravyeṣu svīyāṃ'śa vibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ |
' vi. 6|5|7. satre yaḥ ko'pi somakrayāt prāk paścādvā satraṃ parityajya gantumicchettena viśvajidyāgaḥ kartavyaḥ |
idamidānīṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ te eva satriṇaḥ ṛtvijaḥ, uta anye upādātavyā iti |
kutaḥ ? jyotiṣṭome hi prakṛtitvanye kartāra upādeyāḥ |
tadadihāpi satribhiḥ prakṛtitvat kurvāṇaḥ środakanmahānyāyena evopādeyā iti |
yajamānasaṃskāro hi dīkṣāpadārtho'dhvaryādidharmāyogena karmanimittena prasiddhirūpeṇa abhidhāya vidhīyamāno yajamānānāṃ teṣāmācāryyādi saṃbandhavanmavodhayati |
katham ? yadi te tān padārthān kurvanti, evaṃ te naimittikībhirākhyābhiryujyante, nānyatheti |
kiṃ tadvacanam ? ' adhvaryugṛhapati dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati, yati, tato hotātaṃ tata udgātāram ' ityupakramya sarvartvijaḥ upakrāntā dīkṣāsaṃbandhena |
tasmāt gamyate yajamānā eva ātvijye syurnānye |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet manyase yajamānā ṛtvijaḥ syuriti |
prakṛtitvat ihāpi yajamānebhyo'nyaiva bhavitavyamiti pūrva eva pakṣo vyapadiśyate |
katham ? etāvadeva śrūyate ' adhvaryugṛhapati dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati ' iti |
tadyadi bhinnā api kartāro bhavanti, tān ātmīyābhiḥ saṃjñābhirdharpalavya vacanāsāmarthyāt dīkṣāsaṃskārasteṣāṃ vidhīyate iti nāpunarbhavam |
yathā'nyatrāpyvijāṃ saṃskāro vidhīyate ādhāne ' yastaṃ śroḍimābhāsyasyāsta etāṃ rātriṃ vrataṃcaret ' iti |
' na māṃsamaśnīyāt, na striyamupeyāt ' iti vacanādadhvaryaniyamo vidhīyate |
tathā jyotiṣṭome ' sarvartvija upavasanti ' iti ṛtvijāmupavāso vidhīyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? yajamānā eva ṛtvijaḥ syuḥ |
kutaḥ ? etasmin saṃśaye ta eva yajamānā ṛtvijaḥ; anye vā bhinnā iti |
katham ? aprākṛtaprayojanā vā dīkṣā ṛtvijāṃ vidhīyate |
prakṛtitvadā prākṛtakāryā satī yajamānabahutvāt kramaparatayā saṃkīrtyeta |
yattu, yathā ṛtvijāmupavāsavidhānam, ādhātuśca vratavidhānaṃ tadvadihāpīti |
vispaṣṭaṃ vacanam ' ṛtvija upavasanti, sa tāṃ rātriṃ vrataṃ caret ' iti |
atha kasmānna svāmyākhyā etā adhvarvādyā bhavanti gṛhapatiditi |
kimevaṃ bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ codakaprāptā anarthakṛtatā na bādhitā bhaviṣyati |
adhvarvādyāśca samākhyā gṛhapati-yajamānābhidhānatayā'thaivyo bhaviṣyantīti, sthite'yaṃ sūtreṇa paricodayati |
ādhvaryavādi-karma kurvāṇe hi kartṛṣu karmanimittā etā ākhyāḥ prasiddhāḥ, na yajamānaṃ kurvāṇe |
api cāvayava-prasiddhyā'pi gṛhapatiśabdaḥ patirvācya iti yajamānā-gṛhapatirjñeyate |
na tvadhvaryāḥ svāmini cāyaṃ prayuktaḥ, gṛhapatirjñeyeteti |
na tvadhvaryāḥ svāmini kena-cidapi prakāreṇa tankriyāsaṃyuktā upapadyante ityanyakriyā-saṃbandhāttā miyanta iti |
kutaḥ ? evamāha ' yo vai bahūnāṃ yajamānānāṃ gṛhapatiḥ satrasya pratyetā sa hi bhūyiṣṭhā mṛddhimāpnoti ' iti, ekasmin gṛhapatirite viśeṣavacanamatra satyupadyate, nānyathā |
yadi sarve gṛhapatirkaṃ kuryurna karmā-ntaram, tato viśeṣābhāvād gṛhapatī viśeṣavacanānupapattiḥ syāt |
atha tvitare ubhayaṃ kurvanti, gṛhapati-ryajamānameva, tato viśeṣavacanaṃ yuktaṃ bhavati |
tasmāt viśeṣavacanācca eta ṛtvija iti gamyate |
evamāha ' dīkṣitāḥ satraṃyajante, adīkṣitā ahīnairyajanti ' iti |
atha tu satre yāvatkāryaṃ tattvenaṃ dīkṣitāveva, kriyate |
ahīne cādīkṣitaiḥ, tato vyapadeśa upapadyate, nānyathā |
na hyatra gaurdīyate, na vāso na hiraṇyam ' iti dakṣiṇābhāvadarśane svayaṃkartṛtve upapadyate, nānyathā |
na hi kaścidṛte svārthāt parārthaṃ paraṃ pravartate |
śā-- satreṣu api kimantarāliyaṃ uta yajamāne-reveti saṃdehe codakānugrahādanyaiḥ |
' ye yajamānāste ṛtvijaḥ ' iti vacanaṃ yacchudopapadyamānadeśena tatsaṃskārārthatayā ātvijyavidhiḥ, na tu ātvijye yajamānavidhiḥ |
yadā ' adhvaryugṛhapati dīkṣayitvā ' ityanena ṛtvijāṃ saṃskārārthatvena dīkṣā vidhīyate iti tadyogatā ṛtvigeva yajamānaśabdagocaraḥ ityanuvādaḥ |
tasmāt prākṛtakāryatve ātvijyasya yajamānāḥ kartāro vidhīyante, ataḥ anyeṣāṃ codakaprāptānāṃ bādhaḥ |
soma-- pūrvatra bahukartṛkatvavidhivaladakakartṛkatva-bādhe'pi iha ātvijye yajamānakartṛkatvavidhyābhāvāt anyakartṛkatvaṃ codakaprāptaṃ na bādhanīyamityupapadyate tataḥ saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- ' ṛtvijo'nye'yam yatthuḥ syusta evota codakāt |
bhā-- tatra ca yajamānairvātvijyaṃ kāryaṃ ' ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ ' iti vacanena jaghanyaṛtvikpada-
yena yajeran' iti bahuvacanaṃ bhavati, evamatrāpīti |
prākṛtaṃ yajamānamiṣṭakartṛtvaṃ varaṇabharaṇādikaṃ ca bādhyate tatparihartavyam |
na kṣatra yajamāna- saṃskārārthatayā ātithyavidhiḥ, aprākṛtakāryakāritā- naikanyapadeśāt |
' kuṇapamapi yaḥ satre pratigṛhṇāti, eka evaṃ yajeta' iti, satramekaḥ prakṛtitvat |
satramapyanyasyaikakartṛkatāṃ vidadhacca bahukartṛtāṃ gama- bhāṣyam-- iha dvādaśāhaprabhṛtīni satrayāgādya- yati |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ satramekaḥ prayuṅgīta, uta bahavaḥ |
praśastasyārthasyānuvādabhūtaḥ śabda uccāryamāṇaḥ sāmānya- kiṃ prāptam ? ekaḥ |
nanu bahavaḥ śrūyante 'ya bhinnānudavasānānupalakṣya kriyāmātraṃ vidhīyate, tadva- evaṃvidvāsaḥ satramāsate |
ya evaṃvidvāsaḥ satramupayanti' hutvaṃ ca samānakartṛtvādeva prāptamanūdyate ityuktameva |
te ca para- iha tu śabdapūrvikayā kriyāpravṛttiḥ |
te yathaikaikarūpeṇa kurvanti viśiṣṭaṃ prayogaṃ satrabhirbhiḥ saṃvadhnati |
ataḥ śabda- tathā'pi satrakriyāmasīmaya bahava eva kurvantīti prāmāṇyādupādīyamānāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ bahutvaṃ vivakṣitamiti bahuvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yathā loke pṛthaktvenanāpi kuryā- bahavaḥ prayuñjīranniti |
ṇānāṃ bahuvacanaṃ dṛśyate 'devaśceṣṭadevaiḥ kurvantyuḥ' saṃnivāpaṃ ca darśayati |
sasaṃ cetsaṃpadyeta bahavo brāhmaṇā yajeran' iti |
tathā bhāṣyam-- ittha bahava eva yajeranniti |
evamatrāpi, āsīran, upeyuriti bahu- 'padmabhiḥ paśubhirbakṣamāṇāḥ saṃnivaperan, sāvitrāṇi vacanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |

bhāṣyam-- etadāmnāyate ‘sarvābhyo vā eṣa devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānamāgurate, yaḥ satrāyā-''gurate, sa viśvajitā'tirātreṇa yajeta |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ satrāyā''gurate yaḥ satraṃ prayuṅkte tasya viśvajit, uta na prayuṅkte tasyeti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? yaśca prayuṅkte, yaśca netyaviśeṣāt |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? evaṃ hi śrūyate ‘yaḥ satrāyā''gurate, sa viśvajitā'tirātreṇa yajeta’ iti |
yaḥ satraṃ kariṣyatītyevamāgurate sa viśvajitā yāgena sādhyayeti |
katham ? ya āgurate, sa tena yajeta, yāgena nirvartayediti vākyārtho gamyate, na yāgaṃ nirvartayediti |
ḍupa-- (ekaiṣā matena siddhāntamāha-) phala-mārambhasaṃbandhi (syāt, tadarthaṃ ca) karmāpi ityevaṃ abhisaṃdhāya pumān pravartate |
tatra phale āguḥkṛte (abhisaṃhite) viśva-jit upātvalena vidhīyate ‘satraphalamāgūrya (abhisaṃdhāya) viśvajitā tat sādhayet’ iti |
evaṃ ca yadi viśvajitā tat sādhitam, na satreṇārthaḥ |

(pakṣāntaramāha ‘iti tantraratnam, ‘svābhimata-māha’ iti bhā-ṭippaṇī) athavā yaḥ ‘satreṇa phalaṃ kariṣye’ iti saṃkalpayati, tasya satrakartṛvyatā'śaktau yat phalamabhipretam, tasmin viśvajit vidhīyate |
(prathamaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ dūṣayati-) āgoraṇamātre (nimitte sati) ekasya (vākyasya) dve bhinne prayojane syātām |

bhāṣyam-- evaṃ tatra śrūyate ‘sarvābhyo vā eṣa devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānaṃ niṣkrīṇīte’ iti |
niṣkrayadvāreṇa ca saṃstavaḥ pravṛtte na yujyate |
atha kasmāt naivamisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate, āgūrya satrāya viśvajitā yajeteti |
viśvajitaḥ satrasya ca saṃbandho vijñāyate, āgaraṇavelāyāmiti |
āgaraṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ hi satram, satraviśvajitsaṃvandhe vyavahitakalpanā syāt |
śrutiśca puruṣeṇa viśvajitaṃ saṃbandhayati ‘viśvajitā yajeta puruṣaḥ’ iti |
na satreṇa, ‘satrasya viśvajitāyāḥ’ iti, āguryati ca evaṃ śravaṇaṃ arthavattvati |
na ca āgūrya yajeta ityurāguraṇāntare śakyaṃ vidhātum |
sa cet, ya āgurya (aśaktyā) na satreṇa yajeta, tasya viśvajiditi |
śā-- kimāgūrya pravṛttasya viśvajit, uta apra-vṛttasya, utobhayoriti saṃśayaḥ |
pravṛtta eva vā kuryāt satrānni hi tathā bhavet |
soma-- pūrvavat ihāpi aṅgatvamiti pratyava-sthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- apravṛtte viśvajit syāt yataḥ : satraphalamavane karmaṇi viśvajit syāditi |
aviśeṣāt pravṛtte'stu satrān hi tathā bhavet |
’ bhāṭṭa-- satraprakaraṇe ‘yaḥ satrāyāgurate sa viśva-jitā yajeta’ iti śruto viśvajit |
satrasaṃkalpa-māguraṇaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ satraṃ na karoti, tasyedaṃ satraphalārtha-tvena vidhānam, na tu satrajñatayā, tathātve āgaraṇasya nimittatvaśravaṇācca |
na ca evaṃ satrakaraṇasyāpi nimittāntaḥpraveśāt gauravāpattiḥ |
ataḥ saṃkalpamātre nimitte naimittikamidaṃ phalāntarārthaṃ vidhīyate iti vācyam |

tacca phalaṃ yadyapi na mukhyameva svargādi phalatvena kalpayituṃ śakyam, tathātve vītāyāṃ phalecchāyāṃ saṃkalpasya nimittasya satvena naimittikānuṣṭhāne nimittasaṃkocāpatteḥ, tathāpi prārabdhakaraṇanimittadoṣaparihārārthe vaidhātavyākhyāne vidhīyate |
