krayaṇa- vat yathā somakraye govāsohiraṇyādidravyaṇāṃ vikalpaḥ |
athavā 'dhṛtye' iti vākyaśeṣaśrutadhāraṇaśakteḥ saṃtardanaprayojana- nasya prakṛtau saṃbhavata saṃtardanaṃ notkṛṣyate |
'dīrghasome saṃtcād dhṛtye' iti jyotiṣṭome śrutaṃ saṃtardanaṃ jyotiṣṭomāt notkṛṣyate iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartyann siddhāntamāha |
na ca iṣṭatvāpekṣayā dīrghatvaṃ dīrghasomaśabdapravṛttau nimittam |
tasmāt jyotiṣṭome dīrghasomatvābhāvāt saṃtardanasya tasmādutkarṣaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'dīrghasome saṃtcād dhṛtye' iti vihitaṃ saṃtardanaṃ jyotiṣṭomātnotkṛṣyate |
dīrghasya unnatasya yajamānasya somaḥ dīrghasomaḥ iti |
'dīrghasome saṃtcād dhṛtye' idaṃ dīrghasomatvaṃ kartuḥ syāt dīrghasya unnatasya soma iti pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ sūtraprāptaṃ śaṅkāṃ vāśabdena nirasyan āha siddhāntī |
ṛtutaḥ evedaṃ dīrghasomatvaṃ syāt na kartutaḥ |
dīrgha kālena kriyamāṇaḥ somaḥ dīrghasoma iti |
kartutaḥ dīrghasomatve tu 'dhṛtye' iti arthavādasya anupapatteḥ |
unnatasya vāmanasya vā yajamānasya dhṛtiḥ samāneva |
dīrghakāle tu some punaḥ punarnāmavirhaḥ abhihyamāne somābhiṣavaṇaphala- kayoḥ dāraṇādāśaṅkā dhṛtye ityarthavādasyopapattiḥ |
'dīrghasome saṃtcād dhṛtye' iti vihitaṃ saṃtardanaṃ ukthyādiṣu saṃsthāsu bhaviṣyati agniṣṭomāpekṣayā ukthyā-
agniṣṭome iva ukthyādiṣvapi tāvāneva somaḥ ‘daśa muṣṭīmimīte’ iti vacanāt |
tathā ca tatrāpi dhāraṇe na kaścit viśeṣaḥ |
kartṛtvat yathā unnatasya vāmanasya vā yaja- mānasya vidyamānatve'pi somābhiṣavadhāraṇe na kaści- dviśeṣaḥ tadvat |
‘dīrghatveme saṃtucye dhṛtye’ iti uktasya saṃtardanasya ahīnādiṣu notkarṣaḥ |
avivṛddhe pradeye some na tāni śakyāni vivardhayitum |
tena na śakyāni apūrṇāni pātrāṇi grahītum |
ataḥ saṃsthāsu saṃtardanaṃ niveśita iti siddhāntī āha sma |
‘dīrghatveme saṃtucye dhṛtye’ iti uktaṃ agniṣṭoma- prakaraṇe saṃtardanaṃ pradeyaviśuddhyā ukthyādiṣu saṃsthāsu utkarṣavyaṃ ‘dhṛtye’ iti stutatvāt iti siddhāntasutre- ṇokte pūrvapakṣī āha |
stutirvyarthā aviśeṣāt yāvāneva daśamuṣṭiḥ san kathaṃ śakyate vivardhayitum |
triparvā iti ca parvasaṃkhyāniyamāt na śakyo bahuparvā grahītum |
evaṃ somasya avi- śeṣāt ‘dhṛtye’ iti stutirvyarthā iti cet |
agniṣṭomāt ukthyādiṣu saṃsthāsu somasya aviśeṣāt samānatvāt ‘dhṛtye’ iti stutirvyarthā saṃsthāpakṣe iti pūrvapakṣiṇā śaṅkite siddhāntī āha |
nanu pradeyaviśuddhinopapadyate daśamuṣṭividhitve'pyavadhividhānāt, ata āha- anityatvāt parvaṇāṃ āyāmapramāṇasya aniyatatvāt |
api ca tṛtīye savane aṃguṣṭhareḥ abhibhūyate tasya pramāṇaṃ nāmnātaṃ tamekaparvāṇaṃ sthūla- parvāṇaṃ dīrghaparvāṇaṃ ca grahīṣyati |
kiṃca ‘prajā- bhyastvā iti upaśadānaṃstan upasamūhate’ iti upa- samūhanevidhānena yāvadapekṣisatamomivṛddhiḥ |
jyotiṣṭome śrutaṃ saṃtardanaṃ saṃsthāsu ahīneṣu satreṣu ca niviśate na prakṛtau ||
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome adhiśavaṇaphalake prakṛtya śrūyate ‘dīrghasome saṃtucyād dhṛtye’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ki saṃtardanaṃ jyotiṣṭome eva, āhosvitdīrghakāleṣu some- ṣviti |

tatra prakṛtya śrūyate ‘dīrghasome saṃtucyād dhṛtye (dhṛtye)’ iti, mittvā saṃghātāyetyarthaḥ (dvayoḥ samī- bhūtayoḥ phalakayoḥ saṃredhārthe saṃkṣepapradeśau takṣaṇena tan- kṛtya ekasyopari aparaṃ sthāpayitvā kīlakādinā dṛḍhaṃ saṃśleṣayet) |
tatra dīrghasomaśabdaḥ ki prakṛtāveva kathaṃcit upapadyate tataśca avirodhaḥ prakaraṇasya, atha dīrghakāla-
kiṃ śuddhe eva jyotiṣṭome niveśaḥ dīrghayajamānake vā, athavā ukthyādisaṃsthāsvityeva, athavā satrāhīnayoreva, athavā agniṣṭomābhyāmātre iti |

kiṃ prāptam ? dīrghasomaśabdaśca iṣṭipaśuvihitomāpekṣāyā prakṛtāveva upapatteḥ ; saṃtardanaprayo- janasya ca dāḍharyasya saṃbhavāt, (a ?) saṃtardanavidhinā ca saha brīhiyavavat vikalpasiddheḥ prakaraṇānugrahāya anu- tkarṣaḥ |
krayaṇavyāṇāṃ ) samuccayasthāpanāt pūrvapakṣeṇa dṛṣṭānta iti vyākhyāyemam |
na cāvaśyaṃ sarvatra siddhānta eva dṛṣṭānto bhavati, yasya kasyacit nidarśa- nasya pratipattikāraṇatvasiddheḥ |
asaṃtardanavākyamanupa- nyasyaiva vā anarthalopadṛṣṭāntaḥ (na tu saṃtardanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ) krayaṇavat (krayaṇavat) iti samarthayati |
tatra evaṃ yojanā bhavati- nanu alpakalpatvāt somasya prakṛtau mandaphalaṃ saṃtardanam |

yathā alpamūlyatvāt somasya vāsaḥprabhṛtīnāmekena kenacit kraye siddhe śeṣāṇi vacanasāmarthyāt dīyamānāni tasyaiva ānatasya sutarāṃ ānatiṃ kurvanti iti na lusāyāni bhavanti, svānatāt- prītaḥ somaḥ amyudayakārī bhavati iti ca śāstrābhyāṃ vijñāyate, tathā atra satyapi asaṃtṛṇṇayorapi prakṛtāmi- ṣavaphalakatve vacanasāmarthyāt dṛḍhatarakṛtaḥ abhiṣavaḥ śreya- skaraḥ ityavagamāt akkuśātatvam |
na hi iṣṭipaśurvihomāpekṣā somasya dīrghatvaṃ yuktam, vijātīyatvādanupapattatvāt |
na cātra iṣṭyādaya upāttāḥ, yānālocya jyotiṣṭomo dīrgha ityucyate |
yadyapi anupāttaḥ ; tathā'pi tulyajātīyatvaṃ tāvadasti apekṣākāraṇam |
viśeṣaṇa- viśeṣyabhāvācca somatve sati dīrghatvamupādīyamānaṃ somā- ntarasya vyavacchedārthameva vijñāyate |
teṣāṃ kaḥ punardīrghaḥ kuto vā dīrgha ityapekṣyate, jyotiṣṭomāt na kutaści- dīrghaḥ |
teṣāṃ ca prāthamyāt sa evāpekṣākāraṇaṃ bhavati |
vā-- yathākathaṃcit dīrghasomaśabde avakalpyamāne na yuktaḥ prakaraṇabādhaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti, jyotiṣṭome saṃniveśa iti |
dīrghakāle some punaḥpuna- rgranthamirihyamāne somābhiṣavaphalakayordāraṇaśaṅkāyā ‘dhṛtye’ ityarthavādaḥ upapadyate |
vā-- kratuta eva dairghyam, samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ ityarthaḥ |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? evamubhayoḥ svārthaḥ eva vādo bhaviṣyati, anyathā ekasya paraviśeṣaṇatvāt svapradhāna- bhūtārthavādānupapattirbhavet |
evaṃ ca bahusomābhiṣavāt dṛḍhatvācchaṅkāyā satyāṃ dṛṣṭo'yaṃ vādo bhaviṣyati, anyathā mandatvāt dṛḍhatvācchaṅkāyāḥ tadanupapattiḥ syāt |
( evaṃ arthavādānupapatteḥ iti padaṃ yathā yojitam |
itarathā dīrghaṃ kartā viśeṣaṇaṃ anyatārthāt bhavet |
kāni padāni ? atha kimarthaṃ saṃhāsu na niveśaḥ|
dīrghatvome hi agni- ṣṭomapekṣya ukthyādiṣu somaḥ iti|
na saṃhāsu dīrghatvalave'pi some arthavādaḥ upapadyate|
tāvāneva hi tatra somaḥ 'daśa muṣṭīrmimīte' iti vaca- nāt|
mā nāma agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāṃ niveśo'bhūt ukthyādiṣu tu agniṣṭomāpekṣayā dīrghatvomaśabdaḥ upapattaye, prakaraṇaṃ cānugṛhīṣyate|
prakaraṇāviśeṣaḥ saṃtvādhikaraṇena adyāpi na nirākṛta ityeva yuktam|
tatra yeṣāṃ dharmānāmagniṣṭomārthatā bhavati, teṣu nityā- nityasaṃyogavirodhāt vyāvartyate|
saṃtardnasya punarnitenā- grahaṇāt kevalanityaviṣayatvaṃ na virudhyate|
kartṛpakṣava- devātau dhruvā iti vṛthā stutiḥ||
' satyapi atra karmakālyordīrghatve tāvāneva atideśaprāptaḥ daśamuṣṭiḥ somaḥ abhiṣūyate|
dhāraṇasya tu tulyatvāt dṛṣṭārthatvārtha- vādayoḥ anupapattiḥ syāt|

('ukthyādiṣu vā'rthasya' itisūtrabhāṣyatātparyārthamāha-) 'aviśeṣāt stutirvyarthā' iti sūtrabhāṣyābhiprāya- ('aviśeṣāt stutirvyarthā' iti sūtrabhāṣyābhiprāya- māha-) daśamuṣṭirnivedaparimāṇayoḥ śābdatvāt pradāna- viśuddheḥ toyādividdhayā saṃpādanīyā|
tāni aviśuddhe pradeye na śakyāni vivardhayitum|
tasmāt dhāraṇā- śaṅkāyā dhāraṇaṃ āśaṃsitavyaṃ bhavati|
saṃsthāsvapi artha- vādaḥ avakalpate pradeyavivṛddhayā iti|
yāvāneva agniṣṭome somaḥ, tāvāneva ukthyādiṣvapi saṃsthāsu|
'trirvā' iti ca parvasaṃkhyā- niyamataḥ na śakyo bahuparvā grahītum|
tasmāt dhāraṇā- viśeṣāt arthavādānupapattiḥ saṃsthāsu syāt|
vā-- syādvā tena hetunā saṃsthāsu niveśaḥ|
pradānaviśuddhayā ca pradeyavivṛddhau satyāṃ arthavāda upa- padyate|
tathā sati pradānaviśuddhayarthoktaṃ parimāṇaṃ saṃbhāvitaṃ bhaviṣyati|
ataḥ 'avaśiṣṭānaṃśanyūhet' ityamyūho yaḥ aniyata- parimāṇaḥ, tadabhiprāyaṃ 'syādanityatvāt' ityetat vyākhyeyam|
saṃsthādhikaraṇanyāyena vā prakaraṇaviśeṣaṃ bruvāṇasya nityena agrahaṇādi aniyatatvamuttaramabhi- dhīyate|
tathāpi eta somādupādānāt ato'trāpi viprakṛṣṭaparvamātrameva kāraṇaṃ vaktavyam|
' yathaiva 'ya etenāgniṣṭvādena yajeta' ityetanna saṃsthāsveva syāt (5|1|13|17)|
kiṃ tarhi agniṣṭomavyatirekamāne, tathā dīrghatvamapi agniṣṭomāti- riktamātratvasambhavanaṃ prakaraṇaṃ saṃsthāsveva sthāpayi- tum|
na hyetat gṛhītaṃ prākṛtaṃ kiṃcidaṅgaṃ punarūryārthaṃ vidhīyate, prathamopadiṣṭamānajyotiṣṭomadharmamadhyāpatitvāt|
'yadi hi saṃtardnaṃ ukthyā- dīn vidhāya avāntaraprakaraṇe śrūyeta, tataḥ syādi pra- karaṇagraham|
idaṃ tu saṃsthādhikaraṇanyāyena (3|6|12) tadagrādyajyotiṣṭomadharmaiḥ antaritatvāt, na saṃsthākathaṃ- bhāvātnuṣṭhena saṃspadyate|
tasmāt prakaraṇaṃ saṃsthāne vā saṃsthāsu viniyojakam|
tacca dīrgha- somatvāviśeṣāt satrāhīneṣvapi tulyamiti sarvadharmatā|
(dīrghasomaśabdasya karmadhārayeṇa yāgāvācilasaṃbhave dīrghaḥ somaḥ asmin asti iti bahuvrīhyāśrayaṇāt dīrghakālomayāgāmātravācī ayaṃ śabdaḥ ityāśayaḥ|

] padottarasūtreṇa saṃsthāsveva ityavadhāraṇāt, 'ukthyā- diṣu vā' iti sūtreṇa apiśabdārthe vāśabde'dhikṛtya 'ukthyādiṣu cārthasya' iti cakārayuktameva vā pāṭhaṃ kṛtvā, ukthyaśabdena vā saṃsthāsthito'pi [ukthya- ṣoḍaśī-atirātrān ], ādiśabdena ca satrāṇi ahīnāśca uktvā saṃsthāsu satrāhīneṣu ca dīrghasoma- śabdārthasya dīrghakālasomayāgātvasya vidyamānatvāt saṃtardnaṃ syāt iti dvitīyapūrvapakṣokte, satrāhīnamātraviṣayatayā utkarṣanirāsena agniṣṭomānyamātraviṣayatayā utkarṣe siddhā- nnite, saṃsthāsu pradeyasya somasya daśamuṣṭipratve niyamena vṛddhayākhyaviśeṣābhāvāt nirālambanastutyāpatteḥ agniṣṭomānyamātraviṣayasiddhāṃtāyogo 'aviśeṣāt' iti sūtreṇa āśaṅkaya avaśiṣṭānaṃśanyūhetparimāṇasya [krītāt somāt daśamuṣṭi pṛthak kṛtāt avaśiṣṭāḥ ye aṃśāvaḥ, teṣāṃ abhyūhasya samāhārasya yat muṣṭidaśakāt adhikaṃ parimāṇam, tasya ] aniyatatvāt saṃsthāsvapi pradeyasya vṛddhayākhya viśeṣaḥ syāt iti anyathaiva parihiyate ityeva vyākhyeyāni|

śā-- avaśiṣṭānāṃmanāṃ upasamuhanavacanaṃ śrūyate 'yadā etāvāneva somaḥ syāt yāvantaṃ mimīte, yaja- mānasyaiva syāt nāpi sadasyānāṃ prajāpyasatvā ityava- śiṣṭān aṃśānpasūhati, sadasyānevānabhajati' iti|
soma-- pūrvavat ihāpi anutkarṣaḥ iti pratyava- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ|
' 16. bhāṭṭa-- jyotiṣṭome adhipavaṇaphalake prakṛsya 'na saṃtṛṇatti' ityanena asaṃtardnaṃ vidhāya 'atho khalu dīrghasome saṃtṛdyed dhṛtye' ityanena saṃtardnaṃ vihitam|
saṃtardnaṃ nāma dvayoḥ phalakayoḥ saṃrepapradeśatakaraṇena ekoparyaparasya saṃśleṣaḥ|
tadeva saṃtardnaṃ kiṃ prakaraṇe eva niścitate, uta agniṣṭomānya utkṛṣyate iti cintā- yām, prakaraṇānugrahabhādunutkarṣaḥ|
yastatra sūtre krayaṇavaditi krayaṇānto vikalpe dattaḥ, sa dvādaśa 'daśabhiḥ krīṇāti' iti vacanena samuccayasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt vacanābhāvaṃ kṛtvā bodhyaḥ |

astu vā ihyādeḥ ihānupādānāt, tadapekṣayā dīrghasya ca nityatvena dīrghasomapadavaiyarthyāpatteḥ aṣṭadoṣaduṣṭavikalpasya ca anyāyāt, dīrghasya yaja- mānasya somo dīrghasomaḥ ityevaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣamapi praka- raṇānurodhenāṅgīkṛtya yajamānadairghye nimitte saṃtardhanavidhā- nam |

yadi tu niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇanyāyena karmadhāraya- syaiva nyāyyatvāt, yajamānadairghyaṃ ca phalakavidārā- prasakteḥ taddvā (dvā, hā) raktatvena saṃtardhanasterasaṃbhavena 'ghṛtaiḥ' ityarthavādānupapatteḥ ; dīrghasāsau somaśca iti karmadhāraya evāṅgīkriyate |
tadā'pi jyotiṣṭome eva ukthyādisaṃsthāntasya ca pradānavibhuddhatve'pyetatsomacchide- rāvaśyakatvāt dīrghasomatvopapatteḥ vākyaprakaraṇayorviro- dhanideśaḥ |
na ca pradānavibhuddheḥ toyādinā saṃpādanam, somadravyasya yāgasya vinā vacanaṃ dravyāntarasaṃjñena somena karaṇādyogāt |
na ca trivarṣadaśamuṣṭirūpasoma- parimāṇatvāt, sthūladīrghaparvasomagrahaṇe tadabhāvābhāvāt |
ata eva somapadena yāgalakṣaṇayā pramāṇābhāvāt soma- dīrghaparvameva saṃtardhane nimittamapi śakyaṃ vaktum |

vastutastu — trivarṣadaśamuṣṭiraparimitasomagrahaṇottaraṃ 'avaśiṣṭānaṃśanupasampahati' ityupasamūhanevidhānāt, tatra cārthavāde 'yadai tāvāneva somaḥ syādyāvantaṃ mimīte yaja- mānastathaivā syāccāpi sadasyānāṃ prājāpatyasyetyavaśiṣṭānaṃśan upasamūhati' iti pūrvoktamānanindā uttarādohanavat yāvadapekṣitaparatvapratīteḥ kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyasya api apravṛttyā parimāṇābhāvāt pradeyavibhuddhiḥ sulabhaiva |

na ca evamapi agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyā asvatvāt anyāsāṃ kāmpānāṃ tisrāṇāṃ saṃsthānāṃ ca vikṛtitvena prakaraṇabhāvāt jyotiṣṭome ca pradānadhruvabhāvena pradeyadhruvabhāvāt kathaṃ vākyaprakaraṇayorvirodhaḥ iti vācyam |

kāmpasaṃsthāsu grahaṇavibhuddhyā āśrayabhūtajyotiṣṭomāsavibhuddherādeśya- katvāt, saṃsthānāṃ ca tisrāṇāmapi svataḥ prakaraṇabhāve ca jyotiṣṭomasya sarvatrānusyūtatvāt, kāmpasaṃkhyāka- jyotiṣṭomaprayoge saṃtardhanavidhānena prakaraṇamupapatteḥ |
ata eva agniṣṭomasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomaprayoge asaṃtardhanam, pradānavibhuddhayabhāvāt na vikalpo'pi |
ata eva ca dīrghatvasaṃkhyāyoginaḥ kāmpasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomasya prati- yoginaśca nityasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomasya prakaraṇādeva lābhā- diti lāghavam |

na ca evamitarasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomasyāpi prakaraṇe aṅgīkriyāmāne 'eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānāṃ yajjyotiṣṭomaḥ, ya etenāgniṣṭadhāyānyena yajate gatai- patyameva tadbhavati' ityatacchadena itarasaṃkhyāka- jyotiṣṭomasya grahaṇāpatteḥ agniṣṭomasaṃkhyākasyaiva prakaraṇāt grahaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ virudhyete vācyam |
jyotiṣṭoma- tvāvacchedena phalavattvena prakaraṇāṅgīkārāt, agniṣṭoma- saṃsthāyā asvatvena itarāṅgatva-chedakatvānupa- patteḥ |

etacchadena tu jyotiṣṭomatvasyaiva uktā- vapi anyaśabdena tadvikṛtitvāccaivena saṃsthānāmapi uktatvāt tāsāmapi jyotiṣṭomatvatkālavibhuddhipatteḥ : arthāt agniṣṭomasaṃkhyākasyaiva prakaraṇamapyapatteḥ |
ato vākyaprakaraṇayorvirodhāt prakaraṇe eva saṃtardhanasya niveśaḥ |
vārtikakāreṇa tu vikṛti- mātre agniṣṭomātiriktāvibhuddhastomake niveśa ityuktam |
dīrghatvaṃ tāvat grahaṇavibhuddhayuktasoma- vibhuddhikṛtamiti bhavato'pi civadādam |
vibhuddhagrahaṇāni ca saṃkhyāni vacanāt na tu jyotiṣṭomāṅgāni |

na coktagrahaṇānāṃ jyotiṣṭomābhāve'pi saṃkhyādvārā tatsaṃbhavasattvāt tasya dīrghasomatvopapattiḥ, sarvatomukhādau pūrvādidikṣu agniṣṭomānāṃ saṃsthāke diga- ntare dīrghasomatvasya sattvāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthāke'pi saṃtardha- nāpatteḥ |

yadaṅgagrahaṇavibhuddhiyuktavibhuddhapradeyatvaṃ yatra- yuktavibhuddhapradeyatvameva vā yatra, tatra tadapūrvadādhanībhūta- phalakasaṃskāratvāt saṃtardhanavibhuddhavagamāt uktavikṛtaiśca saṃkhyāprayuktatvena jyotiṣṭomaprayuktatvābhāvāt tadaṅgatvena
saṃtardhanavidhyanupapatteḥ, vākyena prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā ukta- vighasavibhuktāveva niveśaḥ, na tu saṃsthākhe, tāsāṃ vikṛtitvena prakaraṇabhāvāditi |
ata eva saṃtṛdyāditi ghātoḥ sakarmakatvāt anuṣaktadvitīyāntapadena phalaka- syaiva saṃskāryatvāvagamāt dīrghasomātvasya uddeśyatvatadvi- śeṣaṇatvayorekasaṃbhavena nimittatvameva |
ata eva nāyaṃ bahu- vrīhiḥ, na vā somapadena yāgalakṣaṇayā svarākrānto'pi tatpuruṣaḥ |
' 16. saṃtardhanādi- (saṃtardhana-pravargya) nyāyenaiva vākyaprakaraṇavirodhe sati (vākyāt) vikṛtyarthatvaṃ bhavati |
vā. 31413124, kṛ. 314129. saṃtardhanaṃ nāma utpādyotpādakakrameṇa avasthitāḥ puruṣā eva |
saṃtāpanaṃ kapālānāṃ puroḍāśaśrapaṇāt kriyate adhaḥ- śrapaṇāt adhastāt pākārtham |
sauryaṃ caro tu adhaḥ- śrapaṇābhāvāt saṃtāpanaṃ na kartavyam |
idaṃ caro na kartavyam, puroḍāśe tu kartavyam |
10|1|15|56. 'saurye caro saṃtāpanasya bādhaḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
su. pṛ. 891. saṃdaṃśaḥ : ekaviṣayakavākyadvayamadhye sthita- tvam |
prākṛtairdhai- dapūrvaṃ samamidhyāhiyate, tadapūrvamapi saṃbadhyata eva ākāṅkṣāyāṃ avyāvṛttāyāṃ arthabhedaiḥ padairvyavahitamapi |
prākṛtāsaṃjñatvena śrūya- māṇāḥ kāryabhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ avyāvṛttāyāṃ ye padārthā upaniyanti te saṃbandhayavāyena (avāntaraprakaraṇena) gṛhyante |
mīnyā. saṃdaṃśaḥ saptavidhaḥ 'śrutyādi- pramāṇaṣṭaka' iti dvinido bāla.praṣṭake draṣṭavyaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 9-12. saṃdaṃśaṃ vinā avāntarakartavyabhāvā'- niṣpattiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1069. 'saṃdaṃśena abhicaran yajeta' iti saṃdaṃśaśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyaṃ na guṇavidhiḥ |
bhā. 4|4|15, 'saṃdaṃśena abhicaran yajeta' iti saṃdaṃśaśabdaḥ, saṃdaṃśena yathā durādānamadyate iti sāha- śyena yāge, tasmāt karmanāmadheyam |
(darśapūrṇamāsādipraka- raṇasthānāṃ prajādīnāṃ śrutyādibhiḥ kaścicchraddhe jñāte, punaśca taiaiva pramāṇaiparasminddhe jñāte, saṃdaṃśena saṃdaṃśabhavena tadiṣyate avāntaraprakaraṇamiṣyate |
) sarveṣāṃ hi prajādīnāṃ aṅge kiṃciduktā punaḥ parāmarśo'sti iti tatparyantā- vāntaraprakaraṇakalpanā bhavati |
balavatā pramāṇena pradhānakarmārthaṃ bādhitvā aṅguṇatvā- vagame saṃdaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ ca avāntaraprakaraṇatvena abhimānānāṃ śrutyādibhiḥ prākū tadaṅgamuktvā paścādapi tadaparāmarśasadbhāvāt na kacit saṃdaṃśāmānaḥ śaṅka- nīyaḥ |

na cātmaśabdasya ('ātmai- vāsya jyotiḥ' ityatra) paramātmaparatvam, pūrvavākye ātmani nāḍīsaṃbandhapratipādanāt uttaravākye ca 'katama ātmeti yo'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu hṛdi antarjyotiḥ' iti paryālocanayā saṃdaṃśanyāyena jīvaparatvam |
tadavayavayoḥ madhyapātinaḥ padārthasya yathā grahaṇamevaṃ pūrvottarayorgrahaṇena tanmadhyasthapadārthasya grahaṇaṃ yatra vivakṣyate, tatrāsya pravṛttiriti |
bhāṭṭa. 3|1|10. saṃdaṃśanyāyaḥ : mī.ko. pṛ. 3678 'viśiṣṭavidhi- saṃdaṃśanyāyaḥ' ityatra draṣṭavyaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 140. ⚑ saṃdigdhe saprayojanaṃ ca vicāramarhatīti nyāyaḥ |
yathā- vicāraviṣayatvaṃ hi nājñātasya nāpi niścitasya, kintu saṃdigdhasyeti bhāvaḥ |
bhā. 2|1|12 pṛ. 370. ⚑ saṃdigdhe tu vyavayād vākyabhedaḥ syāt |

taittirīyake darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ saptamādhyāyorhānānuvākayoḥ sāmadhenya uktāḥ, navame nividaḥ, daśame kāmyāḥ sāmadhenīkalpāḥ, ekādaśe ca yajñopavīta- māmnātām 'upadhayate devalakṣameva tat kurute' iti, tataḥ punarapi sāmadhenīguṇāḥ |
tatra kiṃ upavītasya avā- ntaraprakaraṇatvāt sāmadhenyarca ut mahāprakaraṇatvāt darśapūrṇa- māsāṅgatvaṃ iti vicāre upavītaṃ sāmadhenyaṅgaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntamāha |
upavītavākyaṃ sāmadhenīvākyena ekavākyaṃ na veti saṃdigdhe vākyabheda iti nirṇayaḥ syāt |
na tasya tena ekavākyatvaṃ vyavayāt nividāṃ vidhāyakena vākyena sāmadhenīmirasaṃbandhena vyavadhānāt |
tathā ca na sāmi- dhenībhiḥ ekavākyatā upavītasya |
tasmāt kṛtsne darśa- pūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe yadanuṣṭheyaṃ tat yajñopavītinā iti siddhāntaḥ |
vā. 2|1|12 pṛ. 525. saṃdigdhe upakrameṣu vākyaśeṣāt nirṇayo bhavati |
'tejo vai ghṛtam' iti vākyaśeṣe ghṛtasya stutatvāt ghṛtenāñjanaṃ iti nirṇayaḥ |
saṃkarṣa, 3|1|6. some sutyā saṃndhidine eva ' ityadhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭa- vyam |
'yokuṇḍena patnī saṃnahyati' iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ patnyāḥ saṃnahanamuktam |
tat somāgneṣu aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu codakena prāptamapi na kartavyam |

'patnī saṃnahyāyenodehi' ityadhvaryukartṛke patnī- ścāndrasya pratisaṃbandhibodhaṃ apekṣya svārthopasthāpakatvena 'adho vā eṣa ātmano yat patnī' ityāmnānāt dampatyorekakārakatvena ca gṛhakarmasu patnyeva nipuṇā madapekṣyeti laukikavākya iva vaktumāryāyā eva bodhā- dadhvaryūbhāryāyā eva saṃhananam |
iti prāpte, 'saṃpattī patnyā sukṛtena gacchatām' iti mantravarṇādyajamānapatnyā eva phalonkṛṣṭatvādyadhvaryukṛte'pi tasmin patnīpadena yaja- mānāyā eva bodhadarśanāttasyā eva saṃskāraḥ |
'yasya vratayedahanyalammukā bhavati tāmapyadhva yajeta' iti liṅgācca |
saṃnahanamantrasya (barhiṣaḥ) ātithyābarhiṣi amīṣomīyadeśe staraṇārtha saṃnahya āhutirna kārya jyotiyiṣṭhome |
ātithyāyāmupayuktasya barhiṣaḥ agnīṣomīyārthe uttara- vedismīpe nayane 'pūṣā te granthi gradhnātu' iti saṃnahanamantraḥ |
'bṛhaspatermūrdhnā harāmi' iti haraṇamantraśca ātithyāyāḥ sakāśāt bhedena prayoktavyau |
saṃnahanaharaṇe saṃnahanaharaṇamantrau tathā staraṇamantravat āvartanīyau iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
ātithyābarhiṣaḥ ātithyādeśāt agnīṣomīyārthe uttaravedismīpe nayane 'pūṣā te...' iti 'bṛhaspate- mūrdhnā...' iti ca saṃnahanaharaṇamantrau bhedena na prayoktavyau |
anyārthatvāt darbhacchedanadeśāt yāgadeśe saṃnahyāharaṇārthe tau mantrau |
tasmāt saṃnahanaharaṇamantrau na āvartanīyau iti siddhāntaḥ |
ātithyā- barhiṣi agnīṣomīyadeśe staraṇārtha saṃnahyā''hiyamāṇe saṃnahanaharaṇamantrayorāvṛttiḥ ||
bhāṣyam- agnīṣomīye eva deśāntaraṃ nīya- mānasya barhiṣaḥ saṃnahanaharaṇamantrau prayoktavyau neti cintyate |
lūnasya barhiṣo ye saṃnahanaharaṇe te upādānāyai |
tatra hi mantrau svīkriyamāṇasyaivopavarṇanārūpau, 'pūṣā te granthi gradhnātu' 'bṛhaspatermūrdhnā harāmi' iti |
ime punaḥ svīkṛtasya deśāntaraprāpaṇārthe, anyārthatvātprākṛtakārya na mantraṃ gṛhṇītaḥ |
yathā tatraivā''stithyāyāṃ yadā gārhapatya- deśādahavanīyadeśaṃ prokṣaṇāya barhirnīyate, na tadā āharaṇamantraḥ prayujyate |
śā- tadeva barhiḥ prāgvaṃśe staraṇataḥ punaḥ saṃnahya uttaravedismīpe strīyate |
prakṛtau saṃnahanamantraḥ 'pūṣā te granthi gradhnātu' iti |
tau kimasmin saṃnahane haraṇe ca prayoktavyau neti saṃdehe saṃnahanaharaṇayorādṛtteḥ mantra- yorapi pūrvavadāvṛttiḥ syāt |
prakṛtau hi lūnasya barhiṣo yadvihāradeśaprāpaṇārtha saṃnahanaṃ haraṇaṃ ca tadādyarthito mantrau, vihāradeśaṃ prāptasya barhiṣo vedi- deśaprāpaṇārthametanmetat |
ataḥ anyārthatvāt kāryaprayukta- tvācca mantrayoḥ, na prasaṅgaḥ |
tathā ca prakṛtāveva gārha- patyādāhavanīyaṃ nīyamāne barhiṣi mantrau na prayujyate tathehāpi |
soma-- tatrāvāpacintā'pi iyaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇokta- mantrāvṛttiprasaṅgāt atra kṛteti dhyeyam |
vi-- 'saṃnāhe haraṇe mantrāvatyau kiṃ na vā, ''dimaḥ |
' prakṛtau lavanadeśādānayane kārye tau mantrau dṛṣṭau, na tu gārhapatyādāhavanīyaṃ prati ānayane |
ato''pi prāgvaṃśā- duttaravediṃ prati ānayane tau mantrau na codakāt prāpnutaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- tasyaiva barhiṣaḥ prāgvaṃśe stīrṇasya uttaravedi- samīpe staraṇārthaṃ punaḥ saṃnahanamāharaṇaṃ ca kriyate |
tatra prākṛtau tanmantrau 'pūṣā te granthi gradhnātu' 'bṛhaspate- mūrdhnā harāmi' ityetau kiṃ punaḥ prayoktavyau na veti cintāyām, pūrvavat kriyāvṛttau āvṛttiḥ |
iti prāpte, nedaṃ prākṛtaṃ saṃnahanaṃ lavanottarakālavihitasaṃnahanasyaiva tattvāt, kiṃtu ārthikam |
ataśca vedhaprākṛtasaṃnahanāṅga- bhūto mantrau nāvaidhe bhavitumarhatau |
yājñikāstu tatra mantraṃ paṭhanti, teṣāmayamāśayaḥ, yadyapi ārthikamidaṃ saṃna- hanaṃ tathāpi tasya prākṛtakāryatvameva |
ataśca uktapraṇāḍyā apūrvasaṃnahanenāpi mantraḥ ukta- vidheḥ ārthike'pi saṃnahane syādeva |
tasya vaidhatvādanā lavanottarakālīnatvādinā vā uddeśyatā, pramāṇābhāvāt |
vastutastu 'bahiḥ saṃnahyati' iti vacanena uktaprayojanārthaṃ vihitasya saṃnahanasya atra prayojanānurodhena āvṛttireva staraṇavat iti mantrāvṛttau na kiṃcit bādhaka-masti |
āharaṇe tu prakṛtau vihāradeśaprāpaṇāṇukūla eva mantro vihitaḥ, na tu gārhapatyāt vedideśaprāpaṇānukūlaḥ |
iha ca vedideśaprāpaṇānukūlasyaiva āvṛttiḥ iti ka mantrāvṛttiśca |
ata eva vastutaḥ ubhayatrāpi atra prasaṅgābhāve'pi āvṛttibhāvamātreṇa prāsaṅgikī adhyāya-saṃgatiḥ |
' nāhaḥ saṃ-hananam, itiḥ haraṇam, tayoḥ manū mantrau, evaṃ micau na, nāvartanīyau ityarthaḥ |
na hi atyantasaṃnikarṣa eva ekaṃ saṃvandhakāraṇam |
yathā yathā hi saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ na labhyate tathā tathā viprakṛṣṭe vedaśaktiḥ saṃcarati |
dravya saṃyogena, tadgataguṇakarmajāto dvitīyena, guṇakarma-gatajātayaḥ tṛtīyena |
sattā ca tatkālasaṃbandhaḥ iti tasya jātigatatvaṃ nānupananmīlāhuḥ |
śabdasya ca dravyatvāt tatrāpi saṃyoga eva saṃbandhaḥ |
na ca śabde śrotrasaṃyogāsaṃbhavaḥ, tasya sarvopalambhena vibhutayā digātmakaśrotrasapattyā vibhutayā saṃyogasāma-vāyikāraṇakarmabhāvāt iti vācyam |
na tāvat saṃyogatvāvacchinnaṃ prati karmaṇe janakatā, saṃyogabasayoge vyabhicārat |
kiṃtu vijātīyasaṃyoge, tatra vaijātya-kṛtyanapekṣya jayasaṃyoge karmatvena kāraṇatā yuktā |
vibhunī mithaḥ saṃyukte, nirantaradravyatvāt, ghaṭā-kāśavat, ityanumānena vibhusaṃyogasiddheśca |
maṇi. pṛ. 20. saṃnikarṣasya saṃnidhilena sthānatvāt tasya ca prakaraṇāt daurbalyam |
su. pṛ. 1286. saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣau tatrāpekṣyete yatra virodhaḥ kaścit |
ekasminnapi vākye tadavayavabhūta-sthānapekṣitasya naiva bhavati saṃbandhaḥ |
yathā adhvena vrajati, śvetena patenāhūtaḥ iti |
bhā. 6|4|6|13. ākāṅkṣā -yogyatā-saṃnidhānani hi anvitābhidhāne prayoja-kāni na tu śabdopāttatvamapi |
soma. 5|1|11 varṇakaṃ 3. sarvairvākyanyavi dhinne saṃnidhānasya api ākāṅkṣāvaśāt viśeṣa(ra)tvam |
tasmin cirakālaṃ saṃgṛhītaṃ yat nava-nītaṃ tad ājyasthāne grāhya iti vākyārthaḥ |
tadidaṃ navanītaṃ pradhānasya syāt, iti utsūna pūrvapakṣe siddhā-ntayati |

jyotiṣṭomavicāre śyene saṃnidhānaviśeṣāt codakena prākṛtasya somasya saṃnidhānaṃ bhavati, tādṛśāt somasya codakaprāptasaṃnidhānaviśeṣāt śyenapradhāne nava-nītasya asaṃbhavaṃ sati ānarthakyatadannyāyena tadjñānāṃ śyenājñānāṃ dīkṣaṇīyādīnāṃ hatinavanītamārjya syāt |
yatra codakena ājyaṃ prāptaṃ tatra ājyasthāne hatinavanītaṃ syāt |
tathā ca śyene hatinavanītaṃ na pradhānasya kiṃtu ajñānāṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
tasya 'sannidhau tvavibhāgāt0' iti nyāyena sannidhau apravṛtteḥ |
kau. 2|3|13 pṛ. 164. 'paurṇamāsyāṃ yajeta' 'sāyaṃ juhoti' 'prātaḥ juhoti' ityādī kāledeśena karmavidhāvapi na karmā- ntaratvamiti 'sannidhau tvavibhāgāt0' ityadhikāraṇe'- nupadameva vakṣyāmaḥ |
ku. 2|3|1|124. prakaraṇā- ntaratvācca vinā phalādīnāṃ bhedakatvamuktamapi na hyaṃ (bhāṣyāntarakṛdbhiḥ) : 'sannidhau tvavibhāgāt0' ityādi |
vā. 2|3|1|126 pṛ. 620, phalasaṃbandho'pi ca 'sannidhau tvavibhāgāt0' ityanena nyāyena na karmāttara- buddhiṃ karoti |
2|3|12, satyapi phala prati vidhāne 'sannidhau tvavibhāgāt' ityanenākarmāntaratā |
yathā svāvāntarāpūrvasaṃbandhāt vāṅniyamo nādhikārāpūrvānupraveśī tathā avaghātādyapi syāt |
tataśca adhikārapūrve pratyavaghātādīnāmaṅgatā na syāt, tadanaṅgatve ca tatpyutpatyāvaghātādīnāmapunar na syāt |
tasmin khalvāśrite adhikārābhāvena tasyā- nuṣṭhānānupatteradhikāriṇaḥ kalpayitavye prakṛtādhikārā- pūrvo'dhikṛta eva prayājādiṣvādhikriyate iti upāyopayeyabhāvāt tadaṅgatvasiddhiriti |
avaghātādiṣu śabdato vastuto vastusvabhāvataśca prokṣaṇādiṣu śabdata eva tuṣakaṇavimocanādi dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ ca kāryamadrīkriyate |
tatra yadi niyoge''pyapara āśrīyate kāryabhūtastadā kāryadvamekasmin kārye nānnīyate |
nānyasyetyava- guṇādhikārānupraveśitaiva nyāyyā, yataḥ na svatantrā- |
kasmāt kriyājanyaphalabhāgitve tu śabdārthe na śrutahāniriti |
saṃbhavati ca atra prakṛtaniyogāpratyabhijñānāt niyogāntare sthire prajā- |
tucchatve hi avaghātādīnāmaṅgīkriyamāṇe utpattiniyogā- snānādiṣu vastusvabhāvaparyeālocanayā
vāpāt parasya puroḍāśasya kṛte kapālaṃ iti parārtha tathā audumbarī puruṣāt parasya yajñasya kṛte iti parārthā |
vāsiṣṭhādīnāṃ narāśaṃsādikalpastu na parārthaḥ kiṃtu puruṣārthaḥ |
tasmāt vāsiṣṭhādarekasya narāśaṃsādikalpe saṃgṛhyate na sarveṣāṃ kalpaḥ saṃgṛhīto bhavati |

satre anekeṣāṃ yajamānānāṃ madhye kenāpi ekena yaja- mānena saṃmitā audumbarī śākhā yadi prakṛtaṃ yajñaṃ saṃpā- dayet tarhi anyanāpi prayogāntaresthanāpi yajamānena saṃmitā satī yajñaṃ saṃpādayet iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
ekaprayogasthā audumbarī śākhā anyaprayogasthena yajamānena saṃmitā na syāt |
yajeta ityākhyātātyena anvitasya yajña- mānasya ekatvāt, tasya cānyaprayogasya yajamānasya pūrvaprayoge anadhikārāt |
tatrānupradiṣṭadharmakeṣu aindrādyādiṣu atideśena tatprāptiḥ aindrādyādiṣu karmasu vihitadharmakebhyo darśapūrṇamāsādibhyo |
tatra prathamaṃ tāvadupo- dharmā atidiśyante iti |
pūrṇamāsādikarṇapaṭhitāḥ prayājādayaḥ sarvayāgeṣveva upa- saptamādhyāyasya prathame pāde- ' samānitaracchyatvena |
na ca tadvidhīyamānaṃ gānamātraibhidhāyinā gānasyaiva atideśyatvamityetadaśaḥ |
tassādyāge phalaṃ vihite satyanumitena vākyena hotranāmnā'tideśaḥ |
prakaraṇāmānādapi yadi śabdasya pradhānā- diṣu cintayitumiṣyate kimeṣāṃ dharmāḥ santi neti |
tena ca svavākyā sarvayāgā- yadā ca santi tadā ke cintyante vā kathaṃ cānuṣṭhātavyā |
'pi uddiśyamānasya viśeṣaṇavivakṣā'saṃbhavāt sarvāyāṃ santi dharmā ityucyate |
siddhāntastu bhāvenaiva pratyayārthaḥ prayojyatvā iti navamena |
tatraikasyā- ṣaṭke upadeśavicāraṃ parisamāpya idānīṃ uttare ṣaṭke |
mitikartavyatāviśiṣṭāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ mānamanyasyāḥ kutaḥ atideśavicāro hetuhetumadbhāvasaṃgatyā prastovyate |
vidhīyamānaiva bhāvanā tribhirbhavairrūpeṇa ' itthaṃ kuryāt ' ityupadeśapūrvakatvāt ' tadakuryāt ' |
idamananetthaṃ kuryāditi tasyāṃ tu viśiṣṭāyāṃ ityatideśasya tadvicārayorapi hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ |
' kriyante atideśena, kiṃvā na ityanena praśnena saptamo- |
tena sākṣātsaṃvadhyate na hi bhavatītyartha yāga iti kiṃcitsyaṃ prārambhaḥ |
kiṃ pratiprakaraṇaṃ niyatā dharmā uta śabdajātaṃ upadeśātmakamatadeśātmakaṃ ca |
phalasya bhāṣyatvaṃ sākṣādasaṃbhavapūrve saṃkrāntamatastadeva prayuktatve'pi tadiśeṣaprayuktatvāccaiva vyavasthāpa- |
ṇāpūrveṇa pratyayavācyatvamucyate, tato viśvajidadhikaraṇe kathita ityadoṣaḥ |
vyāpāreṇānyasya kartavyatocyate, kasyeti bhavati sākāṅkṣa dharmajāta bhāvyaprayuktamiti bhāvyaṃ tu nāpūrvaṃ svarge bhāvaye- |
bhāvanā ca phalasyocyate iti tatra tatra |
bhāvyaviśeṣasya svaśabdenābhidhānaṃ tadā kasya bhāvyatva- bhāṣyakāravacanāt |
mityākāṅkṣā na jāyata yatra tadiśeṣadhādhyāhāro bhavet |
evamanyatrāpi yāge karaṇe ca pūrvapakṣe na cāpūrvasya kartavyatāmāha phalakartavya- |
vā kartavyatocyate kāme veti na tāvadapūrva kartavya- tāyāṃ hi satyāṃ tadavagamyate iti vadan phalamābhyato- |
mityukatvā, nanu ca phalaṃ kartavyaṃ syādityanena tadevopācyate carakālamapūrvakalpanaṃ darśayati |
tasmāt evamavagamā- viśeṣapekṣāṃ darśayan na vyāpārasya kartavyatocyate, kasya |
locanena pratyayārthatvamapūrvasya bhāṣyakāreṇoktamiti jalpa- tarhi vyāpāreṇānyasya kasyeti bhavati tadādanīṃ sākāṅkṣa- |
kimarthaṃ punaḥ pratyakṣapannabhābhyabhāvaphalaparityāgena māsākhyena yāgasamudāyena kuryāditi yatra kartavyatā |
etadapi bhāṣyakāreṇa phale yajeḥ pratyayo guṇabhāvaḥ tat |
ānumāniko'pūrva iti coditvā pratyakṣopi nāḍanā- phalamatra vākye śrūyate ' svargakāmo yajeta ' iti |
na caitāvatā takartavyaṃ syāditi coditvā satyaṃ śrūyate na tu tadyajinā |
yataḥ praṇālyā''pi yena kriyate, vinaṣṭe yajau tadavati apūrvaṃ tu tena kriyate |
kriyate tatakaraṇaṃ bhavati yathā ' gomayaiḥ pacanti ' ' tuṣa- tasmāt tasya kartavyatocyate iti parihṛtam |
kathamanenaitapari- na sākṣādyajirvā śāstraphala sādhyati kintu apūrva- |
tena apūrve kṛte tenaiva phalaṃ bhaviṣyatītyava- |
kṣaṇikasya na sākṣātbhavatīyanumānikāpūrvapraṇālyā dhāraṇāttatkartavyaṃ bhavati, tena bhāvyaprayukta- |
anumite cāpūrve na phalāpūrveyoḥ kaści- mañjātām |
dviśeṣaḥ, dvayorapi bhāvyatvasyāvagatatvāt, aniṣṭato- ntarāpūrve paryavasyatīti etadeva punaḥ śro'pūrvake prakaṭitam |
nātra kaścidetadasti yadyavahitabhābhyamapūrva- yaśca yajeḥ pratyakṣaḥ phale guṇabhāvaḥ, sa nānāṣṭyā pūrvaṃ |
padhasānādyadharmāṇāṃ cāvāntarāpūrve bhāṣyamapi bhāvyapratyayārthaṃ na hītikartavyatā ākāṅkṣyate |
ataḥ siddhamavāntarāpūrvabhāvasaṃba- kartavyamiti, na yajiḥ kīdṛśa iti, tasmāccākartavyaṃ |
ndhād vyavasthā eva dharmā na pāriplavā iti |
tenānupradiṣṭadharmakairaindrādyādibhistadiśena dharmāḥ sidhya- kartavyamiti bhāvyaniṣṭhaṃ vyāpāraṃ vidhīyuktaṃ pratyayārthe |
tatra saptame pratyakṣavacanena nāmadheyena ca sāpāvadā- tadarthaṃ itikartavyatātāmityarthaḥ |
nanu adhikaraṇatvaṃ nāma na yena kenacit saṃbandhena |
kiṃ prakṛtau haviṣpiādiṣu prakṛtaṃ prokṣaṇam, uta apūrva- |
jātyāśraye samavāyāśraye ca bhūtatvā dau abhyāsaḥ |
cintā jāyate tadupāyatvena ca kiṃprayuktā ete prakṛtāviti |
mantareṇa sidhyatīti iha tadākhye tatra tu yaji- |
nimittamātraṃ vā tatra, atra tu prayo- |
dṛṣṭamahaṃ vā prayojanaṃ parikalpya lakṣaṇayā vā'vikṛtā- |
ranumavikī, na tatra kalpane yathā viśeṣādipadeṣu |
tatra ādheyatvameva ādheyatvatvena saptamyarthaḥ, tatra ca |
dhāraka eva ākhyātāthainvayaḥ, na tu kārakāntaradhārakaḥ |
yasaṃbhavāt tasmāt tatrāpi adhikaraṇatvasya na sākṣāt |
eva bodhaḥ anena janayituṃ śakyaḥ ; bhūtalaniṣṭhādhikaraṇa- |
bhāvanānanvayaḥ iti samādhatte-) caitrādau tu parayā kartṛ- |
myarthaḥ' iti cet, 'odane pacati' ityapi prayogā- |
lyarthānvayo'pi, tasya ca āśrayatve ākhyātātyartha, tasya |
ākāśe pakṣī gacchati, ākāśe tiṣṭhan ākāśamantaro |
ca pratiyogitāsaṃsargena nañarthe abhāve, tasya ca prathamā- |
pacati iti prayogo nāstyeva' iti keṣāṃciduktaṃ yuktam, |
'yasminnagnau pacedaṃ tasmin homo vidhīyate' iti bahu- |
nvayaḥ nañaḥ samabhivyāhārasthale iti matam" tadapi |
kartṛtvāvivakṣāyāṃ caitre pacyate iti bhāve prayogāpatteḥ |
vyutpattikalpane iti keṣāṃciduktaṃ yuktam, caitre na |
pacyate iti prayogasya evamapi nivārayituṃ śakyatvāt |
evaṃ laḍādyarthasyāpi dhātvarthānvayo na tyakto bhavati |

yadi tu asmin pakṣe ghaṭasa ākhyātārthe sākṣātsaṃbandhena anvayāt kartṛtvānupapatti: āśaṅkyeta, tata: astvakhyātasyaiva uktārthasyapratiyogikoktavidhā- bhāve saptamīnubhayasambandhihāre lakṣaṇa, nañpadaṃ ca tātparyagrāhakam |
saptamyarthasya ca tasminbhāvā- bhāve kartṛghaṭitaparaṃparāsaṃbandhenaiva anvayāt na vyutpatya- ntarakalpanā |
uktavidhāśrayatvatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākā- bhāvaśca ghaṭe na ghaṭasya bhūtalavṛttitādaśāyāṃ ityarthāt bhūtaladhikaraṇakaghaṭābhāvabodha: |
tasya ca sākṣātsaṃbandhena itarakriyānvayaḥ pūrvakriyāyāśca kartṛkarmaviśeṣaṇatve'pi saptamītvasaṃbandhisargaghaṭakatva- mapi nānupapannam |
evaṃ ca yatra 'iko yaṇaci' (pā0 6|1|77 ) ityādi kriyā nopāttā, tatra 'sati' iti sattārūpakriyā'dhyāhāro bodhyaḥ |
yatra tu saṃbandhino lakṣakatvaṃ na vivakṣitaṃ tatra 'gāvo duhyante, caitro gataḥ' : iti vākyadvayamayogaḥ |
ata eva tatra pūrvakriyāyāḥ uttarakriyāpalakṣakatvabodhaḥ kavikavyādivat mānasa eva |
ata eva ca samānārthakatvābhāvāt na saptamīvidhiḥ tasya vācakaḥ, apitu apūrvavidhiḥ, kathaṃcit ṣaṣṭhībādhako vā iti dhyeyam |

yattu-- 'kriyāhrāṇāṃ kriyākartṛtvādāṃ vivakṣite, kriyāhrāṇāṃ tadabhāve vivakṣite saptamī' yatā 'kriyāhrāṇāṃ tadabhāve kriyāhrāṇāṃ ca tasmin viva- kṣite' ityevaṃ vārtikaṃ ( vastutastu 'kārakāṇāṃ ca kārakatve, akārakāṇāṃ cākārakatve, tadapi yat sa' ityeva vārtikaśāstrapūrvam) 'satsu taratsu pūjyamāneṣu vā asanta āsate na pūjyante vā, ayatsu tiṣṭhatsu apūjyamāneṣu vā santastāranti pūjyante vā, satsu tiṣṭhatsu apūjyamāneṣu vā asantastāranti pūjyante vā, asatsu taratsu pūjyamāneṣu vā santāstiṣṭhanti na pūjyante vā' ityatra saptamīvidhāyakam, tat 'yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' ityanenaiva siddhe anarambhaṇīya iti kecit |
kaiyaṭādyastu lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvāvivakṣāyāṃ saptamīvidhānārtha ityāhuḥ; tatra, lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvātirikta- saṃbandhasya asākṣāttvāt abhāvane tasminnarthe saptamī- vidhānavaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
ataḥ arhatvāvacchinnakartṛkatvakarma- tvānyatarasaṃbandhena svasaṃbandhakriyākālakatvasya saptamyartha- syotanātha anuśāsanāntaram |
tadviropaṇī- bhūtāhrayāpyupādāne ca 'tiṣṭhatsu āsate' ityevābhyāṃ taraṇābhāvo lakṣyate |
sadasatpadābhyāṃ ca vācyavyaṅgya- vidhayā kriyāhrāṃnatve vyajyate |
bhataśca etādṛśa- lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvasya 'goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ' ityādi- vyāvṛttaśca atra vaiśiṣṭyaṃ anubhūyamānasya apaholu- maśakatvāt pṛthaganuśāsanam |
evaṃ 'ṣaṣṭhī cānādare' (pā0 2|3|38 ) iti sūtrāt anādaraviśiṣṭalakṣaṇabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī- saptamyo vikalpena |
'rudati rudato vā prātrājīt' rudantaṃ putramanāhya ityarthaḥ |
evaṃ 'svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca' (pā0 2|3|39 ) iti sūtrāt ebhiḥ saptamīyoge ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyo staḥ |
'virūpāṇāmapi samānāthānām' iti vārtikāt vakradaṇḍau itivat padatrayakoṣastu śabda- svarūpaparatvāt na śakyaḥ |
'gavāṃ goṣu vā prasūtaḥ' gā anubhavituṃ jñāta ityarthaḥ iti haradattaḥ |
evaṃ 'āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām' (pā0 2|3| 40 ) iti sūtrāt 'goṣu gavāṃ vā āyuktaḥ kuśalo vā' ityevaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyo |
viṣaya- saptamyāṃ prāptāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate |
tadabhāve tu 'āyukto goḥ śakaṭena' īṣa- yukta ityarthaḥ |
iti sūtrāt jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñābhiḥ yataḥ samudāyāt ekadeśasya pṛthakkaraṇārthakaṃ nirdhāraṇa kriyate tadācakṣāt ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyo staḥ |
'nṛṇāṃ nṛṣu vā brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ; gavāṃ goṣu vā kṛṣṇā bahukṣīrā, gacchatāṃ gacchatsu vā dhāvan śīghragāmī, chātrāṇāṃ chātreṣu vā maitraḥ paṭuḥ' ityādī |
idaṃ ca padopāttasya nirdhāra- ṇapratiyogitāvacchedakasya manuṣyatvāgotvādeḥ nirdhāraṇa- viṣayībhūtabrāhmaṇādau sattve eva vikalpāmidhānaṃ bodhyam |
yadā tu tasya tatra asattvaṃ tadā nirdhāraṇapratiyogi- vācakatvāt pañcamyeva |
'pañcamī vibhakte' (pā0 2|3|42 ) iti sūtrāt 'mādhurāḥ kāśīsthebhya āvyatarāḥ' ityādī pañcamī |
evaṃ 'sādhunipuṇābhyāmāryāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ' (pā0 2|3|43 ) iti sūtrāt 'mātari sādhunipuṇo vā' ityatra saptamī |
'sādhunipuṇo vā mātaraṃ prati pari anu vā' |
evaṃ 'prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca' (pā0 2|3|44 ) iti sūtrāt ābhyāṃ yoge tṛtīyā syāt saptamī vā ityarthakāt prasita utsuko vā hariṇā harau vā ityatra vikalpena saptamī |
prasitaḥ āsaktaḥ; na tu prakarṣeṇa śuklaḥ |

evaṃ 'nakṣatre ca lupi' (pā0 2|3|46 ) iti sūtrāt nakṣatravāciprākṛteḥ 'nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (pā0 4|2|12 ) ityanena aṇpratyayasya 'lubviśeṣe' (pā0 4|2|44 ) iti lupi kṛte nakṣatrayuktakālaprāti- padikāt adhikaraṇe tṛtīyā saptamyo staḥ |
ityarthakāt 'mūlena mūle vā devīmāvāhayet' ityādī saptamī |

evaṃ 'saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye' (pā0 2|3|7 ) iti sūtrāt sajātīyayorvijātīyayorvā kārakayormadhye yau kālādhvānau tatra saptamīpañcamyo staḥ ityarthakāt 'adya bhuktvā adya hyahe dvādaśa bhoktā, ihastho'yaṃ krośe krośārddhā lakṣayaṃ vicchet' ityādī vikalpena saptamī |
atra yadyapi bhojanadvaye'pi eka eva puruṣaḥ kartṛkārake tathāpi adyatanakālīnabhojanakriyānirūpitakartṛtvāt hyahakālīnabhojanakriyānirūpitakartṛttvasya medāt kāraka- dvayamadhyatvam |
dvitīyādāharaṇe tu ayaṃ iti kartā, lakṣyaṃ iti karma, iha ityadhikaraṇam, iti vijātīya- madhyatvam |
evaṃ adhikaśabdanāpi yoge 'loke lokād adhiko hariḥ' ityādī pañcamīsaptamyo śreye, 'tadasi- nadhikaṃ' (pā0 5|2|45 ) 'yasmādadhikaṃ' (pā0 2|3|9 ) iti ca sūtrīyadivinirdeśāt |
evaṃ 'yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī' (pā0 2|3|9 ) iti sūtrāt ādhikyārthakakarmapravaca- nīyayukte saptamī syāt ityarthakāt 'upa parādhe harerguṇāḥ' ityādī saptamī |
evaṃ 'adhirīśvare' (pā0 1|4|97 ) iti sūtrāt aiśvarye adhiḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaḥ |
tayukte aiśvaryaprati- yogini tadanuyogini ca 'adhi rāme bhūḥ, adhi bhuvi rāmaḥ' ityādī paryāyeṇa saptamī |
atra krameṇa anuyogitvaṃ pratiyogitvaṃ ca saptamyarthaḥ |
svasaṃbandheyartha- saṃndhītaravṛttitvaṃ ākhyātāthasaṃsargeḥ adhiḥ tātparya- grāhakaḥ |
rāmapratiyogiṇvasvatvāśrayo bhūḥ, bhūvṛttitva- pratiyogī rāmaḥ iti phalito'rthaḥ |
tat siddhaṃ saptamyarthaḥ śakyo lākṣaṇikoṃ vā sarvo'pi bhāvānvayī iti |
tena 'sthālyāṃ pacati, bhūmau vasati, kaṭe śete' ityādiprayogaḥ |
adhikaraṇaṃ ca trividhaṃ aupaśleṣikam, vaiṣayikam, abhivyāpakaṃ ceti |
tena 'gurau vasati, ghaṭe jñānam, tileṣu tailam' ityādiḥ
samaṃ syādabhūtatvāt ' iti nyāyena ekasmin pātre vidyamānasomasya sarvaiḥ samāṃśatayā bhakṣaṇīyatvāt kasya-cidbhāgādhikyaṃ na yuktam, tatsahanāyai anuśāpanam |
soma. 3|5|16. athavā ' samaṃ syādaśruti-tvāt ' iti nyāyena daśadaśa (pātāraḥ) prāptā mukhyayaiva itthyā anuvadadhinte |
kartṛsaṃskārārthe hi sati dakṣiṇāvat vibhāgaprāpyā ' samaṃ syāt0 ' iti daśadaśaikaṃ iti prāpnuyāt |
ekādaśānāṃ ṛcāṃ (sāmidhenīnāṃ) prayamottamayoḥ yāvatsaṃkhyāsaṃparabhyāse ' same syāt0 ' iti nyāyena pratyekaṃ trirmyāsaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 10|1|8. ekādaśasu anūyājeṣu ' samaṃ syāt0 ' iti nyāyena saikīkaraṇena vibhajya prakṛtivikārabhāvaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|3|4. dve āhavanīye ' iti vākyena abhyāsadasyasyāpi āhavanīyādhikaraṇatve vihite atra |

śiṣṭābhyāseṣu tattadvākyābhyāṃ gārhapatyānvāharyapacana-rūpādhikaraṇamātravidhānāt ' samaṃ syādaśrutvāt ' iti nyāyena ca ekaikasmin gārhapatyānvāharyapacanarūpe adhika-karaṇe abhyāsacatuṣṭayaprāpteḥ daśadhā abhyāsasiddhiḥ |
dvayoretenāpi ca tyajya-mānasya ' samaṃ syādaśrutvāt ' ityanena nyāyena ardha-pūṣṇo bhāgaḥ iti gamyate (somāpauṣṇadau) |
na ca ' samaṃ syāt0 ' iti nyāyāt (ekādaśānāṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ pañcadaśatvātthe) samavibhāga eva prāpnoti na, dviśatasyamyasa iti vācyam |
yatra hi ekena vākyena ekārthaḥ anekasya vidhīyate tatraiva samavibhāgaḥ |
ekasmin vidheye, vibhāgaṃ vinā tasyānekasaṃndhabhāvena vibhāgaparyantatvāt tatra vivikṣāpārasya, tatra caikarūpa evobhayatra vivikṣāpāre vākya iti samavibhāgavidhiḥ |
yatra tu vākyadvayenāneka-manekasya vidhīyate tatra vividhyakavyāpārayorekarūpa-pramāṇābhāvāt na samavibhāgasya pravṛttiḥ |
pañcaśarādīye ' pañcottame'hani ' ityatra uttame'hani pañcatvavidhī avaśiṣṭānāma ' samaṃ syādaśrutvāt ' iti nyāyena anvahaṃ trayāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ prāpteḥ |
paśo ekādaśa prayājāḥ tatra prākṛtānāṃ pañcānāṃ madhye caturthapañcamayoreva, ṣaḍapi aprākṛtadevatyāḥ ' samaṃ syādaśrutvāt ' iti nyāyena kramaso'ī iti tayorevābhyāsāt |
prayājā-nūyājayormilitvā pañcasaṃkhyākatvāt ' samaṃ syādaśrutvāt ' iti nyāyena prayājadvayārthe kiṃcidadhikaṣaṭtraya-syaivānayanaṃ prasajyeta |

yadāhava-nīye juhoti ' ityanārabhyavādena sarvahomānāṃ āhavanī-yādhikaraṇatvaprāpteḥ : ' āhavanīyaṃ dve ' ityasya āhavanīya-natarapariṣaṃkhyārthatvāt adyānāmāhutīnāmadhikaraṇapekṣāyāṃ gārhapatyānvāharyapacanādhikaraṇatvavicau ' samaṃ syāt0 ' itya-nena nyāyena ekatra catuṣṭayasya prāpnuyāt ' gārhapatye juhoti ' ' anyāharyapacanaṃ juhoti ' iti vākyānta-rabhyāṃ vā gārhapatyānvāharyapacanaprāpteścarātritkṣaṇaguṇa-mātravidhānārthatvāt tattasyogasya āhavanīyasyogasya ca dvidhāgacitkṣaṇaguṇamātravidhānārthatvāt na vākyabhedā-pattiḥ |

tathā ca iye dayenasya asaṃnidhānāt jyotiṣṭomasyaiva saṃnidhānāt na dayenadharmānāmanuvādaḥ kiṃtu jyotiṣṭomadharmānāmanuvāda eṣaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
apivā yadyapūrvatvāditaradadhikāryaṃ jyoti- ṣṭomikād vighestadvācakaṃ samānaṃ syāt |
saḥ jyoti- ṣṭomikānāṃ dharmānāmanuvādaḥ; na dayenadharmānāṃ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtraprāptaṃ 'yadi apivā' iti akṣarasamadāyena nirasana siddhāntamāha |
'yadi iti asaṃdigdhe sadigghavacanam' iti 'yadi apivā iti viparyasya pakṣavyāvṛttau dhyākhyeyam' iti ca tantraratnam |
nanu samānamitarat iti itaraśabdasya sarvanāmatvena saṃnihitatvāt anu- vādo jñāyate |
tat kasmādanyat ityapekṣāyām, itarat adhikāryaṃ jyoti- ṣṭomikād vidheḥ ityucyate |
jyotiṣṭomagatatva vidheḥ jyotiṣṭomagatadharmebhyaḥ adhikā ye dayenavaiśeṣikā dharmāḥ iti adhikāye 'itarat' iti śabdo bhavati |
samāna- mitarat iti itaraśabdaḥ jyotiṣṭomadharmebhyaḥ adhikānāṃ dayenadharmāṇāṃ bodhakaḥ ityarthaḥ |
tadvācakaṃ samānaṃ syāt, samānaśabdaḥ tadvācakaḥ syāt |
te ca jyotiṣṭomadharmebhyaḥ adhikāḥ dayenadharmāḥ lohitoṣṇī- ṣatva-lohitavasanatva-nivītatvādayaḥ kaṇṭakavitodanā- dayaśca |

' samāpti: śabdārtha: ' ityanena nyāyena pūrvaṃ tyajamānakametirodhānena parapūjyamānakarmāvirbhāvāt, ekakametvāvadhāraṇena saṃpradānavatśaktikkamabhibhūyaiva nirdeśo bhavati 'viṣṇuṃ yajati' 'viṣṇuryajavya:' iti, na tu tatra devatātvamabhidhīyate |

\ satyapi kartu: śabdārtharūpeṇa prādhānye vastulakṣaṇāt karmaprādhānyasya bhāṣyākāṅkṣākāle pratīte: bhāvanā- svarūpāvagatikālakartṛprādhānyapratītyuttarakalatvena paratayā 'samāpti: śabdārtha: ' iti nyāyāt vivakṣitamityam |
\ samāmnāyasya samastasya vedasya aidamarthya artha- vādādhikaraṇe adhyayanavidhivatvāt vyavasthāpitam |
somante śālāmukhīyādīnāṃ nāsti laukikatvaṃ prāptatvāt prājñitasyaiva tu samāropa: |
sarve prāyaṇīye puna: sarve udayanīye syu: |
jyotiṣṭomaprakṛtitvāt tau jyotiṣṭome ca ekasminnevāhani samastanāmadheyaikādaśinā- nāmalambhāt, prāyaṇīye udayanīye'pi tathaiva coda- kāt |
'annahamekakamālameta ' iti aikādaśi- nānāṃ paśūnāṃ vihāra: prāpta: tasya pratiṣedha: kṛto'tra |
tasmāt sarve prāyaṇīye, sarve ca udayanīye syu: |
prāyaṇīyodanīyayo: pratyekaṃ sarve aikādaśinā: paśava ālambhyā: |
aikādaśinānāṃ prāyaṇīyodanīyayo: samāsa: na kartavya: kintu vibhāga: syāt |
śrutita: prāyaṇīyodanīyayo: iti dvivacanaśruti: , dvitvaśrutipādeyā na lakṣaṇa- tayā |
lokavat yathā loke śataṃ devadattayajñadattābhyāṃ dīyatāṃ ityukte na pratyekaṃ śataṃ dīyate kintu vibhajya tadvat |
prāyaṇīyodanīyayo: aikādaśinānāṃ paśūnāṃ vibhāge- nānuṣṭhānaṃ na samāsena ityatra hetvantaramāha |
vihāra: prakṛtitvasya sa vihāraprakṛti: prāyaṇīyodanīyayorekā- daśinapaśuvibhāga: |
'aikādaśinām ' 'annahamekakamāla- meta ' iti vihāra: prakṛta: , tasya vikāra: vibhāga: samāso vā tatra yāvacchakyaṃ vihārasya anugrahītavyam |

prāyaṇīyodanīyayo: iti dvivaca- nānusārāt aikādaśināṃ dvedhā vibhāge kartavye sarvathā samāsatvena vibhāgasaṃbhavat prāyaṇīye kati, kati ca udaya- nīye iti viśaye-saṃśaye sati tadāsatte: samavibhāgasya āsatte: pratyāsatte: sānnidhyāt pañca prāyaṇīye ṣaṭ udayanīye iti nirṇaya: |
prāyaṇīyodanīyayo: aikādaśinānāṃ paśūnāṃ tathā dvedhā vibhāge kartavye sati prāyaṇīye traya: syu: śeṣā aṣṭau udayanīye iti vibhāga: kartavya: |
bahuva- samānādhikaraṇasaṃkhyānāṃ tritvasya prāthamyāt prathamau- sthitasya ca tyāge kāraṇābhāvāt |
prāyaṇīyodanīyayo: aikādaśinānāṃ paśūnāṃ dvedhā vibhāge kartavye traya: aṣṭau iti vibhāga: syāt bahuṣu tritvasya prāthamyāt iti śaṅkā niṣidhya siddhāntamāha |
kiṃtu pañca ṣaṭ ityeva vibhāga: kartavya: |
sāmyena pravibhajyante, evamapipā yāvacchakyaṃ sāmyena vibhajya amyadhika eka udayanīye ālampyate |
tasmāt pañca ṣaṭ iti vibhāga iti siddhānta: |
devadattasya gurukulaṃ ityatra nitya- sāpekṣatvāt samāsa: |
(devadattasya yo guru: tasya kulaṃ gṛhaṃ ityartha: ) |

guruśabdasya saṃbandhiśabdatvāt śiṣyasaṃbandhirūpaṃ vinā svārthapratipādanākte: tādrūpyama- stareṇa svārthābhidhānaparvavasānāt aparyavasitasvārthābhi- dhāna (tve ?) eva śabdāttarābhidhānasaṃyogāt svārthā- bhidhānavelāyāmeva saṃbandhavyantaraśriyamāpnotīti nirviśeṣa- sāmānyānupapatte: taddeśeṣāpekṣāmapi paryavasitasvārthā- bhidhānavyāpārasya śabdasya saṃbandhavyantarānyasiddhau vyāpā- rāntarābhāvena sāmyadhyāvighātāt samāso yukta: |
sarveṣu samāseṣu abhiyuktavacanaṃ pramāṇaṃ iti vārtikakāra- caraṇā: |
iti khasmibhāve avagate, citraguriti citrāmirgobhiḥ saṃbandhe'vagate, pañcamūlīti samāhārasaṃbandhottarakālam, upakumbhamiti samīpasaṃbandhottarakālam |
dup. 6|1| 6|24 pṛ. 1273. samāsena ca vidadhato nāneka- guṇavidhānaṃ duṣkaram |
bhā. 2|1| 17|41. samāseṣu śaktiraṅgīkāryā iti vaiyā- karaṇāḥ |
kiṃtu samāsopasthitavigrahavākyādeva bodhaḥ iti bhāṭṭa- cintāmaṇikāraḥ |
samāsāntargatayoḥ ekamuddeśakaṃ itaradvidhāyakaṃ bhavituṃ na khalu arhati (ekaprasaratābhaṅgapatteḥ iti śeṣaḥ ) |
bāla. pṛ. 181. samāsavākyasya vigrahavākyopasthityā bodha- janakatvaṃ yuktam |
nīlotpalaṃ iti karmadhārayaḥ, pañcamūlī iti dviguśca tatpuruṣasya bhedo |
nanu unmattagaṅgaṃ ityavyayībhāve tatlakṣaṇaṃ anyāptam, ativyāptaṃ ca bahuvrīhilakṣaṇam |
evaṃ supraprati ityādi avyayībhāve 'sup pratinā mātrārthe' (pā0 2|1|9) itisūtravihite tatpuruṣalakṣaṇānvitāti |
evaṃ 'ardha napuṃsakam' (pā0 2|1|2) ityādisūtravihite ardhapippalī, pūrvakāyaḥ ityāditatpuruṣe avyayībhāvalakṣaṇānvitātiḥ |
evaṃ śaśakuśa- palāśaṃ iti samāhāradvaṃdva samāhāraprādhānyāt dvaṃdvalakṣaṇasya anyāptiḥ, bahuvrīhilakṣaṇasya ca ativyāptiḥ |
tena unmattagaṅgaṃ, supprati ityādyavyayībhāve nāvyāptiḥ, na vā tatpuruṣalakṣaṇatiprasaṅgaḥ |
tena rājapuruṣaḥ, ardhapippalī ityāditatpuruṣe na lakṣaṇavyāptiḥ, na vā avyayībhāve lakṣaṇātiprasaṅgaḥ |
dvibhāḥ ityatra api samastamānapadārthasaṃkhyāprādhānyena dvaṃdvatve'pi anya- padārthasaṃkhyeyaprādhānyena bahuvrīhitvam |
evaṃ ca 'saṃkhyāyā'vyayā0' (pā0 2|1|25) iti sūtraṃ saṃkhyeyaprādhānyagamakaṃ saṃkhyāvācakāvyayādipadānāṃ bahuvrīhividhāyakaṃ iti saṃgacchate |
evaṃ 'diṅmānāyantarāle' (pā0 2|1|26) ityādisūtrāṇi anyapadārthaprādhānyena bahuvrīhividhāyakāni bhavanti, yathā uttarapūrvā, keśākeśi, bhujābhuji, saputraḥ iti |
kukṣimarāḥ paraṃ te'pi na santi khalu ketake ||
28) itisūtravihite 'saputraḥ' iti bahuvrīhau tulya- kriyānvayī pitā anyapadārthaḥ iti bahuvrīhilaṃ sustham |
samāhāradvaṃdva tu samāhitamāṇānāmeva kriyānvayitvena samāhārasya aprādhānyāt na dvaṃdvalakṣaṇāvyāptiḥ bahuvrīhi- lakṣaṇānvitātiśca iti yuktam |
anye tu 'unmattagaṅgaṃ' ityādināṃ bahuvrīhitvam, dvibhā ityādi dvaṃdvavādikameva |
na ca tatrāpi prakaraṇavirodhā- pattiḥ, adhikārasūtrasyānurodhena prakaraṇāvasya nyāyya- tvāt |
'anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām' (pā0 2|1|21) ityavyayībhāvasya sammindhyāhaviśeṣe anvarthatābādhat tena prakaraṇatvācca |
'samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' (pā0 2|1|1) iti mahādhikāreṇa ekārthībhāvalakṣaṇe sāmarthye samāsādi- sakalavṛttitvidhānāt |
padodeśena vidhīyamānaḥ samāsādiḥ samarthaḥ vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne śaktiṃ prāptaḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
sa ca arthaḥ arājakīyabhinnaḥ rājasaṃbandhaśca ayaṃ iti bhedarūpaḥ saṃsargarūpaśca |
na ca klaptarājādipadaśaktita eva tādṛśopasthitisaṃbhave kiṃ samāsaśaktikalpanena iti vācyam |
rājapuruṣādipade uktarūpopasthitaye citragavādipade svāmitvenopasthitaye ca tatkalpanāt |
anyathā paṅkajādipade'pi padamatvena upasthitaye atiriktaśaktikalpanaṃ na syāt |
kiṃca samāsagatarājapadena svataḥ svatantropasthiteḥ rājā puruṣa ityatraiva viśeṣaṇavyāptiḥ |
na ca 'saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna, vṛttasya ca viśeṣaṇayoge na' iti niṣedhena tadanāpattiḥ, tasya viśeṣaṇasiddhipadārthai- deśatvakṛtānanvayatānudāttvāt |
apica evaṃ vākya- samāsayoḥ tulyārthatvena vibhāṣāvacanasya samāsaniyama- nivāraṇārthatvaṃ kalpya iti gauravam |

kiṃca, kṛtavibhaktaḥ, prātodakaḥ, uddhṛtaudanaḥ ityādi- bahuvrīhiṣu viśvajanakṛtatimān, udakakartṛkaprāptirm, odanoddharaṇāvadhiḥ ityādyartheṣu kutādipadānāṃ lakṣaṇā- saṃbhavāt, citragavādipade ca vinigamanāvi raheṇa citra- pade gopade vā lakṣaṇāsaṃbhavāt ubhaya lakṣaṇāyāṃ bodhyāvṛttiprasakteḥ |
na ca pratyārthānvayurodhena carama- pade lakṣaṇā iti vācyam |
na ca tātparyagrāhakatvayā anyeṣāṃ tatpratipādakatvam, ghaṭādi- padeṣvapi ādyavarṇānāṃ tātparyagrāhakatvā anyavarṇai śakyāpatteḥ |
kiṃca, śivo nāma gāyako yasya iti śivanāma- gāyakaḥ iti bahuvrīhau śivakartṛkagānakarmabhūtanāmavān iti bodhasya śaktikalpanaṃ vinā sutarāmanupapattiḥ |
kiṃca, tatra śakyanaṅgīkāre arthavatvābhāve prāti- padikasaṃjñā na syāt |
na ca 'citragumānaya' ityādiṣu karmatvādyarthabodhakatvaṃ samastamānottarapadārthagatasvārthabodha- katvaṃ vā samāsottaravibhaktīnāṃ iti vācyam |
kiṃca, samāsasya prātipadikatayā tadekadeśapuruṣadi- padārthasya puruṣadeḥ prātipadikatvābhāvena tatkāraka- bodho na syāt |
na syācca samastamānapadārthayoḥ paraspara- nvayaḥ, vibhaktyanyopasthityābhāvena rājapadārthakāraka- bodhādyogāt, abhedātiriktasaṃbandhena nāmārthaprakārakabodhe vibhaktijanyopasthitirahetutvāt |
kiṃca, rājapadasya saṃbandhini saṃbandhe vā lakṣaṇā |
nādyaḥ, rājaḥ puruṣa iti vākyasya samāsābhidhārthatayā tena vivaraṇavirodhāt |
nāntyaḥ, viruddhavibhaktirahita- prātipadikārthayoḥ abhedānvayavyutpattyā rājasaṃbandharūpaḥ puruṣaḥ iti bodhāpatteḥ |
samāseṣu klasarājapadādereva saṃnnidhilakṣaṇā rājasaṃvandhinimnaḥ puruṣaḥ iti bodhasaṃbhave na śaktikalpyanaṃ yuktam |
mahādhikārasyāpi ajahatsvārtha- lakṣaṇyapekṣarāsāmarthya samāsādi vidhānena upapatteḥ |
padoddeśyena vidhīyamānaḥ samāsādiḥ samarthaḥ svārthavācaka- padāniṣṭhaḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
-etena- rājapadārthe śobhanādiviśeṣaṇānvayāpattiḥ, niṣkośāmbiḥ , gorathaḥ ityādī kāntyuktādipada- kalpanā''pattiśca-parāstā |

rājādipadaśaktasyeva rājapuruṣaḥ, citraguḥ ityādau bodhābhāvena tatra śaktigrahasya āvaśyakatayā paṅkajādipadeṣu avayavaśaktyagrahe'pi bodhodayane tallakṣi- grahasyānāvaśyakatayā paṅkajādipadevalakṣaṇasya spaṣṭatvāt |
cakārasamabhivyāhāre eva etadvadvodhaka iti tayoḥ samāsaḥ |
' cāyeṃ dvaṃdvaḥ ' iti sūtreṇa cakāramātrabodhitairdvaṃdvavidhānāt anyayoḥ cakāraṃ vinā apiśabdenāpi bodhanācca |
atra itaretarayogadvaṃdvopasthitayoḥ dhavakhadirayoḥ chidi- kriyānvayena dvitvānvayena ca kutrāpi na śaktirlakṣaṇā vā |
' pitarau ' ityādivirūpaikaśeṣeṣu pitṛ- padena janakadāṃpatye lakṣite dvitvānvaye lakṣaṇa |
' pāṇi- pādaṃ ' ityādau samāhāradvaṃdveḍapi ekatvānvayānuparodhena tāvatpadārthavṛttiḥ ekabuddhiviṣayarūpaḥ samāhāre lakṣaṇayā upasthāpyate iti siddhāntaḥ |
itaretarayoge vibhaktyupasthite dvitvādisaṃkhyāyāḥ dhave khadire cānvayaḥ |
tatra ca na dhavatvāvacchinnāvācachedakatvaṃ dvitpaparyāyavibhaktiracanāva- cchedakatvāt, vibhakteḥ prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakavyāpyasaṃkhyā- midhāyakatvaniyamāt |
ato dhavapadaṃ sāhityamāśrayatayā dhavakhadirau lakṣaṇayā upasthāpayati iti sāhityavācchede dvitvānvayaḥ |
evaṃ ca mitrāvaruṇapade mitrayoḥ varuṇayoḥ iti vigraho- padaśaṃkaṃ vākyaṃ upapadyate, anyathā dvitvānupapatteḥ |
evaṃ samāhāradvaṃdveḍapi ekatvānvayārthe sāhitye lakṣaṇā āvaśyakī |
evaṃ ca vibhakteḥ prakṛtyarthagatasvārthabodhadhatva- nyutpattiḥ aparityaktā bhavati |
evaṃ sarūpaikaśeṣe'pi sāhityopasthitā dvitvānvayarthaṃ lakṣaṇā ityāhuḥ |

pratyakṣeṇa padadvayenopasthite arthadvaye dvitvānvayasaṃbhavāt, yogyatāvacchedakaprakārakajñānasya śābdabodhahetutve mānābhāvāt, vibhakteḥ padārthatāvacchedaka- dharmadharmamānādhikaraṇasaṃkhyābhidhāyakatvāt |
ata eva ' ghaṭena jalamāharati ' ityatra sacchidrataratvena na ghaṭo- pasthitaḥ, kiṃtu ghaṭatvenaiva, ' ghaṭaśca paṭaśca staḥ ' iti dvitvānvayaśca |

ekasaṃkhyābhidhāyakatvalakṣaṇasāmānyā- dhikaraṇyaniyamāt ekatvena upasthite dvitvānvayāsaṃbhavāt ' caitro maitraśca gacchataḥ ' ityādī cakāropāttasāhityā- nyayini dvitvānvayena, kriyāyāṃ vā dvitvānvayena bodhaḥ |
anyathā ekatvena upasthite dvitvānvaye ' ekau dvau ' iti pratīyamānaḥ |
vastuto yatra subupasthāpyasaṃkhyā tiṅupasthāpyasaṃkhyā- virodhinau tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyanopapattiḥ |
subupaya- syāpyaikatvasya tiṅupasthāpyadvitvena virodhābhāvāt ' ghaṭaśca paṭaśca staḥ ' iti prayogo yuktaḥ, na tu ' ekau dvau ' iti, tatra ekatvasya virodhivāt |
na ca samāhāralakṣaṇayāṃ pāṇṇādīnāṃ kriyānvayo na syāditi vācyam |

kecittu ' evaṃ nañtatpuruṣe'pi ' aghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ ' ityādi ghaṭapratiyogikānyoyabhāve naño lakṣaṇā, tatrāpi anvayitāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvasya vyutpatti- labhyatvāt anyonyābhāvamātre lakṣaṇā |
evaṃ ca ghaṭa- pratiyogikānyoyabhāvavān paṭaḥ iti bodhaḥ |
evaṃ ' na ghaṭaḥ ' iti vākye'pi lakṣaṇe, nañaḥ saṃsargābhāve śaktatvāt iti dik |
vākya- sthaṃ tu ' ṛdasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ' itivat saṃśrayamānaṃ dṛṣṭam |
bāla. pṛ. 22, ' samidho yajati ' ayaṃ ṛtvarthaḥ utpattividhiḥ |
pṛ. 13, ' samidho yajati ' ayaṃ pañcamallakāraḥ vidhiḥ śrautaḥ |
pṛ. 9, ' samidho yajati ' ityādyāḥ darśapūrṇa- māsāṅgaṃ prakaraṇāt |
bhā. 3|4|11, ' samidho yajati ' , ' tanūnapātaṃ yajati ' iti krameṇa paṭhitānāṃ yāgānāṃ aniyamenānuṣṭhānamuta pāṭhakrameṇa |
śā. 5|1|4, samidho yajati ' , ' tanūnapātaṃ yajati ' iti yajatiśabdaḥ pañca- kṛttvo'bhyastaḥ |
tatra pratyabhyāsaṃ adṛṣṭabhedaḥ, na tu pañcabhyaḥ ekamapūrvam |
bhā. 2|2|12, ' samidho yajati ' ' tanūnapātaṃ yajati ' ityādīnāṃ karmanāmadheyāni |
vi. 9|2|10, ' samidho yajati ' ' tanūnapātaṃ yajati ' ityādī yajatipadāmyāsaḥ karmabhedakaṃ pramāṇam |
2|2|212. mīko. pṛ. 568 ' abhyāsādhikaraṇam ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
' samidho yajati ' ' tanūna- pātaṃ yajati ' ityādividhivyākhyapaṭhena pravītaḥ kramo niyato gṛhyate prayājānām |
atra samidhaḥ iti bahutvaṃ ' samidho agra ājyasya yantu ' iti mantravarṇaprāptaṃ devatāgatamanucyate, na tu karmatatvena vidhī- yate, utpattivākye vidhānābhāvāt |
bhā. 10|1|7|14 pṛ. 1890, samidādīnāṃ ajñānāṃ yathā prayogavacanaikyaṃ na tathā naimittikapādhikṛtādi- yāgānāṃ prayogavacanaikyam |
9|2|10|58-59. mīko. pṛ. 2052 ' darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prayājāḥ ' ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
samidādivākyāni yājyāvidhiparāṇyaiva iti vedārthakuśalā mīmāṃsakaśiromaṇayo vidākurvantu |
ājyabhāgayoḥ : ' juṣāṇo agra ājyasya vetu ' , ' juṣāṇaḥ soma ājyasya haviṣo vetu ' iti nigadarūpo mantrau |
tatra arthapratipādanarūpa- dvāramede api mukhyaviśvobhūtapradhānaprakāśanarūpakārya- katvāt juṣāṇanigadayorvikalpaḥ |
haviḥ-padaviṣaye tu ahaviḥ-sahaviḥ- padayoḥ samiddhṛtanyāyena ukta- yoreva nigadayoḥ prayogasaṃbhavādupavādamātram |
iḍopa- hūtā iti pade eva prakṛtya asya pāṭhāt padaviṣayaṇī evāvṛttiḥ samiddhṛtanyāyena ayaṃ pravādaḥ |
vanaspatyādige samiddharhinaspatyādiṣu ca yā devatāḥ tāḥ pratyakṣa upasamiddharhinaspatya eva |
' yūyamevainaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ karoti ' iti vacanāntare upasyaiva vanaspatījyābhāgitva- śravaṇāt |

bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvenānyadaśāyāmeva devato- deśyakatvena yāgasvarūpabodhatvāt paścātkāryabhāvākāṅkṣayā anvīyamānānāmimaṃviharhinadīnāṃ devatāsvarūpaghaṭakatvā- yogāt sarasvatītisiddhadevatānāmasābhyena ' ekā cet sarasvatī nadīnām ' iti mantre nadīstavanavat soma- latāyāmumāsahāyatāsāmyena ' somaḥ pacate janitā matīnām ' iti mantre cāvāpṛthivyādijanakaratvoktivacca stāvakamātraṃ yupasya havirbhāgitvavādaḥ |
