kāni punastāni ? yāni sutasyākriyā pratiṣiddhasevanāni, tānyucyante |
yathā 'yasyāhṛtamami- hotraṃ sūryo'bhyudiyāt maitraṃ caruṃ nirvapet, sauryameka-
kapālam ' yasyāhutamagnihotraṃ sūryo'bhyudiyāt , agniṃ samādhāya yāca yatnā dampatī sarvārhamupasīyātām ' iti |
taccai- nimittikaṃ karmaṇaḥ prakaraṇe utpannatvāt karmāṅgaṃ vijñāyate |
yāvanti cocyante, tāni sarvāṇi prayogavacane gṛhyante |
śā-- yāni punarna doṣanidhārtārthāni, nimitte karmājñāni ' minne juhoti ' ityādīni, teṣāṃ prayājā- divat aparyāyavidhānāt samuccayaḥ |

soma-- ekaikasminnimitte śrūyamāṇānāmapi bahūnāṃ tattadicchiṣu tattadākyaśeṣe vā doṣaśravaṇābhāvena pūrvavat vākyena nirapekṣatayā doṣanidhārtārthatvena vidhānābhāvāt na vikalpaḥ, kiṃtu nimitte vidhīyamānānāmapi prayājā- divat ṛtvaṅgatayā tadvadeva aparyāyavyāpāreṇa prakaraṇe yugapat grahaṇāt samuccayaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- yāni doṣagrāhakamamāṇābhāvāt doṣanidhār- tārthāni, api tu kevalaṃ nimitte naimittikāni arhā- ryāni, tatra ekanimittakanaimittikasthale prayājā- divat samuccaya eva |
yathā anvādhānottaraṃ candrasūryo- parāge iḍābhakṣaṇāt pūrvamapi ' udayaṃtaṃ, udayantaṃ, citraṃ ' iti mantrayakaraṇakahomamayavidhau |
nahi tatra kaścidoṣaḥ vedādiprayuktasyāpi iḍābhakṣaṇāt pūrvamapravṛtteḥ |
etādṛśa- viṣaye prāyaścittasamākhyā tu prāyaścittakaṇapattitva- mātreṇa aupacārikī, yajamānakartṛvyasāmavaidikapadārtheṣu audrātrasamākhyāvat |
yattu atra bhāṣyakāreṇa sūryodayāta pūrva- magnihotrahomākaraṇe prāyaścittadvayamāmudāhṛtam, tat ' rūpaṃ kālo'nunivāpo devatā śrapaṇaṃ tathā |
ādye ve viddhatāḥ pakṣāste sarvadā smṛtāḥ ||
' iti chandoga- pariśiṣṭānusārat anuditahomināṃ kālatikramanimitta- doṣanidhārtārthatveopapatteḥ, itarathā uditahomināṃ sarvadā
yadapi pārthasārathinā ' minne juhoti ' ityādyudāhṛtam, tadapi ṛtvikkapāla- medananimittavaiguṇyaśamanādyarthatvopapatteḥ dvitīyaprāyaści- tālilanācca upekṣitam |
' samuccayasaṃbhave ca bādhavikalpau, na saṃbhavati samuccayaḥ |
yadyapi śābdikaiḥ ' pratyekamekakriyanvayaḥ samuccayaḥ ' iti viśeṣato'sau lakṣitaḥ; tathāpi mīmāṃsakavyavahāraḥ sāhityasāmānya eva dṛśyate |
' pareṇāvedanāt ' (5|1|129) ityatra hi samuccayapramāṇābhāvo'pi aikārthyavat vikalpaheturuktaḥ |
na ca prayājādiṣu pratyekaṃ ekasyāḥ darśapūrṇamāsakriyāyāḥ anyo'sti |
grahaikatvādhikaraṇe (3|1|13-16) hi vārtikakṛtā pratyekavākyaparisamāpti-samudāyavākya- parisamāptinyāyayoḥ evaṃ viṣayabheda uktaḥ :- prādhānye pūrvaḥ, guṇatve tu uttaraḥ |
yathā ' ahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi ' ' aruṇa- yaikahāyinyā krīṇāti ' iti |
prayogavidhau ca prayājā- derguṇatvāt na pratyekaṃ ekakriyā'nyo'sti, asti ca samuccayapramāṇavyavahāraḥ iti sāhityasāmānye eva mīmāṃsakānāṃ samuccayavyavahāraḥ siddhaḥ |
so'yaṃ samuccayo'pi vikalpavat prathamaṃ tāvat trividhaḥ; nyāyagamyo vācanikaḥ : aicchikaśceti |
tatra nyāyagamyaḥ samuccayo vikalpavat nāṣṭavidhaḥ; dravyādīnāṃ tadabhāvānāṃ ca samuccayāyogāt |
nāpi caturvidha evāsau jātyoḥ dravyayoḥ guṇayoḥ kriyayośceti, kiṃtu sajātīya- vijātīyaviṣayatvena dvikatrikacatuṣkaviṣayatvena ca pañcadaśavidhaḥ : samuccayaḥ |
tatra sajātīyaviṣayasyaiva trividha dravyayoḥ jātiguṇayoḥ jātikriyayoḥ, dravyaguṇayoḥ dravya- kriyayoḥ, guṇakriyayośceti |
(1) nyāyagamyo jātyoḥ samuccayo yathā - ' nirmanyenekā- kryakyāt tatraiva gavājādīnāṃ nyāyena samuccayaḥ sādhito dvādaśe ' krayaṇepu tu vikalpaḥ syādekārthatvāt ' ityadhikaraṇe (12|14|13) ||

(2) nyāyagamyo dravyayoḥ samuccayo yathā, āghāne ' saṃbhārān saṃbharati ' ityatra saṃbhriyante iti saṃbhārāḥ iti saṃbhāraśabdasya yaugikatvena, ' pari- dhīn paridadhāti ' ityatra ca paridhīyate agniḥ tadā- yatanaṃ vā ye iti, pari samantāt dhīyante iti vā paridhiśabdasya yaugikatvena dravyavācitvāt ' saṃkhyā- yukteṣu tu samuccayaḥ ' iti dvādaśādhikaraṇāyāt (12|14|14|30) |
' tāṃ caturbhirabhirādadhate ' ityatra mantrasamuccayāt uktāt āghāne darśapūrṇa- māsayośca parīṇāṃ samuccayaḥ iti ||

(3) nyāyagamyo guṇayoḥ samuccayo yathā ' aruṇyā ekahāyinyā ' ityatra aruṇādhikaraṇanyāyena (3|1|12) ' ekaikasyā- niyamaḥ syāt ' ityanena āruṇyasya ekahāyinyasaṃkha- yośca anyonyaniyamataḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(4) nyāyagamyaḥ kriyayoḥ samuccayo yathā, ekādaśe hi ' aṅgānāṃ tu śabdabhedāt ' ityādidvādaśasūtre dvitīya'dhikaraṇe (vārtikamatena adhikaraṇasya pañcadaśasūtrakatvam |
11|1| 215-19) prayājānuyājādīnāṃ vikalpaḥ, aṅgatvasye phalabhūtatvaṃ veti pūrvapakṣadvayaṃ nirasya eka- prayogavidhiceyatvāt samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā dvādaśe ' krayaṇepu tu ' (12|14|13) ityatra saṃnipātikya- samuccayau nyāyagamya uktaḥ |
tathā dvādaśe ' samuccaya- svadoṣanidhārtārtheṣu ' ityadhikaraṇe (12|16|17) naimittikakratvaṅgakriyāsamuccayo nyāyagamya uktaḥ ||

(5) nyāyagamyo jātidravyayoḥ samuccayo yathā ' aruṇyaikahāyinyā piṅgākṣyā gavā somaṃ krīṇāti ' iti gopadamānāti iti ākuladhikaraṇe ' adṛśyavadatvāt ' (12|13|131) iti sūtravyākhyāne vārtikakṛtā uktam |
tatra ekahāyinīpiṅgākṣīśabdābhyāṃ yaugikāmyāṃ uktasya dravyasya gośabdenoktāyataḥ aruṇādhikaraṇa- nyāyena samuccayaḥ ||
(6) jātiguṇayopi samuccayaḥ yathā - ' nirmanyenekā- pacanti ' iti |
nahi aruṇādhikaraṇe (3|1|12) niyamyamānasya svaśabdenopādānaṃ nyāyaśarīrāntargatam, kiṃtu yathākathaṃcit upādānamapekṣate |
tena nirmanyaśabdavihi- tāyā mathanakriyāyāḥ pākāśitāyāścamiśritairekakarmāt aruṇyānyāyenaiva samuccayaḥ iti ||
(8) nyāyagamyo dravyaguṇayoḥ samuccayo yathā - ekahāyinīpiṅgākṣīśabdābhyā- mabhihitasya dravyasya āruṇyasya ca samuccayaḥ ||
(9) nyāyagamyo dravyakriyayoḥ samuccayo yathā - nirmanya- śabdena yaugikena dravyopādānāt tasya mathanakriyāyāśca anyonyaniyamataḥ aruṇyānyāyenaiva samuccayaḥ ||
(10) nyāyagamyo guṇakriyayoḥ samuccayo yathā - ' lohi- toṣṇīṣā lohitavasanā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti ' iti |
atra hi vastate paridhīyate tat vastraṃ iti yaugiko'yaṃ vasanaśabdo nirmanyavat na vastrajātivacanaḥ |
tathā sati uṣṇīṣāpi vastrātvāt lohitavasanā ityanenaiva siddhe lohitoṣṇīṣā ityanarthakaṃ syāt |
tataśca nirmanyaśabdeneva vasanaśabdenoktāyāḥ paridhānakriyāyāḥ lohitaguṇasya ca pracaranti ityeva kriyāyāścākārāt aruṇyānyāyenaiva samu- ccayaḥ ||
evaṃ jātidravyaguṇānāṃ, jātidravyakriyāṇāṃ, jāti- guṇakriyāṇāṃ, dravyaguṇakriyāṇāṃ iti trikaviṣayāścatvāraḥ, catuṣkaviṣayaśca iti pañcānāṃ nyāyagamyasamuccayabhedā- nāmudāharaṇāni vācyāni |
ta ete pañcadaśa nyāyagamyasamuccayabhedāḥ kratvarthajātyādiṣvidhā etadādṛṣṭāḥ |
(1) tatra puruṣārthayorjāntyogyanyāyagamyaḥ samuccayo yathā - manuḥ - ' tilairhīyavaimāpairdvirmūlaphalena vā |
dalena māsaṃ prīyante vidhivat pitaro nṛṇām ||
atra hi hrīyavairiti dvaṃdopāttaṃ saṃcitya jātidvayaṃ prakṛtaśrāddhādi phale vidhīyate |
bhūditi dvaṃdvayaṃ svīkṛtaṃ iti nātra samuccayo vidhikisata iti pratīyate|
(2) puruṣārthadravyayoḥ nyāya- gamyaḥ samuccayo yathā-- mārkaṇḍeyaḥ- 'bhakṣyobhyastu saṃskṛtaiḥ' 'rāgalāṇḍavacoṣaiśca' 'dattastu māṃsaṃ priyante śrāddheṣu pitaro nṛṇām' iti|
atra hemādriṇā vyākhyātam -dantarekhalakhaṇḍaṃ yad bhujyate tad bhakṣyam|
yattu anati- kāṭhinyādatiprayatnavatkhaṇḍanānapekṣaṃ carvyataiva nigīryate tad bhojyam|
yasya oṣṭhadanḍarasanādibhirnippīḍitasya sasatkāreṇa mukhamāstena raso nippīyate tat coṣyam|
tatra' bhakṣya-bhojya-coṣyāśabdāḥ uttārthaviśeṣavacanebhyo dhātumyaḥ kṛtpratyaye kṛte niṣpatteryaugikatvāt dravyavacanāḥ|

rāgalāṇḍavaśabdau tu rūḍhyāpi kulālādiśabdavat ākṛ- tyadhikaraṇaviṣayatvāt rūḍhyaiva upādhiviśiṣṭadravyavacanau iti dravyāṇamevātra dvaṃdvapāṭhānāṃ prakṛtaśrāddhāśritānāṃ phale nyāyagamyaḥ samuccayo iti|
(atra kuṃ bhūmitaṃ mṛttikāṃ lalayati saṃskārairniṣedhyāditi iti yaugikatvena kulāla- śabdo dravyavacana iti yuktaṃ pratīmaḥ- ke|
(3) puruṣārthayogaguṇayoḥ: nyāyagamyaḥ samuccayo yathā- vāyu- purāṇe- 'snigdhamuṣṇaṃ ca yo dadyādagnihomaphala labhet' iti|
na ca śabdadarśanāt vācaniko'yaṃ samuccaya iti abhitavyam, aikārthyābhāvāt, ekavākyo- pādānādeva samuccayasiddhau caśabdasyānuvādatvāt|
na ca snigdhoṣṇaśabdau dravyavācī, lohitoṣṇīṣādivat aprāptaguṇasyaiva vidhānāt|
(4) puruṣārthakriyāsamuccayo nyāyagamyo yathā- 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti|
atra hi yajiṣaikaśabdopādānāt āgneyādīnāṃ sāhityaṃ phale vivakṣitaṃ ityekādaśādhye sādhitam ||
(5) puruṣārthayoḥ jātidravyayoḥ: nyāyagamyaḥ samuccayo yathā-- padmapurāṇe- 'saṃvatsaraṃ tathā gavyaṃ payaḥ pāyasa- meva ca' iti|
atrāpi caśabdo'nuvādaḥ, ekavākyo- pādānena nyāyādeva samuccayasiddheḥ|

na ca bhinnapado- pātyayoḥ payaḥpāyasayoḥ vidhau vākyabhedaḥ; indriyakāmā- dhikaraṇe (2|1|11) guṇaphalasaṃbandhavidhau bhāvanā- ntaravidhivyabhyupagamane ubhayaviśiṣṭaphalabhāvanāvidhānāt avākyabhedatā ||
(6) puruṣārthayoḥ: jātiguṇayoḥ: nyāya- gamyaḥ samuccayo yathā- 'lādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kurvīta' iti|
ihāpi hi lādiraprātipadikopāttayā jātyā ekavacanaupāttayā caikatvasaṃkhyeyā viśiṣṭaṃ yat ekaṃ karaṇakārakaṃ dvitīyāvakṣitaṃ tadiśiṣṭā ekā phalabhāvanā vidhīyate|
tatra khadirastajāteḥ ekatvasaṃkhyāśra ekapadopādānāt 'paśunā yajeta' itivat samuccayaḥ ||
(7) jātidravyayoḥ: puruṣārthayoḥ: samuccayo yathā- (8) puruṣārthayoḥ: dravyaguṇayoḥ: nyāyagamyaḥ samuccayo yathā- 'godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet' iti|
atrāpi hi lādirapadavat yaugikodadohana- prātipadikoktena dravyeṇa ekavacanaupāttayā caikatva- saṃkhyayā viśiṣṭamekaṃ karaṇakārakaṃ phale vidhīyate|
śabdena caśabdasamānārthena prāpte ādye samuccaya vidhīyate |
(7) kṛtyarthātirikriyāsamuccayo vācaniko yathā-- śākhalilato- 'tatastalimaistaiḥ śākaiḥ pūpaiḥ kṛśarapāyasāpūpairlabhyabhaikṣaḥ pānairmadhunā ghṛtena payasā ca prabhūtamiṣṭamannaṃ dadyāt' iti |
atra nirmanthyaśabdava payasā śṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ iti śrutāthadvitīyāpattā śrapaṇakriyā payaādijātiśca caśabdena prāpte ādye samuccaya vidhīyate |
(8) kṛtyarthadravyaguṇasamuccayo vācaniko yathā-- brahmapurāṇe- 'pūrikāṃ ca rasālaṃ ca gokṣīraṃ ca niyojayet |
atra rasālāśabdaḥ kulālaśabdavat rūḍho'pi na jātivacanaḥ |

yathā 'saubhare puruṣa- śrutinidhane kāmasaṃyogaḥ' (2|2|12|8) ityatra 'hīṣ iti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt, ūrdhvaṃ ityanyā- kāmāya, ū iti svargākāmāya' iti saubharaphalamyo vṛṣṭyādimyo bhinnāni hīṣādinidhanāni iti pūrvapakṣe, yadā dhṛṣṭyarthaṃ saubharaprayogaḥ tadā vṛṣṭyantarārthe hīṣnidhana- prayogaḥ anarthakaḥ iti |
na tu etādṛśī aihikādi- bhedabhinnasarvapaśukāmanā lokataḥ siddhā'sti |
anyathā citreṣṭyā- derapi punaḥprayogo na syāt, evaṃ svargārthakarmaṇāma- pīti ||

(6) puruṣārthajātiguṇasamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kurvīta' iti jyotiṣṭomā- ṅgāgnīṣomīyapaśvūpaprāptikhaladiranāteḥ, vīryaphalārthayāḥ 'yadi kāmayīta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāccihneḥ sado minuyāt' iti dhṛṣṭyarthaṃ nīceḥ parimāṇasya ca ubhaya- kāmanāyāḥ samuccayaḥ ||

(7) puruṣārthajātikriyāsamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'āhāryapurīṣa paśū- kāmasya vediṃ kuryāt' ityāhāryapurīṣajāteḥ 'ekaviṃśati- manuṣyātpratiṣṭhākāmasya' iti ca anuvacanāntarātkriyāyāḥ ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||

(8) puruṣārthadravyaguṇasamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - 'godohanena paśukamasya praṇayet' iti godohanadravyasya 'vatsa- jānuṃ paśukamasya vediṃ kuryāt' iti vatsajānvākārasya avayavasaṃyogataḥ tatparimāṇasya vā guṇasya paśuphalārtha vihitasya ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(9) puruṣārthadravyakriyāsamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - godohanesya ekaviṃśatyanuvacanasya ca ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(10) puruṣārthaguṇakriyā- samuccaya aicchiko yathā - vatsajānvākārasya ekaviṃśatya- nuvacanasya ca ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(11) puruṣārthajātidravyaguṇakriyā aicchikaḥ samu- ccayo yathā - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āhāryapurīṣa-godohana- vatsajānvākārāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ paśuyakāmanāyāṃ samuccaya aicchikaḥ ||
(12) puruṣārthajātidravyakriyātrikasya aicchikaḥ samuccayo yathā - āhāryapurīṣa-godohana- ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ paśudravya-pratiṣṭhākāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(13) puruṣārthajātiguṇakriyātrikasya aicchikaḥ samuccayo yathā - āhāryapurīṣa-vatsajānvā- kāra-ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ paśudravya-pratiṣṭhākāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(14) puruṣārthadravyaguṇakriyā- (trika) samuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - godohana-vatsa- jānvākāra-ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ paśudravya-pratiṣṭhākāma- nāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(15) puruṣārtha- catuṣṭayasamuccayo yathā - āhāryapurīṣa-godohana-vatsa- jānvākāra-ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ caturṇāṃ paśudravya- pratiṣṭhākārūpaphalacatuṣṭayakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
tadevaṃ nyāyagamyāḥ triṃśat, vācanikāḥ triṃśat, aicchikāḥ triṃśat iti navatisamuccayabhedā uktāḥ |

kecit prakṛtau upadiṣṭapadārtha- viṣayāḥ, kecit vikṛtau upadiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit prakṛtivikṛtyātmakamopadiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit vikṛtau atidiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit vikṛtāveva upadiṣṭātidiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ iti |
tatra ādyodāharaṇaṃ yathā - kraye gavāraṇyādīnāṃ ṛyāṇāṃ ca jyotiṣṭome darśapūrṇamāsayośca adoṣaniṣṭhātārthaprāyaścittānām |
dvitīyodāharaṇaṃ yathā - daśapeye 'śataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ somaṃ bhakṣayanti' ityupadiṣṭāyāḥ brāhmaṇajāteḥ 'daśadaśa ekaikaṃ camasamunasarpanti' ityupadiṣṭāyāḥ śatasaṃkhyāyāśca samuccaya iti ||
tatrāpi bhāṣya- kṛnmate tāsāṃ āghāne samuccayo vācanikaḥ 'saṃvatsare nirvapet, dvādaśa rātriṣu, sadyo vā' iti |
vārtika- kṛnmate'pi aṅgatvāt prākaraṇikaḥ tāsāmeva tisṛṇāṃ anyonyam 'agraye pavamānāya, amaye pāvakāya,
caturthodāharaṇaṃ yathā - 'saṃsave ume kuryāt' 'gosave ume kuryāt' 'apacitavāpi ekāhe ume bṛhadrathaṃtare kuryāt' iti ||
pañcamodāharaṇaṃ yathā - saṃsthā'dhikaraṇe (3|6|16) saṃsthāpayoḥ 'aindrāgnamukthe dvitīyam' iti ukthādikkṛtau upa- diṣṭasya aindrāgneḥ, atidiṣṭasya savanīyasya samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā daśame 'deṣye cāyodanād dakṣiṇāpanayaḥ syāt' ityadhikaraṇe (10|2|16|46) prākṛtavaikṛtadakṣiṇāsamuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā 'naimittike tu kāryatvāt prakṛte syādapatteḥ' ityadhikaraṇe (10|2| 30|70) vāyavyādipaśau upadiṣṭaśvetaguṇasya prākṛtā- jādijāteśca samuccaya uktaḥ |

tathā 'barhirdiṣṭasyeti' ityadhikaraṇe (10|3|14|23-29) amau 'ākṛti- magnim' ityādayaḥ 'ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayati' iti dīkṣayateyā upadiṣṭāḥ ṣaṇmanatrāḥ atidiṣṭairdīkṣayatiḥ 'ākṛtyai prayuje- 'maye' ityādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ mantraiḥ saha samuccīyante, 'dvādaśa juhoti' iti dīkṣā''hutiviṣaye ityuktam |
tathā 'yajuryuktaḥ' (10|3|12|174) ityadhikaraṇe vājapeye 'yajuryuktaṃ rathamadhvaryave dadāti' iti yajuryukte- nopadiṣṭena atidiṣṭasyādhvaryabhāgasya samuccayaḥ ityu- ktam |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe (10|4|1) nakṣatreṣṭī 'so'nna juhoti' ityupadiṣṭānāṃ upahomānāṃ ati- diṣṭānāṃ ca nāriṣṭahomānāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe bṛhaspatisavadau 'bārhaspatyaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti grahāntarasya upadiṣṭasya atidiṣṭānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ samuccaya ityuktam |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe vājapeye upadiṣṭānāṃ prājāpatyapaśūnāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ ca saṃsthāpanānāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe sāṃgrahaṇyāmupa- diṣṭānāṃ trayāṇāṃ āmanahomānāṃ atidiṣṭaiḥ trimiranyaiḥ saha samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā 'upayeṣu' ityadhikaraṇe (10|4|18-9) gavāmayane mahāvrate 'dikṣu dundubhayo nadanti' iti prakṛtya 'palya upagāyanti' ityupadiṣṭānāṃ palīnāmatidiṣṭaiḥ upagātṛbhiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ samuccayaḥ uktaḥ ||
tathā 'saṃskāre ca' ityadhikaraṇe (10|4|16|10-12) añjanābhyañjane 'gaugulavena prātaḥsavane'bhyañjate' ityupadiṣṭagaugulavābhyañjanasya ati- diṣṭanavanītābhyañjanena saha samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe (10|4|13-15) mahāvrate 'tāvyaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte' ityupadiṣṭasya tāvyasya atidiṣṭasya cāhatasya samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe (10| 4|16-17) mahāvrate eva upadiṣṭaśrokādisāmānāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ ca gāyatrādīnāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā 'stomaviṣṭhaddhau' ityadhikaraṇe (10|4|19|20) 'dvā- triṃśat pavamāno'midheyanīyaḥ' ityādiṣvupadiṣṭānāṃ rājasānāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ ca samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā dvādaśe (12|1|4|18) 'gudenopajati' iti prati- pattatvāt paśugaṇe anekeṣāṃ gudānāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ ||
atra ye kecidanye samuccayabhedā dṛśyante yathā dvādaśokaḥ (12|1|2|3-4 varṇake 2 vi.) yājyā- nuvākyayoḥ samuccayaḥ ||
yathā vā dvādaśokaḥ eva (12|1|3|4|30) 'tāṃ caturbhirabhimādatte' ityādī mantrasamuccayaḥ ||
yathā vā agnihotre agnissūryaprajā- patīnāṃ devatānāṃ samuccayaḥ ||
yathā vā jyotiṣṭome prākaraṇikagrahaṇasamuccayāt arthāt siddho yāge anaṅga- bhūtānāmapi indrādyādīnāṃ samuccayaḥ |

taduktaṃ paśu- somādhikaraṇe (12|1|16-20) vārtike 'devatā- nāmanyasaṃyuktatvāt akriyārūpatvācca na prakaraṇena yāgārthatvaṃ vijñāyate (vā. pṛ. 519) iti yāgāṅga- sambandhaṃ pratipadyante iti prasaṅgopakāritvena yāgā- nyamātraṃ upakrame uktam |
upasaṃhāre'pi 'taddeśena devatānāmapi samuccayasiddhiḥ' (vā. pṛ. 519) ityevopasaṃhṛtaṃ nāṅgatvam |
someśvareṇa tu upasaṃhāravārtikaṃ aṅgatvapara- tayā vyākhyātam |
yathā vā satre 'caturviṃśatiparamāḥ saptadaśavārāḥ satramāsīran' iti kartṛsamuccayaḥ ||
yathā vā ādhvarye yājamāne ca kāṇḍe darśapūrṇamāsayo- rāmnāteṣu 'vājasya mā prasavena' ityādimantreṣu sāmā- khyānikartṛdvayasamuccayaḥ |

yathā vā jāteṣṭau naimittikatvānyā'''nuṣaṅgikatvitasya pratyayaparihārarūpābhāvātmakasya phalasya arthādikena pūtattvarūpāpasārakatvābhāvena saha bhāvātmakaiśca taistvittha-anvādyatva-indriyāvitva-paśumattvarūpaiḥ phalaiḥ saha teṣāmapi vā anyonyaṃ samuccayaḥ |
yathā vā svargādikābhyastvaṃ vividhārthe vā anuṣṭhite- ragnihotrādibhiḥ prasaṅgāt nityaprayogaphalasiddhau phala- samuccayaḥ |

yathā vā dvādaśe 'ekakarmaṇi śiṣṭatvād guṇānāṃ sarvakarma syāt' (12|3|16) ityatroktaḥ 'ṛjumādhārayati, ūrdhvamādhārayati, dīrghamādhārayati, saṃtatamādhārayati' iti vihitān ṛjutva-ūrdhvatva- dīrghatva-saṃtatatvānāṃ caturṇāmādhāre samuccayaḥ |
yathā vā 'svāṣṭaṃ pāranīvatamālabheta', 'agmaye'nīkavate prātarahāpālaṃ nirvapet', 'agnaye dātre puroḍāśamahā- kapālaṃ nirvapet', 'viṣṇave śipa
nadyapṛthakkṛte mīko. pṛ 2627 'paurṇamāsīnyāyaḥ' ityatra adhi- yāgaḥ saṃpravartate |
ato nirvāpe yaḥ pratyayaḥ, sa karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
muddiśyanayoḥ sāmānādhi- samudāyānudāpavādaḥ adhikaraṇatrayeṇa (2|1 karaṇyadāttaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
'caturo muṣṭīnnirvepati' bhāṣyam- sarvāṇi tu parisamāpya anuṣṭheyāt atra caturṇāṃ muṣṭīnāmekaḥ samudāyaḥ |
sāṃnāyye tu upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayostantratvāt dadhno dvāva- dānaṃ gṛhītvā payaso grāhyam |
kalpasūtreṣu tu payaso dvadānaṃ gṛhītvā paścāddhana ityuktaṃ tattirīyaśrutau tādṛśakramasya vācanikatvāt |
evaṃ ajñāmyajñavanapanapāneṣvapi tattadvidhisattvāccaikena netreṇa śarīrarāvayavena vāḍanusamayaḥ |
api tvanekayajamānake ahīne ekatra netradvaye'pyañjanaṃ kṛtvā yajamānāntare tatkāryaṃ sarvathāvayopetābhyañjanādinā caṃ pratyekamanusamayam |
satre tu 'adhvaryugṛhapati dīkṣa- yitvā' ityādinā tattatsaṃskārakadīkṣottarakālatvavidhā- nāt kāṇḍānusamaya eva |
samudāyapūrvāpūrva aṅgāpūrva pradhānāpūrve paramāpūrva iti apūrvāvāntarabhedāḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayorvibhinnakālavartitanoḥ samudāyadvaya- janyamapūrvadvayaṃ kalpyate, tacca dvayaṃ phalāpūrvajanakam |
bhavati hi bahūnāṃ ekavacanāntaḥ śabdaḥ samu- dāyāpekṣaḥ |
yathā yūyaṃ vayaṃ kulaṃ pariṣad iti |
samudāyāmījyā pārvaṇo homo, na kālā- bhījyā |
bhā. 9|2|8|51-56. samudāyatvāpādanaṃ ekaśabdasyogāt samudāyā- nuvādarūpeṇa vā bhavati, yathā— 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇa- māsīṃ yajate' iti |
phalādisaṃbandhena vā yathā 'rāja- sūyena svārājakāmaḥ' iti |
vā. 2|2|12 pṛ. 463. samudāyaprayuktaṃ— paurṇamāsī-amāvāsyāsamudāya- prayuktaṃ nāmidharmāṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kiṃtvapūrvaprayuktam |
1 9|1|5|19-19. mīko. pṛ. 2902. samudāyaprasiddhiḥ avayavaprasiddheḥ bādhikaiva samadhigatā |
samudāyaprasiddhisattra bhavati yatrāvayavārtho tirodhāya tyakbhedaḥ samudāya eva pratīyate |
vā. 3|2|1|1 pṛ. 747. samudāyaprasiddheḥ nāvayavaprasiddhyā bādhyate ityuktameva |
bhā. 6|8|0|42,43. samudāya- prasiddheḥ labdhātmikā avayavaprasiddhaṃ bādhyate |
vā. 2|2|1|17 pṛ. 421, samudāyaprasiddhyā ava- yavasiddheḥ nirākaraṇāt |
ahīnaśabdaḥ ahaṃgaṇavācakaḥ na tu na hīnaḥ ahīnaḥ iti vyutpatyā jyotiṣṭomārthakaḥ |
vākyārthavat avayavārtho samucciya saṃbandhaṃ kalpayitvā sā (avayavārthaprasiddheḥ) mavantī śrutimātropanipātalambhāyāḥ samudāyaprasiddherlabhatā |
labdhātmikā hi samudāyaprasiddheḥ avayava- prasiddhiṃ bādhate |
tasyāstu ātmātmabho yatra pramāṇāntareṇa pūrvānubhūtāvayavārtharahite'rthe śabdaprayogo dṛśyate yathā aśvatvakarṇatvarahite vṛkṣe aśvakarṇaśabdasya |
1|4|8| 11 pṛ. 344, samudāyaprasiddheḥ avayavaprasiddhito balīyastvaṃ rathakārādhikaraṇe (6|1|12|44-50) vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 466. samudāyaprasiddhau saṃmavantyāṃ nāvayavaprasiddheḥ prātipadikasya yuktā, udgātrāṃ ityatra |
vāla. pṛ. 165. samudāyavācī ca nāvayave pravartitumarhati |
bhā. 11|4|2|3-1 pṛ. 356. samudāya- vācināṃ ekadeśeṣu na gauṇatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
tathā ca adhyetāra- statraiva sutarāṃ prayukte 'vedamadhīmahe', 'vedo vartate' iti |
su. pṛ. 779. samudraṇa prāduṣkaraṇaṃ vā amīnāṃ pratikarma araṇībhyāmiti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
yathā samuda āpaḥ gaṅgāmaṃdāgodāvarīkṛṣṇākāverī- sindhvādimahānadīnāṃ nānāmukhebhyaḥ samāgatāḥ |

nānāvidhavarṇarasagandhaphalavatyaḥ svīyayajñanīlavarṇa- pītādivarṇaviśeṣam, madhura''tmakatayādirasa- viśeṣam, parimalapūyādigandhaviśeṣam, laghutvagurutvā- diguṇaviśeṣamekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṣṭhādyanadaśaśatakṛccha- samānapuṇyaviśeṣam, tattannāmaviśeṣaṃ ca parityajya samudra- bhāvemeva gacchanti, samudra prāpya tatsaṃbandhamahimnā nāmarūpaguṇaviśeṣaiḥ samudrānna bhidyante ityarthaḥ |
'samudrādudakātmanaḥ ananyatve'pi taddhikārāṇāṃ phenavīcītaraṅgabudbudādīnāṃ itaretaravibhāgaḥ itaretaralepādi lakṣaṇaśca vyavahāraḥ upalabhyate |

na ca samudrādudakātmanaḥ ananyatve'pi taddhikārāṇāṃ phenataraṅgādīnāṃ itaretarabhāvāpattirbhavati, na ca teṣāmitaretarabhāvānāpattāpi samudrāt anyatvaṃ bhavati' anena nayena bhoktṛbhogyayoḥ brahmaṇaḥ ana- nyatve'pi na teṣāmitaretarabhāvāpattiḥ, na ca parasmāt brahmaṇaḥ anyatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yathā manasi samudra- tvadhyānamarthāya tathā svargakāmanāyā guṇatvena vidhāne adṛṣṭārthaṃ syāt |
yatra kriyā niṣphalā tatraivāsya pravṛttiriti bhāvaḥ |
'upahvayasva' iti pṛṣṭvā 'upahūtaḥ' ityukte bhakṣaṇaṃ somadharmaḥ vājinasya surāyāśca |
atheteṣāṃ navānāmahnāṃ aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, athāgrayaṇā- gram |
yatra aindra- vāyavāgratvaśukrāgratvāgrayaṇāgratvānīti triḥ parivartamānānāṃ samūhena asti kramabhaṅgo nāsti sa samūḍhaḥ dvādaśāhaḥ |
yatra tu uktāpratvānāṃ vyutkrameṇa āvṛttiḥ sa vyūhaḥ |
ku. 10|1|2|4|79, yathā tarhi siddhāntaḥ, yatra vacanaṃ liṅgaṃ ca tatra vyūhaḥ pravartate, anyatra aviśeṣeṇa samūḍhaḥ iti |
10|1|2|4|80. samūḍhasya vyūho dvādaśāho 'dvādaśāho vyūhaḥ : samūḍhasya vikāraḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
yatra upasthitapadārthānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenānavyāsabhavastatra upasthitapadārthānāṃ samūhālambaneva bodhaḥ |
yathā— ghaṭaḥ paṭaścetyādau ghaṭa- paṭayoreva viśeṣyatvā, samūhālambane bodhe ca viśeṣyaḥ |
tādṛśam, saṃśaye tvekā viśeṣyateti bhedaḥ : sāhasī.
ekadā kṛtsnānuṣṭhānam, punaḥ kṛtsnasya, punaḥ kṛtsneti kṣetramāpane daṇḍasyevāvṛttiḥ prathamā|
prapāṭhakādhyayane tu ekaṃ vākyaṃ satvāramāvṛtya, dvitīyaṃ vākyaṃ satvāram, evaṃ tṛtīyamiti prapāṭhakasamāptiparyanta- māvṛtyai sā dvitīyā (sā, guṃḍikā- iti marāṭhī- bhāṣāyām|
ātmarakṣaṇārthameva (varṇa- saṃkarānt) rājabhirbrāhmaṇaiśca svapitṛpitāmahādipāraṃparyā- visaraṇārthaṃ samūhalekhyāni pravartitāni|
tathā ca prati- kulaṃ guṇadoṣasmaraṇāttadanurūpāḥ pravṛttinivṛttyo dṛśyante|
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ patnīsaṃyājeṣu agniṃ gṛhapatimiṣṭvā 'saṃ patnī patyā sukṛtena|
' iti suveṇa gārhapatye saṃpatnīyaṃ juhoti patnyāṃ samanvā- rabdhāyām|
ṭup. 10|3|12|150. saṃpradānaṃ ca nāma karmaṇo'pi īpsitatamāt abhi- pretataram|
bhā. 9|1|4|6. pratigrahe vyāptaṃ ca kārakaṃ saṃpradānaṃ bhavati|
saṃkapai. 2|4|2. saṃpradāne caturthī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyogaśrutiḥ yathā 'maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati'|
vāla. pṛ. 44, saṃpradāne ṣaṣṭhī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyogaśrutiḥ yathā 'puruṣamṛgaścandramase godhā-kālakā-dārvaghāṭāste vanaspatīnām'|
su. pṛ. 52. saṃpradāyāt vedaṃ vyācakṣate yājñikāḥ|
śakrasaṃpravedhaḥ paścālbhasmya na prayojakaḥ kintu pratipattiḥ agnīṣomīye paśau|
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|12. saṃpravedhasya lopaḥ śakrataḥ abhāve nāśe vā|
prāyaścittaṃ tu lopanimittaṃ syāt agnīṣomīye paśau|
vā. 2|1|1|1 pṛ. 376. saṃbandhaḥ deśakālanimitta- phalasaṃskārāṇāṃ darśapūrṇamāsau vidhīyate|
vi. 2|3|12. saṃbandhaḥ pradhānena, na guṇena ityutsargaḥ|
vā. 2|1| 12. saṃbandhaḥ yatra vidhīyate, tatra anyatarasyānyatra vidhānam|
yatrobhau lakṣaṇatvena tatra svasaṃbandhena saṃbandho vidhīyate|
yatra tu anyataro lakṣaṇatvena tatra ekaṃ lakṣayitvā anyataro vidhīyate|

bhā. 3|1|10|22. 'saṃbandho vidhīyamānaḥ saṃbandhinaṃ tāvadākṣipetū' iti vārtikoktanyāyena saṃbandhā- kṣisayoḥ saṃbandhinoḥ akriyāṅgatvena anuṣṭheyatvāt anuṣṭheyatvasiddhayai kriyātvena tayorapi vidhānāpattestulyo vākyabhedaḥ|
su. pṛ. 773, 'saṃbandho vidhīya- mānaḥ saṃbandhinaṃ tāvadākṣipetū'|
vākyāntaraprāpte yāge dravyadevatāsaṃbandhavidhau 'saṃbandho vidhīyamānaḥ' ityādyabhārābhidhāyakatvena vārtikoktanyāyena (vā. pṛ. 502 paṃ 22) dravyadevatāyorapi vivyāpattiḥ|
vā. 2|1|3|1 pṛ. 479, parākramaḥ 1. saṃbandhaḥ hi vidhīyamāno na śakyate saṃbandhinau avidhāya, 'vihitaḥ' iti vaktum|
bhā. 1|4|6|9. arthadvāre hi adhyāyādisaṃbandhaḥ na anyasvarūpā- dhayaḥ|
vā. 2|1|6|12 pṛ. 693. prasiddhasaṃbandho hi śaknoti lakṣayitum|
bhā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 715. saṃbandhau virodhinau tulyakakṣau parasparaṃ bādhayetāṃ na guṇapradhānabhūto|
vā. 3|4|1|2 pṛ. 901. na hi dvau saṃbandhau ekasmin vākye vidhīyete, miyeta hi tathā vākyam|
3|6|1|22 pṛ. 693. 'saṃbandhasyāśāstrahetutvāt' ('guṇādvā'pyamidhānaṃ syāt saṃbandhasyāśāstrahetutvāt') 3|2|12|14 iti nyāyena vedasya viśiṣṭatvaṃ śaktyaniniyāmakatvam|
vaiyadhikaraṇyena api yaji saṃbandhopapatteḥ (udbhidādiśabdasya) sāmānādhikaraṇyena yāgārthatvasya avagantumaśakyatvāt alaukikārthakalpanā pāribhāṣikī āpadyate|
sā ca saṃbandhasyāśāstrahetutvāt iti aindradadhikaraṇāsūtrāvayavena nirastātvāt ayuktā|
vā. 2|1|5|27 pṛ. 430. saṃbandhasya viśiṣṭārthapratīto nāntarīyaktvāt saṃbandhaśabdena lakṣaṇayā vaiśiṣṭyābhi- dhānam|
pṛ. 765, saṃbandhasya saṃbandhinirūpaṇādhīnani- rūpaṇasya saṃbandhinibhedana bhedaḥ|
pṛ. 704, saṃbandhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ 'na kriyākṛtasaṃbandhāhate saṃbandhaṃ kacita' iti nyāyena kriyāgarbhatvam|
pṛ. 463. saṃbhavati sākṣā- tsaṃbandhe paraṃparāsaṃbandho na grāhyaḥ|
ku. 3|1|6|12. saṃbandhāsiddhiḥ hetvābhāsaḥ, 'hetvābhāsāḥ' iti bindau draṣṭavyaḥ|
maṇi. pṛ. 41. nahi agṛhītayoḥ saṃbandhinoḥ saṃbandhagrahaṇaṃ saṃbhavati|
ratnākaraḥ anumāna ślo. 146. saṃbandhataḥ vyavasthitatā sphayādīnāṃ darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ|
bindu. 3|1|5|11. saṃbandhadvayakaraṇāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta prāpte karmaṇi|
ubhayaprāptau anubhayaprāptau vā saṃbandhavidhiḥ iti hi jāghanyādhikaraṇe uktam (3|3| 10)|
saṃbandhipadavyavāye'pi hi saṃbandhādeva pūrva- saṃskāro nāpaiti|
yatrāpi apareṇa sākṣāttvena vyavāyaḥ tatrāpyasti saṃbandhaḥ|
bhā. 2|1|9|6|48. saṃbandhiśabdāśca sarve sāpekṣāḥ vinā padāntareṇa na paripūrṇamarthaṃ abhivadanti|
tadyathā- saṃbandhaśabdāḥ- mātari vartitavyaṃ, pitari varti- tavyaṃ, śuśrūṣitavyamiti|
saṃbandhādabhyate- yā yasya mātā, yo yasya piteti 'ādirantyena sahetā' 1|1|71 iti sūtramahābhāṣye spaṣṭam|
sāhasī. 600. saṃbandhiśabdānāṃ pratisaṃbandhinaṃ apekṣamāṇā- mapi na sāmarthyavighāto bhavati, devadattasya gurukulaṃ itivat|
ratnākaraḥ pṛ. 347, saṃbandhiśabdānāṃ pratisaṃbandhivyatiriktārthāntarāpekṣāyāṃ bhavatyeva sāmarthya- vighātaḥ|
nahi bhavati śobhanasya gurukulaṃ iti śobhanasya guroḥ kule iti vivakṣā''pa|
ku. 1|2| 4|43 pṛ. 48. saṃbodhanaṃ cetane eva mukhyam|

rahasya. pṛ. 58, saṃbodhane abhimukhatvaṃ- prakṛtaśabdabodhā- śrayaprakārakaratvavibhaktiviśeṣatvakathañcidviṣayībhūta- śabdajñānavattvam, prakṛtaśabdabodhaniṣṭaviṣayatā nirūpita- vaktṛbhinnaviṣayatvakathañcidviṣayatāvataṃ vā|
vi-- 'saṃmārhi suca ityatra kiṃ pradhānākhya- karmatā |
guṇatvaṃ nahi saṃbhāvya prādhānyaṃ tu prayājavat |

bhāṭṭa-- 'vrīhīn prokṣati', 'suca: saṃmārṣṭi' ityādī hyeṣopakāratvasaṃbhavāt dvitīyāyāśca sādhya- tvavat karaṇatve'pi 'saktūn juhoti' 'makhvajān śikhaṇḍakān kuru' ityādī prayogadarśanāt pūrvādhi- karaṇapūrvapakṣavat arthakarmatvameva |
balavajjñānāṃ hi karote: dvikarmakatvāpatte: na sādhyatvam |
iti prāpte, 'karmaṇi, dvitīyā' ityanu- śāsanāt 'ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityādiprayogāt sādhyatvameva dvitīyārtha: na karaṇatvam |
karmatvaṃ ca 'karturīpsitatamaṃ karma' iti sūtrāt na īpsitatamatvarūpameva |
apitu 'tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam' iti sūtrāt īpsitānīpsitāsādhāraṇaṃ sādhyatvameva |
ataśca vrīhīṇāṃ dvitīyayā sādhyatvābhimānāt yāgā- dvaitatvābhāvena ca īpsitatvapratīte: taduddeśena prokṣaṇaṃ vidhīyate |
ata eva natra nopayoga: kalpata: na vā kalpa- yituṃ śakya: yathā saktuṣu, tatra dvitīyayā karaṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ aṅgīkṛtya saktuviśiṣṭahomasyaiva adṛṣṭārthe vidhānam |
na ca anīpsitakarmatvenāpi anvayopapatte: na karaṇatvalakṣaṇā iti vācyam |
tathā sati adṛṣṭopakārasyāpi bhāvanāyāṃ karmatvena anvayāvaśyaṃbhāve tasya dvikarmakatvāpattyā uddeśyānekanimittavākyabhedāpatte: |
ataḥ saktukaraṇaka- homasya ārādupakārakatve'pi prokṣaṇāde: saṃnipatyopa- kārakatvameva |
karotiparyāya- tvena pratīyanusāreṇa ca ekakarmakatvasya saṃmārgādhi- karaṇe sthāpitatvāt |
pavamāneṣṭaya: ādhānasiddheṣvapyagniṣu stottarabhāvitpayogitayā saṃmārgavat saṃskāra- viśeṣatvāt |

saṃmīlanaṃ vīkṣaṇaṃ ca- ryaṃtare sānni 'abhi tvā śūra.. īśānamasya jagata: ' iti bhāge gīyamāne netrasaṃmīlanaṃ kartavyam, 'svarhaśaṃ' ityādiśabdagānakāle tu vīkṣaṇaṃ kartavyam, 'ryaṃtare prastūyamāne saṃmīlayate, svardaśaṃ pratī vīkṣeta' |
samyagjaraṇārthatā- samyak pariṇata: śaknoti gātrāṇi prīṇayituṃ nāmeśrādhastāt agantuṃ iti samya- gjaraṇārthatā |
sarastvājyasya ājyabhāgāyāṃ prāptaṃ paurṇamāsatantraṃ āgneyavaṣadvādaśakapālasya aindrāgnidhikāratvāt amā- vāsyātantreṇa bādhyate adhvarakalpāyām |
sarastvājyasya upāṃśuyājavikārasya dharmā: paścāt, bārhaspatyasyāgneyavikārasya dharmāstu pūrve kāryā:, codakasya prayogavacanāt adhvarakalpāyāṃ balīyastvāt |
'yathā vā sarpasiddhānte nakulo yāṃ kile- ṣadhim |
kārye prāgabhāvapratiyogi, kāryaniyatapūrvavṛttikāraṇamiti sarve kāryajātaṃ ghaṭādiśānaṃ sakāraṇa mṛdādijñānapūrvakaṃ bhavati |
uktaṃ ca-- 'kāraṇaśanata: kāryavijñānaṃ cāpi so'vadat' iti |
uktaṃ ca-- 'bagatāṃ yadi no kartā kulālena vinā ghaṭa: |
citrakāraṃ vinā citraṃ svata eva bhavediti' |
sarva khalasya caritaṃ maśaka: karotīti nyāya: |
uktaṃ ca-- 'prākpadayo: patati khādati pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ karṇe karṇaṃ kimapi rauti śanairvicitram |
chidraṃ nirūpya sahasā praviśayaśalaka: sarva khalasya caritaṃ maśaka: karoti |

viśvāmitrasyāpi yat rāgadveṣapūrvakaṃmapi tapo- balāruḍhasya caritaṃ sat 'sarve balavata: pathyam' ityanena nyāyena mahānti ca tapāṃsi kṛtvā tāni kṣayaṃ nayata: uttarakālaṃ vā pāpaviśuddhi prāyaścittai: pratikurvāṇasya jīvayatyapi |
vyāsaviśiṣṭaviśvāmitrādīnāṃ tu tapobalena 'sarve balavata: pathyam' iti nyāyāt viruddhācaraṇe'pi na kṣati: |
kau. 1|3|147. sarve brahmaṇe pariharati ' ityatra brahmapadaṃ vidheyam |
yathā'vadhāraṇārthaka evakāralividha:-- (1) kriyā- nvita:, (2) viśeṣaṇānvita:, (3) viśeṣyānvitaśca |
tatra prathamasya atyantāyogavyavacchedo'rtha:, yathā nīla- mutpalaṃ bhavatyeveti |
dvitīyasya ayogavyavacchedo'rtha:, yathā śaṃkha: śveta (eva) iti pūrvaṃ uktamiti |
tṛtīyasya anyayogavyavacchedo'rtha:, yathā pārtha eva dhanurdhara ityevamantrāpi bodhyam |
yathā śaṃkha: śveta evetyartha:, evamanyatrāpi bodhyamiti |
'vrīhibhiryajeta' ityatra 'sarva viśeṣaṇaṃ sāvadhāraṇam' iti nyāyena viśeṣaṇasya anyayogavyavacchedakatvatayā vrīhirūpa- viśeṣaṇena taditaravyāvṛttyā itaranirapekṣatvamarthakam |
' iti nyāyena 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādicat 'la: karmaṇi 0' ityasyāpi 'hyekoyo:' ityādyekavākyatayāvaśyaṃbhāvāt |
sarve ime svabhūtyartha pravartate iti nyāya: |
tathāhi-- 'ye tāvadete guruśuśrūṣo nāma, te'pi svabhūtyarthaṃ pravartante, pāralaukikaṃ ca no bhaviṣyati, iha ca na: prīto gururvāpayiṣyatīti |
tathā ya ete dāsā: karmakarā nāma, te'pi svabhūtyarthaṃ pravartante, bhaktaṃ cailaṃ ca lapsyāmahe, parimāṣābha no bhaviṣyanti |
tathā ya ete śilpino nāma, ete'pi svabhūtyarthaṃ pravartante, mitrāṇi no bhaviṣyantīti vetanaṃ ca lapsyāmahe' iti |
sāhastrī. 626, 627, 628. oṃ sarve guṇāḥ kāñcanamāśrayantīti nyāyaḥ |
athavā ‘sarve tu’ ityavāntarapūrva- pakṣaṃ parigṛhya ‘karaṇādekadeśe syāt’ iti sūtrāntare stotrakāripakṣe niyoktavyam |
sāṃvatsarike cayane sarveṣāmapi āgneyīnāṃ ‘yadyaṇīnāmāgneyaṃ chandaḥ’ ityu- deśyakoṭī niveśanena viniyogāt ‘sarve tu vedasaṃyogāt karaṇādekadeśasya’ (3|4|126) iti nyāyāt |
iti cāturthika- nyāyena brīhādisādhanakāvaghātādidhiyāpi viśeṣaṇa- bhūtavrīhādidravyavidhernimeyārthatayā niyamādṛṣṭasya ava- jarnīyatvāt |
ku. 2|1|136. oṃ sarve vedā yatpadamāmanantīti nyāyaḥ |
yathā- sarvasyāpi śāstrasya mahattātparye nirviśeṣa eva brahmaṇīti paryavasitamiti |
sāhastrī. 524. oṃ ‘sarvān varṇān iṣṭakāsu’ iti rekhā- vādaḥ |
‘sarvān varṇān iṣṭakānāṃ kuryāt’ iti śrutaḥ varṇa- śabdaḥ śvetādirūpapara eva |
anyasamayetararūpāṇāṃ anyatra kartumaśakyatvādeva tādṛśavarṇasamāyasugirādidravya- lepaḥ ākṣepalabhyaḥ, na tu varṇaśabda eva tatparaḥ śabdasaṃyogāt iti sūtrasvarasāt |

iti prāpte, ‘ṛju- rekhāḥ paścācca purastācca nyālikhitā madhye’ ityantena nānārekhāvatīnāmiṣṭakānāṃ deśaviśeṣavidhānāt ‘sarvā- nvarṇān’ ityasya pāṭhena sarvavarṇaśabdasya pūrvaprakānta- vividharekhāparatvāvasāyāt sati tātparyagrahe tadanupapattyā lakṣaṇayā api nyāyyatayā yāvadiśeṣāṇāṃ viniyoga-

saṃskārasya sarvaprakṛtahavirvidhetvena sarvehaviṣāṃ ‘kāryate prayujyate anena’ iti vyutpattyā kāraṇaśabdoktasya prayojakatvasya avi- śeṣāt sarvebhyo havirbhyaḥ śeṣakāryāṇi kriyeran iti siddhāntaprayojanārthatvena suśrayojanā |
su. pṛ. 1440. oṃ ‘sarvebhyo vā kāraṇāviśeṣāt’ (3|4|15|44) ityasya atiprasaktasya apavādaḥ kriyate (‘ājyācca0. 3|4|15|44 ityādinā ) |
na ca vikalpamantareṇa sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ antaḥ karmādisaṃnipātaḥ kartuṃ śakyaḥ |
oṃ ‘sarvesya vā ṛtu- saṃyogādekatvād dakṣiṇāryasya guṇānāṃ cāyaikatvādarthe vikṛtau atibhūtaṃ syāt tatsamavāyo hi karmabhiḥ’ |
bhūnāgni ṛtau ‘dhenurdakṣiṇā’ ityuktvā ekyā dhenvā jyotiṣṭomīkīnāṃ gavāmeva nivṛttiḥ nādhyādīnāṃ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntaḥ |

kutaḥ ? ‘tasya viśvavataḥ stotriyāḥ’ iti tacchabdānupādena tasya bhūnāmnaḥ kratoḥ ‘dhenurdakṣiṇā’ iti kṛtsnaṛtusaṃyogāt vikṛtau bhūnāmni kratau prākṛte arthe dakṣiṇātmake kārye śrutito bhūtaṃ pratyakṣaśrutyā prāptaṃ dhenudvayaṃ ānumānikasarvadakṣiṇāvācakaṃ syāt |
nanu jyotiṣṭome bahudravyyānatānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ karma- saṃbandhāvagataḥ taddhikṛtau śuci api ekadravyāntānāṃ karmasaṃbandho na yuktaḥ |
tayā dakṣiṇayā ṛtvijāṃ karmasaṃbandhāvadhāra- ṇāt ekenāpi dravyeṇa dakṣiṇātvena śrutena ānatānāṃ karmasamavāye yukta ityarthaḥ |
nanu gavādidravyanyānāmānāntī bhedāt na gojyānatyarthaṃ vihitayā dhenvā aśvādinivṛttiryuktā ityāśaṅkya ‘ekatvāt dakṣiṇātvasya’ ityuktam |

ṛtvigā ntayupāyāpekṣāyāṃ ‘ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti’ ityānatisadhanavādivadikṣiṇāśabdasya dadālantyāt dakṣiṇāyāśca upādeyatvena vivakṣitaikasaṃkhyatvāt tada- rthasya pratyayasya ānamanasyāpi ekatvamityarthaḥ |
nanu ‘dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti’ ityekavacanaśravaṇe'pi ‘gauścāśvaśca’ ityādivākye dakṣiṇāsamuccayapratīteḥ tatraprayojanatimede'vasīyate ityāśaṅkya ‘guṇānāṃ cārthaikatvāt’ ityuktam |
caśabdena itaretarahaditā- nāmeva gavādīnāṃ dakṣiṇātvapratīteḥ ‘tasya dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā’ ityekavacanācca samucitānāmeva dakṣiṇātvam |
gavādīnāṃ uddeśyatvāt sāhityāvivākṣaṇātkanirāsāya upādeyatvalakṣaṇārthaṃ guṇaśabdenābhidhānaṃ dakṣiṇātvaṃ ca gavādīnāṃ pratyuddeśyaṃ iti jñāpayituṃ arthaśabdenoktam |
su. pṛ. 435. oṃ ‘sarveṣāmabhigamayavacanayathārthatve'ṭa- kāram’ iti vacanāt sahabhāvādānaṃ ‘indrāya rāśe ... indrāyādhirājāya indrāya svarāje’ ityatra |
vikṛtisomeṣu ‘kaustaṃ bhavati’, ‘kāṇvaṃ bhavati’ iti ekavacanāntena śabdena sāma śrutam |
‘vasiṣṭhasya janitre bhavataḥ’ ‘śuddhāśuddhīye bhavataḥ’ ‘bhargayaśasī bhavataḥ’ iti dvivacanāntena śabdena sāmāni śrutāni |
‘kaunbhāni bhavanti’ iti tu bahuvacanāntena śabdena sāmāni śrutāni |
tāsyeva vikṛtiṣu prākṛtanyapi gāyatrādīni sāmāni prāptāni |
vaikṛtāni tu teṣāṃ prākṛtānāṃ nivartakāni ityavagatam |

tatra kiṃ sarvāṇi sarveṣāṃ nivartakāni uta ekavacanāntaśabdo'pi ekasyaiva prākṛtasya nivartakam, dvivacanāntaśabdo dvayoḥ nivartake, bahuvacanāntaśabdo'pi bahūni bahūnāṃ prākṛtānāṃ iti svasaṃkhyāsamasaṃkhyākānāṃ sāmāni nivarta- kāni iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha- sarveṣāṃ prākṛtānāṃ sāmnāṃ sarvāṇi vaikṛtāni nivartakāni, aviśeṣāt viśeṣā- bhāvāt |
tasmāt sarve sarvasya nivartakaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
‘sarveśāmaviśeṣāt’ iti sūtreṇa prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartyantu siddhāntamāha |
kiṃtu ekasya prākṛtasya ekaṃ vaikṛtaṃ nivartakam, dvayoḥ he, bahūnāṃ bahūni iti niyamaḥ |
evaṃ sati prakṛtervikārāt prakṛteḥ prākṛtānāṃ codakaprāptānāṃ sāmnāṃ avikārāt vikāre bādho na bhavati |
tathā ca kautsena kāṇvena ca prākṛtamekaiva bādhyata prākṛtānāmitareṣāṃ ca kautsādinā samuccayaḥ |
evaṃ śuddhāśuddhībhyāṃ prākṛtayo- rdvayorbādhaḥ ityeṣāṃ tu samuccayaḥ |
bhā. 3|1|16|15 pṛ. 1099. sarveśāmane kastotramānāṃ abhiśoma- pūrvavatkā |
vi. 5|13|19. sarveśāmevājñāṃ śyena hatinavanītam, na sutyākālīnānāmeva |
‘sarveśāṃ tvaika (vaika) mantraya syāt’ (3|1|14|144) iti siddhāntyanena prakṛtau agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāṃ anuṣṭhitaprayogaḥ |

śamīmayatvādi tu lugādimātrāṇuvādena vidhīyamānaṃ savanādhikāro hi’ |
yatra tu vikṛtau na vidhiḥ tatra codakena prāptiḥ |
anā- rabhya vacanena prāpte tu na codakākāṅkṣā iti pūrvapakṣiṇā ukte siddhāntī śakte |
yadi anārabhyavidhinā vikṛtiḥ codakanirākāṅkṣā syāt tadā śatakṛṣṇe ' prayāje ' prayāje kuṣṇalaṃ juhoti ' iti prayājadarśanaṃ nopayeta |
śata- kṛṣṇe prayājānāṃ darśanāt vikṛtau codakaḥ siddho bhavati |
tasmāt juhupālaśāstradikaṃ anārabhyādhītaṃ prakṛtau eva niviśate vikṛtau tu codakena |
' darśanāditi cet ' ( 3|6|14 ) iti siddhānti- kṛtaśaṅkāyāḥ nirāsārthaṃ pūrvapakṣasūtramidam |
anārabhya- vidhinā vikṛteḥ nirākāṅkṣīkaraṇe codako na pravartata iti siddhāntinā yaduktam, tat kutaḥ ? ' codanekāthyāt ' |
codanāyāḥ anārabhyādhītajuhupālaśāstracodanāyāḥ ekārtha- tvāt pālāśatvarūpasya ekasyaiva arthasya vidhāyakatvāt |
ekaḥ arthaḥ vidheyaḥ yasyāḥ sā codanā ekārthā |
tathā ca anārabhya- vidhinā vihitaṃ varjayitvā codakaḥ prāpayati |
tataśca anārabhyavidhau satyapi codakaḥ pravartate eva |
anārabhyavidhiḥ prakṛtivikṛtyarthaḥ iti pūrvapakṣiṇā ukte punaḥ siddhāntī śakte |
prakṛtau tāvat ajñānī saṃkṣepeṇa vistareṇa ca utpadyante |
evaṃ prakṛtau utpattiḥ saṃkṣepa- vistarābhyāṃ bhavati |
evaṃ parṇamayī juhurbhavati ' ' yasya khādireḥ suvo bhavati ' ityādiḥ vistaraḥ, ' yasyaivarūpāḥ sucaḥ ' iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
tathā ca prakṛtau yādṛśī ajñānāmutpattiḥ tādṛśī eva anārabhyavākye ' yasya parṇamayī ' ityādau utpattiḥ |
tasmāt iyamapi prākṛtī eva utpattiḥ iti prakṛtyaiva na vikṛtyarthā |
prakṛtau ajñānāṃ utpattiḥ saṃkṣepavistarābhyāṃ bhavati iti juhuparṇamayītvāderapi utpattiḥ prākṛtī iti siddhāntinā yaduktaṃ tanna |
vikṛtau api utpatteḥ saṃkṣepa- vistarottvasya tulyatvāt |
vikṛtau api ajñānāmutpattiḥ saṃkṣepeṇa vistareṇa ca ucyate eva |
yathā sāṃgrahaṇyā- miṣṭhau ' tisra āhutīrjuhoti ' iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
' āmana- masyāmana devāḥ ' iti vistaraḥ ( āmana asi āmanasa devāḥ iti śrutau padacchedaḥ ) |
tathā ca saṃkṣepavistāravatī utpattiḥ prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ tulyā |
' na codanekāthyāt ' ( 3|6|15 ) iti yat pūrvapakṣiṇā uktaṃ tasyātra viśeṣataḥ uttaram |
codanāyāḥ codakasya yāvān arthaḥ tasya sarvasya kātsnyaṃ kurusatā eva vikṛtau, na ekadeśa- paratvam |
juhuśca pālāśatvaṃ ca, suvaśca khādiratvaṃ ca codakena vikṛtau prāpaṇīyā arthāḥ |
tān sarvānaiva codakaḥ prāpayati na kevalaṃ juhumeva suvameva vā, yena pālāśatvārthe khādiratvārthe vā anārabhyavidhimapekṣeta |
tasmāt vikṛtau pālāśa- tvādi kasya prāpyathaṃ na anārabhyavidhirepekṣa |

mukhya- vipratiṣedhāt, mukhyasya codakasya vikṛtau pravṛttasya sataḥ anārabhyavidhinā punaḥ pālāśatvādervikṛtau vidhāne vipratiṣedhaḥ syāt ' prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt ( 3|6|12 ) iti pūrvokta dviruktadoṣavat syāt |
evaṃ codanāthaikātmyāttu mukhyavipratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt anārabhya- vidhiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ eva, na vikṛtyartho'pi |
atra kutūhale ' na codanekāthyāt ' iti pañcame sūtre codanā - padasya pāṭhaḥ |
aṣṭame ca prakṛte sūtre ' codakārthaḥ ' iti pāṭhaḥ |
bhādipustakeṣu tu aṣṭame'pi codanā - śabdasyaiva pāṭhaḥ |
ubhayatra ekasyaiva śabdasya tu pāṭho yukta iti matvā asmābhirapi aṣṭame'smin sūtre kutūhalapāṭho na svīkṛtaḥ |
arthastu codanāpadena codaka eva grāhyo bhavati |
ata eva ' kṛtaṃ codakaḥ prāpayati ' iti vārtikaṃ ca saṃgacchate |

aśvamedhe ' śauvarṇarātrabhyāṃ mahimānau graho gṛhṇāti ' iti |
tatra praśnastathāḥ vikṛtāḥ : grahāḥ codakaprāptāna prākṛ- tān nivartayeran prakṛtiliṅgena grahaśabdena saṃyogāt iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntamāha |

adhikaiḥ surāgrahaiḥ somagrahāṇāṃ ekavākyatvāt samuccayaḥ evaṃ bārhaspatyādīnāṃ aindrāvāyavādibhiḥ samuccayaḥ iti siddhāntasiddhiḥ |
bṛhaspatisavatriṣupadadau bārhaspatyādīnāṃ vaikṛtānāṃ grahāṇāṃ aindrāvāyavādibhiḥ prākṛtaiḥ grahaiḥ samuccayaḥ iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |

‘sarvāṇi havīṃṣi parimṛjya karoti’ ityāpastambavacanasya sarvatvasya uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvena avikṣitatvāt viśva- kṣitatve'pi vā ‘sarvatva0’ iti nyāyena vacanāntarā- nurodhena (‘puroḍāśaṃ parvaṇi karoti’ ) puroḍāśamātra- viṣayatvopapatteḥ śrutirdarśottaramapi etasyāprāmāṇyameveti kaiściduktam |

viśvadevaśabdasya klṛptāmapi devatāviśeṣatvaṃ parityajya viśvaśabdasya sarvaśabdaparyāya- tvāṅgīkāreṇa ‘sarvatvamādhikārikam’ iti nyāyāt prakṛta- sarvaviṣayatvamāpādya devaśabdasya ca devatāparatvamaṅgīkṛtya prakṛtagatyādisarvadevatākatvasyaiva astraṣapi yāgeṣu pravṛttinimittaṃ aṅgīkriyate |
śatakṛṣṇale carau śeṣabhakṣaviṣaye ‘sarvaṃ brahmaṇe pari- harati’ iti śrūye |
tatra teṣāṃ brahmasaṃbandhibhāgānāṃ adhikārata uddeśyatvāt sarvatvaṃ cintitaṃ syāt ‘yad brahmaṇe pariharati tat sarvaṃ’ iti vacanavyaktiḥ |
śatakṛṣṇalacarau śeṣa- bhakṣaviṣaye ‘sarvaṃ brahmaṇe pariharati’ iti śruto ‘yad brahmaṇe pariharati tat sarvam’ iti yat pūrvapakṣiṇā uktam, tatra |
kiṃtu atra brahmabhikṣebhyaḥ puruṣabhyaḥ śeṣasya apanayaḥ puruṣapanayaḥ kriyate |
teṣāṃ brahmabhāgānāṃ prakṛtita eva siddhatvena avācyatvāt avadheyatvāt |
tasmāt puruṣāṇāṃ itareṣāṃ ṛtvijāṃ ye bhāgāḥ te sarve brahmaṇe eva parihartavyāḥ iti vidhīyate |
‘yat sarvaṃ pariharati tat brahmaṇe’ iti vacanavyaktiḥ |

5 (vyākhyānāntaramāha-) athavā bhāvanāmanepade- taretarayogakāraṇānāṃ tulyatvāt (nāmadheyagatetaretara- yogakāraṇavibhaktyoḥ ākhyātapadasya ca kāmyavākya- samānarūpatvāt svataḥ karmaikatvamityucyate |
karmaikye ca sati dharmāṇāmapi aikarūpyameva yuktam, na tu kacit sākalyaṃ itaratra vaikalyaṃ iti vaicitryaṃ yuktamiti) tathā- bhūtopadeśāt (iti) |
6 (vyākhyānāntaramāha-) athavā puruṣārthasya (bhāṣyasya) ubhayatra (kāmye nitye ca) vidyamāna- tvāt tathābhūtopadeśāt (ityuktam |
yadi hi nimitte niṣphalaṃ karmamātrameva kartavyaṃ syāt tatsvarūpasya aṅgai- vināpi siddhayavagamāt hīnāṅgasyāpi prayogaḥ syāt ubhayatrāpi phalasaṃbhavāt |
tasya ca yathāśrutasāmagya- chīnasiddhitvāt samastaiḥ kartavyatetyetasya karaṇasya phala- sādhanatvena śravaṇāt kāmyavat nitye'pi sarvāṅgapasaṃhāraḥ iti |
yathā kāmyaṃ phalāyopadiṣṭaṃ tathābhūtameva nityamapi iti sūtrārthaḥ |
athavā''pyekadeśe syāt pradhāne hyarthanivṛtti- guṇamātramitarat tadarthatvāt |
darśapūrṇamāsādi nityaṃ karma kiṃ kṛtsnaiḥ sahiṃtaṃ saguṇameva kartavya yathāśakti vā kathaṃciddiguṇamapi kartavyameveti vicāre saguṇameveti pūrvapakṣanirāsārthaḥ : apicāśabdāt |
ajñānāṃ ekadeśe satyapi syāt nityaḥ prayogaḥ |
hi yasmāt pradhāne kṛte sati arthanivṛttiḥ arthasya phalasya pratyavāyābhāvarūpasya niṣpattiḥ |
itarat pradhānāt anyat aṅgājātaṃ tu guṇamātraṃ guṇabhūtameva |
yajamānasya kathaṃcid aśaktau utpannāyāṃ viguṇamapi phaladam |
sūtrasyaikadeśapadaviṣaye vārtikakārairuktam, 'sāṅgasya (pradhānasya) vācakaḥ : kṛtsnaśabdaḥ ; pradhānamātrapekṣayā ekadeśaśabdaḥ |
athavā dṛṣṭārthā (karmasvarūpotpattyarthā) yā puroḍāśanirvṛttiḥ : tāmapekṣya ekadeśaśabdaḥ |
ante coktam, 'sāṅgaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ na śaknoti kaścidapi' kantu ityuktvā yāvacchakyatvāt iti nibadhyate |
vṛttau tu itarat itaratra itaratra iti pāṭhaḥ |
itaratra itaraphale sargādau yāvadaṅgānuṣṭhānaṃ iti tadarthaḥ |
'atyekadeśe syāt' ityatra 'atyekadeśena syāt' iti kutūhale pāṭhaḥ |
tadakarmaṇi ca doṣastasmāt tato viśeṣaḥ syāt pradhānainābhisaṃbandhāt |
nitye agnihotrādikarmaṇi aśaktyā keṣāṃcidvijñānāṃ lopena anuṣṭhite'pi pratyayaparihāro bhavati iti ukte siddhānte, nanu ajñānāmaprayojakatve pradhānasyāpi aprayojakatvaṃ syāt ityāśaṅkā nirasitumāha |
tada- karmaṇi tasya pradhānasya akarmaṇi anuṣṭhāne ca doṣaḥ syāt phalacchedarūpaḥ |
tasmāt pradhānāt anyasmāt tataḥ ajñāt aṅgānuṣṭhātu viśeṣaḥ syāt |
sāṅgapradhānānuṣṭhāne tu pratyaya- parihāre phale'pi viśeṣaḥ syādeva |
paraṃ tu aśaktyā aṅgalope'pi nitye na doṣaḥ |
karmābhedaṃ tu jaiminiḥ prayogavacanaikatvāt sarveṣāmupadeśaḥ syāt |
kāmye karmaṇi sarvāṅgāsāhityāvaśyakatvam, nitye tu aśaktyā katipayaiṅgalape'pi na doṣaḥ iti siddhānte uktai pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇa- māsyā yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyā yajeta' iti sarveṣāṃ sāṅgapradhānatāṃ upadeśaḥ syāt |
arthasya vyavavargitaikasyāpi prayoge syāt yathā kratvantareṣu |
kāmyanityayorbheda iti'pi sarvāṅgapūrṇatvaiva iti pūrvapakṣe sūtreṇa prāpte siddhāntī āha |
arthasya paurṇa- māsamāvāsyābhyorthasya pradhānasya aṅgebhyo vyavavargi-
tvāt bhinnatvāt ekasyāpi kevalasyāpi viguṇasya pradhānasyāpi nitye prayoge pratyavāyābhāvarūpaṃ phalaṃ syāt |
prakṛtau kṛtāyāṃ vikṛterakaraṇe'pi yathā na pratyayāyastadvat |
vidhyaparādhe vidheḥ vihitasya aśaktyādinā akaraṇe'pi, agnihotradravyaskandanarūpe vidhyaparādhe'pi samāpteḥ darśanāt 'tadeva yādṛk ca kīdṛk ca hotavyam' iti vaiguṇya'pi samāpti darśayati |
'bhinne juhoti' 'skanne juhoti' iti vidhyaparādhe prāya- ścittānāṃ vidhānāt liṅgāt nitye karmaṇi vaiguṇya'pi doṣābhāvaḥ |
yadi viguṇe niṣphale eva sati kasya aṅga- bhūtaiḥ prayojanaṃ syāt ? tasmāt viguṇānāmapi nitya- karmaṇāṃ prayogaḥ kartavya iti siddhāntaḥ |

bhāṣyam- 'aindrāgnekādaśakapāle nirvapet prajākāmaḥ' 'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet brahmavarcasakāmaḥ' 'vaiśvadevī sāṃnāyyaṃ nirvapet grāmakāmaḥ' ityevamādiṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ viguṇamapi phalavat uta aviguṇameva phalava- diti |
kiṃ prāptam ? kāmyeṣu caivaṃ syāt, viguṇamapi phalavat iti |
yadi viguṇamapi phalavat evaṃ arthimātraṃ adhikṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati |
anyathā sāmānyaśabdaḥ antareṇa viśeṣam, viśeṣe avasthāpito bhaviṣyati |
asamarthatvāt nādhikriyate iti cet, sāṅgaṃ na samarthaḥ kartum, pradhānamātraṃ tu śaknoti, (iti) pradhānamātre'dhikariṣyati |
yaduktaṃ viguṇamapi phalavaditi, asaṃyogāt pradhānamātrasya phalena |
sākṣāddhi phalaṃ śrūyate pradhānāt , na kevalāt |
tena yadyapi kevalamucyate, tathāpi naivaṃ- jātīyakaṃ tat kuryāt |
tasmāt na viguṇaṃ karma kartavyaṃ evaṃjātīyakamiti |
bhāṣyam-- na cātra pradhānamātrasya akarmaṇi pratyayāya ucyate, yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
tasmādapi na viguṇaṃ evaṃlakṣaṇakaṃ karma prayoktavyamiti |
na ca kāmanāminimittaṃ yenāvarayatvaṃ śabdaṃ syāt, ajñāni tu śābdani na śakyante bādhitum
tathā ca bhāve vā nānyantābhāvaḥ sarvajñatayā ityuktam |
na khalu sarvajñatā sattādiparihāreṇa, sattvādyo vā tatparihāreṇa bhāvā'bhāvavat pratyayapathamavataranti |
na ca sarvajñatayā teṣāṃ vyāptiriti ityuktam |
tathāhi- upadeśo vikalpavijñānayoniḥ, vikalpaśca samāropitagocaratayā midhyeti na tathā tathā- gatavijñānaṃ bhavitumarhati |
tadayamupadeśo niṣedhyasarva- viṣayatattvavijñānaviruddhasamāropitavikalpavijñāna- kārya iti viruddhakāryopalakṣyā buddhyādīnāṃ sarvajñatvā'- bhāvasādhanam |
upadeśa'bhāve vā vṛthā tatpramāṇaṃ tatsaṃnidhānamātrādvā caityavandanādicodanāṃ anisuta- tvābhyupagame anāśvāsa iti |
na khalvapi bhrānto vikalpavān; api tu viditasamastavastutattvavistāraḥ kaṣaṇāparādhīnamānaso duḥlina upadeṣṭukāmaḥ |
vacana- mantareṇa tadanupapatteḥ vikalpaṃ vinā tadasaṃbhavāt tasyā- tāttvikatvaṃ vidvānapi tamāharati |
yathā nairātmyatattvaṃ vidvānapi vikalpaṃ samāropitamānaṃ niṣedhati, nāsyātmeti |
yathā vā vyākaraṇapravaro gāvyādiśabdāna- sādhūn jānāno'pi pṛthagjanapratipādanāyadhiyā prayu- ktāno'pi nāpaśabdakārī |
tadidamāhāryamalaṃ rūpaṃ na tāttvikamiti tattvavido nopadeśavirodhaḥ |
na hīcchāmātraṃ rāgaḥ, apitu cittamalamāramato darśanā- varaṇamabhūtaguṇāminandanaṃ rāgāgacchate |
na hasati nityā- tmadarśanaṃ svārthatṛṣṇāpariplutaḥ kaścitparispandate |
yathā hi caitraḥ svato bhinna maitramudīkṣamāṇaḥ svagatasukhatṛṣṇā- paripluto na maitrasukhāya ghaṭate |
tathā pūrvā'parakṣaṇa- vivikta vijñānamātramāramānaṃ sākṣādīkṣamāṇaḥ san ati- patitatadviparītalakṣaṇāntaroṣakārakarmaṇi pravartate, pravartate ca svārthatṛṣṇāpariplutaḥ |
yathā'haṃ sukhī bhaveyaṃ duḥkhī ca mā bhūviti ca mā bhūviti ca tṛpyato yaivāhamiiti dhaiḥ saiva sahajaṃ sattva- darśanamiti |
na ca sarvavidaḥ karuṇā'hamupakuryāṃ parān ityevamākārā'pi sattvadarśanāvayavā, yasmādātmagāmī phalāmilayā
(evaṃ tāvat sahakāriviśeṣāpekṣā cāntaraviṣaya- tve'pi pāratantryamāpāditaṃ manasaḥ |

saṃprati vimarśapūrvakaṃ indriyaviṣayatvayaiva pāratantryaṃ avadhārayati-) apica viṣayaniyamāt pāratantryamastu sahakāriviśeṣāpekṣayā vā iti (vimarśa) pāratantryaṃ yuktam (ya eva tadindriya- viṣayaḥ tatraiva manaḥ tadindriyayattaṃ pravartate iti yuktam), saraṇe tathā darśanāt |

(api ca tulyajātīyaviṣayaṃ samanantarapratyayaṃ mānasapratyakṣakaraṇaṃ bruvāṇo na tāvat ekendriyagrāhyatayā tulyajātīyatāṃ vaktumarhati ati- prasaṅgāt ityāha-) ekendriyagrāhye ca sajātau (amyu- pagamyamāne) rūpāntaragrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ (pītadarśanamapi cākṣuṣaṃ mānasapratyakṣaṃ cakṣursaṃnikṛṣṭe'pi nīle pravṛttīta, tadindriyagrahaṇārhatvasya ubhayatrāviśeṣāt) |
ekanīlotpannasaṃtānavatyekanīlotpannalakṣya- viṣayaṃ indriyāsaṃnikṛṣṭasaṃtānāntarvati-nīlotpannalakṣaṇa- viṣayamapi viśadaṃ mānasaṃ janayet), tadantasttānadvayoḥ jātyabhedāt |
(upasaṃharti-) tassāt ekasaṃtānakṣaye samanantarapratyayatāṃ vadatā cakṣurādiviṣayagrāhitvameva uktaṃ bhavati, kṣaṇavivekapratibhāsanāt |
(nanu mā nāma kṣaṇabhedaḥ pratibhāsatām, tadabhedastu kutaḥ ? ityata āha-) abhedapratibhāsanāt ('so'yaṃ sphaṭikaḥ' iti pratyamiśeva bhagavatī sthāpayiṣyati [abhinnaṃ] sphaṭikam |

prathame eva kṣaṇe indriya- sāmarthyopapatteḥ) dvitīyakṣaṇopapatteḥ (kevalaṃ mano- vedyatā anumīyate) iti cet |
(nanu saraṇe kevalameva manaḥ pravartate, andhādīnāmapi rūpādisaraṇe'palabdheḥ ityata āha-) saraṇe tu pratīyameva pāratantryaṃ (manasaḥ, pramāṇāntaradhigatagocaratvāt |
na cānumānādiṣu manaḥ svatantramityāha-) anumānādiṣu liṅgyabhāve apratyāyāt pāratantryam, iti na kaścidapi anantare manaḥ sākṣāt svatantraṃ pravartate iti āntaraḥ eva sākṣā- dviṣayaḥ (sukhādiḥ |
) tatraiva sākṣāt itthyā prakalpamanu- bhavet nā''daviṣaye (bāhye) |

(nanu mā bhūt indriyajaṃ mānasaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ sarva- viṣayam, bhāvanāmayaṃ tu bhaviṣyati iti cettatrāha-) bhāvanāmāmayaṃ vijñānaṃ bhūtānumitivat akasmāt bhāvanā'yogāt āgamānumānaparatantraṃ pūrvajñānabhūtatva- viṣayatānuvidhānāt (ca) sāpekṣatvātpramāṇam |
(saṃprati vyavasthāpitonmūlane kaścit prābhākaragandhī pratyavatiṣṭhate-) nanu na kālato niyamaśraddhādīnāṃ (idaṃ rajataṃ ityatra), avartamānarajatajñānupalabdheḥ |

na hi vā śuktikādyupalabdhiḥ, anyākārasaṃvidaḥ anyaviṣayatvā- yogāt (tayoge viṣayatvasyāniyamāt), anāśrayāt (yadi hi anyākārā saṃvit anyaviṣayā bhavet tadā saṃvidaḥ svārthavyabhicārāt sarvairvaināśātprasaṅgaḥ, iti na prekṣāvān kaścit pravartata kutaścidā nivartata, tasmā- dapi rajataviṣayaiva) |
(paratantraṃ bahirmanaḥ' ityathā- kṣipatti-) adhigatasvātantryaṃ ca manaḥ |
na ca svapnajñānaṃ smṛtiḥ, atadrūpatvāt (anubhūtaviṣayāsaṃ- pramoṣa hi smṛteḥ rūpam |
tadetat prābhākaragandhino mataṃ nirākaroti-) naitat sāram |
dehino vartamānābhā svapne spaṣṭā'pi hi smṛtiḥ |
kārā saṃvit nānyaviṣayeti, tatrāha-) rajatābhāsanaṃ yadi na śuktiviṣayaṃ vartamānabhāsanamapi tarhi nāvarta- mānagocaram |
(doṣavaśāt avartamānamapi vartamāna- tayā pratīyate evetyāha-) doṣatastathātvaṃ (avarta- mānagocarasya viśvasya vartamānabhāsanaṃ) |
evamāpātastulyatvāmabhidhāya svābhimat- syāsya viśeṣamāha-) vartamāne ca (śuktiśakle) avartamāna (rajatā-) vabhāsaḥ, nāvartamāne (rajjate) vartamānabhāsaḥ |
arthasaṃnidheḥ sāphalyatvāt ! 'nedaṃ rajatam' iti ca prasaktasya prati- ṣedhopapatteḥ (aṅgulīnirdeśena śuktikāśakalameva rajata- tayā pratiṣedhanti vipratipadyate |
tattatra rajataṃ prasaktaṃ pūrvavijñānena iti gamyate) |
taimirikasya keśoṇḍrabhaṃ jñānaṃ (tu) ālokādiṣu iti nāryāpekṣo vyabhicāraḥ |

(yaccoktaṃ adhigatasvātantryaṃ manaḥ khamāvasyāyāṃ bāhye iti tat vimṛśya svapakṣaṃ pratijānīte-) svapne'pi kiṃ smṛtervartamānābhāsatvam, uta (tasmin) manasaḥ svātantryaṃ iti (vicāre) smṛtervartamānābhāsitā yuktā, anantaradivasasyānubhūtasya avikalā'nadhikasya vispaṣṭa- smṛteḥ [avikalā ... smṛteḥ ityatrasthāne kaṇikāyāṃ -kalpanādhikasyāpi spaṣṭasmṛteḥ-: iti pṛṣṭhaḥ |
na tu ahahaṃ manasaḥ svātantryam (bāhye yuktam) |
doṣataśca na sāmarthyātirekaḥ (yena manaḥ svatantraṃ bāhye tattvajñānaṃ prasuvīta |
viparyāsāttu saṃskārādeva manasaḥ), doṣasya tadapanayanahetutvāt (tacchabdena sāmarthyaparāmarśaḥ) |
(nanu kaścit satyamapi svapnadarśanaṃ bhavati, tasmāttatra manasaḥ svātantryamabhyupeya iti cet, tatrāha-) satyasvapnadarśanaṃ tu yadi vartamānasya tathā grahaṇāt tadupapannam |
(śaṅkate-) prabodhe svapnākhyānārthasaṃvādadarśanāt dṛṣṭam, iti cet (nirākaroti-) na, ākhyānasaṃvāda'bhāvāt |
bhaviṣyatsu vartamāna- vat darśanaṃ kathaṃ satyam ? (codaka āha-) mā bhūt satyam, asti tāvat svātantryaṃ manasaḥ (saṃskārasya bhaviṣyati asaṃbhavāt |
samādhātā svābhiprāyamāha-) tadapi tadvidhasya (anyatra) anubhūtasya smaraṇam |
(nahi sarvathā anubhūtamupalabhyate svapne, parasparaviruddhanāmapi kaścit kadācit kathaṃcidutpannānāṃ sahānanubhavavibhrama- saṃbhavaḥ :) |
dharmaviśeṣaścet (svapne sukhopalabdhau kāraṇaṃ syāt, tadā-) yathārthadarśanapra- jñāt |
tasya (dharmaviśeṣasya, manaḥsvātantryarūpaṃ) kāryaṃ prati adṛṣṭasāmarthyasya kalpyatvāt (kalpyatvaprasaṅgāt) |
yadi ca na smṛtiḥ svapnajñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tarhi, na pramāṇa- mapi bahiḥsthā grāhyasya abhāvāt [svapnajñānasya smṛtitvābhāve anubhavatvena prāmāṇyābhāvāt] |
(yadi cetyāderuttaramāha-) na tarhi bahirarthe svatantraṃ manaḥ; svapne tasya (tathāvidhasya) agrāhyatvāt, grāhyatve vā anubhūtasya grahaṇam, tathā dṛṣṭatvāt |
na (tu) doṣataḥ adṛṣṭasāmarthyātirekaphalanā iti ubhayathā (bāhyasya grāhyatve agrāhyatve ceti) na svatantraṃ bahirmanaḥ |
etena (manasaḥ svamavijñāne'sā- [mudrite tu avagraho nāsti] tantyapradarśanamārgeṇa) timirataḥ keśādidarśanaṃ (mānasaṃ iti) pratyuktam (ālokāṃśālambanatayā tadvijñānasya doṣalocananimittatvāt) |
(saṃprati naiyāyikābhimatayogivijñānaviṣayatvaṃ viśvasya nirākaroti-) liṅgyābhāsājaṃ loke pratibhāsa- niścayaḥ |
sarvataḥ pūrṇavijñānaḥ pūrṇe nyūne na kaścana |
yadapi kila 'śre me ātā āgantā' iti pratibhāyāṃ akṣaliṅgyāpekṣā'bhāvāt bahiḥ svatantraṃ mano dṛṣṭam |

sarve ca 'sarve' iti vā sadasatpadā [rtha] dravyādyaiḥ, prakṛtipuruṣau, padya skandhāḥ, ityādinā vā bhedena (prakāreṇa) lokapramāṇavasena manaso viṣayaḥ : (bhāvanāmayasya sphuṭābhāsasya lokottarasya pratyakṣasya viṣayaḥ) ityapi (manasaḥ) svātantrye bahiḥ : sarvaitadasiddhaḥ |
lokottaraṃ tāvat pratibhānaṃ (sattayā) vivādapadam (iti na tatra

laukikaṃ tu priyāpriyoccaraṃ (na svatantramanojñanyam, yataḥ) prāyaḥ sahapratikṣedaprasadādegādi-(lakṣaṇa) liṅgābhāsa- prabhavam, ata eva aniścayātmakam, tathā ca vyapadi- śanti 'evaṃ pratibhānaṃ na tu niścayaḥ' (iti) |
iti mūlapāṭho mudritaḥ; kaṇikā- mudritapāṭhastu asāmirgrahītaḥ : ] (kiṃtu) pratibheva (ataḥ) na pramāṇam, aniścayaphalatvāt, pramāṇā- nirapekṣaniścayatvāt |
(upasaṃharati-) evaṃ liṅgādi- jātīyatvāt (liṅgābhāsāpekṣatvāt) tatrāpi pāratantryam (pratibhānade'pi manasaḥ pāratantryam) |
anyathā tadanapekṣamanomātrasādhano bahirarthasaṃvandhaḥ sarvasya sarvasmin sarvadā syāditi (sarvaḥ - sarvasyaḥ syāt |

manu adṛṣṭaviśeṣāt bāhye manaḥ svatantraṃ kadācit kasyacideva iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ iti cettatrāha-) adṛṣṭaviśeṣāt akṣaliṅgādyapekṣaṃ manaḥ kasyacit (ka- cit) bāhye'pyarthe sati cakṣurādāramvyaivapratyakṣaḥ; tata eva (manasaḥ) adṛṣṭaviśeṣābhisaṃstatvāt [0 ṇāmi- saṃskṛtāt - iti kaṇikāpāṭhaḥ ] sarvapratitiṣṭhideḥ (sarvarūpādipratitiṣṭhideḥ) tasyāpi (manaso'pi) vaiyarthyāt, akaraṇasyaiva kartṛtvāmanaḥ (ahaṣṭaviśeṣādeva (rūpādi-) paricchitti kriyāsiddheḥ |
(yadi ca-) na khalu anupāyāmahaṣṭamapi artha sādhayati, śarīrādhāra- mbhāt tena tarhi akṣaliṅgādyanapekṣā manasaḥ (bahaḥ) pravṛttiḥ (na khataḥ) |
ata eva yogajādanmāt sarvāyeṣu na mānasaṃ pratyakṣam, (indriyārtha-) saṃnikarṣo- pāyatvāt (bāhyaviṣayapratyakṣatva-) siddheḥ |
anyathā kutsyādiṣvyavahitārthopalabdhiprasaṅgāt (asma- dādīnāṃ iti sarvasya sarvapratyakṣatvāt |
tathā-) anu- māne'pi pratyakṣatvāpātāt, aniktāviccheṣu tasyāpya- yogāt |

ata eva nendriyārthayoḥ saṅgrāhaḥ [: siddhayoḥ iti mūlapāṭhaḥ] saṃnikarṣaḥ (jñānajananaṃ prati parasparasaṅkalpe- nāvasthānaṃ), atītānāgatānāṃ tadā (vijñānasamaye) api asattvāt vyavahitārthopalabdhiprasaṅgāt, anumānā- diṣu ca pratyakṣatvāpātāt, saṃnikarṣagrahaṇārthayakācca |

nanu atītānāgatānāṃ deśādiviśeṣatvena jñānān (iyamatītānāgatavadurājā jagatī iti) jñānasya ca (tajjñānasya ca) viśeṣadeśādyālambanatvāt taiḥ (deśādimirityartha-) cakṣuṣo manaso vā saṃnikarṣa- saṃbhavāt, teṣāṃ ca (deśādīnāṃ) sattvāt saṃnidhānāda- vyāhataṃ anutpannātivṛttajñānasya indriyārthasaṃnikarṣatvam |

anumānādilakṣaṇamapi ca indriyārtha- saṃnikarṣopacaṃ jñānaṃ iti nāmumānādi tattvam (pṛthak anumānādilakṣaṇapraṇayanasāmarthyāt anumānādilakṣaṇā- bhāve indriyārthasaṃnikarṣapacaṃ iti pratyakṣalakṣaṇamiti (dūṣayati-) yadi tāvat yaḥ kaścidaryaḥ (tena saha indriyāsaṃnikarṣāt yadijñānaṃ tat pratyakṣaṃ -) tataḥ smṛtau pratyakṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ |

(śaṅkate-) atha prameyaḥ (deśādiḥ), (dūṣayati-) deśādimātrajñānaṃ bhavatu pratyakṣaṃ tanmātrasaṃni- karṣāt, na tu viśeṣaṇam : (śaṅkate-) viśiṣṭa- jñānaṃ pratyakṣamiti tadākṣepāt viśeṣaṇamapi pratyakṣaṃ iti cet |
nahi asati viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭe vartamāno'pi bhuvati |
sarvasya tathātvaprasaṅgāt (asani- mānāviśeṣe viśiṣṭasya vartamānatvābhāve) ati- vṛttāyāṃ mātari 'devadattāputro yajñadattaḥ' ucyate ? (samādhātuṃ nigūḍhāmiṣaṃ pṛcchati-) kimatra ? (kimatra katham |
codaka āha-) na sa tathā tadā (devadattāputraḥ iti) viśiṣṭatayā vyavahāramanupatediti (avartamānasya vyavahārānarhatvāt |
samādhātā āha-) yadi tarhi avartamānaṃ na vyavahārārham, devadattā'pi viśeṣaṇatayā na vyavahārārhaṃ syāt |
(codaka āha-) atha bhūtapūrvatvena viśeṣaṇena vyavahāraḥ, (samādhātā āha-) viśiṣṭatayā'pi tādṛśyā (ativṛttyā mātrā) na daṇḍavāritaḥ (vyavahāraḥ |
upalakṣaṇaṃ tu, rūpato bhinnasya (svalakṣaṇasya ākāriṇaḥ) asannidhānāt (viśeṣasya abhimat- vastvanākāratvāt) saṃnidhisaṃnidhikṛta eva ca etayoḥ |
yadi ca (viśiṣṭaprameya- tāsiddhayarthaṃ) viśeṣaṇaṃ (api) prameyam, jātādyarthaśca prameyaḥ |
(tataḥ-) anarthasaṃnikarṣamapi (jñānaṃ) pratyakṣaṃ prāptam (viśeṣaṇasya tatra saṃnikarṣābhāvāt), na ca tathā (saṃbhavati) |
nanu mā bhūta lakṣaṇam, viśeṣye- ndriyasaṃnikarṣamātrāt tajjanitatve, lapyate ca pratyakṣaṃ vaiśadyāt iti cet tatrāha-) indriyasya arthāpekṣatvāt |
(śaṅkate-) atha deśaviśeṣa eva prameyo na tadviśeṣaṇam, tathā ca na tallakṣaṇavirahaḥ (pratyakṣa- lakṣaṇavirahaḥ), arthyamānasaṃnikarṣāt |
(uttaram-) na tarhi deśādyalambhanaṃ ajñānena anutpannādivideno dhyāyinaḥ [ na tarhi deśādyalambhane jñānena anutpannā |

prameyaikadeśasaṃnikarṣāt (kathaṃ- cidviśeṣaṇībhūtavartamānaviśvaviṣayaka-) pratyakṣajñānodaye (svīkṛte) sarvaḥ sarvapratyakṣadarśī syāt, sarvasya indriyasaṃnikṛṣṭaṃ prati kathaṃcidveṣaṇatvopapatteḥ |

anu- mānalakṣaṇasābhāve'pi pratyakṣavidyamānārthasmṛtau pratyakṣa- prasaṅgaḥ (anumānalakṣaṇānaruddhe viṣaye pratyakṣalakṣaṇe vyavasthāpyamāne, pratyakṣe kasmiṃścit sadṛśe gavayādau dṛṣṭe saṃskārodbodhāt sadṛśāntarasya gavādestathasya vidya- mānasya smṛtau pratyakṣaprasaṅgaḥ |
śaṅkate-) saṃskārastatra kāraṇaṃ nārthavattā, asatyapyarthe (smṛteḥ) bhāvāt |
nahi tatra arthopayoge pramāṇam, saṃnihite asannihite, vyavahite avyavahite, vartamāne avartamānaṃ ca sarvatra yogipratyakṣotpādābhyupagamāt |

'vartamānadeśādyalambhanaṃ liṅgābhāve' iti vadatā saṃplavo nirastaḥ syāt (nyāyabhāṣyakāreṇa, pramāṇena pramāṇabhyāṃ pramāṇeṣu ekasyaiva prameyasya ātmādeḥ pramitiḥ iti yaḥ pramāṇaplavo darśitaḥ, sa tvayā codakena nirastaḥ syāt tathā ca bhāṣyavirodhaḥ) |
(śaṅkate-) liṅgādyabhāvapadena-) anumānādibādhanāt (pratyakṣalakṣaṇasyenāpi tatkaraṇāta) notsṛṣṭaṃ iti cet (nirākaroti-) śabdanivṛttyarthaṃ anya- padeśapadadvyākhyānaṃ (bhāṣyagataṃ) ayuktaṃ (syāt) |
ṣaḍvidhasaṃnikarṣabhyupagamaḥ indriyagrahaṇaṃ ca (indriyārtha- saṃnikarṣapañca iti nyāyasūtragatam) anumānādinivṛttyarthe ityādi (sūtra-bhāṣyoktaṃ) parāhataṃ syāt |
(api ca) sarvaṃ ca paripūrṇaṃ cet laukikaṃ pramāṇa- gocaraḥ, laukikapramāṇavyavahārī api paripūrṇajñānaḥ eva iti na tato lokottarajñānābhimatasya viśeṣaḥ |
nirākaroti-) na tatra (sarvasmin saṃpūrṇagṛhīte) tasya (spaṣṭāvabhāsasya) upayogaḥ |
(śaṅkate-) atha niścayaḥ (lokottareṇa jāyamāno viśeṣaḥ; nāsau laukikena iti cet |

(śaṅkate-) pramiteḥ pratyakṣadarśanaḥ (sarvārthapratyakṣa- darśinaḥ sarvasyāḥ pramiteḥ pratyakṣaparatvāt ) sarvārthaiṣu nairā- kāṅkṣayam, natarasya (pramāṇāntareṇa sarvārthapratyakṣadarśino laukikasya |
nirākaroti-) apratyakṣampi yadi pari- pūrṇam, (tarhi) mānāntareṇa mitaṃ kimapyanākāṅkṣediti |

prameyamidāpi tasyā āśutaravināśitvena-) punaḥ prameyasiddhayarthaṃ pramāṇā- ntarākāṅkṣā, (iti cet) na, pūrvasmādapi (yogaja- jñānāt) asakṛt tatsiddheḥ, siddhasya punaḥ siddhayapekṣā- hetvābhāvāt (yadi vicitrābhisaṃsthityā pratipattṛṇāṃ) upāyāntarasadbhāvaḥ (cet tumitsitaḥ syāt, tarhi-) upāyāntarāsakāṅkṣaiva syāt, (na prameyāntarāsa- kāṅkṣayata, tarhi-) prītiviśeṣaśca (upāyāntareṇa ākāṅkṣayata, tarhi-) pūrvapramāṇārdaśanāt sidhyati iti vyarthaṃ pramāṇāntaram |
nijasamānaṃ (pratyakṣa-) dṛṣṭamapi itare: (pramāṇairanumā- nādibhi: ayaṃ vicitrāmisaṃdhi: pratipattā) jijñāseta, (na pratyakṣaparā sarvapramiti: |
atha-) viśeṣaniścayātmakaṃ pratyakṣam, aniścayātmakamanumānādi vyabhicārāt (iti viśeṣaścet, tadidamapyupabham, anumānāderapi yathokta- lakṣaṇopapannasya vyabhicārābhāvāt |
sthūlanirākaraṇāntaramāha-) apra- mitatvādeva tarhi ākāṃkṣā, vyabhicārina: (ata eva) aniścayātmakasya apramāṇatvāt |
(śakte-) mānā- diyogyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ saṃnikarṣārtaṃ (saṃnihitatvāt) nānu- mānādi (tasya deśakālaviprakṛṣṭavastunocaratvāt |
nirā- karoti-) saṃnikarṣārdhana tarhi gamanādi apekṣātām, na tu pramāṇādhanam, (anumānādeva heto:) siddhatvāt pramāyā: |
(na ca prameya manādihetu: ityāha-) pramitau ca saṃnikarṣasya mānādihetutvāt |
( na ca sāmānyaṃ alīkam, saṃni- hitaṃ ca vartamānaṃ ca ) tathābhūtaṃ ca sarvārtheṣu yogināṃ ( katipayabhūmikāsamārūḍhānāṃ ) tathāgatānāṃ ca ( daśama- bhūmikāgatānāṃ ) darśanamiti |
( yadyapi sāmānyaṃ aparamārthatayā asaṃhitamevavartamānaṃ ca, tathāpi tathā avabhāsate iti anubhavākārapravṛttyā tatpratipattiḥ pratyakṣaṃ prasajyeta iti pūrvadoṣārpāttiḥ ) |

( atraiva dūṣaṇāntaraṃ 18 kārikāyāḥ pūrvarnāha - ) api ca tathābhūte ( vartamāne atīte anāgate ca ) tathābhūtadarśanāt [ atathābhūtadarśanāt iti yuktaṃ bhāti ] vartamānaṃ mithyājñānameva, tairmikadarśanavat |
na tu pratyakṣamanthā bhavati, tadindriyārthasāmarthyajanyalakṣaṇam, itarathā timirādyupaplavakeśaśādidarśanaṃ kasya hetoravā- kriyaṃta ( pratyakṣatvāt abhraśat ) |
( sākāravādī pratyavatiṣṭhate - ) sarvameva pratyakṣaṃ asaṃhitāvabhāsam, arthasaṃyogaḥ kāryakaraṇabhāvena ( nātra yathāsaṃkhyam ) kālabhedāt |
( dūṣaṇavādī gūḍhā- bhiprāyaḥ pṛcchati - ) ki tadīdaṃ prakāśate ( nīlādi saṃnihitadeśakālaṃ codaka āha - ) jñānākāram |
( prajñā abhiprāyaviṣkaroti - ) na hīdānīṃ sarvadeśasyāpi ( artharūpasya ) pratyakṣadarśī ( vidyate ) |
( sarvārtha- pratyakṣadarśī codyati - ) jñānākāre arthavedanāsa- dhyavasāyenaiva vyavahāradarśanāt nārthadarśanahāniḥ |
codaka āha - ) niruddhatvāt anādeḥ arthagrāhābhiniveśapāsmaralakṣaṇāyā avidyāyāḥ : [ ṣaṣṭhī iyam ] |
( sopahāsaṃ dūṣayati - ) svasti tarhi sarvajñatvāya bhūyiṣṭhāvidyāpasmārāya, varaṃ kanīyo'vicaṃ [ kanīyasī avidyā yasmin tat ] eka- deśadarśitvameva |
apica paribhāṣā'pi tāvat eka- deśe evaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt |
grāhyatvaṃ hetutvameva jñānākārā- rpaṇakṣamamiti, na punaḥ sarvaiḥ, tasyāhetutvāt deśataḥ kālato vā'saṃnidhānāt |
anyathā ( saṃnidhivirahiṇe- 'pi hetutve ) sarvasya ( asmāderapi ) sarvadarśi- svaprasaṅgāt |
( pūrvārdhasya anyā vyākhyā - ) athavā pratyupakārameva jñānam, atītānāgatākāramapi vā ? pūrvatra ( pūrvakalpe ) sarvasyātathābhāvāt mithyā |
uttaratra ( kalpe ) atītādirūpakalpanāpravṛttatvāt na pratyakṣam ( kalpanārahitasya tattvāt |

yastu manyate 'astu vartamāna- viṣayameva pratyakṣaṃ tathāpi sarvaviṣayam, atītānā- gatayorapi atītānāgatatvābhyāṃ vartamānatvāt ' iti, tannirāsāya 18 kārikāyārthasyaiva vyākhyānataramāha - ) sarvaṃ vā jñānakāle pratyupakāramānā jñāyeta, tathā'vasthaṃ vā ( yo yadavasthaḥ sa tathetyarthaḥ ) |
uttaratra ( pakṣe ) na sarvaṃ pratyakṣam, avasthāntarāpratyakṣīkaraṇāt |
( uttarārdhaṃ vivṛṇoti - ) api ca sarvaṃ na krameṇa śakyāvagamam, ānantyāt |
nahi pūrvāpara- koṭivirahiṇo jñeyasya utpādataḥ pariniṣṭhā asti |
( nityasyāpi tāvat paramāṇuvādeḥ vyavasthitarūpasyāpi neyattā, kimpunaḥ punaḥ avyavasthitarūpasyetyādataḥ :) na yogapadyena, ānantyādeva |
( codyati - ) nanu ana- vadhāraṇe'pi iyattāṃ rūpato yogapadyena sarvamaiti |
nahi iyattā- navadhāraṇe sarvamavadhāritaṃ bhavati ekadeśo vā, anyatarāṇyavacchedat ( anyatarasyaikadeśasya parimita- rūpamātrāgrahaṇe avyavacchedat |
jñātiśayaṃ ca jñānaṃ ( upalabhyate ) ataḥ kvacit kāṣṭhāprāptaṃ sarvaviṣayamiti |
( uttaramāha ) ucyate 'kāṣṭhā yadyapiḥ kāmaṃ paraṃ yasmādasaṃbavi |
( vikalpaya dūṣyati-) yadi yataḥ paraṃ nāsti sā kāṣṭhā, bhavatu .tanmāsiḥ. na ca tathā sarvaviṣayatvasiddhiḥ |
pārthivasyeva golakasya pārthivā- ntarāpekṣaṃ ( parvatasāpekṣaṃ ) bahutarākāśāvakāśavyāpyatvam, na sarvavyāpitā |
( kalpāntaramāśaṅkate-) atha yataḥ paraṃ na saṃbhāvyate ( sā kāṣṭhā |
nahi śātiśaya api ghaṭādayaḥ [ kuṭakumbha- maṇikādayaḥ- iti kaṇikā ] parimāṇataḥ parāsaṃbhava- nīyā' ( nīya rūpadeśā' ) tiśāyinaḥ ; anyānavakāśa- prasaṅgāt ekena ( dravyeṇa ) sarvavyāpteḥ |
( guṇatve sati iti viśeṣaṇañca vyabhicāra iti cettatrāha-) na ca guṇadharmā''dyamiti sāṃpratam |
tadvatānāṃ ( kāryadravyagatānāṃ ) garimādīnāṃ tadavasthā''saṃbhavāt ( kāṣṭhāyā asaṃbhavāt ) sarvagaṃtṛtvavadaddhiḥ |
na ca tasya ( viśeṣasya ) asaṃbhavīyatparāvasthaḥ atiśayaḥ, anantatvāt namasaḥ |
tasmāt prayatnavaisādhāraṇaguṇena buddhi- guṇena vā vyabhicāraḥ |

īśvaraiśvaryasya dharmaphalatvāt ( dharmaphalatvā- pātāt iti pāṭhāntaram ) kleśakarmavipākāśayāparamārthāt [ īśvarasya kleśadādiśūnyatvāt ] ( yastu parameśvaraiśvarya- syāpi dharmajanitatvamabhyupaiti, taṃ pratyāha-) anekeśvara- prasaṅgāt ( sarveṣāṃ ) aiśvaryavyāghātāt ||
( yacca ' kāṣṭhāprāptirūpalambhate ' ityuktam, tadvikalpya dūṣyati-) api ca ' nāsaṃbhāvya parā- vastaṃ nabhaḥ parimitaṃ yadi |
[ yadi parāvastyaṃ asaṃbhāvya nabhaḥ parimitaṃ na ityanvayaḥ : ] ( parimitaṃ cedākāśaṃ iti tato'dhikaṃ kimiti na saṃbhāvyeta, sātiśayapari- māṇadarśanādeva saṃbhāvanīyametat |
śaṅkate- ' athānantyā tatvaṃ ' - ) anantatvādi cet ( śaṅkāṃ nirācikīrṣuḥ pṛcchati-) kimidaṃ ānantyam ? ( śaṅkitā brūte-) aparicchinnatā |
( uttaraṃ-) nanu eṣa parimāṇabhāvaḥ ( eṣa vacanavyaktyantareṇa āśritaḥ ) |
etāvat tarhi parimāṇam ( tadviparītatā tu tadabhāvaḥ ) |
īdṛśī ca kāṣṭhāprāpti īśvarajñānasya vadan ajñānaṃ ( īśvarasya ) āvirbhāvayati ( ātmīyasyaiva vijñānasya sākalyenāparijñānāt ) |
( naiyāyikaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate-) sarvakāryāṇāṃ kartṛtvā- deva tarhi sarvajñatvam |
saṃpradānaṃ kṣetrajñāḥ, yānayaṃ bhagavān svakarma- bhirabhipreti |
sarveṣāṃ ca kāryāṇāmīśvaraḥ kartā, iti samasta- kāryopādānābhyabhiṣaḥ, tathā ca sarvajña iti |

( etaṃ para- tantrasiddhāntaṃ dūṣayitumupakramate-) kimete ( kulālā- dayaḥ ) svakāryasya niravaśeṣopakaraṇavedinaḥ katipaya- karaṇavedino vā ? na tāvat aśeṣopakaraṇavedinste ( anantaḥ ) : adṛṣṭasyājñānāt |
bālonmattādayaśca sarvakāryāṇāṃ na prayojanādidedinaḥ ( iti taddarśanaina īśvarasya tanmātrajñānamapi na sidhyati ) |
sādhyaṃ cet kartṛtvaṃ tat kathaṃ antarbhāvitasarvajñatvaṃ hetumantareṇa seddhumarhati ? ||

prekṣāpūrvaprasādādiseni- veśavaitakṣavye'pi ca itareṣāṃ tarugirisāgarādīnāṃ yadyapi saṃniveśamātrasāmānyāt ( caitanyāmātrasiddhiḥ syāt iti pareṇa saṃbandhaḥ ) tathā asati vibhaktatvatayā svārthe parānugrahe vā duḥkhottarādarśanāt prayojanābhāvanirā- kṛtā''pi caitanyāmātrasiddhiḥ syāt, ekatvaṃ tu tasya ( īśvarasya ) kutastyam ? nahi ghaṭarādayaḥ eka- buddhimatpūrvakāḥ |

( śaṅkate-) īśvarapūrvatvena [ īśvara- kartṛkatvena- iti kaṇikāyām ] ( sarvasya kāryajātasya ) tathā ( ekakartṛkatvaṃ ) iti cet ( uttaramāha-) sādhyaṃ tat ( īśvarapūrvatvakatvam, tat kathaṃ sādhyatayopādīyate ? punaḥ śaṅkate-) cetanamātranāntarīyakatvāt saṃni- veśasya keṣāñcit ( ghaṭarādīnāṃ ) tathā darśanāt anya- trāpi ( kṣityādī ) tathābhāvaḥ : ( iti siddhamīśvarapūrvatva- ekakartṛkatvaṃ ca ) iti cet |

( nirācaṣṭe-) dṛṣṭānta- sādhyābhyāmekāntaḥ ; ( dṛṣṭānte hi ghaṭādau ekaḥ kartā kulālādiḥ, sādhye ca kṣityādau īśvaraḥ, iti vyabhi- cārāt notpattisattvaṃ acetanopādānatvaṃ vā cetanamātraṃ kartāraṃ tatamuvanādīnāṃ sāghayitumarhati, anekakartṛkatvasya dṛṣṭāntasādhyayordarśanāt |
yadi tu sarvameva īśvarapūrvatvena sādhyeta tato ghaṭādīnāṃ īśvarapūrvatvena pakṣaviniveśāt dṛṣṭāntābhāva ityāha-) sarvasādhyatve dṛṣṭāntābhāvaḥ |

dvikartṛkatve ca ghaṭādeḥ : [ īśvaraśca kulālaśceti dvāvapi ghaṭādeḥ kartārau iti cet ] muvanādyapi tathā iti īśvareśvaraprasaṅgādanavasthā [ yathā ghaṭakartāraṃ kulāla- madhiṣṭhātṛmīśvaraḥ tathā jagatakartāramīśvaramadhiṣṭhātṛ anya īśvaraḥ ; tasyāpyaparaḥ : ityanavasthā ] |
( codayati-) ata eva ( anavasthāprasaṅgādeva ) na dvitīyānumānam |

( pariharati-) ekānumānamapi tarhi mā bhūt, tathāpi ( ekānumāne'pi ) anavasthāyāstulyatvāt ( lakṣadharpi- pākā''daghvakṣeṣasaṃyogādeva kṣityādilakṣaṇakāryautpattau etasyāpīśvarasyānumāne tulyatvānvayetyarthaḥ |
śaṅkate-) atha na hyadhiṣṭhātṛkā ghaṭādayaḥ : ( kiṃtu ) sarvamekādhi- ṣṭhātṛkam |

( śaṅkate-) rathādyakṣayavayāḥ nānālakṣanirmitā api dṛśyante jagati prāya upakāryopakārakāḥ ; evaṃ ca ' rathā- jñādi ekatatpūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭam, tasmāt ' jagadapi ekakartṛ- pūrvakam ' iti ( yat parasparopakāryopakārakatvena vyavasthitaṃ tārha ekakartṛkaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā rathāvayavāḥ ekatatpūrvaka dṛṣṭāḥ, tathā ca tanubhuvanādi iti ) |
nahi karmaśayā''bhāve tasya ( īśvarasya ) śarīrindriyayogaḥ, buddhiḥ, aiśvaryaṃ vā saṃbhavati iti pramāṇavicchedastadupagamaḥ; hetvabhāve kāryanupapatteḥ |
upapattau vā saṃniveśatā tajjñānamanvataḥ syāt ( yena karmaśayena asya śarīrādayo janayitavyāḥ |
codayati-) nanu ata eva ( hetvabhāve kāryābhāvādeva ) tadanumānaṃ ( tasya buddhimat tanubhuvanādihetoḥ anumānaṃ ) anyathā ( hetvabhāve'pi kāryabhāve ) dūṣaṇamapi ( kārikoktaṃ ) na syāt |

vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ, yato dūṣaṇam, na sādhanamiti ( umāvapi hi dūṣaṇasādhanavādinau kāraṇābhāve kāryābhāvaṃ vaktuṃ pravṛttau, tat kathamekaḥ paryanuyujyate ? svapakṣe viśeṣamādarśayan pariharati-) ucyate |
pratyakṣaṃ vilakṣaṇā hi apratyakṣapūrvāḥ saṃniveśaḥ : atadetataḥ syuḥ ( apratyakṣaveditavaḥ syuḥ ) |
na caivaṃ buddhimageyā dṛṣṭālakṣaṇe''numānāt ( sā ca nityā asarvaviṣayā upalabhyā asadādau iti tadvidvedhānumātavyā, tathā ca nityasarvaviṣayatvavyāghātiḥ : iti dūṣaṇasya viśeṣaḥ |

) api ca tulyatve'pi [ sādhanadūṣaṇayoḥ svīkṛte'pi ] pratibandhamātrāt dūṣaṇaṃ sādhanamapi ( satpratipakṣatayā ) sādhanaṃ tu nirastapratipakṣaṃ sādhyasiddhau ( sādhanatāyāmava- tiṣṭhate, na tu sapratipakṣaṃ pratibandhamātrāditi ) iti |
(kārikāyā: pakṣārthe vyācaṣṭe-) na ca buddhimān saṃniveśahetu: (kiṃtu) vinyāsaprayojanavicāranirṇayā- tmikā medhā (vinyāsaprayojanayo: ye vicāranirṇayau tadātmikā prekṣā buddhirviśeṣa: ) |
na ca sā tatra (īśvare) saṃbhavati, svārthaparāyaṇābhāvāditei |
[ etāvatā granthena sarvajña: kaściccoktā iti mataṃ nirākṛtam |
atha yogasiddha: kaścitsakṛttatkarmā niyoktā iti mataṃ nirākaroti |
tatra pūrvapakṣopānyāsaṃ karoti-] nanu mā bhūt sarvaśo niyoktā, dharmaśca iṣyatām |
nahi rūpatakṣurādīnāṃ viṣayaniyamo nirūpyate ityu- ktam |
kālatastva niyame yadā vartamānaṃ tadā ati- śayavakṣurādiviṣayabhāve na viruddha: |
tatra 'kuru' ityasya dharma:, yāgāderviṣayasya dharmateno- pagamā
anyeṣāṃ punareka eva ratha- cakramātraḥ puroḍāśa āmnātaḥ |
sa yadā''kriyate tadā vicāraḥ, kiṃ karmabhedāt śeṣakāryāṇāṃ medaḥ, uta dravye- tvāttvamiti |
nanu caikādaśavicāro'yaṃ tatra nirṇīyate ‘ekadravye saṃskārāṇāṃ vyākhyātamekatvamityam’ (1|1|4| 12|42) ityam |
yadyapyamekādaśānuguṇe vicārastathā'pi atra śeṣakārya- prasaṅgāccheṣo'pi vicārātmakatvāt kriyate |
tatra caika- dravyatvāttantratvaṃ sidhyati yatra dravyaṃ tadasvitvameva sarva- karmaṇāsupakaroti |
medakaraṇe ca prayojanāntaraṃ na dṛśyate na ca kartuṃ śakyate |
khaṇḍastvasya pradhānopayogitvaṃ tadupakāradvāraśca saṃskāraḥ pradhānamedādeṃda pratipadyamāno na dravyakatvāttatkartuṃ śakyate |
kutaḥ ? ‘na hyeṣa karma- saṃskāro hūyamānasya veṣyate |
’ karmasaṃskārarūpe hūyamāna- saṃskārapārthe vā tadbhedādabhedo bhavet |
yadyapi hyekadhanānohe- śenottarādhaṃ gṛhyīstathāpi tathā coditārthasya pradhānā- ntarāṇyapi kṛtāthāni bhaveyuḥ |
yattu pratipādyaṃ vibhaktīti, pratipadyante caturdhākaraṇe tadupayujyate |
śā— sarvapṛṣṭhyāyāṃ ‘indrāya rāyantarāya’ ityādinā ṣaṭ karmāṇi vihitāni |
tatra kiṃ pratikarma medena sviṣṭa- kṛdidaṃ avadyata uta sakṛditi saṃśayaḥ |
tāvataiva hi sarveṣāṃ kṛtaṃ syāda- viśeṣataḥ |
sūtrārthastu- dravyābhede'pi karmabhedāt sviṣṭakṛdādīni pratikarma medena kriyan |
puroḍāśastatra śeṣakāryaṃ kiṃ bhidyate na vā |

bhāṭṭa— sarvapṛṣṭhyāyāṃ ‘indrāya rāyantarāya nirvepati, indrāya vārhatpāya, indrāya vairūpāya’ ityādi ṣaḍḍhaviṣyāyāṃ ṣaḍbhyo'pi nirupya sahāvaghātapeṣaṇe kṛtvā prakṛtitvat vibhāge prāpte, tankṛtvā vacanādekameva rathacakramātraṃ puroḍāśaṃ kṛtvā ‘samantataḥ paryavadyati’ iti vacanena samantataḥ paryavadāya pradhānāni kriyante |
na ca dravyaikatvāttantrā, avadāna- pradeśamedena tattaduttarārdhādīnāṃ medāt |

na ca saṃskāra- vākyānāṃ parasparānvaye pramāṇābhāvena uttarārdhasya avadānapradeśapratiyogikatvābhāvāt prakaraṇena haviḥprati- yogikatvapratīteḥ tasya ca puroḍāśakyena sādhāraṇatvāt dravyaikatvamiti vācyam, tattaddevatāyai bahusudhiparimi-
syaiva nirasta haviṣtvena puroḍāśasya atra haviḥprakṛti- tayā haviṣtvābhāvāt |

na ca tathā''pi haviḥ saṃsṛṣṭa- tvena sādhāraṇyāccāgākāle indrāya rāyantarāya yantriṣṭaṃ tattatsme na mama iti pratyekaṃ saṃkalpe'pi saṃsṛṣṭotrā- ghāṃdeḥ agrahyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt tantratvaṃ śeṣakāryāṇāmiti vācyam, tathā'pi ‘na chātrānyājān’ itivat ‘dvirendrāvayavasya bhakṣayati, dvirhetasya vaṣaṭ karoti’ ityanena pradānamedasa śeṣakāryamede hetutvāvagamātta- danyathā''nupapattikatve'pi tasmin medoṣapattiḥ |
iti prāpte, ‘tena chātraṃ kriyate’ ityetat vicau laṭo bhūta- kālalakṣaṇopetapekṣastattutimātraparatvādviṣayatā, gamaka- mātrasya ca nyāyaprāptatvatvādvādhātvā'nupapatteḥ sakṛdeva śeṣakāryāṇi |
‘na chātra’ ityatra tu lakṣaṇābhāvādetu- vidhilamiti viśeṣaḥ |
aindrāyave tu vacanādeva bhakṣā- vṛttiriti vaiṣamyam |
’ sarvapṛṣṭheṣṭi- karmaṇi pradātṛ puroḍāśāt ‘sakṛt’ ekameva bhavati śeṣakāryamiti śeṣaḥ |
atra pradānānāṃ medaḥ, paraṃtu śeṣakāryaṃ sakṛdeva kāryam, na ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ pṛthak |
7|3|13-16 mī. pṛ. 220 ‘atideśaḥ : viśvajiti ṣaḍḍhapṛṣṭhatantram’ ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
sarvasvamapi (adhikamapi) jyotiṣṭome dvādaśa- śatadakṣiṇayā ṛtvigātmabhāve dātavyam |
6|7|4|16. mī. pṛ. 3689 ‘viśvajiti vidya- mānasyaiva sarvasvasya dānam’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
6|5|18|9-53. mī. pṛ. 497 ‘apacchedyogapaye adākṣiṇyaḥ’ ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
6|7| 8|14-17. mī. ko. pṛ. 750 ‘aṣṭarātrasye'pi viśvajiti sarvasvadānam’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vi. 6|7| 8. sarvasvadānameva (na dvādaśaśataṃ) udgātrapa- cchedasya paratve tannimittakapunaḥprayoge |
6|5|20|55. mī. ko. pṛ. 122 ‘udgātrapacchedasya paratve’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
sarvasvadāne'pi viśvajiti, pratiṣiddhatvāt aśvādīnāṃ dānamiti vakṣyati (6|7| 3|4) |
bhāṣyam— idaṃ ānamasti ‘viśvajiti sarvasvaṃ dadāti’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ : kiṃ yāvatkiṃcit svaśabde- nocyate, yathā mātā-pitṛttvevamāpi, tatsarvaṃ deyaṃ uta yatra prabhutvayogena svaśabdastadeva deyamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? aviśeṣāt mātā pitṛtvevamāpi dātavyam |
na hi kathaṃ- citpitā na pitā bhavati |
na satvaṃ na pādānaṃ ca dānaṃ dadāterarthaḥ |
yasya prabhutvayogena svatvaṃ tadeva deyam, netat |
na hi pitrādīnāṃ śakyate svatvaṃ parityaktum |
nanu yatra svaśabdo vartate tadeyamityukte pitrādayo dātavyā gamyante|
tasmāt tān prati prayuktāya smṛtiṃ bādhitvā''pi yatitvayamiti|
svaśabdo'yamātmīyadhanajñātīnāṃ pratyekaṃ vācako na sama- dāyasya|
tatrā''mīye sarvatāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ kṛte śāstrātheṃ, nāśakayeṣu jñātiṣu sarvatā kalpanīyā, nāpi smṛtibādhi- tavyā|
api ca gavādīnāmātmīyānāṃ codakena prāptau satyāmavaśyamātmīyatā sarvatopādeyā|
tasyāṃ copāttāyāṃ kṛtaḥ śāstrārtha iti jñātimāmudāne na kiṃcikāraṇa- masti|
tasmāccaiva prabhutva- yogena svatvam, tadeva deyamiti|
soma-- pūrveṣu pādeṣu ekapadaparyeālocanādaviśeṣataḥ prakṛtatvādhikārāt padāntaravākyāntarādavichalāt vyavasthā kathitā|
iha tu yatpadaparyeālocanāt aviśeṣataḥ prasaktiḥ tapadabalādeva viśeṣe vyavasthāpyate iti pādāntarasatvasya sūkṣmatvāt ānantyaṃ ca|
tatra pitrādīnāmapi jñātivena svaśabdavācya- tvāt dhanadeva dānam|

na ca pitrādiṣu yatheṣṭavini- yojyatvarūpasvatvasya 'svāmī rikyakrayavibhāgapari- grahādhigameṣu' ityādisvatvahetubhāvenāsaṃbhavāt, pitṛ- tvādyatirekeṇa ātmīyatvābhāvāt svatvavyāptaghaṭitadattā- karmatvānupapattiḥ|
astu vā tadanurodhena parasva- tvāpādanameva dānapadārthaḥ|
iti prāpte, pariṣedhīyakaraṇa- mātreṇa lekhe dānaśabdaprayogāmāvāt svatvatyāgapūrvaka- parasvatvāpādanameva dānapadārthaḥ|
na ca pitrādau svatve pramāṇamasti, svatvahetūnāmabhāvāt|
na ceha tadāśrayaṇaṃ yuktam, svaśabdasya svatvāśrayībhūtadhanaparatvenāpi upapatteḥ|
kiṃca ayaṃ svaśabdaḥ pratyekaśaktyaivātmīyajñātineṣu pravartate, sarvānu- gataikaśaktyāvacchedakābhāvāt|
ataścaikasmin prayoge ekasyaivāthasya ājñātatvādyanurodhena dhanasyaiva grahaṇam|
' sarvasve viśvajiti deyatvena vihite, jñātayaḥ pitrādayaḥ na syuḥ, api tu gavādivanameva ityāśayaḥ|
'maraṇakāmo hyatena yajeta, yaḥ kāmayetānāmayaḥ svargaṃ lokamidām' iti|
'maraṇakāmo hyatena yajeta yaḥ kāmayeta anāmayaḥ svargaṃ lokamidām' iti vidhivakyam|
tatra ca 'ārbhave prastuyamāne audumbarī sadasena vāsasā pariveṣṭaya brāhmaṇāḥ parisamāpayata me yajñamiti saṃpreṣya viśati' iti|
yathā, 'yadi somamapahareyuḥ, vidhāvate- cchateti brūyāt' iti|
atha yaduktam, jīvan kartā bhavati, na mṛtaḥ iti|
yadā asau prayuktavāstadā tāva- tparisamāptistena na kṛtā|
yadvavān muktasaṃśayaṃ jīvantaṃ kartāraṃ manyate tenaitattutyam|
yo''pi parisamāpyatete preṣya pari- samāptikāle jīvati, tasyāpi jīvanaṃ parisamāpanakāle'- nupakārakam, pūrvapreṣādevāvasya kartṛtvamupapadyate iti|
athavā, pratyakṣameva parisamāptervacanam 'brāhmaṇāḥ saṃsthāpayata me yajñam' iti|
śā-- sarvasvāro nāma ekādaḥ svargakāmasya vihitaḥ|
tatra ārbhavastotrakāle 'brāhmaṇāḥ samāpayata me yajñam' iti preṣaṃ ṛtvigbhyaḥ pradāya yajamāno mriyate|
tasminmṛte śeṣaṃ karma samāpanīyaṃ na veti saṃśaye na samāpyam, mṛtasya kartṛtvasaṃbhavāt iti pūrvapakṣe
siddhāntamāha- 'yathasaṃbhavi kartṛtvaṃ tata evaṃ bhave- didam|
jīvanneva tu saṃpreṣāt śiṣṭaṃ kartṛtva- mucchati|
' 'varaṇabharaṇādisāmācaraṇameva jīvadavasthāyā- mapi yajamānasya kartṛtvam, tacca maraṇottarakālabhāvi- nyapi karmaśeṣe jīvadavasthāyāmeva saṃvidhānena saṃbhavati|
pratyakṣameva ca 'samāpayata' iti preṣeṇa samāptiśco- mānā na śakyā apahnotum|
soma-- kāmanāmāvāccaistattvādidaṃnivṛttau kimu vaktavyaṃ kāmayiturabhāve ityudhiteḥ|
sūtrā- rthaistu- diṣṭagatau yajamānasya maraṇe sarvasvārasya samāpanaṃ na vidyate, sarvasyāpi karmaṇaḥ jīvadadhikārakatvena mṛtasya adhikārāsaṃbhavāt iti|
ci-- 'sarvasvāro mṛterūdhvaṃ tyajyatāṃ vā samāpya- tām|
' bhāṭṭa-- asti sarvasvāro nāma yajñaḥ 'maraṇa- kāmo hyatena yajeta yaḥ kāmayeta anāmayaḥ svargaṃ lokamidām' iti vākyena svargārthatayā vihitaḥ|
'ārbhave prastuyamāne ārbhavaṃ praviśati' ityanena copāyavidhānāt maraṇamatrājñatayā vidhīyate|
ataśca maraṇottarakālaṃ sa kratuḥ samāpanīyo na veti cintāyāṃ mṛtasyāsthiyaśavat kartṛtvasaṃbhavāt maraṇāntasyaiva svargasādhanatvāt na samāpanīyaḥ|

iti prāpte, 'ārbhave prastuyamāne audumbarī sadasena vāsasā pariveṣṭaya brāhmaṇāḥ parisamāpayata me yajñamiti saṃpreṣya praviśati' iti vacanena samāpanapraiṣavidhānāttasya ca darśayatva- lāmāya laiṅgikasamātividhivikalpakatvāttatastadaṅgalena ca mṛtasyāpi ṛtvikprayojakatvopapatteḥ samāpanīya eva kratuḥ|
yattu kaiścit praiṣasyaivāsya 'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' itivat samāpanavidhāyakatvamityuktam, tat brāhmaṇā iti saṃbodhanena vidhiśaktiprativandhakāt karmakāle prayojya- tvānupapatteścāpekṣitam|
sakalaiḥ ṛtvarthayaiva varaṇamaraṇayoḥ prakṛtāvivā'nuṣṭhānāt tadalena ca jīvadavasthāyāmapi mṛtāvasthāyāmapi ṛtvijāṃ kartṛtvopapattiḥ |
ata eva jyotiṣṭomādikamantareṇa- yaiva diśā'ntarā maraṇe ṛtvigbhiḥ samāpanam |
evaṃ ca preṣyasya vidhikalpakatvāme'pi samāpanasārakatvenaiva dṛṣṭārthateti dhyeyam ||
('yathā paresu sarva- svārān' 5|1|2|136 sūtrāṃśaḥ) sarvasvāramantrāt kratoḥ parastāt yāni 'karmāṇi svādhyāye vihitāni, teṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ pūrvapakṣe kevalamadṛṣṭārthaḥ svīkṛtavyaḥ syāt |
bhā. 5|1|2|136. sarvasvārasya diṣṭagatau samāpanaṃ na vidyate karmaṇo jīvasaṃyogāt |
tatra madhyataḥ- kārisamāravyānāṃ hotṛbrahmodgātṛyajamānānāṃ catvāra- śramasāḥ; maitrāvaruṇabrāhmaṇācchaṃsipotṛneṣṭṛacchāvākīgrāṇāṃ hotrāṇāṃ ṣaṭ |
tatra prātaḥsavane śukrāmanthipracāre acchāvākacamasavarjaṃ nava camasāḥ savanamukhyāḥ prathamamindrāya hūyante |
yathā prātaḥsavanaṃ daivānmānuṣāt pratibandhāt utkṛṣyamāṇaṃ mādhyaṃdine savanamutkarṣitā tathā sāṃtapanīyā utkṛṣyamāṇā prātaragnihotramutkarṣet iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
puroḍāśasya ( paśau upakrānte śravaṇam, yena tantramadhya- |
tatra hi prakrānte daśaṃ katipayeḥ padārthaiḥ |

prātaḥsavanikānāṃ tu ' agnimaya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamānaḥ ' ityādi ukta - yadyapi sahaiva paśunopakramaḥ iti na tadalocanayā kasya vākyamaiṣo maitrāvaruṇakartṛko'bhīṣomīyāt paśoścadena tantritvaṃ kasya prasaṅgitamiti niyantuṃ śakyam |
