tatra hi 'ya iṣṭyā' ityādivākyena sāṅkaprayogasya paurṇa- māsyādikālavidhānāt ātideśikadvyahakālatvānugrahe ca tadbādhaprasaṅgāt yuktaṃ sadyaskālatvam |
prakṛte tu prātarādi- kālakatvasya dinadvaye'pi saṃbhavāt dvyahakālatvameva |
ataśca trayodaśyāṃ prātarādikāleṣu trayāṇāmapi anuṣṭhānaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāṃ prātarādikāleṣu yāgā iti draṣṭavyam |
karmamadhye karmāntarārambhastu 'dvyahaṃ sākamedhena' iti vacanāt naiva duṣyati|
yadi tu prasaṅgasiddhirāśaṅkyeta tadā astu trayodaśyāṃ prātaḥ sakṛdeva anvādhāya bahu-rdaivyāṃ prātarādikeṣu yāgāḥ |
aṅgānuṣṭhānaṃ tu pūrvārddhānāṃ anīkavatyā saha, uttarāṅgānāṃ tu sāṃtapanīyā saha |
kecittu ekādaśīprabhṛti dvyahakālaṃ pṛthakprayogaṃ iṣṭimarthaṃ pūrvapakṣe kartavyaṃ iti vadanti |
iti prāpte, ekasmin prātarādike vihitasya sāṅgatatvaprayogasya dvyahakālatvapakṣe aupadeśikakālatva-bādhāpatteḥ |
na ca sāyaṃprātaḥśabdayoḥ adhyayanatvena ekavacanāntatve pramāṇabhāvaḥ |
ramikramet' iti vākyena sāṃnāyyāṅgabhūtamanabhikramaṇa- māśrayatvenocyate, kumbho nirūpakatvena, anyat sarva- manūdyate |
vākyabhedaśca na, nipātatvādiṣṭabhāvanā- vidhānādvā ityuktaṃ dvitīye |
tadatra sāṃnāyyādvayā strigdhadādidoṣakathāyāni kartavyāni na veti cintāyām, abhibhramaṇe kumbhīsāhitye'pi āhavanīyapradeśaṃ gatvā caturavattaṃ ādāya eva homātpaścāt śeṣasadbhāvena karta- vyāni |
iti prāpte, na atra apūrvamabhikramaṇamāśritya- medkapramāṇābhāvāt, api tu sāṃnāyyaprakṣepāṅgabhūta- meva |
tādṛśābhikramaṇakartuḥ kumbhīnāṃ sāhityaṃ ca kartṛbhikramaṇakālīnanayanasaṃskāryatvam, nānyat |

kathaṃ nu tāsāṃ sādhutvaṃ, naivaṃ tāḥ sādhavo matāḥ ||
sāṃtapanīyasya māghyadine nirupyate iti vacanāt madhyadinakālānyeva aṅgāni bhavanti |
vastutaḥ sādhutvajñānaṃ na kāraṇam, nāpi asādhutvajñānaṃ pratibandhakam |
kintu tādṛśasamabhivyāhārasya tādṛśa-kāṅkṣāyā vā hetutvāt noktātiprasaṅga iti yuktam |
sāṃtapanīyā iṣṭiḥ cāturmāsyagata-sākamedhasya madhyadine kartavya syakālaḥ |
sādhubhāṣaṇasya sarvadā niyame maune doṣaḥ aparihāryaḥ |
svābhiprāyaprakāśanadvārā arthajñāpanārtha mauninā aśninikocādinā kriyamāṇaṃ na śreyaḥsādhanam |
bhojanādau maunavidhāne śākādeḥ nivāraṇādi hasta-saṃjñādinā na kāryam |
cāturmāsyeṣu sākamedhayavaḥ māghyadine sāṃtapanīyā nāma iṣṭiḥ 'marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyo māghyadine caruṃ nirvapati' iti |
sā daivānmānuṣādā pratibandhāt sāyaṃ-mādikāle utkṛpyamānā sāyamagnihotrahomaṃ utkarṣeṇa vā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
pūrve prāptikasya utkarṣabhāva uktaḥ, tadelakṣaṇārtheḥ tu-śabdaḥ |
sāyamagnihotramapi utkarṣeta iti pūrvapakṣe savanavat iti yo dṛṣṭānta uktaḥ, taṃ nirasituṃ siddhāntapakṣīyaṃ sūtra- midam|
savanena prātaḥsavanena pratibandhakatvāt mādhya- dinādikāle utkarṣena mādhyandinaṃ savanamutkṛṣyate iti yaḥ savanotkarṣa uktaḥ sa savanāt ekaprakṛtyantvāt yuktaḥ|
agnihotrahomasya tu na sākamedhaiḥ na vā sāṃtapa- nīyā saṃbandhaḥ|
'dvāda- śāhena prajākāmaṃ yājayet' iti dvādaśāhanimittakāla- vidhirayam, ataśca sāṃtapanīyānyāyena ātideśika- kālabādhāt sājñānāṃ dvādaśasutānāṃ dvādaśadinasamāpya- tvātgateḥ, ityādiḥ|
bhāṣyam-- cāturmāsyeṣu sākamedhāvayavaḥ sāṃta- panīyā nāmeṣṭiḥ |
'marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyo mādhyandine caruṃ nirvapati' iti sā vaiśvānarapaśunā pratibandhā- dutkṛṣyamāṇā agnihotramutkarṣet veti saṃśaye |
yadi notkarṣe'gnihotraṃ anagnihotrakāle ucyate'gnihotraṃ triguṇaṃ syāt |
yathā prātaḥsavanaṃ devamānuṣādvā pratibandhādutkarṣamāṇaṃ mādhya- dinaṃ savanamutkarṣatīti |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ sāṃtapanīyamagnihotraṃ na vyava- hitaṃ bhaviṣyati |
kramamede ca doṣaḥ śrayate 'apa vā etadyajñasya chidyate, yada- nyasya tantre vitate'nyasya tantraṃ pratāyate' iti |
bhāṣyam-- nāmihotrasya sāṃtapanīyā aṅgam, na sāṃtapanīyāyā vā'gnihotram |
'sāyaṃ juhoti' 'prātarjuhoti' 'udite juhoti' 'anudite juhoti' 'prathamāstamite juhoti' 'saṃghe juhoti' 'nakṣatrāṇi dṛṣṭvā juhoti' iti |
tadapāye aśrutameva sarvaṃ kriyeta tannimittatvaṃ cānupādeyatvena śravaṇāt |
ḍup-- kāle hi nimitte karma vidhīyamānaṃ tasminneva kāle kartavyam |
'aṅgamātre'nyaḥ kālavidhirdhyāta- miti cet' setikartavyatāke'tra prayoge'vadhṛte paścāt kālayogaḥ |
śā-- sāyaṃ kāle dvayoḥ saṃnipatitayoḥ avaśyaṃ- bhāvini paurvāparye, sāṃtapanīyāṃ kṛtvā kriyamāṇasyāgni- hotrasya kālātipannasaṅge sati nyāyyaṃ iti yuktā cintā |
tatra sāṃtapanīyā tāvat svakālaṃ mādhyandina- matipadyaiva, na tasyāḥ kaścit ubhayathā'pi viśeṣaḥ |
agnihotrasya anyataḥ praṇayanajanyopakāralāme tadanāhe- syāt, utkarṣe tu kālalopaḥ |
tatra kasyānugrahaḥ; kasya lopaḥ iti cintyate |
tatra mukhyatvāt praṇayānanugrahe sāṅga- prayogācāraṇottarakālaprāpteḥ kālasya jaghanyatvena bādhaḥ, iti prāpte, ucyate |
kālasyānupādeyatvena nimitta- viśeṣaṇatvāt tasmin prātarmāgnihotraṃ kiṃciddharmaprahāyāpi kartavyam |
tasmāt agnihotraṃ hutvā sāṃtapanīyā samāpa- nīyā |
soma-- pūrvatra jaghanyapāṭhakramavat iha jaghanyakālasya bādha iti pratyavasānāt saṃgatiḥ |
na ca kālasya adhikāraviśeṣaṇatvāt tadabhāve adhikārābhāvāt kathamagnihotrānuṣṭhānamiti vācyam |

kālasya adhikāri- viśeṣaṇatvenāśravaṇāt, iti cenna, aśvavaṇe'pi kālasyā- nupādeyatā yadā svayameva kāla āpatati, tadā karma kartavyam, ityarthāt kālataḥ adhikāraparyavasānāt kāla- syādhikāraviśeṣaṇatvasya adhikāratvāt |
sūtrārthastu- yathā prātaḥsavanamutkṛṣyamāṇaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanamutkarṣati, evaṃ sāṃtapanīyā'pi utkṛṣyamāṇā agnihotramutkarṣet, tadā agnihotrasya praṇayanābhāvena vaiguṇyāt iti |
vi-- 'daivāt sāṃtapanī sāyaṃ prāptā cedagnihotra- kam |

' bhāṭṭa-- daivāt mānuṣādvā pratibandhāt mādhyandina- kriyamāṇasāṃtapanīyā utkarṣe svakāle'gnihotram kartavyaṃ na veti cintāyām, svakālakaraṇe sāṃtapanī- yā'rthe praṇītasyāgneḥ punaḥ praṇayanasaṃbhavāt mantravatpraṇa- yanalopena vaiguṇyāpatteḥ, kālasya ca padārthaguṇatvena prayogavidhiviśeṣaṇatvottarakālapratītivalena ca lope'pi vaiguṇyābhāvāt utkarṣaḥ |
iti prāpte, anupādeyatvāt kālasya nitye yathāśakti upādeyāṅgatvāt tadanu- rodhena paṣṭhe vakṣyamāṇatvāt (6|1|1) praṇayanalopenāpi kālānugrahaḥ eva nyāyyaḥ |
vastutastu, agnihotrasya anyataḥ praṇayanajanyopakāralāme tadanāhe- patvasya darśadau klṛptatvāccope'pi na vaiguṇyam |
ataḥ svakāle evāgnihotraṃ kṛtvā sāṃtapanīyā kartavyeti sāṃtapanīyājñānāṃ naiva krama ādaraṇīyaḥ |
anāvanadyakaviṣaye 'apa vā eta- dyajñasya chidyate yadantyasya tantre vitate'nyasya tantraṃ pratāyate' iti niṣedhāt |

na caivamanīkavatvyutkarṣe'pi madhyadine sāṃtapanīyāpattiḥ, tathātve sāṃtapanīyāyā anīkavattvottarakālatvasyaiva prayogavicchedyatayaiva praṇayanasya ca bādhena varamekasyaiva madhyadinakālasya bādhaḥ |
kecittu nimittaviśeṣaṇabhūtakālasyaivānuṣṭhānatvāt, na tu kāla- mātrasyeyaṅgīkṛtya sāṃtapanīyāyāḥ kāmyavat madhye'nāva- śyakatvātkaraṇīyamiti vadanti |
tattu cāturmāsyānāmapi nityatvāt mādhyandinasyāpi nimittaviśeṣaṇatvāpatte- rapekṣitam |
bhā. 10|8|14|144, sāṃnāyyaṃ ekena vākyena soma- yājinaḥ vidhīyate, apareṇāpi vākyena asomayājinaḥ |
somayāgāt prāk, somayāgāt paścāt tu sāṃnāyyameva iti siddhāntaḥ |
somayājina eva sāṃnāyyam, asomayājinastu puroḍāśena āgneyadhai- ndrāgma nityau ityeva siddhāntaḥ |
8|2|13|15 - 18. 'sāṃnāyyaṃ vā tatpabhavatvāt' (8|2|14|13) ityanenaiva nyāyena ayamavagamyataḥ (hṛdayasyāme- vayati) sārūpyāt sāṃnāyyavatprakṛtiḥ |
idaṃ saṃyata eva, sāṃnāyyarahitena tu daśa~ śālāpraharaṇaṃ na dravyasārūpyāt paśuyāgasya aṣṭame sāṃnāyyayāgavikāratvā- |
kartavyam, na ca tadarthaṃ śālā saṃpādanīyā |
saṃyataḥ darśapūrṇamāsayo havirnirvāpe tatkṣandrodaye sati sārūpyāt sāṃnāyyāvadānaprakṛtikatvāvagateḥ, sāṃnāyyava- |
abhyudayeṣṭirvihitā, tatra sāṃnāyyāsyāpi pūrvadevatātyāgena dānasya ca yāgīyadravyasaṃskāratvena asyāpi tathātvā- |
'ye syaviṣṭhāḥ (taṇḍulāḥ) tānindrāya pradāne darśaśrvaṃ, vasāyāt hṛdayadīnāṃ saṃskāratvānupapattyā pūtka- |
ye'gniṣṭhāstān viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śrute carum' ityatra phalacamasavat yāgasampadāyānupapattiḥ |
sāṃnāyyaṃ somottaramukta- sāṃnāyyaṃ somādapyatsukṛṣyate ' nātomayyā saṃna- |
tatra sāṃnāyyenaḥ caruṃ dadhasi payasi yyāt svacchakṛddhidaṃ nityaṃ amāvāsyāyāmavadyate |
ca syātām, sāṃnāyyarahitasya tu pūrvadadhipayasorābhāvāt vā. 3|5|2|13, sāṃnāyyasya guṇavikāraḥ |
5|4|2. sāṃnāyye dohanaṃ svānāṃ sarvāsāṃ svacchakṛdavadānaṃ prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇaṃ vedyāmāsādanaṃ ca |
bhā. 9|1|9|47-53. sāṃnāyye dvira- pravṛttikamāt pūrvaṃ na kartavyaṃ kiṃtu mukhyakramāt āgneya- |
bhā. 6|4| 13|141-42. sāṃnāyya eva avadānādipradānataḥ ekaḥ padārthaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 5|2|6, sāṃnāyye upa- staraṇāmighāraṇayosta-ntrāt dadhno hyavadānaṃ gṛhītvā payaso grāhyam |
kalpasūtre tu payaso hyavadānaṃ gṛhītvā paścādadhnaḥ ityuktam |
krameṇa samākhyā vādhitvā 'śunadhvaṃ' iti mantraḥ sāṃnāyyapātraśeṣaḥ |
tathā ca asaṃnayataḥ vatsāpākaraṇābhāve'pi tadupalakṣite kāle vratopānayanaṃ (bhojanam) |
sāṃnāyyaṃ prakṛtya śrūyate 'na dārupātreṇa dugdhādami- vadai dārupātram, yaddārupātreṇa dugdhādātyannā haviṣā yajeta |
atho khalvāhuḥ puroḍāśamulāni vai havīṃṣi netaḥ itaḥ puroḍāśaṃ haviṣo yāmo'stīti kāmameva dārupātreṇa dugdhāt ' iti |
dāruṇo- 'ntarameḥ satvena dārudevatvasya'pi agni saṃdhanānpāyā- dancūnāvāgneyāyeva yāgo saṃpadyo |
tasya cāmitāpādaka- tvāt tatparijihīrṣayā 'puroḍāśamultāni vai' iti vākyenāgneyasāṃnāyyayormadhye yāgāntaraṃ puroḍāśadvaya- mupāgnyājavadvidhīyate |
tasyāpi payodravyatve ukta- rītyā agni saṃdhanāndhājitātādavasthyāpatyā tadanmuktiḥ |
tulyanyāyena madhyasthayāgasyāgnidevatātve'pi sāmitāna- pāyāt taditaradevatātve siddhe 'indrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi' iti prakaraṇamātmāntarātpuruṣāthryeṇa eva
gatāgnīṣomīyapuroḍāśarūpā prakṛtikṣa yathā iṣṭipūrvādhāna- iva vidhikalpanā'pi na duṣyatīti bodhāyanakalpā- |
prakṛtitvat vikṛtiḥ iti nuguṇe pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntastu jāteṣṭivākye iva |
candrodayaṃ nimittīkṛtya apadhṛtatvāt praṇītādharmā dārupātre ca doṣasadbhāvādayuktatāmivāśaṅkayo khalvi- |
vi. 9|2|14. tyādinā tadabhāvaṃ samarthya kāmamiti nigamanāvākye |
sāṃnāyyārthe tiṣṭhamyo'dhikāḥ sarvāḥ gāvā go vidheḥ spaṣṭaṃ pratīteḥ |
1|1|16|147-53. mīko. pṛ. 1098 vākyabhedaḥ syādeva, āgneyavākye devatāttaditādinā |
na sarve sarvatra saṃbhave'pi dravyamātraśravaṇeṇa kathaṃ tatkalpanā |
kartavyāḥ; kiṃtu yatra kriyamāṇā arthavantaḥ tatra te yāgasya spaṣṭamakīrtanāt kathamanucitā''vagamaḥ |
vikṛtīnāṃ jyotiṣṭomottaratvaṃ tathā somavikārāṇāṃ darśa- doṣamāśākayātāyāmarūpapuroḍāśasya prathamaṃ sattvāt- |
vṛ. 5|4|126. duścaraṃ kriyamāṇaṃ sarvamayātāmameveti parihṛtya paścādā- |
sāṃnāyyadohe 'ananyamasya tūṣṇīmuttarā rupātraṃ vidhīyate ityeva yuktamiti |
dohayati' atra prāptaṃ sarvottaradohanamanūca apūrvamana- sāṃnāyya makṣaḥ rājanyavaiśyayoḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ |
vi. 11|1|9, sāṃnāyyadohe 'na rājanyo na vaiśyo vā sāṃnāyyaṃ pibet, asomapītho |
sāṃnāyyadharmāḥ vatsāpākaraṇādayaḥ pūrvamāmnātāḥ sāṃnāyyapriyomīyayoḥ ūrdhvaṃ somāt |
pravṛttikramaṃ sāṃnāyyasya pūrvaṃ na kartavyaṃ kiṃtu āgneyasyaiva sāṃnāyyaṃ śṛtaṃ dadhi ca amāvāsyāyām |
ityādayaḥ somāt agneiṣomānuṣṭhānottaraṃ syuḥ na prāk |
8|2|12|10-14. mīko. pṛ. 100 ‘amīṣomīyaḥ paśoḥ sāṃnāyyavikāraḥ’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhā. 8|2|12|9-11. sāṃnāyyapakṣe śākhā satī hi pratipācyate |
8|2|12|19-24. mīko. pṛ. 222 ‘atideśaḥ vaiśvadevyāmikṣāyāṃ sāṃnāyyapayodharmāṇām’ ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
nanu vikalpo bhaviṣyatītyuktam, prakaraṇaviśeṣāt pāśvadasyena na vikalpaḥ, viṣamaśanāt |
vikṛtau tu ānumānikaṃ pāśvadasyaṃ bādhitvā anārabhyavidhivākyena pratyakṣeṇa pāśvadasyaṃ niveśyate |
tatra pūrvādhikaraṇenaiva sāmidhenīkhāsadasyanyārambhavadāsya prakṛtyatve, prakaraṇā- dhītena pāśvadasyena saha vikalpa iti viśeṣaśaṅkā nivartayati |
kathaṃ punaḥ prākaraṇikena viśeṣavidhinā saha atulyabalasya vikalpo'midhīyate ? āha |
' tulyapramāṇako hi viśeṣo bādhako bhavati, na durbalapramāṇakaḥ |
na ca ṛtuprayogadasya tatra sāmidhenī cintyate |

sāma-- anuṣṭup, abhīvarte, ānvīgavaṃ, āmahīyavaṃ, auśanaṃ, kārpaṇaṃ, kāleyaṃ, kāvaṃ, kautsaṃ, krauñcāni, gāyatraṃ, naudhasaṃ, pauṣpalaṃ, yajñayajñīyaṃ, yaudhājayaṃ, rathaṃtaraṃ, rauravaṃ, vāmadevyaṃ, vāsiṣṭhasya janine śarīraṃ, ityāvaśyaṃ, ślokaṃ, saṃhitaṃ, sapkam |
sāma arthataḥ paripūrṇe ekasmin vākye gātavyam |
tadāhuḥ śabarā- cāryāḥ - " pratyṛcaṃ gānaṃ kartavyam |
yathā goṣṭhaḥ vāsiṣṭhaḥ iti (nāmnī dve sāmanī) |
evaṃ yāvati paripūrṇaṃ vākyaṃ tāvati sāma parismāpayitavyam |
kvacit pāde'pi pūrṇaṃ vākyaṃ ṛcyapi, kacidadha
kiṃ pragītaṃ mantravākyaṃ sāma uta gītimātraṃ sāma iti uttaravicāropapodātastvena smāraṇārthe vicāre pūrva- pakṣamāha |
mantraṃ pragītaṃ sāmāni iti eke manyante |
pragītaṃ mantravākyaṃ sāmaḥ iti hi smaranti cchāndasāḥ |
'ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya, yamṛṣayaścayavidā viduḥ |
ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajūṃṣi' iti mantraprakāraḥ kaścit sāmāni iti upadeśaśca bhavati |
tasmāt smṛteḥ upadeśācca pragītā mantrāḥ sāmāni iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
athavā ūhasāmāni nityāni apauruṣeyāṇi uta anityāni pauruṣeyāṇi iti vicāre apauruṣeyāṇi mantra- bhūtāni nityāni ārṣāṇi ityeke manyante |
smṛtyupa- deśābhyām, 'mantrabhūtānyetānyetāni ārṣāṇi nityāni' iti smṛteḥ |
yadi cāyaṃ pauruṣeyaḥ syāt na pramāṇaṃ syāt |
tasmāt ūhyamyo nityaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā ṛcaḥ sāmāni iti tattadudoṣaṃ uktaḥ |
ṛcaḥ sāmatve ṛcaḥ pradeśo nopapadyate 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti deśalakṣaṇā dharmalakṣaṇā vā prāpnoti ityuktaṃ ( 7|2|1|13 ) tasmāt gītayaḥ sāmāni, na pragītāni mantravākyānīti |
athavā yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā ūhamanyo nitya ityādi tat bhavato vacanaṃ taddoṣaṃ bhavadaccanaiva tasya doṣa ukto bhavati |
yaduktaṃ smṛternitya- teti, neṣā smṛtiḥ pramāṇam |
bhavati hi vacanaṃ 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti atideśa- vacanāt nyāyena evaṃ gātavyaṃ iti vācanikaṃ prathamaṃ vijñānam |

ke. sāmāni- rathaṃtaram, bṛhat, vairūpam, vairājam, śākkaram, raivatam, naiśokam, gāyatram, āma- hīyavam, rauravam, yodhāyajam, auśanam, vāmadevyam, naudhasam, kāliyam, saṃhitam, dyāvāśam, āndhī- gavam, sapham, pauṣkalam, kāyam, yaśayaśīyam, simā-saṃtani-yataya-evāgapatya-śākaravarṇam iti |
rathaṃtaraṃ, bṛhat, vairūpaṃ, vairājaṃ, śākkaraṃ, raivataṃ, etāni sāmāni dvādaśāhagatapṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe krameṇa dṛṣṭu ahaḥsu gīyante |
vikṛtau ( gavāmayane pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe ) api ekena sādhitavyaṃ codakānugrahāya |
bhāṣyam- kacit karmaviśeṣe śrūyate 'ṛcā stuvate' 'sāmnā stuvate' 'yadṛcā stuvate tadasurā anvavāyan, yatsāmnā stuvate tadasurā nānvavāyan |
ya evaṃ vidvān sāmnā stuvīta' iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? vikalpaḥ, ṛcā vā sāmnā vā ( iti ) |
bhinnamidaṃ vākyaṃ dṛśyate 'yadṛcā stuvate tadasurā anvavāyan' iti |
ṛcā stave kriyamāṇe asurā anvavagatā iti |
evamarthamidaṃ saṃkīrtyate, kathaṃ nāma gamyate ṛcā stotavyamiti |
kimartham ? yasmin karmaviśeṣe śrūyate, tasyāṃ yathā syāt |
tasya prayoga- sāmarthyāt prayogavacane gamyate iti |
na vayaṃ nindatām ani- nditān vā asurān vidmaḥ |
stutirhi nirvartayatītyeti, tadanyatareṇa sidhyati iti vikalpaḥ |
yadi sāmna vidhāyakaḥ śrūyeta, tathā sati kāṃcit nindāṃ prakalpya sāmnāṃ stutyekavākyatā syāt |
itthaṃ ṛk śobhanā yadasurā api anāgata- pūrvāḥ tatrāgacchantīti |
'yadṛcā stuvate, tadasurā anvavāyan' 'yatsāmnā stuvate tadasurā nānvavāyan, ya evaṃ vidvān sāmnā stuvīta' iti sāmnā stutiḥ praśasyate pratyakṣeṇa praśaṃsāvacanena |
itarā kalpā syāt, 'ṛcā stvane asurā anugatāḥ, tasmāt ṛcā stotavyam' iti |
atha sāmnā svataḥ praśasyate, tato 'yadṛcā stuvate tadasurā anvavāyan' iti itarapraśaṃsāṃ nindeśā, na kiṃcit kalpayiṣyate iti |
dup-- 'sāmnā stuvate' iti sāmnaḥ stutau vidhānaṃ asurāṇāmagamanāntevādena |
asurāgamananindā- dvāreṇa sāmnā saha ekavākyatā yāti 'yadṛcā stuvate' ityetat |
itarā nindyā ninditāyāḥ praśaṃsāṃ kalpayitvā vākyadvayaṃ prakalpyam |
sāmnāmupasaṃhāre śravaṇāt 'ya evaṃ vidvān sāmnā stuvate' iti |
śā--- kacidvikṛtiviśeṣe kanicit aprākṛtāni stotrāṇi vihitāni |
teṣāṃ ca prakṛtitaḥ kiṃcit sādhanaṃ prāpnoti |
prākṛtānāṃ gāyatrarathaṃtarādisāmāṃ prākṛtīṣu bahiṣpavamānādistutiṣu nibaddhānāṃ aprākṛteṣu prāpyatvāt, tena tāni sākṣātkāṅkṣan |
tavedaṃ śrūyate 'yadṛcā stuvate tadasurā anvavāyan, yat sāmnā stuvate tadasurā nānvavāyan, ya evaṃ vidvān sāmnā stuvīta' iti |
sāmnā hi akṣarābhivyaktidvāreva stutiḥ kriyate, na sākṣāt |
tena 'sāmnā stuvīta' iti sāmābhivyakteḥ ṛgakṣaraiḥ stuvīta ityarthaḥ |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kimucā sāmnā vā stotavyaṃ uta sāmnaiveti |
sāmna upasaṃhāre vispaṣṭa- praśaṃsāvacanena vidheyatvāvagamāt ṛktaritaṃ asurāgama- nindyā sāmapraśaṃsārtham |
vi-- ṛksāmyābhyāṃ vikalpena stutiḥ sāmnaiva vā, 'gnimaḥ |
bhāṭṭa - sāmavede śākhābhedena ekasyaiva svara- samūhātmakasya sāmnaḥ ārohāvarohādibhedena prakārabhedā āmnātāḥ, ekasyaiva rāgasya deśabhedena prakārabhedat |
teṣāṃ ca prakārāṇāṃ ekagītyarthatvāt śrīhiyavādivadeva vikalpaḥ siddha eva prabandhāt snāyate |
evaṃ vā, vikṛtiviśeṣe kanicidaprākṛtāni stotrāṇi vihitāni |
teṣu ca yūpavātāstaraṇārthernindyena na prākṛtānāṃ rathaṃtarādisāmāṃ ṛcāṃ vā prāptiḥ, prākṛtastotra- viśeṣeṣveva teṣāṃ nibaddhatvāt |
tatkaraṇe cedaṃ śrutam- 'yadṛcā stuvate tadasurā anvavāyan, yatsāmnā stuvate tadasurā nānvavāyan, tasmāt ya evaṃ vidvān sāmnā stuvīta' iti |
nahi ṛgāśrayaṃ vinā sāmnaḥ stotrādyanatā saṃbhavati |
atastatra pragītāpragītaṛgvikalpena sādhanatā uta pragītāyā eveti cintāyām, antimasā- khyātyasa yacchabdopapattatvena sāmavidhāyatvāttvāt |
ādyoreva aprāptārthatvādinā leṭvaniścayāt ṛksā- mayoḥ ubhayorepi vidhiḥ |
na cāturāgamanena ṛco ninditatvāt kathaṃ tadvidhiḥ ? niṣedhaikavākyatayā vinā nindātvasyaivā- pravīteḥ |
ataḥ atyantadurārādhyānāmapi ṛcā vaśīkaraṇāt vidheyavākyatayā asya stutimeva |
iti prāpte, vākyabheda-viṣamaśiṣṭa-vikalpādidoṣa- miyā yacchandopabandhasyāpi liṅa eva sāmavidhāyaka- tvam, na tu leṭvena saṃdigdhayoḥ |
ṛknindā'pi 'nahi nindā'- nyāyena vidheyasāmastutyartha eva iti pragītāyā eva sādhanatvam |
idaṃ cādhikaraṇaṃ yatra stotrāntarakaraṇe sāma, tadyonistatraiva na paṭhitāḥ tadipyam |
itaratra sāmnaḥ ṛcāṃ ca prakaraṇādineva aṅgatvopapatteḥ sāmavidhi- vaiyarthyāt |
ata eva prakṛtodāharaṇe sāmnā ityekavaca- nopādānāt ekameva sāma sāmavedādinevam |
'ekaṃ sāma tve kriyate' 'yacchonyāṃ gāyati' ityādiḥ dīkṣaṇīyāvāhaniyama- nyāyena prākṛtatattvottamīyameva uddeśena aprākṛte amṛṣṭeḥ |
ṛjutatprākṛtacatuṣṭomalavādiguṇānurodhāt ekasyā eva pragītāyā ṛcaḥ tāvaddārambhāsaḥ |
nanu evaṃ yatra aprākṛtastotrāntaraprakaraṇe yoniḥ uttarā ca āmnātā tatrottarayoḥ sāmni pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
yatra ca saṃjñādibhiḥ stotrāntaramupāttam, na ca prakaraṇe ṛcaḥ paṭhitāḥ, na vā prakṛtodāharaṇe sāmavidhiḥ, tatra stotravidhitvasyā'nupapattyā ṛcāmānaye'pi sāmā- nayane pramāṇābhāvaḥ |

atha tatra pragītamantrādhyaguṇābhi- dhānasyaiva stotratayā stotravidhivyanyā''nupapattaye sāmā- nam, tataḥ atrāpi tat eva sāmaprāpteḥ 'sāmnā stuvīta' iti vidheyaidhyapyatiḥ iti cet, 'sāmnā stuvīta' ityasya anāramyādhītatvena prakṛto ānarthakyena aniveśe sarvatraiva vikṛtau aprākṛtastotraviṣaye sāmavidhāyakatvo- papatteḥ |

bhāṣyakārādilekhenasvarasyāt asya vikṛti- viśeṣaprakaraṇapaṭhitatvāṅgīkāre tu nāyaṃ vastutaḥ sāma- vidhiḥ, apitu stotrapadaśaktigrāhakayāśikaprasiddhayupo- dvalakaḥ san anuvāda eva aprākṛtastotravidhitvarthaḥ ekatvavidhānārtho veti dhyeyam |
bhā. 10|4|10|20, sāmabhiryuktaṃ rathaṃ udgātre dadāti vājapeye nānyaṃ na cānyasmai |
'rathaṃtaramuttarayogāyati' 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti rathaṃtaraśabdena kimyucyate iti vicāryate |
yadyapi 'gītiṣu sāmākhyā' (2|1|1|136) ityatra rathaṃ- tarādiśabdaḥ gītivācī iti siddhaṃ tathāpi sthūṇānikha- nananyāyena dābhyārthaṃ punarvicāryate |
imaṃ pakṣaṃ ayuktaṃ matvā dvitīyaṃ pūrvapakṣamāha sūtram |
sāmnaḥ abhidhānaśabdena rathaṃtaravṛhadādi- śabdena yathāśiṣṭhaṃ pravṛttamabhiḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ yathā śiṣṭaṃ upa- diṣṭaṃ tadanatikramya yathāśiṣṭhaṃ rathatarādiśabdaḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
'rathaṃtaramuttarayogāyati' iti rathatarādiśabdasya stomatvādiviśiṣṭāyāṃ ṛci pravṛttiḥ iti pūrvasūtrokte pakṣaṃ nirāsati |
śabdānāṃ arthavicitvāt arthavidhānaparatvāt arthābhi- dhānaparatvāt rathaṃtaraśabdaḥ 'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ' iti abhivatīsaṃjñakaṛkvācakaḥ |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti vacanācca 'kayā naścitra ābhuvat'
tena arthāntare apravṛttiḥ syāt, phalayā arthe abhi- vatī vaktuṃ na śakyatvāt |
tathā ca abhivatyāḥ kārye kavatayā atideśo na ghaṭate |
nāpi kavatayāṃ abhivatya ādyetvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate, pṛthagbhāvāt |
nahi śabdaḥ śabde samavaiti pṛthageva tu avatiṣṭhate |

tasmāt 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' ityatra hi yasmāt kriyāyāḥ gānakriyāyāḥ rathaṃtaraśabdena abhisaṃbaṃdhaḥ syāt, abhivatyāṃ yaddānaṃ tat kavatayāṃ kartavyaṃ iti, tasmāt rathaṃtarādiśabdasya na ṛci pravṛttiḥ |
'kriyāyāṃ' iti pāṭhe tu rathaṃtarādiśabdasya kriyāyāṃ gānakriyāyāṃ abhi- saṃbaṃdhaḥ ityarthaḥ |
svārthe vā syāt prayojanaṃ kriyāyāstadaṅgabhāve- nopadiṣṭayeran |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' ityatra vartamāne abhivatyaḥ ṛcaḥ tadaṅga- bhāvena kavatīnāmaṅgabhāvena aṅgatvena upadiṣṭayeran |
prayojanasya adṛṣṭasya kalpyatvāt nāyamapi pakṣaḥ sādhuḥ |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' ityatra yadi rathaṃtaraśabdaḥ na kevalaṛkvācakaḥ, na svarādiviśiṣṭaṛkvācakaḥ nāpi abhivatīnāṃ kavatayaścābhāvaḥ, tarhi śabdamātraṃ syāt |
'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' iti kavatīṣu ṛkṣu rathaṃtara- śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti vākyārthaḥ syāt |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' ityasya 'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' ityādiṣu kavatīṣu ṛkṣu rathaṃtaraśabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ ityarthaḥ iti yaduktaṃ tanna, autpattikatvāt
rathaṃtaraśabdaśca kavatīṣu prayoktuṃ na śakyate, tayorasaṃbaṃdhatvāt |
'śabdamātramiti cet' (7|2|1|4) iti sūtroktasya pakṣasya 'nautpattikatvāt' (7|2|1|5) iti sūtreṇa niṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ |
evaṃ 'śabdamātrasya prayogaḥ' iti pakṣe ca śāstraṃ ana- rthakaṃ syāt 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti ati- deśaśāstraṃ vyarthaṃ syāt aśakyatvāt |
upavarṣavṛttikārastu mene- 'gānaśāstraṃ autkathyaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt iti |
tasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ, satyāṃ gatau naitāvān prayāsaḥ śiṣṭānāṃ aphalo'myupagantuṃ nyāyya iti' iti bhāṣyam |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' ityatra ko rathaṃtara- śabdārthaḥ ? ṛk vākyārthaḥ ityatra pañcamaḥ pakṣaḥ ucyate |
sāmaśabdena loke svaro'bhidhīyate, susāmā devadatta iti sukharo devadatta ityarthe |
tasmāt 'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' ityādiṣu kavatīṣu rathaṃtarasvarasyātideśaḥ |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti vākye rathaṃtarasya nāma svarasya 'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' iti kavatīṣu ṛkṣu atideśaḥ iti kavatīṣu ṛkṣu rathaṃtarasvarasya atideśaḥ |
'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ' iti abhivatyāḥ arthasya svarasya kavatīṣu abhāvāt |
nahi abhivatyakṣarāṇāṃ abhivatyo nādaḥ kavatīṣu bhāvayituṃ śakyate |
evaṃ śruteḥ 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti śrutipāṭhānāṃ arthābhāvāt parasparaṃ saṃbandha eva na syāt svarātideśasye |
yadi 'abhi tvā śūra notumaḥ' iti abhivatvāḥ svarasya 'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' iti kavatīṣu upadeśo nopapadyate, anuvāda- svarhi bhavatu 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti |
kavatīṣu yat rathaṃtaraṃ tat gāyati iti vacanavyaktiḥ |
kavatīnāṃ utpattiṣu uccāraṇeṣu abhivatīṣu bhavatīṣu ca bahvyo mātrāśca varṇā avibhaktāḥ samānā vidyante |
tasya svarasya anuvādo'yaṃ 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti |

'abhi tvā śūra notumaḥ' ityabhivatvā ṛcaḥ 'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' iti kavatīśca ṛcaḥ bahūnāṃ mātrāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ ca samānatvāt kavatīṣu vidyamānasya abhivatīsvarasya anuvādo'yaṃ 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāya
uttare dve ṛcau uttarāccike nāma uttarāgranthe paṭhitā: |
aśikṣitā supaṃ guḍaṃ vā paktuṃ jānāti |
tasmāt ratha- kiṃcicca sāma kaścit ayonī yonibhinnāyāmapi ṛci taragānasthāpi āśrayābhedādvidhasya akarmakāle abhyāsa paṭhyate |
tathā ca śruti: 'bṛhad gāyatrīṣu kriyate' upapadyate |
tathā samānacchandaske tūce sāma prāya: gīyate |
kaṃcicca yoni- cchandasa: bhinne'pi cchandasi gīyate tādṛśaṃ sāma athā- yoni |
tathā ca śruti: 'yo vai vicchandasi sāma ūhati' iti |
evaṃ sati sāmna: kaścit ayonīka- syāt, kaścicca atayonīkatvāt sāmaśabda: niyataṃ ṛgvācako bhavituṃ nārhati |
' tasya ca kriyā grahaṇārthaṃ ' iti sūtre (7|2| 1|5) siddhāntitā yaduktaṃ tatra pūrvapakṣī śakte |
tasya ca svayonibhūtāyāṃ ' abhi tvā śūra ' ityasyāṃ ṛci abhyāsena haṭhīkaraṇe uttarayorapi ṛco: prayogavelāyāṃ gātuṃ śakyatvena prayogāt bahi: paṭhanaṃ vyartham |
tadāha, rathaṃtaragānasya aikārthye ekarūpatve sati uttarayogānasya vairūpya bhedo nāsti iti grahaṇārthyā: kriyāyā: nāvekṣā |
tasmāt saṃskārakarmatve akarmakāle prayoga: anarthaka eveti |
rathaṃtaragānasya ekarūpatvāt yonigāne abhyaste uttarāgānasya akarmakāle prayogo vṛthā iti śaṅkāyāṃ uttaramāha siddhāntī |
syāt vairupyaṃ ekasyāmṛci rathaṃtaragānāt anyasyāmapi rathaṃtaragānasya |
ekasyā- mṛci abhyāse'pi arthāntareṣu ṛgantareṣu abhyasta- rathaṃtaragānasya aniṣṭatve: ṛgantareṣvapi puna: punarabhyāsa: sārthaka: |
paraṃtu anyathālakṣaṇa: odanasya pāka:, anyathālakṣaṇa: sūpasya, anyathālakṣaṇe guḍasya |
evaṃ ca sāmadāsya ratha- tarādiśabdānāṃ ca gītivācakatve sāmaśabdānāṃ ṛk- śabdānāṃ ca sāmañjasyaṃ bhavati |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti kavatīśabda: 'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' ityādīnāṃ ca vakṣyati rathaṃtaraśabdaṃ sāma vakṣyati |
tathā ca na virodha: ! tasmāt gīto sāmaśabda: iti siddhānta: |
sāmna: ādhārabhūte tūce prathamā ṛk yonināma, sā ca 'yonigranthe pūrvācika' vihitā |
uttare dve ṛcau ' uttare ' nāma, te ca 'uttarāgranthe-uttarācika' vihite |
vi. 10|4|24, sāmna: ṛksaṃskāra- 'ghoḍayuyusare' iti prānānuvāda: aṅgirasāṃ dvirātre |
10|1|13|5-54 varṇaka 2. mīko. pṛ. 189 ' aṅgirasāṃ dvirātre ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
sāmna: saubharasya hīṣ ityādidhanasya ca phalakathaṃ bṛhadādi |
vi. 2|2| 13. sāmno: gevyaugājayayo: gānaṃ bṛhatīvighāra- paḍkatvoriva prathamena saṃpādite bārhane tuce, jyotiṣṭome |
9|2|6-28 varṇaka 2. mīko. pṛ. 189 'jyotiṣṭome bṛhatīviṣṭhārapaḍkatvoriva' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
maṇi. pṛ. 5. sāmnā aprākṛtānāṃ āgamena atirātre eka- viṃśādī kāmye adhikasaṃsthāpūrṇaṃ kartavyam |
10|1|6| 15-25. mīko. pṛ. 256 ' atirātre ekaviṃśādau kāmye ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
10|1| 7|76. mīko. pṛ. 367 ' vivṛddhastomake kratau bahiṣpavamāne ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
apica 'śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vratānyupākuya, māgantūnāṃ mādhyaṃdinābharvapavamānayo: gāyatrādiṣveva ardhaṣṭamān māsān svādhyāyamadhīyīta ' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 140. sāmnāṃ-ādhānasāmnāṃ- pradhānasparśanimittaṃ upāṃśutvaṃ iti pradhānadharmatā |
vā. 3|2|12 pṛ. 811, sāmnāṃ- ādhānasāmnāṃ- yājurvedikāpradhānavidhivihi- tattvāt upāṃśutvam |
3|2|12 pṛ. 813. sāmnā- māvāpodvāpau kasmiścit stotre pavamāneṣveva gāyatrī- bṛhatnuṣṭup kartavyau na tu kasyāccidaci |
10|4|12- 22. mīko pṛ. 3668 ' vivṛddhāvivṛddhastomakratuṣu mādhyaṃdinābharva ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
tebhyamartha: samadhi- gata:; gīti: sāmaśabdenocyate iti |
tata idamadānīṃ saṃdigdhate, kiṃ gīti: ṛca: prati pradhānabhūtā, uta guṇabhūteti |
nanu siddha saṃskārakarma: sāmaśabdo vācya iti, apitu ṛksaṃskāra: syādvāvodhārtha:, prasiddhagrahaṇa- tvāditi |
kiṃ prāptam ? pradhānakarma vā sāmaśabdenocyate iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? pradhānavidhi- lakṣaṇaṃ hyatrāsti dvitīya vibhakti: - 'rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati, bṛhadgāyati' iti |
tadyadi dravyasaṃskārārtham, saṃskṛtaṃ dravyamadṛṣṭena saṃskāreṇa, na karmakāle puna: saṃskṛtaṃ śakyam |
na hi snigdhasya snehanaṃ śakyaṃ kartum, piṣṭasya vā peṣaṇam |
sa eṣo'dhīnāmābhyupagatanya:, akarma- kāle kriyamāṇa: saṃskāro bhavatīti |
dup-- nanu sasame nirṇayaṃ saṃskārakarma sāmeti |
yadi na guṇabhūtam, kimasya dravyam, yatprati pradhānabhūtametat |
yathā'nyasya karmaṇo dravyaṃ sādhakam, evamasya ṛk sādhikā |
yathā, pākayajñeṣu tattadācanikaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati, lājā:, dhānā:, taṇḍulā:, ājyamiti |
kathaṃ dravyavyatireke sati dravyāntara- pradeśaṃ ca tadidaṃ sāmeti |
yadatra dravyavyatirekaṃ gītimātram, tadeva bṛhadvā rathaṃtaraṃ veti na doṣo bhavati |
stutirhi coditā, 'ājyaiḥ stuvate, pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' iti |
tataḥ stutya- rthāśca ṛcaḥ satyāḥ sāmārthā parikalpyate |
kutaḥ ? asa- mbandhaśca sāmnaḥ stotreṇa syāt |
tatpradhānabhāvena stutiḥ sāmnā upadiśyeta, na sāma stuteḥ |
tatra 'bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati, rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti vacanaṃ bādhyeta |
rathantaraguṇaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati, bṛhadaguṇaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavatītyedeva- mupadiśyate |
pratyakṣaṃ hi tadā pṛṣṭhopakārakaṃ sāma karoti |
yadasya vācakaṃ prakāśayati śabdam, tadyantarapṛṣṭhaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyādekārthatve śakya vijñātum |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam, akarmakāle gānamucaḥ- saṃskārakamanyādhānamiva kalpayet |
bhāṣyam-- yadi hyakarmakāle gānaṃ kṛtaṃ karmakālaṃ yāvattiṣṭhet, na vinaśyet |
yadi vā punarna śakyeta karmakāle kartum, tathā- pyaprayogaḥ syāt |
śakyante tu pragītāḥ śabdāḥ punaḥ prayoktum |
tasmādarmakāle prayuktā asādhakā iti karmakāle prayujyeran |

kāmeṣṭau pratyakṣeṇa vacanena kartāro na prāpnu- vanti |
śā-- sārasvate satre śrūyate ' plakṣa prasravaṇaṃ prāpya agreye kāmāyāṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapanti, tasyāmaśvāṃ puruṣīṃ ca dhenuke deyuḥ ' iti (sārasvataṃ satraṃ sara- svatyāḥ nadyāstīre kartavyam |
sā ca nadī yasyāt parvatā- dārabhya pravahati, tatra plakṣaplakṣaṃ jalaprasravaṇamasti |
tadeśaṃ prāpya tatra deśe iyamiṣṭiḥ kartavyā- soma |
aśvāṃ puruṣīṃ dhenuke dattvā iti turaga-manuṣya-gojātīyānāṃ strīṇāṃ dakṣiṇātvena dānaṃ śrutam- iti vistare uktam |
āśva. śrau. sū. 1216 nārāyaṇavṛttau tu 'aśvāṃ ca puruṣīṃ ca dhenuke dadyuḥ ' iti strī aśvā, strī puruṣī te dhenuke te prathamaprasate iti ca vyākhyātam |
tadarthaṃ cintyate, kimetasyāṃ ṛtvijaḥ santi, uta yajamānaireva iyamiṣṭiḥ kartavyeti |
tatra dvādaśāhe 'ye yajamānāste ṛtvijaḥ' iti yaja- mānānāmātvijyaṃ ihādiṣṭena prāpyamāṇaṃ prākṛteṣveva
'yajamāno yūpaḥ', 'ādityo yūpaḥ' - atra yaja- mānena ādityena ca yūpasya śrutiḥ |
āditya- yajamānaśabdau ca yūpe tejastvordhvatvaguṇe pravṛttau |
'na ca sārūpyamevakamatideśasya kāraṇam -' vā. 3|6|16|43 pṛ. 1068. sārūpyeṇa aśāndena upasthāpane śābdatvānvyavahāraḥ |
'yajamāno yūpaḥ' ityādi yajamānaśabdaḥ sārūpyena nimittena gauṇaḥ yūpastvarthaḥ ||
aśakyatvāt yūpa- kāryasādhane yajamānasya yajamānakāryasādhane vā yūpasya, cintyantarabhāvācca na vidhiḥ |
cākṣuṣaṃ hi yūpasyordhvatvam, añjananimittaṃ ca tejastvam |
yajamānasya hi paśudvāre viniyuktasya nilā- tasya ca svapadārthakathanavirodhaḥ |
yadi ca kaścitkaścit dāhapratikṛtimupādāyāt tasyāpi gauṇatāprasiddhirviṣayā syāt taddaraṃ stutayeva tadāśrayaṇamitividhitvaṃ syāt |

soma - nanu yajamānasya yūpakāryaṃ niyojanādau vidhisaṃbhave'pi ādityasya tatra vidhānāsaṃbhavāt tadvākye ('ādityo yūpaḥ' ityatra) kathaṃ guṇavidhikṣa- saṃbhavaḥ ? na ca 'asāvādityo yato'jāyata, tato bilva uditiṣṭhāt' ityekadeśajananimittena āditya- śabdena bilva eva gauṇyā pratipādyate |
sa eva khale- vālīvat yūpakāryaṃ vidhīyate iti yuktam |
tathā sati vidheyasamarpakādityaśabdasya lakṣaṇaprasaṅgāt, tadapekṣā arthavādatvasyaiva jyāyastvāt |

etena ādityaśabda- prakṛteḥ aditiśabdasya bhūvācakatvamaṅgīkṛtya mṛnmayo yūpaḥ kāryaḥ iti, ādityaśabdasya arkavṛkṣavācakatva- maṅgīkṛtya arkavṛkṣo yūpaḥ kāryaḥ iti, nimbavṛkṣasya ādityanivāsatvāt tatparatvamāśritya nimbavṛkṣo yūpaḥ kārya iti, yūpe ādityapratibimbaṃ saṃpādya tatra niyojanaṃ kārya iti, ādityapratikṛtau vā niyojanaṃ kārya iti, 'ive pratikṛtau' (pā0 5|3|96) iti vihitaka- pratyayasya 'arcāsu pūjārthāsu citrakarmeṣu ceṣu |
' iti smaraṇāt yūpe likhitamādityasya ādityākāravat vā saṃpādya niyojanaṃ kārya iti guṇavidhyupapādanaprakārā nirastāḥ |

teṣāṃ prasiddhādityaśabdārthatāgatadattatarakalpanāduṣṭatvāt dhṛti cet, ādityasyānakakāryaupyasādhanādau yūpasya, 'antarā yūpaṃ cāhavanīyaṃ ca dakṣiṇāstiṣṭhatya' ityādi- katipayayūpakārye ādityasya vā vidhisaṃbhavāt |

) cakṣurbrāhmaṇasāhacaryasya udbhūtatvāt tannimittatvaṃ śabda- pravṛtteḥ jhaṭiti pratīyate ityāśayena, sūtre pramāṇāntāsyāpi sārūpyaśabdasya udbhūtaścakṣustatporaṇārthe 'sārūpyāt' iti pañcamyā (śā-dīpikākāreṇa) upādānaṃ kṛta- miti dhyeyam |
nyāyasudhākṛtastu - 'ādityo yūpaḥ' ityādau sārūpyaṃ pratyakṣatvāt śabdabuddhiviṣayaḥ |
'yaja- mānaḥ prastaraḥ' ityādau tu sattvā sārūpyamupayujyate |
iha sārūpyasya pratyakṣasiddhatvaṃ hi tatprayojakatejastvordhvatvādeḥ pratyakṣatvāt vācyam |
tathā cehāpi sārūpyaprayojaktejastvatvādeḥ prathamopasthita- tvāccayabhāvena śabdajñānaviṣayasaṃbhavāt |
tasmāt sattvā sārūpyasya 'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' ityādī niyā-
makatve ihāpi tathā syāt, iha sārūpyasya śabdajñāna- viṣayatvasvīkāre 'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' ityādāvapi tathā syāt, iti yatkiṃcidetat |

sudhāmbastha — 'liṅgasamavāyāḥ' iti dvaṃdvasamāse prathamābahuvacanadarśanāt tassiddhiśca jātiśca sārūpyaṃ ca praśaṃsā ca bhūmā ca liṅgasamavāyaśca iti prathamayaiva sarvatra vigṛhyata'ye'pi prastāvarūpyamānādisāhūpyaṃ tatkārya- karatvādivarmasāmānyāt saṃbhavadapi śabdasya tatkārya- karatvādimātre paryavasānena śābdabuddhiviṣayatvābhāvāt, aviṣayasya ca pratipādanātmakaśabdapravṛttinimittatvā- yogāt na śabdapravṛttinimittam |
yūpasya tu āditya- yajamānasārūpyaṃ śabdapratītiviṣayatvāt śabdapravṛtti- nimittaṃ iti vaidhamyaṃ darśayituṃ pañcamī adhyāhṛtā |
'sārūpyaṃ vinā gauṇatvābhāvāt tasya gauṇatva- nimittatve'pi bodhakalatvātiriktāyāḥ śabdasya ghaṭera- bhāvāt, nirviṣayāyāśca buddherasaṃbhavāt śābdabuddhiviṣa- yasyaiva śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ vācyam |
na ca śabda- tātparyārthadhāraṇaṃ vinā śābdabuddhiviṣayatvaṃ yuktam |
tatkāryakaratvādimitte ca sārūpye tanmātraparyavasitasya śabdasya tātparyavadhāraṇamaśakyam |

'cakṣurbrāhmaṇe sādṛśye tātparyyaviṣayatvāccadhāraṇasaṃbhavāt śābda- buddhiviṣayatvarūpaśabdapravṛttinimittaviśeṣavidhānārthe tatkāryakaratvādihetukebhyaḥ sadbhavāmātreṇa gauṇatvanimi- ttebhyaḥ sādṛśyebhyaḥ asya (sārūpyasya) pṛthak asādhā- raṇyena ihapādānam ( pañcamyantatvena ) |
' evaṃ 'yajamāno yūpaḥ' ityatra cakṣurbrāhmasya ūrdhvatvasya samānatvāt yajamānaśabdena yūpaḥ stūyate |
bhāṭṭa — 'ādityo yūpaḥ' ityādī tu sārūpyaṃ gauṇīnimittam |
na ca sarvatra tadeva nimittam, ko'tra viśeṣaḥ ? cakṣurbrāhmaṃ tejastvamiti atra nimittamiti prāñcaḥ |
vastutastu - anyatra śabdanimittaguṇasyaiva khasamānajātīyaguṇatāsaṃsargeṇa prakāratvābhidhattā, na tu sārūpyasya, tasya saṃsargatvāt |
iha tu śakyanidhaguṇa- sajātīyaguṇavattvarūpa sārūpyasyaiva samavāyādisaṃsargeṇa prakāratvāt tadeva nimittamiti viśeṣaḥ |
artha- vādānāṃ avayavārthaparatvābhāve sārūpyādhikaraṇavirodhaḥ tatra yajamānaśabdasya ūrdhvatvaguṇayogāt gauṇyā vṛttyā yūpe dhṛtervyavasthāpanāt |
'ekasme vā anyā ihyaḥ kāmāyā''hiṣyante, sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' iti 'ekasme vā anye ṛtavaḥ kāmāyā''hiṣyante, sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ' iti ca |
atra ca yat darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ sārvakāmyatvaṃ uktaṃ tat aṅkakāmaiḥ aṅkaphalaiḥ saha |
aṅkakāmānāṃ prakaraṇe vidhānāt ukta- vākye sarveṣāṃ phalānāmanuvādaḥ, na vidhiḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' 'sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ' iti yat darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ sārvakāmyamuktaṃ so'nuvādaḥ, na vidhiḥ iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntayati |
nāyaṃ anuvādaḥ sārvakāmyasya, kiṃtu phalopadeśo'yaṃ phalavidhiḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsau jyotiṣṭomaḥ iti pradhāna- vācaśabdena sarvaphalānāṃ saṃyogo vihitaḥ |
pratiphalārthaṃ tu pṛthak prayoga iti vakṣyate uttarādhikaraṇe |
ke. sārvakāmyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ jyotiṣṭomasya ca phalavidhiraye, na aṅkakāmaiḥ aṅkakāmaiśca sahānuvādaḥ |
bhā. 4|3|1|25-26, etacca sārvakāmyaṃ paryāyeṇa na yugapat |
sārvabhaumaḥ mahābhūmi gopya-rājamārga-jalā- śayadāsyahitā dātuṃ na śaknoti, khatvābhāvāt |
bāla. pṛ. 132. sāvakāśaṃ nirava- kāśena bādhyate |

vā. 3|17|14 pṛ. 860. sāvakāśaṃ niravakāśena bādhyate, yathā- 'yat kiñcit prācīnaṃ0' iti vīsārthakarakañci- cchabdena abhīpomīyaprāgbhāvipārśvaviśeṣeṇa vihitaṃ dīkṣaṇīyātaḥ anyatrāpi sāvakāśaṃ upāśrutvaṃ dīkṣa- ṇīyādimātrāthyena svareṇa anyatra niravakāśena bādhyate |
yathā- 'mā hiṃsātsarvabhūtāni' iti vākyena niṣedhavākyaṃ niravakāśena 'śvetamālameta' iti vākyena bādhyate, hiṃsāyā vaicetaraviṣayatvasaṃbandhena tatra tasya sāvakāśatvāt |
paśukāmātirikta- viṣaye camasaḥ sāvakāśaḥ; godohanaṃ niravakāśaṃ iti 'sāvakāśa0' nyāyena godohanaṃ balavat |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|18. sāvitrāṇi juhoti antarvedi tiṣṭhan abhi- cayane |
bhā. 8|1|5|20. sāvitrehomaḥ tata ukhāsaṃbharaṇam, tato dīkṣa- ṇīyādikaṃ iti yathāpāṭhamevānuṣṭheyam, pratyakṣapāṭhakramasya codakāt prābalyatvāt |
bhāṣyam- asyamiḥ 'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' iti |
tatra dīkṣaṇīyāḥ pūrvaṃ sāvitrahomāḥ, ukhāsaṃbharaṇam, iṣṭakāḥ; paśuśca ityetadāmnātam |
kiṃ tadeva pūrvaṃ kartavyaṃ uta dīkṣaṇīyā iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? vaikṛtānāmante prayogaḥ, 'ante tu bādarāyaṇaḥ' iti |
pūrvaṃ sāvitrahomāḥ, iṣṭakāḥ, paśuḥ, ukhāsaṃbharaṇaṃ ca |
tasyāśca purastāt sāvitrahomāḥ, iṣṭakāḥ, paśuḥ, ukhāsaṃbharaṇaṃ ca |
ṭup- sāvitrahomāḥ ukhāsaṃbharaṇaṃ ityādi vidhāya anantaraṃ dīkṣaṇīyāguṇavākyāni śrūyamāṇāni tasthāna- meva guṇinamavabodhayanti |
ato'sya pāṭhasya pratyakṣatvāt prathamaṃ sāvitrahomāstato dīkṣaṇīyā |
śā-- dīkṣaṇīyādīn kṛtvā sāvitradāyaḥ, viparītaṃ veti saṃdeha |
' soma- iha pratyakṣa'pi pāṭho na niyāmakaḥ iti pratyavasthānārthaṃ saṃgatiḥ |
cayanaṃ ca anarambhādhīta vaikalpakaṃ somayāgāṅgam, tatkaraṇe ca sāvitrahoma-ukhāsaṃbharaṇadayaḥ cayanāṅga- bhūtā dharmāḥ śrutāḥ |
paścācca savanajyotiyomāṅga- dīkṣaṇīyāprayogedena kecit guṇāḥ śrutāḥ |

tadatra dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ sāmānyataḥ somaprakaraṇāmnātadīkṣaṇīyā- pūrvapadārthaḥ saha pāṭhena baddhakramatvāvagamāt cayanaprakaraṇe dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ guṇāmātraśravaṇeṇa pāṭhābhāvācca sāvitrādī- nāmāgantukānāṃ dīkṣaṇīyādinakulyante niveśaḥ |

iti prāpte, guṇenāpi guṇena upasthiteḥ, tadvākye guṇina uddeśyatayā kīrtanāt guṇaguṇinoḥ ekasthāna- svāgavateḥ, pratyakṣena viśeṣatvena ca pāṭhena sāmānya- rūpasya pāṭhasya bādhāt pūrvaṃ sāvitrādayaḥ paścādīkṣaṇīyā iti siddham |
su. pṛ. 389. sāhasaṃ prathamaṃ cinvānaścinvīta ' ityādi agnau naimittikameva na nityam |
satyāśrau. 17|1|22. sāhasasya prathamasya vidyantaḥ uttareṣu sāhaseṣu |
jyotiṣṭome hi sāhatā, ahrā samāpta- mānatvāt |
vā. 3|18|15-16. sāhaśabdena ahrā samāptyamānatvāt 'sahaivāhā saṃkhyāpayanti ' ityevaṃ jyotiṣṭomo gṛhyate iti vyupasattvaṃ tasya |
siṃhatvāvatavyutpatyasā- pitaprasaṅkārityācanekadharmaprayatāt devadattapratyayaḥ iti pūrveṇa śaktiḥ nimittam |
anyeṣāṃ taṃ darśanaṃ- sarva eva hi siṃhādiśabdāḥ jātiguṇakriyāsamudāyavācinaḥ samastārthasaṃbandhe devadattādiṣu katipayaguṇakriyāyogāt upacaryante iti |
' ityatra siṃhaguṇena śiyādinopeto devadattaḥ siṃhaśabdena stūyate |
vi. 11|4|123. siṃho devadattaḥ ' iti puruṣasya tadbhāvena praśaṃsā |
' iti siṃhaśabdo devadattavacanaḥ pramāṇāntareṇa, na tu 'siṃhamālameta' iti yatra, tatra tu tat pramāṇāntaraṃ nāsti |
siṃhārthaiḥ pravītaḥ prasaṅkāriti saṃbandhāt itaramarthaṃ pratyāyati |

yathā siṃhaḥ kaścinmṛgaṃ hatvā agre gacchannapi 'pi cetsvayamapi hanyāmiti dhiyā paścādapaśyati hanti ca dṛṣṭipathamāgatam, tathā buddhi- pathāgataspakṣaparipanyaparikalpitayuktābhāsāntanirāsā- yāpyuttaragranthapravṛttirityarthaḥ |
( siṃho yathā vyādhamītvā palāyamānaḥ madhye śiro viparītya paścādavalokate vyādha āyāti na veti tadvat |

yathā siṃhāvaloka'pi kathaṃ- cit grāmīṇavaśaṃ prāpto meṣaḥ saha caran-yuvā'pi san vividharūpakṛtalakṣmaṇatvāllabdhavarṇatvaśaṅgāśvisvādi- kṛtaṃ viśeṣaṃ paśyan ātmānamapi meṣaviśeṣaṃ mene, dūrādikaṃ ca bubhuje, tathā prakṛte'pi |
svasya siṃhatvamasmā meṣatvaṃ mene tathā jīvaḥ saṃsāritvaṃ manyate |
yathā suvarṇapātre eva sihī- kṣīraṃ tiṣṭhati phalasya ca bhavati, tathā sadgurupadeśo hi śamādisādhanasaṃpanne sañchraye eva pratiṣṭhāṃ labhate |
sāhasī. 319. sikatāsu iṣṭakādharmāḥ abhicayane na kartavyāḥ |
sikatānāmapi skhalananirvartakatvāviśeṣatvāt iṣṭakāśabda- prayogacca saṃkhyāntargatatvavaśyābhāvena 'tayā devatayā ' iti mantreṇaiva upadhānaṃ bhavet |
iti prāpte, tāsāṃ 'apari- mitābhiḥ siphatābhiḥ pūrayati ' iti aparimitaviśeṣaṇe sahasrasaṃkhyāhavirbhāvāt caturthākaraṇe dakṣiṇāśabdasya tāsu iṣṭakāśabdaprayogasya stutyarthatvāt na mantraḥ |
nanu cānye siddhāḥ kecit ( svarga ) dṛṣṭavantaḥ, te cā'''khyātāvanta iti cet |
na tatra pramāṇamasti, siddhā evaṃjātīyakāḥ santi, te ca dṛṣṭvā āśvīranniti |

yo yadā yat sapiṇḍīkaroti sa tatpinnādimirbhi- reva karoti iti caturthe virāmaḥ siddha eveti 'caturthe puruṣe chedaṃ ' iti vacanārambhaḥ ' siddhe sati ārambho niyamāya ' iti nyāyena, sāpiṇḍyavayavacchedārthaḥ |
dattakacandrikā pṛ. 26. siddhadravyasya sādhanānākāṅkṣatvenāsādhitaṃ (tvaṃ) iti nyāyaḥ |
'tisro yahasya samidhaḥ ityetayā somaṃ karoti ' iti somagrahaṇamidhau śrūyate |
iha karote- reva bhāvanārthakatayā tatra somasya bhāvyatayā ṛcaḥ karaṇatvena ca anyo bhāsamāno'pi na yuktāḥ, ' siddha- dravyasya ' iti nyāyena yāgakriyayeva tena svabhābhya- kabhāvanāntarāpekṣāt |
saṃkarṣa. bhāṭadīpikā 3|1|2. siddhavaktītarnārthavādakalpayo vidhiḥ yathā- ' trīṇi ha vai yajñasyodarāṇi gāyatrī bṛhatnuṣṭup ca |
atra āśvastyaṃ ata eva uddasanyaṃ iti kalpanā |
bāla. pṛ.12. siddhavaktīrtanakṛtastvanarthavādakalpyo niṣedha- kalpyapratiṣedho yathā- ' agnihotraprakaraṇe ' tasmāddhastaṃ jātaṃ daśarātrīrna duhanti ' iti daśarātraṃ gāṃ na duhyāt iti kalpanā |
bāla. pṛ. 30. siddhasādhyayoḥ samamintyāhāre siddhaṃ sādhyāyopayujyate ' iti nyāyaḥ |
svargo dravyarūpaḥ siddhaḥ, yāgastu śravaṇavelāyāmasiddhaḥ iti ' siddha- sādhyayoḥḥ. yujyate ' itinyāyāt yāgasya bhāgyātva- mevocitam |
' tṛptikāmo bhojanaṃ kuryāt ' ityādī asiddhasyāpi bhojanasya tṛptisādhanatvagrahaṇe ' siddhasādhyayoḥ ' iti nyāyaśca
yeṣāṃ hi yāgīyadravyadevatā- disaṃskārārthatvaṃ tadaṅgatobodhakapramāṇābhāvena neṣyate, tāni karmāṇi svatantrāmaniṣṭhāgrahajanakāni santi dravyādiprati- pradhānabhūtāni |
dravyādīni ca tatra ' siddhasādhyasama- bhivyāhāre siddhaṃ sādhyāyopayujyate ( siddhaṃ sādhyārtha- pāṭhaḥ ) ' iti nyāyena, tṛtīyāśrutyaiva vā kriyāṃ prati guṇabhūtam |
kau. 2|1|4|18. siddhasvabhāvaḥ dhātvarthaḥ ' pākaḥ, paktiḥ, pacanam ' ityādibhiḥ śabdairvyahiyamāṇo liṅgasaṃkhyā- kārakanvitaḥ |
vi. 2|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2. siddhasvabhāvadhātvarthadyotanāya ghañādayaḥ pratyayā vihitāḥ |
vi. 2|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2. sinīvālīkuhvoḥ saṃnipāte uttarasmin dine eva piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ kāryaḥ |
saṃkarṣe. 1|2|10 mīko. pṛ. 2566 piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ sinīvālīkuhvoḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
tasyāḥ kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ na pratiṣedhaḥ brāhmaṇasya tu niṣedha eva |
vā. 1|3|1|2 pṛ. 167. sukhasya mānyatvaṃ vidhiśrutyā siddham |

' sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati ' iti vākye prastara- praharaṇakāle sūktavāka: iti kālavidhi: iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtraprāptaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartayan siddhāntamāha |
evaṃ ca sati ' sūktavāka eva yājyā, prastara āhuti: ' iti vākyaśeṣe yājyāśabda: akasmāt kāraṇaṃ vinā na syāt |
tasmāt prahara- ṇāṅgatvena sūktavākasyopadeśa: iti siddhānta: |
' sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati ' iti vākye prastara- praharaṇāṅgatvena sūktavāko vidhīyate iti siddhānta ukta: |
nanu devatāsaṃkīrtane sūktavāka: samartha:, na prastarapraharaṇe iti cettatrāha |
sa sūktavāka: devatārtha: prastarahaviṣke yāge devatāprakalpaka: |
sa ca devatārtha: san tatsaṃyogāt aṅgatvena praharaṇena saṃyogāt praharaṇāṅgamapi |
tatsaṃyogāt sūktavākena iti tṛtīyāśrutisaṃyogāt tasya praharaṇāṅ- tvam |
nanu prastarasya praharaṇaṃ pratipatti: tathā ca tadaṅgatvaṃ sūktavākyasya nopapadyate iti kālārtha eva saṃyogo'stu iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
' sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati ' iti prastarapraharaṇaṃ pratipatti: ato na tadaṅgaṃ sūktavāka iti cecca |
kiṃvā prakṣepapāśena prastarasya saṃskāra: uddeśāṃśena upayuktadevatāyāśca saṃskāra: iti ubhaya- saṃskāraṃ jñeyam |
sviṣṭakṛt dravyaṃ sviṣṭakṛdyāga: prakṣepapāśena upayuktahavi:saṃskāra: mantraśabdena iṣṭadevatā- devatāsaṃskāraśca tadat |
para- syaraniyāmaca ahaṣṭaṃ sādhayan yāgo bhaviṣyati |
ubhaya- saṃskāraḥ ityasya ubhayarūpāsau saṃskāraśca iti karma- dhārayaḥ uttare prame'daye |
ubhayoḥ dravyadevatyoḥ saṃskāraḥ iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ uttare'daye |
sūktavāke darśapūrṇamāsagate yajamānaśabdaḥ bahu- kartṛke vikāre ūhitavyaḥ |
sūktavāke yajamānanāmanirdeśe nāmadvaya- grahaṇam, somayājinastu tṛtīyamapi ||
yajamānasya amukatvena jñāpanārthatvāt bahunāma- śālino'pi yatkiñcidekaṃ nāma grāhyamato vidhau bahuva- mivilakṣitam |
iti prāpte, ‘dvākṣaracaturakṣarāṇināmāni kuryāt’ iti vidhāya ‘somayājī tṛtīyaṃ nāma kuryāt’ iti vidhinā bahunāmavidheḥ somayājiparatvenopa
dhānātvena asyādhikaraṇasya prakṛtaviṣayavivekasaṃgatiḥ, apavādatvena ca avāntarasaṃgatiḥ |
' evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ - ' śrutyā praharaṇāñjñatvaṃ sūktavākasya gamyate |
' tena upapannaṃ iṣṭadevatāprākaśanaṃ kurvata eva sūktavākasa praharaṇāñjñatvam |
soma-- pūrvavedihāpi kālārtha eva saṃyoga iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe praharaṇasya homorūpatvābhāvāt uddeśyatvābhāvāt, siddhānte tu tatsadbhāvaḥ iti |

tatra sūktavākapadavācyasya mantrasya iṣṭadevatāprākaśanana kṛtārthatvāt prastarapraharaṇasya ca upayukaprastarapratipattivena kṛtārthatvāt ' darśapūrṇamāsa- bhyāmiṣṭvā somena yajeta ' itivat kālārthaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |

na caivaṃ lakṣaṇā, tasyā api anuśāsani- katvena śakyatvāt |
ataśca anujñāoccaraṃ sūktavāka- pāṭhāt tatkālaviśiṣṭa prastaroddeśena praharaṇameva vidhīyate, na tu sūktavākasa praharaṇāñjñatvam |
iti prāpte, pratura- prayogāt lāghavācca karaṇatve eva tṛtīyāyāḥ śaktiḥ, na tu itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe, tasyā ānuśāsanikatve''pi lākṣaṇikatvena upapatteḥ |

tasmāt ye yatropakurvanti, te tatra prayoktavyā iti na kṛtsnaḥ paurṇamāsyām, na kṛtsnaśca amā- vāsyāyāmiti |

vi. 3|2|9. [ 'vacanādiṣṭapūrvatvam' (5|4|3|5-9) ityadhikaraṇavayavabhūtāni 'somastraikepā-' ityā- dīni catvāri sūtrāṇi tatraiva (mīko. pṛ. 3394) saṃgrahītuṃ yogyānyapi pramādāt na

yadyapi ādhānaṃ kṛtvā tato darśapūrṇamāseṣṭiḥ kartavyā tato yathākālaṃ somaḥ iti ādhānasya iṣṭipūrvatvaṃ vaca- nādasyeva tathāpi ekeṣāṃ keṣāṃcit śākhināṃ ādhāno- ttaraṃ iṣṭeḥ prāk somaḥ syāt ādhānottaraṃ ādau somaḥ tata iṣṭiḥ iti |
kutaḥ ? somapūrvatvaṃ anyādheyasya ādhānasya tadante tadantena somāntatvena hetunā somasya ādhānāntarye gṛhītvā ityarthaḥ |
'ṛtunakṣatrātikramavacanāt somakālasya vasa- ntādeḥ ṛtoḥ, kṛttikādeśa nakṣatrasya, atikramaḥ ukto vacanena 'yaḥ somena yakṣyamāṇo'gnīnādhīta nartuṃ pravī- kṣenna nakṣatram' iti |
soma ādhānāntaryābhāve tu ṛtunakṣatrātikramavacanaṃ anarthakameva syāt |
tadantena - ityatra tadarthena iti pāṭhe tadarthena pūrvapakṣasiddhayena yoge kāla- bādhakaṃ vacanaṃ anarthakameva syāt ityarthaḥ |
tadarthena avyavahitottarakālavācinā yakṣyamāṇa iti laṭā yuktaṃ vacanaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt |
yadvā adyatana- bhaviṣyatkālavācinā luṭā yuktaṃ vacanaṃ anarthakaṃ civaddhaṃ syāt ityarthaḥ |
ādhānottaraṃ ādau somaḥ tato darśapūrṇamāsau iti ādhānasya somapūrvatvaṃ iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
anyathā hi saṃvatsarapi asau yakṣyamāṇaḥ agnimādhatte somena ca agnihotrādimiśra |
tasya somāthetvasya agnihotrādyarthatvasya ca aviśeṣāt viśeṣābhāvāt tadarthatvaṃ viśeṣataḥ somāthetvaṃ na syāt |
vidyate ca vacanaṃ somāthem, tasmāt idaṃ vacanaṃ
athakṣyamāṇasya ca pavamānahaviṣāṃ kāla- nirdeśadānāntaryāt viśeṣā syāt |
ādhānasya iṣṭipūrvatvaṃ somapūrvatvaṃ vā vikalpena iti siddhānte yuktyantarapradarśanāya sūtram |

ānantaryāt athakṣyamāṇasya ādhānanānantarameva yaḥ somena na yakṣyate tasya, pavamānahaviṣāṃ pavamāneṣṭānāṃ kālasya nirdeśāt 'yaḥ somenayakṣyamāṇaḥ agnimādadhīta na sa purā saṃvatsarāt havīṃṣi nirvapet' iti śrutvā pavamānahaviḥ kālanirdeśāt viśeṣā syāt somapūrvatvā- bhāvapakṣasya śaṅkā saṃśayaḥ na syāt |
śrutau athakṣyamāṇapadena āghānānantarameva yo na somena yakṣyate ityuktamityarthaḥ |
pañcamādibhiḥ aṣṭamāntaiḥ sūtraiḥ siddhasyādhikaraṇasya prayojanakathanārthamidaṃ sūtram |
evaṃ ca somena athakṣya- māṇasya yaḥ idānīṃ somena na yakṣyate tasya ādhānottaraṃ darśapūrṇamāseṣṭirārabdhavyā |
tādarthye ādhānasya somā- thetve tu somapūrvatvameva |
yaḥ somena ādau yakṣyate tasya ādhānottaraṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ prāgeva somaḥ kartavyaḥ paścāt darśapūrṇamāseṣṭirbhaviṣyati |
3|5|7|12. ✺ soma: darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ prāgpūrvaṃ vā, somavikārāstu gavādayaḥ ekāhāḥ ūrdhvameva |

some agnicitkartṛke uttaravedipurāṇāmi- dvayasyaikaviṃśatilokaṃpraṇāṃ ca samuccayaḥ ||
uktavacane cayanottarakālīnatāṃ iṣṭipṛṣṭhomānāṃ- viśeṣeṇa grahaṇāt sarvāṇi purāṇāmidravyam |

iti prāpte, ' punaryāstu vā etatkṛte punaryā etatprayanti yatraivā- minnit somena yajeta tadetaikaviṃśatilokaṃpraṇā uttaravedyāmapi yajeta ' iti vacanāntareṇa some dravyāntaravidhānāt sāmānyavacanena iṣṭipṛṣṭhomayoratraiva purāṇādravyavidhiḥ paryavasyati |
vastutastu ' yadīṣṭyā ' iti vākye'pi somasya viśeṣya grahaṇānyathā'nupapattyo- ttaravediyurāṇāgnidravyasyaikaviṃśatilokaṃpraṇānāmapi agni- cirakṛtsome samuccayaḥ |
somāntargataiṣṭipṛṣṭhānāṃ tveka- viṃśatilokaṃpraṇābhāvaḥ iti saṃkarṣa. 1|3|12. some- agnīṣomīye paṣṭho vihitairekādaśaprayājaiḥ prākṛtā- jñāntarāṇāṃ na vādhaḥ |

some bhakṣo na vidyate avacanāt bhakṣyaniyamaḥ somaḥ iti vacanābhāvāt |
jyotiṣṭome somaśeṣasya nāsti bhakṣaḥ iti pūrvapakṣa- nirāsārtho vā-śabdaḥ |
syādeva bhakṣaḥ ' sarvataḥ pari- hāramāśritaṃ bhakṣyati ' ' bhakṣitāpyāyitāṃśamasmān dakṣi- ṇasthānaso'valambe sādayanti ' iti anyārthadarśanāt |
vacanaṃ anyārtha sat bhakṣaṃ darśayati iti anyārthadarśanaṃ ityucyate |
āśvinapātrabhakṣaṇāt prāk tatpātraṃ khamasta- kasya sarvataḥ samantāt , pariharaṇīyam ābhāmayitavyaṃ iti pariharaṇavidhānārthe vākyaṃ iti bhāṣyasyāśayaḥ prathamavākye |

dvitīyavākyaṃ tu bhakṣitānāṃ, bhakṣaṇottaraṃ adhikena soma- rasena āpyāyitān vardhitān camasān kṛtvā dakṣiṇa- deśasthasya anasaḥ śakaṭasya avalambe īṣayormadhye adha- ssāt sādayet iti vidhānārthe iti |
pūrvasūtre yāni anyārthadarśanāni uktāni tāni vastutaḥ bhakṣavidhāyakāni vacanānyeva ' sarvataḥ parihāramāśritaṃ bhakṣyati ' ityādinā |
svamasta- kasya samantāt ābhāmaviśiṣṭaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ tadāśrayaṃ vidyati |
tasmāt bhakṣavacanasadbhāvāt yathopradeśaṃ yena ṛtvijā yadevatākaṃ
pātraṃ yathā bhakṣaṇīyaṃ uktaṃ vacanaiḥ tathā tathā bhakṣaṇāni syuḥ |
someḍvacanādkṣo na vidyate' ( 3|5|6| 19) iti sāmānyena bhakṣavicāraṃ kṛtvā viśeṣavicāro- 'yaṃ ( 'aindrāvāye tu0' 3|5|188 ityayaṃ ) kartavya āsīt |
grahamesaṣu haviḥprakalpanamātre kṛte yathā na sarvahomaḥ , tathā 'someḍvacanāt' ityatrādhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |

'ṛtvikśabdaḥ yāgīyasarvakarma- keṣu na pravartate, kintu saptadaśatve ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |

soma-- gurvanugamanādeḥ nitye'pi na somāde- rnityatvaṃ iti pratyavajñānāt (pratyāudāharaṇa—) saṃgatiḥ |
dvitīyavarṇake ṛṇavākyena saṃyogataḥ khalu somavidyāprajaṃ brāhmaṇasyaivāvaśyakaṃ iti manyate |
' bhāṭṭa— somasya 'vasantevasante jyotiṣā yajeta' iti vacanādeva nityatvam |
guṇabhūtakālā- nurodhena pradhānānuṣṭheyaprasātayā vīpsāvyāpti vidhīyate vākyabhedāt pratinimittaṃ naimittikādyuccinyāpta- vīpsāpārthānuvādatvāt tadākyasthāyā eva tasyā nimitta- paratvāvasāyāt |
adhītatya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham' 'anadhīyānā brātā bhavanti' ityādindinoktākaraṇa- pratyavāyabhayena nityatvam |
yattu 'paṣṭhe annāyakāmasyopanayīta' ityādiphaleśravaṇaṃ tadupa- nayanādyavaśyakatvātpakṣādityeva śreyam |

yatra tatratve ṛta- nāmādayatvātpekṣitavidyāderapyāvaśyakatvena phalato nityamuktam, tat ṛtūnāṃ vidyāprayojakatvasya nirastā- tvāttadat āvaśyakatvakaraṇe pratyayāvagāteḥ vidyā- derakaraṇe ṛtanāmaṇadhikāratvādenāvādyapekṣitvam |
evaṃ prajotpādanamapi 'anutpādya sutaṃ mohanānmokṣamicchan patatyadhaḥ' ityaviratasya pratyayāśravaṇāt nityatvam |
ata eva ' jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇastribhirṛṇavā jāyate, brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ ' ityapi saṃgacchate |
na cātra brāhmaṇapadaśravaṇāttasyaivaite nityāḥ itarayostasyāvaśyakatā iti śakyakam |
bāla. pṛ. 21. somaśabdaḥ ākṛtivacanaḥ, na vyaktivacanaḥ |
bhā. rā. 2|1|6|7. somaśabdaḥ kṣīraṇyāṃ latyāṃ prasiddhaḥ na rase |
2|1|6|7. somaśabdaḥ na karma- nāmadheye ato nāsau dharmātideśakaḥ |
3|5|122. mīko. pṛ. 1699 'jyotiṣṭome camasināṃ somaśeṣa- bhakṣaḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
3|5|132. mīko. pṛ. 1833 'jyotiṣṭome somabhakṣe homāmi- ṣvo samuccitau kāraṇam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
somaśeṣabhakṣaṇaṃ ṛtvijāṃ yajamānasya ca 'camasi' samākhyāyā sidhyati |
vi. 3|5|7. somasaṃskāravidhīnāṃ 'krīṇāti' 'abhiṣuṇoti' ityādīnāṃ some eva pravṛttiḥ, phalavamase tu atideśena saṃskārasiddhiḥ |
5|1|3|137-38. mīko. pṛ. 71 'agniṣṭomasya yaśeṣu prāthamyam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhā. 8|1|136. somahiraṇyādayo dravyaśabdāḥ, suvarṇādayo guṇaśabdāḥ, citrādyenādayaḥ karmaśabdāḥ apūrvapralayākā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
ākhyātenāpūrva pratīyate, ākhyāta- pratyayāntāt bhāvārthapadātpūrve gamyate iti siddhāntaḥ |
vi. 2|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2. somāpauṣṇaḥ ekādaśakapālaḥ ' ityādyekaṃ trikam, tatra śyāmo dakṣiṇā |
'āgneyava ekā- daśakapālaḥ ' ityādi dvitīyaṃ trikam, tatra 'vāmano dakṣiṇā' |
vi. 1|1|41. somāpauṣṇaḥ ekādaśakapālaḥ rājasūye dvitīya trisaṃyukte prathamaṃ haviḥ |
bhā. 11|1|412. somāpauṣṇe paśau vihitena audumbarena prākṛtasya khādiresya bādhaḥ yūpārtham |
10|1|18|61-62. mīko. pṛ. 1539 'khādirasya prākṛtasya somāpauṣṇe paśau0' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
somāpauṣṇādidvidaivatye pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ nāsti, ekadaivatya eva hi tat |
vi. 3|1|20. somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ abhirancara, śaramayaṃ barhirmevati ' iti śaramayena prākṛtakuśamayaṃ nivartyate |
bhā. 10|1|411-2 varṇakaṃ 2. somāraudre caru ājyameva prokṣaṇam |
tatra 'prokṣaṇīrāsādya' iti praipamantre prokṣaṇīśabdaḥ saṃskāra- vācī iṣṭike adhikāraḥ |
yaugikaḥ iti siddhānte tu 'prokṣaṇāsādya' iti liṅgavacanena prayogaḥ |
soma. 1|4|9. somāraudre yāge upadiṣṭeḥ śaraiḥ adhiṣṭhitānāṃ kuśānāṃ bādhaḥ |
10|1|411-2 varṇakaṃ 2. mīko. pṛ. 3884 'śaranyāyaḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
somāraudrādiyāge śrūyamāṇaiḥ śuddhādiguṇa- viśiṣṭavrīhibhiḥ prākṛtayavānāṃ bādhaḥ |
vikṛtau tvaniyamaḥ syātpṛṣadājyavad grahaṇasya guṇārthatvādubhayośca pradiṣṭatvād guṇaśāstraṃ yadīti syāt |

bhāṣyam-- 'somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapecchuddhānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāmaḥ, somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapetkṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāmbhirancara, netraṃ taṃ caruṃ nirvapetkṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ, sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapetkṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāma' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ vrīhibhirevaivā yaṣṭavyam, uta vrīhibhireva |
kiṃ prāptam ? vikṛtau tu virodhināmatve gṛhyamāṇe'niyamaḥ syāt, vrīhibhirevaiveti |
bhāṣyam-- kratvantare eva vā, darśapūrṇamāsayo- riva taddarśanaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yadyapi darśapūrṇamāsayośru- tavat yajamānaḥ, tathā'pi pañcāttathaiva vadhā bhavati |
śā-- 'somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet śuklānāṃ vrīhī- ṇām, naikataṃ caruṃ nirvapet kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ vrīhiyavoḥ vikalpaḥ, vrīhīṣveva ca śuklakṛṣṇādividhirasta sarvadā vrīhya eveti |
tatra vrīhi- grahaṇasya śuklādiguṇasambandhārthatvena avidhāyakatvāt na yavānāṃ bādhaḥ |
nahyekana vākyena yāgasya codakaprāptaudeśena guṇasya ca vidhānaṃ saṃbhavati, tasmāt dravyaguṇaviśiṣṭakarma
yathā 'āgneyaḥ sūkteriktā upadadhāti' ityatra yāva- dihakamātreyasūktagrahaṇam, na tu tatra kapiñjalādhikaraṇa- nyāyapravṛttiḥ |
manorkrayaḥ yāḥ vikṛtau vihitāḥ tāḥ yāvadarthe prayojanānusāreṇa yāvatmīmiḥ abhisamindhanarūpo'rthaḥ sidhyati tāvatya eva prayoktavyā na sarvā manulipsā iti śeṣaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- tat etat somapānavyāpadi somendra karma sarvatra vamane syāt ātvije yājamāne vā |
na viśeṣaḥ kaścidādhīyate asya vamane syāt , nāstyeti |
vā-- aśrutapratiṣedheṣveva karmajñatvāt svāmi- kartṛkatve siddhe'pi tasya kiṃ ātmīyaṃ vamanaṃ nimittaṃ uta ātvijyamapi iti vicāryate |
kiṃ prāptam ? viśeṣa- prāgupādānāt ubhayatrāpi syāt |
yathā ca svāmimavamena pratipattivināśaḥ tathā ātvijyenāpi, ubhayoḥ dravya- saṃskārātmakatvāt |
tasmāt yadi doṣanighārtārthametat karma athāpi apūrvopakārārthe ubhayathā vamanadvaye'pi kartavyam |
tadarthaṃ khalu yajamānārtham, yatra somo vamyate |
yat atra somendra karma, tadapi tadarthameva |
tat soma- svāmino yajamānasya sat upakartuṃ śaknoti, na ṛtvijaḥ |
na hi tat ṛtvigarthaṃ karma, yatra somo vamyate |
ayodhyeta, somavāminaḥ adhvaryoḥ hotṛrvā ātmīyā ṛtvijaḥ tadīyeṣu abhisu nivartiṣyantīti |
tathā sati, yadi vā vyuddhasomasa karmaṇo nāśam, na somavāmino'dhvaryorhoturvā, tatra atyantaguṇabhūtā adhvaryādayaḥ svairṛtvigbhiḥ kārayanto na phalaṃ prāpnuvanti |
tadarthaṃ ca kriyāṇāṃ na yajamānasyopakāre vartate iti na ṛtvijo vamane kriyate |
vā-- yadyapi tāvat ārādupakārakatvaṃ tathāpi svāmivamane bhavitavyam |
' 'yaḥ somaṃ vamati sa nirvapet' iti yacchabdatacchabdayogāt yāgavamanayoḥ ekaḥ kartā gamyate |
tatra naimittikaṃ tāvat svāmikartṛ- katvena asaṃdigdham |
na ca svatantrameva nimittam, śuddhena ākhyātena nimittapratyayānupādāt |
tena cet saṃbadham, pūrvataṃ samānakartṛ- katvam, paścāt nimittatvapratītiḥ |
atha ṛtvijaḥ devatārtha pariikrayārthaṃ ca dravyaṃ tyajanti |
tatasteṣāṃ svātmani parikrayavirodhāt avaśyaṃ tairapi anye adhvaryādayo varītyantaḥ |
ādhānagatena tu ātmane- padena agnīnāṃ ādhānavyatiriktapuruṣasaṃbandhābhāvāt svāmyartheṣu agniṣu yaṣṭavyam |
tataśca yadi tāvat vāntasomakartopakārabuddhyā kurvanti tato deśakālakartṛ- medāt viguṇam, na tena pradhānena gṛhyate |
na ca āhutya deśādibheda āmnāyate, yena tastvāde'pi avaiguṇyamāśrayeta |
svāmivamane ca kṛtārthatvāt na anenaiva śāstreṇa deśāntarādīnāmanujñānam |

kathaṃ vā ekameva śāstraṃ svāmimanapakṣe samānadeśāditvaṃ āśra- yet, ṛtvigvamane ca tadbhedam ? atha tu ātmārtha- buddhayaiva te prayuñjīrān, evamapi ṛtveyanāghāritasya puna: puruṣārthatvābhāvāt tadarthena kriyamāṇasya āna- yaikyameva syāt |
atha tu etasiddhayarthe puruṣārthataiva śāstreṇaśrīpate tathā sati upasthitaṛtutyāgāt asaṃ- nihitasvargādikalpanāpyatra viprakarṣaḥ |
sadṛśaṃ laukika- vamane'pi etat iti na yāge syāt |
atha tu adhvaryādivamane'pi svāmyeva dravyaṃ rathayet tathā sati tadeva bhinnakartṛkatvaṃ āpadyeta |
ubhayāśrayaṇe vā vairūpyanimitto vākyabhedaḥ syāt ; 'yaḥ somaṃ vamati, yasya somaṃ ṛtvijaṃ vamati' iti ca āśrayāt |

yadā tu vākyaśeṣopanītayāgaśeṣadravyapratipatti- niyamabhreṣopajanitaphalalābhāyogatvaṃ tena pratisamādhīyate iti kalpyate, tadā yajamānaphalatve'tyantādṛṣṭatvāt tadāśaṅkā ( phalalābhāyogatvaśaṅkā ) iti tenaiva prati- samādhāneṣṭiḥ kartavyā ityasadidham |
yat dakṣiṇālābhā- tyamakaṃ ṛtvijāṃ phalaṃ tat sati asati ca vamane labhyamānaṃ dṛśyate iti nirāśrayatvāt anapekṣitaprati- samādhānaṃ neṣṭiṃ gṛhṇāti |

yadā'pi prakṛtakarmakartṛ- niyamaśona bhakṣayitusaṃskārārthaṃ bhakṣaṇam, ataśca dveṣe karturvaiguṇyamupajātaṃ dravyasaṃskārasya tadupayogitātmakasya niṣṭhatvatvāt iti kalpyate tadā'pi tad-aśrutatyāja- mānaphalaviprasaṅgāt tannibandharathatvāt yattacchandani- deśācca yajamānavamane eva bhavitavyam |

yadā'pi hi soma- vamanāt na vihitakaraṇam, nāpi pratiṣiddhasevanamāpadyate iti kṛtvā dopanirmātārthatvaṃ iṣṭeḥ : anāśritya naimittikaṃ karmājñam, tadā'pi ca yacchabdena puruṣopacāttatvāt jaṅgamyamānanyāyena ( 3|4|15-16 ) prakaraṇagata- puruṣasaṃskāratā adhyavasīyate tadā'pi 'yājamānāstu' ( 3|8|2|4 ) ityanenaiva tatkartavyatā |
yattu adhvaryādivamane'pi dravyapratipattibhreṣaḥ, kartṛsaṃskārāt vināśo vā samādhimapekṣate iti, yadyapi apekṣate tathāpi avighānāt na gṛhyate |
sarveṣu ca adhvaryapuruṣārtheṣu ca ṛtvigvamane avidhānamityuktam |
ataśca yadi tadamanaduṣṭameva tatsantumīmeva āsita- vyam |
atha duṣṭaṃ tat : sāmānyavihitaṃ. kiṃcit kartavyam |
na cātra ṛtvarthyādanyatamapakṣatvāvadhāraṇaprayojanamasti iti nātīva avadhāraṇe yatitavyam |
athāpi tattvajñānaṃ prayojanam, tato jaṅgamyamānapakṣaḥ parigrahītavyaḥ |
tathā ca sūtrakāraḥ : 'svāmino vā tadarthatvāt' ( 3|4|13|15 ) ityāha |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgaṃ ca bhavati, yajamānasya soma- vāmina iti |
katham ? 'somapīthena vā eṣa vyudhyate yaḥ somaṃ vamati' iti |
yajamānaḥ somasaṃskāre vinaṣṭe viguṇamasya karma iti vyudhyate, na kathaṃcit ṛtvijo vyuddhiḥ |
'ṛtvijo yasya somaṃ vamanti' iti vamanena saṃbandhaḥ syāt, na 'yaḥ somaṃ vamati' iti |
vā-- vyudhyate iti sa vaktavyo yasya somapānāt ṛddhiḥ prārthyate |
saumendraṃ sa caruṃ kuryād yaḥ somaṃ vama- tīti hi ||
iṣṭau ca ṛtuśeṣatvāt svāmyeva hi niyujyate ||
bhāṭṭa-- saiva hi yājamāne eva vamane syāt uta ṛtvijo'pi iti cintāyām, ṛtvigvamane'pi prati- pattilopenāpi vaiguṇyasyāvaśyakatvāt tatsamādhānārthaṃ iṣṭimiṭiḥ syādeva |
iti prāpte, iṣṭisyādiyaṃ ṛtvig- tvāt yajamānena kāryā, ṛtvigbhiḥ yajamānadravyasya tyaktumaśakyatvāt, svadravyeṇa svāmiṣu karaṇe punaḥ ṛtvarthatvānupapatteḥ |
yajamānakartṛkāyā ca na ṛtvigva- manasya nimittatā, 'yaḥ somaṃ vamati' iti yacchabda-
balena iṣṭe: vamanasamānakartṛkatvātpateḥ tasya ca upādeya- viśeṣaṇatvena vivakṣitatvāt |

ataśca samānakartṛkatva- balāt, yadyapīmiṣṭi: naimittikī kratūpakārikā, yadi vā anaimittikī evaṃ arthavādavaśāt ṛtuvaiguṇyasamā- dhānārthā satī ārādupakārikā, yadi vā vamanasya jumbhādeva ārthikaṃ nimittatvamaṅgīkṛtya taddeva iyamiṣṭi: ṣaṣṭhyā kratuyuktapuruṣasaṃskārikā, sarvathā yajamānavamane eva syāt |
ṛtvigagamane tu sāmānya- vihitaṃ yajuryenanimittam ( prāyaścittaṃ kāryam ) |
maṇḍana— 'syāt svāmino vai vamane sa yāga: |
tanmataṃ tannirāsaśca mīko. pṛ. 884 'ākṛtivāda: ' iti bindau śāstradīpikāprabhṛtake draṣṭavya: |
saugandhikena tṛtīyasavane abhyajyate añjanā- bhyañjane nāma satre |
bhā. 9|1|6|21, sautya: iti sutyātvāt savanīyaṃ (paśūṃ) āhu: |
mīko. pṛ. 200 'atideśa: ekādaśineṣu paśuṣu ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
mīko. pṛ. 3259 'yūpānāṃ agnimiṣṭhānāṃ mānaṃ sautye'hani' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
sautrāntikā: jñānavaicitryasiddhayarthaṃ arthamapi nīlapītādivicitrakārameva kalpayanti, na nirākāram |
yadeva ca ākārasamarpaṇaṃ hetutvaṃ tadeva arthasya āhaṃ iti na prājñalakṣaṇayoga: |
yathā āhu: - ' bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ grāhyamiti ced grāhyatāṃ vidu: |
nanu evaṃ jñānasamaya janakasyārthasya atītatvāt kathaṃ vartamānabhāvasya: ? jñānākāro jñāyaṃ vartamāna: prayate, arthastu tatsamarpakatvā atīta eva kalpyate, ato na doṣa: |
kathaṃ puna: pratyakṣa- jñānena avabhāsasya pratyakṣatvam ? idameva pratyakṣa- marthasya yat sākṣāt sākāravijñānajananam |
yastu paraṃ- parayā sākāraṃ vijñānaṃ janayati, so'numeya: |
yathā vahnilakṣaṇaṃ dhūmalakṣaṇaṃ taddarśanatadvikalpaṇādhikā abhijñānaṃ janayatya anumeyam |
ata eva pratyakṣamanu- mānaṃ ca dve eva pramāṇe |
sākṣātkanasya pratyakṣatvāt paraṃparayā janakasya cānumeyatvāt ajanakasya agrāhyatvāt, nāto dvayādanyat saṃbhavati iti |
'agni citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta' atra prasidvasautrāmaṇyapekṣayā karmāntarameva tadarthakaṃ agnipūrvakālatvaviśiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |
atrāgnicyanā- ṅgatvena sautrāmaṇīyāgasya vidhi: na tu kālārtha: saṃyoga: |
sautrāmaṇi: abhicyanāṅgaṃ san api iṣṭiprākṛtitvāt parvaṇi kārya: na tu cayanakāle eva |
vi. 4|3|20, sautrāmaṇi: cayanāṅgaṃ 'agni citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta' iti |
sautrāmaṇi: cayanāṅgatva: yāgaprayogottarakālīne parvaṇi kārya: , na tu cayanasamanantarameva |
sautrāmaṇi 'agni citvā ' iti vihita: ṛtvaṅgam, na cittyaṅgam |
' agni citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta ' iti sāścittyakatvena cinotyartha- tvāt ṛtvaṅgaṃ sautrāmaṇī vaiguṇyatva kratoranantaramevā- nuṣṭheyā |
sautrāmaṇī abhicyanottarāṅgaṃ 'agni citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta' iti |
mīko. pṛ. 2984 'bṛhaspatisavanyāya: ' ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
tatra abhicyanāṅgaṃ prasiddhasautrā- maṇyā: sakāśāt karmāntarameva |
vi. 4|3|12, sautrāmaṇyā: aṅgāgniṣvedapi nāṅgina: kāle anuṣṭhānaṃ kiṃtu svakāle parvaṇi |
mīko. pṛ. 27 'agnicyanāṅgabhūtā: sautrāmaṇyādaya: ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhā. 4|3|16|41, sautrāmaṇyāṃ anyadevatā: paśu- puroḍāśā: bhavanti anyadevatā: paśava: |
10|1|9 | 24, sautrāmaṇyāṃ āśvino dhruva:, sārasvato meṣa:, aindra ṛṣabha: ityevidhavā: paśavo vijātīyā: santi |
teṣu kumbhīśūlavāśapaṇīnāṃ meda eva, na tanmam |
11 | 4|10|37-38, sautrāmaṇyāṃ āśvina: sārasvata: aindraśca iti traya: surāgrahā:; atha: prayogahrāsa: |
tatra adhvaryu: āśvinaṃ juhoti, brahma sārasvatam, prati- prasthātā ca aindram |
tathā uttare'mo prayogahān juhvati, dakṣiṇe'mo surāgrahān |
grahaśeṣasya ca pātāraṃ kaṃcid brāhmaṇaṃ parikrīṇāti |
tasyaiva śeṣasya kiyantaṃścidaṃ śatātpuṇyāṃ ( śatacchidrayāṃ ) kumbhāṃ viśārayanti |
3|5|3|4- 15. sautrāmaṇyāṃ ' āśvinaṃ gṛhṇāti ' ityādinā surāgrahā uktā:, tatraiṣṭikrahavi:sāmyādaiṣṭiko vidyantaḥ na tu somavidyantaḥ |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ āśvinasārasvatasautrāmadevatākeṣu paśuṣu aindravāruṇāvitrā: puroḍāśā: paśuprakaraṇāloktyadhante |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ paśupuroḍāśadevatāvipri- pattau vyudadhvacanaṃ devatāsaṃskāre evāvakalpate |
' yadye sautrāmaṇyāṃ vyuda tadasyā: samuda, yadanyadevatā: paśu- puroḍāśā: bhavanti, anyadevatā: paśava: ' iti 24 |
puroḍāśā bhavanti, anyadevatā: paśava: iti tadasyāṃ samudaṃ bhavati ' iti |
yaśvomayo: pakṣayordoṣa: na tameka- środho bhavati |
yathaiva hi saṃskārapakṣe vyudavacanamartha- vāda:, evamitarasminnapi pakṣe arthavādo bhaviṣyati |
anyayā devatayā paśupuroḍāśayāge nirvatyamāne na kiṃcit paśudevatāyāṃ hīyate |
tatra abhyuda eva vyuda- vacanaṃ bhavati |
madīye tu pakṣe devatāprakāśanaṃ aṅgabhūtaṃ hīyate |
anyadetaducyate yat vyudampe samudaṃ bhava- tīti |
adhīne tu vyudaśabde uccarite na śabdādhau gṛhīta iti |
naiteṣāṃ paśūnāṃ puroḍāśā vidyante grahapuroḍāśā hote paśava iti |
grahā eṣāṃ puroḍāśā:, grahapuroḍāśā hyete iti |
kiṃ teṣāṃ puroḍāśā: sāmānyam ? yadi devatā- saṃskārārthā: |
evaṃ dhruvate ' naitasya paśograhaṃ gṛhṇanti puroḍāśa- vāneṣa paśu: ' iti |
atha yaduktaṃ aindravāruṇāvitrāṇāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ sautrāmaṇī- prakaraṇotkarṣa: prāpnoti |
ato vipritapannadevatākeṣu chidrāpidhā- nārthatayā prakaraṇotkarṣo na bhaviṣyati |
tatra sautrāmaṇyāṃ saṃpratipannadeva- tākā eva codakena puroḍāśā: prāptā: |
kathama ? ekadeśā hi teṣāmime varṇāntarasahitā uccāritā iti gamyate |
kimarthaṃ punarevaṃ kalpyate ? yato devatāntarāṇi paśudevatā- saṃskārārtheṣu yāgeṣu pratyāyamānāni anarthakāni bhaveyuḥ |
yo graho devatāsaṃstabdhaḥ sa paśupuroḍāśa- yāgena na saṃbadhyate |
surāgrahān' iti vacanena anavadya eva homāvagamāt |
yaina ādānaṃ saṃbhavato yathopāttānāṃ ca homena śrūyate |
na ca 'ucchinaṣṭi na sarvahutaṃ juhoti' iti vacanena 'yathāgṛhītān grahānṛtvija upadadate |
dyutaśeṣāvamateḥ śeṣakāryakaraṇam, tasya 'brāhmaṇaṃ pari- payomagrahān juhoti, dakṣiṇe surāgrahān' iti |
krīṇītoccheṣaṇasya pātāraṃ yadi na vindet valmīka- tadvacca śeṣavacanam |
vapāyāmanavanet tato'pyavaśiṣṭaṃ śatāttuṇānāṃ viṣkāra- bhāṣyam-- etameva nyāyaṃ śeṣavacanamupabṛhayati |
yanti' iti viśiṣṭa pratipatyantaravidhānenātideśika- 'ucchinaṣṭi, na sarvaṃ juhoti' iti |
yadā tu vārtikoktarītyā devatāsaṃskāra- yāduccheṣaṇasya pātāram' iti |
rārthaṃ yāgāntarameva surāpayodravyaṃ vidhīyate tadā'pyoṣa- vācaniko viniyogaḥ, 'śatātṛṇānāṃ viṣkārayanti' |
ahame vakṣyamāṇatvena sviṣṭakṛdādiprāptāvapi pūrvavadeva- vā-- ananyaśeṣabhūtaśca pratiṣedho'nuvādaḥ 'ucchi- |
maṇīyāgasaṃbandhini grahe na syuḥ; śeṣakāryāṇīti śeṣaḥ |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ surāgrahāḥ śrutāḥ 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti na kartavyamiti |
tatra dāśapaurṇamāsikaḥ pauro- śā-- sautrāmaṇyāṃ payograhāḥ surāgrahāśca |
bhā. 8|2|1|9-9, śrūyate 'yathāgṛhītān grahān ṛtvija upadadate, utta- |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ surāgraheṣu anuṣaṭkāraḥ; samupāhuya makṣaṇaṃ, re'mau payograhān juhoti dakṣiṇe'mau surāgrahān' iti |
krayaṇaṃ, śravaṇaṃ, purorucaṃ, upayāmagrahaṇa, āsādanaṃ, tatrāpi pūrvadeva saṃśayapūrvottarapakṣaḥ |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ surācamasaṃ 'brāhmaṇasya mūrdhani āsāda- ci-- 'sautrāmaṇyāṃ grahe sviṣṭakṛdādista na vā'sti |
maṇīprakaraṇe vipratiṣidhāt na śakyaṃ dṛṣṭakāryamāsādanaṃ bhāṭṭa-- sautrāmaṇī nāma paśuyāgāḥ |
tasmāt kriyāmātramadṛṣṭakāryaṃ sautrāmaṇīprakaraṇe deśāptadevatāsaṃskārārthaṃ paśupuroḍāśo dravyatayā payograhāḥ |
prasaktau amīnāṃ pātrāntare sthāpanena sahanayanaṃ syāt upadadate, uttare'mau payograhān juhoti dakṣiṇe'mau |
nidhanasya prakaraṇābhāvāt prakṛtāśrayālāmena guṇaphala- hotrāṅgatvam (ityādiḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ) |
mukkyānāṃ brahmasāma bhavati' iti ukthyastotramadhya- (6|1|2|50) ityanena nyāyena, 'ṛṣūṇāṃ tvā |
tadeva punaḥ 'yadi rathaṃtara- devatānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmi iti rathakārasyādadhyāt' |
sāmā' 'yadi bṛhatsāmā' iti naimittikatvena atirātre ityādyānanmantravarṇāt 'saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ' iti ca |
tataḥ punaḥ 'yo vṛṣṭikāmaḥ ; yo'nnādakāmaḥ, saudhanvanādaśasāmānādhikaraṇyāt, ṛbhuśabdasya 'taṃ |
yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa saumareṇa stuvīta' iti nityasyaiva nemimubhavo yathā' iti mantravarṇāt rathakāraviṣayatva- |
vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt' 'ūrk ityannādakāmāya' rathakārasya saṃkaratāratepi āghāne adhikāraḥ |
dayaḥ nidhanaviśeṣāḥ saumaraphalataḥ phalāntarayatayā ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vidhīyante ? evaṃ ca yadā vṛṣṭikāmena saumaraṃ prakāntaṃ saudhanvanāparaparyāyaḥ rathakāraḥ traivarṇikebhyaḥ |
tadā itarayorapi ūrk ū iti nidhanayoḥ tattvatphala- kiṃcidīnaḥ jātyantaram |
kāmanayā prayogaḥ hīṣnidhananivṛttiśca, 'vṛṣṭikāmaḥ sauparṇopāyaśāne vinatayā garumān amṛtārthe |
nidhanaṃ saumarasāmni kariṣye' iti pṛthak phala- saubharaṃ nāma sāmaviśeṣaḥ; ṣoḍaśīsaṃsthāyāṃ nityaṃ |
uta saumarasyaiva tattvatphala sādhayataḥ tattaḥ kāmyaṃ ca, atirātre naimittikaṃ ca |
nidhanaṃ śālāntaritaṃ niyasyate, evaṃ ca vṛṣṭikāmake saubharaṃ-- hīṣ, ūrk, ū |
saumare hīṣ ityeva nidhanaṃ prayoktavyaṃ ekaiva vṛṣṭiḥ prārtha- yo'nnādakāmo yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa saumareṇa stuvīta' |
vṛṣṭikādiphalārthatayā śrute kuryāt, ūrk ityannādakāmāya, ū iti svargakāmāya' |
saumare sāmani, hīṣādī nidhane ca kāmasaṃyogaḥ anyaḥ iti vākyāntaram |
puruṣaśruteḥ vṛṣṭikāmādiśabdaiḥ tattvatphalakāmasya tat pṛthakkṛtya svīkārya melane cobhayoḥ phalabhūyastvaṃ |
puruṣasya saumare nidhane ca pṛthak śravaṇāt |
eva hīṣādivākyeṣvanūyante na tu pārthakyaṃ vākyayoḥ |
sarvasya voktamatvāt tasmin kāmaśrutiḥ : hīṣādinidhanānāṃ kevalaṃ niyamanameveti siddhāntaḥ |
saumarasya sāmanaḥ tadīyasya hīṣādinidhanasya ca vihitam |
vṛṣṭyādirūpaṃ pṛthak phalaṃ iti pūrvapakṣa vāśabdena nivarta- saṃsthāvidhayaḥ |
sarvasya samasta- sādhyatvena āśrayatvāyogatvāt āśrayatvayogyasya ca |
vayavasya saubharasya 'yo vṛṣṭikāmaḥ' ityādivākyāntareḥ mī. pṛ. 486

uktatvāt uktavṛṣṭyādiphalakatvāt, tasmin saubhara- phale eva vṛṣṭyādiphalakatvaṃ kāmaśrutiḥ 'vṛṣṭikāmāya' ityādicatuṣṭayasya-vṛṣṭikāmādipada-vṛṣṭyādiphalaśabdaḥ saubharavākyoktaphalasyaiva prasabhijñāpakaḥ syāt |
nanu yadi saubharavākye nidhanavākye ca ekameva phalaṃ tarhi nidhanavākye vṛṣṭikāmāya ityādi punaḥśravaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt, iti cettatrāha |
saubharasya vṛṣṭikāmāyatve hīṣa ityeva nidhanam, annādyakāmāyatve ūr iti ityeva nidhanam |
tasmāt tattannidhanaviśiṣṭasya saubharadeva phalaṃ nidhanamātrāccaiva kiñcit phalaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
api ca vṛṣṭiprārthanayorapi medaḥ kartavyo yadi nidhanadaparaṃ phalam |
atha tu nidhana- niyamastato hīṣaiva proktanyamekaiva vṛṣṭiḥ prārtha
' nidhanānuvādena hīṣidhāne phalapadamarthakaṃ punaḥśrutivaiyarthyaṃ ca syāt |
saubharagrahaṇenaiva hi nidhanamātravacanaiḥ prāpta iti tanmātravacanenāyaṃḥ |
tatra yadi vṛṣṭikāmāya yatsaubharaṃ tasya yannidhanamiti viśiṣṭamantyaṃ tatra hīṣidaṃ prayujyate tato'ti 'nekasaṃjñakacaraṇādācārya bhidyeta |
yadyapi vṛṣṭikāmāyasaubhara- tannidhanāni prāptāni tatrā'pyanekasyāpi saṃnidhirastīti vyavacchedārthamavaśyaṃ yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ |
pūrvapakṣanirākaraṇamapi na samyak kṛtam, samāmnāyādeva hīpādīnāṃ nidhanasiddheḥ |
tasādevaṃ varṇanīyam (dūṣaṇamabhidhāya svamatena bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātumupakramate) 'vṛṣṭikāmāpadenaiva saṃbandha sati saṃśayaḥ |
' atra hīṣiti vṛṣṭikāmāyetyevamevāva- sthite saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sākṣātphalena hīṣaḥ saṃśravo'tha phalalakṣi- tena sādhanaviśeṣaṇeti |
tadā ca 'hīṣiti nidhanam' iti, etaphalaṃ bhavatīti vacanavyakkiriva bhāṣyakāreṇa darśitā |
'vṛṣṭikāmāyeti saubharaviśeṣaṇam' iti saubharasya nidhana- vākye svapadenānupādānāllakṣaṇārūpeṇaiva viśeṣaṇatvam |
tatra tathaiva vidhipunaḥśrutyapekṣaṃ vyākhyānam, prayogavacana- sāmarthyādeva siddhaṃ syāditi, aparā vyākhyā |
yadi hi svārthapravṛttasyaiva saubharasya nidhanamātraṃ niyamyeta tata- stat prayogavacanenaivopanītamādīṣādiṣvidhisiddhervidhana- rthakavyaṃ bhavet |
phalasaṃbandhapakṣe tu na prayogavacanaḥ samartha ityarthavattā |
' anyathā'nena saubharaṃ prakaraṇagatamapi vṛṣṭi- sādhanaśaktiyuktaṃ lakṣyeta |
tathā 'śrutilakṣaṇāviśaye ca' iti bruvato bhāṣyakārasyāpyetadeva vyākhyānamipretamiti gamyate |
' sarvasyaiva saubharasyāyaṃ kāma- saṃyogaḥ pūrvokta eva pratyabhijñāyamānaḥ kīrtyata iti nāpūrvaphalaprāptiḥ |
kimarthā tu prāptasya punaḥ śruti- rityāha--nidhanārthā punaḥ śruviriti |
kasmā- tpunaḥśrutyapāttena phalena hīṣādayo na saṃbadhyante |
' hīṣā vṛṣṭiṃ sādhayediti hi gṛhyamāṇe'vaśyaṃ kimāśritenetyapekṣyate |
tatra yatsaubharaṃ prakṛtaṃ tattāvanna śakyamāśrayaṃ pratipatum |
na ca tadīṣā sādhayituṃ śakyam, yathā dadhnā homaḥ |
yattu tena vyāpyā sādhayituṃ śakyate nidhanam, na tasya prakaraṇamastīti na vākyādinā''śrayatvaṃ pratipadyate |
tatra yadi vākye- naiva phalasaṃbandhaghaṭaneva cā''śrayalābhastato vākyaṃ midyate |
tathā nidhanamātrānuvādena hīṣādisaṃbandhe prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā sarvasāmasaṃśravaprasaṅge punaḥ saubharasya yaditi kathamapi viśeṣaṇīyam, tatrāpi punarmatiḥ kleśanīyā |
' na tāvatsaubharavacana nidhana sādhita- tena prakaraṇamapyasaubharaṃ sādhitaṃ bhavati |
na ca yathā śaktyāvatsā''śraye- dityeṣā kalpanā''stītyuktam |
upeyāpi tvāśrayatvama- nekaprastāvādibhakti saubhare katamasyāṃ bhaktau hīṣādayaḥ prayujyantāmiti naiva jñāyate |
'mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanā- chokavat' (12|1|10|15) iti prastāve vā prāpnuvanti |
evamatrāpi phale vihitānāṃ hīṣādīnāmāśrayatvena saubharamupasarpatāṃ samāmnāyavalena lakṣaṇayānāṃ nidhanatvamanudiśyata iti |
hīṣādiṣu bahusthānaḥ kā syāditi na gamyate ||
na hi teṣāṃ sthānā- ntaraṃ dṛṣṭapūrvam |
yo'pi vacanāntareṇa sthāna- viśeṣalāmaḥ so''pi pṛthakkṛtyatvaviśānādanaiva phala- codanayā gṛhyate iti tadartha eva vijñāyate |
hīṣā- dīnāṃ punaḥ samāmnāyaprāptaḥ sthānaviśeṣasaṃśravaḥ sa tāvat saubharavidhānena ṛtvarthatvena saubharaphalatvena copayojitaḥ |
idānīṃ tu phalaṃ svatantrasya hīṣo vidhānāt lokenedasāmānaramakyanārakṛtabhaktivartitvā- divaviśeṣo na jñāyate kāvatiṣṭhatām |
yadi hi prakṛta eva vihita iti vijñāyeta tatastasya jñātasthānatvāt saṃdeho na syāt |
nanu caikatvācchabdasya ya evārthaḥ prakṛtaḥ syāt sa eva lokādiṣpapīti tadgrahaṇa'pi tadeva viśeṣa- sthānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
' na śabdaikatvena yatkiṃcikāryaṃ sthānaṃ dṛṣṭasāmarthyaṃ tadevānyatrāpīti śakyate vaktum |
na hi yat, devadattasya yadyamānasya sthānamava- gataṃ tadeva bhujanasyāpi bhavatīti gamyate |
na ca saubharāmrābhūtasya hīṣaḥ sthānaṃ tadeva puruṣārthasyāpyavadhāraṇaṃ śakyam |
prāsaṅgika- saubharasādhanatvāditi cet, na, tasyaiva sthānaviśeṣalābhā- ttrāgasiddhatvāt |
itaretarāśrayaṃ hi saubharasādhana- tvena sthānaviśeṣasattāca sādhanatvamiti |
nanu yathā''myuditeṣṭyāṃ madhyamāditaṇḍulā upādīya- mānatve'pi prakṛtā gṛhyante tadā''śra hīṣādayo mahī- ṣyante |
yuktaṃ tatra prakṛtāmirvibhajativākyepekṣitānāṃ devatāsaṃyogavākyānāṃ tadviṣayatvācchando'pyamadhyādi- vibhāgatvaṃ ca prakṛtaprayatnatiriktādanyeṣāmagraham |
iha tu na hīṣādīnāṃ tādṛkkāramastīti na laukikaprayayo nivartate |
yadā sarvaprakāramanviṣyamāṇo'pi śrautaḥ phala- saṃbandho na labhyaḥ, tadā mā bādhitatvaṃ śrutiriti prakṛta- sādhanalakṣaṇayā vijñāyate |
prakṛtagāmī ca vṛṣṭi- śabdastatsthānabhūtaṃ saubharameva lakṣayati nānyam |
te ca hīṣādayo yathā- bhūtāḥ saubhareṇa āśritāstathābhūtā eva niyamyanta iti vinā'pi nidhanasaṃbandhena siddhaṃ nidhanatvamanbhūyate |
yastu vākyabhedaścodita āsīttata nidhanasaṃbandhe sati śrutyā vā saubhare viśeṣaṇa- tvenopādīyamāne bhavet |
na ca prakaraṇalampyā viśeṣā vākyaṃ bhavati |
ki yatra kvacana śālāyāmadhītasya saubharasya vṛṣṭyādisādhanabhūtasya hīṣādayo niyamyeta uta yatra hīṣanidhanaṃ paṭhyate tacchālāgataṃ vṛṣṭikāmādye prayo- kavyam |
tatrāniyamena sahasrālāgatasaubharaprayoga- iti prāpte''ṣṭikāmādi nimitte hīṣādīnāṃ niyama iti prāpte''bhidhīyate |
yatra tannidhanaṃ paṭhyate tacchālā- gataiva vṛṣṭikāmādeḥ samasta gītitapādātyeti |
sāmarūpaṃ hi samāmnāyādava- gamyate taccālpenanyatvenaprayamijñānādapyadeva bhavati |
tatra yadi śāstrāntarāyā gīto śāstrāntarīyanidhanaṃ prayujyate tato rūpānyatvaṃ syāt |
na ca vacanāhate 'airaṃ kūcodreyam' (airaditi-'na girābhiriti brūyāt' 'airaṃ kūcodreyam' iti vacanabalāt-yajñāyajñīyasāmno girāpadatyāgena irāpade 'pi na prakṛte, iti vyatireka- dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ |
ata ekadeśaniyama iti kāṭhyabhoji- nyāyena samastaniyamaḥ |
yadvṛddhikāmāya saubharaṃ cya hīṣalīye nidhanaṃ tadekatra saṃpādanīyamiti |
śā - 'yo vṛṣṭikāmo yo'nyakāmo yaḥ svarga- kāmaḥ sa saubharena stuvīta' iti brahmasāmasyaṃ stotraṃ prakṛtya tadasādhaṃ saubharaṃ phalatrayasādhanatvena āmnātam |
phalatrayasādhanabhūtaṃ saubharaṃ prakṛtya āmnanti- 'hīṣviti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt, ūrgityabrahmakāmāya, ū iti svargakāmāya' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ - kiṃ hīṣādyo nidhanaviśeṣāḥ saubharatvāt phalāntarāyena vidhīyante uta saubharasyaiva tatphalaṃ sādhayantaḥ tatnidhanaṃ aniya- mena pāṭhataḥ prāptaṃ niyamyante |
iti puruṣasya śrota- tvāt tadarthameva hīṣādīnāṃ vijñāyate caturthā |
tacche- ṣatā ca tanmilitaphalatvādhanatayā iti phalārthatvameva eṣām |
vṛṣṭyādīni pūrvoktānyeva viparīrtamānāni pratyabhi- jñāyante iti na phalāntaragamaḥ |
soma- saṃgatistu revatīvākye guṇaphalaviṣaya- saṃbhede'pi iha tatsaṃbhava iti pratyavakṣānāt bodhyā |
sūtrārthastu- vṛddhikāma ityādipuruṣasaṃyogāt saubharā- dhite hīṣādau phalasaṃyogaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- brahmasāmākhyaṃ stotraṃ prakṛtya samāmnātaiḥ 'yo -vṛddhikāmo yo'nyakāmo yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa saubharena stuvīta' ityetaduruktastotrāśritaṃ saubharaṃ sāma- phalatrayoddeśena vidhīyate |

saubhare ca śākhā- bhedena nidhanasyāntimabhāvāvadhāvataratā 'hīṣ ū- ūrk' ityādintyarāmnātāni tadaiva saubharaṃ prakṛtya 'hīṣiti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt, ū iti svarga- kāmāya, ūrgityanyakāmāya' iti śrūyate |

saṃkhyāyāṃ prāpyamāṇāyāmāṣṭakapālatā asya coditā bhavati, nānyathā |
nahi bahuṣu kapāleṣu puroḍāśavat odanaḥ paktuṃ śakyaḥ |
kevale ca kapāle prāpyamāṇe yā'sau aṣṭakapālatā coditā, sā naiva prāpyate |
ato yasmin kaści- dravyapāte dravye paktavyaścariti |
sa eṣa caraḥ kapāle eva syāt, evaṃ prakṛtitvaccadaḥ anugṛhīto bhavati |
bhāṣyam-- yadi bahuṣu kapāleṣu na śakyate caraḥ paktum, vipratiṣedhādekasmin paktavyaḥ |
yadetaducyate, ' aṣṭakapāle bhavati ' iti etaduktaṃ bhavati aṣṭasu kapāleṣu śrapayitavya iti |
na vā'rthāntarasaṃyogādapūpāṃ pākasaṃyuktaṃ dhāra- ṇārthaṃ carau bhavati tatrāṣṭa pātralābhaḥ syāda- niyamo'viśeṣāt |
apūpapāke yat kapālamupādīyate, tadtenoṣmaṇā'pūpasya nirvartakaḥ pāko yathā syāditi |
yaduṣmaṇeodakatena odanapāko nirvartyate, sa odanapāko na kapālatena ūṣmaṇā nirvartyate |
tatrodakadhāraṇārthe kapālamupādīyamānaṃ na prākṛtakāryai syāditi codako naivānugṛhyate |
yāsu sthāliṣu somāḥ syuste caravaḥ syuriti |
somasthālīṣu caraṃ pakkavyaṃ bhuvan viśeṣeṇa sthālau cara- sādhanādhau darśayati |
sthālyāṃ sa casaṃśakaḥ pāko nirvartyate, na kaṭāhe, kapāle vā |
kiṃ bhavati prayojanam ? yadi kapālavikāraścaḥ, yadi codanena havirvi kriyate iti, yadi kapālavikāraḥ, tasmin peṣaṇamarthalopāt kartavyam |
atha odanena havirvi kriyate, akriyā peṣaṇasya, apūpahetutvāt |
piṇḍārthatvācca saṃyavanaṃ pūrvapakṣe kartavyam, na siddhānte |
saṃtāpanaṃ cāpyataśca śrapaṇāt pūrvapakṣe kartavyam, na siddhānte |
pṛṣṛkṣaṇe ca pūrvapakṣe kartavye, na siddhānte |
śā-- sa eṣa caraḥ kiṃ kapāle paktavyaḥ uta yatra kacit uta sthālyāṃ iti saṃśayaḥ |
na ca caraḥ aṣṭasu kapāleṣu śakyaḥ paktum |
satyaṃ aṣṭacaṃ prāpyate, tacca asaṃbhavāt nivartyate, na tu tanni- vṛtyā kapālamapi nivartintu arhati |
prakṛtau hi kapālatoṣmaṇā haviḥpāko nirvartyate, carastu udakagato- ṣmaṇā paktavyaḥ, tatra kapālaṃ udakadhāraṇārthaṃ upādīyamānaṃ aprākṛtakāryaṃ syāditi na codakānugrahaḥ |
sthālyāmeva syāt tasyāṃ hi caratvanimittaḥ pāko nirvartyate nānyatra, tasmāt sthālyāṃ syāt |
yadyodanavacane api caraśabde sthālyāmeva pākaḥ tataḥ pūrvādhikaraṇe sthālikapālavikāra iti pakṣasya odanena haviḥ vikriyate iti pakṣasya ca
ko'nuṣṭhāne viśeṣaḥ ? ubhayathā'pi sthālyāṃ pakkasya haviṣtvāt ityāśaṅkaya (agnidharādhikaraṇe prayojanamucyate iti śeṣaḥ) |
soma-- puroḍāśakāryaṃ cariva kapālakāryaṃ anya- svāvidhānāt na tannirvṛttiḥ ityatitheḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- sa pākaḥ prakṛtiprāptyā kapāle eva syāt iti |
vi-- ' caraḥ kapāle paktavyaḥ kāpi vā'pyuci- te'thavā |
sa ca ' caraśabdavācyatvena prākṛtahaviṣā bādhaḥ ' (mīko. pṛ. 1684) ityatra draṣṭavyaḥ |
mīko. pṛ. 1644 ' grahasamuccayanyāyaḥ ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
sauviṣṭhakṛtaiḥ avadānaiḥ sauviṣṭhakṛtānāṃ (daivatai- daivatāṃnāṃ, aidaiśca aidānāṃ) ekadevatākapayaṇe anu- samayaḥ, vājapeye prājāpatyapu |
6|5|15|45-47. mīko. pṛ. 2069 ' darśapūrṇamāsād bhedanādinimittakomāḥ ' ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
skandanabhedanādau ekadeśasya jāte'pi prāya- ścittaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
kiṃtu samuccayaḥ ' skanne juhoti ' ' bhinne juhoti ' iti |
' skanne juhoti ' iti skandanahomaḥ nimittatvāt āvarta- nīyaḥ |
(daśaṃdī hi ājyādihaviḥ skandanādau prāya- ścittāye homo vihitaḥ |

yathā stanandhayaḥ śiśuḥ āgalaṃ stanaṃ pāyayitvā mṛdāviguṇayogini talpe śāyitaḥ svakīyādijñānaśūnyatvena rāgādirahitaḥ san sukhamuttirevāvatiṣṭhate, tathā brahmajñānavat tatpuruṣo brahmānandakabhāgabhavati |
sāṅkhyasa. 336. stanayitnau nādhyeyam ' adhyayanadharmo'yaṃ na karmaṇi prayogadharmaḥ |
stambena tṛṇamūlena saha pāṃsunāṃ vedeḥ pūrvāghāt bahirharaṇam |

121120144. mīko. pṛ. 112 'amīpomīye paṣṭī ātithyā- barhiṣaḥ 0 ' ityatra adhikaraṇa draṣṭavyam |
