9|3|2|3. mīko. pṛ. 1226 'ūhaḥ raktapadasya haritapadasthāne 0' ityatra adhikaraṇa draṣṭavyam |
stāvakrena brāhmaṇādisaṃyuktasya vidhāyakatvaṃ na nivāryate tadānuguṇyāt |
'prauga śaṃsati ' āūthaḥ stuvaṃta ' ita stavana śaṃsanaṃ ca śrūyate |
tat kiṃ devatā prati guṇabhūta uta pradhāna iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
yājyāvat yājyā- mantrāṇāṃ guṇaprakāśadvārā guṇaprakāśaparatvaṃ tadvat |
stotraśastre devatā prati guṇabhūte iti ukte pūrvapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha |
yadi stotraśastre devatāsaṃskārakarmaṇī syātāṃ tarhi arthasya indrādidevatārūpamarthaṃ prati stotraśastrayoḥ guṇabhūtatvāt śeṣatvāt devatā-nāma-codanā arthena apakṛṣyate |
devatā- nāmaghaṭitamantrāmakastotrākhyayoḥ vidhānaṃ arthena indrādi- prakāśarūpaprayojanavaśena yatra pradhānaṃ ta
sarveṣāṃ vācaḥ stome 'sarvā ṛcaḥ, sarvāṇi yajūṃṣi, sarvāṇi sāmāni vācaḥ stome pārivlavaṃ śaṃsati' iti |
tathā 'yasyā'śvine śasyamāne sūryo nodiyāt api sarvā dāśatayī anubrūyāt' iti |
tasmāt saṃskārakarmaṇi stotraśastre iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
apivā śrutisaṃyogāt prakaraṇe stotriśaṃsatī kriyotpattiṃ vidadhyātām ||
stotraśastre devatāṃ prati guṇabhūte iti pūrvapakṣa- vyāpyarthaḥ |

'ājyaiḥ stuvate' 'praugaṃ śaṃsati' iti stotriśaṃsatī stuvate śaṃsati iti ākhyāte śrutisaṃyogāt prakaraṇe prakṛte māhendra- yāgādau kriyotpattiṃ kriyāyāḥ apūrvasya utpattiṃ vida- dhyātāṃ pratipādyatām |
śrutisaṃyogāt ityatra 'kavatīṣu stuvate' ityādi asamīkṣyā stotinā saṃyogaḥ |
'indrasya nu vīryāṇi provocam' iti ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā devatāyā guṇeḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
'indro yāto'vasthitasya rājā' iti prathamatayā devatāyāḥ guṇeḥ saṃbandhaḥ |

prakaraṇe ityatra 'prakriyate iti karmaṇyupapanna prakaraṇaśabdamaṅgīkṛtya prakṛte māhendra- yāgāṅgabhūte praugakhye stotre rathaṃtaracodanopasthānātmakena saṃnidhinā klaptyā śrutyā aindrasya pragāthasya akṣatvena saṃyogāt' iti upalabdhatayā sudhāyāmuktm |
kiñca idaṃ pūrvapakṣasūtraṃ iti api śrutisaṃyogāt iti akāra- praśleṣeṇa aśrutisaṃyogadoṣapatteḥ |
idaṃ siddhāntasūtraṃ iti itikṛtvā sarvamānya eva |
kiñca stoti- śaṃsatidhātvoḥ śrutyā stutivācitvāt ityevaṃ śrutisaṃyo- gāt ityādau'pi sudhāyāmuktaḥ |
stotraśastre pradhānakarmaṇī iti siddhānte hetvantara- māha |
śabdapṛthaktvāt dvādaśastotraśastro'miṣṭomaḥ iti dvādaśaśabdena stotrāṇāṃ śastrāṇāṃ ca pṛthaktvaṃ jñāyate |
tacca teṣāṃ prādhānye yujyate itarathā śaṃsanasya stavanasya ca ekaikatvāt dvādaśatvaṃ nopapadyeta |
stotraśastrayoḥ ārādupakārakatvena pradhānakarmatvābhāve tadvacanaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt |
abhiṣṭuti kratau prākṛtagrahānu- vādena 'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' iti agnisaṃbandhavidhī agniprakāśakatvena āgneyīnāṃ ṛcāṃ punaḥ 'āgne- yīṣu stuvate' iti vidhiḥ vyarthaḥ syāt |
tasmāt stotraśastre pradhānakarmaṇī ārādupakārake na guṇakarmaṇī iti siddhāntaḥ |
'stutamanu śaṃsati' iti vacanāt stotraśabdāt śastraśabdasya anyo'rthaḥ pratīyate |
ubhayorekastutiparatve tu vacanabādhaḥ syāt, kiṃca stutaśastrayoḥ paurvāparyasaṃbandha- vacanāt dṛṣṭādanyo'rthaḥ pratīyate |
prakāśanarūpadṛṣṭārthatve tasya ekatvena ekārthatvāt vikalpapattau paurvāparya- saṃbandhānupapattiḥ |
'samidho yajati' 'tanūnapātaṃ yajati' iti karmavat pradhānakarmaṇaḥ iva 'praugaṃ śaṃsati' 'pṛṣṭhānyupayanti' iti dvitīyā iṣṭitattvamabhidhānaṃ dṛśyate |
'stutasya stutamasi' ityevamādi 'indravanto vanāmhe yukṣīmahi prajāmiṣaṃ sā me satyā'''śvīryasya bhūyāt' iti phalasya nirvṛttiḥ niṣpattiḥ |
tasmāt pradhānakarmaṇī stotra- śastre, na tu devatāṃ prati guṇabhūte iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- 'praugaṃ śaṃsati' 'niṣkevalyaṃ śaṃsati' 'ājyaiḥ stuvate' 'pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' iti guṇavacanaṃ stavanaṃ śaṃsanaṃ ca |
yadetad guṇavacanaṃ śrūyate kimetad guṇabhūtaṃ devatāṃ prati, uta pradhānamiti |
guṇavacane nirvartyamāne guṇī devatā saṃkīrtyate, nānyathā tadguṇa- vacanaṃ bhavati |
tatra pratyakṣaṃ devatābhidhānaṃ gamyate, devatāprakāśanaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ upakāro yāgasiddhiḥ |
yathā 'yājyām-āha' 'puro'nuvākyām-āha' iti stutivacanaṃ devatāprakāśa- nārthavat tadvadetadapīti |
vā-- 'yaistu dravyaṃ cikīrṣate' ityasyāpavāda- tvena stotraśastropanyāsaḥ |
tatra guṇānāṃ tāvadakarmatā niṣprayojanatvāt ekāntena stutyarthatā |
tannivartitatā tu stutiḥ kiṃ stutyasya smārakalatvena śeṣī- bhavati, uta svaprādhānyenādṛṣṭārthā bhavatīti |
kiṃ prāptam ? 'dṛṣṭena ṛtusiddhayarthā sādhyayanti yataḥ smṛtim |
stotraśastrāṇi tena syuḥ saṃskārā devatāḥ prati ||
bhāṣyam-- yadi saṃskārakarmaṇī eva stotraśastre, arthenāpakṛṣyeta devatānāmaśraddhānārthasya guṇabhūtatvāt |
devatārthasya guṇabhūto mantra iti tadpradhānabhāve yatra pradhānaṃ tatra nīyeta |
tasmā- deṣa duṣṭaḥ pakṣa iti paryudasitavyaḥ |
katamaḥ punarasau mantraḥ : 'ami tvā śūra' ityendraḥ pragāyo māhendrasya grahayajeḥ saṃnidhāvāmnātaḥ, yatrendrastatrāpakṛṣyeta |

' yā yadetannāmasaṃyuktā stutiścodanā bhāveneti yāvat, codyamānatvāt, sā tadarthaparatvāt tasminsati na svārthe karotīti tadadhrena aindrīstutirmāhendragrahayaji- saṃnidhimuluṅghya yatrendrastatra gacchet |
bhāṣyam-- na paryudasitavyam imaṃ pakṣam, saṃskāra- karmaṇī eva stotraśastre, devatābhidhānatvādeva |
indraśabdena mahendro- 'bhidhāyiṣyate, sa evendro mahattvena guṇena mahendra ityu- cyate |
pratyakṣaṃ hi indraśabdaṃ devatāvacanamupalabhāmahe, mahattvavacanaṃ ca mahacchabdam |
yathā rājā mahārājaḥ, brāhmaṇo mahābrāhmaṇa iti vaśāvat |
yathā 'sā vā eṣā sarvadevatyā yadajā vaśā, vāyavyāmālabheta' itya- jāvaśāśabdena codite karmaṇi chāgaśabdena nigamā bhavanti tadvat |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? 'tatra mantro- 'pakṛṣyeta yatra so'rthāntaraṃ vrajet |
' ya eva hi abhivyatībhirendraḥ stūyate, sa eva māhendragrahejyate |
na ca samāsārthaṃ vṛttasya taddhita- etasminneva prayoge samāsārthe vṛttirityete, etasminneva taddhitārthe |
na cāyamindraśabdaḥ avitahatavat svārthe taddhitārthena saṃbadhyate, vihitavat parārthe mahattvena saṃbadhyamanuccai |
anyaścendro haviṣo devatā bhavatīti sakṛduccāraṇe ca nobhayaṃ śakyate |
tasmādindro devatā mahattvaviśiṣṭaḥ (akṣarasya praśleṣeṇa praśleṣā- bhāvena ceti dvedhā vyākhyāsyate vārtike) |
harati-) tasmādindra eva mahattvaviśiṣṭo mahendro nānya |
na ca samāsaṃ kṛtvā taddhite kriyamāṇe |
na ca mahānindraḥ prāptaḥ, yato guṇenopa- apekṣāhetubhedena vyavahāraḥ pṛthaktayā |
pūrvaṃ sarvatra śuddhā- tmanaḥ pratipannadevatātvasya paścāttato'yaṃ guṇaḥ stuti- tathā yājyāpuronuvākyayoḥ |

'aindraṃ sānaṃsiṃ rathimam' ityendrayājyā- sthite ca devatāntare, śuddhasya devatāyāḥ prakāśanam, puronuvākyayodyam, 'mahaṃ indro ya ojasā' iti bhedena śuddhena vā viśiṣṭasya, viśiṣṭadevatāyāmāpi vā śuddhasya māhendraṃ darśayati |
tatra pakṣe devatātvam, śuddhaśabdāccaraṇe'pi vā viśiṣṭe devatātvaṃ
’ yadi hyekāntena prathamaṃ dṛṣṭārthatvamavadhāritaṃ syāt, tataḥ krama- saṃnidhikalpyā śrutirbādhyeta |
yatastu viniyogotkalā prayojanakalpanā, na tadarthenaiva viniyogaḥ, tena krama- saṃnidhibhyāṃ viniyukte dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ vā prayojanaṃ kalpyamānaṃ na virudhyate |
liṅgaṃ hi devatāṃ prakāśayituṃ sāmarthyena tanmantraṃ svarūpe viniyuṅkte, tathā cāsyānyatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
karmasaṃbandhe tu na kaścid dṛṣṭo vyāpāraḥ |
tadetalliṅgaṃ yadi sāmānyataḥ kenacitkarmasaṃbandhaḥ kriyate, tataḥ kathaṃ tasyopakārakatvītyapekṣite, yathā śaknotītyevamā- śrayaṇāt devatāprakāśanādvāreṇeti viniyuṅkte |
kiṃca ‘evaṃ ca saptamī ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyā stutirviśati |
naiṣa doṣaḥ, ‘ādhāratvamapi hyasāṃ kara- ṇatvaṃ ca vidyate |
api ca ‘stauti’ ‘śaṃsati’ iti stutibhavanā pūrvārthābhūtā śrūyate |
tasyāṃ ca dhātvarthaḥ karaṇabhūtaḥ śeṣārṇāṃ ca kārakāṇi nityaṃ dhātvarthe niṣpādyante saṃbadhyante |
tatra yadi ‘mantrāḥ stotranirvṛttārthā bhavanti, tato'pekṣitārtha- karaṇāt śāstradṛṣṭamarthaṃ kurvanto dṛṣṭārthā bhavanti |
kiṃca, ‘śrutyaiva ṣaṣṭhī pārārthyaṃ devatānāṃ bravīti naḥ |
’ devatāprādhānye hi prātipadikārthatvāt avyatiriktārthaviṣayā ‘abhirmūrdhā’ itīṣat prathamaiva śrūyeta |
yathā indro yāto jaṅgamasya, avasitasya sthāvarasya ca rājeti |
na ca guṇānāmupayogo'stīti tatpradhānānyāśraye stutya- thaiva yuktā |
) tatrādyarthanyāyena śeṣapradhānārthaprasaṅgāt satyapi pūrvatra prādhānyaparyavasānasaṃbhave stutyarthaiva ekavākyatā yuktā |
na caivaṃ stotiśaṃsatyoḥ prakāśanalakṣaṇārthatā bhaviṣyatīti stutereva prādhānyam |
itarathā hi dvādaśatvaṃ na syāt stotrāṇāṃ śastrāṇāṃ ca |
atha bheda āśrīyete, tato na dvādaśatve avatiṣṭhate |
vā— pṛthastvaniveśinī dvidvādaśasaṃkhyā na prakā- śanāmede sati śabdenocyate |
sāmānyāvikṣāyāṃ vā pratyṛcaṃ pratipadaṃ ca tannivṛtterna dvādaśatve'vatiṣṭhate |
na cānyathā vivakṣā'sti yato dvādaśatā bhavet ||
’ atha stomaśatāt ṛksamudāyāsādhyāḥ stutayo gaṇyante, tathā prakāśanāpyanyaviśeṣaḥ |
’ prakāśanāttve hi pratyṛcaṃ pratipadaṃ ca tannivṛttidarśanāt kriyāsamāsena kiṃcikāraṇamasti, yena dvādaśatvaṃ paricchidyate |
apūrvā- rthatve tu teṣāṃ śāstragamyatvāt yathoktastomasaṃpadaḥ prāṅ- nirvṛttipramāṇābhāvāt ṛksamudāyenāvṛtteḥ taddvāreṇa kriyāsāmyādupalakṣaṇatvāt apūrvāṇāṃ dādaśatvena stutidvāda- śatvasiddhiḥ |
nahi pratyṛcaṃ sarvastomebhyo vā tatkalpanāyāḥ kiṃcipramāṇamasti yathā prakāśanasya darśanam |
bhāṣyam— agniṣṭuti śrūyate, ‘āgneyā grahā bhavanti’ iti |
vā— ṛcāmanuṣṭhātvāt āgneyagrahacodanayaiva āgne- yīnāṃ stutidhāvanasiddheḥ ‘āgneyīṣu stuvate’ ityana- rthakaṃ vacanam |
itarathā yadeva stotraṃ tadeva śastraṃ syāt |
nanu stutyatvāt taditarāpi tulyametat, atha pragītā- pragītamantrāsaṃbandhatvena medaḥ, tadyacchidratvena vā, sa pūrva- pakṣe'pyaviśiṣṭaḥ |
na tu prakāśanaṃ svataḥ phalato vā midyate |
bhāṣyam— pradhānakarmaṇaḥ ityatra cāmidhānaṃ bhavati dvitīyāsaṃjogena |
vā— yadidaṃ dvitīyāpratipāditakarmārthamabhidhānam, idaṃ cāparaṃ prādhānye kāraṇam |
pradhānakriyā hi kenacidape- kṣitā ‘agnihotraṃ juhoti’ ‘āghāramāghārayati’ itivadbhavati, na saṃskārakriyā, atyantaguṇabhūtatvāt |
‘stutasya stutamasi’ ityevamādi ‘indravanto vanāmahe dhuṣmahi’ prajāmimāṃ sā me satyāśīryajñasya bhūyāt’ iti stotraphala- manūdyate, na devatāyāḥ |
vā— yo'yaṃ mantre phalāśīrvādāḥ sa stuteḥ pradhānatve ghaṭate, sarvatra pradhānaviṣayatvāt prārthanānām |
tatve tu ‘devataiva pradhānatvāt phalaṃ yācyeta karmavat |
na svāmini sthite kaścidāsāt prārthayate phalam ||
’ śā— pragītamantrādya guṇena guṇinaḥ saṃtrandhāmi- dhānaṃ stavanaṃ stotram |
‘ājyaiḥ stuvate’ ‘praḍaṃ śaṃsati’ iti guṇakarmāṇi pradhānakarmāṇi veti vicāraḥ |
tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ devatāṃ prati guṇabhūtāni tatprakāśanāyāni, kiṃvā devatāṃ prati pradhānabhūtāni adṛṣṭārthāni iti |
soma— pūrvavidihāpi guṇakarmatvaṃ iti pratyaya- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ |

prakṛte na kevalaṃ prakaraṇānānena lakṣaṇā kiṃtu ‘abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ’ iti pragāthasya mahendragrahavyatyāsakrame uttarārdhane paṭhita- tvāt uttaragranthapratipattistatrārthatayā tataddeva indra- śabdasya tātparyamahān saṃbhavati lakṣaṇā |
ityādistotraśastrāṇāṃ yāgīyadevatāprakāśakatvayā yājyā- mantradeva dṛṣṭārthatvāt avaghātādivadeva saṃnipatyopakāra- katvam |

iti prāpte, loke guṇaviśiṣṭaguṇatātparyakatvābhidhāna- syaiva stutipadavācyatvena prasiddhatvāt, pragītāpragīta- mantrasādhyaguṇaviśiṣṭaguṇatātparyakamidhānasyaiva stotraśastra- padavācyatvāt, eṣāṃ guṇaprakāśatātparyakatvā'saṃbhavena naiṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ guṇaprakāśanā'rthatvam, api tu guṇaprakā- śanarūpāṇāṃ stotraśastrāṇāmārambhaniṣṭhādṛṣṭārthatayā ārā- dupakārakatvāt tanmantrāṇāṃ tadarthatvameva |
na ca prayājaśeṣābhicāraṇanyāyena dṛṣṭārthatvānurodhena lakṣaṇayā guṇaprakāśanā'rūpatvam, liṅgādeva tādṛśopapattau vidhī- vaiyarthyāt |
evaṃ ca māhendrāyāgasaṃnidhau aindrī stuti- rūpanvā bhavati |
itarathā śabdasamavāyinī devatā vidhi- śabdaneva nigameṣu vaktavyeti mahendrendrāśabdadena śakyate prakāśayitum |
ato yatrendra eva devatā tatro- ktapāṃpattiḥ, sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇābhāvena vā mano- tāsyāścidvadatva lakṣaṇayā indradeva mahendrendratve prakāśa- nāpattiḥ |
stotraśastreṣu viniyuktānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ karmasamavāyidevatāstutayā devatāsaṅgatyarthaṃ nāsti iti sutaśastrādhikaraṇe uktam |
vā. 3|2|16|17. sutaśastrādhikaraṇe liṅgakramayorvirodho darśitaḥ ' arthena tvapakṛṣyeta ' ( 2|1|15|4 ) iti |
sutaśastrādhikaraṇe stotra- śastrayorarthatvaṃ vakṣyate tathāpi tayorabhidhānātmaka- yoradṛṣṭārthatve'pi tanmantrāṇāṃ abhidhānarūpadṛṣṭārthatvaṃ na vihanyate |
' ityatra viruddhanāmāpi apekṣā- bhedena ekatra yugapatsaṃbhavatvāt vastuvirodhastavā- nnāsti |
vājiṃśabdasya viśvadevaparatve'pi na viśvadevatvena teṣāṃ devatatvaṃ kiṃtu vājitvena, tataśca sutaśastrādhi- karaṇagatendramahendranyāyena devatāmedāt nāsti pūrvakarma- samavāyaḥ |
sutaśastrādhikaraṇavārtike ' tadartho yāhyo yatra devatātvena coditaḥ |
tatra guṇānāṃ tāvadakarmajñatayā niṣpayo- janatvāt ekāntena stutyarthatā |
vi. 9|2|3. stutiḥ nāma stotrasya stāvakaguṇaiḥ saṃvandhīkīrtanaṃ gānaviśiṣṭam |
vi. 1|2|8. na ca pratyakṣaviruddhā stutiḥ saṃbhavati |
' yanti vā ete mithunāt ye saṃvatsaramupayanti |
anvavaidi mithunī saṃbhavataḥ ( mahāvrate ), tenaiva mithunānnayanti ' iti samudāyadoṣamabhidhāya tadavayavabhūtasya mahāvrata dharmeṇa anujighṛkṣan samudāyasyāvayavadharmeṇa stuti darśayati |
yasya stutistasya vidhānaṃ yat vidhīyate tasya stutiḥ iti paribhāṣā |
yatra ' ājyaiḥ stuvate ' iti codanā tatra kānicit padāni guṇaṃ pratyāyayanti kānicit guṇinam |
stuti- codanāsu stutimāśritya guṇābhidhānātmaketya codita- tvāt viparivṛttyā na guṇārthatvātiśavakṣyate |
karaṇesu ( abhidhāneṣu tu ) viparivṛttyā stutirguṇine vyāpayati |
vi. 1|4|15, stutyarthaḥ ' aindro rājanyaḥ ' ityendraśabdo rājanyasya |
stutyarthaḥ gavādīnāṃ apaśu- śabdaḥ ' apaśavo vā anye go'śvebhyaḥ ' |
stutyarthaḥ chaṃdomas asatra- śabdaḥ ' asatraṃ vā etadyacchandomam ' |
1|4|18, stutyarthaḥ brāhmaṇasya ' āgneyo vai brāhmaṇaḥ ' ityāgneyaśabdaḥ |
1|4 14, stutyarthaḥ yajamānaśabdaḥ ' ekapālasya ' yaja- māna ekapālaḥ ' |
1|4|13, stutyarthaḥ yajamāna- śabdaḥ ' prastarasya ' yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ ' |
1|4|14, stutyarthaḥ sāmnaḥ ayaśabdaḥ ' ayaso vā eṣa yo''sāmā ' |
asattā'pi guṇena asato'pi guṇinaḥ stuti- buddhayutpattisaṃbhavaḥ |
stutimantrāḥ -- yeṣu kānicidapadāni guṇaṃ pratyāyayanti kānicit guṇinam |
stuti- codanāsu stutimāśritya coditatvāt viparivṛttyā na guṇārthatvātiśavakṣyate |
stuti- mantreṣu sajātīyaiḥ samuccayo na vikalpaḥ |
stutimātraṃ yatra kasyacid vidhānārthaṃ tadanarthakaṃ ityuktaṃ ' āgneyasya kriyārthatvāt ' ( 1|2|1|1 ) iti |
stutye bale tu balavān parikopametīti nyāyaḥ |
ayaṃ mahān janaḥ mahatsu janeṣveva parākramaṃ karoti, na durbaleṣviti bhāvaviṣayāmāvataratīti |
' tejo vai ghṛtam ' ityevaṃ tejasvena ghṛtasya stūyamānatvāt vidhīyate
soma. 6|9|1 pṛ. 493. • stokena stokādvā suktaḥ iyaṃ karaṇe pañcamī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 45. • stokārthavidhisaṃbhave tāvat vidhāyakau bahutarārthavidhānamupekṣate |

' homasya phala- bhāvanākaraṇatvāt bhāvayedindriyaṃ homena ityevamavasthitasya karaṇabhūtenaiva dadhmā sammatvāt saṃbandhe anupapadyamāne avaśyaṃ mattvarthalakṣaṇā parigṛhyatetā dadhimatā homena iti |
na ca dadhi- śabdasya asati pravṛttinimitte karmanāmadheyatvaṃ ghaṭate |
so'yamubhayasamāt bhraṣṭaḥ dadhiśabdaḥ anarthaka eva prāpnoti |
tattaśca śabdadharmasaṃnikarṣātnugraheṇa dharma eva śabdaḥ parityāgāt bādhitaḥ iti bādhyaterāṃ śrutiḥ |
vā. 2|1|126 pṛ. 548. • stotavyaṃ sāmaiva na ṛcā |
9|2|8|29-30. mīko. pṛ. 4276 ' sāmaiva stotrayam ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
• stotraṃ arthakarma, ' stoti ' iti kartavyatā- pravīte : vi. 1014|22. • stotraṃ ekāpūrvasādhanī- bhūtastutisamūhaḥ |
su. pṛ. 885. • stotraṃ pragīta- mantrasādhyā stutiḥ |
vā. 2|1|13 pṛ. 416. • utkathyeṣu utkṛṣṭeṣu ṣoḍaśastotraṃ utkṛṣṭate veti cintāyāṃ utkarṣaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

grahaṇasya ṣoḍaśiyāgābhyāsa- kalpakatvena antaraṅgatvāt tatkramasya prābalyam, stotre grahaṇottarakālatvasya pradhānapratyāsatteśca bādhaprasaṅgena eka- sthevāsya sambhāvyadhinitakālatvācca nyāyatvāt |
māṭṭa. 5|1|18. • stotrāṇi sarvāṇi ekaviṃśāni bhavanti ṣoḍaśini |
ṭap. 9|2|5|24 varṇakaṃ 2. • stotrasya upākaraṇaṃ grahaṇottaraṃ bhavati |
vi. 105|22. • stotrātideśaḥ pañcokthya-śatokthya-śatāgni- homa-śatātirātrādiṣu jyotiṣṭomikavyāmiṣṭomāti- rātrādibhyaḥ |
10|6|1|22-23. mīko. pṛ. 61 ' abhisuti śrutasya trivṛttvam ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
• stotrāpūrvaprayuktā hi gītiḥ ; na varṇasvarūpa- prayuktā |
ṭap. 9|1|2|155. • stotrādau savanīyādau ca savanāntaragate yathāsavanaṃ svaraḥ |
su. pṛ. 1180, • mandrādisaratvābhya sava- nātvāttvāviśeṣeṇa stotrādiṣvapi avagatatvena saṃbhavatvāt stotrādau mandrādisaratvābhāvātpitturūpo doṣo nāsti |
bhā. 10|5|12|50, • stotraśastre sauti śaṃsati iti kartavyatāmātrat pradhānakarmaṇi |
( 2|1|13-29) stutistu guṇātātparyaka abhidhānaṃ ahaṣṭārthakaṃ ityukte stotraśastrādhikaraṇe |
ityukte, naipa do'sti, yataḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vinā'pyayam |
vā. 3|1|2|9 pṛ. 812-13. • stotraśastrādayaḥ ṣaḍahadharmāḥ ṣaḍahāvṛttau āva- rtante |
na hi te ahaḥsu avasānasaṃyogena codyante |
su. pṛ. 102. • stotraśastramantrāṇāṃ prākṛtānāmeva abhisuṣṭi avikāreṇa prayogaḥ |
bhā. 10|4|24|50. mīko. pṛ. 65 ' abhisuṣṭi stotraśastramantrāṇāṃ ' ityatra adhika- raṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhā. 9|2|8|30-31 varṇakaṃ 1. • stotrīyaḥ nāma ṛcaḥ jyotiṣṭome vahiṣpava- mānādau prathamaḥ ' upāste gāyatā ' |
bhā. 9|2|7| 29. • stobhaḥ nāma adhikatve sati ṛgvilakṣaṇa- varṇatvam, ṛgvilakṣaṇavarṇatvaṃ cārthānabhidhāyakatvam |
vi. 9|2|11. • stobhāḥ sāmaśabdārthaikadeśaḥ iti bhāṣyam, neti vārtikam |
' yathonyāṃ taduttarayogyāyati ' atra uttaravarṇavaśena gātavyaṃ na yonivarṇavaśena ityavagatam |
atha stobhāḥ atidiśyante na veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
eke ācāryāḥ dvyantarā ṛgantare uttarāyāṃ stobhasya nivṛttiṃ manyante |
yathā yonyakṣarāṇāṃ stobhāḥ uttarāyāṃ na pradṛśyante tathā yonyāṃ gītasya stobhasyāpi uttarāyāṃ nātideśaḥ iti |
yono gītatānāṃ stobhānāṃ uttarāyāṃ nātideśaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena vyāvartayan siddhāntamāha |
kiṃtu sarvātideśaḥ sarvasya sāmnaḥ ati- deśaḥ |
yadyapi stobhāḥ ṛkśabdārthaiḥ na saṃbadhyante tathāpi nārthakāste |
lokavat yathā gāyakaiḥ aṅgavastukāni yāni nāma prakṣipyante tāni gīti- kālagatanāmāni na arthasaṃbandhāya uccāryante tadvadihāpi kālaparicchedāyāni stobhāśrāṇi anuvartan |
tasmāt stobho'pi prakṣepa rūpo vikāraḥ syāt |
yonikṣatānāṃ stobhānāṃ uttarayorṛcoḥ anvayaṃ darśayati ' yatra ārcikāni padāni nirvartante stobhā gehamā- śnuyanti ' |
yonitastomanāṃ uttarayorṛcortideśaḥ iti siddhānte ukte pūrvapakṣī āha |
stobhānāṃ nivṛttiḥ syāt atideśo na syāt |
agniṣṭome avabhṛthasāma agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsyantaṃ iti āgneyyāṃ ṛci gīyate |
tatra ca ' agni- ghpati pratidahati ' iti stobhā bhavanti |
kvacit vikṛtisome ca ' ainyāmabhyasāma gāyati ' iti śrutam |
tena uktānāṃ stobhānāṃ tatra arthasya tapanapratidahanāderlopāt nivṛttireva svīkartavyā |
‘nivṛttirvā’ iti sūtreṇa prāptā pūrvapakṣaḥ śaṅkāṃ nirasyati |
abhiṣarpāta ityevaṃjātīyakānāṃ stobhānāṃ ainyāṃ ṛci anvayaḥ syāt, indrasya sītakramalaviṣayako'vākyaśeṣeṣu artha- vādaḥ syāt |
tasmāt ainyāṃ avabhṛyatāmagāne'pi abhi- ṣarpatīdīnāṃ stobhānāmanirdeśo na viruddhaḥ |
tathā ca vāmadevyasāmnaḥ yonistasya ‘o ho ho hāī’ ityasya stomasya uttarayorapi atideśaḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 5. stobhānāṃ huṃphadādīnāṃ kātyānādikṛtastomabhāṣya- rītyā arthābhidhānārthatā |
yadyapi navame (9|2|1|138) stobhānāmarthatvaṃ vakṣyate tathāpi sāmayonibhūtyā ṛcā ekavākyatvābhāvābhiprāyakaṃ tat iti adoṣaḥ |
ku. 1|4|143 pṛ. 46. stobhākṣarāṇi gītakālaparicchedārthāni kvaci prakṣipyante |
bhāṣyam— ‘kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati’ ‘rathaṃtara- muttarayogaryāta’ ‘yadyonyāṃ taduttarayogaryāta’ iti |
athedānoṃ idaṃ saṃdihyate, kiṃ stobhāḥ pradiśyante neti |
yā gītiḥ, sā pradiśyate, ‘yadyonyāṃ taduttarayogaryāta’ iti gāyati-śabdasaṃbha- ntvāt |
ārṣaca, ṛk-śabdārthaiḥ asaṃbadhyamānaḥ stobhaḥ anarthakaḥ syāt |
apica kacit bhavati vacanaṃ ‘ainyāmabhyasāma gāyati’ iti |
yathā ṛgakṣarāṇāṃ agītitvāt nivṛttiḥ, evaṃ stobhākṣarāṇā- mapīti |
yadi stobhā nivarteran, tatkṛto viśeṣo nopasaṃgyetaḥ syāt |
yattuktam, ṛk-śabdārthaiḥ asaṃba- dhyamānāḥ stobhā anarthakā bhaveyuḥ iti |
tathathā loke gāyanaiḥ aṅgavastukāni yāni nāma prakṣipyante tāni gītikā- gaṇanārthāni nārthasaṃbandhāyā uccante |
tadaha ipi kālaparicche- dārthāni stobhākṣarāṇi anuvarteran iti |
dup— ‘ṛkstomasvarakālābhyāviśiṣṭāyā gīteḥ sāmaśabdo vācakaḥ’ iti etat (bhāṣyaṃ) ayuktam |
yadyapi stobhā na sāmaśabdavācyāḥ tathāpi atidiśyante |
tasyopakurvataḥ dṛṣṭena sāhāyyaṃ kurvantaḥ stobhā upakurvanti |
tadatideśe ca yadi stobhāḥ nāgaccheyuḥ tatkṛta upakāro'pi hīyeta |
bhāṣyam— anvayattrāpi stobhān darśayati ‘yatra ārcikāni padāni nivartante stobhā gehamābhya anu- yanti’ iti |
na tena evaṃ- jātīyakāḥ stobhāḥ saṃbandheran iti |
bhāṣyam— anyāt saṃbadhyante lokavat iti yaduktam, tat parihartavyam |
na hi vayaṃ indrarūpaṃ pratyakṣamupa- labhāhe |
śā— sāmānyātideśe kiṃ stobhānāṃ atideśaḥ asti na iti saṃśaye, sāmabhyaḥ abhibhūtatvāt stomānāṃ ṛgakṣa- rāṇāmiva nātideśaḥ |
sāmāni hi yonau yena aṃśena akṣarāṇi abhivyañjanti tena dṛṣṭameva stuterupakāraṃ kurvanti |
stobhākṣarābhivyaktinirvartena tu aṃśena stutyopadhikameva aṣṭaṃ kurvanti |
tadyadi stobhā nātidiśyeran tannirvartyasya gītyaṃśasya lopāt tatkṛtopakārasya hānyā vaiguṇyaṃ syāt, tasmādati- diśyeran |
ṛgakṣarāṇāṃ tu pradhānatvāt na sāmavaśāt atideśaḥ |
soma— yadi ṛgakṣarābhivyaktirūpopakāramukhena sāmātideśaḥ tarhi stobhānāṃ ṛgakṣarābhivyaktau anupa- yogāt teṣāmatideśaḥ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
bhinna- tvena rathaṃtarādiśabdavācyatvabalāt atideśābhāve'pi rathaṃtarādiśabdavācyagītajñatayā pradhānabhūtagītyatideśā- deva tadatideśaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

stomanirvartyasāma- bhāgasya ṛgakṣarābhivyaktyā dṛṣṭadvārā stutyupa- kārābhāve'pi adṛṣṭadvārā stutyupakārakaṃ yonau klaptam, uttarayorapi stobhanirvartyasāmabhāgānatideśe tatsādhyādṛṣṭavattvena stuteḥ vaiguṇyaṃ syāt, ataḥ ṛgakṣarābhivyaktyā stutyupakārasya stobhīyasya adṛṣṭarūpa- stutyupakārārtha atideśe siddhe taccirvartakatvayā stobhā- nāmapi atideśa āvaśyakaḥ |
sūtrārthaḥ— stobhānā- mṛgantare nivṛttimugat eka ācāryā bruvate iti |
bhāṭṭa— sāmaḥ kaścit aṃśaḥ ṛgakṣarādhiṣṭhaḥ kaścicca stobhākṣarādhiṣṭhaḥ |
tatra sāmātideśe stobhānāmapi ati- deśo bhavet vā iti cintāyāṃ sāmnaḥ ṛgakṣarābhi- kyatvavat stobhākṣarābhivyaktyarthatvasya tulyatvāt guṇātturodhena pradhānabhūtānāṃ ṛcāmiva stobhānāmapi nātideśaḥ |
na ca stobhānāṃ prāyaśaḥ anarthakatvāt stotrāśadhanatvasaṃbandhena niṣprayojanānāṃ prādhānyānupapatteḥ gītikāālaparicchedatvena gīvyakṣatvāt tadatideśe ati- deśopapattiḥ iti vācyam |
‘abhiṣarpati’ ityādi- bhāṣyakāroktastobhākṣarāṇāṃ ṛgekavākyatvāvadhe'pi svātantryeṇa guṇāmidhānarūpastotrakaraṇatvasaṃbhavena ṛgaveda prādhānyopapatteḥ |
yeṣāmapi huṃphadādistobhākṣarāṇāṃ artha- śūnyatvaṃ tatrāpi tatkāraṇasya adṛṣṭadvārā anuṣṭhānavāde- syāt pradhānaṛgakṣatvaṃ prakaraṇādinā stotrātvameva vā iti na sāmāṅgatvakalpanā'vasaraḥ |
na ca sāmno vā adṛṣṭā- rthatvaṃ stobhānāṃ vā ityatra niyāmakabhāvaḥ |
sāmno'śe dṛṣṭārthatvaṃ aṃśe ca adṛṣṭārthatvaṃ ityevaṃvidhavai rūpyāpattereva niyāmakatvāt |

iti prāpte, ‘yajñāyajñiyena stuvīta’ ityādau tatra sāmnāṃ sāmānyāto viśeṣataḥ vini- yogasyaiva niyāmakatvena sāmoccāraṇasya tadaṃśe adṛṣṭā- rthatvam, stobhānāṃ tu arthaśūnyānāṃ gītikāālapariccheda- tvena dṛṣṭārthatvameva |
anyathā hi sāmnaḥ prakaraṇādineva sarvasyāpi vivakṣitārthasya lābhe viniyogavidhirvaiyarthyā- pattiḥ |
ato viniyogavaśena jhaṭiti prayojanalābhe dvārabhūtādṛṣṭasyāpi tatraiva jhaṭiti kalpanā, na tu stomeṣu, stotrādipūraṇārthasaṃbandhakalpanāyā'pekṣatvāt |
ataḥ : stobhādīnāṃ gītikāālatvāt tadatideśe atideśo- papatteḥ na tadaṃśasya lopāpatteḥ |
arthava- stomādhareṣu tu ṛgakṣaradeva stotrādyupayogapatteḥ gītireva tadaṃśatvaṃ iti tu pratibhāti |
ata eva anarthakastomeṣu ṛksattve sāmnaḥ āśrāyikatvaṃ tadabhāve śuddhādṛṣṭārthatvameva |
adhikaṃ ca vivarṇaṃ ca jaiminiḥ stomaśabda- tvāt |
bhāṣyam -- atha kaḥ stomo nāma, tasya lakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam |
ya ṛgākṣaramyo'dhikaḥ ; na ca taiḥ savarṇaḥ sa stomo nāma |
tadyathā, devadattena sabhāyāṃ paraṃ pralapatā bahustomaṃ kathitamiti |
lakṣaṇakarmaṇe hi tadeva prayo- janam, yallakṣito bhaviṣyatīti |
nanvanyatastasyāntam, adhikamiti vā vivarṇa- miti veti |
ekaviṃśatiṇavāyatirāmeṣu vivṛddhastomakeṣu ṛtuṣu adhikasaṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ prākṛtānāṃ sāmnāmabhyāsena iti pūrva- pakṣanyāyadṛṣṭyo vācyam |
stomavibhṛddhau adhikasaṃkhyā- pūraṇaṃ sāmnāṃ āgamena kartavyam, na prākṛtasābhyāsena abhyāsasya aśrutitvāt vidhānābhāvāt aviyamāna- śrutitvāt |
ekaviṃśatiṇavāyatirāmeṣu vivṛddhastomakeṣu ṛtuṣu adhikasaṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ aprākṛtānāṃ sāmnāṃ āgamena iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
ekaviṃśatyādeḥ uktāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ pṛthaktvaniveśāt pṛthaktve svabhāvato nive- śāt |
ekaviṃśatiṇavāyatirāmeṣu vivṛddhastomakeṣu ṛtuṣu adhikasaṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ aprākṛtānāṃ sāmnāṃ āgamena iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
parākuśabdāt 'parāk bahi- ṣpavamāne stuvanti' iti anabhyāsasya vācakaḥ parākuśabdo bhavati |
yathā 'parācīḥ sāmidhenīranvāha' iti anyamastā iti gamyate |
vivṛddhastomakeṣu ekaviṃśatiṇavāyatirāmeṣu saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ sāmnāmāgamena iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
utthā- vikārāt utthānāṃ avikārāt apunarvacanāt anabhyā- sāt |
'jāmi vā etadyajñasya kriyate yathaikaṃ bhūyaḥ kriyate' iti |
vivṛddhastomakeṣu ekaviṃśatiṇavāyatirāmeṣu saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ sāmnāmāgamena, abhyāsasyāśrutitvāt (10|5|16|16) iti siddhāntinā ukte, pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
parimāṇaśāstraṃ ekaviṃśena triṇavena iti stomaparimāṇavidhānaṃ arthacoditānāṃ saṃkhyāvidhisrūpatā- rthapattilabdhānāṃ prāpakaṃ syāt |
nahi sāmasu uktā saṃkhyā tāvatītyarthīḥ vinā svarūpā |
vivṛddhastomakeṣu ekaviṃśatiṇavāyatirāmeṣu āgamena saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ iti siddhāntavādī- abhyāsapakṣaṃ anupapatyā dūṣayati |
'śrīṇi ha vai yajñastomadāṇi gāyatrī bṛha- tyutthuṣṭu ... atra hyevāvapanti' iti āvāpavacanaṃ abhyāse svīkṛte nopapadyate |
vivṛddhastomakeṣu ekaviṃśatiṇavāyatirāmeṣu saṃkhyā- pūraṇaṃ sāmnāmāgamena iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
sāmaśāstre sāmnāṃ utpatteḥ sāmarthyāt āgamenaiva saṃkhyā- pūraṇaṃ nābhyāsena |
uktaṃ ca 'daśa sāmasahasrāṇi śatāni ca caturdaśa |
aindraṃ syāt sataviṃśāni yāni gāyanti sāmagāḥ |
' iti abhyāsena saṃkhyāpūraṇe eteṣāṃ sāmnāṃ utpattarnārthikā syāt |
yadi vivṛddhastomakeṣu ṛtuṣu sāmnāmabhyāso na syāt, dhuryeṣvapi sāmasu abhyāso na syāt |
tathā sati prāguktā dhurye āvṛttiḥ (10|5|13|11) virudhyeta |
vivṛddhastomakeṣu ekaviṃśatirāmeṣu yadi sāmnāṃ nābhyāsaḥ dhuryeṣvapi na syāt iti pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ śaṅkāyāḥ siddhāntī parihāramāha |
'āvṛttaṃ dhurṣu stuvate, punarāvṛttaṃ dhurṣūpatiṣṭhate' iti vacanena āvṛttidharmatvāt |
tasmāt āgamenaiva saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ nābhyāsena iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. stomavibhṛddhau bahiṣpavamāne purastāt paryā- sādāgantavyaḥ syustathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ dvādaśāhe |
agriṣṭome bahiṣpavamānaṃ trivṛt nāma ṛddhava- kāramakaṃ bhavati |
'ekaviṃśenātirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yāja- yet, triṇavenaujaskāmam, trayastriṃśena pratiṣṭhākāmam' iti vivṛddhastomakeḥ ṛtavaḥ paṭhitāḥ |
vardhitasaṃkhyā- pūraṇaṃ ca ṛgāgamaneti vakṣyate (10|5|126) tatra āgamitānāṃ ṛcāṃ kiṃ ante niveśaḥ |
kiṃvā paryāsāt prāgniveśaḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
ekaviṃśati- rāmeṣu stomavibhṛddhau satyāṃ bahiṣpavamāne stotre āgantavaḥ tṛcāḥ paryāsāt purastāt syuḥ |
tatra hi 'stomīyānu- rūpau tṛcau bhavataḥ, vṛṣaṇvantastṛcāḥ, tṛca uttamaḥ paryāsaḥ' ityuktam |
dvādaśāhe bāḍahike dvitīye'hani stotrīyānurūpau tṛcau paṭhitvā apūrvāḥ vṛṣaṇvantaḥ vṛṣan- śabdaghaṭitāḥ tṛcāḥ paṭhitāḥ |
tasmāt paryāsāt pūrvaṃ eteṣāṃ niveśo dvādaśāhe dṛṣṭaḥ iti prakṛte'pi tathaiva bhavitumarhati |
pūrvasmin sūtre 'purastāt paryāsāt' ityuktaṃ tatra ko'yaṃ paryāso nāmeti paryāsaśabdāt ucyate sūtreṇa |
paryāsa iti antasya antimasya ākhyā nāma bhavati loke |

'ekaviṃśenātirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yājayet, triṇa- venaujaskāmam, trayastriṃśena pratiṣṭhākāmam' ityatra stomānāṃ vivṛddhau, āgamena ca saṃkhyāpūraṇe sati āgantūnāṃ tṛcānāṃ paryāsāt purastānniveśaḥ iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntamāha |
āgantūnāṃ niveśaḥ na paryāsāt prāk, kiṃtu ante niveśaḥ |
tatsādhako nyāyaḥ 'ante tu bādarāyaṇaḥ' iti prāguktaḥ (5|1|19|19) |
ekaviṃśo'tirātraḥ triṇavo'tirātraḥ trayastriṃśo'ti- rātra ityatra stomavibhṛddhau satyāṃ bahiṣpavamāne saṃkhyāpūrtiḥ tṛcāgamane bhaviṣyati |
āgantavaśca tṛcāḥ paryāsāt tṛcāt purastāt niveśanīyā iti pūrvapakṣe dvādaśāhe vṛṣaṇvatāṃ tṛcānāṃ dṛṣṭānta uktaḥ : 'stomavibhṛddhau' |
satyaṃ dvādaśāhe bāḍahike dvitīye ahani vṛṣaṇvatāṃ tṛcānāṃ paryāsāt purastānniveśaḥ |
iti sa tu 'vṛṣa- vantastṛcāḥ, tṛca uttamaḥ paryāsaḥ' iti vacanāt bhavati |
ekaviṃśatyātirātre tu prakṛte vacanābhāvāt nyāyena nirṇayaḥ kartavyaḥ |
nyāyaśca āgantūnāmante niveśa iti 'ante vā taduktam' itya- śroktam |
dvādaśāhe yadyapi vṛṣaṇvadādya- stṛcāḥ paryāsāt prāk bhavanti tathāpi ekaviṃśati- rātrādayaḥ na tadvikāraḥ na dvādaśāhavikāraḥ |
tasmāt saṃkhyāpūraṇārthaṃ āgamitāstṛcā ante eva syuḥ |
tadvikāre'pi ahīnasavatroḥ vṛṣaṇvadatiriktānāṃ ṛcāṃ ante eva niveśaḥ na paryāsāt prāk |
vṛṣaṇvadvihānāṃ tu klṛpta- sthānāmāvāt ante niveśa eva yuktaḥ |
tasmāt stoma- vibhṛddhau bahiṣpavamāne āgantūnāṃ tṛcānāṃ ante eva niveśa iti siddhāntaḥ |

yajamānaḥ pumān vidvān, patnī strī cāviyā ca |

striyāḥ yad dravyaṃ bhaktopasarpaṇena vā kartanādinā vopārjitaṃ bhavati tadapi sā yasya svabhūtā tasya
raudrīmiṣṭiṃ vidhāya 'etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yāja- yet' iti vihitam |
iyaṃ sthapatīṣṭiḥ niṣādasthapateḥ iṣṭiḥ agnyādheyaṃ prayojayet |
sthapatiḥ ityarthe agnyā- dheyaṃ kṛtvā tatsaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu iṣṭiṃ kuryāt |
nahi agnyādheyaṃ vinā saṃskṛtānāmagnīnāṃ lābhaḥ saṃbhavati |
prayājavat yathā prayājān codakāt prayojayati tathā agnyādheyaṃ prayojayet |
tādarthyācca agnyādheyasya iṣṭyarthameva prayuktatvāt iṣṭyapavarge ādhānamapi apavṛjyeta samāptaṃ syāt |
agnīnādhāya iṣṭiṃ kṛtvā agnayo visarja- nīyāḥ sthapatinā ityarthaḥ |
tasmāt sthapatīṣṭiḥ saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
niṣādasthapatīṣṭiḥ: ādhānasaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu bhavet iti pūrvapakṣeṇa sūtreṇa prāptaṃ agnyāśabdena nirasya siddhā- ntamāha |
sthapatīṣṭiḥ: laukike agnī syāt na saṃskṛte |
ādhānasya asarvaśeṣatvāt sarvapuruṣakartṛkayajñājñatvā- bhāvāt ādhānopattivākye traivaṇikakartṛkatvaśravaṇena traivaṇikayajñajñatvāt |
niṣādasthapateśca atraivaṇikatvena ādhānādhikārābhāvāt laukike'gniṣu eva sthapatīṣṭiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
6|8|3| 20-21. mīko pṛ. 2389 'niṣādasthapatīṣṭiḥ laukike'gniṣu' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
oṃ sthaviralagudhanyāyaḥ: vṛddhasthagitātilaguḍasya yathā yathāsthānaṃ na patanamevaṃ lakṣyasāne'patanaṃ yatra tatramya pravṛttiriti sāhasī 502.
' sthāṇau sthāṇvāhutiṃ juhoti ' iti yūpe śrutam |
evaṃ ca deśamātratvāt sthāṇau āhuteḥ anirvṛttiḥ pratīyate |
kiṃtu sādyaskre khalevālyāṃ yūpe sati sthāṇvāhutiḥ: yatra kvacit sthāṇau kartavyā |

sādyaskre sthāṇau sthāṇvāhutiḥ: kartavyā na vā, sā āhutiḥ: ārādupakārikā vā yūpasaṃskāro vā iti vicāre ārādupakārikā sthāṇvāhutiḥ, sā ca agnīṣomīye paśau iva sādyaske'pi kartavyā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākartuṃ apivā iti śabdaḥ |
sthāṇvāhutiḥ: agnīṣomīye paśau tāvat tatsaṃskāraḥ: yūpasya saṃskāraḥ pratīyate, śeṣabhūtatvāt sthāṇoḥ yūpaśeṣabhūtatvāt |
sādyaske ca tasya sarvasyābhāvāt sthāṇvāhuterapi: iti siddhāntaḥ |
tadvat yūpavāntaraprakaraṇavat sthāṇvāhutiḥ: iti samā- khyānaṃ āhuteḥ: yūpasaṃskārārthatvaṃ bodhayati |
sādyaske ca khalevālyāṃ yūpatvena uktasaṃbhavāt sthāṇvāhuterapi: iti siddhāntaḥ |
' atastvaṃ deva vanaspate śatavalśo viroha ' iti yastvaṃ mayā vṛkaṇaḥ saḥ ataḥ āvraścanāt bahuprakāro viroha iti yūpa iva sthāṇurādiśyate |
so'yaṃ mantravarṇaḥ tadvat samākhyānavat sthāṇvāhuteḥ: saṃskārakarmatvaṃ bodha- yati |
tasmāt tat sādyaske khalevālyāṃ yūpe na kartavya iti siddhāntaḥ |
sthāṇau tu deśamātratvāt 0 ' (10|1|16| 10-13) ityatra khalevālyāṃ sthāṇvāhutiḥ: kartavyā
viniyuktayūpasaṃvanatvena aviniyuktasthāṇusaṃvanatvena vā ārādupakāritvāditi pūrvapakṣayitvā siddhāntaṃ na kartavyā yūpīyo hyayamāvraścanasthāṇuḥ iti tatsaṃskāra- dvārā yūpasaṃskārārthatvāditi |
sthāṇvāhutiḥ: yūpe vṛkṇe sati avaśiṣṭaṃ vṛkṣamūlaṃ sthāṇuḥ tatrāhutiḥ: sthāṇvāhutiḥ |
bhāṣyam- tasminnevāgnīṣomīye paśau śrūyate ' sthāṇau sthāṇvāhutiṃ juhoti ' iti |
tataḥ sādyaske ayamevārthaḥ: sāṃdhāyako bhavati kiṃ sādyaske sthāṇvāhutiḥ: kartavyā neti |
tatraitat tāvat: parīkṣyaṃ kimārādupa- kārakaṃ karma sthāṇvāhutiḥ: uta yūpasaṃskāra iti |
yadi ārādupakārakaṃ karma tadā kartavyā, atha yūpasaṃskāraḥ nivartateti |
kathamāradupakārakaṃ karma syāt, kathaṃ vā yūpasaṃskāra iti ? yathaivamabhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate yūpama- cchedyatā sthāṇvāhutiḥ: kartavyeti tato, yūpasaṃskāraḥ |
atha yūpamacchedyateti prakṛtena na saṃbadhyate tadā ārādupakārakaṃ karmeti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? ārādupa- kārakaṃ karmeti |
apica nivṛttaprayojane sthāṇunā saṃbadhyamānā āhutiḥ: kimiva yūpasyopakariṣyati ? saṃbaddhe hi kriyamāṇaṃ saṃbandhi upakuryāt |
apica tanmekādaśinyāṃ yūpāhuti- rmeviṣyati, yadi ārādupakārakaṃ karma syāt, tathāhi nāśrato'ḍabhyāsaḥ: kalpayiṣyate |
apica aviśiṣṭena vākyena sthāṇau sthāṇvāhutiḥ: śrūyate |
tasmādādupakārakaṃ karma sthāṇvāhutiḥ: sādyaske ca kartavyā codakānugraheyati |
kutaḥ ? prakaraṇa- viśeṣāt yūpamacchedyataḥ: sthāṇvāhutiḥ: vidhīyate iti gamyate |
yo hi manyate aviśiṣṭena vākyena sthāṇudeśa- mātre vidhīyate iti, phalaṃ tasya kalpanīyaṃ bhavati |
yo''pi manyate prakaraṇāt ārādupakārakaṃ abhīṣomīyasya bhavatīti, tathāpi prakaraṇāsāmānyaṃ prakaraṇaviśeṣeṇa bādhyate |
karmaśeṣabhūtaśca yūpaḥ, prayojanavattvāt tena saṃbadhyamānā aṣṭyādyapi ārādupakārikā satī kalpya- prayojanā syāt |
nivṛttaprayojane cāpi sthāṇau, yūpāt vyāvṛtte ca yūpīyo'sau iti kṛtvā tatra kriyamāṇā sthāṇvāhutiḥ: yūpasaṃbaddhā kṛtvā bhavati iti tadāvraścane kriyate |
yathā śirasā dhāritāyāḥ srajaḥ śiraso'pa- vatāritāyāḥ: devadattīyāsī iti kṛtvā śucideśa- nidhānādiḥ saṃskāraḥ: eṣitavyo bhavati |
ekādaśinyāṃ ca antikadeśasya avivakṣita- tvāt yūpāhūtirbhirvidheyatve |
bhāṣyam-- sthāṇvāhutiriti ca samākhyānaṃ sthāṇu- pradhānāyā ivāhuterbhavati |
saptamī- samāso lakṣaṇapateḥ: iti kṛtvā nādartavyo bhavati |
katham ? saptamyantasya śauṇdā- dibhiḥ saha samāsaḥ : ('saptamī śauṇḍeḥ' pā0 2|1|40) |
nanu ' saṃjñāyam ' ( pā0 2|1|44) iti samāso bhaviṣyati |
tatra alūk prāpnoti, yathā aravyatilakāḥ iti |
ata eva yasya kasyacideva sthāṇoḥ adhi- ubhayathā'pi adṛṣṭārthā, kimatra garīyastvam ? ucyate |
karaṇatvena prāptatvāt sthāṇvāhutiḥ ityapi saptamīmāse- satyamadṛṣṭārthā, kiṃtu samavāyasaṃbandhaḥ klṛptaḥ |
na ca āhutiśabdasya śauṇḍādigaṇa- pakārakatve kalpyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
aravyetilakāḥ itivat aluk prasaṅgaḥ, haladante eva bhāṣyam— itaśca paśyāmaḥ saṃskārakarmeti, yato |

atra upahomavākyārthasya vyāpāra- rūpatvena itikartavyatātvena anvayayogyatvāt, anyathā utpādyetikartavyatā''kāṅkṣā'pi tadanvayānāpatteḥ vartanidhi anyāseḥ; saṃnidhipāṭhayathākramapāṭhasthalīyasaṃni- dhitvānirukteḥ; brīhiyāgādisaṃnidheḥ prajāyādivākyapradhāna- vākyārthasaṃnidheśca satve'pi 'pradhānaṃ vyapadeśā bhavanti' iti nyāyena tadaṅgāṅgibhāvasya śrautaprākaraṇikatve'pya- hāropapatteḥ tadārakatvaviśeṣaṇadvayaivyarthyāpātācca etadupeṣi- tam |
ataḥ sāmānyapadena prāya- myādisāhacaryavivakṣāyāṃ abhinnadeśatāsaṃgrahaḥ; abheda- vivakṣāyāṃ sahaśadeśatvātsaṃgrahaḥ iti dūṣaṇamanavakāśaṃ ityāhuḥ : (bhāṭṭālaṃkāraḥ pṛ. 199) |
tanna, deśe pradhānaviparivṛttivaiśiṣṭyāvivakteḥ ; upahomadeśe darśa- pūrṇamāsaviparivṛtterapi smṛtyādyātmikāyāḥ |
na ca śāstrīyatvaṃ viparivṛttiviśeṣaṇaṃ ato noktadoṣaḥ, darśapūrṇamāsa- śāstrasmṛtijanyāḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ upahomapradhāna- tvābhāvāt na doṣaḥ iti vācyam |
ayaṃ ca dvividho'pi kramaḥ pratyekaṃ ubhayākāṅkṣayā anyatarākāṅkṣayā ca viniyojakaḥ, ityataḥ bahuvidhaḥ |
tatra pradhānasya vikṛtitve anuṣṭhānasādeśyasya anyatarā- kāṅkṣayā viniyojakatvaṃ yathā uktapaśudharmedhyalīyānuṣṭhāna- sādeśyasya klṛptopakārakāṅkṣā'nirākāṅkṣatayā pradhā- nasya ākāṅkṣā'bhāvāt |
evaṃ aindrāgnādivikṛtikramapaṭhita- mantrāṇāṃ anyatarākāṅkṣāsahakṛtayathākramapāṭhāt tadaṅga- tvam |

yadyapi yājyānuvākyāmantrāṇāṃ liṅgavini- yojyatvena yathākramapāṭhasya atra apūrvaviśeṣasādhanatva- bodhakatvameva, na tadviniyojakatvam, tathāpi vikṛti- kramapaṭhitaliṅgaviniyojyajapādimantrāṇāṃ yathākramapāṭha eva anyatarākāṅkṣāsahakāreṇa viniyojakaḥ anveṣaṇīyaḥ |
ata eva davihomādyaṅgabhūtajapādimantrāṇāṃ yathākramapāṭhaṃ eva ubhayākāṅkṣayā viniyojakodāharaṇam |
evaṃ upa- homīyakṛtisaṃnidhipāṭhaḥ anyatarākāṅkṣāsahakṛtaḥ tadu- dāharaṇam |

śundhanamantrasya sāṃnāyyasaṃnidhiproṣaṇe liṅgādeva viniyogāt tasya sāṃnāyyasaṃnidhipāṭhaḥ sākṣādvini- yojako'pi apūrvaviśeṣasādhanatve'pyathāpakatvena vini- yogaprayojakatvāt ubhayākāṅkṣāsahakṛtasaṃnidhidāhara- ṇam |
atra anyatarākāṅkṣāsahakṛtakrama- mātrasya itikartavyatā''kāṅkṣorathāpakatayā prakaraṇāt durbalatvaṃ spaṣṭam |

prakaraṇāpekṣayā kramasya durbalatvādeva ca iṣṭipaśusomayāgāmararājasūyā- ntargatāmiṣecanīyasaṃnidhisābhmātavidevanādīnāṃ anya- tarākāṅkṣāsahakṛtasaṃnidhipāṭhāt abhiṣecanīyamātrā- dvaṣamaktau rājasūyamāhaprakaraṇāt rājasūyāt ityuktaṃ balādhalādhikāre |

na ca rājasūyasyāpi vikṛtisamu- dāyātmakatvena prākṛtājñaireva nirākāṅkṣatvāt prakaraṇa- saṃbhavaḥ, pratyekajanyaparamāpūrvāṇāṃ prākṛtāṅgaiḥ nairākāṅkṣye- 'pi sarvayāgānāṃyatparamāpūrvasya sākāṅkṣatvena tadanukūla- pratyekaparamāpūrvaviniyogyatājanakatvena prakaraṇāṅkṣālopa- patteḥ |
na ca sarvayāgajanyaparamāpūrve mānābhāvaḥ, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ samuditasādhanatāśravaṇasya samudāyāpūrve

tadanaṅgīkāre'pi vā pavitrā- dārabhya kṣatrasya dhṛti yāvat ajñavidheṣu 'rājasūyāya hyenā utpunāti' ityanena upakramāt 'rājasūyenāyanaḥ sarvamāyureti' ityupasaṃhārāt vācanikāṅkṣasaṃdeśena rāja- sūyatvena rūpeṇa sarvaiṣāmākāṅkṣayāḥ uttejanāt tatmaka- raṇopapatteśca |
śundhanamantraḥ sāṃnā- yyapātrāṇāṃ pāṭhasādeśyāt na tu pauroḍāśikasamākhyāyā puroḍāśapātrāṇām |
mīnyā. sthānadeva sava- nīyasya prathamamupakaraṇam, taduttaraṃ dakṣasya taduttaramanu- bandhasya, prakṛtitaṣṭapaurvāparyasyaiva niyāmakāntarābhāve niyāmakatvāṅgīkārāt sācakrame |
5|1|6|13 sādhrame nāma yāge 'saha paśūnālabhate' iti savanīyapaśukāle trayāṇāṃ sāhityaṃ śrutam |
tathāpi tatra kiṃ agnīṣomīyaḥ pūrvamālavdhavyaḥ savanīyo veti vicāre pūrve agnīṣomīya eva kartavyaḥ prakṛtau tattattvāt iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntāmāha |
savanīyapaśusyaiva prathamamupā- karaṇamarhati syānāt āśvinagrahagrahaṇottarakālaprasthāna- vaśena tasyaiva prathamamupasthiteḥ |
'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti ' iti utpattividhau tena kālena savanīyasya saṃyogāt |
sācakrame 'saha paśūnālabhate' iti savanīyasthāne paśuyajñālambhe kartavye sati savanīyaḥ agnīṣomīyaḥ anubandhavya iti kramaḥ |
bhā. 5|1|6|13 varṇakaṃ 2. yadyapi prakaraṇaṃ sthānāt balavat tathāpi upāṃśuyājānumantraṇa- nyāyena liṅgānugṛhītakrama evātra balīyān vijñāyate |
vā. 3|6|125, sthānasya caitadeva lakṣaṇaṃ yaduta mī. ko. 553
bhā. 3|6|17 taḥ 3|7|7, sthānasya prathamasyotpattasya ca dharmaḥ sāmidhenyāṃ triprayāsaḥ |
atirātre triṇavādi- stomakeṣu ṛcaḥ kāṇḍakrameṇaiva viniyojyāḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- 'ekaviṃśonātirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yāja- yet, triṇavairnaujaskāmam, trayastriṃśena pratiṣṭhākāmam' ityevamādi śrūyate |
tatra āgame kriyamāṇe kiṃ aniyatakramāḥ sarvā ṛcaḥ āgamayitavyāḥ ? uta kāṇḍakrameṇeti |
yat āsāṃ sambhāvanāye sthānaṃ tenaitāḥ atra niyamyante |
yāḥ pūrve samāmnātāḥ tāḥ pūrvameva prayoktavyāḥ |
triṇavādiśabdaiḥ atirātre yogapathena āsāṃ prāpteḥ pāṭhakramasya avivakṣaḥ ityadhikaraṇāntaraṃ iti bhavati matiḥ |
dup-- yadyapi prathamamantragrahaṇe aniyamaḥ tathāpi pūrvo mantraḥ pāṭhenaiva uttaraṃ paryadhapayati |
yathā mantrasamāmnāyādavagamyate, evaṃ kramaviśiṣṭamapi ava- gamyate |
brāhmaṇāpāṭhana tu padārthā vidhīyante ityatāvān viśeṣaḥ |
sthānadharmaḥ sāmidhenīṣu prathamottamayoḥ triḥ paṭhanaṃ na tu 'pra vo vājā' ityādereva |
bāla. pṛ. 117-119. sthānāpattipramāṇapañcakaṃ bhaṭṭasomeśvarena navame uktaṃ 'pratyakṣavinā bhāve vikāroṇa vidhānataḥ |
bhāṣyam— vājapeye śrūyate 'bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ naivāraṃ saptadaśaśarāvaṃ nirvapati' iti |
tat nīvāreṣu bhavati na veti saṃśayaḥ |
tathā 'udbīyā vā etarhi vāgbhavati yadi ṣaḍahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate, na bahu vadet, nānyaṃ pṛcchet, nānyasmai brūyāt |
saṃsthita ṣaḍahe maścāśayet, ghṛtaṃ vā' --iti maścāśane ṣaḍahadharmā ca ṣaḍahadharmā na bhavanti saṃśayaḥ |
tathā rājasūye śrūyate 'naiṛtaṃ caruṃ nagvāpatānāṃ paridhatte gṛhe' |
tathā cātu- rmāsyeṣu śrūyate 'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' |
paridhau yūpadharmāḥ kartavyā na kartavyā iti saṃśayaḥ |
tathā 'na girā gireti brūyādyadi girā gireti brūyādātmānaṃ tadu- dghātodiredair kṛtvodreyam' |
irāpade girāpadharmā bhavanti, na bhavantīti saṃśayaḥ |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? vrīhādiṣuktā dharmāḥ, na nīvārādiṣu |
samavaiti hi teṣu sā prakṛtiḥ dharmaḥ |
prakṛtau tāvat apūrvayuktau sa, na vrīhādiprayuktaḥ |
yenāpūrvasya viśiṣṭo'yaṃ sādhanaviśeṣastatra dharmo na vrīhādāviti samadhigatametat |
sa ca nānyena prakāreṇa nīvāro yāgasyopakaroti varjayitvā taṇḍulanirvṛttim |
sa pratyakṣa- ṇāvagamyate vrīhikārye vartate iti |
evaṃ 'ṣaḍahenopāsīta' iti codanāyāṃ satyāṃ yadā ṣaḍahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate, na ṣaḍahenopāsyate ityarthaḥ |
ṣaḍahaniṣṭau maścāśanaṃ bruvan ṣaḍahakāryaṃ vadatīti gamyate |
tasmāt ṣaḍahadharmā vrataṃ niyamo vā maścāśane bhavatīti |
grahaṃ vā gṛhītvā camasaṃ votrīya stotramupākarotīti grahacamasā- bhāvātstotrābhāvaḥ |
savanābhāvātsavanīyā na pravartante, itye- mādi na pravartate |
yadi na taistupā vipūyante, tasmā- dupavimocane navāḥ śrutā iti gamyate |
tathā 'paridhiryupakārye vartate' iti vispaṣṭameva vacanaṃ 'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti |
tathā 'na girā gireti brūyādair kṛtvodreyam' iti naitau dvāvapi vidhī- yete- pratiṣedha irāpadaṃ ca |
yadā irāpadaṃ tadā vyaktaṃ girāpadaṃ na bhavatīti |
tasmādirāpadoccāraṇamirāpadasya tatkāryāpattipradarśa- nārthe 'na girā gireti kṛtvodreyam' iti |
duṣ-- yadyapyapūrvaprayuktāḥ dharmā iti sthitam, tathā'pi kāryāpatyā vinohasiddhirnāstītyanenādhikaraṇena kāryāpattiḥ pratipādyate |
svaśabdāt, pratiṣedhena svaśabdānumānam, saṃsthayā pratiṣedhānumānam, pratiṣedhāca śabdaḥ |
nanu svaśabde- naiva nīvārā vrīhikārye viniyujyante |
nīvāraśabdo nīvārān vadati, taddhito vikāram, devatāṃ bārhaspatyaśabdaḥ, caruśabdo dravyam |
kataraḥ kāryā- pattiparaḥ ? tasmāt pratyakṣaṇātra kāryāpattiḥ |
nīvārā api tannirvṛttyā yāgasādhanārthā eva pratyakṣamupalabhyante |
tasmāt vrīhayo yathā'pūrvāthā iti dharmān prayuñjate tathā nīvārā api |
'na natvāpatānāṃ caruḥ' ityava- hananasya tuṣakaraṇavipramokaṃ phalaṃ dṛṣṭvā anumānaṃ bhavati, natu mūlūkhalamusalakāryaṃ natvā vartante iti |
'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti svaśabdenaiva yūpa- kāryaṃ paridhivartate |
'na girā gireti brūyāt' iti, girāpadaṃ pratiṣedhan tatkāryaṃ lakṣayati |
'udbīyā vā etarhi vāgbhavati, yadi ṣaḍahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate' iti saṃkhyā pratiṣedhaḥ |
katham ? yadi maścāśanacodanāne ṣaḍahakārye vartatāṃ tathā phalasādhake syātām |
tatra 'dvādaśahena prajākāmaṃ yājayet' iti vacanaṃ viru- dhyeta |
'ṣaṭtriṃśadeho vā eṣa yaddvādaśāhaḥ' ityeva- mādīni liṅgāni virudhyeran |
yadi cānyastatkāryā- patiḥ svāttathā sati ṣaḍahaṃ nivarteyāt |
yathete ṣaḍahakāryaṃ kurutaḥ ; tatastaddharmaḥ saṃdhyayetām, yathā nīvārāḥ |
na caite ṣaḍaha- kārye vartante ityuktameva |
tasmādanyathā'udāharaṇamudāhriyate 'sa prayatamāne sthānāt' iti dravyavināśāt karma- vināśaḥ |
śā-- prakṛtau vrīhādiṣu śrutāḥ prokṣaṇādyātādayaḥ na tatsvarūpaprayuktāḥ |
tanmātrārthavasāyinaḥ kiṃtu 'vrīhibhiryajeta' ityādi vihitasādhanaviśeṣaṇa apūrva- bhāvanāyāṃ |
tada- yamarthaḥ— vrīhibhiḥ puroḍāśaṃ kṛtvā tena yajeteti |
tataḥ punaratraiva tān vrīhīn prokṣati avahantīti |
tataśca sarvaiḥ saṃhyamāṇairayamarthaḥ saṃpadyate— prokṣaṇasaṃskṛte- ravāghātavipukṛteśca vrīhibhiḥ puroḍāśaṃ kṛtvā tena yajeteti |
evaṃ cet āmeyādibhāvanāyāḥ śeṣabhūtaḥ prokṣaṇādyartha- bhāvaḥ |

tatra naivāre carau puroḍāśasthāne carorniveśāt vrīhisthāne ca nīvāniveśa- śāt itarat samastasya yathātideśamavasthāyatāt naivāraṃ caruṃ nirvapate āgneyavat ityasya śrutānumitedeśa- niṣpannasya naivāracarvidheḥ ayamartho bhavati— prokṣite- ravāghātavipukṛtenaivāracarvidheḥ kṛtvā tena yajeteti |
tena vrīhādisthānāpanneṣu nīvārādiṣu siddha ūhaḥ; sthānā-
sthālīpulākavat alikṣāsvapi iṣṭiṣu dārśa- paurṇamāsikavidhiyantyasya siddhiḥ |
vi.8|1|2. sthālīpākādīnāṃ smārtānāṃ vaidikasya ca vāstuhomasya nāmadheyaṃ darvihomaśabdaḥ |
yathā rajatādijñāna- tadbādhajñānayoḥ : sarvasvanābhādi rūpajaṅgamasthāvaraviṣayo- ścetareṇa pūrvapakṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tathā prakṛte'pi |
sthūṇā yathāsakṛtcālya nikhanane kriyamāṇe dṛḍhā bhavati tathottaragranthena prāgu
satyaṃ na smṛtihetubhiḥ sphoṭābhivyaktiḥ, ye tu varṇopaladhihetavo nādajanyāḥ śrotagatāḥ saṃskārāḥ tairaiva varṇānāmiva sphoṭābhivyaktirbhaviṣyati|
yadi avatiṣṭheta tato visarjanīyaśravaṇa- velāyāmapi gakāraśravaṇamanuvarteta|
ato na teṣāṃ saṃhatya sphoṭābhivyañjakatvaṃ bhavati|
tasya ca viśvadhameva bhaṅguratvaṃ gatavattvāt dhvanīnām|
tathā varṇāti- riktaḥ śabdaḥ kalpyaḥ iti bahu apramāṇakamāpannam|
matpakṣe tu dṛḍhasmṛtiparivartināṃ varṇānāṃ vācakatvāt na kiṃcidūnam|
nanu yugāpat smaryamāṇānāṃ vācakatve vyuktameṇāpi uccāritā varṇāḥ vācakāḥ syuḥ|
kaḥ punaḥ kramo'jñam, nahi varṇānāṃ vibhūtāṃ nityānāṃ ca svarūpataḥ kramavattvam|
evaṃ tarhi dhvanikramo yo varṇeṣu āropitaḥ pratibhāsate so'ṅga itya- doṣaḥ|
tasmāt vyañjakānāṃ dhvanīnāṃ krameṇa vyūhayeṣu varṇeṣu samāropitena taddhantaḥ smaryamāṇā varṇā vācakāḥ|
ko'yaṃ praśnaḥ? ayaṃ praśnaḥ, yadi apariṇatyā śabdaḥ arthaṃ prati
kathamayuktam ? vivartapakṣe hi kā nāma iyaṃ śabdakalpanā ? yassāt adhyāsito- pādhi sarvapramāṇāvagamyaṃ ekaṃ vastu ityuktam |
tasmāt aśabdajñatā eveyaṃ yaduta bhinnayorapi śabdārthayoḥ autpattikaḥ saṃbandho'bhidhīyate (iti) |
nanu ekatvavādino'pi naivāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ śakyate'- vagantum, 'jyotiṣṭomo'yam, darśapūrṇamāsāvimau' iti |
sarvavākyānāṃ ekatā prāpnoti, varṇānāmapi pade, padānāmiha vākye, ekatvāvagamādeva |
bhavati hi sarvavākyeṣu śabdaḥ śabdaḥ ityekā buddhiḥ |
tadidaṃ abhinnaṃ sarvameva jyotiṣṭomādi karmajātaṃ prāpnoti |
tatra viruddhāḥ : kṛṣṇalacarurvarṣārādāyaḥ ; avi- ruddhāśca agnihotrādayaḥ |
satyaṃ nai katve upapadyate, bhinnārthāni caitāni vākyāni, ekārthapratipattyarthā caikatā |
śabdaprāmāṇya- vādino hi (ca) arthasaṃbaddhaḥ śabdaḥ śabdenocyate (abhimataḥ ) na kākavāśitāpi śrotrādyam |
nanu śrotrādibhedamupavarṇayatā sarvametat avidyā- jātaṃ ityuktam |
tadrūpatayā kena bhedo'bhidhīyate ? śāstrārthavagatau ca kena vā bhedo'pa- hotuṃ śakyate śrotrādināmiva ? satyaṃ nāpahūyate,
tasmānna kiṃcidatra pūrve pareṇa virudhyate (abhedābhidhānaṃ paramārthāmiprāyaṃ pareṇa avidyānibandhanabhedābhidhānena ) |
guṇavaktānāṃ kathamarthata ekatā śakyate vaktum ? uktaṃ bhinnatve'pi ekānuṣṭhānasiddhiriti nityakāmyaprayogayoriva |
nanu ca sarvaśabdeṣu 'śabdaḥ śabdaḥ' ityekā buddhirasti |
asatyāṃ caikabuddhau śabdaśabdavācyatā'pi na syāt sarvaśabdānām |
eka- nimittā hi ekaśabdavācyatā na punarekatvakṛtā |
tacca nimittaṃ kaścit jātiḥ, kriyā, guṇaḥ, dravyaṃ vā gauḥ, gantā, śuklaḥ, viṣāṇī iti yathā |
kacit vastunā eva ekatvaṃ yathā tasminneva vastuni punaḥ śabdapravṛttau ākāśaṃ ākāśaṃ iti |
ataḥ anekāntikatvāt ekaśabdapravṛtteḥ na sidhyatyekā buddhiḥ |
) atra ca ekaṃ nimittamasti śrotrāgrāhaṇe śrotragrahaṇe hyaṃ loke śabdaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ śrotra- āhūtaivā gṛhyate na punaḥ : gotvavat śabdatvamāśrīyate |
(pṛcchati —) kiṃ punaḥ sāmānya- viśeṣaviṣayaṃ jñānam ? (uttaraṃ —) idaṃ jñānaṃ, yasmin padārthagrahaṇe sati pūrvadarśanasaṃbandhavarmaṇo
śrāddhamayūkhaḥ pṛ. 51 dhārapuresaṃpāditaḥ . smaraṇaṃ anādi na śakyaṃ paryanuyoktum |
pṛ. 169, smṛtyā adṛṣṭārthayā dṛṣṭārthaṃ bādhyate, aprāptatvādhaḥ |
3|3|7|4 pṛ. 860. smṛtyā avigītayā vigītasmṛtirbādhyate, yathā- 'na stenaḥ syāt' ityanathā 'tathaiva samaste bhakte bhaktāni ghaḍanadantā |
bādhyastu atra daṇḍābhāvātmātraparatvaṃ alpadoṣa- paratvaṃ vā |
bāla. pṛ. 139. smṛtyā ācāro bādhyate, yathā- 'mātulasya sutā- mūdvā mātṛgotrāṃ tathaiva ca |
bāla. pṛ. 138. smṛtyā- āsāvigītasmṛtyā anāsavigītasmṛtiḥ bādhyate, aprāptatvādhaḥ |
yathā- 'nātmānaṃ ghātayet' iti manvādismṛtyā 'kedāre pātayedeham' iti pālñvādyādismṛtiḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 139. smṛtyā śrutiprabhavā liṅgaprabhavā artha- vādaprabhavā ca smṛtirbādhyate, aprāptatvādhaḥ |

vā. 3|3| 7|4 pṛ. 860. smṛtyā śrutiprabhavā liṅgaprabhavā smṛtiḥ bādhyate, yathā- 'putraṃ pratiṣedhahyanna nive- śanasya madhye vyāhṛtibhirhutvā' ityādyathā śrutiprabhavā smṛtyā 'na śeṣo agre anyajātamsti' iti dattaka- putraniṣedhaliṅgāt tatprabhavā 'yasya ye bījino jātāstasya te netarasya tu' ityādyā |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 120. smṛteḥ prameyabalīstvena śravādyatvamātraṃ bhavati, na tu śrutivādhakatvam |
mantrebhyaśca arthādebhyaśca smṛtirmūlaṃ vijñānamityate iti pratyakṣagamyate |
. ye ālocanamātreṇa mantrārthavādān paśyanti teṣāṃ tat smṛtimūlam |
ye punarnipuṇataḥ paśyanti teṣāṃ tadvādhita- mapi ca kasyacitsmṛtimūlaṃ bhavati |
bhā. 9|1|4|9 pṛ. 1653. smṛtermūlaṃ na dṛśyate- 'śālānāṃ viprakīrṇatvāt puruṣāṇāṃ pramādataḥ |
virodhe'pi pramāṇatvaṃ smṛteḥ śrutyā na vāryate ||
' vā. 1|3|17 pṛ. 198. sadṛśa- darśanāt sadṛśe arthāntare smṛterudbhavaḥ |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 54. 'svātantryeṇa pramāṇatvaṃ smṛtestāvat saṃma- tam |
' vā. 1|3|12 pṛ. 172, 'smṛtīnāma- pramāṇatve vigānaṃ naiva kāraṇam |

' 1|3|8|27 pṛ. 286, smṛtīnāṃ kāsāñcit svavedaśālāgatavacanaviparītārthaśālāttara- vacanamūlanāṃ adhītavākyavirodho dṛśyate, tāvataiva dṛḍhatarasmaraṇopasthāpitapuruṣātta- (smṛtimūlabhūta-) śrutinirākaraṇaṃ na śobhate, adhyayanavacca smṛterī dhāraṇamabhyām |
su. pṛ. 41. smṛtīnāṃ pratyakṣaśrutivirodhe svarūpeṇaiva aprāmāṇyaṃ iti bhāṣyakāramatam |
tatra ananuṣṭhānalakṣaṇa- pramāṇyaṃ na svarūpataḥ iti vārtikakāramatam |
ku. 1|3|4|5 pṛ. 56. smṛtīnāṃ vedamūlatvāt veda- tulyatā |
' vā. 1|3| 2|3 pṛ. 104, 'tasmād vedaviruddhānāṃ dṛṣṭārthānāṃ ca hetubhiḥ |
bhāṣyam- evaṃ tāvatklṛptasya vedasya prāmāṇya- muktam |
athedānīṃ yatra na vaidikaṃ śabdamūlametad, atha ca smaranti, evamayamartho'nuṣṭhātavya etasmai ca prayoja- nāyeti |
yathā aṣṭakāḥ kartavyāḥ, gururupagantavyaḥ, taḍāgaṃ khanitavyam, prajā pravartayitavyā, sthityākarma kartavyamityevamādayaḥ |
nanu ye vidu- ritthametau padārthe kartavyaḥ iti, kathamiva te vadiṣyantya- kartavya evāyamiti |
na hi ananubhūte- 'śruto vādhateḥ smaryate, na cāsyāvaidikasyālokikasya ca smaraṇamupapadyate pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvāditi |
yā hi vandhyā smaredidaṃ me dauhittrakṛtamiti, na me duhitā''stīti matvā na jātucideko pratīyatāsyage- tajjñānamiti |
evamapi yathaiva pāramparyāvicchedāt ayaṃ veda iti pramāṇameṣāṃ smṛtirevamimapi pramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
tadyathā, kaścijjātyandho vadet smarāmyahama rūpaviśeṣa- syeti |
kutaste pūrvavijñānamiti ca paryyanuyukto jātyandha- mevāparaṃ vinirdiśet |
evaṃ jātyandhaparamparāyāmapi satyāṃ naiva jātucistaṃpratīya- viṃdāṃsaḥ samyagdarśanametaditi |
vā- evaṃ tāvadvidhārthavādamantrāmadheyatvāt vedasya dharmaṃ pratyupayogaḥ sādhitaḥ, idānīṃ pauruṣeyeṣu sarvamaṇāvartheṣu manvādipraṇītanibandhanānāṃ smṛtiṣva- ninvedhu cā''sāreṣu cintā |
tatra kiñcidāhṛtya vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ ityekādisamaraṇāṇi manvādihāni tadanmathasamarthitāni pramāṇāpramāṇavicāraviṣayatvenodāhi- yante |
manvādibacanaṃ smṛtipakṣaṃ smṛtiśca mūlapramāṇamapekṣaṇīti naikasyāpi vedavaccirekṣaprāmāṇya- niścayaḥ |
yatastu vedadādimevāvibhāgenāvicchinnapāra- mparyaparigrahārthamato nāprāmāṇyavyāsanamiti yuktaḥ saṃdehaḥ |
tatra pūrvapakṣavādī vadati naiṣāṃ prāmāṇyamevā- pekṣitavyamiti |
tadihāṣṭakā- dīnāṃ svargadisādhanabhāvaṃ pratyakṣadī tāvacca gṛha- ṇīti sādhitam |
chando'pi yathā'gnihotrādiṣu pratyakṣe- ṇopalabhyate naivaṃ mantrāḥ |
sa cetanānvanavagamyamāno'pītyucyate tato varaṃ dharmā- sthitameva niṣpramāṇakamabhyupagatamiti |
na hi smṛti- stathā vyākhyā dṛṣṭā'nyathā''numāpakam ||
' yathaiva dharme saṃnvādadarśanācca kiñcicciddhaṃ kramate tathā'-
tena manvādibhirapi kimadyakā śrutīpalabhya vedamuktvaṃ khanibandhananāṃ pratiśatānupalambhyaiva śraddheya- vākyatvamiti duṣṭapuruṣākulitacetasāṃ bhavati saṃdehaḥ |
nityasya vacanasyā''di- matsaraṇamūlapratipādane vyāpāra eva nāsti |
na ca mantraliṅgānāṃ svayaṃ mūlatvaṃ pratipadyante |
yadi hetvekāntena gamyeta yathāvidhi vākyānveva manvādibhirupalabdhānīti |
tataḥ kā'pi kalpanā syād- dyatve'pyanyapadārthatvādādivacanebhyo'pi śrāmyataḥ |
mṛtasākṣika- vyavahāravacca pralīṇaśālāmūlatvalakṣaṇayā yasya yadyocyate sa tanmāṇīkuryāt |
' yadi hi śrutikalpanena vinā smṛtirnopapadyate tataḥ sabhyamūlaṃ syāt |
tasmādanupalambha- gocaraprajñāyāṃ śrutau satvapi mūlāntareśmipretamūlabhāvā- cchimūlatvābhimānam |
'nanu ye vidurevemitikartavya- tāka evaṃphalakaśāstro padārthaḥ kartavyaḥ' iti |
athavā ye kartavyo'sāvitītthaṃ viduste tathā vijñānanta-
nanvanye evaṃ vadanti kartavya ityanye na vā kartavya ityāhuḥ |
kathamanvayaṃ yadā teṣāmapyevamayaṃ syata iti kathamite bhavatyevaṃ pratipattiḥ |
athavā ye manvādayo vidurkartavyo'yaṃ padārtha iti kathamiva te vinā''parādhena lokaṃ vañcayituṃ vadiṣyanti kartavya evāyamiti |
ye tāvanmanvādibhyo''vvaḥ puruṣāsteṣāṃ yajñānāṃ tattāvadanavagatapūrvārthatvācca smṛtiḥ |
manvādīnāmapi yadi prathamaṃ kiñcitpramāṇaṃ saṃbhāvyate tataḥ smaraṇaṃ bhavennanyathā |
kasmātpunaḥ putraṃ duhitaraṃ vā'tikramya vandhyādyohodāharaṇaṃ kṛtam |

putrādiśānīyaṃ hi manvādeḥ pūrvavijñānaṃ dauhitraśānīyaṃ smaraṇamatha yathā duhitṛbhāvaṃ parāmṛśya dauhitrasmṛtiṃ bhrāntiṃ manyate tathā manvādibhiḥ pratyakṣā- yasaṃbhavaparāmarśādahakādisaraṇaṃ mithyeti mantavyam |
vedaḥ punaḥ saviśeṣaḥ pratyakṣagamyastatra ghaṭādivadeva puruṣā ntarasyamūlamya smaranti |
sarvasya cā''smyassaraṇamāpūryamupa- labdhiḥ saṃbhavatīti na nirmūlatā |
prāgapi hi vedaśabdavantvastu vilakṣaṇaṃ vedāntaravilakṣaṇaṃ vā''dapyeta- mṛgvedādirūpaṃ mantrāṇāṃrūpiṇāṃ cānyavilakṣaṇānyupa- labha
vipralipsā prayojanaṃ lokasya ca tatra bhrāntasyāśreyantaṃ kālamanuvṛttiścityādyādyathaṇīyam |
yāni punaranupapannavedasaṃbhāvanāni mlecchādīnāmatī- ndriyārthasmaraṇāni teṣāṃ mūlakalpanāvedhameva codanā saṃbhāvanāpadaṃ nā''suruḍheti mithyātve hetubhūtacatuṣṭayapari- śeṣādyadapramāṇatvam |
saṃbhāvyitāyāṃ punaścodanāyāṃ kāra- ṇāntaraniṣedhe kṛte nirmūlatvātsabhavaviśeṣaścoda- nāmūlatvam |
yathaiva hi granthaḥ saṃpradāyāvicchinno'- stistvaṃ bhajate tathaiva pratijñayā nityānumeyaśrutisaṃpradāyā- vicchedasiddhiḥ |
anyaparamparayānyādeva yā hi codanā na kadāciduccāryate tasyāḥ sarvapuruṣa- pratyakṣādiprasarābhāvāddurlabhataramāstitvam |
katha- manupalambhiriti ceducyate— 'śākhānāṃ viprakīrṇa- tvātpuruṣāṇāṃ pramādataḥ |
ye tu kratumak- raṇāmmātāḥ kenacitkiñcitenoktalabhyamānāḥ puruṣadharmāṃ bhajante |
yathā 'malambadāsā saha na saṃvadet' 'tassāca brāhmaṇāyāvagureta' ityevamādayaḥ |
tatra yadi tāvattā- nyeva vākyāntyudyathāpāyeyeyustataḥ kramāntyātvādhyāya- vidhivirodhaḥ |
anena ca nirdeśenānye'pyatha- vā''dāreṇa vidhimātramadhīyiran karmaupādhikamātraṃ vā |
te hi prayatnena śākhāntarādhyāyibhyaḥ śrutvā''śramātra svākyairavistaranyāye nirbravīyuḥ |
api ca 'vedo'khilo dharmamūlam' 'sa sarvo'mi- hito vede' iti ca svayameva smṛtibhirāmā baddhvā sama- rpitastaccatvibhiyogastatkāleḥ kartṛbhirdvāritvādyupalabhya- mataḥ siddhaṃ vedadvāraṃ prāmāṇyam |
yastu kartṛsāmānyā- tsvatvameva prāmāṇyaṃ vedamūlatvaṃ vā''numānena sādhayati tasyārthāmānānusārimirhṛdayairācarairnekāntaḥ |
śākhāntareṣu vidyante eva tāḥ śrutayastadā'pi kasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ kāḥ paṭhyante ityasyāśca vissaraṇam |
āgatamāgatāṃ nimittaṃ prati ye niyabhyante vṛddhavayaḥ pratyupasthānādyasteṣām |
kutaḥ— 'dharmaṃ prati yato'trevaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ prastutaṃ smṛteḥ |
' na hi yāvatkiñcidācaraṇaṃ tasya sarvasya mūlamiha pramāṇī kriyate |
yadi ca gurvanugamanādīnāṃ kevalaṃ dṛṣṭārthatvameva syāttaḥ kṛṣyādivaddharmaṃ pratyaprāmāṇyameveti nopanya- sitavyāḥ |
śakyate hyapāyāntare- ṇāpi sāmadānādinā gururadhyāpanādīni kārayitum |
sarvatra ca yathā- kathañcillokapravṛttisahāyopādānātarakṣaṇaprītyutpādādikā dṛṣṭārthatā bhāṣyakāroktā śakyā vaktum |
na cāva- ghātādīnāṃ vṛṣṭikāmādīnāṃ ca dṛṣṭārthatāmeva vedamūlatvaṃ kathayam |
ataśca gurvanu- gamanādernimittakatvādakriyā pratyavāyaḥ karaṇe ca na bhavati |
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa dṛṣṭārthatvādeva prāmāṇyamityuktaṃ tatpūrva- pakṣatvātiśayārtham |
etaduktaṃ bhavati, yāstāvadadṛṣṭārthāḥ smṛtayastāḥ kathaṃciddharmāṇī kuryādvān, imāḥ punargurvanugamanādiviṣayāḥ kathamivāpramāṇaṃ bhaviṣya- ntīti |
sabhāpravādīnāṃ yadyapi viśeṣaśrutiḥ naiva kalpyate tathā''pi paropakāraśrutyeva samastānāmupādānā- ddhrāmāṇyam |
yathā dhanyani nirudake kṛtāḥ prapāḥ pareṣāsupakurvantyevaṃ tviti devatā- stutipare vākye siddhatvatprasādāvastyāśca parārthya dṛśyate |
gotracihnaṃ śilākarmaṃ tatrāpyācāraniyamasthā- dṛṣṭārthatvācca tāvanmātrameva prayojanam |
śakyaṃ hyupā- yāntareṇāpi gotraṃ smṛtaṃ tenānyameva evābhiprāyaḥ |
yattu pṛthivībhāgākathanaṃ taddharmādharma- sādhanaphalopabhogadeśavivekayā kiñciddarśanapūrvakaṃ kiñci- dvedamūlam |
'mantro hīnaḥ svarato varṇato vā' iti ca pratyayasmṛtista- dvedamūlam |
sādhuśabdaprayogaphalasiddhirapaśabdena tu phala- vaiguṇyaṃ bhavatīti vaidikam |
chandovicityāmpi gāya- trādividhivo lokedavedyoḥ pūrvadeva pratyakṣaḥ |
tathā cāniśaṃ śrūyate 'yo ha vā'viditārṣeyacchandodaivatabrāhmaṇena mantreṇa yajati yājayati vā' ityādi |

jyotiḥśāle'pi yugapari- vartanaparimāṇapreraṇaṃ candrādityādigativibhāgena tithi- nakṣatrajñānamavicchinnasaṃpradāyagaṇitānumānamūlaṃ grahaṇe'sya- dausthyanimittapūrvakṛtaśubhāśubhakarmaphalapākasūcanaṃ tadvat- śāntyādividhānadvāreṇa vedamūlam |
mīmāṃsā tu lokedeva pratyakṣānumānādibhi- ravicchinnasaṃpradāyapaṇḍitavyavahāraiḥ pravṛttā |
te ca jātyādibhedena saṃkīrṇo loka- vartmani |
parīkṣārthitaḥ śakyāḥ pravivektuṃ na tu svataḥ |
' tathā ca mānave'pyabhihitam— 'pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca śabdaṃ ca vividhāgamam |
prāyeṇa ca manuṣyāṇāmabhyarhitatvātsvajñānapratibaddhāḥ pratibhāste teṣu kumārgeṣu pravartante |
yadapi ca nityānityapṛthaktvaikatvasāmānyaviśeṣavyatirekā- dyekāntapratipādanaṃ tadapi pakṣapātāhate'nyatarāśanirūpaṇā- śakteḥ |
anyathā ye'navāsasāmānyaviśeṣādyupapattayaḥ puruṣahaste padapratipādyaṃ niṣkṛṣṭaṃ sarvabhāgaṃ lokamātrāllo- nena naivādhyavastheyuḥ |
mantrārthavādopāttaśca stutinindā- stattvajhityānityakapṛthaktvakāntamādhitya tatra tatra vidhi- pratiṣedhākṣatvena pravartamānāḥ pakṣapātapratipāditavatdharma- vecindhyāhate nirālambane syuḥ |
yāścaitāḥ pradhānapuruṣa- śvaraparamāṇukāraṇaprādiprakriyāḥ sṛṣṭipralayādirūpeṇa pratī- tāstāḥ sarvā mantrārthavādājñādeva dṛśyamānasūkṣmasthūla- dravyaprakṛtivicāramācadarśanena ca draṣṭavyāḥ |
sarvatra hi tadvalena pravartate tadupame tadupameti |
vijñāna- mātrakṣaṇabhaṅgetyādivādānāmapyupaniṣadarthavādaprabhavatvaṃ viṣayeṣyāntikaṃ rāgaṃ nivartayitumityupapannaṃ sarveṣāṃ prāmāṇyam |
sarvatra ca yatra kālāntaraphalatvādimānu- bhavāsaṃbhavastatra śrutibhūtā |
sāṃhidikaphale tu dṛṣṭika- vidyādau puruṣāntare vyavahāradarśanādeva prāmāṇyamiti vivekasiddhiḥ |

soma— sākṣāt nirapekṣatayā dharmabhinajanaka- tvāt codanāyāḥ prathamaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vicāritam, tadanantaraṃ tadekavākyatāpannānāṃ arthavādādīnām, ityevaṃ kṛtsnasya vedasya prāmāṇyavicārānantaraṃ tanmūlatayā pramāṇatvāt smṛtīnāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vicāryate iti ānantarya- mityarthaḥ |
sūtrārthastu--codaneva dharmaṃ prāmāṇamiti dharmasya vedaikamūlatvāt mūlabhūtavedahitaṃ smṛtyādikaṃ dharmaprāmāṇatvena anapekṣyamiti |
na mā sārtāchāṅka- svāyāṃ janā iti mantrīḥ |
bhāṭṭa— śiṣṭairvaṇikaparigṛhītānāṃ manvādismṛtīnāṃ dharmādharmayoḥ prāmāṇyamasti na veti saṃdehaṃ sammūlakatva- niścayābhāvāt aprāmāṇyam |
na hyatra pratyakṣadi mūlam, teṣāṃ dharmādharmayoḥ apravṛtteḥ |
pratyakṣapaṭhitasya idānīmucchedasya ca vaidike- rthāparigaṇanaṃ śākhānāṃ mātrāmātrāparityāgena pālya- mānatayā kalpayitumaśakteḥ |

iti prāpte, śiṣṭānāmadha- yāvadadhītaparaṃparayā jyotiṣṭomādiṣviha ahakākala- jhamakṣaṇādiṣvi dharmalenādharmatvena ca parigrahāt manvādīnāṃ traivaṇikatvena vedadarśanasaṃbhavācca tanmūlakatva- meva yuktam, na tu bhrāntyādimūlakatvam |
śākhāntarapasaṃhāreṇa arthavādārthoddhāreṇa nyāyasiddhārtha- kathanena ca smṛtipraṇayanasya sārthakyāt |
ato mūla- śrutyupasthāpakatvaiva dharmādhameprayojakatvaṃ smṛtīnā- miti siddham |
\ smṛtyādhikaraṇe eva ubhayorāpi smṛtyācārayoḥ prāmāṇyaṃ sthāpitam |
kau. 1|4|16, \ smṛtyādhi- karaṇe bhrāntyādikalpanāto vedamūlatvakalpanāyā laghubhūta- tvāt vedamūlatvamevāśritam |
1|3|16 \ smṛtyā- dhikaraṇe smṛtīnāṃ vedamūlakatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt adhya- yanādidharmaniyamasmṛternamūlatvenaprāmāṇyaṃ na śaṅkyam |
su. pṛ. 53. \ smṛtyādhikaraṇe smṛtyācārayoḥ anu- mānavidhayā na śrutyanumāpakatvaṃ kiṃtu arthāpatti- vidhayā ityuktam |
kau. 1|3|15 \ kalpa- sūtrāṇāṃ vedamūlakatvā prāmāṇyaṃ smṛtyādhikaraṇe tulya- nyāyatayā avagatam |

\ yatra kalpasūtrāṇāṃ mūlabhūtā śrutirna pratyakṣatā tatra tāvat pauruṣeyatvena laukikavākyavat dharmapramāṇatvā- bhāve'pi mūlabhūtapramāṇopapattitvena dharmapramāprayojaka- tvāt bhākta eva prāmāṇyavyavahāraḥ iti smṛtyādhi- karaṇe eva ( dharmapramājanakatvaṃ ) nirastam |
kau. 1|3|12 pṛ. 91. \ yuktopayogopapatyānamārgeṇa sṛṣṭipralayādivākyānāmapi yathāsaṃbhavaṃ dharmādyupayogitā jñeyā |
\ kalpasūtrāṇi kiṃ vedarūpāḥ eva, kiṃvā pauruṣeyāḥ santaḥ smṛtyādhikaraṇanyāyena vedamūlatayā pramāṇaṃ iti saṃdehaḥ |
kau. 1|3|161, \ kalpasūtrādīnāṃ tu smṛtyādhikaraṇanyāyena vedamūlatvopapatteḥ nāprāmāṇyam |
\ smṛtyādhikaraṇavakṣyamāṇaprāmāṇyayāḥ sadācāra- rūpāyāḥ yājñikaprasiddheḥ asamamūlatvāśaṅkā na yuktā |
\ kalpasūtrāṇāmapi viprakīrṇanekaśākhāgata-śrutyartha- nibandhanatvena smṛtitulyatvāt smṛtyādhikaraṇaviṣayatva- masyeva |
su. pṛ. 228, \ kalpasūtrāṇāmapi smṛtyā- dhikaraṇe vedamūlatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ ityabhyupetauvyam |
idānīṃ aśabdatvena tatra pūrvapakṣakaraṇāt kalpasūtreṣu ca tadasaṃbha- tvāt eṣāṃ smṛtyādhikaraṇaviṣayatvābhāvāt ityāha |

sva eva satāṃ parārthatā grahaṇānāṃ hi yathā yathārthatā iti nyāya: |
asyārthaḥ- hi yato yasmāt satāṃ sādhūnāṃ parārthatā paropakāritvaṃ svata eva svabhāvāta eva bhavatīti śeṣaḥ |

katham ? sarvapuruṣārthamidhāāyī sāmānyavacanaḥ śabdo na viśeṣe'vasyāpito bhavati |
yathā kāṣṭhāṃnyāhṛtaṃ prasthita ucyate, ‘bhavatā śākamapyāhartavyam’ iti |
evamihāpi svarga-phale phalamaparamupadhīyate ‘brahmavarcasakāmo yāgena svarga-mabhinirvartayet’ iti |
na hi tatra brahmavarcasaphalavacanaṃ svargaphalasya pratiṣedhakam |
yathā yajñāṅge katvarthaḥ ‘godohena paśukāmaḥ praṇayet’ iti |
tatra yadi svargaḥ phalamiṣyate, puruṣaprayatnavacanasya na bādhaḥ |
bhāṣyam— vīte ca kāraṇe vītāyāṃ phalecchā-yāmavāpte vā phale samāptiniyamo dṛśyate |
yadi na varṣeta śvobhūte juhuyāt’ iti |
yadi na svargaḥ, kimarthaḥ samāptiniyamo bhavet |
bhāṣyam— kāmo vā phalaṃ mavenna svargaḥ |
pratyakṣastatra ṛtunā saṃyogaḥ, kāmena ca ‘yaḥ paśukāmaḥ syātsa godohena praṇayanamami-nirvartayet’ iti |
na tvatra pratyakṣaḥ śabdo'sti ‘yo brahmavarcasakāmaḥ syāt, sa yāgena svargamabhinirvartayet’ iti |
kathaṃ varhi ‘yo brahmavarcasakāmaḥ syāt, sa tadyāgena nirvartayediti |
bhāṣyam— atha yaduktaṃ ‘vītāyāṃ phalecchāyāma-vāte vā phale samāptiniyamo dṛśyate’ iti |
ye hi devebhyaḥ saṃkalpya haviḥ, na yāgamabhinirvartayanti, tān śiṣṭā vigarhante |
tatastaddarśanaṃ yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati ‘yadi varṣaṃ tāvatyeva juhuyāt’ iti |
śa— yatra svargadityat phalaṃ śrutaṃ ‘sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet brahmavarcasakāmaḥ’ iti tat kiṃ svargārthaṃ śruta-phalārthaṃ ca, uta śrutaphalārthameveti saṃśayaḥ |
soma— sūtrādyastu- kāmye karmaṇi svargaḥ nitya-phale brahmavarcasādikamanvācyaphalaṃ yathā prastarapraharaṇādau
yajñāṅge ṛtūpakāro nityaḥ, sūktavākaprakāśāyādikaṃ tvanvācyaphalam, tadvaditi |
bhāṣye tu krato ṛtukamaṃ kāmayeta yajñāṅgo vā yajñāṅkāmamityādisutrakāra-vyavahārāt yajñāṅkaśabdo godohanādiyathā syāt |

bhāṣ— yatra śrutatanbrahmavarcasādiphaleṣvapi śāstrasya mahāviṣayatvalābhārya svargakalpanā, brahmavarcasādikaṃ tu āyurādidavānupaṅgikam, tatra kiṃ vācyaṃ rātrisatre iti śaṅkāṃ mandavipanayena śiṣyahitāya parihṛtaṃ sūtram |
svargaśabdaḥ ayaṃ ātmīyadhanaśātanī pratyekaṃ vācako na samudāyāsya |
‘paricchau paśuṃ niyuñjīta’ iti svaśabda-naiva yūpakārye paricaryate |
svasāmarthyapravṛttaistu brāhmaṇādeḥ śakyā śakya-napekṣaṃ aṅgatvaṃ abhīcyate |
tatra kiṃ tisṛṇāṃ daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttiḥ, ekadā krameṇa tisraḥ, punastā eva krameṇa tisra iti utta svasthānaviśuddhiḥ, prathamā dvivāraṃ madhyamā dvivāraṃ tṛtīyā ca dvivāraṃ iti |
iti vicāre daṇḍakalitavat āvṛttiḥ iti pūrvapakṣe utsūtre prāpte, siddhāntamāha |
kṛtānupūrvatvāt prakṛtau kṛtaṃ klṛptaṃ ānupūrvya kramo yāsāṃ tādyatvāt cayane'pi svasthānaviśuddhyā anuṣṭhāne eva tadanusara-saṃbhavāt |
daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttau tu klṛptaṃ ānupūrvyaṃ bādhyeta tṛtīyāyā anantaraṃ prathamāyāḥ |
ekaṃ bhāgamanekavāramāvartayet, dvitīyo bhāgo'nekavāramāvartanīyaḥ, evaṃ tṛtīyo bhāgaḥ |

svatantrakāmanāyāmeva paśuddeśena vihitaṃ paśu-prayojyaṃ godohanaṃ kartavyam |

evaṃ cānyasambandhitvena ava- gatānāṃ anyasambandhitvena bhānaṃ śuktirajatajñānavat |
na ca bāhyaviṣayeṣu manasaḥ tadānīṃ asambaddhatvāt kathaṃ bhānamiti vācyam |
maṇi. pṛ. 96. oṃ svapne nṛpa iti nyāyaḥ |
ayaṃ 'yathā svapne nṛpo bhūtvā bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān |
sāhasī. 907. svapnārtho mantraḥ 'tvamame pratapā asi' iti |
yadā prati- buddhaḥ punaḥ svapiti tadā mantrasya āvṛttiḥ, jyotiṣṭome |
ataḥ adṛṣṭahetukameva svapnādijñānam, kiṃcit cintādihetukaṃ iti upapannaṃ śuktikādijñānatulyatvaṃ svapnādijñānasya |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 55. svapnādijñānaṃ tāvat mithyeti siddham |
taca yadi bāhyalambanameva, tato mithyābhāva eva na ghaṭate |
na cārthatve satyapi mithyātve kāraṇaṃ anyat kalpayituṃ yuktam |
ṛju. pṛ. 54. svapnādijñānotpādanādapareṇa adṛṣṭameva sula- duḥkhaṃ janayat svapnaśanetuḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 55. svapnārambhaprabhṛti svapnāvasānaparyantaṃ jāyamāna- pratyaye karaṇaṃ sannidraṃ manaḥ iti karaṇadoṣarūpā nidrā mithyātvasya hetuḥ |
cintā ca na tadānīṃtanī eva svapnakāraṇam, kiṃtu kityapi pustakāle nirvṛttā- 'pi saṃskāramukhena |
tena jāgraddaśābhāvinī cintā'pi svapnasya hetuḥ; ahaṣṭaṃ ca |

tataśca yadyapi asmin janmani ananubhūtaṃ svapne'nubhūyate tasyāpi anyathā'nupapattyā janmāntare anubhavakalpanāt siddhamastitvam |

ayam 'sthāne'ntara- tamaḥ' (pā. 1|1|50) itisūtramahābhāṣye dhvanitaḥ- "tadyathā- 'samājeṣu samāseṣu sabhāvāyeṣu cāsvatām' ityukte, naiva kṛśāḥ kṛśaiḥ sahāste, na pāṇḍavaḥ pāṇḍubhiḥ, yeṣāmeva kiṃciddharmakṛtamantarthaṃ tairaiva sahāste |
tathā- gāvo divasaṃ caritavanto yo yasyāḥ prasravo bhavati tena saha śerate |
tathā yānyetāni goyuktāni saṃyuṣṭakāni bhavanti tānyanyonyamapadyanyaṃ śabdaṃ kurvanti |
tadyathā- lohaḥ kṣito bāhuvenaṃ gatvā naiva tiryyagacchati, nordhvamā- rohati, pṛthvīvikāraḥ pṛthivīmeva gacchantyantaryyataḥ |
tathā- yā etā āntarikṣayaḥ sūkṣmā āpastāsāṃ vikāro dhūmaḥ, sa dhūmaḥ ākāśe nivāte naiva tiryyagacchati, nāvāṃgavarohati, avikāro'pa eva gacchantyantaryyataḥ |
tathā jyotipo vikāro'ciḥ ākāśadeśe nivāte suprajvalitaṃ naiva tiryyagacchati, nāvāṃgavarohati, jyotipo vikāro jyotireva gacchantyantaryyataḥ" iti, tathā prakṛte'pi |
uktaṃ cānyatrāpi- 'vṛdhudhuṃ punarapi punaścandanaṃ cārugandhaṃ, chinnaṃchinnaṃ punarapi svādu caivaikakāṇḍam |
dagdhaṃdagdhaṃ punarapi kāñcanaṃ kānta- varṇaṃ, na prāṇānte prakṛtivikṛtirjāyate cottamānām |
