tasyā uttarārdhe 'īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśaṃ' iti svardṛśaṃ prati svardṛkchabdoccāraṇakāle idaṃ svardṛśaṃ prati vīkṣaṇaṃ uccyamānaṃ kālamātraṃ syāt svardṛkśabdoccāraṇakāle vīkṣaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ iti kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
uttarayokterapi ādita ārabhya saṃmīlanam, svardṛk- śabdo yāvati bhāge yonī, uttarayopi tāvati bhāge vīkṣaṇaṃ iti śeṣam |
pratiśabdaḥ karmapravacanīyatvāt svardṛkśabdasya (vīkṣaṇaṃ prati ) lakṣaṇatāmācaṣṭe śrutyaiva |
(vīkṣaṇa-svareśaśabdayoḥ ) prayojanaprayuktaḥ iti gṛhyate (bhā. 10|6|2|3 pṛ. 1987, 'svareśaṃ prati vīkṣeta' iti svareśaśabda-vīkṣaṇayoḥ saṃyogaḥ kālārthaḥ |
svareśaśabdoccāraṇa-kāle udgātrā cakṣurunmīlayeta, yat prastāvakāle saṃmilitam |
avabhṛthādisāmāṃ anugranthyādisāmāṃ ca svarūpataḥ prāpto yathāvedameva svaro yuktaḥ |
vā. 3|1|2|5 pṛ. 813. svaraḥ upāṃśu upasatsu, sa copasadpūrvaprayukto na jyotiṣṭomaparamāpūrvaprayuktaḥ |
bhā. 9|1|2|3 varṇakaṃ 2, svaraḥ ṛgvedasya ūrcaḥ, yajurvedasya upāṃśuḥ, sāma-vedasya yat kiṃcit kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ vā coyate tat sarvamuccaiḥ kartavyam |
yā vikṛtiryasmin vede bhavati tasyāḥ śeṣeṣveva yathāprakṛti prāpti yattatsamaive vedadvayāntarama-pūrve coyate sa viṣaya iti |
'jyoti-ṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' itivākyasya sāmavedayo- rāmnātatve'pi somadravyasya, vākhyādidevatānām, aṅga-bāhulyasya ca yajurveda śravaṇāt sāmavede guṇavidhā-nāyānuvādāt |
vi. 3|1|2, svaraḥ jyotiṣṭome dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ avāntarapūrvaprayukta eva na paramāpūrva-prayuktaḥ |
9|1|2 varṇakaṃ 2, svaraḥ jyotiṣṭome dīkṣa-ṇīyādau agnīṣomīyāt prāk upāṃśuḥ |
3|1|1, svaraḥ jyotiṣṭome 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyā-manubrūyāt, mandraṃ prāyaṇīyāyām, mandratamātithyāyām, upāṃśusatsu, uccairmīpomīye' iti |

jyotiṣṭome vācanikasavanavibhāgavihitamandra-madhyamoccoccāraṇadhāraṇam, dīkṣaṇīyādipradhānamātre tu 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanu-brūyāt, mandraṃ prāyaṇīyāyām, mandratamātithyāyām, upāṃśusatsu' iti |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'mandryā ājyabhāgāntaṃ paraṃ madhyama uttamayā anu-yājādi' iti |
3|1|2|9 svaraḥ prāyaṇīyāyāṃ sa ca prāyaṇīyāpūrvaprayukto na paramāpūrvaprayuktaḥ |

bhā. 9|1|2|3 varṇakaṃ 2 svaraḥ- 'mandraṃ prātaḥsavane caranti' ityādisambhyā savanānāṃ ādhāralapyateḥ, karmamadhye anuṣṭhānādeva ca karmanāmādhārasvarapratīteḥ, karmakāle ca anuṣṭhānaṃ vinā anuṣṭhānasya karmamadhyatvā-siddheḥ, savanakāle yat prayujyate tatra sarvatra mandrādi-vidhivadagamāt savanīyādiṣvapi yathāsavanameva svarā bhavanti |
su. pṛ. 1180. svaraḥ mantrataḥ āti-dhyāyāṃ sa cātidhyāpūrvaprayukto na jyotiṣṭomaparamā-
bhā. 9|1|2|3 varṇakaṃ 2, svaraḥ 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta' ityādinā vihitaḥ aṅgā-pūrvaprayukta eva na paramāpūrvaprayuktaḥ |
yeṣāṃ prākṛtānāmaṅgānāṃ prākṛtaḥ svaraḥ, taddvayāṃ vikṛtau codakena prayogavacanatvāt, prayoga-vacanaṃ ca vinā pradhānadharmāprāpteḥ apūrve aṅge svaveda-svaropapattiḥ |
'na ca loke prayuktānāṃ padānāṃ dṛśyate svaraḥ' |
'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta' ityanena dīkṣaṇīyāśabdavācye vāhuniyamo vidhīyate |
sa dīkṣaṇīyāśabdaḥ pradhānamātre vartate naiveṣu, tasmādupāṃśutva-maṅgeṣu, pradhāneṣu 'yāvatyā vācā' |
(yāvatyā vācā iti-) sa dharmaḥ pradhāneṣu bhaviṣyati, dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu pradhānasyopabandhatvāt |
su. pṛ. 1181, svaraḥ vaidikeṣu padeṣu niyataḥ, laukikeṣu aniyataḥ |
pṛ. 1180-81, svaraḥ savanāntaragate savanīyādau stotrādau ca yathāsavanam |
sutyottarakālāni yānyaṅgāni teṣu savana-grahaṇābhāvāt yayāvedameva svaraḥ iti avabhṛthāsā-dīnāmapi uccaistvasiddhiḥ |
saṃkarṣe. 4|1|4. svarasya, agnīṣomīyāt kauṇḍapāyanāmayanagatā-tyācīnai dīkṣaṇīyādau upāṃśutvameva |
bhā. 9|1|2|3 varṇakaṃ 2 svarasya bhādhikasya niyamaḥ krato brāhmaṇo-tpannamantreṣu |
1|2|1|3|23-24. mīko. pṛ. 1497 'krato brāhmaṇotpannānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
' grastaṃ nirastaṃ nihatāva-lambite ambakṛtaṃ dhmātamatho vikampitam |

' iti smṛtayavagatatvātdoṣavarjita-niyatahalādikālāmi-vyaṅgyayathālakṣitakramagrāhīṣu varṇeṣu abhiyuktajñānāṃ sādhu-śabdaprayogāt, tadviparītaitu ca asādhuśabdaprayogāt avaśyaṃ tadālambanaṃ kiñcit vyavasthitaṃ vaktavyam |
nihṛtaṃ iti mahābhāṣye kaiyaṭe ca pāṭhaḥ |
ambakṛtaṃ yo vyakto'pi antarluma iva śrūyate |
dhmātaṃ śvāsabhūyiṣṭhatayā hasso'pi dīrgha iva lakṣyate |
eṇīkṛtaṃ aviśiṣṭaṃ kimayaṃ okāraḥ aya okāra iti yatra saṃdehaḥ |
kākalitvena ( gānaśāstre ) prasiddhaḥ ( yathā caturthaśrutiḥ sannapi ṣaḍjaḥ tṛtīyaśrutisthitatvena gīyamānaḥ ) |
upāṃśutvaṃ kāmyeṣṭiṣu pradhāne eva, aṅgeṣu tu tadavedadāṃnusāreṇa dhvaniḥ |
nanu yājurvedikajyotiṣṭomāyajñānāṃ stotraśastrādīnāmapi anenaiva nyāyena upāṃśutvaṃ prāpnoti |

katham ? darśapūrṇamāsayostāvat vedadyavihiteṣu aṅgeṣu nānā- vedasvare prāpte guṇamukhyavyatikramanyāyena yājurveda- dikapradhānadharmaḥ upāṃśutvaṃ prāpnoti, tato vāca- nikaḥ svaro bhavati 'mandrayā ājyabhāgāntaṃ' , 'paraṃ madhyamayā', 'uttamayā anuśājādi' iti |

tathā vikṛtīnāṃ iṣṭiputranvādīnāṃ etasminneva prākṛte svaratraye prāpnuvati pratyakṣopadeśena pradhānavedasvara- prasaktau 'tadgrahaṇādvā svadharmaḥ syāt' ityanena nyāyena prayogavacanasya codakāpekṣitvena durbalatvāt codakāpi- tasvaragrahaṇameveṣṭam |

evaṃ jyotiṣṭomādīnāmapi dīkṣaṇī- yādīnāṃ prākṛte svare prāpte pratyakṣopadeśena bādhyamāne codakabalīyastvena punarupasthite jyotiṣṭomasya yājurvedi- katvāt klṛptopakāraprākṛtadharmāgrahaṇācca guṇamukhyavyati- kramanyāyenaiva taddoṣāttuguṇadharmaprasaṅge sati 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāmanūyāt' ityete svarā guṇamukhyavyatikramanyāyenaiva sāṅgānāṃ prātaḥ |
tata jyotiṣṭomasya vācanikasvaravibhāgāvihitamandrayamo- cchocāraṇāvadhāraṇāt tadjñānāmāpi sarveṣāṃ prākṛtasvarasya- mandradhamyoccamoccāraṇasyaiva pradhānadvāreṇa prātāni |

tato 'yatkiñcit prācīnamabhīṣomīyā tai upāṃśu caranti' ityapāṃśutve sāṅgānāṃ dīkṣaṇīyādīnāṃ prāte pradhānamātrāvidīkṣaṇīyādiśabdeśena vihitāḥ pradhānā- namātreṣu ete svaraviśeṣā bhavanti 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāmanūyāt, mandraṃ prāyaṇīyāyām, mandrasvara- pasatsu ' iti |
tatra upāṃśutvasya pūrveṇaiva sarva- vyāpinā upāṃśutvavidhinā prāptatvāt dīkṣaṇīyādisvara- prasaṃgādyaiḥ niṣṭhānuvāda eva |
abhīṣomīye tu savana- vibhāgasvareṇaiva 'mandrā ājyabhāgām' ityādi- prākṛtasvarapratiprasavaḥ |
savanavibhāgastulyaṃ vā sāṅgaṃ prayogaṃ tredhā vibhajya mandramadhyamoccoccāraṇasaṃpādanaṃ kāryam |
sutyākālasavanīyā- dīnāmapi evaṃ svare prāpte prātaḥsavanagatatvāt yathāsavanameva svarā bhavanti |
nanu savanaśabdānāṃ soma- yāgāvayavavacanatvāt dīkṣaṇīyājvat tadīyasvarābhāva- prasaṅga iti cet, na, saptamīnirdeśena tatkālaprayuja- mānatvamātrāśrayaṇāt |
'yadi ṣaṣṭhī bhavedyatra sava- nebhyaḥ parā tataḥ |
saptamyāṃ tu tadādhāro yāvā- mantraḥ prayujyate |
tadā teṣāṃ na mandrādiḥ syādanādhe- yatāśruteḥ |
ityukte naiṣa doṣo'sti yataḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vinā''pyayam |
yathā hi śakunivṛkṣe paśupādhi tathe- dhyate |
yadi vā stotraśastrādi kṛtaṃ sutyājñameva naḥ |
'tadgrahaṇādvā svadharmaḥ syādadhikāra- sāmarthyādvyaktaḥ śeṣe' itivat kalpanīyaḥ |
yat prākṛtasvarayuktāyāṃ vikṛtau vedāntarīyamapūrvamaṅgaṃ cocyate iti |
( pakṣāntaraṃ śakte - ) evaṃ tarhi yā vikṛtiḥ yasmin vede bhavati tasyāḥ śeṣeṣva- ṅgeṣu yathāprakṛti prāpteṣu yat tasminneva vede advāntarapūrva cocyate sa viṣaya iti |
( pakṣāntaraṃ śakte - ) tadeva tarhi pradhānaṃ viṣaya iti, na, tasyāpi prākṛtāvaruddhatvāt |
na tarhi pradhānadvāreṇa apūrvasyāṅgasya prāptiḥ iti tadeva viṣaya iti |
naivamapi yaḥ pradhānasya dharmaḥ tasyaiva tatrāpi bhāvāt |
api ca tredhā vibhakteṣu yajñabhāgamaghaṃ ca svare sthite yadapūrvamapi tadgaṇāti bhavati tasya na yūpāvaṭasvara- bahiṃstulyatvaṃ iti bhavitavyameva prākṛtena dharmeṇa |
'mandraṃ prātaḥsavana' ityādi hi nityatvāt anityatveḥ kāmyanaimittikeḥ asaṃjñyamānaṃ nityāśviṣayameva bhavati |
tena yat ṛgvedasāmavedābhyāṃ kiñcit kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ vā codyate tat sarvaṃ uccaiḥ kartavyam |
tathā yāni sutyottarakālāni aṅgāni teṣu savanagrahaṇābhāvāt yathāvedameva svara iti avabhṛthasāmādīnāmapi uccaistvasiddhiḥ |
pravarya- sāmnāṃ punaḥ 'uccaiḥ pravaryaṇa' ityevaṃ uccaistvam |
'ya evaṃ vidvān vāmadevaṃ gāyati' ityādinī yajurvedavākyanyeva |
svaraniyamaḥ : 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayīta tāvatyā vācā dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ' |
iti, na jyotiṣṭomāpūrvārthaḥ : kiṃtu dīkṣaṇīyāpūrvātha eva |
svaraviśeṣeṇa udāttādinā bahuvrīhi- tatpuruṣa- samāsādiniścaye arthaviśeṣo'vaboddhuṃ śakyate |
svaraśabdasya 'mārutasturasi caran mandraṃ jana- yati svaram' ( pāṇinīyaśikṣā ślo. 7 ) ityādi- darśanāt vāyavīyasaṃyogāvibhāgajanitanādākhyadhvanyapara- paryāyopāmārutakaśabdaparaṃ avagamyate |
svarasaṃskārau samarthau prādeśikena guṇena anvitau bhavataḥ ( syātāṃ iti yāske mūlapāṭhaḥ ) |
svarasāmā prathamaḥ āgrayaṇāyaḥ, dvitīyaḥ aindra- vāyavāgraḥ, tṛtīyaḥ śukrāgraḥ |
svarasāmānaḥ trayaḥ divākīrtyamamitaḥ gavāyamane, aṣṭarātre pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ dvau svarasāmānau |
to ca dvau teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ āhakau |
sthānamamiparyāharanti, sa uttarāṇāṃ stomānāṃ abhya- vāyāya, trayāṇāṃ ca sasadaśānāṃ anūcīnatāyai' iti śrutam |
asyārthaḥ kutūhale-- pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe trivṛt- pañcadaśa-saptadaśa-ekaviṃśa-triṇava-trayastriṃśatstomāni krameṇa ṣaṭ ahāni bhavanti |
atrāgre ca yat tṛtīyaṃ saptadaśamahaḥ tat trayastriṃśadahaḥ utkaṇṭhyam |
tathā sati ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyottarāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ stomānāṃ trivṛt- (9) pañcadaśa-ekaviṃśānāṃ avayavāvau bhavati |
tathā saptadaśasya trayastriṃśadūrdhva utkaṇṭhyaṃ idamekaṃ saptadaśam, svarasāmānau ca dvau sasadaśāveva iti trayāṇāṃ saptadaśānāṃ nairantaryaṃ ca bhavati iti |
ayaṃ agharātragataḥ svarasāmaśabdaḥ gavāmayanagatasvara- sāmadharmāṇāṃ atideśakaḥ grāhakaḥ syāt |
agharātragatayoḥ svarasāmnoḥ saptadaśatve eva trayāṇāṃ saptadaśānāṃ nairantaryaṃ bhavati nānyathaiti |

āmayane ca cāvā- pṛthivyaikapālaṃ vidhāya 'yat sarvahutaṃ karoti sā tvekā paricakṣā (doṣaḥ), huto'hutaḥ paryāvartate sā dvitīyā, ājyasyaiva cāvāpṛthivyau yajeta' iti ājyavidhipare vākye sarvahomamaparyāvṛttiṃ ca vaiśvadeviko dharmau prāptau darśayati |
etasmāt liṅgadarśanāt āyayagata eka- kapālaśabdaḥ vaiśvadevaparvagataikapāladharmāṇāṃ grāhakaḥ |
tatra ca 'na vājinena pracaranti' iti vājinapracāro niṣiddhaḥ |
etasmāt liṅgadarśanāt maitrāvaruṇyāmīkṣādhaḥ vaiśva- debhyāmīkṣādharmagrāhakaḥ iti jñāyate |
evaṃ svarasāma- śabdaḥ ekapālaśabdaḥ āmīkṣāśabdaśca dharmagrāhakāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
codanā- sāmānyāt ca svarasāmatvasāmānyarūpaṃ ekakapālatva- sāmānyarūpaṃ āmīkṣāsāmānyarūpaṃ ca |
bhāṣyam-- gavāmayane śrūyate 'amito divākīrtya- mahaḥ, trayaḥ svarasāmāno bhavanti' iti |
teṣāṃ viśeṣa- dharmā āmnātāḥ, yathā 'saptadaśā bhavanti, saṃtatatayā atigrāhā gṛhyante' ityevamādāya |
punaranyatra śrūyate 'pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho dvau svarasāmānau' iti |
tathā vaiśva- deve śrūyate 'cāvāpṛthivya ekapālaḥ' iti |
tatra āmnātā viśeṣadharmāḥ : 'sarvahutaṃ juhoti, aparyāvartayan juhoti' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ svarasāmaśabdaḥ anyatra śrūyamāṇaḥ gavāmayanikebhyaḥ svarasāmabhyaḥ dharmāṇāṃ grāhakaḥ uva neti |
tatra 'guṇavidhiśeṣu na gṛhṇīyāt samatvāt' (7|3|6|17) iti agrahaṇe prāpte, idamucyate |
liṅgaṃ tatra tādṛśaṃ dṛśyate, yena jñāyate sarve ete dharmāṇāṃ grāhakā iti |

svarasāmasu tāvat 'pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho dvau svarasāmānau' ityuktvā āha 'tatra yat tṛtīyaṃ saptadaśamahaḥ tat trayastriṃśasya sthānaṃ amiparyāharanti, sa uttarāṇāṃ stomānāṃ abhyavāyāya, trayāṇāṃ ca sasadaśānāmanūcīnatāyai' iti |
yadi etau svarasāmānau gavāmayanikānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ grāhakau tatra etāvapi saptadaśau |
tathā atra trayaḥ sasadaśāḥ anūcīnāḥ bhavanti |

pṛthivyaṃ ekapālaṃ vidhāya āha, 'yat sarvahutaṃ karoti sā tvekā paricakṣā, huto'hutaḥ paryāvartate sā dvitīyā, ājyasyaiva cāvāpṛthivyau yajeta' iti ājyavidhipare vākye sarvahomamaparyāvṛttiṃ ca vaiśvadeviko dharmau prāptau darśayati |
tathā maitrāvaruṇyāmīkṣāyāṃ 'na vājinena pracaranti' iti vājinasyāṃ vaiśvadevikaṃ dharmaṃ pratiṣe- dhan tat dharmaprāptiṃ darśayati |
etebhyo liṅgebhyaḥ etat jñāyate yathāsthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ grāhakā iti |
) [ atra 'svarasāmaika0' sūtrottaraṃ 'codanā- sāmānyādvā' iti sūtraṃ vṛ-yapustakayornāsti |
māṣye'pi ānandāśramīye tatsūtraṃ tadīyabhāṣyatvena ca kiya~cchidramatho'pi mudritaḥ |
parantu etatsūrīyabhāṣyatvena mudrito grantho na kathaṃcidapi sūtrārthena saṃvadhyate |
'liṅgāt lakṣaṇaparigrahaḥ svarasāmatvasāmānyāt' ityādirekaḥ san granthaḥ saṃśordhakarmaṇye eva ccheditaḥ |
nedaṃ sūtraṃ bhāṣyeṇa vyākhyāta miti ca |

tathāpi 'yasya liṅgarmathasaṃyogāt' ityatra (8|1|2|12) vartamānamena 'codakavākyamanumāpayatā liṅgena' iti vistaragranthena 'kā punaścodanā liṅganimittasyātideśasya āmīkṣasya nāmadheyaprastāvasaṃgatiḥ' iti tantraratnena ca svarasāmasūtrāvattikamavatārayatā jñāpakena 'codanā- sāmānyādvā' iti sūtraṃ jñāpitamiti śaṅkā saṃbhavati |
yathaiva gavāmayane guṇavidhiḥ tathā itaratrāpi 'pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ dvau svarasāmānau' iti |
evaṃ guṇavidhitvāt atideśā- bhāve prāpte 'yasya liṅgarmathasaṃyogāt' (8|1|2|12) ityanena atideśaḥ prāpyate |
śā-- ananyagatitvebhyo liṅgebhyaḥ svarasāmatvādi- codanāśabdopabṛṃhitebhyaḥ tadadhikāratvam |
soma-- codanāliṅgāt viśeṣatideśasya āha- mikasyāpi nāmadheyatvātprasaṅgāt atra saṃgatiḥ |
guṇavidhitvāt svarasāmādiṣvanāṃ atideśakatvābhāve- 'pi codanāliṅgāt atideśamādāya gavāmayanikādi- vikāratvaṃ yuktaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
atra mādhavīye (vistare) 'trayastriṃśasya sthānamamiparyāharanti' iti vyākhyāvidhi- rityuktam |
tathāpi saptadaśasyoktavidhaiva tātparyam, na viniyame iti draṣṭavyam |
atra vājinasyāsya pradhāna- tathā aṅgatvābhāvenānatideśāt vājinasyāpratiṣedha- darśanarūpaṃ liṅgamukteti kuvācintyediti keci- dāhuḥ; tadyuktam |
vājinasyāsya vājinapātre dravyaprayojanākṣatatvā anityasya nityāmīkṣāyāgā- dibhiḥ sahādhikāravidhiviṣayatvābhāvena vājinasya pratiṣedhastathā svecchukadācit aṅgatvasya yuktatvāt |
sūtrārthastu- svarasāmaikakapālāmīkṣaṃ ca prāguktaliṅga- darśanāt gavāmayanikavaiśvadevikadharmāgrāhaka miti |
vi-- 'na vikārā vikārā vā svarasāmādayo, na hi |
bhāṭṭa-- pūrvamuttaravedapratiṣedharūpeṇa liṅgena saumika- praṇayanātideśe niraste adhunā liṅgādapi atideśo'sti ityevaṃ tadapavādaḥ prastūyate |
tathā vaiśvadeva parvaṇi 'vaiśvadevyāmīkṣā cāvāpṛthivya ekapālaḥ' iti sadharmakau yāgau |
anyatrāpi 'maitrā- varuṇyāmīkṣā kāya ekapālaḥ' ityādyāmīkṣakapāla- dravyakā yāgāḥ śrutāḥ |

nikasvarasāmaprakṛtikāḥ, anye āmiṣayāgāśca vaiśva- devikāmiṣayāgāsya, anye ekakapālāśca vaiśvadevikaika- kapālasya uta na iti cintāyām, guṇavādineva kalpitena atideśena itikartavyatākāṅkṣāśānteḥ svara- sāmādiśabdānāṃ ca svarākhyasāmādirūpaguṇavidhāyaka- tvena anatideśakatvāt noktvāyāgaprakṛtikatvam |
iti prāpte, guṇatvādisāhacaryāpekṣayā svarasāmakatvādi- viśeṣasāpekṣena liṅgopabṛṃhitena atideśakalpanāt codanāliṅgātideśena tatprakṛtikatvam |

liṅgamina ca svarasāmasu tāvat ‘pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ dvau svarasāmānau’ ityuktvā āha, ‘tatra yat tṛtīyaṃ saptadaśamahaḥ tat trayastriṃśatstomasya sthānamabhiparyāharanti, sa uttarāṇāṃ stomānāmadhvayāyā, trayāṇāṃ saptadaśānāṃ anucīnatāyai’ iti dravyoḥ svarasāmnoḥ saptadaśastoma- katvadarśanam |
śabdo'pi kramasya dharmī, śabdadharmamanujighṛkṣatā tasya dharmī bādhyate |
tasmāt yūpaśabdasya lakṣaṇabhāyāt itarā vacanavyaktiḥ, yat svaruṃ karoti, tat yūpasya iti |
anena abhi- prāyeṇāha- 'śrutirapi bādhyate vākyamapi' iti |
'yaḥ prathamaḥ śakalaḥ parāpatet sa svaruḥ kāryaḥ' iti |
tatra prakaraṇāt anyārthena khadirādinā joṣaṇādiramiśeṣeṇa yāgārthena prakṛtena asyaikavākyatā |
yūpāya khadirādi joṣayate, chinatti, takṣati ca |
tatra yaḥ śakalaḥ prathamaḥ parāpatet taṃ svaruṃ ajñanārthe karotīti |
tasmāt naitadasti pṛtha- ḍniṣpattiḥ svaruriti, yena anyasyāpi vṛkṣāditi śakyate |
'yathā''nupūrvya svarubhiḥ paśūn sammajya madhyame raśanāguṇe svaṃ svaṃ yūpaśakalamupagṛhṇāti' iti svarubahutvaṃ darśayati |
yadi ca svaruḥ pṛthaḍniṣpattiḥ syāt, eka eva ekādaśinyāṃ tantreṇa kāryaṃ sādhayet |
yūpamanuniṣpannasya tu grahaṇe prakṛtau svaruprakṣalena ajñanaṃ kṛtam, ityekādaśinyā- mapi codakaḥ |
svayūpaśakalameva prāpayati iti bahutva- mupapannaṃ bhavati |
yāhyasau prākṛtaḥ, tādṛśo'sau gṛhītavyaḥ, na viśiṣṭa iti |
bhāṣyam- atha yaduktaṃ utpattiyassa śabdenocyate svaruṃ karotīti, evaṃ ca karotiśabdaḥ avakalpiṣyate iti |
yathā kāṣṭhāni karoti, gomayāni karoti iti ādāne karotiśabdo bhavati, evamihāpi draṣṭavyam |
ityādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi sūtrāṇāṃ vākyāntara- racanayā vyākhyānaṃ bhāṣyakārīyaṃ mudritam |
tatra ṭippaṇyāṃ evamuktaṃ- 'bhāṣyaṃ kasmiṃścit likhitapustake upalabhyate nānyasmin' iti |
soma- kimeṣa svaruḥ chedanādīnāṃ khadirādeśa prayojaka uta neti |
tadarthaṃ ca kima yūpān pṛthaḍ- niṣpannaḥ uta yūpānuniṣpannaḥ śakalo mahītavyaḥ |
tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ svaruṃ karotīti svarubhāvanāvidhiḥ uta svaru- pādānāpādānavidhiḥ iti saṃśayaḥ |
svarunāśe yena kena- cicchakalena ajñanaṃ kāryaṃ na tu svarvarthe punastakṣādi- prayuktiḥ |
vi- 'svaruṃ kuruta ityatra svarūpāt pṛthak chidām |
prayojyena vā, sso'stu viśiṣṭasya vidhā- nataḥ ||
bhāṭṭa- daikṣe paśau 'yūpasya svaruṃ karoti, svaruṇā paśumanakti' iti śrutam |
tatra svaruśabdasya aprasiddhatvāt ādyavākyena ('yūpasya svaruṃ karoti' iti vākyena) svarumikā bhāvanā vidhīyate |
tatra ca sādhanībhūtadravyāpekṣāyāṃ 'tatra yaḥ prathamaḥ śakalaḥ parāpatet sa svaruḥ' iti vacanena śakalasya sādhanatvā-
vagamāt, itikrtavyatāpekṣāyāṃ yūpapadena taddharmalakṣaṇayā ajñanaprokṣaṇādayo vidhīyante |
athavā yathaiva yūpayava- katvaṃ siddhānte ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
evamupapannasya ca dvitīyavākyena ('svaruṇā paśumanakti' iti vākyena) viniyogaḥ |
astu vā dvitīyavākyātisaktakarmaka- bhāvanānuvādena yūpadharmamātravidhiḥ iti na viśiṣṭa- vidhirāpi |
na caivaṃ śakalaśabdasya saṃvandhiktvādeva uttarādhādit yūpīyatvopapatteḥ |
ata eva dharmaprayojakatvena kāṣṭhāntaraprayojakatvaśaṅkāyāṃ tannivartakatvena 'yadyanyasya vṛkṣasya svaruṃ kuryāt anye'sya lokamanāroheyuḥ' iti nindā'pi saṃgacchate |
dharmaprayojakatve'pi ca yūpaikādaśinyāṃ 'yathā''nupūrvya svarubhiḥ paśūn sammajya' iti yūpabhedena svarubhedadarśanaṃ nānupapannam |

na ca śakalaśrutyaiva prāptatvāt tadvidhivai- rthyam (yūpāyavatvavidhi), etadvidhabhāve yūpapadahitātāṃ paraśvādāna-vanagamana-vṛkṣacchedana-sthāṇvāhutyādīnāṃ yūpārthatvavat svarurthatvasyāpi saṃbhavena śakalaśruteḥ vṛkṣa- pratiyogikatvaiva upapatteḥ |
ata eva yathāśakti- prayogadau yūpabhāvā'pi svarurthameva vanagamanādisiddhiḥ |
pañcāratnitvāsiddhayarthaṃ dvitīyayūpacchedādi 'yūpaṃ chinatti' ityādivākyena vihitam, yūpāme pare nivartatām, na tu vanagamanādyapi |
ata eva yūpānuniṣpannaprathamakalanāśe yena kenacit kāṣṭhena ajñanaṃ paśoḥ |
tena prokṣaṇādeḥ svarurthatve pramāṇābhāvāt na svarusteṣāṃ prayojakaḥ |
sūtrāṇi ca sudhībhiḥ asminnevārthe vyākhyāyante, na tu bhāṣyākārokte |
amīṣomīye paśo śrūyate 'svaruṇā svahitinā vā paśumanakti' iti |
ayaṃ svaruḥ kiṃ yūpaṃ paśvaṅgaṃ veti vicāre pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
apiśabdena pūrvādhikaraṇoktaṃ raśanāyā yūpāhṅgatvaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ karoti |
yathā raśanā yūpāhṅgaṃ tathā svarupi yūpāhṅgaṃ syāt |
yūpacchedanakāle prathamaḥ patitaḥ śakalaḥ svaru- rnāma |
svaruḥ yūpāhṅgaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe hetvantarārthaṃ sūtram |
taddvat yūpāhṅgaṃ svaruḥ yūpasya niṣkrayaḥ iti darśa- yati arthavādaḥ |
'apanayan ha sa vai purā ṛṣayaḥ, ye yūpaṃ prāpayanti, saṃbhajya sucam, te manyante yajñaveśāya vā idaṃ karmeti |
te prastaraṃ kṛco niṣkrayampaśyan, yūpasya svaruṃ ayaśavaiśāya iti |
keciccaityaḥ yajñānte yūpaṃ agnī prakṣipanti sma |
lucaṃ ca saṃbhajya bhittvā agnī prākṣipan |
tadapare kecana ṛṣayaḥ: apanayan amanyanta ca iha keṣāṃcidgrīṇāṃ karma yajñaveśāya yajñasya nāśayaiva bhavatīti |
kathaṃ tarhi kartavyam ? sucaḥ prastaro niṣkrayaḥ, yūpasya niṣkrayaḥ svaruḥ |
tathā sati sucaḥ sthāne prastara eva agnī prakṣepa- ṇīyaḥ, yūpasya sthāne ca svaruḥ prakṣepaṇīyaḥ |
tena agnī prakṣepaṇaṃ ca syādeva yajñanāśaśca na syāt itya- vadārthaḥ |
'svaruṇā paśumanakti' iti amīṣomīye uktaḥ svaruḥ yūpāhṅgaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe sūtradvayena prāptaṃ vāśabdena taṃ niṣedhaya siddhāntayati |
paśoḥ ghṛtena ajñanaṃ svaroḥ prayojanaṃ karma |
‘svaruṇā paśumanakti’ iti abhīṣomīye paśau śrutaḥ svaruḥ |
yūpāṅ‌ga iti pūrvapakṣe svaruṇā yūpasya niṣkrayavādo hetutvenoktaḥ |
tasya nirākaraṇaṃ siddhāntinā kriyate anena sūtreṇa |
yo'yaṃ niṣkrayavāda uktaḥ sa bhaktyā guṇastulyā syāt |
amau svaroḥ prakṣepe yūpa eva bhavati iti niṣkraya iva svaruṇā yūpasyoktaḥ sā śrutiḥ |
ke. ❀ svaḥ chedanādīnāṃ khadirādeśa prayojakaḥ uta neti saṃśaye neti siddhāntaḥ yūpaprayukta chedanadanuniṣ- nno'yam |
10|27. svaro: pratipatti: somānte ‘ saṃkṣipte yajñe prakṣipyate ’ iti |
anayā prastaraṃ praharati svaraṃ vā ’ iti |
ki bhavati prayojanam ? ekayūpe svaro: yāvadanubandhyāpaśūnāṃ dhāraṇa kartavyaṃ na tu ekādaśa paśavo yadā niyujyante, tadā ekasyaiva paśo: amīṣomīyapaśūnāṃ pratipatti: |
ślokaśca svaro: yupānuniṣpannapaśūnāṃ nāśoṃ yena kena- bhavati- ‘ svarūpāpyami’ti cedakartavyaṃ samaja- cit kāṣṭhena paśorajanam |
bahunāmekayūpatve sarveṣāṃ tu samaja- sarva (ru-a ) dhikaraṇam |
bhāṣyam-- ‘ asti jyotiṣṭome paśuramīṣomīya: somājñabhūta: ’ yo dīkṣito yadīmīyameva paśūmālabhate ’ iti |
tatra śrūyate ‘ svaruṇā svadhitinā vā paśumanakti ’ iti |
tatra saṃdeha:, kiṃ yūpārddha svara: uta paśvaṅgamiti |
ekadeśa: svarūpasya iti śrūyate, ‘ svaruṇā svaṃ karoti ’ iti |

‘ apaśyan ha sma vai purā ṛṣayo ye yūpaṃ prāpayanti, saṃbhajya srucaṃ te manyante yajñavaiśasāya vā idaṃ karmeti, te prastaraṃ suco niṣkampamapaśyan, yūpasya svaramyaśa- vaiśasāya ’ iti niṣkarṣaśravaṇāt tadajñatā vijñāyate |
bhāṣyam-- paśvaṅgaṃ vā, tasya hi ajñanārthena svaruṇā prayojanam |
tathāhi śrūyate ‘ svaruṇā paśu- manakti ’ iti |
yadi tadartha eva svaru:, tato dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanam |
atha yūpārtha:, adṛṣṭaṃ prayojanam, tata: kalpyam |
bhāṣyam-- kayā bhaktyā ? evamāha, ‘ yūpa: kilāsau praśastasya: |
tena yūpa: śā-- ‘ svarūṇā paśumityevaṃ śeṣaśeṣivibha- kti: |
soma-- raśanāvat svarupi yūpārddha iti pratyavasānāt ( dṛṣṭānta- ) saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu- svarūṇāpi yūpārddhaṃ syāt ‘ yūpasya svaruṃ karoti ’ ityasya ṣaṣṭhībalena svarumantaṃ yūpaṃ karoti ityarthaparyavasānena yūpaikadeśatayā tadaṅgatvaucityāditi |
bhāṭṭa-- ‘ yūpasya svaruṃ karoti ’ iti paśyā svaro: yūpārthatvāvagamāt ‘ svarūṇā paśumanakti ’ iti ajñanaṃ pratipatti: , ‘ yat kiṃcit somalita tenābhyaṃ yanti ’ itivat |
iti prāpte, svaroryūpārthatve adṛṣṭārdhatvā- patte: paśvaṅgaśca avayavavyatirekanimittatvenāpi upapatte: ‘ svarūṇā ’ iti tṛtīyādicchatvāt paśvaṅganārthameva |
somalite tu avabhṛthapade gauṇavācanekadopamiyā tadaṅgī- karaṇaṃ ityuktameva ( 4|2|8 ) |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe eka- yūpake paśūnāmekasyaiva paśo: svaruṇā samajamam, siddhānte tu sarveṣāmiti |
pārthasārathi mate prayāja- śeṣābhiprāyanyāyena ādhāraniyamasya paśusaṃskārārthatvā- patte: pūrvapakṣe'pi sarveṣāmajñanaprasaṅgāt prayojanānupa- patti: iti bhāṣyavirodho'pi |
svaruśabdasya tadarthasya ca alaukikavedapi prasiddhapadasamabhivyāhāreṇa vyutpatti: |
svarūpeṇa avidheyatve'pi viśiṣṭa- rūpeṇa vidheyatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
su. pṛ. 864. svarūpeṇa padārthānāmanirdeśa: iti daśamādyapūrvapakṣanyāya: |
svarūpāsaddhi: hetvābhāsa:, ‘ hetvābhāsā: ’ iti vindī draṣṭavya: |
maṇi. pṛ. 41. svarūpavalāvelena āśrayatvāvalasa vādhyarthaṃ pikanemādhikaraṇe vakṣyate |
yadidaṃ dravyaguṇādimāsādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ tadvyatirekena medo dharmo nāsti, svarūpamātreṇaiva medyavyavahāropapatte: |
nanu yadi svarūpamātreva meda:, tarhi svarūpamātradarśanatargeva medyavyavahāra: syāt, na ca tathā dṛśyate |
satyam, svarūpasamakāle medyavyavahāro nāsti, tathāpi svarūpātirekto medo nāstyeva kiṃtu pratiyogiāpekṣo medyavyavahāra:, svarūpa- mātradarśane tadabhāvāt medyavyavahāraprasaṅga: |

nanu tarhi pratiyogisyapekṣo meda: svarūpaṃ tu pratiyogi nirapekṣameva, kathamanayorekatvam ? naivam, medastu na pratiyogisyapekṣa: kiṃtu medyavyavahāra eva, ata eva nirvikalpake pratiyogijñānābhāvādeva meda- vyavahārābhāva: |
na caitāvatā svarūpadarśanemātra meda- vyavahāraprasaṅga:, medastu svarūpata: medava, na hi svarūpa- mātraṃ meda: |
yathā devadatta: nirapekṣayā putra:, na tu devadattamātraṃ putra:, atha devadattavyatirikta'pi na bhavati putra: |
nanu kimanayā kliṣṭakalpanāyā ? medastāvat ‘ ayamasādinna: ’ iti pratyakṣeṇa pratīyate eva |
na ca svarūpāvidyat dravyadharmatvamupapadyate, dravyaguṇādiṣvantarbhāvāt, guṇādiṣvitatvāt |
nanu tarhi svarūpāṇāmanyonyadeśatvāccamekaṃ na bhavet, naivam, pratiyogisyapekṣameva svarūpamityupādhi- katvenaitadupapatte: |

nanu pratiyogisyapekṣaṃ svarūpaṃ meda ityuktam, keyaṃ pratiyogisyapekṣatā nāma ? yadi svarūpamātrameva, tarhi pūrvokto doṣa:, atha dharmāntaraṃ pratiyogisyapekṣatvam, tarhi sa eva meda iti, aṅgīkṛta: svarūpātirekto meda: |

naivam, dharmabhedādinā mithyābhedādināṃ ca medyatiriktameva pratiyogisyapekṣatvaṃ nāma dharmāntaramaṅgī- kartavyam ; itarathā ghaṭasvarūpamātreṇa tadtabhedadarśanādeka- sidveva medyavyavahāraprasaṅgāt |
atha saṃyogādidiśi- tvāccedrodaśena eva medapratīti: ; naivam, ghaṭā- dvinna: paṭa: iti medyavyavahāra:, na saṃyogadiśi- tathā, tatrāyamasātsaṃgayo: iti na kadācidapi pratīti: |

evaṃ saṃprātigotvena pratipannasya medasya paścād vyava- hāramātramanayorbheda iti, tasmādbhedātirekena pratiyogi- syapekṣatvaṃ nāma sarvabhedatvādibhiraṅgīkṛtam, tadapekṣa svarūpaṃ medyavyavahārakāraṇamastu, kimantargaṭhanā medadharmaṃ ? nanu dharmavādinā pratiyogisyapekṣatvañca dharme- syāṅgīkartumucitam, sarvatra tadapekṣadarśanāt |
svarūpaṃ tu na, pratiyoginirapekṣatayā svarūpasya kadācidapi jñānāt |
ato na prativandisiddhiriti, naivam, atrāpi prati- yogisyapekṣatvaṃ na svarūpasya svabhāva:, kiṃtu meda- vyavahārasya |
nanu vilakṣaṇavyavahāro vilakṣaṇavyavahāryenivandha- no'pi dṛṣṭa:, yathā ghaṭavyavahārāt medino bhinno meda: - iti vyavahāra:, tatra vilakṣaṇo vyavahāro'sti, na tu vilakṣaṇyam, atonaikāntiko hetu: |
abhidho medino meda ityaṅgīkāre nāmāntareṇa svarūpabhedavāda eva svīkṛta: syāt |
thaikyādilakṣaṇavyavahārameva nāsti, tarhi bhinno ghaṭaḥ ityatrāsammataidathaikyāt vilakṣaṇavyavahāralakṣaṇameva na bhavet, ataḥ svarūpātirekeṇa medāṅgīkāro na yuktaḥ |
nanu svarūpasa pratiyogyapekṣā vaktavyā, tatra vikalpa- nīyam- kiṃ svarūpādinnaḥ pratiyogī, kiṃvā abhinnaḥ iti |
na tāvadbhinnaḥ, svayameva svasya pratiyogitva- prasaṅgāt |
na ca bhinnaḥ, mede sati pratiyogitvasiddhiḥ, pratiyogitvasiddhau ca bhedasiddhiritītaretarāśrayatvam |
atha medāntareṇa bhinnaḥ pratiyogī, tarhyanavasthāprasa ṅgati |
naivam, dharmabhedavādino'pi pratiyogisyapekṣala- mastyeva, tatrāpyevaṃ vikalpo doṣaśca samānaḥ, yastatra parihāraḥ sa evātrāpi |
tathāhi, 'paṭādbhinno ghaṭaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇatvena medaḥ pratīyate, bhavatastu svarūpavyatirekeṇa medābhāvādidiśeṣaṇabhūto'yo nāstyeva, ataḥ 'medo ghaṭaḥ' ityeva vyavahāraḥ syāt
paśuputrādīnāṃ tu aihika- kāmuṣmikatvam, na tu kevalāmuṣmikatvam |
yatra tu dṛṣṭādau aihike eva kāmanā tatra kevalaihikatvam |
bhāṭṭa. 4|3|12-28 varṇakaṃ 2. svargastu janmā- ntare eva |
sa hi niratiśayā prītiḥ kāmānurūpā ca iti na śakyā iha janmani anubhavitum |
yataḥ asmin loke kṣaṇeṣu duḥkhaiḥ anubhavānti (janāḥ) |
tacca amṛtasya (puṣpasya) na saṃbhavati, ityataḥ janmāntare eva svargaḥ |
ṭupa. 4|3|11|28 varṇakaṃ 2. svargaḥ duḥkhamiśritatvābhāvāt niratiśayasukhatvācca sarvapuruṣā- ṇāmiṣṭaḥ |
kathamavagamyate ? sarveṣāmeva śabdānāṃ arthajñāne laukikaḥ prayogaḥ anupāyaḥ|
tasmiṃśca laukike prayoge dravyavacanaḥ svargaśabdo labhyate|
kauśeyāni sukṣmāṇi vāsāṃsi svargaḥ, candanāni svargaḥ, dravyavarṣāḥ striyaḥ svarga iti yadyat prītimat dravyaṃ tattat svargaśabdena ucyate|
tena sāmānyādhikaraṇyāt prītimat dravyaṃ svarga iti manyāmahai|
upamānāt śabdapravṛttiḥ iti cet, na hi kasmiṃścit anupagamito loke prasiddhaḥ, yasyaitat upamānaṃ syāt|
tadeva hi dravyaṃ kasyāṃcidavasthāyāṃ na svargaśabdaḥ abhidadhāti|
tasmāt anvaya- vyatirekāmyāṃ etadavagamyate, prīto svargaśabdo vartate iti|
nanu svargaśabdo loke prasiddho viśiṣṭe deśe|
yasminnoṣṇam, na śītam, na kṣut, na tṛṣṇā, nāratiḥ, na glāniḥ|
puṇyakṛta eva pretya tatra gacchanti, nānye|
yadi tatra kecit amṛtā na gacchanti, tata āgacchanti ajanitvā vā, na tarhi sa pratyakṣo deśa evaṃjātīyakaḥ|
nanu ca anye siddhāḥ dṛṣṭavantaḥ, te ca ākhyātavantaḥ|
iti cet, na tatra pramāṇamasti, siddhā evaṃjātīyakāḥ santi, te ca dṛṣṭvā ācarantī- iti|
nanu ca lokāt ākhyānebhyo vedācca avagamyate deśa evaṃjātī- yakaḥ svargaḥ iti|
puruṣāṇāṃ evaṃvidhena deśena asaṃśrayāt pramāṇaṃ vacaḥ|
tathāpi asatyapakṣasya avirodhaḥ, prīti- sādhane svargaśabda iti|
tena deśena vyavahārābhāvāt kutastasya abhidhāyakaḥ svargaśabdo bhaviṣyati|
yadā prītimat dravyaṃ svargaḥ, tadā brūmaḥ|
tatra avaśyaṃ svargasya yāgasya ca saṃbandhaḥ|
kathaṃ punaravagamyate yāgaḥ kartavyatā koyate iti|
yadā kāmasyāpi kartavyatā asmāt vākyāt avagamyate|
kāmasya kartavyatā vākyāt, yadyarthasya kartavyatā śruteḥ vākyāt balīyasī|
sa tu yasyecchā tasya sidhyati, nānyasya iti gamyate|
tayā dravyamānetuṃ yatate hyeta- naiva dvāreṇa|
yathaiva sā guṇabhūtā prāptā, tathaiva satī niyamyate|
tena svargecchā guṇa- bhūtyā svargadravyaṃ prati yatiṣyate yāgaṃ sādhayitum|
phalavattve avagate ka etaccintayite iti yukto vicāraḥ|
yadi ca evaṃ kāmaśabdaiḥ phalama- mīyate tato bhāvārthādhikaraṇe (2|1|2) cintā, kiṃ bhāvaśabdāḥ phalasambandhinaḥ uta dravyaguṇaśabdāḥ iti|
sadbhāve ca ( taddhikārāt ) codanālakṣaṇa iti vicāraḥ|
katham ? bhedābheda- śeṣaśeṣi- prayojakāprayojaka- evaṃkramayuktaḥ karmabhiḥ ko'dhikriyate iti vicārasya ayamevāvasaraḥ|
'kiṃ svargo guṇataḥ karma pradhānataḥ' iti (bhāṣyaṃ) ayuktamidam|
svargaśabdo yadi ākhyātena saṃbadhyate, na kāmapadena|
tassāt svargaśabdaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa- tvena upakṣīyatvāt nānyena saṃbandhamarhati|
yayā rāja- jātiviśiṣṭaḥ kartā rājasūyasādhanaṃ vidhīyate, rājasūyo vā tadyathaitena|
rājanāvite sādhyā, nāpi sādhanam, evaṃ na svarge|
kiṃca 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' iti sāmānyādhikaraṇyāt yāge guṇabhūtaḥ kartā nirdiśyate|
yathā 'devadattaḥ pacati' ityatra na devadattyarthaḥ pākaḥ, evamihāpi atyantaguṇabhūta eva kartā pratīyate|
nāyamekānto yat pradhāntaṃ guṇabhūtam, pradhānamapi bhavati kriyāyām|
tatra yadi svargaśabdena dravyamabhidhīyate, tato'sau sādhanatvena tatkāmyamāno yāge sādhanatvenaiva saṃbadhyate|
athāsya prītirbhidheyā, tataḥ tāṃ ārabha- saṃbandhitvena kāmyamānaḥ svargaśabdena abhīdhīyate|
evaṃ dvipakārayāṃ kāma- nāyāṃ svargo guṇabhūtaḥ; atha pradhānabhūtaḥ iti upapannaḥ saṃśayaḥ|
svargacchāviśiṣṭasya yāge kartṛtā, atadviśiṣṭena yāgo na kartavyaḥ|
yathā rājajāti- viśiṣṭena rājasūyaḥ kāryaḥ na atadviśiṣṭena, tada-
evaṃ cet nāvaśyaṃ upādeyaṃ prītimat dravyam|
'athāpi adṛṣṭena, tathāpi na doṣaḥ' ( prathamasūtrānte bhāṣyam ) ityasmāt granthāt ayaṃ dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ anu- mīyate|
yasyaiva paraḥ śrūyate tasya śrutyā kartavyatāmāha|
api ca aniṣpanna- tvāt yāgasya bhāvyatvam|
yat niṣpannaṃ tat karaṇatvaṃ pratipadyaṃ śaknoti dātrādi|
anena prakāreṇa bhāvyamāno yāgaḥ, na svargaḥ|
kimuta yadā prītimadravyavacana eva loke svargaśabdaḥ; tataḥ tatsādhanatvena kāmyate|
tadyathā daṇḍī ityanena ' asya granthasya saṃbandho vyavasthitasyāpi (tadyathā daṇḍī..svargaśabda iti, yadyat prīti... tattat- svargaśabdenocyate iti krameṇa )|
'yadyapi kevalasvargavacanārthatayā tādṛśo deśaḥ syāt tathāpi asatyapakṣasyāvirodhaḥ, ' prītisādhanaṃ svarga iti|
'tena deśena vyavahārābhāvāt kutastasyābhidhātā svargaśabdo bhaviṣyati' iti|
ekasya ( siddhāntinaḥ ) prītiḥ svargaśabdavācyā, aparasya ( pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ ) prītimat dravyam|
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasya apratyakṣatvena vyavahārā- bhāvaḥ|
kiṃtu yasya prītirbhidheyā tatsādhanaṃ ca yāgaḥ, tena sā nānubhūyate iti arthapatyā vācyo'pi sa kalpyate|
karmaṇāṃ tu alpamadhyamamahatā alpamadhyamamahatva eva prītayaḥ|
tatra yā prītiḥ niratiśayā anubhavitā sā ca śītoṣṇādidvaṃdvarahite deśe śakyā anubhavitum|
asmiṃśca ( martyaloke ) deśe suhūrtaśatabhāgo'pi dvaṃdvaiḥ mucyate|
candanādijanyā tu yā prītiḥ candanā- dīnyeva tasyā utpādakāni na yāgaḥ |
asmiṃśca deśe yāvat jaṅgamatimargādi tat sarvaṃ prītayagrī anubhavati |
na ca taiḥ karmāṇi kṛtāni asmin deśe |
ato ye sādhāraṇe prītayaprīte te svabhāvakṛte |
ayogyacca anya- smin janmani taiḥ kṛtāni karmāṇi, yena prītimanubhava- ntīti |
yathā asmin janmani sarvāṇi na kurvanti, eva- manyasmin janmani |
ato yadi iyaṃ karmajanyā syāt kaiścidevānubhūyeta |
sā ca aśakyā viśiṣṭadeśāte anubhavi- tum |
'yadyapi kevala- sukhaśravaṇātprāptyā' iti abhyupetyavādena ayaṃ granthaḥ |
bhavatā prītisāma- rthyāt viśiṣṭo deśaḥ kalpyate, tathāpi prītimat dravyaṃ tasya sādhanam
tatra yadi prabhāsate puruṣārtha upanipatati, dvitīye ca yāgaḥ; tataḥ kataraśabdasya bādhā kṛtā |
atha kimaṃśe yāga upanipatati tato niyataprayojikā pratyayasya śaktiḥ; sā bādhyate |
katham ? svarge ātmasaṃba- ndhitvena prārthyamānaḥ svargakāmo'midhīyate |
tassāt anayoḥ avinābhāvāt svargakāmaśabdena śakyate tadupāyo lakṣayitum |
ataḥ śāstreṇa yāgādayaḥ tatra upāyatvena vidhīyate |
bhāṣyam— ato na svargakāmapadena svārtho vidhīyate |
bhāṣyam— tatra vākyādavagatasya kāmasya kartavyatā avagamyate, yāgasya ca karaṇatā |
evaṃ ca yāga- kartavyatāṃ na pratyakṣavirodho bhaviṣyati |
tassāt karmopadeśaḥ syāt (sūtrāvayavaḥ), karma svargaṃ prati upadiśyate, na svargaṃ prati |
kimato yadi svargo nopadiśyate ? etadato bhavati, na hi anupadiṣṭaḥ arthaprāmāśra guṇe bhavati |
tassāt svargaḥ pradhānataḥ, karma guṇataḥ iti |
apica, yasya svarga iṣṭaḥ syāt sa yāgaṃ nirvartayet itthaṃ asaṃjñadrabhima anyadicchati anyat karoti |
atha matam, tataḥ svargo bhavati iti saṃba- ndhāt idaṃ gamyate iti |
vākyādeva asmāt imaṃ saṃbandhamavagacchāmaḥ, yathā 'kāṣṭhānyāhartukāmaḥ araṇyaṃ gacchet' iti yadi brūyāt, brūyādetat, dṛṣṭaṃ tatra pramāṇatareṇa araṇyagamanasya kāṣṭhāharaṇasāmarthyaṃ vidyate iti |
atha manyate upadeśānarthakyaṃ mā bhūditi arthā- pasmirbhaviṣyatīti |
yat, antareṇa phalavacanam, yāgasya prītiḥ phalaṃ avagamyeta, kāmaṃ asyānarthakyaṃ bhavet, na jātucit sāmarthyamasya jāyate |
na hi dagdhukāmasya udakopādānaṃ asati dāhe anarthakaṃ iti dahanaśakti asya janayet |
athavā svargakāmasya yāgo vidhīyate iti pakṣāntarā- valambanena asya arthavattā bhaviṣyatīti |
dup— 'tatra vākyādavagatasya kāmasya kartavyatā- 'vagamyate, yāgasya (ca) karaṇatā' iti |
'athavā svarga- kāmasya yāgo vidhīyate iti pakṣāntarāvalambanena assā- rthavattā bhaviṣyati iti' yāgaṃ kartādityassāt pakṣāntaraṃ yāgena kuryāt iti |
'athavā svargakāmasya' iti ataḥ svargakāmasya' iti draṣṭavyam |
bhāṣyam— nanu itarasminnapi pakṣe svargakāmasya yāgo vidhīyate, na yāgāt svargaḥ |
tasmin khalu pakṣe svarge prārthyamānasya anuṣṭhānamanūdya yāgaḥ tasya upāyatvena vidhīyate iti na doṣaḥ |
tadanuṣṭhānaṃ svarge prati iti nāsti vacanaṃ iti cet, idamarthe prati anuṣṭhānaṃ bhavati |
ataḥ svargaḥ pradhānataḥ, karma guṇata iti svargakāmādhikṛtya yajeta iti vacanaṃ iti adhikāra- lakṣaṇamidaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati |

dup— 'nanu itarasminnapi pakṣe svargakāmasya yāgo vidhīyate, na yāgāt svargaḥ' iti, ko'bhiprāyaḥ ? padārthapūrvatvāt vākyārthasya yāgena svarga iti yadi śrayeta tat idaṃ sādhyaṃ idaṃ sādhanaṃ iti syāt |
na ca yāgena svarga iti śrūyate |
tasmin khalu vai pakṣe svarge prārthyamānasya anuṣṭhānamanūdya yāgaḥ tasya upāyatvena
tassāt svargakāmaśabdaḥ śaknoti upāyaṃ lakṣa- yitum |
sa ca lakṣitaḥ san upāyatvena vidhīyate |
tassāt phalavattve karmaṇāṃ yuktaṃ adhikāra- lakṣaṇamārabdhum |
adhikārī iti karmaṇāṃ uparibhāvena avasthitaḥ, svāmī ityarthaḥ |
karmabhiḥ puruṣaḥ kartā kimadhikriyate na vā ||
' 'darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' ityādiṣu kiṃ puruṣasya adhikāraḥ svāmyaṃ karmajanyaphalabhoktṛtvaṃ asti na vā iti cintyate |

tadarthaṃ idaṃ vicāryate, yeyaṃ prayojyatā bhāvanā tasyāḥ kiṃ dhātvartha eva bhāvyaḥ pradhānam, svargādi tu sādhanatayā guṇabhūtaṃ uta kāmyamānatvena upāttaḥ svargādireva bhāvyaḥ tatsādhanaṃ ca dhātvartha iti |
tato'pi etat vivektavyaṃ yo'tra kriyāyāḥ svargakāmā- deśa puruṣasya kriyākartṛrūpaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tatra kiṃ kriyā pradhānataḥ, puruṣo guṇataḥ; tato viparītaṃ veti |
idamapi ca cintyate svargaśabdo dravyavacanaḥ prītivacano veti |
tatra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ ' dhātvarthasyaiva bhāvyatvaṃ pada- śrutyā pratīyate |
svargādeḥ khalu vākyena śrutervākyaṃ ca durbalam |
bhūtaṃ ca svargapadādi dravyaṃ bhavyāya karmaṇe |
kharasāt puruṣāṇāṃ hi kāmanā phala- gocarā |
soma— sutrārthastu- dravyāṇāṃ svargapakṣādīnāṃ karmabhiḥ saṃbhoge śrūyamāṇe dravyāṇāṃ karmajananasāmarthyāt guṇatvena saṃbandhaḥ iti |
vi— ' karmādhikāraḥ karturne kiṃvā'sti, na pada- śruteḥ |
bhāṭṭa— evaṃ sakrame prayojyatvena nirūpite adhunā tatra adhikārī nirūpyate |
tatra adhikāre nāma phala- bhoktṛtvasamānādhikaraṇaṃ kartṛtvam |
śrāddhādau pitrādeḥ ṛtvijāṃ ca adhikārāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayam |
na caiva jātehī pituḥ phalabhogābhāvāt adhikārānapattiḥ |
satyapi akaraṇe pratyayāce karaṇasya putlādiphalakatvena pāpakṣayaphalakatvābhāvāt iti vācyam |
jāteṣṭiādāvādāvapi phalasya anyaniṣṭhatve'pi tadicchāyā yajamānaniṣṭhatvāt adhikārāvighātaḥ |
ṛtvijāmapi 'yajamānasya phalaṃ bhūyāt' ivīcchāyāḥ svaniṣṭhakartṛttva- samānādhikaraṇatvādādhikāraprāptiḥ |
'dakṣiṇāprāptirme bhūyāt' ivīcchāyā eva ṛtvikpravṛtti- janakatvena uktaviśeṣāt |
tatra adhikārasya iṣṭarūpa- pravṛttiphalavattvāt tadeva iṣṭarūpaṃ phalaṃ bhāvanāyāmiti na vā iti prathamaṃ vicāryate |
tatra bhāvanāyāḥ bhābhyā- pekṣayā padaśrutyā dhātvarthasyaiva sarvatra bhāvyatvam, na svargādeḥ, api tu tasya sādhanatvameva yogyatvāt |
pakṣāderiva svargaśabdasyāpi 'candanaṃ svargaḥ' ityādi- prayogāt dravyāvācitvameva sulabhaviśeṣabhogyatvadeśa- viśeṣavācitvāgrāhakasya anyaparatvāt |
athavā svargakāmaśabdaḥ kartṛviśe- ṣameva yāgājñatvena vidadhat viśeṣaṇībhūtāṃ kāmanāmapi tadaṅgatvena vidhatte iti na kaścit virodhaḥ |
na ca vidhiśrutayorudbhūta ihābhyaktatvāgamaḥ, vidheḥ pravṛtti- jananasvarūpayogatvasya vācyatvena phalopadhānainaivayā- bhāvāt, pravṛttivirahe'pi araṇyasthadaṇḍavat vidheḥ
nahi phalopahitapravṛttijanakatvaṃ vidheyarthaḥ; vidhiśravaṇe'pi keṣāṃcit pravṛttyadarśanāt |
ata eva pravṛttiviṣayasya iṣṭasādhanatvākṣepatvamapi vidherna prāmāṇikam |

yadi tu pravṛttikarūpayogyatva- mātroktau vākyasya vaiyarthyāpattiḥ śaṅkyeta tato yāgasya samānapadaśrutyā bhāvyatvāvagame'pi yāge bhramaprāsādhāraṇapravṛttikāraṇeṣu iṣṭasādhanatvasyaiva ākṣe- pāt bhramātmakaiṣṭasādhanatvājñānādeva pravṛttisiddheḥ neṣṭa- sādhanatvākṣepatvam |
athavā astu 'strīkāmaḥ prāya- ścittaṃ kuryāt' itivat svargakāmanāyā api nimitta- tvam |
tataśca nimitte naimittikakaraṇe pratyayābhāvamātram, na tu karaṇe kiṃcidiṣṭam |
akaraṇe pratyayābhāveva ca puruṣapravṛttisiddheḥ na vidhivaiyarthyamapi |
sarvathā yāgasyaiva bhāvyatvena iṣṭasādhanatvābhāvāt na pravṛttiprayojaka- pravṛttiviṣayajanyaphalasyehasamānādhikaraṇakartṛttvarūpādhikāra- siddhiḥ |
iti prāpte, na pravṛttisvarūpayogyatvamātraṃ vidhivyarthaḥ vaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
nāpi iṣṭasādhanatvānumiteḥ bhrama- tvam, jñānānāṃ svataḥ pramāṇatvena bādhakaṃ vinā amatvā- nupapatteḥ |
ataśca utsargasiddhapramāṇatvavicārārthaṃ yāge iṣṭasādhanatvaṃ viṣayo'pi vakṣyaḥ eva iti bhāvanāyāṃ iṣṭabhāvyatvaṃ yāgakaraṇatvaṃ ca āpannameva |
yadapi kāmanāyāḥ nimittatvamaṅgīkṛtya vidheḥ akaraṇajanyapratya- vāyākṣepatvena pravarttakatvaṃ ityuktam, tatra, kāmanāyāḥ pravṛttijanakatve'pi nimittatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
'strīkāmaḥ' ityādāvapi na tasyāḥ nimittatvam, prāyaścittakaraṇe pratyayāntaraprasaṅgāt |
api tu pramāṇa- ntarasiddhakāmanājanitapratyayanāthāśrayatvameva iti tatrāpi iṣṭasādhanatvākṣepatvameva vidheḥ |
ata eva sarvatra naimittikasthale akaraṇe pratyayābhāvākṣepatve'pekṣā lāgha- vāt iṣṭasādhanatvameva vidhinā ākṣipyate iti tadśāt bhāvanāyāḥ iṣṭabhāvyatvasiddheḥ |
yathā caivaṃ sati naimi- ttikasthale pāpakṣayabhāvyakatvaṃ tathā yāvajjīvādhikaraṇe (2|4|1) nirūpitam |
tacca iṣṭaṃ svargaputrādi svarga- kāmādipadaiḥ samarpyate, yogyatvāt kāmaśabdayogācca |
kāmanā'pi svarasataḥ phale, dravye tu aupacārikī |

ata eva svargaśabdo'pi śrutismṛtipurāṇādivāt duḥkhā- saṃbhinnasukhabhogayogyadeśaviśeṣavācī ākṛtyadhikaraṇa- nyāyena (1|3|9) tādṛśasukhamātravācī vā, na tu candanādivācī, tatra hi ādhunikaprayogasya aupacā- rikatvāt |
ata eva svargakāmādipadamipi lakṣaṇayā svargaparaṃ prathamā ca karmatvaparā iti bhāvanāyopapatteḥ nānyopasarjanatvena svargasya tadananvayāśaṅkā |
svarga- kāmo vā adhikāritvena anvīyate iti svargādi- vācakadvitīyopadādhyāhāreṇa tadananvayaḥ iti kecit |
tatra, phalapekṣayāḥ prāthamikatvāt lakṣaṇāyāḥ adhyā- hārāpekṣayā laghvāt |
evaṃ ca balavattaravidhiśrutayā- nurodhena svargādereva bhāvyatvāvagateḥ sāmānyapravṛttā paddhatirupi yāgādeḥ karaṇatvameva lakṣaṇayā pratipādayati iti siddhaḥ |
atra ca uttaviṣecchaphalā- nyatarasamānādhikaraṇaṃ (pravṛttiyojakapravṛttiviṣayajanya- phalecchāphalānyatarasamānādhikaraṇaṃ) kartṛtvena adhikāraḥ iti bodhyam |
(nyāyasvarupaṃ) aphalasya kāmyasyāyogāt kāmaśabdopabandhe 'asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt' (6|1|1|2) iti svargakāmādhikaraṇa- siddhāntāyena paśukāmaśabdaḥ phalaparaḥ |
(nyāyasvarupaṃ) svatantrakarmavidhau kāmapadasya phalaparatvābhāve naiṣphalyatayā vidhānārthakyā- patteḥ, phalaparatve'pi jyotiṣṭomena phalatvopapatteḥ paśukāmaśabdo na paśugāphala pratipādayati |
pṛ. 415, svargakāmādhikaraṇe phalasya uddeśyatayā ukta- tvāt medehetutvaṃ saṃbhavati |
pṛ. 498. 'citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' iti prakṛtya ... na cāyaṃ dravyārja- nādyaśūkāpānāvādaḥ iti yuktam, tadanuvādatvasya
na ca bhāvādhikaraṇe dhātvarthasya karaṇatvamukta- miti vācyam |
uttāsyāpi tasya prāk svargakāmādhi- karaṇe (6|1|1) samānapadasthyā dhātvarthasya phalatvaṃ na tu svargāderityākṣipya sādhyaviṣayamāṇāt |
tataśca svargakāmādhikaraṇanyāyena bhāvyatvāt prayutyanantara- meva bhāvādhikaraṇapravṛttiḥ |
ku. 3|2|136. ('citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' iti) paśukāma- śabdo'pi svargakāmādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣanyāyena arjanā- jñatvāt anuvādā''dimataḥ, na yāgaphalam |
'na hi paśuyāgaḥ paśukāmyamānena anuṣṭhātuṃ śakyate, yāgānu- vādo vijñātatvāt |

yā. 1|4|3 pṛ. 328. svargakāmādihavyarthasya puruṣasya bhāvanākṣepa- labhyatvāt svargakāmādidravyasya lohitoṣṇīṣādivat viśeṣaṇaparatvāvagateḥ tadupāttasya svargādeḥ yāgaṃ prati guṇatvenānvayaḥ prādhānyena vā iti saṃdihya 'dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃbandhe guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhaḥ' (6|1|1|9) iti ṣaṣṭhādyasvargakāmādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣasūtre 'bhūtabhavyasamu- ccāraṇe bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyate' iti nyāyāt bhūtasya svargaśabdeḥ bhavyaṃ karma prati guṇatvena anvayasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt paśukāmaśabdāt paśoḥ sādhanatvāvagatiḥ |
su. pṛ. 415.. svargakāmādhikaraṇasiddhāntasūtraṃ 'asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt' (6|1|1|2) iti |
kāmaśabdopabandhasya phalatvāpratipādakatve karmaṃ tasādhakatvaśūnyaṃ syāt phalā- rthatvāt pravṛtteḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
'svargakāmo yajeta' ityatra vidhinā iṣṭasādhanatve bodhite bhāvanābhāvyasya rūpadvayamavagataṃ bhavati sādhyatvamicchāviṣayatvaṃ ceti |
bhāvyaṃ tu kāma- nayā arthākṣiptam, siddhe icchāvirahāt |
ataḥ kāmanāmullaṅghya svargadameva iṣṭaviśeṣā- kāṅkṣāpūrvakaṃ tatropatamatam |
yadyapi ca yāge sādhyatvamupa- sthitaṃ tathāpi tasya gauṇatayā mukhyatayā vā svargasādhana- tvānvayāt prāk iṣṭatvaṃ na siddhaṃ iti so'pi tatra bhāvyatvena nānneti |
3|4|1524 bra. sū. svargakāmaśabdasya brāhmaṇādiśabdavat puruṣa- viśeṣasamarpakatvaṃ ātmārthe yaḥ svargamicchati sa eva svargakāmaśabdārtho nānyaḥ |
soma. 6|1|1 pṛ. 445. svarganarakau ca niratiśayasukhaduḥkhātmakatvāt deśāntarajanmāntarā'nubhavanīyau na karmāntaraṃ saṃbhavataḥ (tataḥ apūrvameva vaktavyaṃ) iti pakṣāye vakṣyam |
na hi svarganarakau nāma niratiśayasukhaduḥkhasvabhāvau, deśa- viśeṣau vā yāvihaiva janmani nānubhūyetām |
naiva hyanyaphalaṃ karma sādhayetḥ phalānta- ram |
ślovā. citrakṣepaparihāre. svargaśabdaśca utkṛṣṭasukhe rūḍhaḥ candanādidravye tu lākṣaṇikaḥ |
10|2|121. svastyayanyāṃ iṣṭaṃ rakṣitavantau ājyabhāgau 'agre rakṣā jo ahaṃsaḥ 0 tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvataḥ 0' iti |
āśvadhau. 2|10|5. svastha citte yuttyaḥ saṃsphurantīti nyāyaḥ |
'cintā''krāntaṃ dhātuvṛddhaṃ śarīraṃ naṣṭe citte dhātavo yānti nāśam |
tasmāccittaṃ sarvato rakṣaṇīyaṃ svasthe citte vṛttayaḥ saṃsphuranti |
adhīyata iti karmavyutpattyā śāstrā- vāci-adhyāyaśabdabhyupagamena svaśāsau adhyāyaśca
iti vigrahaśravaṇāt svādhyāyavidhita eva praticaraṇaṃ śāstrādyavasthāsiddhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 991. svādhyāyau- 'dhyetavyaḥ ' ayaṃ vidhau śrautaḥ |
ataśca adhyayanamātreṇa svarga- phalaniṣpatteḥ na dharmajijñāsārtha gurukule'vasthātavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
vidhiḥ akṣarādigrahaṇaparyantapaṭhyamāna- vākyārthajñānāthaṃ adhyayanaṃ vidhatte, tasya ca vicāramanta- reṇāsaṃbhavāt dharmajijñāsārthaṃ gurukule avasthātavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
111 | 119. svādhyāyau'dhyetavyaḥ ' iti sakalasya tāvadvedasya adhyayanabhāvanā vidhīyate |
tatra kiṃ bhāva- yedityapekṣāyāṃ adhyayanamiti āgatamapi puruṣapravarta- nāśaktiyuktena vidhāvakenāpuruṣārthatayā bhāvanāyāṃ pravartanāśaktiprasakteḥ tadaśā nirākriyate |
tataśca adhya- yanenaiti avirodhāt saniṣedha karaṇe niviśate |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? aṅga- pradhānārtāni pūrveṇa nyāyena prāptam |
phalena tu saṃbandho bhaviṣyatītyeva- marthaḥ puruṣaḥ śrūyate |
yattasya saṃskārasya prayojanam, tatra sāmarthyaṃ janaya- nīti |
phalaṃ ca grahītuṃ puruṣasya prayojanam, na yāga- mabhinivartayitum |
tasmāt ye puruṣasaṃskārāḥ, te puruṣaṃ phalapratigrahaṇasamarthaṃ kurvanti, na yāganirvṛttisamartham |
yadi yāganirvṛttau na sāmarthyaṃ janayanti, kathaṃ tarhi yāgadharmāste bhavanti |
kaśca tasya svārthaḥ ? yasya kartā phalena saṃbadhyate |
' (3|8|4|4) ityenādhikaraṇena yeṣāṃ yājamānatvaṃ siddham, te kiṃ yajamānasya kartṛtvāṃśena aṅgapradhānārthāḥ, uta bhoktṛtvāṃśena kevalapradhānārthāḥ |
sarvārthe hi yajamāne avasthitāḥ śaknuvanti sarveṣāmupakartum |
' yadi hyete kartṛtvāṃśapātino bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ sarvārthatvaṃ pratipadyeran |
kartṛttvaṃ tu tadabhāve'pi yathā bhavati tathā sarvaloka- pratyakṣam |
ṛtvijāmapi ca tatsaṃbhavāt naiva tebhyo nivṛttiḥ syāt |
abhīṣṭe cāyaṃ yogyatā''dhānamā- kāṅkṣati, yatra ca yogyatvamanupajātam |
yogyatāṃ ca ādadhānāḥ kriyāḥ saṃskārā ityucyante |
yasya ca karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ yajamānena bhujyate, tadeśāḥ tasyaivopakartuṃ śaknuvanti nānyasya |
pradhānasya phalaṃ puruṣairbhujyate nājñā- nām, kratvarthatvāt |
yadi kronirvartakāṃśe na patanti, tat (tadā) phalasyaiva aṅgaṃ prāpnuvanti |
eṣa eva hi pradhānasyopakāraḥ, yadasya phalagrahaṇāya yogyaḥ kartā kriyate |
tataśca yathaiva anyāni adṛṣṭārthāni aṅgāni phalayogyatāmapi kurvanti (śatrantāmidam) nājñatvāt prayacchante, tathaiva ete'pi (yājamānāḥ saṃskārāḥ) draṣṭavyāḥ |
prayojanaṃ agnīṣomīyādivikāreṣu gamanaṃ vapanā- dīnāṃ aṅgamanaṃ siddhānte |
śā- saṃskārāḥ vapanādayaḥ aṅgapradhānārthāḥ syuḥ, , iti prāpte'bhidhīyate |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe agnīṣomīyapaśuvikāre nirūḍhapaśubandhau teṣāṃ pravṛttiḥ, siddhānte tu neti |
sūtrārthastu- svāmisaṃyuktaṃ vapanayogātrādikaṃ pradhānasya dharmaḥ : phalasaṃyogāt phala- bhāvatvarūpabhoktṛttvasaṃyogāt iti |
vinā'pi saṃskṛtiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kartṛtvaṃ tatra nāsti saḥ |
' saḥ vapanādi- kṛtaḥ upakāraḥ tatra kartṛtvākāre nāsti |

bhāṭṭa- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ jyotiṣṭomādau ca keśa- śmaśruvapanādayastāvat kratuktpuruṣasaṃskārārthāḥ, na tu ārādupakārakāḥ 'keśaśmaśru vapate' 'nakhāni nikṛntate' 'dato dhāvate', 'snāti' 'āṅkte' 'abhyaṅkte' ityādau ātmanepadanirdeśena puruṣārthatvāt |
ārādupakāra- katve tu tatphalasya kratusādguṇyasya kratutvena na ārambha- gāmitalam |

yadyapi krutīaṅgajuṣāḥ parasyaiveha, tathāpi chandasyātmane- padadarśanāt, tathāpi ca sārthakatve saṃbhavati sādhutvā- rthatvasya anyāvyatvāt, 'svarita' ityādidhaireva aniyatatvaṃ parikalpya ātmagāmikriyāphalatvasvīkāro na doṣāya |
evaṃ 'dato dhāvate' ityādī dantānāṃ dvitīyayā'pi saṃskāryatvāvagamaḥ |
antato yatra na kiṃciddamakam, tatra dīkṣāmātrādeva tathā, yamādiparigrahānukūlapuruṣa- saṃskārāvācitvāt |
puruṣasya ca kratūpayogitvaṃ kartṛtayā, kratujanyaphalabhoktṛttvayā vā |
tadiha saṃskārāḥ kiṃ kartṛ- tvāṃśopayoginaḥ, uta bhoktṛtvāṃśopayoginaḥ : iti cintā- yām, bhoktṛttvārthatve samaprādhānyāpatteḥ prakaraṇāvagatakratu- saṃbandhabādhāpattiḥ, ataḥ kartṛtvāt |
dantadhāvanādīnāṃ śarīrasaṃskārārthatvāt, tasya ca paralokabhogaphalabhoktṛtve anupayogadāpi tathātvam |
iti prāpte, kartṛtvasya śarī- rādideva saṃskāravyatirekeṇāpi jāyamānatvāt yathyathāt adṛṣṭarūpabhoktṛttvārthameva yuktam |
na ca evaṃ prādhānyāpattiḥ, kṣetrasaṃskārāṇāṃ bījāvapanārtha- tyasyaiva ātmasaṃskārāṇāmapi kratujanyaphalādhānayogyatā- jananāthānāṃ kratvaṅgatvopapatteḥ |
ata eva sarvaireva saṃskāraiḥ svasvāvāntarādṛṣṭadvārā samuccitya sā janyate |
pradhānaphalameva vā ātmanyupācyate iti tadarthā eva saṃskārāḥ, na aṅgārthāḥ; tatphalasya kratugāmitvāt |

yatra tu dṛṣṭavidhayā vacanādeva vā kartṛttvopayogitvam, yathā prāthamikaśuddhayarthānānācanādau, 'hiraṇyamālinaḥ pracaranti' ityādī ca, bahutvavacanāt tatra kartṛtve evopa- yogādaṅgapradhānārthatvam |
ata eva tādṛśasthale aṅga- vikṛtiṣu tasya atideśaḥ |
tatra mī. pṛ. 1250 'ṛtvijaḥ svāmi- sadasaḥ jyotiṣṭome |
tatra kimeṣāṃ sadasyaḥ sadasaḥ uta gṛhapatiḥ iti vicāre karmakara- tvāt camasasya varaṇasya ca satvāt sadasyaḥ sadasaḥ iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntasūtram |
uktāḥ- sasa- daśa ṛtvijaḥ svāmisadaśāḥ syuḥ |
svāmī samasta- samadaśasaṃkhyāpūraṇaḥ yeṣāṃ te tathā |
yat camaso varaṇaṃ ca tat brahmaṇa eva na pṛthak |
vārtikakārastu sadasyaṃ brahmaṇo bhinnaṃ manyate, tathāpi sadasatvaṃ svāmina iti tasyāpi matam |
tadu- ktistu - 'yat sadasyo'pi pratyavekṣaṇāt yajanīti, vacanasāmarthyādevā'sau kriyate, na tu kaścit padārthaḥ tadīyena nyāyena vyapadeśaḥ syāt |
na ca pratyekaśaṃ nāma kaścit padārthaḥ, yenāsya kartṛttvadoṣaḥ kenacit pramāṇena niyamyeta |
tasmāt satyeva sadasye sūktaṃ svāmisamadaśā iti' |
atra kutūhalam- śāstrāntare tu dīkṣādakṣiṇāvākyeṣu sadasyasadasaḥ ṛtvijo'nukrāntāḥ |
'camaseṣu samā- khyānāt' (3|1|7|22) ityatra bhāṣye eva 'praitu hotṛcamasaḥ, pra brahmaṇaḥ, prodgātṛṇāṃ, pra yajamānasya, prayantu sadasyānām' iti praiṣa āmnātaḥ |
tataśca sadasya- camasīyo yajñabhyāsaḥ bhakṣaṇaṃ ca tasya astyeva |
svāmisamadaśāḥ karmasāmānyāt' (3|7|18 38) iti yajamānasyāpi brahmādivat ṛtviktvaṃ

' (3|1|18|8 ) satre ' ye yajamānāsta ṛtvija: ' atra na tāvat yajamānānāṃ ṛtvijanakartṛtvarūpakatvamādāya dvayo: prathamāntayo: sāmānādhikaraṇyena anvaya: 'svāmisata- daśā: 0 ' iti nyāyena prāptatayā vākyavaiyarthyāpatte: |
svāmisthale satre pratinidhitvasya svāmidharmavat vapanādi- saṃskārā bhavanti |
6|3|1|26. mīko. pṛ. 4109 'satre svāmisthale pratinidhitvasya svāmidharmatvaṃ bhavati' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vi. 10|2|7. svāhākāreṇa vaṣaṭ- kāreṇa vā devebhyo'nnaṃ pradīyate |
svāhākāreṇa vaṣaṭkāreṇa vā devebhyo haviḥ pradīyate |
bhā. 8|4|17, svāhākāreṇa saṃyuktā darvhomāḥ 'pṛthivye svāhā, antarikṣāya svāhā' iti |
8|4|121. svāhākāraṇā pura- stāt śrayamāṇānāṃ 'svāhā vāce, svāhā vānaspataye' ityādī na homārthatā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
vāgādīnāṃ caturthya- ntatvena devatātvāvagamāt kāpi sthitasya arthaprakāśa- katvānapāyāt pradānārthataiva iti siddhāntaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|17, svāhākāraṇā pradānārthatvaṃ 'pṛthivye svāhā' 'antarikṣāya svāhā' ityādī |
svāhākāradimantreṇa- āvāhanamantreṇa devatā- smaraṇe'pi svāhākāradimantreṇa dādhārthya punaḥ smaraṇam |
10|8|120- 22. mīko. pṛ. 2015 darvhomeṣu kacit svāhā- kārapunaḥśravaṇasya ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|17. 'home purastātsvāhākārā api mantraḥ karaṇam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
sviṣṭakṛt agniḥ āhavanīyādanya eva na tu āhavanīya eva |
saṃkarṣa. 4|2|9-10, sviṣṭakṛdagniḥ udyamāno (vahū) na homārthe kiṃtu havyaprāpaṇārtham |
saṃkarṣa. 4|2|10. mīko. pṛ. 19 'agniḥ sviṣṭakṛt gārha- patyādhiṣṭhātā' |
sviṣṭa- kṛt aniyāśepeḥ tribhirbharaiḥ kartavyaḥ amīpomīye paśo |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ tṛtīyo'nuyājaḥ ārādupakārakaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tadartha- māha- anuyāje tṛtīyānuyājantre yaḥ sviṣṭakṛdagniḥ pacyate sa āvāpikaḥ syāt na āvāpagrāhaḥ |
anuyāje āvāpikasviṣṭakṛtkarma prayojanavat dṛṣṭaphalakaṃ pradhānāmeḥ- saraṇadvārā saṃskārarūpaphalavat |
ajñānāṃ ārādupa- kārakāṇāṃ prakaraṇe kratūpakārakakṣaṇaprayojanena saṃyogān saṃnipātānāṃ tu śruyādinā saṃskārārthena arthena saṃyogān saṃbandhāt |
tasmāt anuyāje sviṣṭakṛtpaṭhanaṃ āvāpikāyaiḥ saṃskārakarma iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhā. 3|5| 4|17. sviṣṭakṛt ekadevatāke paśugaṇe tantreṇa yathā prājāpatyapaśuṣu |
māsādo, tena devatāmāhaṣṭaṃ kriyate na devatāyāḥ saṃskāraḥ |
saumike avabhṛthe 'agnīvaruṇau sviṣṭakṛtau yajati' iti śrutam |
agnī- varuṇayośca kevalamidevatāyāḥ sakāśāt anyatvaṃ vyāsajyavṛttidevatātvakatvāt |
tasmāt agnīvaruṇayoḥ devatānyatve sati sviṣṭakṛt iti śabdaḥ tacchabdatvāt agnīvaruṇavācakatvāt nivartate |
agnīvaruṇayoḥ sviṣṭa- kṛt iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na deyamityarthaḥ |
tasmāt 'agnī- varuṇabhyāṃ sviṣṭakṛdmyāmanubrūhi' iti na vaktavyaṃ kintu 'agnivaruṇābhyāmanubrūhi' iti vaktavyaṃ ityādi |
saumike avabhṛthe 'agnīvaruṇau sviṣṭakṛtau yajati' iti śrutam |
tatra sviṣṭakṛcchabdaṃ kartavyaṃ iti pūrva- pakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena vyāvarttayan siddhāntamāha |
'agnīvaruṇābhyāṃ sviṣṭakṛdbhyāmanubrūhi' ityādi sviṣṭa- kṛcchabdakaṃ kartavyaṃ ityarthaḥ |
arthāpatteḥ amarethaṃ agnī- varuṇayoḥ āpatteḥ prāpteḥ |
prakṛtau yatra agniḥ sviṣṭakṛt tatra sthāne avabhṛthe agnīvaruṇau prāptau, tasmāt sviṣṭa- kṛcchabdavanto kartavyau |
abhidhānasya karmajatvāt sviṣṭa- kṛt iti abhidhānasya 'sviṣṭaṃ kṛtavān sviṣṭakṛt' iti sviṣṭakaraṇanimittakatvā
agnīṣomīyapaśupuroḍāśasya guṇalopaḥ śrūyate 'agniṃ yajati' iti, tatra sarveṣu sviṣṭakṛnnigameṣu guṇalopaḥ kartavyaḥ na yāga eva |
gṛhamedhīye 'agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati' iti sviṣṭakṛ- ti śrūyamāṇe bhakṣapratiṣedhaḥ bhakṣaṇāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
anyeṣāṃ śeṣabhakṣāṇāṃ bhakṣya ca parisaṃkhyā syāt |
sviṣṭakṛto bhakṣāṇāṃ ca tulyakāraṇatvāt śeṣasaṃskārārtha- tvasya kāraṇasya tulyatvāt |
tasmāt sviṣṭakṛt itareṣāṃ śeṣakāryāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyāpaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
śeṣabhakṣāṇāṃ aprati- ṣedhaḥ na pratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
'iḍā- mupahvāti' iti vacanaṃ sati bhakṣaṇe yujyate nāsti |
iḍāyāṃ tu vidhipūrvasya darśanāt na doṣaḥ |
prathamaṃ codakaśāstreṇa haviḥśeṣaprati- pattisāmānyātpratītiḥ, tataḥ sviṣṭakṛdbhinnā parisaṃkhyā svātiriktanirvṛttī punarādivāciḥ abhyanujñāpaḥ, netara- prāpakaḥ iti bhāvaḥ |
tasmāt sviṣṭakṛt itareṣāṃ pari- saṃkhyāpakaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

ke. 'sviṣṭakṛt bhakṣapratiṣedhaḥ syāt' ityadhikaṇe (10|7|11) gṛhamedhīye parisaṃkhyāpake 'ājyabhāgau yajati' ityasya avadhāraṇārthalakṣakasya ājyabhāga- sajātīyasya yāgāntarasyavacchedekatvam, sviṣṭakṛdbhinnāsya ca avadhāraṇārthalakṣakasya śeṣakāryāntaravyavacchedakatvaṃ darśitam |
sviṣṭakṛt yathā aṃśabhedaḥ tathā prayājaśeṣe nāśabhedaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- sto darśapūrṇamāsau, tatra śeṣakāryāṇi aiḍaprāśitravauṣadhakṛtādīni |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ haviṣo haviḥ kartavyāni, utaikasmādaviṣa iti |
yadi śeṣakāryaiḥ prayuktāni, bhaveyuḥ sarvāṇi prayuktānīti sarvebhyaḥ kriyeran |
vā-- yadā''havanīye prakṣepeṇa, akṣapito haviḥ- śeṣaḥ pratipāditastadā śeṣakāryāṇi sviṣṭakṛdādīni kathaṃ kriyantāmiti vicāryate |

(‘yadi śeṣakāryaiḥ’ ityādi bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyāte ‘satyapi’ ityādinā ) satyapyekametve yadi tadarthamevaitāni dravyāṇyutpannāni bhaveyustataḥ sarveṣāṃ saṃbhāvanāya paśavadadānāmivāvaikasmādapi sidhyati ( śeṣa- kāryamiti śeṣaḥ :) yāge sarveṣāṃ saṃbandhaḥ kriyeta |
bhāṣyam-- sakṛcca evaṃjātīyakena śeṣakāryeṇa saṃskṛtaṃ pradhānamiti kṛtvā nāparasmādapi kartavyamiti |
vā--yaśca pradhānāmevāhaḥ saṃskāraḥ sa eka- dravyaniṣṭhādiḥ śeṣakāryaiḥ sthitistati na dravyāntara- mapekṣate |
itarathā tu sarvādānāde'pi tantreṇa prayogātkṛtsnopa- patteravakalpyate syāt |
athavā tataḥ śeṣakāryāṇi sarvebhyaḥ kriyeran yadi saṃskārakāṇi bhaveyurna cetāni saṃskārakāṇi |
yāvadyatkṛtaprayojanaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tāvatsaṃskāramapekṣate pradhānanivṛttyuttarakālaṃ tu kṛtaṃ saṃskārairiti saṃskārāṇā- manavasaraḥ |
sarvebhyo vā kāraṇāviśeṣāt saṃskārasya tadartha- tvāt |
bhāṣyam-- sarvebhyo vā havirmyaḥ śeṣakāryāṇi kartavyāni |
yasyaiva na pratipādyate tasya tena saṃskāreṇa varjanaṃ syāt |
yadyapi caitābhi- dravyāṇi na prayojyante tathāpi dravyaireva tāsāṃ prayuktatvasarvaviṣayatā |
nivṛtte'pi ca pradhāne tadīyānāṃ satāmeṣāṃ kā pratipattirbhavatvityapekṣite śakyaḥ pratipatti- niyamo vidhātum |

bhāṣyam-- liṅgaṃ ca dṛśyate ‘devā vai sviṣṭakṛta- manuvan havyaṃ no vahati, so'bravīdvaraṃ vṛṇe bhāgo me'stviti, vṛṇīṣveti te'bruvan, ṣoḍaśavīttucarādyaṃ deva mahaṃ sakrasviṣṭakṛdavadyāt’ iti vīpsādarśanam |
vā-- ‘sakṛtsakṛt’ iti sviṣṭakṛdavadānavīpsā sarvebhyo'vadāne saṃskārapakṣe vā'vakalpate nānyathā |

( evaṃ tāvadyathābhāṣyamadhikaraṇaparatayā sūtrāṇi vyākhyāya tatra caitādṛśaviṣaye pratipattirbhavasva caturthī- dhyāyaditīyapāda eva vyavasthāpyamānatā paunaruktyā- patterapiritobhāṣyaṃ tāvatpūrvādhikaraṇaprayojanakathanārthatayā sūtrāṇi vyākaroti-prayojanatvenādi ) |
yadi nāma śeṣakāryaśeṣaṃ pūrvapakṣe'pyasyaivapradānaṃ kiṃ bhavati tadā vicārasya prayojanamiti |
tatra yaḥ pūrvama- smābhirabhihito'thaistatraivaṃ sūtraṃ yojyam |
balāccāpa- hāraḥ pradhānamebhyaḥ, sakṛtkṛte samastaḥ kṛta iti saṃskṛta- tvātsvānyato'pi kartavyaḥ |
śā-- sati śeṣe śeṣakāryāṇi sviṣṭakṛdādīni kiṃ ekasmāddhaviḥ kāryāṇi uta sarvebhyaḥ iti vicāraḥ |
tatra ekasmādeva śeṣāt sviṣṭakṛt iti śāstrārthasya kṛtatvāt ekasmādeva kāryāṇi na sarvebhyaḥ |
śeṣasya tu ākīrṇakasya apekṣitapratipatteḥ pratipattiniyamo'yaṃ vidhīyate |
sa yasyaiva na kriyate tasyaiva pratipattiniyamalopāt vaiguṇyaṃ syāt |
sūtrārthastu-- ekasmādeva śeṣakāryāṇi kriyeran śeṣasya śeṣakāryaṃ prati guṇabhūtatvāt tatraprayojakatvābhāvāditi |
’ bhāṭṭa-- atra bhāṣyakāreṇa śeṣakāryāṇāṃ arthame- tvāt ekasmādeva haviḥ śeṣakāryāṇi kartavyāni iti pūrvapakṣayitvā pratipattitvaṃ prasādhya sarvebhya iti siddhā- ntitam |
tat caturtha eva tādṛgviṣaye pratipattisya sādhyaviṣyamāṇatvāt punaruktatvāpatteḥ : pūrvādhikaraṇaprayo- janakathanārthāni etāni sūtrāṇi iti vārttikakāro vyācaṣṭe |
yadi pūrvādhikaraṇe śeṣakāryāṇāṃ havistarā- kṣepaṃ pūrvapakṣe tadā spaṣṭameva prayojanam |

yadā tu śeṣakāryānurodhena śeṣasthāpanaṃ tadā teṣāṃ paraprayuktadravyopa- jīvitvena aprayojakatve'pi arthakatvena tṛtīyāpa- kapālavattve'pi śeṣasya guṇabhūtatvāt guṇānurodhena pradhānānte- ranyāyatvātpadeyaviśeṣatvena tadantasaṃsthayā vivakṣita- tvācca ekasmādeva karaṇaṃ śeṣakāryāṇām |
(taisaṃ. 2|6|6) iti viśeṣaśravaṇaṃ tu 'caturthe. caturthe'nyahīnasya' itivat prayogāntaraviṣayam |
siddhānte tu vidyamānaśeṣatvāt cāturthikanyāyena prati- pattisambhavāt avikṣitasaṃkhyopasaṃhārakāryyanurodhena sarvaibhyaḥ karaṇam |
sviṣṭakṛdavadānaṃ āgneyapuroḍāśasya pūrvaṃ karttavyaṃ tataḥ sānāyyasya, pravṛttikramānusāreṇaiva balīyastvāt |
10|1|2|134. mī. pṛ. 1603 'gṛhamedhīye yāvaduktaṃ karttavyam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
sviṣṭakṛddhomaḥ sarveṣāṃ haviṣā śeṣebhyaḥ kartavyaḥ na tu kasyacidanyatarasya śeṣāt |
3|4|19, sviṣṭa- kṛddhome amīṣomīyapaśupuroḍāśīye 'agniṃ yajati' iti kevalamabhiprādāt sviṣṭakṛcchabdo vilopanīyaḥ; kevalo'gmiśabda eva vaktavyaḥ |
6|7|8-13. mīko. pṛ. 3687 'viśvajiti dakṣiṇārthanirdiṣṭo' ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
6|7|145. mīko. pṛ. 3689 'viśvajiti vidyamāna- syaiva sarvasya dānam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
tathāhi- 'ibhaturagaśataiḥ prayānti mūḍhā guṇavanto vibudhāśalanti padyayām |
giriśikharagatā'pi kāka- paṅktiḥ pulinagataireva sameti rājahaṃsaiḥ ||
'anumānajñānaṃ tāvat vyāptipakṣadharmāparāmarśa- vaśāt liṅgavalena upajāyamānaṃ haṃsakṣīranyāyena vyāpa- kaviśeṣaviṣayameva upajāyate |
kṣīre nīramiśmite'pi haṃsaḥ kṣīremeva tatrāya gṛhṇāti na nīram |
tadvat sadasanmiśrite vyavahāre santamaiva gṛhṇāti nāsantamiti |
tathathā- 'kastvaṃ lohitalocanāsyacaraṇo haṃsaḥ kuto mānasāt iti suvarṇapaṅkajavanaṃ nīraṃ sadā nirmalam |
ratnānāṃ nicayāḥ suvarṇalatikā vaidūryarohāḥ kacinmaṇḍakā api tatra santi na, bakairākarṇya hīhīkṛtam ||
yadā- 'haṃsaḥ śvetaḥ vakaḥ śvetaḥ ko bhedo bakahaṃsayoḥ |
kṣīra- nīrapṛthakkāre haṃso haṃso vako bakaḥ ||
tat utsāryamāṇamapi svacchadataḥ punaḥ punarudakaṃ chādayati |
evaṃ yo'nyo'pi svacchandavyavahāraḥ sa haṭha iti prasiddhaḥ |
bhāṣyam- darśapūrṇamāsau prati samāmananti 'prokṣitābhyāmulkhalamusalābhyāmahanti' 'prokṣitābhyāṃ haṣadu palabhyāṃ pinaṣṭi' iti |
tatrāyamarthaḥ sāṃkhyāyikaḥ: kiṃ prokṣaṇaṃ hantipiṣyapṛktam, uta apūrvaprayuktamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? saṃskāre hantipiṣye prayudhyamānasya prokṣaṇasya tatprayuktā syāt saṃskāraprayuktā |
yat hi yena kartavyaṃ bhavati, tat tasya prayojakam |
yadi apūrvamena kriyate, tataḥ asyāpūrva prayojakam, yadi hantipiṣyau, tatastau prayojakau |
prakaraṇācca apūrve kartavyaṃ gamyate, vākyāt hantipiṣyau, vākyaṃ ca prakaraṇāt balīya iti |
nanu hantipiṣyauḥ kriyamāṇa- pūrvāthe bhaviṣyati, tatra prakaraṇaṃ ca vākyaṃ ca ubhayamapi anugrahīṣyate |
na prakaraṇasāmānyāmātreṇa prakaraṇavataḥ arthena samāmnātamidaṃ gamyate |
prakaraṇasāmānnāt prakṛtena ekavākyatā bhavati, tataḥ tādarthyamavagamyate |
iha tu pratyakṣābhyāṃ hantipibhyāṃ prokṣaṇasya ekavākyatā |
na ca dvābhyāmapi saha ekavākyatā syāt |
yadā ekena ekavākyatā, tadā tena nirākāṅkṣasya nānyenāpi ekavākyatā kalpyate |
nanu hantipiṣyau apū- vārthau, tadarthe prokṣaṇam |
kiṃcidapūrvasya etadaṅgaṃ viśiṣṭamityanena kāraṇena aṅgena saṃśravyate, kiṃcit anapekṣyaiva apūrvatvaṃ svarūpeṇaiva kāraṇatvena saṃbadhyate |
yadapūrvasaṃbandhaṃ kāraṇatvena upādāya dharmajātamanyaviśeṣeṇa saṃbadhyate, tadapūrvaprayuktaṃ bhavati |
tādṛśaṃ ca vikṛtau arthāntare tatkāryāpanne, ūhitavyaṃ bhavati |
yatra punaḥ svarūpamaṅgasya dharmasaṃbandhe kāraṇaṃ bhavati, tat svarūpaprayuktam |
tatra yadyapi tena dharmavatā apūrvaṃ sādhyate |
tatra sādhyamānatve na dharmasya prayogahetubhūtaṃ bhavati, na taprayogajam, tasya svarūpaṃ vidyate iti na dharmeḥ prayujyate |
yadi vākyama- pūrvasya kāraṇatāṃ vadati, tataḥ apūrvaprayuktam |
yatrayatra hantipiṣī prayujyeta, tatrā- tatra evaṃdharmako bhavataḥ iti |
dup- nanu adhastāt apūrvāthā dharmā iti sthite hantipiṣiprayuktaṃ prokṣaṇa iti (pūrva-) pakṣasya anuṣṭhāna- meva |
satyam, kintu śrutiliṅgāvākyaiḥ saṃyuktāḥ ( saṃnipātinaḥ ) te apūrvāthāṃ na saṃbhavanti iti manya- mānaḥ pūrvapakṣaṃ karoti tribhiradhikaraṇaiḥ : ( vākyaliṅga- śrutibhiḥ iti yuktameva) |
atra codyate kiṃ ulkhalamusala- prayuktaṃ prokṣaṇam, uta apūrvaprayuktamiti saṃśayo yuktaḥ, na tu hantipiṣiprayuktamiti |
tasmāt yathā 'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti (atra ) vrīhyartha ( prokṣaṇam ) evami- hāpi niṣṭhāśravaṇāt ulkhalamusalābhyāmeva prokṣaṇam ( na hantavyam ) |
( tatra hi ) prokṣati iti bhāvanā vidyate, tasyāśca bhāvyena bhavitavyam |

tatra kaścit kriyamāṇatayā bhāvyaḥ (yathā avaghātabhāvanāyāḥ vrīhayaḥ), kaścit saṃskāratvena (yathā vrīhayaḥ prokṣaṇabhāvanāyāḥ), kaścit utpādyatvena (yathā saṃyavanabhāvanāyāḥ puroḍāśaḥ), kaścit prāpyatvena (yathā 'gāṃ payo dogdhi' ityatra go-dohanabhāvanāyāḥ payaḥ ) |
'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti ( bhāvyavāci- ) dvitīyāyogāt vrīhayo bhāvyāḥ |
( prakṛte āha- ) niṣṭhā'nte punaḥ nāsti bhāvanā |

( nanu dvitīyā karmatvavācinyā bhāvyamucyeta, tatrāha- ) satyapi karmatve prokṣaṇaṃ ulkhalamusalābhyamiti kenoktam ? ( dvitīyeti cet, tatrāha- ) dvitīyā- caturthyāṃ satyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ ( ekabhāvanā''pāditasaṃbandhā ) ātmāthīṃ kriyāṃ ( ghātyartha ) kurutaḥ |
tṛtīyā''dyasya satyameva bhāvanāyāṃ ( taddvāreṇa ) ātmāthīṃ kriyāṃ tathaiva kurvanti |
athavā dvitīyā udbhūtaśaktiṃ karma pratipāda- yati, niṣṭhā ( tu ) nyagbhūtam |
kathaṃ jñāyate ? ( ataḥ ) āha, ulkhalamusale atra karmabhūte |
te ca kārake kārakāntareṇa sayujyamāne dṛśyate 'ulkhala- musalābhyām' iti |
na ca dvitīyā''ntaṃ kārakaṃ kārakāntareṇa saṃyujyate, udbhūtaśaktitvāt |
tasmāt yat udbhūtaśakti kārakam, tat kriyā vaśīkaroti, na tu anudbhūtaśakti, anudbhūtaśaktitvāt |
api caivaṃ ulkhalamusalayoḥ prokṣaṇasya ca saṃbandhārthe hantiruccā- yate, tatra atyantaṃ vākyaṃ syāt |
tasmāt hantavyam, ( prokṣaṇam, nolkhalamusalādyartha iti vicāraḥ |
idānīṃ ulkhalamusalādyarthevāparityāgenaiva ayaṃ vicāraḥ, na tadapyanena ityāha- ) athavā vākyāntareṇa 'karaṇa- tayā prāpte ulkhalamusale arthāte vā anūya upa-
atra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, vākyāt hantipiṣyarthaṃ prokṣaṇam, prakaraṇāt apūrvārtham |
tena tvarthena yajñasya saṃyogān dharmasaṃbhava- stasmād yajñaprayuktaṃ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt |
tena tvarthena hantinā piṣitā vā yasmādapūrvasya saṃyogaḥ, tasmāttasya prokṣaṇasaṃbandhaḥ |
apūrvasādhanaviśeṣakāritaḥ prokṣaṇasaṃkā- reṇa saṃbandho na hantipiṣyādhikāritaḥ |
yadi tatprayuktaṃ prokṣaṇam, tadapi niṣprayoja- nam |
na prokṣa- ṇasya apūrvasya kaścidasti saṃbandhaḥ |
yadi prokṣaṇaṃ na kriyate, na hantipiṣī apūrvasya sādhanabhāvaṃ na gacchataḥ |
tasmāt yadyapi hantipiṣī apūrvasyopa- kārakī, tathāpi tābhyāṃ saṃbadhyamāne prokṣaṇamanarthakameva |
athocyate, yadarthaṃ hantipiṣī upādīyete tat prokṣaṇa- saṃbaddhau śaknutaḥ kartum, nānyatheti |
katham ? prokṣitābhyāmeva hanti, prokṣi- tābhyāṃ pinaṣṭi iti yat hantipiṣyāṃ kriyate, tat prokṣaṇasaṃbaddhābhyāmiti hantipiṣyāṃ saṃbadhyate, na tābhyāmiti |
yadi yat hanti- piṣyābhyāṃ kriyate, tat prokṣaṇena abhisaṃbadhyate, saṃbandha eva prokṣaṇasya na syāt |
atha prokṣitābhyā- mapūrvaṃ kriyate iti saṃbandhaḥ, na tarhi hantinā piṣitā vā |
atha tatsaṃbandho'pi ucyate iti; anekasaṃbandhe vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
tasmāt hantipiṣyāṃ prokṣaṇa saṃbandha- mānaṃ prajāpanirmiti prakaraṇātpūrveṇa saṃbadhyate |
katham ? iha avaghātaṃ prati yatamānasya dvayaṃ niṣpadyate, avahantirūpaṃ, taṇḍulanirvṛttiśca |
yadyapi avahantirūpeṇa saṃbadhyamāne prokṣaṇe śrutyā saṃbandho bhavati, tathāpi tatra niṣprayojanatvāt lakṣaṇaiva āśrayate |
na ca avahantiḥ ārādupakārakaḥ apūrva niṣpādayati |
dṛṣṭamupakāraṃ kurvan adṛṣṭena sāmarthyena samīcīnaṃ karotīti gamyate |
yadyapi ca niṣpādayet, tathāpi upakāreṇa asaṃndhyamānaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kevalavahanti- saṃbandhena anarthakameva syāt |
ṭup- atra kecit varṇayanti ( siddhāntam ), vākye parigṛhyamāṇe anarthakatvaṃ prokṣaṇasya āpadyeta |
tatra asaṃyuktaṃ padāntareṇa prokṣaṇaṃ apūrveṇa saṃbhantyate |
ato brīhidvāreṇa ( brīhipadaṃ ca 'vrīhīna prokṣati' ityetadapi ulūkhalamusalavākyatulyanyāyam, katham ? prokṣaṇamapūrveṇa gṛhyate, tacca prayājavat ārā- dupakārakaṃ prāpnoti |

api tu vidhyantaraprāptāvaghātānuvādena arthāt saṃbhavamasākṣikamapi ulūkhalamusalayoḥ pūrvapravṛtta- śrīkāreṇa prokṣaṇaviśiṣṭayorvidhī ādhikena viśeṣaṇa- vidhinā ulūkhalamusaloddeśena prokṣaṇavidhividhavyaḥ |
tataśca ulūkhalamusalatvena uddeśyatā apūrvasādhanatvena veti vicāraḥ kāryaḥ |
so'pi ca tadā bhavet, yadi sakalpaparoḍāśika- pātrāsādhāraṇyena prokṣaṇavidhinaṃ syāt |
na tvetadasti 'uttā- nāni pātrāṇi prokṣati' iti vidhyantareṇa tasya prāpta- tvāt |
nahi mīmāṃsakamate paroḍāśikapātraprokṣaṇābhāvaḥ ; kintu mantrābhāvaḥ ; mantrābhāvasyaiva paraṃ tṛtīye sādha- nāt |
ataḥ prakārāntareṇa prāptasyārthasya ayamanuvādaḥ abhyudayaśiraskatayā ulūkhalamusalavidhinārthaḥ |

ata evaṃ vicāro vācyaḥ - pātraprokṣaṇavidhinaiva ulūkhalamusalyorapi prokṣaṇaṃ prāptam, tacca pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyenaiva ulūkhalamusalaniṣṭhā- api tu yāgāṅgaparoḍāśaśaṅgīhitadavadhitvārikaiva prayo- jakatvāparaparyāyā |

tatra ca atiprasaṅgaparihārārthaṃ sādhanatā'vacchedakasyāpi yāgaḥpuroḍāśatvatrividhatvada- ghātatvāderapi vivakṣā, uta tadvāpārasādhanatāmātrasyaiva iti cintāyām, vyāpāravat vinigamanāvicchedena sādhanatā'vacchedakasyāpi vivakṣā, itarathā kugādau atiprasaṅgapatteḥ |
athavā sādhanatāyā avacchedakaṃ na nirūpayitumaśakyatvāt tadeva vivakṣitam, na tu vyāpāraḥ ; taṃ vinā'pi sādhanatāyāstvena nirūpayituṃ śakyatvāt |
evaṃ ca yadyapi śrutasya ulūkhalatvāderapūrva- sādhanatvalakṣaṇopayitatvāt upakṣīṇātvādiva syāt, tathāpi āntarālikānāṃ sādhanatā'vacchedakānāṃ yāgasva- prabhṛtīnāṃ vivakṣā durnirāvārya |

iti prāpte, apūrva- niṣṭakāryatānirūpitakāraṇatāyāmatiprasaṅgaparihārārthaṃ madhya- vartitayā jhaṭityupasthitavyāpārasyaiva vyāpārasattve vivakṣā, na tu sādhanatā'vacchedakasya, tasya kāraṇatāyāḥ paśvādya- sthiteḥ |
ata eva yatra madhye yāgādau na vyāpāraḥ ;
tatra kāranatāyā eva śṛṅgrāhikayā vivakṣaṇam, na tu tadavacchedakasya, gauravāt |
vi. 9|4|2. haraṇaṃ barhiṣaḥ 'bṛhaspaterharaṇāmi' iti mantreṇa kriyate |
vi. 9|1|21. haraṇe tu juhotiyogasāmānyād dravyāṇāṃ cārthaśeṣatvāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati' iti śrūyate |
atroktaṃ śālā- praharaṇa pratipattirvā arthakame vā iti saṃśaye pūrvapakṣa sūtreṇāha |
'saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati' iti prastarasya praharaṇe ukte sati śālāyā api juhotiḥ homa eva jñātavyaḥ |
yathā prastarapraharaṇa arthakame tathā śālāpraharaṇamapi arthakameva ityarthaḥ |
yogasāmānyāt prastarasyaiva śālāyā api praharaṇāparaparyāyahomena yogasya saṃbandhasya samānatvāt |
yadyapi śākhayā iti tṛtīyā, prastaraṃ iti dvitīyā tathāpi ubhayoḥ praharaṇe samāna eva saṃbandhaḥ |
śālāprastarādīnāṃ arthaśeṣatvaṃ yāgāṅgavat 'bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyate' iti nyāyāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati' iti śrutaṃ śālāpraharaṇaṃ arthakarma iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntamāha |
saha śākhayā praharati iti śabdasya tatpradhānatvāt śālāpraharaṇatvāt |
yadyapi śālāyā iti tṛtīyā, tathāpi tulyayoge iyam |
praharaṇe prastaraḥ pradhānam, śālā ca prastarasya guṇabhūtā tadā śālāprastarayostulyayogo na syāt |
tasmāt yaḥ prastare dvitīyārthaḥ sa śālāyāmapi |
darśa 'saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati' iti palāśa- śākhāyāḥ praharaṇaṃ pratipattiḥ iti siddhāntinā uktam |
pūrvasūtre ca 'prastareṇa śālāṃ' iti vibhaktyavyayena śālāyā dvitīyāntatvena prādhānyamuktam, tatra pūrvapakṣinaḥ śaṅkā |
'saktūn juhoti' iti arthe'pi śeṣatve'pi guṇabhāve'pi dvitīyā bhavet tathā ca dvitīyā'pi prādhānyaṃ na labhyate iti cet |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati' iti śrutam |
tatra śālāpraharaṇaṃ pratipattiḥ iti siddhā- ntinā uktam |
śālāṃ prastareṇa iti vibhaktyavyayena yuktā praśāsya śālāyāḥ dvitīyāntatvena prādhānyaṃ siddhāntinā uktam |
tatra 'saktūn juhoti' ityatra guṇabhāve'pi dvitīyā dṛṣṭatvāt śālāyāḥ dvitīyā- tve svīkṛte'pi guṇatvameva syāt na prādhānyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣiṇā 'arthe'pīti cet' iti śaṅkite siddhāntī uttarayati |
tasya saktādeḥ anadhikārāt anyatra viniyogābhāvāt karaṇatvena saktavo viniyoktavyā bhavanti iti dvitīyā- ntatve'pi teṣāṃ karaṇatvaṃ svīkartavyam |
śālāyāstu vatsāpākaraṇādirūpasya arthasya kṛtatvāt vihitatvāt na karaṇatvādi atra vaktavyam |
tasmāt upayuktatvāḥ śālāyāḥ praharaṇaṃ pratipattireva nārthakarma iti siddhāntaḥ |
haraṇamantraḥ barhiṣaḥ, ātithyāvarhiṣi saṃnahā- mībomīyadeśe nīyamāne pṛthak na prayojyaḥ |
lavana- deśāt saṃnahā haraṇe hi sa mantraḥ |
haraṇamantrasya āvṛttiḥ ātithyāvarhiṣi saṃnahā akṣībomīyadeśe saraṇārthamāhiyamāṇe |

haritapadasya sthāne raktapadasya maudre carau barhiḥstaraṇamantre ūhaḥ |
harivāsare pāraṇā niṣedhaḥ ācārakalpyaḥ prati- ṣedhaḥ |
uktaṃ ca śrīmadbhāgavate tṛtīyaskandhe navamādhyāye - 'nāmihadā- diha sato'mbhasi yasya puṃso vijñānaśaktirahamāsamana- śakteḥ |
rūpaṃ vicitramidamasya viṣṇupato me mā ririṣīṣṭa nigamasya girāṃ visargaḥ |

asya ślokasya ṭīkā - abhmasi sato yasya nāmihadādihāsam, vijñāne śaktiryasya mahatttvātmakasya cittasya tada- bhimānī, asya rūpamidaṃ vistārayato me nigamastha avayavabhūtānāṃ girāṃ visargaḥ uccāraṇaṃ mā ririṣīṣṭa 'halāntaṃ brahmavarcasam' iti nyāyena mā luppyatāmiti |
tadeva hi dravyaṃ ayātasaṃbaddhaṃ payaḥprabhṛti na loke haviḥśabdavācyaṃ bhavati |

havipaḥ kṛtsnanāśe doṣe vā ājyasya pratinidhirvam |

'yasya sarvāṇi havīṣi naśyeyuḥ duṣyeyuḥ apahareyurvā ājyena tā devatāḥ parisaṃkhyāya yajeran' iti |

haviratyādhikaraṇe ( 6|4|122-23 ) 'yasyobhayaṃ havirātaumāchait aindraṃ pañcaśarāvamodanaṃ nirvapet' iti ārtagamanasaṃbaddhasya haviṣaḥ nimittatvena uddeśyatvāt haviṣtvasya ca prakṛtāpūrvasādhanalakṣaṇatvena pratītimātropādhikatvāt grahavat avivakṣitaviśeṣatva- siddho api ubhayapadānārthakyāpatteḥ |
ubhayatvasya uddeśye antargatamabhyupagamena vivakṣāṃ pūrvapakṣatvā ādhikāriko- bhayatvābhyupagamena ubhayapadānarthakyaparihāraḥ vakṣyate |
'putraṃ hi svaḥ svargatī iti dvayorjayamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt'
ityatra 'dvayorjayamānayoḥ' iti yadi saptamī tadā sā nimittatvaparā |

yadyapi ca pṛthagvibhaktiśravaṇaṃ tathāpi haviratyādhikaraṇanyāyena pākṣikatvābhāve pratyekaṃ nimittatvāparvasānāta pradhānabhūtanimittānurodhena militayoreva dvitvāvacchinnajayamānatvāvacchinnayoḥ nimittatvaṃ pratipādyate |

'yasyobhayaṃ havirātaumāchait' ityatra yasya kasyacidātāṃ satyāṃ nidhiṣayakānimittakayāgasya aprāpteḥ haviḥśabdasya vivakṣā, tadiśeṣaṇībhūtobhayaśabdasya prāsānuvādakatvāt tadvidhāne vākyabhedāpatteḥ |
su. pṛ. 200-201. havirātanimittakaḥ pañcaśarāvayāgo darśasyā- jham |

kau. 3|1|14 pṛ. 185. havirgaṇe adhvarakalpayāṃ 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśa- kapālaṃ nirvapet, sārasvataṃ carum, bārhaspatyaṃ carum, agneya pāvakāya, agneye śucaye' ityatra śucidevatye āgneyasya vidhyantaḥ |
adhvarakalpayāṃ āgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ prathamaṃ haviḥ, agneye śucaye pañcamaṃ haviḥ |
tatra āgnāvaiṣṇavasya āgneyavidhvantaḥ śucidevatyasya ca agnīṣomīyavidhvantaḥ |
athavā ato viparītaṃ iti saṃśaye pūrvapakṣamāha |
havirgaṇe adhvara- kalpadau paraṃ antimaṃ śucidevataṃ uttarasya āgneyāduttarasya agnīṣomīyasya vikāraḥ syāt |
evaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvasya āgnā- vaiṣṇavaṃ āgneyasya vikāraḥ syāt |
prakṛtau āgneyaḥ prathamaḥ, atra āgnāvaiṣṇavaḥ prathamaḥ |
prakṛtau agnīṣomīyo dvitīyaḥ; iha śucidevato dvitīya iti |
tasmāt deśasāmānye liṅgena paramyuttarasya pūrvaṃ prathamasya vikāraḥ |
śabdavattvāt devatāvācakaśabdavattvāt āgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ agneye śucaye iti |
itarasya deśasya tu aśrutitvāt deśavācaka- śabdābhāvāt |
tasmāt śucidevatye āgneyasya vidhvantaḥ āgnāvaiṣṇave ca agnīṣomīyasya iti siddhāntaḥ |
(8|3|112) ityadhikaraṇe āgneyavaiṣṇave agnīṣomīyasya vidhyantaḥ iti sādhye devatāsāmānyāt iti heturlasaṃgataḥ syāt |
dvidevatyatvasya aindrāgne'pi tulyatvāt, evaṃ abhisama- vāyamātrasyāpi |
taddhitamātraṃ tu āgneye'pi tulyatvasya vā pañcākṣaradattitāntapadavattvaṃ ca amilatadattitāntapadavattvaṃ vā kiṃcit codanāliṅgāntaraṃ iha siddhāntahetutayā vivakṣitaṃ gamyate |

te yadi tāvat prātaḥsavane kriyante, paryabhi- karaṇāntaṃ kāṇḍaṃ notsuṣṭaṃ bhavati |
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti brahmasāmni kriyante, tathāpi viparyāsaḥ kuto bhavati |

sa yadi prātaḥsavane ucyate, aprāptakālatvāt padārthasyā- samarthaḥ syāt |
na ca prājāpatyeṣu tat preṣyatvaṃ yujyate |
śa— jyotiṣṭome anusavanaṃ savanīyāḥ puro- ḍāśāḥ |
teṣu codakaprāptaṃ haviṣkṛdāhvānaṃ tantraṃ uta pratisavanaṃ medena |

tathā vājapeye prājāpatyān ṛtu- paśūṃśca saha upakramya yadā prājāpatyān paryabhi kṛtvā utsṛjya brahmasāmni ālabheta, tadā kiṃ ṛtupasārambha- kāle prātaḥsavanakāle kṛta agnigorvā prājāpatyā- mapi tantram, uta prājāpatyatvena brahmasāmakāle puna- rātrivṛttavyaḥ |

tathā 'āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvamālabheta, saumyaṃ babhrum, āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvam' iti kṛṣṇagrīvayorbhedena pradāne kriyamāṇe avadāne ca kimanvākhyāteḥ manotā- mantrasya ca tantratvam, uta āvṛttiḥ, iti vicāre, sarvatra asaṃnipātitvāt prayogavacanānugrahāya tantratvam |
vākyāyāḥ manotāyāḥ manotāsūktasya ca kālabhedāt bhinnakālatvāt āvṛttiḥ syāt |
haviṣkṛcca agnigośca puro'nuvākyā ca manotā ca teṣāṃ samāhāraḥ iti dvandve napuṃsakatvam |
agnigoḥ mantrasya sakṛtkaraṇa- pakṣe viparyāsāt viparyāsaprasaṅgāt āvṛttireva |
agnigoḥ prāknānāṃ āśrutaprayāśrutādīnāṃ prātaḥsavane anuṣṭhāne paryabhikaraṇānte vihita utsargo bādhitaḥ syāt |
tṛtīya- savane karaṇe ca prājāpatyāgnigoḥ purastāt kartavyānāṃ para- stāt karaṇena kramalopaḥ syāt |
kariṣyat ucā- raṇavyāhṛtotcaraṇe anuṣṭhāpar vacanaṃ 'ārambhacaṃ' 'upanayata' iti śabdaḥ yasmin agnigo sa kariṣya- dvacanaḥ |
prātaḥsavane agnigo sakṛt kṛte bahukarmaṇā vyavahitameva mantrapratipāditasyārthasya anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt tataśca vacanasya bādhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt haviṣkṛdāhā- nāgnipreṣādīnāṃ āvṛttiḥ kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. haviṣkṛdāhānaṃ tātīyasavanikapuroḍāśeṣu saumyacaru-āśvinadvikapāle ca bhedena na kartavyam |
paśau tu saṃśrute vidhānāt tātīyasavanikeṣu saumyāśvinayoścāpacukatārthatvāt |
bhāṣyam— tātīyasavanikeṣu puroḍāśeṣu tu saumyā- śvinayośca medena haviṣkṛt syāt |
na kevalaṃ sā yajñāṅgāni sādha- yitum |
'kastavā yunakti sa tvā yunakti' ityevamādinā mantreṇa yathārthe yuktā |
soma— pūrvatra samākhyābalāt paśuprākaparyantaṃ anapavṛktatvāt pākāt pūrvamevādhiṣu prātaḥsavanīyamādhya- dinasavanīyeṣu prajñasabhe'pi iha nāsti prasaṅgaḥ |
sutārthastu- tātīyasavanikeṣu puroḍāśeṣu saumyāśvinayośca haviṣkṛt medena na syāt, pakve paśau teṣāṃ vihitatvena tasyāstadānīmapavṛktatvāt iti |
ci— 'asyāhutiścau saumye nāsti vā, paśu- pākṛtaḥ |

bhāṭṭa— kṛtvācintāyāmeva tātīyasavanikasavanīya- haviṣṣu saumyacarau āśvinadvikapāle ca savanīyapaśu- pākottaraṃ kriyamāṇe medena punarāhātavyā, haviṣkṛttamā- khyayā tasyā haviṣkaraṇamātraprayojanatvena pakve paśuprāke tasyā apavṛktatvāt |
iti prāpte, samākhyāyā upa- lakṣaṇatvāt sahāyakaraṇamātrārthe sā |
vastutastu upalakṣaṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt haviḥkaraṇārthatve'pi kṛte'pi patnīsaṃyājottaramutthānavidhānāt āpannī- saṃyājāntaṃ tasyā vihāradeśe sattvādyukta eva prasaṅgaḥ |

hāriyojanaṃ anyadeva pradhānam, tathā paridhayaḥ pañcaham, na tayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
atra satyāṣāḍhaḥ- prahṛteṣu paridhiṣu saṃvelābhimukha hāriyojane caranti |

taṃ sarve samaśaḥ prativibhajya uccetara upahvamiṣṭvā 'iṣayajjuṣaste deva soma' iti cisucciākāraṃ dhānā bhakṣayanti |

'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalamāyu- ṣkāmaḥ' ityatra kṛṣṇalamujjñātāparimitaṃ hiraṇyaṃ haviḥ śrutam |
hiraṇyaṃ asyāṃ tejaḥ ājyaṃ gavāṃ tejaḥ sāra ityarthaḥ |
tasmāt śatakṛṣṇalaśvaḥ upāṃśuyājadharmakaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
prājāpatye śatakṛṣṇale carau upāṃśuyājavidhvantaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe hetvantaram |
ājyasya dharmāṇāṃ avekṣaṇā- dīnāṃ hiraṇye anugrahāt auṣadhadharmāṇāṃ ca avahananā- dīnāṃ hānāt ājyadharmā eva grāhyāḥ iti |
prājāpatye śatakṛṣṇale carau ājyasya vidhvantaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtrābhyāṃ prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasya siddhāntamāha |
auṣadhaḥ vidhvantaḥ asya asti tat hiraṇyaṃ auṣadham |
viśada- tvāt hiraṇyamapi viśadaṃ auṣadho'pi viśadāḥ |
prājāpatye śatakṛṣṇale carau tejastvasāmānyāt ājyavidhvantaḥ prāptaḥ viśadatvasāmānyācca auṣadha- vidhvantaḥ prāptaḥ |
evaṃ sati ko viśeṣaḥ auṣadhaviśeṣe ityāśaṅkāyāṃ viśeṣahetumāha |
asādi- śeṣāt auṣadhavidhvanta eva hiraṇye syāt |
prājāpatye śatakṛṣṇale carau auṣadhavidhvanto grāhyaḥ iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
tasmin śatakṛṣṇale carau 'dhṛte śrapayati' iti śrapaṇasya śrutiḥ bhavati, śrapaṇaṃ ca auṣadhadharmaḥ, na ājyadharmaḥ |
śrapaṇaśruterhetoḥ auṣadhadharmaḥ eva śatakṛṣṇale syāt iti siddhāntaḥ |

mīko. pṛ. 1246 ṛtavyājyāvaraṇa-hiraṇyadānayoḥ adṛṣṭārthasya sabhe na bādhaḥ |

hiraṇyadhāraṇaṃ puruṣārtham, tasya svargo vā phalam, śobhanavarṇaprāptiḥ arthavādagatā vā phalam |
bhāṣyam- anārabhya śrūyate 'tasmāt suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhāryam, durvarṇo'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati' iti |
tatra kiṃ prakaraṇadharmaḥ uta puruṣadharmaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ |
akaraṇe samā- mnānaṃ na kaṃcit viśeṣaṃ kuryāt |
vā- idānīṃ prakaraṇādhītāni śrutiliṅgavākyāni prakaraṇasamavāyaṃ gacchanti na vā iti vicāryate |
'tasmāt suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhāryaṃ durvarṇo'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati' itye- mādiṣu saṃdehaḥ |
kiṃ karmasu hiraṇyadhāraṇamanucca suvarṇatā vidhīyate, vāsaḥ paridhāne ca śobhanatvam, uta viśiṣṭa- vidhānarūpeṇa nityaḥ puruṣadharmo vidhīyate iti |
anekavidhavibhaktāt karmasahiraṇyavāso'nuvādena suvarṇa- śobhanatvavidhiprāptau ucyate puruṣadharma iti |
karmaṇā saha saṃbandhe pramāṇaṃ tu na ciyate |
' prakaraṇāmā- nasya hi etadeva prayojanam, kathaṃ tadaṅgatvaṃ vijñāya- yeta iti |
yadi prakaraṇādhītāpi karmājñaitava syāt tataḥ prakaraṇāt anarthakaṃ bhavet |
asati tu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhe vibhaktirayaṃ dhāraṇāvacanaḥ saṃskārākhya śeṣabhūtatvātkalpyate, nānyathā |
vā-- yadyapi tāvat viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ tathāpi karmaśeṣa eva syāt |
tena tatsaṃbandhaḥ pramāṇavān, na svarga- saṃbandhaḥ |
evaṃ ca manyate, yathā yāgadānahomān muktvā nānyat pradhānakarmatvaṃ pratipadyate |

athavā 'tata eva anekavidhavidoṣāt sati ca saṃbhave balādaguṇe vidhiśaktisaṃcāraṇāt hiraṇyadhāraṇaṃ ‘hiraṇyaṃ haste bhavati atha gṛhṇāti' 'hiraṇyaṃ haste saṃpradāya ṣoḍaśinā stuvate' ityevamādivākyavihitaṃ anūdya suvarṇatā vidhīyate |
'vāsaḥ paridhatte' iti ca etadvihite vāsasi śobhanatvam |
evaṃ ca sūtrakārāṇāṃ 'hiraṇyamiti jātarūpaṃ pratīyate' ityādiparibhāṣayāsya etadeva mūlam |
anyathā rajatajātatadrūpasādhāraṇe sati hiraṇyaśabde anyatarādhāraṇamūlaṃ anyat kalpyaṃ syāt |
‘adravyatvāt' iti ca (sūtre) nātra dravyaṃ vidhī- yate, kiṃ tarhi ? tadviśeṣamātravidhānametat |
tadutsūtramayuktaṃ ca pradhānaṃ hi hi japādyapi |
śeṣabhūto hi adhvaryuṇā kriyate, na puruṣadharmaḥ |
vā- karmāṅgatve ca asyāḥ kriyāyāḥ ādhyarvyava- samākhyā viniyoktrī bhaviṣyati |

tena yo nāma vadet loko'pi asyeva vāsohiraṇyadhāraṇaprāptiḥ, tataḥ tadanuvādenāpi śakyaṃ guṇavidhānaṃ iti, so'pi vyāvartyato bhavati |
bhāṣyam- dravyaparatvātra bhavati nirdeśaḥ : 'suvarṇaṃ bhāryam' iti dvitīyārthasaṃyogāt |
dravyasaṃskāraka karma- śeṣapakṣe prayojanavān, anarthakaḥ puruṣadharme |
vā- pūrvaṃ dhāraṇasya svābhāvikameva saṃskāratvaṃ ityupantyastam |
idānīṃ tatraiva upacayādyetutvete karmatva- nirdeśāt iti |

kutratyena tu abhi- hitatvāt nātra karmaṇi dvitīyā utpannā, prathamaiveyam |
dvitīyārthastu bhārya iti utpalyena uktaḥ iti dravyapara- tvābhidhānam |

ānarthakyapari- hārāya phalacodanayā saṃbandha eṣitavyo bhavati |

sarvo hi anārabhyavādo vākyasaṃyogena aṅgaṃ vidhatte |
yathā- sati trividha- bhūtabhāvivartamānā'nyatamapratibandhe jñānaṃ nodeti |

bhāṣyam-- astyamiḥ 'ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinute' iti |
tatra evaṃ samāmnāyate 'hiraṇyaśakalasahasreṇamiṃ prokṣati' 'dadhnā madhumiśreṇamiṃ prokṣati' 'vetasaśākhayā- 'vakāmibhrāṃ vikarṣati' |
tatrāpyamarthaḥ sāṃśāyikaḥ pratīṣṭakaṃ kiṃ vikarṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca kartavyaṃ atha sakṛdeva (citisamu- dāye) kartavyamiti |
tatraivaṃ vicāryate, kiṃ iṣṭakā- yadi samudāye, tataḥ tacchritānāmiṣṭakānāṃ agamyamāne viśeṣe sarvāsāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ vikarṣaṇaṃ ca |
vṛkṣādiṣu ca avayavasiddhatvāde'pi ākarṣaṇaṃ na dṛṣṭa iti atastat avayavasiddhatvāde'pi|
tasmāt pratyakṣabalāt pakāmasaṃyoge'pi asti agniravayavī iti tasyedaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ sakṛdeva kartavyam|
pūrvādhikaraṇe dravyajyāsasamudāyātmakamajyotiṣṭoma- prayuktitvicāritā, samudāyaprasaṅgāt prokṣaṇaṃ vicāryate iti prāsaṅgikī (adhyāye anantaraṃ ca) saṃgatiḥ|
