śāstrārthā ca trīhīṇāṃ haviḥprakṛtitayā ekasādhanatvācchinnānāṃ caturbhuṣṭiparimitānāmiva, na pratyekam, tena tatra na pratyekaṃ prokṣaṇam, iṣṭakānāṃ tu 'vajriṇī'padadhāti' ityādiṣu bhedenaiva śāstrārthatvāt pratyuddeśyaṃ bhedenaiva prokṣaṇam, graheṣu saṃmārga iva|
tathā ca 'śrīhibhiryajeta' iti śāstrāt bahūnāṃ sādhanatvam, iha tu sādhanānāṃ bahutvaṃ iti vaiṣamyam|
kiṃca 'ukṣa secane' iti yadyapi aśeṣeṇa śābdikāḥ smaranti tathāpi ekadeśasya jalasaṃyoge eva loke prayogaḥ|
na ca pratyekaṃ trīhiṣu ekadeśasya jalasaṃyogaḥ śakyānuṣṭhānaḥ iti vidheyānuśeṣāt sahitagrīhanvayaḥ|

kiṃca pratyekaṃ trīhiṣu prokṣaṇe jalasaṃbandhādicchāt avahananāyogyatā syāt iti pradhāna- kāryavirodhaḥḥ, naivamiṣṭakāsu saṃyoga- dāḍhyāpāttvāt anukūlameva prokṣaṇaṃ iti pratipradhānaṃ prokṣaṇasyācchitre yuktā iti (pūrvapakṣāya)|
prathama- sūtrārthastu agnidharmaḥ prokṣaṇādiḥ pratīkaṃ syāt saṃghāta- syaiva agniśabdavācyatvāt 'caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmi- mureta' itivat iti|
sūtrārthastu-- agnidharmaḥ prokṣaṇādiḥ pratīkaṃ syāt saṃghātasyaiva agniśabdavācyatvāt caturhotrā paurṇamāsī- mabhimṛśediti vat iti|

bhāṭṭa-- amo śrute 'hiraṇyaśakalasahasreṇābhi prokṣati' ityādī kiṃ agniśabdena saṃsthānaviśeṣasādhanī- bhūtā iṣṭakā evocyante, tadarthaṃ ca prokṣaṇaṃ uta ikāratve avayavatvameva agniśabdenocyate tadarthaṃ ca prokṣaṇaṃ iti cintyate|
tatra, yatraikavākyatvena itarāyavākyatvam, yatra vā na saṃdhiśadarśanam, tatraiva śarīraghaṭādau avayavya- ntarābhyupagamaḥ|
na ceha ekeṣṭakākarṣaṇe itarekākarṣa- ṇam, saṃdhiśca purīṣacchannānāmapi iṣṭakānāṃ anumānena dṛśyate eva|
ato vyāpakābhāvāt 'pakāmasaṃyogena dravyāntaram' iti kāśyapavacanācca avayavantare pramāṇā- bhāvāt iṣṭakāṃsaṃskārārthameva prokṣaṇam|
ataśca iṣṭakātva- samānādhikaraṇameva apūrvasādhanatvamapidena lakṣyate iti tasya pratyekatvatvāt pratīghaṭaṃ prokṣaṇa ityapi siddhaṃ bhavati|
na caivaṃ trīhipātraprokṣaṇādāvapi pratyekaṃ tadā- pattiḥ|
nyāyatastathātvātpi 'agnaye vo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi, śundhadhvam' iti mantre bahutvavacanopādānabalena tatrala- pratīteḥ|
iti prāpte, ekāvayavakarṣaṇe itarāvayavakarṣasya nāvayavitvavyāpakatvam, nāpi saṃdhyadarśanam, vṛkṣa- paṭādau vyabhicārāt! ato yatra ekākārapratīti- svādhitā tatraiva avayavasvīkāraḥ|
vanaṃ ityādau tu bādhitā ekā- kārapratīti|
ataśca agnipadena avayavina evokta- tvāt tadarthameva prokṣaṇam|
na caivaṃ avayavasvarūpe ānarthakye apūrva- sādhanībhūtāgnyādhāratvalakṣaṇāyā abhāviba uttaravedyāmapi hiraṇyaśakalaprokṣaṇādidharmapatiḥ|
iṣṭakādisaṃpādana- laukikasthalaviśeṣe anyādipadamagrobhāvena adṛṣṭa- viśeṣavāvacchinnayaviśeṣasya abhyuttaravedyādiśabdā- bhidheyatvāt|
tatra ca ānarthakyābhāvena apūrvasādhanatva- lakṣaṇāyā evābhāvāt|
na caivaṃ uttaravedidharmāṇāṃ agnau atideśa- kathanaṃ saṃkarṣe vi
garbhamantraḥ na pūrvasyādhārasyāṅgaṃ kiṃtu uttarasyeti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. ‘hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre0’ ayaṃ mantraḥ prajāpati- paraḥ san indraparaḥ sādhito bhāṣyakāreḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa vāyavyapaśau ādhāre cihi- tena prākṛtāntarāṇāṃ na bādhaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- asti vāyavyaḥ paśuḥ ‘vāyavyaṃ śvetamāla- meta bhūtikāmaḥ’ iti tatra śrūyate ‘hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavarta- tāgra ityādhāramāghārayati’ iti |
idaṃ tu cintyate kiṃ pūrvasminnādhāre guṇavidhiḥ, uta uttarasminniti |
‘hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgra ityādhāramāghārayati’ ityatra mantre idamasti vacanam, ‘bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt’ iti |
sa hi prajotpattisaṃbhavāt prāk prajotpatteḥ ekasaṃkhyā- yukta iti gamyate |
bhāṣyam-- ‘prakṛtitvat’ iti codakasya anupa- rodho bhaviṣyati |
bhāṣyam-- vāyavyaṃ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati, na pūrvasya guṇavidhiriti |
‘kasme devāya haviṣā vidhema’ iti ekasme devāyatyarthaḥ |
ekāralopena etacchabdavijñānat etadarthapratyayo bhavati, ekasmai devāya havirdātavyamiti |
na ca pūrvasminnādhāre śrautaṃ vijñāna- maṅgabhūtam asti |
tacca hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre ityetena kartavyamiti kalpanāyāṃ na pramāṇamasti |
idaṃ hi vākyaṃ mantrakāryaviśeṣasya vidhāyakam, na mantrakārya- sāmānyasya niyāmakam |
ānarthakyam, asatyapakṣaparigrahaśca, upadeśasya sārtha- vaccam, jauhavādhāraviṣayatvāt |
yaduktam, prajāpatitvano'yaṃ mantraḥ indramabhidaṃtu- maśakno bhaviṣyatīti |
yathā hi prajāpati- reka iti saṃstutaḥ, prajāpatiśabdatvāt |
‘ka eṃ stavatakaḥ pṛṇāt ko yajāte yadugramimantvā viśvahāvet |

ka īṃ stavatakaḥ pṛṇāt ko yajāte iti, aindre sūkte vacanādaindrī ṛk |
ka enaṃ śaknoti stotum, ko vā'smai dadāti, ko vā yajatīti sarvānavavakti |
yathā, gacchan kaścitpūrvapadampadaṃ karoti, aparaṃ ca pūrvam |

tathā, ka u nu te mahimanaḥ samasyeti, ke asya sakalasya mahimnaḥ asa- tpūrve api ṛṣayo'ntaṃ prāptuṃ śaknuvanti ? yanmātā- pitarāvapi svasmāccharīrājanayasīti, mātāpitṛmapi pūrvaḥ, kimutānyasmāt janāditi siddhamekatvameveti |
ṭup-- ādhāraśrutitvāt ubhayoḥ paśyostulyā ( nānyatarasya pramāṇaṃ bhavati ), vākyaṃ ca ( tulyam ) |

tata uttarasmin ādhāre mantrānmānāt ( mantrānmāna- sāmarthyāt ) itareṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ |
pūrvasmin ( ādhāre ) mantro nāsti ( ataḥ ) tatra ta eva ( brāhmaṇādayo'bhyu- pāyāḥ ) prāpnuvanti |
vikutāvapi tathaiva ( prātiḥ ) pūrvaḥ : abhimantrakaḥ, uttaraḥ samantraka iti |
evaṃ ( sati ) uttare ( samantrake mantra-) viśeṣamātraṃ vidhāyiṣyate |

tatsāmānyaṃ ca ( vidhā- tavyam, tacca mantraviśeṣajanitaṃ iti ) mantrakāryaṃ ca ( sāmānyarūpaṃ śrautaṃ vijñānaṃ pūrvadhāre ) pākṣikam |
ata- stadapi vidhātavyam, tatra mantraviśeṣaśca ) tatra ( mantra- viśeṣa- ) niyama eva yuktaḥ, na vidhiḥ |
‘tasmin pākṣike mantrakārye viśeṣavidhānamiti cet’ ( iti bhāṣyaṃ nigadavyākhyātam |
ānarthakyaṃ iti bhāṣyasyārtha- māha - ) yadā mantraprāptiḥ |

‘asatyapakṣaparigrahaśca’ iti bhāṣyasyārthamāha - ) mayā'pi sāmānyena prāpte ( mantrakārye viśeṣo ) vidhīyate |

( ‘upa- deśaśca sārthavattvam’ iti bhāṣyasyārthamāha - ) yadi nityaṃ samānamānaṃ ( mantrakāryasya ) na syāt, tataḥ anupapattyā pākṣikato'pi mantropadeśaḥ kalpyeta |
( asti cottarādhāre nityasamānamānam, tatra mantraviśeṣopadeśasya nityavadarthaḥ |
uttarasūtre kāryapatti pratipādayati ‘vidhestatra’ ( 10|3|120 ) iti ( tatra hi klṛptakāryapattau saṃbhavantyām, na kāryāntaraṃ kalpya iti |
taca pūrvādhāre na vidyate, tasmāduttarādhāre iti ) |
vidhyatideśāt tacchrutau vikāraḥ syād guṇā- nāmupadeśyatvāt |
anyacchrautaṃ mantraviśeṣavijñānaṃ ‘ūrdhvo'dhvaro divipraśamahuto yaśo yajñateridanān bṛhadbhāvī hi maghoṣiṃtasya svāhā’ iti |
tatra aṅgabhūta- mupakārakasya vijñānasya sādhanamitīndrāya havirdātavyam |
iha tu hiraṇyagarbha iti vijñānaṃ śrautam, śrautasya prākṛtasya vijñānasya kārye vidhātumarhati, sāmarthyāt |

‘idaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ śākamime śālayaḥ; devadatto bhojayi- tavyaḥ; devadattaścādyadattastailaṃ’ iti bhojane tailamupa- kārakaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ yasya prākṛtasya kāryamabhinivartayituṃ śaknoti, tasya kārye viniyujyate ghṛtasya |
ihāpi mantra uccāryamāṇaḥ prākṛte śrautavijñāne viśeṣamutpādayati |
taccottarasminna- ṅgabhūtaṃ tadarthavijñānasya sādhakam, na pūrvasmin |
bhāṣyam-- pūrvasminnādhāre amantrameva darśa- yati, ‘na svāheti karoti, mantraṃ ca nā''sraha’ iti |
śā-- vāyavye paśau śrūyate ‘hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavarta- tāgra ityādhāramāghārayati’ iti |
prakṛtau ca dvau ādhārī, pūrvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ amantrakaḥ, uttarastvaindraḥ samantrakaḥ |
kiṃ pūrvasya ādhārasya mantravidhiḥ uta uttarasya iti saṃśaye, mantrasya prajāpatiliṅgatvāt 'prajāpatitve hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prajāpateranupatvāt' iti ca vākyaśeṣāt pūrvasya |
tatra mantravidhī mantrakāryaṃ aprākṛtaṃ kalpyaṃ syāt |
uttaratra tu prakṛtāveva mantravidhānāt asti mantraniyama-janyamahaṣṭaṃ tatra mantravidhānaṃ sukaraṃ mantraliṅgaṃ tu indre api aviśiṣṭaṃ iti darśitaṃ bhāṣye |
vākyaśeṣo'pi prajānāṃ patiḥ prajāpatirityevaṃ indra evopapannaḥ |
'yo hi khalu vāva prajāpatiḥ sa evandraḥ' iti ca ekatvāt upapatti-rvākyaśeṣasya, pūrvācāryasya ca āhattyaiva amanatratvaṃ dṛśyate - 'na svāheti karoti mantraṃ ca nāha' iti, tasmāduttarasya mantraḥ |
soma-- pūrvasmin prākṛtānuvādena guṇamātravidhi-mupajīvya pravṛtteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu - 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre ityādhāramādhārayati' ityatra pūrvasminneva ādhāre mantravidhiḥ syāt liṅgalāditi |
vi-- 'hiraṇyagarbhaṃ ādhāre pūrvasminnuttarai'thavā', liṅgadādhe, samaṃ liṅgaṃ kalpyakāryatve'tontime |
bhāṭṭa-- vāyavye paśau 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre ityādhāramādhārayati' iti śrutam |
prakṛtiśca dvāvādhārau, pūrvo'mantrakaḥ prājāpatyaḥ uttara aindro mantravān |
tadiha vaiśeṣiko mantro na tāvadādhāradvaye'pi vidhīyate, vakṣya-māṇavidhayā tadasaṃbhavāt |
ekatrāpi pūrvādhāre eva vidhīyate, tasya prajāpatitvetākatvena mantrasya sāma-rthyāt |
hiraṇyagarbhadiśabdā hi prajāpatau rūḍhāḥ yogarūḍhā vā |
'sraṣṭā prajāpatirvaiḥ', 'hiraṇyagarbho lokeśaḥ', 'ityādyanuśāsanāt', 'kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema' iti mantraśeṣe śravaṇāt, kaśabdasya prajāpatau śrutvāt |
ata eva 'prajāpatitve hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prajāpateranupa-tvāya' iti vākyaśeṣo'pi saṃgacchate |
na ca pūrvādhāre prakṛtau mantrasyābhāve mantraniyamāhaṣṭasyāvāt tatra vaiśeṣikamantravidhāne tanniyamahaṣṭakalpanā''pattiḥ, utta-
rādhāre tu tasya klṛptatvāt tatra mantravidhau lāghavamiti vācyam |
uttarādhāre hi hiraṇya-garbhasyaiva devatātvakalpanāyāṃ tatrāpi gauravāñca |
kiñca pūrvādhāre'pi sarvatra mantrābhāve brāhmaṇasya smārakatayā niyamasya pañcame (119) uktatvāt brāhmaṇaniyamyā-dṛṣṭatvena tajanakatvenaiva etanmantravidhānopapatterlāghavāvi-śeṣaḥ |
na ca tadadṛṣṭaṃ prati mantrasyabhicāraḥ; tattatkalpapūrva-sādhanībhūtādṛṣṭaṃ prati tasya tasya kāraṇatvenāpyavicārāt |
iti prāpte, yatra mantrasāmarthyaṃ klaptam, tatra mantraviśeṣavidhāne lāghavād-dharādhāre eva niveśaḥ |

vastutastu prakṛtau pūrvādhāre 'na svāheti karoti mantraṃ ca nāha' iti vacanameva mantrānāmabhāvādeva mantrābhāsaprasaktau nityānuvādarūpamapi svārthasyaiva parihārāt hiraṇyamantrasya tānivedatātparyagraha-kam |
ata uttaradhāre prākṛtamantrasya bādhaḥ, na tu pūrvā-dhāre prākṛtabrāhmaṇasya |
ataścāyaṃ nityānuvādaḥ pūrvā-dhāre hiraṇyagarbhamantrasya parisaṃkhyāphalakaḥ san uttarādhāre eva tasya vidhi gamayati |

astu vā - 'yo hi khalu vāva prajāpatiḥ sa u vāvendraḥ' iti vākyaśeṣātu-sārāt hiraṇyagarbhādipade rūḍhi parityajya yogamātre-ndraparatā 'kasmai', ityatrāpi ekāradhyāhāreṇa ekasmai ananyasādhāraṇāyaitaddhīkāraḥ |
tatrāyaṃ siddhāntavākyaḥ uktaḥ - 'mantravidhau mantranyaṃ niyamahaṣṭamapekṣaṇīyam, anyathā brāhmaṇakalpasūtropadraṣṭa-vacanādibhirapi anuprayarthasmaraṇasaṃbhavena mantraniyamavaidha-dharyāt |
tacca niyamāhaṣṭaṃ prakṛtau pūrvādhāre na klaptaṃ tatra tasyāmantrakatvāt |
tat kalpanīyam, uttarādhāre tu tat klṛptam, tasya prakṛtāvāpi samantrakatvāt |
ataḥ klṛpte niyamahaṣṭe mantra-viśeṣamātravidhānaṃ laghu, ityuttarādhāre eva mantravidhi-ryuktaḥ |
iti uktaṃ ca duṣṭīkāyā 'mantraniyamāda-hṛdayamahaṣṭaṃ kalpanīyaṃ pūrvādhāre, tat klṛptamuttarādhāre, tasmin sati kalpayituṃ na śakyate' iti |
pṛ. 103. kaṇvarthatasya bṛhadgraṃthatarasthānāpannatvena tadgatastomābhitagīryaśajanyādṛṣṭārthatvenaiva hiraṇyagarbha-mantranyāyena (10|3|2) kalpanāt tatrāpi dharmaprāptyupapattiḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 9|2|14 pūrvapakṣaprabhṛte siddhāntī, kaṇvarthatare ca hiraṇyagarbhamantranyāyena tattatsaṃskārasamahṛdayajanakatayaiva śragantarajanyasamatada-saṃkhyākaguṇābhidhāyakavidhivānāt tattatsaṃskārasamūha-prayuktadharmaprāptyupapattiḥ |

9|2|14 siddhāntaḥ, sāma-dravyaniyamamāhaṣṭatvaṃ tannimāhaṣṭasādhanatvenaiva ca taddharmavidhī uddeśyatvāvacchedakatvat kaṇvarthatare ca hiraṇyagarbhamantranyāyena tadbhedābhāvāt uccaistvādidūpa-dharmaśaṃkānāpattiḥ |
'hīp' iti nidhanaṃ saubhare kāmyaṃ vṛṣṭikāmāsya vihitam |
vi. 2|2|13. hīp, ūrka, ū iti nidhanaviśeṣaṇāṃ saubhare eva phalabhedena vyavasthā na tu tebhyaḥ saubharāt pṛthak phalam |
hīṣādinyāyena sarvakāmavākyaprāpta-paśuprayojanajanakatvasaṃbandhenaiva prakaraṇāparodhena paśudeśena godohanaṃ vidhīyate na tu sākṣāt |
hutahavirdāhaḥ : śiṣṭācārahavirdāhaprāptaḥ - bhūtopayogadravyasaṃskārārthe adṛṣṭārthe saṃniyopakārakaṃ kratvarthaṃ pravṛttirūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma |
tataśca kramabodhikā śrutirapi anuvāda eva, na tu krame pramāṇam |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1|9. 'hṛdayasyāgre-'ḍavacatraya jihvāyāḥ atha vakṣaḥ' atra kramaḥ pāṭhakramaḥ, na śrautaḥ |
dup. 5|1|1|1 pṛ. 1289, 'hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati' ityemādīni na yāgaṃ codayanti iti dvitīyadhyāye sthitam (2|1|6|17) |
hṛdayādīnāmeva avadānasaṃbandhitayā śrūyamāṇāṃ haviṣtvena, taditarāvayavānāṃ haviṣtvaparisaṃkhyā |
10|7| 2|13-9. hṛdayādīnāṃ niṣpattayarthaṃ paśoḥ viśasanakarma na jāghanyāḥ |
bhā. 10|7|1|1-2. hṛdayādyeveṣpi vapāvat pañcāvattatvameva jyotiṣṭome'gnīṣomīye paśo |
hṛdayādyavadānameva paścālambhasya prayojakam, śakrasaṃppravedhaḥ lohitanirasanaṃ ca śeṣapratipattiḥ |
agnīṣomīye paśo aṅgāvā-dāneṣu ekādaśabhya itareṣāṃ parisaṃkhyā |
paśo hṛdayā-dīnāmeva avadānasaṃbandhitayā śrūyamāṇānāṃ haviṣtvena taditarāvayavānāṃ haviṣtva parisaṃkhyā |
idamadānīṃ saṃdihyate, kiṃ yena kenacidaṅgena haviṣā yāgo nirvartitavyaḥ : uta sarvebhyo'vadātavyam, athavā parisaṃkhyā kenaciditi |
yānyavadāne saṃkīrtitāni, avaśiṣṭāni ca paścākṛtyā praṇaḍyā paricchinnāni tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo'vadātavyam |
padavākṛtyā hi na kecit viśeṣāḥ paricchidyante |
teṣāṃ vā avadānatvaṃ vivakṣannanirdideśat tadyadi esmādaṅgādavadīyeta, na paśvākṛtiparicchinnāḥ paśoḥ paśvādānatvāt ||
tatra paśvākṛtyā aṅgabhāvo na kṛtaḥ syāt |
anekaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ hi māṃsarādi paricchidyata aṅgabhāvaṃ nītā bhavati, nānyathā |
eka- haviṣye hi paśvākṛtiparicchinnāṅgāśaḥ sarvāvadānā- nabhyāsenaiva yathāśrutādevāvat bhavati |
pṛthak praka- lpiteṣu aṅgeṣu ekasmādaṅgādavacanaṃ kāścidviśeṣān jahyāt |
nanu paśvākṛtiparicchinnānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ yāgārthatvāt anyatamena yāgaḥ sidhyet |
tasmāt viśeṣeṣu gṛhyamāṇepu aṅgabhāvaḥ kuto bhavati iti tadartha prayogavacanena viśeṣā gṛhyante, nāvagamyate viśeṣaḥ, ko vā viśeṣo vyuhitaḥ, ko vā neti |
yaśca viśeṣo na gṛhītaḥ, tena vinā'pi yathāśrutamaiva bhavati iti kalpyamāne, tasya paśvākṛtyā paricchede na kaścidapi adhiko''ṅgīkṛto bhavati iti anādaraḥ taṃ prati āśritaḥ syāt |
tatra hi trayo doṣāḥ-- svārthaprahā- ṇam, parārthakalpanā, prāptabādhaśceti |
naivaṃ vacanavyaktirbhavati 'ekādaśaiva paśoravadānāni, nābhyadhikāni, yānyavadānāni tāni dvirdvivacati' iti |
etāni dvirdvivacati iti eteṣāṃ dviravadānaṃ vidhāya kṛtārthaḥ śabdo bhavati |
aṃśaśiro'nūkasakthipratiṣedhaśca tadanyapari- saṃkhyāne''narthakaḥ syāt pradānatvāt teṣāṃ nirava- dānapratiṣedhaḥ syāt ||
evameteṣāṃ pratiṣedha upapadyate, yadi na parisaṃkhyānaṃ bhavet |
atha tu na parisaṃkhyā, tat pradāna- tvāt, yānyavadānāni teṣāṃ niravadānaṃ pratiṣidhyate |
ki- midaṃ niravadānamiti ? niṣkṛṣya tasmādaṅgāt avadānaṃ niravadānaṃ 'dviravacati' iti tat pratiṣidhyata iti |
tena hṛdayādine vākyena homasaṃbandhāni bhavanti, nāmyā- tanmātreṇaiva yāgaḥ syāt sarveṣāṃ yugapanmateḥ ||
'aviśeṣāddhi sarveṣāṃ haviṣṭvamava- pragakṣe hṛdayādivākye sati paśvākṛterdevatāsaṃbandho- gamyate |
' evamākṛtikāt gṛhyamāṇepu ākulidevatāsaṃbandha ura- padyate etra |
api ca anavadānīyaśabdo bhavati 'mārutyān anavadānīyān surāgrahāṃ ājisuddhyabho harati' iti |
kutaḥ ? a- brāhmaṇe hi bhakṣaṃ darśayati |
katham ? 'kakubho rājaputraḥ prāśnāti dhruvagopaḥ' iti kakubho bhakṣaṃ darśayati |
itarathā yāge pravṛttasya adarśanaṃ syāt, sarvapradānaṃ ca bhavet |
śrutātopadeśo hi bhavati 'dvyānya- dhānyabhimuśati śrutāntyutāni ca' iti |
yadi na pari- saṃkhyā, sarveṣāṃ śravaṇaṃ syāt, aśratadarśanaṃ nopapadyate |
yathā 'parthemikkṛtaṃ pātilavamutsṛjanti' iti teṣāṃ tatra śravaṇaṃ na syāt |
viśasanāditāraparyagrāhakasakṛtpaśugaṇāvasthānyanupapattyā hi kalpyamānaṃ svāvayavasādhanatvaṃ avayavenaḥ sarvāvayaveṣu vyāsaktatvāt sarvāvayavavṛttayeva kalpayitumucitam |
ato vinigamanāvirahāt sarveṣāmeva sādhanatvāvagamāt pradeya- tvam |
ata eva ekādaśānāyaṃ kramaḥ; anyeṣāma tu aniyamaḥ |
athavā 'hṛdayasyāmevadyati' ityāyuktvā 'ekādaśa vai paśoravadānāni tāni dvirdvi- racayati' iti śravaṇāt ekādaśasu dviravadānaṃ anyeṣu tu paśvāvadānasaṃpadakatāya triravadānamityevaṃ sārtha- kāni |
ata eva 'nāṃsa- yoravadyati na śiraso nānūkasya nāparasakthyoḥ' iti paryudāso'pi saṃgacchate |

iti prāpte, yathaiva viśasanādi- saṃskārānurodhāt paśoravayavaprakṛtitvaṃ kalpayitvā''vayavā- nāmeva sākṣāt haviṣṭvamavagamyate, tathaiva 'hṛdayasyāme- 'vadyati' ityādityeṣu hṛdayādīnāmevāvadānāmeva prākṛtahaviḥsaṃskārāvadānasaṃbandhatvā teṣāmeva haviṣ- pratītestatprakṛtitvameva parirakṣiti na sarveṣamavayavānāṃ sādhanatā |
ata eva hṛdayādivākyāni teṣāmavadānā- khyasaṃskāravidhividvārā haviṣyoghakāni santi ita-
yadi ca 'tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti hetuḥ avatiṣṭheta yadyapi ca bhavet anakaraṇaṃ hetuḥ darvī- piṭharādiprakārāṇāṃ tathāpi sūpa eva avatiṣṭhate |
nirdeśāt iti 'tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti sūpagatasyaiva anakaraṇasya hetutvanirdeśāt ityarthaḥ |
nanu anakaraṇatvasya sūpamātragatasya homasādhanatvahetutvakathanavaiyarthyāt darvīdyadhikaraṇalābhāya sāmānyena anakaraṇatvamātrasya hetutvaṃ iti cet brūme, tatra vadāmaḥ |
vidhīnāṃ vidhe- yānāṃ darvīpiṭharādīnāṃ anyavyavasthā avadhāraṇābhāvaḥ syāt |
vastumātrasya kvācit praṇālyā aniṣṭisiddhānatvāt homasādhanatvena vidhānaṃ syāt |
kiṃtu hetu- vannigadāpi stutireva kārya iti siddhāntaḥ |
dṛṣṭānte gṛhītasyāpi sahāyakṛtya bodhaka ākāro hetuḥ |
balīyānapi hetuḥ virudhyamānaṃ avalīyāṃsaṃ bādhitumurhati nāviruddham |
bhā. 3|1|3| 14 pṛ. 844, siddho hi heturbhavati na prasādhyaḥ |
sūpa- homastu tṛtīyānirdiṣṭadravyakaraṇakatvāt ārādupakārakaḥ iti dūrāpāstaṃ tasya dravyaprayuktatvam |
hetvadhi- karaṇe api anvayavākyakalpanena darvīdādidhanāśā- miṣṭānam |
su. pṛ. 73, iha (9|1|5|11-19) apūrvāthe home sthite prathame'dhyāye (hetvadhikaraṇe 1| 2|136-30) kimannakaraṇaṃ vidhīyate uta anakaraṇaṃ stutiḥ |
ityaṃ vicāraḥ (ato nāsya vicārasya hetvadhi- karaṇena paunaruktyam, viṣayabhedāt |

) ṭup. 9|1|9| 11 pṛ. 1659, iha dravyasya tṛtīyānirdeśatvāt homasādhanāpyarthatve sthite hetvadhikaraṇe sūpaśabda avyu- tpannavāda svīkṛtvākaraṇamātraṃ homasādhanatvena na vidhī- yate kiṃtu anakaraṇatvaṃ pūrvavidhaiva stutirityuktamiti apunaruktiriti dhyeyam |
soma. 9|1|50 'pūṣā prapiṣṭhabhāgaḥ adantako hi' ityatra peṣaṇe adantakatvaṃ na hetuḥ, hetvadhikaraṇe (1|2|13) evaṃjātīyakahetu- vādasya akiṃcitkaratvaniścayāt |
prayojanaṃ (kalpasūtrādhikaraṇasya) kalpasūtrādīnāṃ vedatve vedatulyatve vā yatra pratyakṣaśrutivirodhaḥ tatra vikalpaḥ |
yatra vā pratyakṣaśrutivirodhe'pi nyāyā- bhāsamūlakaṃ vacanaṃ tatrāpi vacanādeva tadanuṣṭhānaṃ nyāyo- nyāyastu hetvadhikaraṇanyāyena arthavādaḥ iti (pūrva- pakṣe) |
darvīdyadravye homasādhanatvasya hetvadhikaraṇapūrva- pakṣaprayojanasya 'yadi ca heturatiṣṭheta' (1| 2|13|30) ityanena nirāsaḥ |
tatra yadā hetutvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā hetumadvyāpāre vivakṣite'pi ṇijyutpadyate kartṛtvamātravivakṣāyāṃ vinaiva ṇiccā |

karaṇasya samanantaraṃ avyavahitapūrve) virodhādhikaraṇā- bhyuccaya- (1|3|2) hetubhūtahetudarśanaparasya svātantryeṇāpi aprāmāṇyāpādanaśaktipratipādanaparasya vā virodhādhi- karaṇabhaktvāt na tena pṛthak saṃgatyapekṣā |
'hetumati ca' (pā. 3|1|26) prayojaka- vyāpāre preṣaṇādau vācye dhātorṇic syāt |
hetuvannigadaḥ arthavādaḥ 'sūpena juhoti' 'tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 50 hetuvannigadaḥ 'sa vai dhruvāmevāgre'bhidhārayati tato hi prathamāvājya- bhāgo yakṣyan bhavati' iti |
bhāṣyam- atha ye hetuvannigadāḥ 'sūpena juhoti, tena hyannaṃ kriyate' ityevamādayaḥ |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ stutisteṣāṃ kāryamuta heturiti |
satyamevaṃ loke, vidhīyate tu vacanena vede |
kiṃ prayojanam ? anyadapi darvīpiṭharādyakaraṇaṃ yat tenāpi nāma kathaṃ homaḥ kriyate |
kutaḥ ? tasyāpyana- kriyāyāmarthavattā, śakyate ca tenāpyannaṃ kartum |
na hi vartamānakālaḥ kaścidasti, yasyāyaṃ pratinidhiḥ |
devī ca śrutiḥ śabdaḥ, stutau lakṣaṇā |
yadi ca darvīpiṭharādi na sākṣādannaṃ karotīti nānnakaraṇamityucyate |
sūpamapi hi na sākṣādannaṃ karotīti tena vinā- 'rthena sūpasya stutirnopapadyate |
vā- iha ye hetuvannigadyante hiśabdādimirna ca paramārthahetavastata udāharaṇam |
tatra yadi tāvadetutvaṃ vidhīyate tataḥ pūrveṇaiva gatam |
yadi hetṛtvaṃ tacchūpa- homasaṃbaṃdhanaṃ prati na cāvihito'sāvastīti kasya hetu- rucyate |
na ca bhūtānuvādamātraṃ kiṃ tarhi hetoḥ prasiddhipūrvakatvāsiddhadupadiṣṭasya yāvatsiddhayāśaṅkā tatrāpyarthāpattibhyādacanātsiddhiḥ |
yā''pi cārthavādā- kāṅkṣā kasmāditi sā''pyanenaiva hetunā nivartyate iti manyate |
athāpyarthavādādaṃ tathā''pi tadantarnirṇayahetutva- meveti sarvādhikaraṇaviṣayaṃ vijñāyate tataśca heturupa- sthitivai pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
saṃbandhasya ca vidheyatvāccata- meva hetvatvaṃ homasyeti vadati |
anya- sminneva tu saṃbandhe sati paścādaprasiddhayantamenamanu- mānavyavahāropalakṣaṇatvenopanyasyati |
yadā śaktyabhiprāyaṃ yayoreva hi vyāptigrahaṇakāle gamyamakasāmarthyātmanā kāryakāraṇabhāvitvena sā'vadhṛtā tatraiva hetutā |
avināmāvo hyanekakāryakāraṇasvāsamisahacaramāvā- dipamedaminaḥ, tatrānnakaraṇatā home hetutvenocyamānā saṃbandhantarābhāvāt kāraṇatvena syāt |

satyaṃ loke hetuvyavahārālaprathamataṃ pramāṇāntareṇa saṃbandhaprasiddhirapekṣyate vede tu hiśabda- pratipāditahetvavānyathānupapattyā saṃbandhamidhāyi dṛṣṭānta- vacanaṃ kalpyeta yadyannakaraṇaṃ tena tena juhoti, tena
aparastvāha vyāptau siddhāyāṃ sarvāṅgasādhanadhako homaḥ siddho bhavati |
itarastvāha anna- kriyāyāṃ tāvattasyārthavattā'sti tāvanmātraṃ vā''śrayiṣyate |
yadeva hi tadupayogimātraṃ tadeva śakyate kathaṃcitkathaṃcidātmatvena vivakṣitum |
athavāsyārthavattvaṃ karaṇavibhaktinirdeśālambanamupapatyā punarvartamānākriyā- yasya hetutvābhidhānātsādhahome pratyanupapaśyāśaka- yopapatti vadati |
etaddhi kriyata ityucyate tadarthaṃ śakyata ityabhidhīyate |
sādhakatamatva- vartamānatve cettatra na vidhyete darvi'pi tathaiveti stutirna syāt tena yathā tatra stutyarthaḥ |
kathaṃcit vidhyate tathā mama hetvartha ityaviśeṣaḥ |
'sūrpeṇa' iti cāsmin pakṣe nityānu- vādo'karaṇasāmānyānyena prāptasya |
tatrārthavattvaṃ tāvadarthavādatāprayojanavattvarupa- pattirapiprasiddhaṃ, saṃbandho'pi kālpanikavākyāśraya- ṇāt |
bhāṣyam - na tvetadasti, śabdapūrvako'yamartho'nna- karaṇaṃ heturiti |
na ca darvipiṭhādahome, tena śabdapūrva sūrpam, na darvi- piṭhādadeśonā |
vā-- sūrpeṇeti tāvatkaraṇavibhaktistyaivāvacche- homo nānumānikairdarvipiṭhādibhiḥ saha ārthavikalpasamu- ccayātpratipadyate |
anuṣṭhitāyāmeva ca darvipiṭhādiśau sūrpaṃ prāpnuvacchenumānaṃ prativadhnāti |
tena bravīti- 'aco- danā ca tasya' iti |
sūrpaśrutiśca vidhyadeśa- pātinyanyaprayojanā vispaṣṭā ca satī parityaktuṃ na yujyate |
tatra yathāśrutaṃ vidhyu- deśe hetutāmapratipadyamānaṃ tadanantarākāṅkṣitāparyeplu- hetvapekṣitāśastyahetutvarupadhārthe, annakaraṇatvātprasta iti |
siddhaṃ hi praśastānāṃ karta- vyatvamabhikaraṇatāṃ ca praśastatvamiti |
tava hi yadyadanakaraṇaṃ tadyocyate na ca darvipiṭhādīnāṃ karaṇātā sādhakatamasya pākādeḥ karaṇatvāt |
vā-- yatpunaḥ sūrpe''nnakaraṇatvānupapatteḥ stutirna prāpnotītyuktaṃ kiṃ tannāmidhīyate |
saṃvādācca stutivacanatvena, yathā vayaṃ sūrpeṇā'nnaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ jānīmaḥ, tathā sūrpeṇā'nnaṃ kriyate ityeva gamyate |
svapakṣe eṣa doṣo yasya te heturvidhiḥ |
vidhī hi na paraḥ śabdārthaḥ pratīyate |
na ca vartamāna- mupadiśanan vedaḥ śakyamarthaṃ viddhyāt |
yathā loke 'balvāndevadatto vartamāno na siṃhaṃ śārdūlaṃ vā''pekṣya prayujyate, ye devadattāt nikṛṣṭabalātānpekṣya bhavati |
śastraṃ kriyata iti prakṛṣṭākaraṇena saṃstatraḥ sūrpasya, nikṛṣṭāni anyāni annakaraṇāni apekṣya bhaviṣyati |

vā-- asatyakṣe artho'sti stutyālambanakaraṇatvaṃ nāma, vākyaśeṣo hi bhavanparatvādyautatvādyapi pratipadyate tadā ca vidhyetāntaravaśādavaśyamanuvādena bhavitavyamanu- vādaśca yathāvijñātasya bhavati |
ataḥ śabdanevābhyanujñātāṃ yādṛśaṃ vayamannakaraṇatvaṃ sūrpe paśyāmastādṛśamidaṃ saṃkīrtyate iti |
tatrāpi hi kṛtaṃ vā kariṣyamāṇaṃ vā stotuṃ kriyate ityucyate |
kathaṃ stutiḥ, sarvalokasya bhūtabhaviṣyadanādareṇa vartamānopā- rānurāgādattamānālokenanaiva ca kālāntare''pi tatra prīti- riti kriyate evanenā''nabhidhiyucyate |
tatra tu vidhividhā- svāt mukhyānnakaraṇatvavartamānatvayoragrahaṇe doṣaḥ |
etadevā''ha- 'vidhe hi na paraśabdārthaḥ prayojanam' iti |
tadiha bhūtabhaviṣya- kriyāvācinaḥ śaktivartamānatvacinā vā svārthe varta- mānākriyāvācī śabdaḥ kalpanīyaḥ |
na ca vartamānaṃ sādhakatamaṃ yopadiśanan vedaḥ śakyamarthaṃ viddhyāt |
na hi varta- mānākriyeṇa sūrpādinā sādhakatamatvena vā pākena hetuṃ śakyate tasmāttubhāvapi vipratipadyama |
'yathā loke balavā- ndedadattaḥ' iti bhūmyatiśāyane vā matuppravṛttaṃ ca viśeṣa upātto'muṣmātkṛṣvata iti |
tatra sarvastyebhyaḥ prakarṣe mukhyaḥ śabdo na tathā saṃbhavati siṃhādīnāṃ balavattaratvāditi devadattānyūnatvabalatānpekṣyaivamabhivyate tathā''tra viprakṛṣṭatarānasādhanatvāpekṣayā sūrpaṃ
nanyevāmapekṣapravṛttermukhyatvameva syāt, tathā ca devadatte balavacchabdapravṛtti naiva gauṇī manyate |
satyamevam, yadā tāvannyūnamātrāpekṣayaiva prayujyate yadā tvaviśeṣapravṛttestadadhikabalatve'pi balavadbuddhirjātā tadā sa eva śabdaḥ kutaścidapi nyūnatvale vartamāno gauṇaḥ saṃpadyate |
tathā yadi vidhyudeśātte sūrpe'nnakaraṇatvamanū- dyate tat tatannyūnamātrāpekṣayā vā mukhyatvaṃ nyanānupādā- nādvā sāmānyataḥ pravṛttasya sarvaprakṛṣṭagāmi-vahuddhī satyāṃ gauṇatā |
bhavattatsavapūrvavidhānādatyantāsādhakatamatvavata- mānatvayoḥ kriyāṃ pratyupādānānnyūnāpekṣāgauṇatvayo- nimittaṃ nāstītyatikleśaḥ syādityasamānam |
yadi ca heturupasthita nirdeśāt, sāmānyā- diti cedavyavasthā vidhīnāṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- yadyapi ca bhavedanyakaraṇaṃ hetūrvīpiṭha- prakārāṇām, tathāpi sūrpa evāvatiṣṭhate |
taddhi nirdiśyate, yasmāt sūrpeṇā'nnaṃ kriyate, tasmāt sūrpeṇa juhotīti |
yathā yasmāt balavadupadhamāto- ''miṣṭena me gṛhaṃ dagdhamiti, nānamirvi balavadupadhamāto dahatīti gamyate |
atha matam, yena yenānnaṃ kriyate praṇavyā sūrpādenyāyena, tena tenāpi homaḥ kriyate iti |
tatra yāvaduktaṃ syājjuhotīti, tāvadevā'nna- karaṇena juhotīti |
loke'pi ca yaṃ dharmiṇaṃ pratijñāya yo heturpadiśyate sa prathamaṃ tāvatpratyaviśeṣyā- tmanaiva pratīyate |

tadārambhakasya tu sādhyāṃśānugamā- bhāvātsāmānyātmanā vivakṣitamiti dṛṣṭāntaprayogavelāyā- mevāvadhāryate, vedahetūnāṃ punarna sāmānyātmanā sādhya- saṃbandho'vagato na viśeṣātmanā so'dhunevācāryyā kalpanīyaḥ |
tada- kalpane hi hetunirdeśaḥ śruto virudhyate |
tassādī- haśaṃ dṛṣṭāntavacanaṃ kalpayaccarpyamakaraṇaṃ tena tena juhotīti |

yathā ca gamanaṃ gośabdavyutpattinimittatvena upādīyamānaṃ sākṣādimassāmānyapratyayottaratvāttadatmeva nimittatvaṃ pratipadyate na gantṛmātraviṣayamiti gośabdavyavasthā tathā śūrpagatābhakaraṇahetūpadeśādannagatahetūpadeśaḥ |
yadyadannakaraṇasamarthaṃ śūrpaṃ tena tena hotavyaṃ na darvipiṭharādigrahaṇam |
yathā balava- dupaghātate'mo dahanahetutvenokte sa evānudhamāto na dahenna tu śabdādyo balavadupaghātā dahanti |
tassādha- dahenna tu śabdādyo balavadupaghātā dahanti |
śā-- evaṃ ānarthakyapratiyogino vidhipratiyogi- naśca arthavādā vicāritāḥ |
evaṃ śrūyate 'śūrpeṇa juhoti tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ śūrpeṇa home karttavye annakaraṇatā hetuḥ uta arthavāda iti |
tatra hi śabda- śrutvā hetutvaṃ gamyate, lakṣaṇayā prāśastyam |
yena annaṃ kriyate śūrpadanyenāpi darvī- piṭharādinā tena tenāpi homasiddhiḥ |
ata eva hetu- vyapadeśāt vyāptimanatareṇa anupapyamānāt vyāpti- vacanaṃ kalpyate, yena yena annaṃ kriyate tena tena hotavya- miti |
tena īdṛśamidaṃ vākyaṃ śrutānumitaikadeśaniṣpannaṃ śūrpasya homasādhanatvaṃ annakaraṇatvāt hetoḥ |
ataḥ śūrpaṃ anyat vā yat annakaraṇaṃ tena hotavyamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu śūrpasya tṛtīyāśrutyā karaṇatvaṃ gamyate, na tat ānumānikadarvīpiṭharādibhirvikalpitumarhati |
na ca vedena ucyamānaṃ śūrpasya homasādhanatvaṃ hetumevapekṣate, veda- syaiva tatra pramāṇatvāt arthavādastu apekṣitaḥ |
evaṃ ca aprasiddhavyāpti- vacanakalpatve na bhaviṣyati |
'kriyate' iti ca arthamāne vartamānanirdeśaḥ prarocanārthatve yukto bhavati |
nahi bhūte bhāvinā vā tādṛśī prītiḥ yādṛśī vartamāna |
soma-- yaduktaṃ sarveṣāṃ vidhivicchidānāṃ stutyarthatva- miti, tadyuktam |
sūtrārthastu-- 'tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti hetuvidhiḥ syāt, tathā sati darvīdīnāmapi homasādhanatvena arthavatvāt hiśabdasyopapatteśca |
, śūrpa- sādhanatā śrautī nāśrautaiḥ sā vikalpyate |
bhāṭṭa-- cāturmāsye 'śūrpeṇa juhoti' iti śūrpakaraṇahome vidhāya śrute 'tena hyannaṃ kriyate' ityarthavāde na stutilakṣaṇā |
api tu homasādhanatve sādhye annakaraṇatvasya hetutvaṃ vidhīyate |
na hyatra pūrva- vat bhāvyatva iva kiñcit kalpanīyamasti, hiśabdastvaidha hetutvābhidhānāt |
yatra- dannakaraṇaṃ tenatena hotavyamiti vyāptivacanaṃ kalpayati |
tataśca śūrpadanasyāpi darvīpiṭharādemisādhanatvapratīteḥ vidhau śūrpademupalakṣaṇam, avayavānuvādo vā |
yadvā- tacchabdena śūrpasyaiva parāmarśat tadatmevānnakaraṇatvaṃ hetuḥ |
tena ca viśeṣyaiva vyāptiḥ kalpyāt annakaraṇa- samarthaśūrpavyāvṛttāvapi na vidhirathaṃ śūrpadamyathā neya- miti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu -- kriyate iti laḍantanirdeśāt vartamānakālatvasya hetutvaṃ vācyam |
yadyapi ceyaṃ prāśastyalakṣaṇopayogiguṇaghaṭakatayā mamāpyā- vaśyakī, tathā'pyanuvādakatvāt prāśastyotpādakatvācca na doṣaḥ, vartamānanirdeśaṃ vinā tadapratīteḥ |
kiṃca, apekṣitaprāśastyaparatve saṃbhavati nānepekṣitahetuparatvāddhī- kāro yuktaḥ |
su. pṛ. 93. hetuvidhiḥ arthavādaḥ -- 'caturgṛhītājyāni bhavanti, sa hyatrānuyāja yakṣyan bhavati' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 52, hetuvidhirmantraḥ -- 'indro vāyumanti hi' iti |

tatpratiyogi- pramāṇakārakatvaṃ asiddhatvādīnām, tena hetuniṣṭho doṣo hetvābhāsaḥ |
yādṛśaviśiṣṭaviṣayatvena yathārthajñānasya anu- mitiprātibandhakatvaṃ tattvaṃ iti yāvat |
(tatra ityasya sthāne) tena duṣṭo heturhetvā- bhāsaḥ |
upādhijñānasya sākṣāt pratibandhakatvābhāvena tadabhāvasya anumitiprayoja- katvā hetvābhāsāḥ |
tatra asiddhiḥ svarūpasiddhiḥ saṃbandhāsiddhiḥ vyatirekā- siddhiḥ āśrayāsiddhiḥ vyāpyatvāsiddhiḥ iti pañcadhā |
pakṣe vyāpyatvena abhimatābhāvaḥ svarūpasiddhiḥ iti akṣapādīmate tu īśvare prasiddhasattve buddhe tadabhāvāt akṣatiḥ |
yathā herambanarasiṃha- vāyu: ākāśaśca anila:, mūrtatvāt iti |
evaṃ nīladhūmat ityādivāpi nīladhūma- tvasya gurutayā hetutāvacchedakatvena sā'pi vyāpyatvā- siddhi: |
saṃdeha- janakatvaṃ ca sādhyadabhāvasaṃbandhitvajñānena satyapi pakṣata- tvena ca |
atra amūrtatvaṃ anityakriyādhāratvāt sādhyasaṃdehaṃ jana- yati |
evaṃ vāyu: apratyakṣa: arūpidravyatvāt, vāyu: pratyakṣa: mahattve sati udbhūtasparśavatvāt |
sthāṇutvapuruṣatvavyāpyajñāne pratyakṣa- rūpasaṃśayavat satpratipakṣatve'pi saṃśayākārānumiti- rastu |
yatra ekakoṭivyāpyadarśanaṃ prabalaṃ tatra adhika- balatayā dvitīyakoṭimānapratibandhāt na saṃśaya: |
phala- balena ca adhikasamabalabhāva: kalpya iti |
tadabhāvasattāṃśasya tadabhāva- vyāpyatvajñānasyāpi laukikasannikarṣajanyajñānatvameva pratibandhakatāvacchedakam, tena na saṃśayākārānumiti: ityādi |

yathā herambanarasiṃha- yorekadeśe gajatvaṃ siṃhatvaṃ vā'parasminnastviti deśā- medena virodhābhāvāccāstyā''rhaṃtasyaikasminneva sarvatrā- 'sattvādīnā anekāntatvābhidhāne dhammā'nupapatteriti rāmānujīyā iti |

varaṇaṃ darśādāvadṛṣṭārthameva, varaṇāt prāgapi sāmidhenīṣu tasya pravṛtte: |
ata eva jyotiṣṭoma- gataiṣṭikeṣu gomikavaraṇāt pṛthageṣṭikaṃ varaṇaṃ kartavyam |
hotrādīnāṃ ca sadasi karmapravṛtte: avaśyaṃ vaṣaṭ- kārasāmānyānimittamarthaṃ sadasi somā: ānetavyā: |
hotṛkāma: 'yaṃ kāmayeta vaḍhīyān syādityanve- staraṃ tasya vaṣaṭ kuryāt' ityādi: darśapūrṇamāsādī
hotṛvaraṇaṃ darśike jyotiṣṭome iṣṭipu paśu kartavyam, brahmavaraṇaṃ tu na kartavyam ||
bhāṣyam-- 'darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ hotṛvaraṇaṃ ānātam 'agnirdaivyo hotā devān yakṣat' iti |
tat codakena aiṣṭikeṣu karmeṣu somāgneṣṭeṣu prāpyate |
asti tu some'pi hotṛvaraṇaṃ 'agnihotā sa me hotā hotastvaṃ me hotā'si iti hotāraṃ pṛṇīte' iti |
tatra vicāryate, kiṃ aiṣṭikepu karmeṣu darśapūrṇamāsika hotṛ- varaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ uta neti |
sāṅgatya somasya karaṇena ca ānatasya ānamanakāryamasti |
naitadasti, 'saumikaṃ varaṇaṃ prasaṅgāt darśapūrṇamāsikasya kāryaṃ sādhayiṣyati' iti |
pravṛtte varaṇān, pravṛtte karmaṇi dāśapūrṇamāsikaṃ varaṇaṃ kriyate |
na cet kriyate tena guṇavaiguṇyaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet paśyasi pravṛttavaraṇāt hotṛvaraṇaṃ pratikarma kartavyamiti, brahmā'pi pravṛtte karmaṇi kriyate |
varaṇāduttarakālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ karma, tadarthaṃ varaṇaṃ karmārtham |
bhāṣyam-- ayojyeta, asti amāvāsyāyāṃ aupavasathye ahani vedikarmaṃ nirdiṣṭam, 'pūrvedyuramā- vāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti' iti |
bhāṣyam-- pūrvedyuramāvāsyāyāṃ vedikaraṇaṃ śrutam, na parigraham, aśrutatvāt |
yathākālameva dhṛte brahmaṇaḥ parigrahaḥ kariṣyate, varaṇasya karmārthatvāt |
darśa- pūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe haviṣāṃ abhivāsanādūrdhvaṃ vedikaraṇa- māmnātam |
tasminnapa- kṛṣyamāṇe parigraho'pi apakṛṣṭaḥ, prasavo'pi, brahmavara- ṇamapi, 'pradhānadeśakālatvāt guṇānām |
evaṃ sati paurṇa- māsyāṃ praṇayanakāle brahmavaraṇam, amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvayuḥ |
ato na pratikarma brahmavaraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ saumikenaiva varaṇena ānatatvāt brahmaṇaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet paśyasi, yadyapi pravṛtte karmaṇi brahmaṇo varaṇam, na ca varaṇāt prāk kiṃcit
brahmaṇaḥ karmasti, tasmāt na pravṛttavaraṇo brahmā iti |
hoturapi prāk varaṇāt na kiṃcit karmāsti |
bhāṣyam-- asti hotuḥ prāgvaraṇāt sāmidhenī- karmaṇā saṃyogaḥ 'avataḥ sāmidhenīranvāha' iti |
tat aiṣṭikepu karmeṣu dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu kartavyam, brahmavaraṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭārtham, tat saumikenaiva kṛtatvāt na kartavyamiti |

śā-- hotṛvaraṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ uta adṛṣṭārthatvāt kartavyamiti saṃśaye, varaṇasya ānatarthyatvāt, ānatiśca saumikena varaṇena prasaṅgāt siddhā ataḥ na kartavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte, pravṛtta varaṇaṃ na kathaṃcid dṛṣṭārthe bhavati |
dakṣiṇādānaṃ hi bhaviṣyadavaśyamapi bhavati āna- tinimittam, loke tathā darśanāt na tu varaṇena bhāvinā bhavati ānamanaṃ tasmāt adṛṣṭārtham |
amāvāsyāyāmapi pūrvedyurapakṛṣyamāṇā vediḥ svāṅgabhūtapasavasiddhaye brahmaṇo varaṇamapyakarṣati |
soma-- bhakṣāṇāṃ kṛtakāryatvābhāve'pi varaṇaṃ ānatarthyatvāt kṛtakāryaṃ iti ucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- dārśikaṃ hotṛvaraṇamapi somāyane samantra- keṇa varaṇena dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu na prajñāyate, prakṛtau tasyā- dṛṣṭārthatvāt |
pravṛtteṣu hi keṣucit padārtheṣu paścāt 'agnirdaivyo hotā devān yakṣat' ityādinā prakṛtau hotṛvaraṇamāmnātam |
atastasya pravṛttatvena dṛṣṭārthatvānupa- patteḥ adṛṣṭārthatvāvasāyāt apravṛttābhyantaratvenā- dṛṣṭārthena saumikena na prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
na ca pravṛttābhya- satve'pi brahmavaraṇavat adṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ brahmavaraṇasyāpi

pūrvadhuḥ vedikaraṇābhyanujñānātthaṃ pravṛttasyāpi praṇītāpraṇaya- nāt pūrvaṃ karaṇāditi vācyam, paurṇamāsyāṃ tāvat vedikaraṇasya havirabhivāsanāt uttarakālīnatvena pūrvedyuḥ- kālatvābhāvāt praṇītāpraṇayanakālī nabrahmavaraṇasya apra- vṛttābhyardhanarūpatayā dṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ, amāvāsyāyāmapi vedikaraṇapakarṣe tadaṅgabhūtābhyanujñānārthatayā brahmavaraṇasyāpi arthakrameṇa pāṭhakramaṃ bādhitvā apakarṣasaṃbhavena apravṛttā- bhyardhanarūpatayā dṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ |
na caivaṃ hotṛvaraṇasyāpi arthakramādanusārāt sāmidhenītaḥ pūrve karaṇāpattiḥ |
ayaṃ hi svatantraḥ sāmi- dhenīmātre varaṇaparyadāsaḥ |
ataśca asyāpakarṣānupapatteḥ pravṛttābhyardhanarūpatvena adṛṣṭārthatvāt na prasaṅgaḥ |
brahma- varaṇasya tu dṛṣṭārthatvāt eva prasaṅga iti vaiṣamyam |

na ca pravṛttābhyardhanarūpatve loke lobhabaśena saṃdehe'pi yatkiṃcitkarmaṇi pravṛttasyāpi karmakarasya madhye niśāyakalināderdṛṣṭārthatvavat varaṇasaṃdehe'pi svalomena sāmidhenīṣu pravṛttasyāpi hotuḥ madhye varaṇasya dṛṣṭārthatvopapattiḥ iti vācyam |

saṃdehrena pravṛttasya kadācit parigraho'pyaṅgapradhānayoḥ ekakartṛkatvāghāpāteḥ avaśyaṃ yajamānenaiva sāmidhenītaḥ pūrve laukikasya apra- vṛttābhyardhanāyupāyasya karaṇena asya vaidhavaraṇasya adṛṣṭā- rthatvāvaśyakatvāt |
ata eva 'avataḥ' ityasya vaidha- varaṇaśūnyaḥ ityevārthaḥ |
evaṃ ca ṛtajāyāvaraṇena vṛtta- varaṇatvameva adṛṣṭārthatvaprayojakam, na tu apravṛttyarthatvaṃ ityapi dhyeyam |
na caivaṃ sati adṛṣṭārthake varaṇe varaṇa- śabdasya aupacārikatāpatiḥ |
ataśca saumikena varaṇena brahmavaraṇa- meva prasajyate na tu hotṛvaraṇaṃ iti siddham |
vastutastu saumikasya varaṇasya prākṛtavaraṇadeva kartṛsaṃskāraka- tayā aṅgapradhānārthatvāt, dakṣiṇāvacca pradhānārthatva- grāhakābhāvāt, tena aiṣṭikabrahmavaraṇade bādha eva na
vaiṣahotvaraṇasya tu so'pi na iti dhyeyam |
' hotravaraṇa somāthe 'yadyotāraṃ vṛṇīte jagatīṃ tad vṛṇīte' iti |
bhā. 11|1|19, hotravaraṇasya avamṛthe pratiṣedhaḥ 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte nārtheyam' iti |
su. pṛ. 110-1101. hotra hyate iti karmaṇi juhoteḥ 'huyāmāśru' iti auṇādike anpratyaye guṇe ca kṛte hotraśabdaḥ niṣpadyate |
su. pṛ. 418. hotraṃ homaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
ku. 3|2|127. hotrakāḥ hotṛvaṣaṭkāreṇa indre hute camasamamunīya devatāntaremyo'nuvaṣaṭkāreṇa juhvati |
homaḥ kriyātmakatvāt ki ityevamamānaḥ pradhānakathaṃbhāvena itthaṃ anugrāhyatvena gṛhyate naivaṃ dravyam |
vā. 2|1|4|2 pṛ. 411. homaḥ citreṣṭau 'agre gorminaṃ' ityādibhiḥ puṣṭimantraireva |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|15. mīko. pṛ. 1709 'citreṣṭau 'agre gorminaṃ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
evaṃ 'catasraḥ pūrṇāḥ prāgudīcyo ninayet ṛtubhyaḥ svāhā, digbhyaḥ svāhā, saptakaṛṣibhyaḥ svāhā, itarajanebhyaḥ svāhā' ityādihitasya udakaninayanādeḥ mānavavarṇikadevatā'danyāt homatā |
su. pṛ. 1104. homaḥ darvihomeṣu pratihomaṃ samidhamādhāyaiva |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|8. mīko. pṛ. 2016 'darvihomeṣu pratihomaṃ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vi. 4|12|7. homaḥ 'phalavākye yajereva saṃbandhaḥ śrūyate sphuṭaḥ |
ye tu juhoticodanātpatyaḥ teṣu pūrvādharbhūto'pi yajiḥ ārambhā vā bhaviṣyati, athavā teṣāmapi ṣoḍaśam |
2|1|4|14 pṛ. 983. homaḥ 'sūryeṇa juhoti' ityuktaḥ apūrvaprayuktaḥ na tu sūryādihetutvaprayuktaḥ cāturmāsyavaruṇapraghāseṣu |
vā. 3|2|13 pṛ. 205. homaḥ somasya, uttaravedyāṃ bhavati |
vi. 3|5|11. homaḥ āsecanolakṣitaprakṣepadhiko yāgo homaḥ, na tu yāgamātraṃ bhavati |
su. pṛ. 1428. iṣṭiyāgaḥ sa eva ca āsecanādhiko homaḥ |
bhā. 6|8|17. devatāmuddiśya dravyatyāgo (na mama ityākārakaḥ) yāgaḥ, tyaktasya ca vahau prakṣepo homaḥ |
vā. 3|4|14|1 pṛ. 981, 'athavā naiva midhyete yāgahomau parasparam |
tena ubhau militvā nimittaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke- ke. homāmiṣavayoḥ kartā bhakṣaṇaṃ prati akṣatvena homāvṛttiḥ darśādau medanānimittādṛṣṭyā |
pūrvamaprāptatvāt ' havirdhāne prāvabhirabhyuhāvanīyai vi. 6|2|9. hutvā 0 ' ityanena vidhīyate |
yugapadekakapālamedane homa- miṣavayoḥ sahitayoḥ bhakṣaṇanimittatā na pratyekam |
homāmiṣavanimittāḥ vaṣaṭkāranimittāśca śeṣa- 6|5|1|138-39. mīko. pṛ. 2108 ' dīkṣotkarṣe maśca jyotiṣṭome |
te ca na parikāryāḥ kiṃtu saṃrakṣā- agnihotrādīnāmapi utkarṣaḥ ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhā. 3|5|1|132 pṛ. 1009. homamātre codite vedādhyāyī śaktaḥ ityadhi- homāmiṣavabhakṣaṇaṃ ca tadvat |
homamātrarūpeṇa phale vihitasya karmaṇaḥ dravyādi- agnihome ' havirdhāne prāvabhirabhyuhya āvahanīye grahaṇe virodhābhāvaḥ |
su. pṛ. 777. hutvā prayajñaḥ pretya sadasi bhakṣān bhakṣyanti ' iti homalakṣaṇam |
tatra bhakṣaṇe homaśca abhyava pratyekaṃ tadukte śravaṇājjuhotirāsecanādhikaḥ syāt |
nimittaṃ yathā pañcaśarāve pratyekasya haviḥ ātiḥ 4|2|1|38 |
homaśca abhyava bhāṣyam— atha killakṣaṇako juhotiriti |
homāmiṣavābhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ homāmiṣavaṃsaṃyu- yadyukte'yai juhotiḥ śrūyate, āsecanādhike |
homāmiṣavasaṃyuktaṃ ca tat bhakṣaṇaṃ ca homāmiṣava- yajatirevā''secanādhiko juhotiḥ |
tadvat havi- jātīyake vakāro bhavanti loke |
' saṃgrāmimaṃ caturhotrā yājayet ', ubhābhyāṃ vā, nahi tayordharmaśāstram |
' caturgṛhītāmyaṃ kṛtvā caturhotāraṃ nyāyacchīta, pūrveṇa homaścabhakṣaṇe homaśca abhyava pratyekaṃ nimittaṃ graheṇārthe juhuyāduttareṇārtham ' iti |
atha dadātiḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ prāsaṅgena nivārayan siddhānta- killakṣaṇaka iti |
yajatitadāhutihotuḥ sarvopasargaḥ cena somabhakṣaḥ syāt, na pratyekaṃ nimittatvena |
tatra yajatitadaivatādyudiśyasaṃjñāmatram, juhoti- homāmiṣavayoḥ dharmasya bhakṣaṇasya śāstraṃ vidhānaṃ nahi, rāsecanādhikaḥ, dadātistatsargapūrvakaḥ parasvatvena saṃbandha nāstyeva |
yadi tayodharmo vidhīyeta tato homāmiṣavau ityeṣa eṣā viśeṣa iti |
pradhānaṃ iti bhakṣaṇaṃ guṇaḥ pratipradhānaṃ bhidyeta |
atha punaḥ [ śā- vi-bhāṭṭa-granyeṣṣu idamadhikaraṇaṃ pūrvā- ubhābhyāṃ nimittābhyāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ vidhīyate |
] eko'rtho vihito bhavati, tena ekaṃ vākyam |
' ' tyāgaḥ vati paryavasitaṃ bhavati ' abhyuhya hutvā bhakṣyanti ' |

hyavadānasya homavat saṃskāra- baudhāyanīye taittirīyaireva pratipanne ityatra tatra tatra gṛhya- katvāt pratyekamanusamayaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cenna, pratyekaṃ vyavasthā'pyupagamādi darśayitvā vicārayitavyam |
bhāṭṭa. 5|2|7. tāni teṣāmeva pramāṇānyuta sarvāṇi sarveṣāmiti ? ' kiṃ homasādhanatvena pitarādayaḥ śūrpeṇa vikalpyante, tāvatpratipattavyaṃ vyavasthā'pyeti pāṭhataḥ |
na hyanyatra ' śūrpeṇa juhoti ' iti vidhāya ' tena hyannaṃ kriyate ' sthitaliṅgālliṅgedhanyatrānumīyate |
anumīyate'ne- iti hetusamarpaṇāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
' tacca vyavasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā stutistu procanopayuktā iti stāvakameva ' tena hyannaṃ liṅgī tatraiva gamyatām |
vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā kriyate ' iti vākyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
holākā sarvalokadharmaḥ, mānau tadviṣayāvevānumātuṃ śakyate nānyagatau |
teṣā- bhāṣyam— anumānāt smṛterācārāṇāṃ ca prāmā- mevāgnihotrādi vidhirdhayavagamyate |
yenaiva hetunā te pramāṇaṃ tenaiva vyavasthāḥ jātibhedadakuladharmā vyavasthāitāḥ |
tasmāt holākādayaḥ prācyaireva kartavyāḥ; dharmādivyavasthā'pi bhaviṣyati |
yadi syātsa- āhīnaibukādayo dākṣiṇātyaireva, uddacyabhayaśādayaḥ rgamātmitaṃ vidhānapratiṣedhayoḥ |
hyācāraḥ sarvadeśagaśaktitamapuruṣaiḥ agnihotravedānuṣṭhī- vā— ' deśadharmānudāhṛtya saṃpratyetadvicāryate |
vidhya- tena nūnaṃ śrutiḥ kā''pi teṣāmeva vidhāyikā |
iha sarve anyathā'nupapattyā ca śrutistra pratīyete |
teṣāmevo- yasmādayaṃ deśācāro'yaṃ vā gallādigrantho'nyathā nopapadyate padiṣṭāste sarveṣāṃ veti cintyate |
evaṃ ye dākṣi- yadi śrutimūlakatvaṃ nāstītyanyathā mūlakalpanā pātyānāṃ pratīcyānāṃ ca kecana |
ādyaṃ sūtra- yadi ca heturutprekṣitaṃ nirdiśati |
tattatrātiprasaṅgaḥ syāt darvipiṭha- dipraṇītadharmaśāstrāṇāṃ gṛhyagranthānāṃ ca prātiśākhyalakṣaṇava- rādiṣu |
na ca tasya ākṛtivacanatā nyāyyā, na ca vyaktivacanatā |
na sarvasāmānyāṇāṃ yadekaṃ sāmānyam, tasya vācakaḥ kaścicchabdo'sti, yo'numīyeta |
kutaḥ ? padārthīḥ kartavyatā iti pramāṇamasti, vyavasthāyāṃ tu na kiṃcit pramāṇamasti |
vā-- ' api vā sarvadharmaḥ syādityatrottara- mucyate |

' iha smṛtīvārāttrāśopalabhya mūlaśrutimanu- mīyamānāsu kāraṇānāṃvidhāyikanyāyena avaśyamupalabhya- mānakāryānurūpakāraṇānāmevamityamiti bhāvanānāma- viśeṣavaccihnanāgādānahomopavāsādidhārthaviśeṣa- svargādiphalakāraketikartavyatāvidhāyaḥ tāvadanumātavyāḥ |

evaṃ varjanīyatve'pi dehendriyamodādaravyavahāreṣu prati- ṣedhyakriyākārakaṃ narakāyanihaphalapratiṣedhaścakadānumāna- mavaśyaṃbhāvi tāvatā ca yogyatvamātraviṣayatvānna digdeśa- paricchinnakartṛviśeṣādhikāraniyatapratipattilābhaḥ |
kutaḥ ? ' tridhaiva jñāyate kartā viśeṣeṇa prativikram |
varjanī- yayogyatāmapi yayopalabhyamānaṃ dvistricaturvarṇaśramātrā- saṃbaddhaṃ vā tadabhyadhikadarśanānumitasamastamlecchādiviṣayaṃ vā vijñāyate |
tadvā- cyapi padaṃ kiṃcidanumātuṃ na śakyate |
' yogyatve- nāviśeṣapravṛtta''pyadhikāraḥ kenacitkaviśeṣapadena rājā rājasūyena, vaiśyo vaiśyastomena ityādiviśeṣyeta na cātra hṛdayamānācarituvāci kiṃcidemanekaṃ saṃbhāvayituṃ śakyam |
' na tāvatprāpyatvadākṣiṇyāttvādijātiḥ pratīcyodīcyādivyaktivyāvṛttyā sarvaprāpyatvadikṣipnu- gatā kācidupapadyate |
yāstu manuṣyatvādbrahmatvādijātayaḥ tāsu vihante tāḥ sarvaiśvasāviṣyaktipaviśiṣṭā iti nā''- cārānurūpaviśeṣaṇasamarthatvena jñāyante |
na hi kāścidapi guṇakriyājātirūpyaḥ pratideśavyavasthita- puruṣavyaktyapalakṣaṇayogyāḥ saṃbhāvyante |
śaktamātrā''pyadhikārapravṛttavidhānaviśeṣaṃ yenopapadenā- numīyamānena kriyate ' na tasyā'''kṛtvacanatā nyāyyā na vyaktivacanatā ' iti |
na hyete holācācārāḥ kāci- dākṛtimanutiṣṭhante na vyaktiṃ na hi yāvatsu puruṣeṣvete- 'vasthitāstāvatāmekenāpi vyapadeśonopasaṃgrahaḥ saṃbhavati |

keṣāṃcitsyā'''kṛtvacanatā nyāyyā na vyaktivacanateti granthastheṣāmāmnāyaḥ yathaiva ' jātiṃ tu bādarāyaṇo'viśe- ṣāt ' ( 6|1|8 ) iti sūtrakāraḥ svargakāmapadaṃ yaugikamapyuddiśyamānapuṃstvaviśeṣaṇasaṃbhavāt phalārthi- mātramanuṣyajātiviṣayopapatteśca sāmarthyātkajātimātrā- dhikāraṃ vakṣyati, tathaivāpi phalārthitvakartṛtvāttvāva- bodhanāt |

dūṣayitvā pūrvameva samarthyamānaḥ sūtragatayāvacchruti- dhānaśabdajanitārttivibhāvanayośca bhedamapaśyanubhaya- svarūpanirūpaṇaparyantayogatrāsāṅgācāryādhikaraṇasiddhāntaṃ vināśayenmāha bhāva iti vā''mnāyaiḥ svadharmeṇa |

tena yaḥ kaścidākhyātpratyayārthatattvaṃ jijñāsamānaḥ pṛcchati kaḥ punarayaṃ bhāvo bhāvanā ceti taṃ pratyanaya- śabdākhyaiyatāt kevalapratyayaprayogadarśanābhāvācca sarva- dhāsvarthādātmyavacanakartorityādigucāraṇamātreṇaivattara dākṣyate kuryācchabda ityarthaḥ; sarvaiṣā''khyāyamāno'thai ākṛtirūpeṇa vā''khyāyeta vyaktyākṛtigocarāti- krāntikaścillā''khyātśabdānenopāyārahitavādanākhyeyo- 'syārtha iti |
' na tasyā'''kṛtvacanatā nyāyyā na vyakti- vacanatā ' iti |
vidhānaśabdo hi sūtre pūrvaṃ prakṛtastameva tacchabdena nirdiśya vyaktyākṛtivacanatādapanayati |
' tadidamasaṃbhavemānupapattiṃ ca śrutisāmānyābhyāmenā- nyārthameva sacchattuḥśaṅkādimanvavadhyākhyākārāmipretārthatyāgena svaprajñāvilasitaṃ prakāśayatā''tmaslevāyai yojitām |
deśācārasarvadharmopapatticāraṇārtho'yaṃ granthaḥ sa yadi pūrvakṛtayā vyākhyopapadanirakāraṇaviṣayatvena varṇyate tata etatsūtravyākhyanena saṃdhayate yathoktanyāyamārgeṇa |
meva vyaktyākṛtirahitārthatvena varṇyatetato'ntāsaṃbaṃdhananu- payujyamānanirupapattikārthatvena heya eva syāt |

' yadi nāma liṅgādityayo bhāvanāyā vidhervā vyakti- mākṛtiṃ vā vadettato holākādayaḥ pratiniyatadeśa- dharmāṇāṃ bhaveyuryatastu vyaktyākṛtivinirmuko''pyadeśyo- 'thaistassāttvādihitārthaviṣayaḥ sarvapuruṣadharma ityevaṃ nīyamānamarthamudāharaṇe jyeṣṭhameva syāt |
anvā- khyānaṃ kṛtaṃ tacca pūrvakena virudhyate |

yadyapi tāvadā- khyātpratyayaḥ kartṛtvādityādārahyamātraṃ vā vadettathāpi ' brāhmaṇo yajamānaḥ ' itivadupadadhātiviśeṣavākṣā- natvācchadīnajātyāditvittamanurudhyamāno na svagatavya- kyākṛtivacanatvavicārādhīnādhikāratvanirṇayaḥ |
yadi caitāvanmātrameva sarvadharmatvakāraṇaṃ bhavettato rājasūyāśvamedhayajñomādīnāmevamāramakā- khyātpratyayavidheyatvāviśeṣataḥ sarvadharmatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
tadyathā cottarasūtrāṇi ' liṅgābhāvācca nityasa ' ' ākhyā hi deśasaṃyogāt ' ityevamādīnyupapada- nyāsapratyākhyānārthāni saṃgṛhyante |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ yathā śilākalpo vyava- tiṣṭhate iti gotravyavasthā yathā śilākalpavyavasthayā darśanaṃ spaṣṭam |

' yathaiva pañcāvattaṃ tu bhṛgāṇāṃ vasiṣṭhasyakātri- vaccāṇakavaṃsakṛtarājānāṃ nārādheśo dvitīyaḥ prayāja- stanapādanveṣāmityanyato vyatirekataścopalakṣaṇasaṃbhavā- dvyavasthitiviṣayatvasānaṃ tathaiva pratijñāvigotraniyata-
kāni tāni padāni ? atha kimarthaṃ na liṅgād vyavasthā ? yathā 'śukle drotā' iti |
ye'pi śyāmā vṛhanto lohitākṣāste'pi na sarvaṃ āhīnaibukādīn kurvate |
' jātivyaktyācyapapadābhāve'pi kartṛ- gatasaṃsthānavarṇādiguṇaviśeṣopalakṣaṇena kṛṣṇakeśadhānavat adhikāraniyamaḥ setyatītyāśaṅkya nirākriyate-- 'liṅgābhāvācca nityasya nāsti karturviśeṣaṇam |
' yastu liṅgaviśeṣaṇaṃ nityaśabdaṃ manyate tasya upasarjanabhūta- liṅgāpekṣatvādasa marthasamāsaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu liṅgaśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvāt svārthākṣisaṃbaṃdhyantaratvena sāmarthya- vighātābhāvāt mavitavyameveha samāsena devadattasya gurukulamiti yathā |
nityaṃ nāpekṣate liṅgaṃ devadattaṃ yathā guruḥ ||
' guruśabdasya hi śiṣyāpekṣa eva āramlābha iti devadattaśabdopāttaviṣayasaṃbandhānatirekānnati- svārthasyāmyadhikāpekṣatāsāmarthyapratibandhaprasaṅgaḥ |
' yadyapi caiṣa gamyamakasaṃbandhe sati liṅgaśabdaḥ pravartate tathā'pi guruśiṣyapitāputrādisaṃbandhasya tadapekṣapravṛ- ttinimittasaṃbandhaśabdatvaprasiddhiḥ |

' 'liṅgyate'neneti hi kriyā- yoganimitto yadyapi liṅgaśabda iti saṃdhiniśśabda- tvenocyate tathā'pi tu kriyāgatakārakāntarāpekṣāṃ na muñcatīti phārmaṃ 'liṅgino liṅgadarśanam' ityādi bhavedayathāvamarthaparihāraḥ |
nityatvaṃ punarlakṣaṇasyārthaliṅgā- pekṣitvaṃ taddharmatayā padyopanīyata iti tatsaṃbandhakathayā- maparihāryo'sāmarthyaprasaṅgaḥ |

tasmānnityasyeti niyata- cihnonopalakṣakatvaviśeṣamevādhikāraviśeṣaṇaṃ vā niyatasya karturnityasyādhikārasya vā na pratipādakaṃ kiṃciccihna- mastīti na tadabhidhāyyupapadaviśeṣitavyavasthitaholā- kādividhānopapattiḥ |
ye dākṣiṇātyā iti samākhyātāste āhīnaibukādīn kariṣyanti, ye udīcyā iti samākhyātāste uddaṣabha- yajñādīn, ye prācyā iti te holākādīn |
dakṣiṇadeśāccirgataḥ prāṅ vā udaṅ vā'vasthitaḥ āhīnaibukādīn karotyeva |
udīcyāśca deśāntare ud- vṛṣabhayajñādīn, prācyāśca holākādīn |
anyadeśaśca deśāntaragato na niyogataḥ parapadārthān karoti |
' sarve hi deśācārāḥ prācyādākṣiṇātyādisamākhyātaḥḥ puruṣaiḥ kriyante samākhyāvatiteṣu ca nopalabhyante |
' samākhyāyāstāvana deśānyaccinimittamasti tadviśeṣavidhivihitāśāssārāḥ kevalameva taddeśasaṃbandha- manuvartaten |
ubhayā'pi tu vyabhicāraṇa deśanimitta- samākhyāviśeṣaviśiṣṭatvena ghaṭate |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet paśyasi, yadi deśasaṃyo- gāt ākhyā bhavet, deśāntarasthasya na bhavet |
vā-- aparasvanayaivopapattyā labdhātmīyakṣopapattiḥ pratyavatiṣṭhamāna āha-- 'na syādeśāntareṣviti cet' iti |
astu vā nirnimittaiva viśeṣayati tathā'pi tu |
' tassādanityā samākhyayaivādhikaviśeṣa- siddhena vyabhicāradeśanimittatvamasyāḥ kalpayitavyami- tyukte abhīyate |
bhāṣyam-- deśasaṃyoganimittāmapyākhyāyāṃ deśā- nnirgatasya tadākhyā na viruddhā |
yata eṣā yogārakhyā yogamātrāpekṣā, na bhūtavartamānabhaviṣyatsaṃbandhāpekṣā |
yato dṛśyate mathurābhipresthito māthura iti, mathuryāṃ vasan mathurāyā nirgataśca |
yasya tvato'nyatamaḥ saṃbandho nāsti na sa māthuraḥ |
' 'so''sya nivāsaḥ' 'tatra bhavastatra jātastata āgata ityevamādinimittaparityāgena na kadācitmākhyādi- samākhyā vartate |
na caināmācāro'nuvartate tannivāsināpi keṣāṃcidā- caraṇācciranirgataputrapautrādīnāṃ ca deśāntareṣvapyācaraṇā- diti na samākhyayā niyatavidhisiddhiḥ |
yattu mathurā- mabhipresthito māthura iti bhāṣyakāreṇoktaṃ tat 'tadgacchati pathi dūtyoḥ' iti vā dūtaviṣayaṃ kalpayitavyam- pratyayitotkaratvādā upekṣitavyam |
yaḥ kṛṣṇamṛttikāsthasya, 'māthuraḥ' āhīnaibukādīnām, yathā 'prācīnapravaṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta' iti |
bhāṣyam-- yathā kartavyavyavasthitaṃ liṅgaṃ śyāmādi na padārthaiḥ saṃvādamupaiti, taddeśaliṅgameva vyavasthitam |
kṛṣṇa- mṛttikāprāye'pyanye na kurvanti, tathā'nyaliṅgai'pi kurvanti |
prāgadeśo yo hi keṣāṃcidanyeṣāṃ dakṣiṇa- pāthaḥ |
idānīṃ keṣāṃcit ācārāṇāṃ smṛtīnāṃ ca vyavasthā avyavasthā vā iti cintyate |
holākādo hi kaiścideva prācyādyābhimānibhiranuṣṭhīyante na sarvaiḥ |
i gadyāṇi mānavātiriktāśca smṛtayaḥ kaiścideva kāścit
tadayaṃ ca kiṃ teṣāṃ smṛtirmūlabhūtā vyavasthitaviṣayā śakyate kalpayituṃ uta sarvasādhāraṇyeva iti|
dhūmo hi yatra tatraiva vahnirnyatra mīyate|
yadi ca sādhāraṇa śrutiḥ syāt tatastanmūlaiḥ smṛtyācārāvapi sarvopagāminau syātām|
yadi hi ālasyādinimittamitareṣāṃ anācaraṇaṃ tadā syādapi sādhāraṇānumānam|
yattu prācyādyabhimāninā- mācaraṇaṃ itareṣāṃ ca anācaraṇaṃ na tatsādhāraṇānumāne- 'vakalpate|
ubhayavādi- siddhenaiva vidhinā asati viśeṣopādāne sarvadharmatvasiddheḥ|
tathāhi smṛtayaḥ tāvat sādhāraṇyenaiva vida- dhatīti na teṣu caraṇaviśeṣopādānamasti|
smṛtyanu- sāyaiva ca śrutikalpanimiti tadapi sādhāraṇaṃ nyāyyam|
kartā hi chandogaḥ svaśiṣyān chandogān svagranthe adhyāpayamāsa|
te api anyān chandogān chandogīyasya chandogeḥ pāṭhaḥ|
tathā āpastambagranthasya taittirīyarevaṃ gṛhya- granthānāmapi iti vyavasthitadharmaviṣayatvaṃ apramāṇakam|
ācārāṇāṃ tu sarvācaritṛgataṃ anācaritṛmyaśca nyāyyaṃ ākṛtivyaktiguṇasaṃsthānādikaṃ na kiṃcit viśeṣaṃ saṃbhavati, yadupadāya holādhikāraṃ viśiṣyāt|
tathā prācyādisamākhyā'pi vyabhicāriṇī taddeśagatānā- mapi keṣāṃcit anācaraṇāt|
tassāt asati viśeṣaṇe sarvadharmatvaṃ ācārāṇāṃ smṛtīnāṃ ca iti siddham|
soma - viṣayapariśodhanena tatrāmāṇyasya sthirī- karaṇāt prāmāṇyasya svātantryābhāvasya ca asattve vyavasthā- vicārānupapatteśca saṃgatiriti|
sūtrārtharastu- anu- māpakasya vyavasthitatvāt vyavasthāsaṃyuktameva śrutirūpaṃ pramāṇamanumeyaṃ syāditi|

' bhāṭṭa-- atha yatra smṛtiṣu pāṭhavyavasthā yathā gautamamīyāḥ chandogaireva, tathā ācāreṣu kartṛvyavasthā yathā holākādi prācyādyabhimānibhireva, tatra tadupameya- śrutiranumāpakasya niyataviṣayatvāt niyatādhikāri- kaiveti nānyestadanuṣṭheyam|
iti prāpte, yadyanumāpakaṃ niyataviṣayakaṃ tathāpi nānumeyaśrutau viśeṣaṃ prācyā- tvādi dātuṃ śakyam|
na hi prācyatvaṃ nāma sarvācaritra- nugataṃ jātivyaktisaṃsthānādibhirnirvaktuṃ śakyam|
gautamamīmāṃsateṣu na chandogādhikārasaraṇam, yena śrutāvipa tatsaṃbandhyeta|
kartā hi chandogaḥ svaśiṣyān chandogān granthamanadhyāpayamāsa|
te'pyanyāntyevaṃ pāṭhaḥ tanmātre vyavasthita iti tatrāpi sarvaviṣayameva|
tatrobhābhyāmācārābhyāṃ śrutyanumānaṃ sāmānyata eva syāt, dākṣiṇātyaprācyādyupapadakalpanāyāḥ holā- kādhikaraṇe nirastatvāt|
sāhasī. 899. holākādayaḥ kiṃ prācyānāmeva dharmaḥ uta sarveṣāṃ iti saṃdehahe sarveṣāmiti siddhāntaḥ|
su. pṛ. 189. holākācācāravyavasthākāraṇaṃ kartṛviśeṣa eva na deśaḥ|
su. pṛ. 257. holākotsavādiḥ sadācāraḥ śiṣṭācāratvāt pramāṇam|
vi. 1314 varṇaka 3. hautraṃ, ādhvaryavaṃ, audgātraṃ iti samākhyāyā dharmaniyamaḥ|
vi. 1316. hautramādhvaryavamaudgātra- miti samākhyāyā hotuḥ adhvaryoḥ udāttaśca tattatka- rmabhiḥ saṃnyadhaḥ|
hautraṃ iti buddhidarśanāt hotṛśabdāt tasyedaṃ karma ityevamanvākhyānaṃ iti gamyate|
vā. 3|1|9|140. hautraṃ iti samākhyāyā arthavatvāt hotā hautrasya kartā bhavati|
bhā. 12|4|14|135, hautramiti samākhyātāni karmāṇi hotā kartavyāni|
3|1|6|13. hautraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ amāvāsyāṃ prakṛtya āmnāyate 'idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame|
hautrāḥ, hotā anuvacanīyā ye mantrāḥ yūpocchrāya- ṇārthā vā yūpapariṇayārthā vā te ekārthatvāt ekakārya- karatvāt vikalparen iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ|
na vikalpaḥ kiṃtu samuccayaḥ syāt hautrāṇāṃ mantrā- ṇām|
'triḥ prathamānanvāha, triruttamān' ityādi liṅgaṃ hautrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ samuccayaṃ darśayati|
bhāṣyam-- hautrāstu ye mantrāḥ yūpocchrayaṇīyā vā 'uccyasva vanaspate' iti, yūpapariṇayārthā vā 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti, te vikalperan|
kaḥ punarayoviśeṣaḥ? 1 karaṇāḥ karomītyevaṃ pratyayaṃ kurvanti|
kriyamāṇānuvādinaḥ evaṃ kartavyamiti kathaṃ kṛtvā? ucyate|
eṣa ca pratyayaḥ sati pūrvasmin pratyaye bhavati|
yo hi sarati idaṃ mayā kartavyamiti, sa tat karoti|
tena ca karmaṇā ākāṅkṣitatvāt smaraṇātha ete vijñāyante|
smaraṇārthasya ca mantrasya āmnānasāmarthyāt sāritaṃ kṛta- mahadarthāya bhavati yathāpreṣitaṃ kṛtam|
pratateṣu ca karmasu smṛtisaṃtānenāthaḥ ityanekasyāpi kriyamāṇānuvādino mantrasyaikasminneva prayoge saṃbhavaḥ iti kriyamāṇānuvāditvādvātrāṇāṃ samuccayaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- ' triḥ prathamāmanuvāha, tristattamāmanvāha, jyotiṣmatīranubrūyāt ' iti |
śā-- ' uccaiyasva vanaspate ' ityādi yo kriya- māṇānuvādino hautrā mantrāḥ teṣāmapi karaṇavat ekārtha- tvāt vikalpaprāptau ucyate |
karaṇāni hi karmānuṣṭhāna- karaṇabhūtā smṛti pūrvakṣaṇavartinī kurvanti |
na ca ekena tasiddhau itareṇa kāryamastīti yuktaḥ tatra vikalpaḥ |
ke-- brāhmaṇavihitānāṃ prathanādimantrāṇāmiva hautrā- ṇāmapi vikalpa ityutthānāt dṛṣṭāntasaṃgatiḥ |
vi-- ' udvicetyuccaiyasvati vikalpo vā samu- ccayaḥ |
' kartavyaṃ karoti ' iti smṛtiprakārānva- tvāt kāryakyābhāvāt samuccayaḥ |
dvitīyavarṇakamāracayati-- ' uccaiyasva samiddha- śvetādīnāṃ kiṃ vikalpanām |
' bhāṭṭa-- ye tu kriyamāṇānuvādino hautrā mantrāḥ, teṣāmapi kriyamāṇakarmasmṛtijanakatvena dṛṣṭārthatvasyaiva mantrādhikaraṇe kaustubhe sthāpitatvāt karaṇamantravat vikalpaḥ |
iti prāpte, karaṇamantrajanyāsmṛteḥ anuṣṭhāna- janakatvena ekena siddhau itarasya vaiyarthyāpattau vikalpaḥ |

prakṛte tu adhvaryuṇā kriyamāṇasya bahukṣaṇavyāptasya karmaṇaḥ smṛtivicchedārthe punaḥpunaḥ smaraṇāt anekairapi mantraiḥ tattadāpādārāṃ saraṇopapatteḥ aghadoṣaduṣṭavikalpā- yogena yukta eva samuccayaḥ |
ata eva ' triḥ prathamā- manvāha tristattamām ', ' jyotiṣmatīranubrūyāt ' ityā- dikāni liṅgānyapi saṃgacchante |
maṇḍana-- ' hautra mantraḥ syāt samuccaye eva |
yathā hṛdanakrayoḥ paraspara- viyuktayoḥ dhīvareṇa pradharṣaṇīyatā bhavati, saṃyuktayostu parasparasāhāyyamācaratordurdharṣatā bhavati, tathā prakṛte'pi |
